If in a group have someone get off the plane asap get right through and head for the Cambio Exchange counter Otherwise you may be queued up for a while The rates are fair There is a small drinks stand down an alleyway between Arrivals Departures Assuming you were smart enough to bring back some CUC or got a small amount in the airport the beers pop are cold cheap Still only for a Crystal or Buccanero but oddly enough its Peso for a Tucola Cheaper than on the bus if offered Back in March there was extensive work being done to bring more AC to the upper level and close in the open outside balcony on the upper level I guess the crowding factor made them notice The duty free is the best deal in town Not being computerized for checkin does have its drawbacks when it comes to seat selection etc Especially when HOG is a stop on the way and others have already boarded Found no difference between Cubana SkyService its the airport running the show The Customs Immigration staff always seem to be polite but not too friendly after all they do have a job to do protecting Cuba Once we left and nobody wanted my cigar documents another time they were all over the boxes A few pleasantries en Espanol goes a long way Be a gracious tourist and learn some of the lingo Note that liquids in carryons is not the concern as in most other countries Full bottles of rum No problem Bottles of lotion No problem And this is for goods packed before Security screening not after like with duty free stuff

Such a comfortable and convenient airport to use The relaxed feeling that I experienced was something you dont normally feel in airports Everything and everyone seemed to be at a relaxed pace and the friendliness of the immigration staff was very pleasant The baggage arrived promptly and even the customs staff seemed very friendly as I passed by At the exit to the car park I was asked by a couple of international visitors if I could assist them as they lost their car park ticket I went with them to the car park and visitor reception desk and the two ladies there were very understanding and helpful There were hand sanitising dispensers and hand towels available throughout the concourse and what is different about Shannon airport is that the sanitising foam dispensers were well stocked compared to other airports that all seem to have the dispensers but they are all empty

I had a heartbreaking day on my departure day So when I was checking in at Delta I was crying actually more like bawling Well I wasnt at first but when Ms Carol asked me how was my day tears just fell and couldnt stop itfelt heavyso I really appreciate that question a lot she gave me some small talk which made me open up a bit and thats when I started crying She didnt have to continue comforting me but she did and I felt it in my heart Ms Ammi saw me crying and offered me some juice and orange and a Chocolate cupcake and also comforted me despite how busy they were They are the best strangers Ive encountered at that moment too for the longest time and that made me feel way lighter So I think its not about the place or the airline its the people that works within a truly unforgettable experience even though that was a month ago I am talking about the Ground staff of Delta Airlines in Baltimore Airport They did their jobs with passion and understanding and I salute them all

Completely pleasant airport Small very clean shopcaferestaurantprices much lower than in Borispol Easily accessible from center by taxi or trolleybus just plan enough time in traffic peaks of Kyiv and Close to very recommendable planemuseum in pedestrian distancemaybe mins to walk Customs working attentively but very polite Immigration takes usually more time mins in average than emigration but much more quickly than in Borispol The same about security Free wifi works properly and fast Have no post office in terminal but one across parking lot located left direction of entrance behind the power plant of the airport

Pokhara to Kathmandu I received very good service by Yeti Airlines at Pokhara and Kathmandu airport on st Dec Due to fog my flight was delayed I had a connecting flight to Delhi from Kathmandu to Delhi at The Staff at Pokhara Airport were very helpful to my request to advance my booking to an earlier flight and ensured my luggage was loaded in the cabin itself so that I could get it first when I landed at Kathmandu At Kathmandu the staff unloaded my luggage and took me in the small van to the terminal so I could leave the airport quickly I would rate this as excellent service On my next trek in Nepal I would fly this airline again

This review is limited to Terminal A I havent flown through Terminal A in years but it still remains a very modern airport terminal It is spacious with plenty of seating and dining options especially at Gates A There is a rather long underground walkway from these gates to the main terminal A The walkway is beneath the tarmac and runways We dined at Legal Seafoods before departure to DFW Excellent food The terminal was very busy given the snowstorm and delayed flights Bathrooms were okay but could have been cleaner WiFi was very fast and easy to connect too Kudos to Logan airport snow clearing crews and the crews deicing planes Our flight to DFW was delayed but we managed to take off Throughout the storm planes kept taking off and landing

BirminghamShuttlesworth Airport is absolutely exceptional across the board Modern well laid out and astonishingly clean Good facilities throughout Parking easy and close to the terminal The modernization of all the facilities done smoothly I live miles away close to another commercial airport but gladly drive the three hour round trip to fly from BHM as I will in April
Brilliant little airport with thoughtful touches such as free snacks and water Only downside was the open air departure lounges so no air conditioning ie humidity very high

I have been using Bangalore Airport for years and as Indian airports go it has been at the better end of pleasant travel experiences The new Terminal for international flights and some airlines such as Vistara is a revelation amazing feeling of space and the plants on nearly every wall and ceiling give a wonderful effect Security is efficient with minimal queues the or times I have departed There are more and more shops and eateries appearing too

This is a good smaller airport to fly in and out of The terminal is new and it shows Also staff are friendly and helpful This terminal is also well located as it is actually on the outskirts of the city not outside of the city In addition it is served by local transit However there is one accessibility issue While the lanes for commercial providers are covered and wide there is only a lane uncovered pickup area on the arrivals level for private vehicles This results in congestion during heavier arrival times

I would like to convey my heartfelt thanks to Sharon and Gayithri who were on duty at the information counter at Seletar Airport Singapore on the eve of CNY reunion evening They both have gone out of their way above and beyond their normal duties in helping me to get a taxi My flight arrived at pm I tried to get a ride to no avail I decided to wait it out at the airport cafeteria after which I thought to try again this time at the taxi stand When I exited the building however the taxi stand seemed empty The police security on duty suggested I ask for help at the information counter by arrivals and I did that Sharon and her colleague persisted and helped me to get a taxi all the way from pm until I finally got into the taxi just short of pm which by the way stopped right in front of the arrival entrance so that I didnt have to walk far I am most grateful and wish to commend Sharon and Gayithri for their exemplary service I will always remember especially Sharon for her kindness and the personal service extended to me a foreigner who had just arrived Singapore and had turned to her for help

There is a reason why this airport is consistently named among the best small airports in the USA Thanks to COVID some shops and eateries have shuttered and not reopened to date Security was a breeze There was no line and I walked right up to the TSA counter and cleared security in less than minutes There is a spill over of passengers from the gate area to the concourse nonetheless there is enough space to navigate the concourses The Escape Lounge is a welcome addition to this airport

Very pleasant experience The airport was very clean and up to a great standard It looked like a new development The airport staff are very polite Passport control a breeze especially for families with small children The baggage arrived in good time I could not find an ATM or a currency exchange counter though Had to go downtown to get local currency

I was very excited to land here as this airport is famous around the globe for its risk landings The infrastrucure per se is very basic you deplane on the tarmac and then walk to the arrivals staff were ok I found people in the Madeira island to be very friendly Do not come without pre booked stuff as I noticed they inflate the prices for tourists who decided to book on the spot The airport is clean and security is fast long lines though Snacks on the land side much cheaper than air side

Since my last review Karlsruhe airport has improved beyond expectations Regular flights to more destinations and vastly improved bus services to Baden and Rastatt Eating and shopping facilities need to be improved especially on Sundays when the duty free shop and gate one bar are generally closed

Karachi to Gwadar Travelled with this airline after I had travelled on a short a domestic flight early September Flight in general was smooth and scenic Ground staff were also pleasant and helpful I see some betterment in overall operations particularly in terms of punctuality

My recent experience of flying through Tuscon reminded me that in the contemporary climate flying through smaller American airports is generally a lot more pleasant than megaairports A case in point was the security screening I have some metal in my leg that occasionally triggers the metal detector and it happened while going through security at Tuscon The TSA person that dealt with me went through the standard procedure for dealing with this sort of thing this wasnt the first time for me but they also managed to be human about it in stark contrast to what Ive encountered at some other airports where the TSA person I was dealing with might as well have been a robot I would agree that the dining options at Tuscon arent the greatest but I was still able to get something satisfying to eat We even had some entertainment courtesy of the Arizona Air National Guard also at Tuscon airport who were doing training flights in their Fs and treated us to an impromptu airshow There is much to be said for flying through smaller airports In general the experience is faster and less stressful than their larger equivalents

Pretty basic as airports go Way out of town it is simply ridiculous and taxis are well keep your belt on and wear a helmet if you have one The airport sort of works but this is a typical domestic Chinese airport not great not entirely hideous but you know what If you want to fly to Hangzhou its this or nothing I can tell you it is heaven compared to the central rail station

vIve flown with Spirit several times and also contacted their customer service center in the past to cancel a flight Spirit can vary wildly in terms of cancellations delays timeliness and staff attitudes If using a ratio two experiences to every one have been overwhelming positive But the remaining one experience has royally sucked Still I take my chances with Spirit because theyve come to treat me more respectfully as a customer than most other US carriers pound for pound It helps that I understand the concept of ultrabudget airlines having flown them around the world and that I treat airline staff with courtesy and politeness This most recent trip from Orlando to Louisville was mostly positive friendly airline staff on ground and friendly though not particularly attentive in air they only came down the aisle once to collect trash Checkin online was easy though it helped that I wasnt checking a bag The flight took off and arrived early The immediate seat was clean enough but the seat back pocket and tray table were a bit nasty They tout their WiFi as being the fastest of any US airline though I havent tried it But I did manage to use their unpaid WiFi connection to track the flight route to Louisville on my phone so that was cool In all Spirit as great as long as you keep a good attitude and dont have any real expectations Thats the point of budget airlines right And just hope you dont get delayed by eight hours as I did once with Spirit years ago

Nice terminal though no seating space at the checkin area seems to be very congested After security check the seating area is much better though limited options of food and shopping The terminal itself is new and well maintained not much walk times The view of the runway from the terminal is good so you can pass your time quite well Free wifi with reasonably good connectivity available Announcements are adequate Overall quite good

A generally good experience at Durban airport Arrival is quite simple and they seem to keep the touts out of the waiting area The checkin is well organized and immigration outbound proceeded quickly There are a number of shops and restaurants The food and the shopping are forgettable but not expensive Decent amount of seating at the gates Wifi works fine

Its always very relaxing to fly from to Nuremberg Its a really small airport but everything works so easy and uncomplicated You can get there easily by train a subway station is directly in front of the entrance or by car you can park just min walk away checkin is very fast and boarding too There is no shopping and not that many food options but when you just want to get relaxed and easy from A to B its perfect And the staff are nice too even the security staff is always goodhumored More airlines should use this airport

I arrived at the George Charles Airport after a flight from Bridgetown Barbados It is a really small airport conveniently located near Castries The airport can only handle smaller aircraft turboprops the main international airport is in the south of the island UVF Aircraft arrival at the platform is greeted by local spectators at the airport fence Arrival hall is a single room that contains one baggage belt and two customs positions Obviously youre out of the airport in minutes

The experience is a unique one and I also have a trouble on how to rate this airline We start off from Singapores Changi Airport and the check in was quite smooth note that their carryon is only kg we get our boarding pass finish security and customs we finally managed to board the plane the cabin crew was very sweet and nice we are not delayed however the landing was super bad

Used this airport on numerous occasions over the last years Over the last year both domestic and international terminals underwent some renovation and rearrangement of facilities in my opinion for the better Of all facilitiesservices expectable from a midsize regional airport ARH lacks free WIFI coverage and cafes serving hot meals Overall it is a decently wellkept airport which may though benefit from further renovations and improvements

Yangon to Mandalay Lounge photo and In flight meal photo are added We can access Lounge at Yangon International Airport for all Business Class traveler variety of Breakfast Lounge is located at the rd floor of Yangon International Airport Terminal for domestic In flight meal is great but simple because it is just a hour short flight

TIPATH A very comfortable flight on leather seats on new CRJ Breakfast well served with a generous portion Service went smoothly and efficiently crew were English speaking Plane interior clean Flight left on time and seemingly no worries about cent for cent baggage weight checking All in all a very pleasant experience

It is clean modern and spacious It is easily accessible by the Leonardo Express from Termini about half an hour Employees are friendly and helpful and can speak English well The WiFi connection is stable Signposts are clear

Regional onboard service food and beverages LagosNairobi very good International onboard service food and beverages NairobiWashington good Onboard cleanliness satisfactory Nairobi lounge services good Airline customer support at Airport fair Kenya Airways App unreliable Online customer support very poor
I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the plane left on time The staff were friendly and helpful Only water coffee and tea were complimentary which is no issue on such a short flight

This was the most amusing flight I have ever flown as I got to share some laughs with not only fellow passengers but with a hostess Anyway I was seated in row row was an exit row so I was invited to sit there since it was empty and was willingable to assist in case of an emergency Te leg room is excellent and I measure cm The staff were professional and courteous Bags came out quickly We were given water upon boarding then a chocolate bar then a croissant filled with chocolate sauce worth the calories and finally a small drink

Never had any problems flying in and out of John WayneOrange County Airport Its clean security is quick and efficient and has that laid back atmosphere that is OC Its very convenient even when it comes to flying internationally you can get almost anywhere in the world with no more than one stopover At times Ill fly out of LAX if Im not in the mood for that stopover but OC always offers a pleasant alternative for convenience and efficiency Because of its curfew a lot of planes depart first thing in the morning so getting there early is advised But overall a great airport

Bremen is a small and convenient airport and my experience proved enjoyable Arriving with Air France I disembarked in the main terminal Very short walk to the baggage claim I picked my suitcase within ten minutes Tram line frequently connects the airport with the city centre every min during peak hours min otherwise travel time min A oneway ticket costs however beware that the machines accept neither credit cards nor bank notes greater than Easy departure with no queue at baggage dropin I breezed through security Bremen uses the fullbody scanner which makes the screening process much faster Security staff efficient and friendly Bright departure lounge but there might not be enough seating facilities if all gates are used at the same time Only issue Not enough toilets facilities either landside well hidden at the very end of the building or airside one toilet block only

Darwin Airport is a small to midsized airport It has limited food options during the off peak times of the day but is sufficient enough There are plenty of seats to wait on before boarding and the maximum time taken through security is about minutes

On the whole SSA is everything youd expect a mediumsized airport to be Its spacious well signposted and safe Checkin is usually fast except for charter flights to Europe security is fast and friendly domestic arrival also fast and efficient The one major problem at SSA are the long queues at customs in the afternoon when several international flights arrive pretty much at the same time If you dont carry a Brazilian passport expect to stand in line for over an hour There are just enough shops and food amenities SSA is still thankfully first and foremost an airport not a shopping mall If you are taking a bus from the city centre to the airport or vice versa be aware that traffic in Salvador is horrendous and the journey at peak times will take at least two hours

The largely renovated and rebuilt MCO airport is absolute class Clean well organized from the signage to the dropoff to security and aesthetically pleasing in most areas Returning to the US the new international arrivals area and postcustoms area so arrivals really is just gorgeous If you have Global Entry you breeze through in seconds with courteous officers that speak English and Spanish That alone is unique for a large US airport where many passport control officers are known for their powertripping belligerence but Orlando pleasantly provided the opposite of all that The signage to trains rideshare and hotel shuttles is granularly specified such that its easy for anybody to follow at least when leaving terminal Cinternational Leaving MCO the next morning arrivals at terminal A had clearly been renovated and was looking quite sharp CLEARPreCheck in tandem reduced security from a minute wait to a minute one The shuttle tram facilities between gates and terminals are showing their age and the terminal A gates area is also showing its age and could also use some more and better seating throughout but I wouldnt necessarily consider them dumpy I suppose that MCO will get to renovating those facilities as they can Truly MCO seems to be running like a welloiled machine that is geared to leave visitors to their city with a first and last positive impression

Small clean airport Close to the city centre If one arrives for a later flight in the evening arrive with a full stomach as nothing is open after It is an efficient small airport with quick security The TV is still on at full volume in the departure area
Very pleasant service on Madrid flight and Vigo flight Professional pleasant crew who were attentive and friendly The food was of a good quality nothing spectacular but good

Kazi Nazrul Islam airport RDP Durgapur is a new greenfield airport in the the industrial city of Durgapur West Bengal Eastern India It is a growing airport which holds much promise for improving air connectivity to this part of the state and can become a major player in boosting tourism and business in the area The connectivity from the city to the airport has improved but still needs more intervention including development of the surrounding areas

Johannesburg to Bloemfontein This review is more for compliment for one of your service staff at domestic departures I had a connecting flight from CPT to Bloemfontein via JHB I flew Mango to JHB and SAA Express to BFN There was only hour between arrival in JHB and departure to BFN The baggage claims for Mango took way too long and l was going to miss my flight Without my bag l ran up to the SAA express checkin counters for assistance Staff really went over and beyond to assist me and make sure l didnt miss my flight He assisted to check me in and help to carry my bag from baggage claim up to the checkin counter and safely on the correct plane All in time Without is quick response and help l would have surely missed my flight Well done for excellent customer service Thank you

On June airport started renovation of taxiways as well as the installation of a new apron The inside of the airport is very clean it is easy to orientate the construction of a new terminal will begin The runway lighting is bad but will also be updated soon I very much hope that everything will be fine and that it will be easier and safer to travel

Nice flight on time Smooth check in Nice cafe after formalities at Windhoek Only minor complaint is that email ticket confirmation says you must print out that document which is or pages so I did for people These pages were NOT required at Windhoek check in

Very clean and big airport Nice facilities Good open space Lots of shops and restaurants and fast food services including MDS and KFC All of it was pretty much airside The queue in Security wasnt that bad Nice airport and a lot of air conditioning

My experiences have always been pleasant Security lines are extremely short and there is a lot of open space Checking in is never a hasslewe have been able to pass by the checkin desk in minutes or less on the worst of days Bathrooms are clean and theres always a cafe or news store open Delta seems to have the largest concentration of flights at the airport most of them being on their regional affiliates running under Delta Connection Overall the airport is very good clean and friendly

This airport was very wellrun when me and my family were here We were going to Punta Cana for a family vacation through jetBlue We were able to get through security smoothly and the customs and shuttles were fast The food court provided a wide variety of foods for me and my family to choose from and everything was very modern The bathrooms were clean enough for usage The only con about this airport was the lack of the jet bridge It didnt help that it was raining upon our leaving Punta Cana We experienced torrential downpour and had to quickly get onboard and we were drenched by the time we were on the plane But there were also many good things about this airport and I would not mind visiting it again
You can change your seats at echeck in without charge Both flights were on time Aneo was clean there were no inflight service for the hour flight Stewards were efficient and friendly enough

I have used this airport a lot over the past two years and find it amazingly efficient and the staff friendly from checkin to immigration and security Its hardly ever busy and normally you can get from the plane to the MRT station within about minutes even when arriving on a packed A from HKG Sure the shopping and food options are not great but KHH is so close to downtown on the wonderful new MRT that this is not really an issue All KHH needs now are more international flights

Decided to fly this route to mainland China instead of my usual HKG Flew from TSAKNH return on what seemed to be a new Embraer E This airline is the domestic offshoot for China Airlines and the English language version of their website is a simple cut and paste from the international airline However the baggage allowance for domestic Taiwanese flights is only KG so I had to really point out that the English information states KG and after some trouble I was able to fly without having to pay extra Despite that the actual flight to and from Kinmen was quick comfortable and care free Only a snack and water was served on the flight but it was only minutes long so it was not an issue I was pleased to have been given the Emergency Exit row on both flights too handy being the taller westerner that I am Except for the baggage allowance issue I can not find fault with them

ABQ is a nice concept but one that needs some improvements For starters If you have TSA PreCheck here youre golden Security is an efficient and friendly process If you dont have PreCheck then the service at least for a small airport can be quite noncommunicative abrasive and slow The puebloinspired architecture and interior design of the airport render it one of the most beautiful small airports in the USA and the postsecurity viewing area of the runway and mountains is the sort of thing that more airports in this country need However its not always easy to enjoy the design and the views when the tile and carpet flooring and seating throughout the airport are dirty and for a lack of better words dilapidated and outdated Speaking of seating there really isnt enough of it in my opinion The signage directing you to amenities services and locations throughout the airport is helpful but also outdated The dining and shopping options are fine for a small airport so no real complaints Some people complain about the rental car facility being separate from the terminal and requiring a shuttle bus but honestly the bus runs frequently and the ride is pretty short Everything is easily accessible from I and downtown Albuquerque With a little modernization and polishing ABQ has the potential be as good as new again

What a fantastic little airport after leaving Paris CDG behind and all its filth it was such a welcome sight to arrive in a clean modern organized airport What a shame that more airlines dont fly into Pau The staff in the airport were also extremely helpful and polite Much nicer airport than Toulouse which is not far away

Arrival at this airport was simple with its connection to the Hanover SBahn suburban train system Hanover airport is a convenient size not an overwhelming number of gates but large enough to have plenty of connections Checkin today with Swiss Airlines went smoothly we were asked for our destination visa but not grilled and luggage was processed without difficulty Security checking was slow today probably because of Middle East tensions but security personnel were good humoured and friendly Cafes and shops on the land side closed before pm there are limited shopping possibilities on the air side but one good cafe
I really love this airport It is small and very quick Regular security is quicker than TSA Pre The Airport has nice entertainment and its a nice regional airport

STNGSE Arrived on Ryanair Single runway so only one plane can landtakeoff at a time Very compact with everything close by A very short stroll from the aircraft to the terminal where Passport Kiosks quickly processed everyone The Baggage Claim is one conveyor and there are limited toilet facilities before getting to Arrivals Hall Arrivals is midway between the Checkin Desks and the Security Scanning Outside the airport there is a taxi rank usually stocked with cars for each flight and the bus to the centre of Gothenburg Picnic tables are still outside on the grass where you can relax Security is OK and then a smallish Departure Lounge which is very busy if flights are going at similar times The Duty Free has various things but no alcohol There is a cafe selling hot and cold drinks sandwiches and similar and a small bar selling drinks There are Departure Doors of which Gate has Passport Control for nonSchengen flights NB Whilst Security is quick if there are two flights at the same time the process slows especially as most passengers travel with volumes of hand luggage that need liquids etc removed It is a good little airport and friendly in size

I was travelling with sight impaired friends Assistance was prebooked with Easyjet I cannot praise the staff highly enough We arrived late at night and we were wheeled very efficiently and cheerfully The staff cared for us very well and made sure we got safely to our taxi

Efficient frequent bus service from St Helier is a good way to get to the airport but once there it goes downhill The first security check boarding pass is quick and easy but wouldnt necessarily say friendly The next bags etc despite belts in operation and at least staff members that I could see the queue to pass through the scanner took minutes even though I was number in queue Some of the staff must be either very new or unable to cope with what I would say not unusual circumstances such as wheelchairs passengers arriving Even after that wait selected for random screening dont mind too much though as best to be safe but the biggest bug bear the public one and only bar had sullen staff looking like theyd rather be somewhere else wouldnt we all then for strange reason their bosses have decided to stop selling their best selling drink Carling Lager and replaced it with San Miguel at approx p more per pint probably suggesting this was a more in drink If a nice tasting lager it may be but I certainly wont be racing to that bar again somewhere enjoyed a pre departure drink many a time These airport bar bosses may think theyre making more money by selling the more expensive drink but I know many who will do exactly the same as me and bypass that bar once theyve realised this ridiculous change

I was very excited to land here as this airport is famous around the globe for its risk landings The infrastrucure per se is very basic you deplane on the tarmac and then walk to the arrivals staff were ok I found people in the Madeira island to be very friendly Do not come without pre booked stuff as I noticed they inflate the prices for tourists who decided to book on the spot The airport is clean and security is fast long lines though Snacks on the land side much cheaper than air side

Kaimana to Manokwari Plane left and arrived minutes late really on time in this part of the world The check in staff were very flexible about cabin luggage size On board seats were reasonably comfortable and crew pleasant
Excellent timely departure and arrival The cabin was clean the staff kind and the bags were promptly delivered Nothing to complain about

Overall our experience my wife and myself in transit twice in KGL has been satisfactory certainly compared with airports in the region with regard to seating not very comfortable but OK cleanliness including toilets signage and announcements attitude of official personnel security and boarding procedures Free WIFI did not work However we have been ripped off when purchasing goods from the VIVA GLOBAL DUTY FREE SHOP billed much higher prices than advertised no receipt received for some goods which we also paid far too much in USD We did not have our luggage on arrival at destination travel with Rwandair to BRU our suitcases arrived early next day via another company but we had to collect them from the airport since Rwandair does not have a policy of sending delayed luggage to the home

An unexpectedly pleasant experience The booking process was a bit odd but after using several different credit cards one finally worked on the airline website for a ticket about euros less than any other airline Check in and boarding was smooth Two suitcases allowed at kg each Or one at a maximum of kg There was entertainment with several English language recent films Ample food provided The layover was fine No one was saying anything about not taking photos and it wasnt any more different than transferring in China Seemed the duty free shops take card now too

Travelled into and out of here on a LCYZRHLUG long weekender last summer and look forward to doing the same again this year Incoming as smooth as expected outgoing return complicated by a fault on the outbound plane but didnt miss my London connection as a result and the small but civilised departure area think those few Ryanair routes that involve local airports that arent hastily assembled wooden shacks offered a wellstocked duty free shop and a sporadically manned bar Shopsbars available outside the airport for departing passengers and accompanying friends and family no problem with one final Swiss beer before checking in at short notice All in all a very pleasant experience

Waco Regional is not a bad airport overall They only have one flight which is to Dallas but I have heard rumors that United Express is resuming flights to Houston The reason I have given it stars is because their flights are always delayed or late My advice to travelers flying into Waco is to have patience The baggage claim takes a while The car rental facility is not bad for a small town Overall I think the airport shows good quality

Flight TF Gothenburg Stockholm Bromma Attentive professional FAs comfortable seats papers for free good in flight magazine on time clean plane smooth boarding and disembarkation clear safety announcements good sound system Best of all a small meal for free with coffeeteasoda and a chocolate candy
No problem with this airline Pleasant onboard service Schedule respected Aircraft ESSAA leased from an Estonian company Very good experience

Khartoum to El Fashir the capital of North Darfur in the Sudan the hr minute flight departed and arrived on time Polite crew who patiently showed people to their seats Two bread rolls one with cheese the other with chicken a cake water soft drink followed by tea and coffee was provided This is more than BA can provide on their domestic or European routes so if Badr airlines can provide it in Sudan on a domestic flight to Darfur why cant BA Overall a great flight and experience

VnukovoIrkutsk An eventful and enjoyable flight Everything went smoothly Vnukovo is the closest airport to the city centre and it has also a convenient train connection the train departs from the Kievsky train station This helps to avoid the usual heavy traffic of Moscow UTair uses a new terminal A which is quite handy It is likely that UTair is the only airline which uses a widebody B on this route and the plane seems to be a relatively new and wellmaintained one Friendly flight attendants the flight was ontime onboard catering is not superb but it was OK Would fly them again

My daughter and myself were at airport this morning waiting for my sister in law coming from London Her flight was delayed we were concerned that maybe she missed her flight We met a lovely young man Philip He was so helpful friendly kind Philip is fantastic with customers Inquiring about flights out of airport Philip was very helpful

Such a comfortable and convenient airport to use The relaxed feeling that I experienced was something you dont normally feel in airports Everything and everyone seemed to be at a relaxed pace and the friendliness of the immigration staff was very pleasant The baggage arrived promptly and even the customs staff seemed very friendly as I passed by At the exit to the car park I was asked by a couple of international visitors if I could assist them as they lost their car park ticket I went with them to the car park and visitor reception desk and the two ladies there were very understanding and helpful There were hand sanitising dispensers and hand towels available throughout the concourse and what is different about Shannon airport is that the sanitising foam dispensers were well stocked compared to other airports that all seem to have the dispensers but they are all empty

Great experience at arrival Very friendly staff welcoming all the way Quick check of Thailand Pass with no waiting time as smooth through immigration The bags already on belt when we came to arrival hall

Changi Airport looking dated but the SQ lounge was outstanding Big working areas excellent shower facilities nice bar plenty of good tasting food spotlessly clean good atmosphere The business class seat lounging and sleeping positions are not comfortable and the seats controls did not work quickly Difficult to use power outlets complicated storage areas sleeping in a diagonal position with very small foothole The IFE feels old with limited choice No live TV Worst deterioration when compared to their past offering was the food beverages Limited choice main course tasted bland and premium drinks served in small sodatype glasses no dining on demand Luckily the complimentary wifi worked well

Today I experience an outstanding level of service and friendliness at Dortmund Airport I forgot my mobile phone in the car of a friend who than brought it to the terminal however I was already checked in at the security so the officer went into the terminal and got my phone for me I have never experienced such a high level of service Also the lady at the gate was very nice and made a lot of jokes while boarding Overall the airport is clean and the signs are reasonable Furthermore the airport is quite small so you wont get lost In Addition to that there are security check ins so the queing times are short The only negative thing today was the wifi you have to pay for it

Finally the new terminal is in operation Arrival and departure were a breeze no queues no trouble with signage nothing to complain about Toilets are clean overall facility is still under final touches of construction The terminal is too big for the amount of flights served so very few people there Pity they have no food and drink outlets landside yet and just a small stall with snacks airside Overall impression very good everything worked there and up to the international standards From plane to taxi in minutes from check in to plane in Good

I will like to thank entire staff of Air Asia We were on family vacation with my year old child and got amazing cooperation Without any hassle we could book seats and the entire journey was enjoyable Will like to be thankful to the pilots as the landing on all the flights was smooth I paid my gratitude to the staff personally too

One of the easiest domestic airports to figure out Just a couple of restaurants but each one has great selection of food Theyve been getting better flights and it is transitioning to more of a transit type airport Staff is scarce but ticket counters are fast to checkin and the security line is real quick minutes at the most I now start my journey to any destination from here
No boarding bridges But views are very nice Not much wait for luggage The ground service is good

Getting through this airport was such a breeze our home airport is Pearson which is insanely busy We were able to apply for TSA cares for our autistic family Tameeka helped us from start to finish of security and was so warm and thoughtful in helping us navigate their first time through Highly recommend using this service if you have a family member with disabilities We applied for the same program at Orlando and no one helped us the staff were rude and the lady guarding the family and disabled line tried to turn us away Thoroughly disappointed especially compared to Buffalo We will definitely be flying out of Buffalo in the future

This airport is clearly not equipped to take the number of pax departing after the winter break Check in was too crowded so we had to wait on another floor Conveyer belt at check in blocked by heavy usage Boarding never indicated on screens but was only announced via PA system Shambles Shame as we had such a great time in Finland

Islamabad to Manchester Very prompt check in for Shaheen Air No hassle Boarding very professional and well organised Friendly cabin staff Clean very aircraft Good quality food served lunch Asian style and evening dinner European style and plenty of cold drinks coffee tea Little treats like chocolates also served during flight Food served on time and promptly This flight had free Wifi which worked well Generally very happy with Shaheen Air I would definitely recommend and I would fly again with them

Dhaka to Singapore Good food good seating and comparatively better ground services at Dhaka Staff on board are just okay though My travel ticket price was high though Worst inflight entertainment service

Berlin Schnefeld to Tel Aviv Fast and efficient check in flight on time very friendly crew Clean plane seat comfort in Economy Plus good Compared to Ups competitors on this route Up has the best flight schedule Have flown Up repeatedly in Economy Plus and never disappointed
Friendly of the staff a new huge mall had been opening Mall del Soll This is the modern and fully functional airport with the biggest mall of the country and four hotels between stars

Nice experience at Zhengzhou airport I departedto Guangzhou and then to Vancouver The service at Zhengzhou was very good Staff are very friendly and efficient They made my trip much easier Great experience

Denpasar to Moscow Hard product ok as the aircraft has been flying for Emirates before with angled seats providing acceptable comfort Huge screen but only showing airshow IFE works on your personal device through a dedicated app Selection of movies rather limited Streaming with some issues during the flight Catering on level of premium economy Some choices but very basic food Wine available one white and one red basic quality No snacks between the two meals on a hour flight nuts only Crew trying to do their best very friendly Overall no consistent business class product huge room for improvement Value for money below average

DUD is a small but efficient airport with everything you need Landed from Wellington bags out very quickly The airport is quite far from city centre mins cost nearly dollars by Taxi and dollars by super shuttle Departure is well organised checkin sufficient airline lounge is located upstairs security check right before you board

I travelled all around the world I saw many regional airports WroclawBreslau was excellent Everything went quickly Staff were really helpful no queues Brilliant seats before departure No problem with luggage One minus no good access to the city transport You must take a taxi to drive to the center

Upon arrival we were herded into two huge queues in passport control Plenty of people to herd you but only two actually processing passports After minutes one of the herders pointed the remaining twenty or so people in our queue to the automated passport machine She then promptly walked away Unfortunately no one bothered to walk through them as you could simply walk around so we all did Spain has no record of me entering its island Arrivals is like revisiting the s it all needs replacing Departures by comparison was like a different airport well managed very short queues and modern Toilets are very clean

A delightful regional airport set amongst the lush valleys and hills of the Northern Rivers District of New South Wales Nice well designed terminal and with more convenient flight schedules with Regional Express down to Sydney than nearby Ballina which handles mainly tourist traffic Lismore Airport is close to town and has all the usual car rental facilities and is only minutes to the coast Byron BayBallina etc Only downside is as is usual at most airport terminals in Australia blaring televisions all around the terminal causing a racket and breaking the pleasant peace of this delightful place
This airport has beautiful views of the tarmac and a nice and comfortable lounge with easy check in and very friendly staff The food is amazing with an amazing variety of restaurants

What a lovely place The tiniest airport an aerodrome actually I have been to People are lovely they take care of you There is a bar free wifi if it doesnt work in some areas ask for the airlines it is kept clean The only thing is getting there taxi only as far as I know

My daughter and myself were at airport this morning waiting for my sister in law coming from London Her flight was delayed we were concerned that maybe she missed her flight We met a lovely young man Philip He was so helpful friendly kind Philip is fantastic with customers Inquiring about flights out of airport Philip was very helpful

A small modern gate airport Smiling and timely checkin security and boarding Pleasant airy shared lounge with good Mongolian and other ethnic items reasonably priced Ours was the only plane at the airport let alone scheduled to fly around midday but all shops and facilities were fully open and staffed Only criticism is the lack of a bar which I would prefer to for example the bridal wear store

Thessaloniki to Athens I was pleasantly surprised by the service on this short flight approx min Service was quick good selection of drinks and small candies and biscuits Friendly staff aircraft was clean The crew are ready to assist the passengers I will be happy to fly them again

Des Moines KDSM is an all round great airport It is a very easy airport to navigate in and it doesnt take long to get through security at all It always seems to be clean and free wifi is always a plus While there seems to be a lack of shopping and food choices there are a few that all seem to be good places of business Terminal seating is in the process of being expanded as it doesnt hold the demand all of the time Its a great airport to depart and arrive to It isnt very big but will get you where you need to go

Luxor via Sharm to Manchester on A after Monarch refused to let me and my year old daughter board with Kiss Flights tickets There were of us stranded at Luxor and about more in Sharm so we only half filled the plane The crew was friendly professional and sympathetic to the fact we had been delayed for a further hours Whilst the plane was obviously quite new the seats were refurb in my opinion but we had plenty of leg room a very pleasant but simple dinner no alcohol on board but drinks free with our meal unlike Monarch who only give coffee free As soon as we had eaten and duty free had been up and down the lights were dimmed as it was very late Air Memphis may be budget domestic flights but their international flight for me and my companions on board I thinks was excellent

SINRDN Return A new ATR with two flight attendants For a hr flight a packed towel plus a bottle of water was given out Although the attendants werent very enthusiastic the crew members in the flight deck kept us up to date with information

My recent trip from Jakarta to Denpasar with Pelita Air was an absolute pleasure Both departure and arrival adhered to the schedule The seat pitch in their aircraft offers ample legroom Every seat has a USB port and an AC power outlet A tasty light snack and water were provided which was perfect for the short flight duration Departure from Jakartas Terminal was offers a bright airy ambiance and a good selection of shops and restaurants for preflight browsing Smooth Transfers Even for a far gate a bus was available to take passengers to the aircraft The cabin crew were professional and courteous Pelita Air provided WiFi access to their Inflight Entertainment IFE system that allowed me to stream movies shows or music on my device making the flight even more enjoyable A Minor Room for Improvement While the ground staff were generally helpful there were a few instances where they seemed a bit inattentive Perhaps some additional training could improve their overall efficiency
Plane clean and on time Ran out of water after row economy Its a short flight so bring back water in seat pockets of you cant cope No coffee tea or drinks for anyone

This was the first time we had used Coventry Airport to travel to Barcelona Having been used to departing from the larger airports oh how we laughed The porter cabin style check in and the cattle shed style arrivals made us laugh and laugh The coffee shop was like having a cup of tea in your front room What fun to be escorted to the plane by the same person who checked us in we wouldnt have been suprised if they had flown the plane too The only hitch was when we arrived back there was already a flight in we were held on the plane while they found someone to escort us to the so called terminal We giggled at the thought of someone shouting Stan Can you leave the loo cleaning and get the next lot off the Barcelona flight We will be using Coventry again if only for a good laugh

My recent flight with Binter Canarias from Fuerteventura to Las Palmas was a delightful surprise The flight itself was a breeze clocking in at just minutes and departed right on schedule Binter Canarias impressed me most with their commitment to passenger comfort despite the short flight duration The aircraft a brand new ATR felt incredibly spacious with ample legroom The cabin crew were topnotch professional friendly and accommodating They even provided a complimentary snack of water candy and a chocolate bar a small gesture that went a long way Considering the price I paid for the ticket the overall experience felt miles ahead of what Ive come to expect from many established European legacy carriers Binter Canarias exceeded my expectations in every way If youre looking for a comfortable and hasslefree way to island hop in the Canaries I wouldnt hesitate to recommend them

BUR is a no frills no wow no stress airport and those are the best things about it Easy to park with valet getting through security is usually a breeze and there is little fog to cause delays Theres a Peets coffee and the cafe is overpriced but decent Do you really expect fine dining on what is primarily a short haul airport basically an SWA airport Other than the charming s air about the place you get on and off the planes old school style with stairs and with SWA can enter through the front of back of the plane the latter to avoid the slow pokes SWA boarding lines are well organized If I were to complain the rest rooms are smallish and Terminal B for United is too small Seating can be somewhat tight close to boarding time Baggage claim is usually reasonably fast but there are only two carousels so dont dawdle If you are going to the westside or even downtown youre in for a long cab ride but most travelers live in one of the nearby valleys and if youre a tourist its close to Universal Studios Theres a train within walking distance that will take you downtown or to Ventura County during limited times Overall a very good travel experience because it is easy and stress free

I would like to share my positive experience with Egypt Air as this Airline have really exceeded my expectations Friendly and professional cabin crew with delicious catering Highly recommended and for sure will fly Egypt Air again

This airport is passable if youre the passenger Have been through many times Problem is if you are waiting for someone to arrive No seats anywhere Pricy food choices super high taxi prices It is clean though

Back to Pristina in February The airport now has a proper baggage reclaim and is looking a little more finished The departure lounge has another shop and increased size It is still best to use the bar before immigration Overall this is still a good little airport

Small and old airport One small ugly terminal with long queues Once past check in counter and paid php airport fee you are in a waiting area Waiting area is on two floors with several stalls selling food and drink but nothing spectacular One small duty free store as this place is an international airport but anybody can buy in this store Lavatorys even if not easy to be found are just ok Gives you the feeling you have been parachuted back to the this airport but all ended well

This is a comparatively new airport in Tunisia and I have nothing but praise for it It is clean smart and well organised Check in and Security were quick and once through to airside a really good duty free shop and a bar Great views from the glass fronted terminal although the view of some aircraft can be obscured by the piers Everything ran smoothly and just a pleasure to travel through this airport

Domestic arrival was good canteen facilities are reasonably priced Toilet was clean in arrival hall International departure money exchange facilities available The security check was not particularly friendly boarding was smooth via gate with Virgin Australia using an air bridge

International Arrival at Tashkent is fine Bus from plane to terminal Very quick and smooth passport control no landing card needed no forms to fill in Baggage Reclaim was slow for some reason Money Exchange in Baggage Reclaim Hall along with local mobile SIM Cards Baggage Xray and then walk in fenced off compound to where taxis and buses await the usual scrum of offers of taxi etc Domestic Departures in separate building which is older Xray and show ticketETicket to get in then Checkin desks Security scanning of hand luggage basic water is allowed to go through Departure Hall has gates for bus loading of planes There is a small cafe serving drinkssnacks and seats International Departures is in a separate building scanned to get in and lots of Checkin Desks Only Money Exchange that was reluctant to exchange Uzbek Soms but did so very important as there is nowhere to do so after passport control Checkin show as no online checkin everyone has to checkin to get a Boarding Pass Passport Control quite quick and Security OK International Departures has a mix of shops selling local items and usual big brand alcholcigarettes price in USD or EUR prices OK A few cafes that were priced in local currency Euros or US Dollars Many departure screens and quite a lot of seating Only a couple of air bridges so most planes land on remote stands served by buses

Average airport Ive been here many times since I live in the UK but my experience never really changed There are a lot of shops which I find good and the food is meh I do often see some rubbish on the floor and wet floors with no wet floor sign which is quite dangerous If you come here I do recommend to go to the lounge since it is relaxing you get tasty food and a view of planes taking off The flights are always massively delayed but overall a pretty average airport

Bremen Airport Terminal E is a big shed with Ryanair inside No doubt noisy in a hail storm its open and breezy Staff efficient Plenty of natural light skylights in the roof The light rail service line service from the station is great too Beware it does not take credit cards or bank notes over Euros functional

We chose Eastar Jet because of its reasonable price for the round trip from Seoul Gimpo to Jeju First we made booking for pax name of one of us is lack one word so we submitted to correct Immediately I received a call from Seoul to let me know how to change and remind me via email On the day of flight theres a storm in Jeju so we hardly to landed We were afraid that we have to flight back to Seoul luckily we landed safe after few trial times On the return way days later at the airport we were informed that the flight was cancelled due to the storm But Eastar Jet told us that they would find another airline for us then we had tickets of Jin Air then boarding without any problem We were satisfied of services and staff of Eastar Jet from booking until last minute Thanks Eastar Jet for making our trip more memorable and happy

Tbilisi to Baku Everything went smoothly here Boarding was quick and on time We were pushed back on time which also meant the flight left on time It was only a short hop of mins I will see how they are again when I fly hours plus on my next flight Overall No issues Airline very smooth and would recommend

Privilege Style operate an old Singapore Airlines and I took their flight between Miami and London Gatwick as Norwegian were unable to run their new Boeing Dreamliner I see a lot of people complaining about Privilege Style however I had an amazing experience in their business class cabin I actually chose to fly with Privilege Style so I could experience the old Singapore Airlines business class cabin and I wasnt disappointed The business class cabin was in a configuration and was completely booked out however the seat I had was very spacious and I had so much room to myself The cabin crew in the business cabin looked after us like a true business class experience which I was not expecting We had a welcome drink and there were plenty of staff for the small number of people in the cabin I pressed the call button at one point and a cabin crew member came over straight away The food was very good too nothing special but it was better than I expected It was also served quickly too which was great theres nothing worse than waiting hours for your meal We had blankets and a pillow provided too really making this feel like a business class flight and I liked how the cabin crew stopped economy passengers from using our toilets As we flew over the Atlantic the cabin lights dimmed and most people got sleep Ive flown business class several times before and for the price I paid this is one where I got the most value Note that the entertainment system is a bit rubbish but I knew that and took my laptop preloaded with some films and my own noise cancelling headphones Im posting this because I did research before this flight online and couldnt find any positive reviews about the business class experience and for that reason I was worried about what it was going to be like I hope this review helps people who might be thinking about booking with Privilege Style
Friendly and fast service Enough toilets seats and bins But shops close early and have a extremely poor selection in duty free If you want anything make sure you get it before coming to the airport

I am pleased to commend Mdm Novia for her exceptional professionalism during our recent flight cancellation on November After our Citilink flight from Pontianak to Jakarta was canceled Novia managed all the necessary arrangements for our next flight with outstanding efficiency and kindness Her assistance made a challenging situation much easier and we are very grateful for her dedication and hospitality She truly goes above and beyond in her service

Tokyo Haneda to Sapporo return with Skymark Airlines First leg on Boeing NG New cabin comfy seat and generous legroom for a lowcost airline Even though I didnt purchase any the drinks and snakcs are sold at a cheap price Departure and arrival on time Return leg delayed for mins due to congestion at destination airport Return aircraft was an older Boeing Very warm cabin temperature But overall worth the ticket price Definetely better than AirAsia and JetStar

The new terminal at Antigua airport has only been open for a few months and it is quite magnificent Its up there with the best European airports although not anywhere near as large The dutyfree shops are amazing particularly their rum selections which include Clement Rhum Agricole from Martinique and some genuine sugar cane syrup to mix it with The souvenir shop also looked very good although I didnt have enough time to look round it in great detail

Thank you for your kind service My elderly parents flew out and the patience and attention to their comfort was impressive and appreciative They contacted me upon their arrival and both were very calm and satisfied They have been worried about flying days coming into it All that went away at the airport in Bellingham They were greeted upon their arrival at their destination with the necessary extra services Thank you so much

I Flew on flight TK on the th February from Istanbul to Bangkok which was an excellent business class flight experience The food on board was as usual very good indeed as was the superb service provided by cabin crew hostess Grulsah She was extremely friendly and very professional for which I would like to thank her for If I had one perhaps negative comment to make and that is regarding the dated seating layout on the airbus A Which with a layout of doesnt provide much in the way of privacy and should if possible be changed to a layout That aside the flight itself arrived into Bangkok exactly on time Highly recommended

It is a small airport no long queues or big crowds quick checkin and boarding It has quite good services if you consider its dimensions It is clean and comfortable I always start my trips here when possible also for overseas flights because it has good connections with the main hubs Rome Paris Munich London Istanbul

Traveled to Manaus many times found the airport good with easy access to car park Staff nice security not too long a queue shops etc are standard airport stuff Would recommend early arrival and double check all documentation you need to travel Stop to look at the turtles outside the terminal in their own pond

Having no low cost carriers until relatively recently between Bangkok and Taipei this was one of the few major Asian routes which meant a plane change in a third country to find a decent fare for budget travelers Now it is served by two V Air and Tigerair Taiwan On the basis of this flight both are excellent and put similar carriers in the shade The Tigerair Taiwan afternoon flight to Bangkoks Don Mueang airport was boarded efficiently using a bus gate and taxiing commenced minutes early FAs were smartly dressed and super efficient smiling as they carried out their duties My preordered meal was piping hot unlike on some fullservice carriers who serve from a trolley All in all a seamless and flawless flight

Luang Prabang to Vientiane CheckIn was fast well organized and the staff friendly The departure arrival was on time and the aircraft made a very well maintained impression During the flight despite the short flight time of only minutes there were small bites and drinks The seat absorbency was slightly larger than other airlines Overall a good surprising experience

Second busiest airport in Finland after Helsinki now really quiet thanks to covid Terminal is reasonably big and has jet bridges so you dont need to go outside while boarding unless its a small turboprop like we had which cannot use jet bridges There are couple of shops a bar and a cafe and just like most other airports in Finland there are rocking chairs where to relax and even a piano anyone can play Checkin security and baggage claim went smoothly and fast since there were only a few passengers Airport is well connected to the city by buses and taxi

We were flying to Kuala Lumpur from Madinah airport through group reservation on Feb The checkin counter staff separated all of us When we wanted to exchange seats with fellow group members the crew were not really helpful All the havoc could easily have been avoided had the checkin counter staff been more accommodating when seating passengers according to their family groupings Do not assign seats according to your mood or whims and fancies for that day It is very unprofessional Next is the passenger security scan Ladies and men security scans were separated At the scan even folding chair cum walking stick was confiscated How do you suppose the passenger is going to walk to the gate when the walking stick is taken away My yearold mother wears a lumbar support waistband She was told to remove it and go through the scan again How to remove without privacy at that scan area Security lady can easily be more sensitive and take her to a more private place

I was a little worried after booking Island Air due to some of the reviews I have read about latecancelled flights Our flight was on time I did notice that on days when the weather was very poor that flights were showing some delays but I guess this would be in common with most airlines flying around the islands The quick minute hop was pleasurable and stress free Island Air operates from the commuter terminal at HNL In reality it is just them and another small airline that shares the facility No lines at check in no lines through security Once airside free wifi available throughout as well as free newspapers and even coffee Onboard had great views and even some commentary en route by one of the flight attendants pointing out points of interest Was a nice touch Served either a bottle of water or a cuplet of juice Bags US each to check in appeared on reclaim belt within a minute of arriving in the baggage hall All staff in the airport and onboard were really friendly

We flew out of YQB UA on Tuesday October at pm I became very disabled after a bad fall in old Quebec Clty on Monday October After going to the Blessed Sacrement emergency and having much pain due to pelvic fractures After much pain we had to delay flight plans back home from Oct I contacted UA for disability help I was assured we would be taken care of at the car rental area and throughout the airport terminal also YQB website assured they are very proud of their disability service Fortunately after Avis personnel refused to help an airport employee saw us struggling to manage our luggage walker and wheelchair and offered to help get us to Avis Sadly I had to beg for help because the response was Our airport is too small Finally at Avis a young man behind the desk said I will help you And then took us to the UA Ticket Counter He refused an offer of a tip Then after getting baggage etc taken care of again we asked for help to go through TSA and boarding area At first the response was again Our airport is too small Fortunately a young woman said she would help And she did with kindness and refused a tip She dropped us off at boarding area after letting us get some food at a vendor and stopped so we could use the restroom She said she would be back to help us get our boarding pass and onto the plane SHE DID We are giving an excellent rating because of the people that did take the initiative to help us despite others refusing

A typical Ryanair airport Small and miles from anywhere although perhaps suitable for the Alps and skiing access or unless you have relatives nearby However it meant that from the plane to the car hire desk was about metres and we were on our way less than minutes after landing If you need a train the station is literally metres from the terminal door Its not an architectural gem the seating is limited and hard but it has a cafe and a shop and its efficient and has what you need The staff were friendly and allowed us to board first on our return to the UK as my wife had a broken hand in plaster As long as the plane is on time it does the job well

Verona to Mahon Flight at full hour aircraft slightly dated but maintained better than others very comfortable seats In mid flight we were served a very good snack nice and elegant and above all professional hostesses volo in pieno orarioaereo leggermente datato ma tenuto meglio di altri sedili molto comodi a met volo ci stato servito lo spuntino molto buono hostess carine e eleganti e soprattutto professionali

A friendly airport if you just want to watch the planes from the viewing area but not passenger friendly poor layout Up a lot of stairs for passport checks when you arrive Had to go through security the past twice on departure the both times they claimed I had passed through a public area after the first check Security patdowns are embarrassingly intimate

Rio De Janeiro is a good aiirport but was very crowded during the Olympics The new terminal is awesome but GOL VIP lounge is poor the Plaza Premium Lounge is better The duty free is good but overpriced Customs and immigration officers are quite sympathetic and the airport is clean

If youre on a budget going on a trip to Jamaica fly Swoop while you can before it shuts down I dont know what a flight is like going to other locations but flying to Sangster airport in Jamaica was perfectly fine It was after tax roundtrip for a hr flight I know there a ton of negative reviews about Swoop but perhaps thats dependent on location Its a low cost flight so YES everything is going to cost you but you cant fault them for that You have the choice to pick who you fly with The flight attendants were nice seats were actually very spacious The only unfortunate thing is that our return flight was cancelled but that wasnt even Swoops fault the airport was doing construction Ended up being a blessing in disguise Swoop covered a free stay in Montego Bay since we had to wait for following day to fly out It was pretty seamless to be honest I dont know why some other passengers didnt have it sorted maybe they didnt book through swoop but I got the email for a complimentary accommodation and they gave me options I picked the thats a minute drive from airport and it was perfect The hotel manager was there waiting for us and everything worked out great we had booking and she checked us in It was awesome another day in Jamaica I couldnt complain The return flight next day was fine Id def fly with Swoop again

Very friendly clean and organized Still in need of more modern technology but above all for being in a poor country it delivers a good service nice food court and souvenir shops although the latter are pricey It has something for everyone

I had to fly from Alicante with a fractured leg The staff and facilities were absolutely amazing Please can you teach Edinburgh Airport how to facilitate and treat disabled passengers Thank you so much Alicante

The best airport in the world I have used it multiple times and there is never any significant waiting time at checkin or security The staff are always goodnatured and friendly Parking is free It is quiet Dutyfree items are cheaper than in eg Copenhagen And on top of all this you get free water and a newspaper while you wait for the plane The best by far

Needs a proper restaurant Toilets are not up to the hygiene standard and are very congested I am muslim and offer regular prayers but call is very loud need to maintain at comfortable listening Needs further variety of fast food international chains to have a quick meal

Flew LIAT from Dominica to Martinique via Bridgetown Excellent experience on this regional airline Ground staff in Melville Hall very helpful and attentive on time wonderful flight and all in all great fun

Juliaca is the smallest commercial airport I have experienced Because of the size it is easy to find your way around There is not very much in the airport so bring something to amuse yourself The good news is due to the size it is a very clean including the bathrooms There was a VIP Lounge that I peeked into It consisted of a few chairs and a cooler with soft drinks and beer

When you get off the plane at Quito Mariscal Airport you are greeted with a stunning view of the mountains The staff are all very friendly and the airport itself is quite modern While there arent tonnes of bars and restaurants like the airports at home in Britain it doesnt matter Because the facilities are satisfactory and the staff behave the way staff should I arrived in Quito after transit in Panama which was a total dump with extremely rude staff so to arrive in my final destination where I now live and to be greeted to my new country in such a friendly manner by immigration and customs was lovely

Ive been using this Airport over the last decade and what is happening in the country did not help a lot with the growth of the overall experience of this Terminal I can admit that compared to the other airports I visited Tunis Carthage kept a Vintage look in its facilities the Departure hall is well decorated with a breathtaking ceiling decoration and paneling the local handicraft shops and the roaming merchants in the airports give a local taste and overview of the country lifestyle The Departures hall offers a multitude of facilities including pharmacies coffeeshops Foreign exchange Post Tourism information desk Banks where passengers should do all their shopping before accessing to the Dutyfree area Once Stamped your exit a central coffee shop is conveniently positioned in the center of the hexagon shaped hall distributing all departure gates offers coffee or snacks before departure but note that beyond the police border and all over the dutyfree zone payments cannot be done in local currency and card payments are not always available due to the immaturity of card payments in Tunisia Duty free zone offers plenty of last minute gift possibilities ranging from local handicrafts souvenirs sweets and clothing to branded perfume chocolates and spirits Cleanliness remains one of the major defects in this Airport make sure you have a pack of tissue or sanitizing wipes when you use the restrooms I wish a pleasant stay in Tunisia for all visitors that would like to discover more about the magic of North Africa

Flew GA Jakarta to Amsterdam I was picked up at home by a car provided by GarudaIndonesia and was them met at the terminal kerb side by GarudaIndonesia First Class Team Nidya Ahda who helped me with check in security and through immigration formalities Although the airport was very busy this process was very quick In the Jakarta airport FirstClass lounge there is full menu and drinks service available however I chose a sandwich When it came time for boarding Naiya assisted me to the aircraft door where I was meet by the FirstClass cabin crew Romad Wanda Cartika and Chef Angga who provided me with a very warm welcome I was quite tired therefore after a short snack after takeoff I bedded down and had a very good sleep for hours There was a good selection of food available for breakfast The breakfast meal can be ordered on demand therefore I chose for breakfast to be served hours prior to landing The quality of food portion size and presentation were outstanding and refills of tea and coffee are none stop When we arrived in Amsterdam Schiphol airport we were met at the plane door by the Schiphol VIP Team who took me to the VIP centre where we go through immigration and checkin for my onward flight This is also a great service and it avoids all the queues I used the onboard Wi Fi and the connectivity was very excellent I would like to thank the GarudaIndonesia First Class Team on the ground and to the Cabin crew for the outstanding service they provided

The arrivals area is pretty shabby but from disembarking the plane to getting on the bus to St Helier took less than minutes We departed from Jersey late afternoon on a Saturday when it was very quiet and so it was a very pleasant experience The staff at security and in the shops were all helpful and charming For the size of the airport the selection of shops and food were decent although there did seem to be a lack of seating after security however there was plenty at the gate

Isnt it fascinating that you can buy any spirit in a one liter bottle but water only in l bottles I asked and the not so friendly stuff assured that the whole airport just sells little bottles at the gates that is after security check Oh and when I asked why she cleverly replied just because I have never seen an airport that poor with food and beverages Dont come hungry or thirsty

Have flown with Air Canada many times and have always had a good experience Our last trip was to Florence via Zurich Flights LX out and LX in No issues whatsoever Check in was smooth boarding in Toronto was about the easiest we have experienced in a while seats were fine service was good The only minor issue was that the seatback in the seatback in front of me was broken somehow and I couldnt put the tray back easily Also whats with offering WiFi but only to Aeroplan members of a certain level I find that annoying Other that that everything was good

This is my second trip using this Airport This is a far superior experience when compared to the main international airport KLIA especially at the immigration Department The staff are friendly and helpful It took us less than minutes to clear immigration and custom The airport is clean and free wifi is provided I would highly recommend this airport if you are travelling within Malaysia or South East Asia

TLLAMS a busy morning flight on the perennially cramped CRJ Compared to my last flight with Estonian a year ago the service much better and Tallinn airport keeps improving and is now probably the nicest small airport in Europe clean free wifi comfy seats and even a library No service whatsoever on Estonian Air which besides being governmentowned is on par with Ryanair for what it offers But as a way to get from Point A to Point B its acceptable

Tanahmerah to Korowai Batu This route is a governmentsubsidized one operated with tiny aircraft carrying only about a dozen passengers No advance booking possible but Dimonim staff were helpful in getting us on a flight the same day Departure time was uncertain but we eventually got on the plane Once aboard it was a great flight offering sweeping views of the rivers and rain forests below Cheap too

This is no longer called Bajpe airport since the opening of a spanking new terminal building at the end of the newish runway The new terminal has aerobridges that are used for passengers disembarking from the front end of the aircraft While I was there passengers could also disembark from the rear end using air stairs this for a B The airport is clean and spacious not particularly stylish but nice Mine was the only flight that came in at the time so the bags came quickly CarsTaxis park outside where theyre not supposed to so getting out took longer than it shouldve On the departure side there are shops before you get through security which is opened only about an hour before the flight but once you get through theres only a small coffee and snack stand The restrooms were clean
