Smaller more convenient airport for Seoul Arrivals process quick and easy short walk from the aircraft to Passport Control Down a set of steps to Baggage Reclaim Bags come reasonably quickly There are toilets within Baggage Reclaim Customs check and then the main Arrivals area The walk to the metrotrain was quite a long way but all flat to push baggage carts Ticket machines that take cash Express train to Seoul Station and other metro trains to most points within greater Seoul A quick and easy way to get into South Korea
The folks at Delta and Sky West were great They took great care of daughter and her room mate on their way home for spring break They made a special trip to get our bags at the Elko Airport

This is a very small airport on an island You have to get a ferry and a bus to reach it both free of charge It is in a lovely setting surrounded by trees The facilities are very limited with only one very small cafe no shops but that is all part of the charm

Gatwick to Prevesa We have flown now this route three times with Small Planet Airline since most recently out on and back and consider that this airline just gets better and better On the latest occasion both flights left on time and arrived early The aircraft was spotlessly clean and comfortable with smart leather seats and bright multicoloured headrest covers The friendly cabin crew were professional and safety aware whilst the commentaries from the flight deck both before take off during the flight and before landing was informative and very well executed For a no frills budget airline the catering was both plentiful and reasonably priced eg full English breakfast with coffee if you wanted it for Great to see that this airline has revived the old tradition of offering boiled sweets to all passengers with courtesy prior to the aircraft starting its descent Based on our experience I would have no hesitation in commending Small Planet Airlines

BOGMZLBOG I took them from Bogota to Manizales when I was visiting Colombia in December The crew was fantastic airport staff was polite The planes were new comfortable and service was great Tickets were very reasonable but book them early through the website to take advantage of the promotional fares which could equal US round trip depending on where you are going and how early you book

Fast efficient little airport to arrive at your luggage arrives quickly and is usually carefully handled It is almost impossible to get lost and the airport has good transport links for Carinthia and the ski regions of NW Slovenia Flying from Klagenfurt is not quite so good the departure lounge could do with some toilets after passport control so if you need the toilet be sure to go before you go through On the positive side the cafe upstairs is very good for the size of airport

KigaliParis th Dec on one of their A aircrafts Checked in online smooth but is unnecessary and does neither add value nor gain time I chose an entire seatrow for free due to my Gold Status with Rwandairs Dream Miles Program Marburg declarations forms have to be filled prior to enter the airport Checkin slow minutes per pax but they managed to checkin luggage onwards with other airline Dream lounge in Kigali is a pleasure with panorama windows over town Catering options varied a bit sparse the best hot snacks appear not to reach the lounge easily only on firm request I suspect that they are consumed by lounge staff have seen indications hereof Wines are subpar No sparkling wine offered Flight on time full on time Seafood meal preordered and given Generous catering They gave me on early request an entire row onboard for better sleep Blankets earset and pillows given Very affordable ticket USD tr purchased months before departure Extremely good value for money Miles given

I had a bad feeling as we queued for the temporary drop off zone at Luton airport as I had heard horror stories of this airport in the past but I went into the journey with an open mind We flew out with Ryanair and check in was an absolute breeze with no hold ups at all Security was very busy but we had FastTrack purchased and cleared the lanes within a few moments the staff were very friendly and helpful to us as we passed and even were open for a laugh The departures area can feel a little claustrophobic with low ceilings till you reach the main area There is good choice of FB as you pass through with a nice selection of shops to spend some money Seating is decent as well outside the FB areas so there is space to take a load off I spotted a nasty spillage on the floor and spoke to a cleaner who told me she would attend to it straight away The gate are for Ryanair and Wizz was a little cramped down the corridor with limited space but if you time it right you wont be there long Overall a very surprising experience at LTN and one I didnt expect

This airport has excellent free wifi but lacks any decent shops or restaurants I stayed in the airport for hrs whilst waiting for a connecting flight The checkin agent wouldnt check my bag through so I was stuck at the airport The best area for wifi is on the nd floor There are powerpoints behind the bench seats for charging your laptop Airside there are small shops and a cafebar at the very end of the departure lounge where the wifi doesnt work As a capital city airport it is lacking in many of the things one would expect Without the wifi it would be very hard to pass the time waiting for connecting flights

Outstanding views when arriving in on a fair weather day Pass through Airport in little time due to size of airport Friendly staff and facilities need to step up with any increase in flightpassenger numbers Sligo City is only miles form the airport or Euro taxi Journey Area beside airport is popular for running golf surfing and sea sports with international surf competitions held regularly

Nice small low cost but very aged airport needs full reconstruction asap Everything looks like the s but not nice way The floor was dirty so they need to improve cleaning as well Restaurant was closed so there was nowhere to even get a coffee Staff were kind and helpful Will fly there again as FR and W operate nice cheap flights otherwise no chance will be back

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

I specifically chose to fly with TransNusa to try out flying on the COMAC ARJ of which the carrier currently operates two of these aircraft at the moment and is also the first airline in the world outside of China to operate this small commercial jetliner Thankfully there wasnt much of a negative experience everything from checkin to boarding to the inflight experience was prompt and precise even if it werent spectacular As TransNusa opts for a singleclass layout the aircraft has a capacity of passengers seated in rows of The smaller capacity of the aircraft meant that boarding and disembarkation was completed fairly quickly and smoothly Arguably the only sore point of the flight was having to use a bus to board the aircraft instead of using an aerobridge TransNusa includes kg of checked bags as part of the basic air ticket so thats a nice gesture to have Despite having to land in heavy rain at KLIA the entire journey was uneventful and decently pleasant and it suggests that the COMAC ARJ will prove a contender in the regional small commercial jetliner market in the years to come

Manila to Legazpi DRP on Christmas Day Flight was full but went smooth Checkin was a breeze Mabuhay Lounge food was OK though I was hoping for some extra flare on this special day Wasnt a problem though Flight took off slightly ahead of schedule Bags first to arrive at DRP due to Elite status Ticket price was reasonable for this season

Flew Stockholm to Tehran with Iran Air I had good flight with the new fleet of this airline minute delay but the cabin was new and clean with good seat distance and very tasty food Iranian film and music and route information was provided I recommend flying with Iran Air on international routes because of the nice cabin and good meals for the value of money

The plane was a CRJ operated by Skywest I was warmly greeted at the door by a very nice FA Service was excellent The seating on the CRJ is rather than on the larger planes The plane was very comfortable and quiet No entertainment system due to the short flight

Athens to Nuremburg First time I had used or heard of this airline and as it was a very late booking I had little choice The experience was very pleasant The plane was modern clean good legroom comfortable seats The cabin staff were young polite and well dressed Plane was delayed after boarding for minutes due to air traffic control and we were informed by pilot who did his best to make up the time They are pretty strict on hand baggage I have sat on many planes that have been delayed due to excess hand luggage which had to be transferred into the hold This plane loaded very quickly due to one person one bag policy If I have one criticism it would be that there is no online check in system I rarely travel with hold luggage so to have to line up with fellow passengers who had cases was a bit of a pain If however like the majority of passengers you are checking in hold luggage then it is probably not such an issue

Flight from Rome to Turin the plane was old but very clean the hostesses were all very friendly Its better than other low cost airlines because they let you bring both a trolley and a small handbag in the cabin while on other low cost such as Ryanair that isnt allowed

I am only writing this review because so many things are off about this airport I definitely expected more as its a huge airport with tons of revenue from the gaming here The companion care restroom was locked as someone who needs this restroom and cannot use the other ones I was waiting for about minutes I knocked several times After minutes I called the courtesy phone operator concerned that someone was in there and unwell or unconscious No one responded then another person called on his own volition and still no one came This is a HUGE security concern After minutes a line was forming so I flagged down a lovely custodian who unlocked the door and discovered thankfully no one was inside He explained It was locked in the night to prevent people from sleeping in it The fact it was not unlocked during the night in the morning means this airport was not ADA compliant and the fact that no body came after securityrelated calls were made to the operator means this airport does not have quick response to security concerns Its filthy theres food crumbs coffee dust and crud on every surface and many chairs The charging stations barely work at least in the AA terminal and nearly all of the USB direct ports are full of grey putty while the ones that arent full of putty dont charge and are loose and broken The staff here are lovely but the facilities are dismal and frankly this place is a security nightmare As a bay area resident I will never fly through here again and will never recommend this airport with a definite preference for connecting CLEAN SAFE airports like Denver IAHHobby Atlanta or Chicago

As I live in Belo Horizonte this is the most used airport by me Before the renovation this airport was very bad but now after the renovation it looks great it is clean the queue time is good there are many options for shopping and eating and the airport is spacious The only problem is that it is far from Belo Horizonte city centre

TimisoaraMunich The flight was h min and operated on a SAAB which was in pretty good shape I believe these are former Crossair props Was offered a decent breakfast on this flight although a little bit disappointed that the cheese omlette was cold Otherwise good selection of drinks and friendly crew Overall a good deal for the price Would fly them again

I was flying to Luanda by TAAG Angola Airlines When I was going to the gate I saw the plane which looked like an elderly but friendly Boeing I had never flew by Anogla Airlines before therefore I was full of hope and enthusiasm for a pleasant and relaxing journey But soon after boarding the plane the magic of the trip was gone and a mixture of amazement and concern started to raise in my head and the same expression was evident on the faces of passengers around me Plane inside looked well worn but I still hoped to watch a movie and rest a bit before arriving in Luanda Sadly entertainment panels were not working and were damaged so I thought to myself not a big deal I will watch something on my phone but when I tried to plug cable to USB port to charge it a little USB port was not working either I wanted to change my seat to look for a working panel but it turned out that none of them are working and many of the USB charging ports were simply missing in many seats and there was just a hole in the seats I tried to stay positive well I have a book to read so I can read for a while instead right Unfortunately the seat lights were not working either and the whole cabin was dark I tried to deploy the foot rest but to my surprise both foot rest pedals were missing too Since the passenger cabin has so many defects it surely must have failed some periodic checks or maybe they were never carried out I learned later is that TAAG Angola Airline was blacklisted banned from EU airspace for many years for failing to meet regulatory oversight standards and restrictions were lifted only before covid It seems to me that decision was premature and perhaps needs to be reevaluated as clearly this airline is not carrying out basic checks On the positive note the cabin crew gave an excellent safety demonstration on the use of life jacket

Astana is a small international airport that is well connected to Europe via Frankfurt London Paris and Amsterdam through Kazakhstans Air Astana The airport has only one terminal for Domestic and International flights A new terminal is being constructed next to the existing facility which is planned to be opening in spring The arrivals and baggage reclaim is small Immigration quite smooth and officers were friendly but remember to fill in your immigration card with a blue or black pen not with a red one as it is not accepted I had almost no queues Taxi pickup at the terminal is not wellorganised and taxi recruiters can be annoying The central hall for departures is quite spacious and there is sufficient seating around the checkin area Checkin areas are small and somewhat oldfashioned but work fine Friendly ground staff Short queuing time at checkin passport control and security Emigration passport control is fine There are few FB and retail facilities at the international departure gates There is plenty of seating at the end of the concourse close to the small cafe in the back Transferring between international flights is quick and easy Passengers do not have to pass immigration only security screening It took me only minutes from arrival gate to departure gate FB and retail facilities are limited especially in the departure are after immigration Food choice is limited Very good wifi while waiting for checkin or for your flight Password can be obtained via SMS Terminal and toilets are clean Remote arrivals and departures via bus in winter when temperatures can go below Celsius can be cold and slippery but also a very interesting experience When the new terminal will be opened in I assume less aircraft will be handled via busses

Lots of good food and shops Amazing love piano playing and fun Wicked Weed food court However the reason Im writing is because this place is filthy I dont want to touch a surface I know theyre under construction but that doesnt account for counters and corners and floors that obviously havent been scrubbed in a long time Gross Embarrassing The survey asks if I would recommend this airport and my reply is mixed First off airport choice is pretty arbitrary as it just depends on where youre going and also some aspects are great The cleanliness however is terrible

Great regional airport by Spanish Standards Easy to Navigate when both landing and departing Arrivals was easy immigration was quick and at the end of the arrivals lounge is the transit bus to the city centre minutes from getting of the plane and on a bus into the city Check in was easy and simple the only departures terminal has about check in desks in the main hall and queues at security where not to long The airside shopping is adequate and walking to the furthest gate takes no more than minutes

Expecting the worst but a great surprise It was a new building and super clean Great welcome by the airport staff and especially the Passport Control proud of their airport and their country and genuinely do their best to make it a painless process On departure the check in staff were efficient cheerful and helpful A very pleasant little cafe for snacks and once again through to more smiling passport control

Check in in Bangkok swift and friendly lounges and boarding in Bangkok and Hong Kong always top notch Service and catering on both flights good What annoys me with flying economy on CX is their unwillingness to credit any Avios in non CX One World programs I was willing to pay a higher fare to get my points but there isnt any which credits points in Economy That is the reason to make me think twice to fly Cathay again in Y in the future

On October th we flew from Vienna to Karpathos which turned out to be the last passenger flight with this Airline to this destination due to the sad development The crew worked flawless as ever and was extremely friendly despite the fact that they are not quite sure about their professional future Not a single mention came up about that but you could see and sense their feelings We are exceedingly angry about the fact that many thousand passengers loose their money and some thousand well working employess lose their job Many many thanks and good luck for the crew and all the other employees of ABNiki

PSP is a great little airport The s style terminal is fairly well designed but with the advent of security screening areas its a bit harder to negotiate Rental cars are right outside the door from the baggage carousels The weather is seldom a problem so flights stay pretty close to their schedules Parking is reasonably priced and convenient to the terminal

Quick flight with good service and friendly staff Checkin was efficient Aircraft was clean and welcoming Only negative was the arrival at a station where bussing brought us back to the terminal rather than an airbridge

I decided to fly to Siem Reap from Phnom Penh as it was a much quicker and enjoyable I cannot believe the price of the Bassaka Air flight it was pretty much the same as a bus The checkin was the quickest check in Ive had at an airport anywhere The staff were great and it was the first time Ive ever been on a budget airline where I received a free drink Bearing in mind we were only flying for minutes I cant speak highly enough for this airline

Baku to Kiev with Buta Airways I have to say after travelling for years this was definitely the best Low Cost Carrier I have ever flown with On time and sharp Plus you get free water and a free sandwich But saying that for a ml beer is and a pizza Incredible value you money I had flown them for a min flight so was interested to see what a hour flight would be like But it was absolutely perfect

The negative reviews of this airport have been highly exaggerated Bangladesh is a third world country so no its not quite up to the standards one would expect from a big international airport but its really completely fine I did not have any trouble getting through immigration or customs and didnt have to pay any bribes nor was I ever approached by someone who attempted to bribe me The Bangladeshi people are the best part of Bangladesh and thats true of the airport as well at least from the perspective of an English speaker Many of the staff speak English and were all polite friendly and welcoming The airport was reasonably clean and there were a few bugs though its not infested by any means Theres plenty of space It can get a little hot though as it is poorly airconditioned but its not any worse than any other airport in other poor countries Once you are out of the official airport you do need to be careful because there are some scammers mostly unaffiliated with the airport running around who will try to get you to put your bags on their carts and then charge you exorbitant fees to get your bags back As usual when travelling to a place with a lot of poverty dont engage with these people and you will be fine

Tambor to San Jos Regional airline Flight with Cessna clean and flight was on time Very basic airport but the staff were eager to operate it efficient They operate from San Jos domestic terminal which is basic but does the job They are trustworthy and I would recommend them

Fortaleza Praia February The flight was operated in a reasonable B by no means new but not as rickety as I had been led to believe The seating was alleconomy and the leather seats fine but slippery Seat pitch was OK and I am a tall chap certainly an inch or more greater than its competitors The flight departed minutes late at and due to the hour I declined the meal offered which looked bland but edible We arrived in Praia on schedule and my bags did the same connecting to Sal and Mindelo without delay All in all a reasonable experience

First time I have ever used this airline Service was impeccable on the plane Business class configuration Pyjamas given The bed is fully flat with a mattress and duvet comfortable The food quality was excellent with options of light meals when you want Breakfast was a delight The plane was fairly empty in business class but service was attentive Movies good selection not the best but good noisecancelling Headphones The Flight was on time into Brussels The lounge option is a bit weak in Shanghai the view lounge is used in Brussels Overall will use again
Macau Intl airport is spacious Security was efficient and fast Checkin counter queues not long and fast Staff at the counters were good and friendlyThe boarding gates were big and not crowded

Another really good experience First leg Madeira to Ponta Delgada flight on a Q turboprop Flight left early and arrived early Polite check in staff in Madeira checked both our carry on and checked luggage all the way to Toronto OK snack and non alcoholic beverage service on a hour flight Second leg Ponta Delgada to Toronto on an Airbus On time departure and arrival Good unique Portuguese meal pasta with tuna bacon and chorizo two passes of the beverage cart Both flights had courteous and professional cabin crew for planes that were full lots of announcements from the flight deck about possible turbulence A better entertainment system would have been welcome for the second hour flight

When I arrived at this airport from incheon the immigration lines were long It took me more than an hour to get out of the airport I headed to Incheon a few days later Security and immigration was actually fine although I found the facilities a little old There were plenty of places to shop and relax but I wished that there were more food choices Overall this is a small but functional airport
The folks at Delta and Sky West were great They took great care of daughter and her room mate on their way home for spring break They made a special trip to get our bags at the Elko Airport
Newquay airport is excellent apart from the abysmal state of seating in the main departure lounge Seating all torn and very scruffy It has been like this for a long time Unacceptable

TNR to SMS via TMM A real delightconvenient timely clean friendly and attractively priced serving routes where you might not generally expect that Its great that theyre introducing some competition to the national carrier and we have nothing but compliments for the staff and the excellent service onboard

Small NW Tasmanian airport with flights to Melbourne Tasmanian destinations Neat tidy with easy checkin baggage collection Small cafeshop enough seating for size of aircraft using airport Not a bad little airport
London to Algiers There was a slight delay but the service onboard was excellent Clean very nice food and friendly personnel Very pleased with the whole experience Would fly Air Algerie again

The crew were attentive and friendly and constantly checking we are ok I would especially like to thank flight attendant Osher who noticed I was upset and on the verge of crying and took me aside for a chat tissue and tea This made me feel I am already at home even before landing

Berlin to Dusseldorf Eurowings flight operated by Germanwings This A was a different configuration then the first flight Legroom was less and was just enough for me m crew were smiling and good The flight delayed by minutes

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

Excellent little airport A bit tired cosmetically but everyone was friendly and everything worked seamlessly Dont rush through security unless youre desperate to look at aeroplanes as theres not much else to do Theres a little smoking box that takes people after security next to gate upstairs Its free and the ventilation works well

After standing at passport control for over hour It was our turn Seconds earlier a couple appeared in another queue next to ours My partner who speaks the language perfectly pointed out that there was a queue Also someone else in the queue pointed it out as well The passport officer told us to go back over the red line And told this couple to come forward Not military not late for the same flight as us Cant believe that someone should get preferential treatment at passport control

Feedback on my initial visit to MCI new terminal I am a Kansas City native this review is critical as it should be Overall impression is outstanding compared to the s era terminals It addresses the needs of a st century Midwest airport with all the modern necessities one would expect as a flying customer First impression walking in its big It spans wide and the design incorporating natural lighting with an abundance of windows is refreshing The evening sunlight streaming in through different angles really provides a nonrestricted feel as you walk about the terminal The respective airline checkin counterplacements are easy to identify and span the width of the front end of the terminal for easy access Security access is fairly streamlined and the entire process is able to accommodate large volumes of travelers nonTSA airport VMD corp more natural light as you progress through each arm of the terminal ABC with interior lighting not overbearing The walkways are wide and allow for excellent views of the tarmac exterior gates and various angles of the entirety of the taxiways and runways Additionally the escalators and walking escalators are positioned nicely and push you through terminal in a speedy manner More shops etc at each terminal branch providing basically anything the traveler would need The vibe and local venues are all a welcome addition and definitely fulfill the needs of the traveler Individual gates and structured well and offer comfortable seating and ample wireless device charging The one thing that seems odd is the placement of the gate flight monitors It is essentially in the seating area of the individual gates Why not place it directly behindabove the agent boothdesk for easy and quick access and explanation poor design decision Boarding the plane the traveler is treated to long glass jet bridges that allow for excellent views of adjacent aircraft and outside weather conditions This is a well thought out design that many major airports do not offer Overall the new MCIKCI terminal is a massive upgrade to the Kansas City area It has the opportunity for expansion and I would expect future modifications to address design shortfalls and customer feedback We concluded it feels like a mall when walking though the new terminal Three things need immediate addressing Mens restroom upkeep and sanitary conditions unacceptable Need to revisit the options of installing automatic hand blower machines and look at the cleaning schedules to ensure conditions do not deteriorate to the point of being an embarrassment Cleaning crews need to maintain a regular schedule on vacuuming the terminal carpet paper and debris everywhere Please explain how the gate flight monitors are controlled by the city How is this beneficial to the traveler or airline staff Local control to changemodify the monitors shouldnt even be a discussion This new terminal is supposed to represent the pride of Kansas City aviation

Good small airport The staff is not friendly at all First nobody smile in that airport and when i pass the gate they dont greeting at the search point and passport point One guy he just pointing me by hand what to do and chewing gum in your face

This is the first time in over a year I used this airport and I have to say that I am not disappointed Its facilities are fair very clean pleasant to stroll through and spacious The staff is pleasant and professional

Super modern airport bright shiny and very clean Security control was reasonably quick on departure and arrival and I found the staff professional although they dont smile a lot Bonus points for having showers after security I took one and it was marvellous I wasnt sold on Abu Dhabi itself but the airport is certainly one of the best Ive experienced in recent times

We were on a chartered flight taking a group of very special kids to Lourdes in France Team were so friendly and welcoming Lovely comfy accommodation clean and spacious Lovely touch was a special package snack for our VIPs Thank you Titan

I took the am flight from Basra to Erbil an Iraqi domestic flight I bought the ticket the day before at the Iraqi Airways ticket office in Basra They were friendly spoke English and only take Iraqi dinars no credit cards I paid roughly the equivalent of The flight left on time and was fine The equipment was a B On the short flight they served a breakfast tray with a lot of very sweet things chocolate milk an Iraqi Twinkietype cake a soft roll with jam and a banana It wasnt really to my liking but it was nevertheless an energypacked breakfast which is more than one gets on European carriers these days The flight attendants were friendly and we landed in Erbil on time I was satisfied with my flight and wish other people would also leave reviews for this airline

There in December Jan and Mar times very quick handling of luggage etc comfortable waiting area and free internet No queues for Immigration desk One point that is minor if you dont know where the bus to Rotterdam centre is located you may have a problem however I took a taxi and then it takes only minutes Its much more agreeable than the big airports like Toulouse Orly JFK or even Schiphol also in the Netherlands

This is a great airport and the T terminal is newly established everything inside this airport are symbols of a modernized airport Staff were friendly and helpful in helping directing me to the baggage claim area upon arrival as well as help me check in efficiently by asking my seat preference which I havent experienced during check in before Only disadvantage would be the WiFi in the airport when I arrived in the airport I do not have a Chinese mobile phone and in order to connect to the airport WiFi I need to have a valid Chinese phone number so I could receive verification code unlike my transfer flight in Guangzhou where I could simply connect to the WiFi using my WeChat account Overall my experience with WNZ is great but please fix the WiFi issue so international traveler can connnect to the WiFi

Small but efficient little island airport Quite possibly the cleanest terminal building Ive ever been in a small team of cleaners were walking around constantly dusting vacuuming polishing and looking for any litter the whole time we were there No fuss no overly loud announcements friendly staff obvious sign posting and a nice selection of shops which had very reasonable prices and unobtrusive sales assistants who didnt attempt to force anyone into buying things I really like this airport a lot the only thing Id mention is that try to remember its a tropical island so be careful where you leave your bags While waiting outside for the shuttle bus to take us to our rental car centre I saw a huge spider the size of the palm of my hand scurry into someones luggage Probably not the best start to that persons vacation but thankfully we managed to arrive and depart without any extra passengers with us

Travelled late Marchearly April Completely empty extremely clean overlooking the runway walking distance from town checkin queue was non existent for me travelling to London Car hire is fine quality food available but all very cosy and empty of huge hordes of people The best airport Ive been too
The airport services were very attentive to the plane we arrived at local time when we left the plane the luggage gang was already in operation and the suitcases were in very good condition

My flights were delayed for many hours due to weather in Dallas El Paso airport is the best airport to be stranded in It has an easilyaccessed smoking area in a lovely courtyard Its small enough to get around quickly but big enough to have decent food My delays would have been much worse in a larger airport but El Paso airport made my delays manageable Staff were also great Security and the like especially outside directing vehicle traffic were nice and helpful offering extra help or information if I needed it Love this airport The only minor annoyance was that it did not have a lot of charging ports in the seating areas so I had to stand while my phone was charging

Check in at LHR T was quick and easy and minimal queue for security Business Class passengers on Malaysia Airlines have access to the Qatar Airways lounge which is excellent and we enjoyed a nice light breakfast before the flight Malaysia use A for the flight to KL and my wife and I had chosen seats D and G meaning that both seats have aisle access Malaysia Airlines cabin crew are some of the best in the industry and as always the service was very good The meal service starts with signature satays followed by smoked salmon for the main course I tried the Malaccanstyle seabass fillet very tasty An area where Malaysia Airlines could improve is in the inflight entertainment the choice of films is quite limited and well below the standard of airlines such as Emirates Flight arrival into KL was minutes ahead of schedule which left quite a long transfer time for our connection to Penang The Malaysia Airlines lounge in the domestic departures area is ok but can get very busy Our onward flight to Penang was on an B one of the upgraded aircraft with new business class seats and WiFi based entertainment system which you use with your own device We did not use this for such a short flight We were impressed with the service on this minute flight which included a small hot meal Arrival into Penang was on schedule and the bags were delivered promptly Overall a great couple of flights with Malaysia Airlines

A very large airport with not many flights There were heaps of gates not being used The airport itself though was very nice clean with lots of places for food and beverages although service at a couple of those places left a bit to be desired There was also a little play area near our gate for our son We hired a trolley from outside but there was nowhere to drop it off inside you had to go out and then go back in via security so we just abandoned ours in the hall Several other people had done the same and we saw someone gather them a small thing that can be easily fixed Security very fast and nice man on duty

rest to say I was pleasantly surprised by my airport experience would be an understatement Beauvais is a hub for budget airlines No one should be under any illusion that youre flying out of CDG or another mega airport in a capital city Could the departure hall use a lick of paint Probably Could a few more benches be put in Absolutely But as a functioning airport with many flights departing at similar times it manages the best it can We arrived at the airport early due to all of the fearmongering in reviews but it allowed us to see that the airport tries its best to manage the flow of traffic There are screens over security confirming when youll be able to go through passport control in relation to your flight time approx hours for us in line with the bag drop opening and from there through to the end of security it was barely even minutes until we were in duty free As I removed my liquids and electricals in advance as nearly all airports expect and clearly have signposted as is the same in BVA there were no issues with security Duty free is admittedly sparse but there were signs up confirming that maintenance work was ongoing The toilets were adequate and there was a caf open for use as well as vending and hot drinks machines There were plug sockets FYI not usb ports and in the grand scheme of things a fair number of benches there are departure gates and of those are in a separate area so the space is distributed fairly In fact the only issues that I could see occurring were from fellow passengers themselves People with luggage double the size of the restrictions were being asked to pay the fee at the gate but this should not be a surprise for anyone who spends even seconds looking at their boarding card information Likewise an outgoing flight was held but this was due to passengers being late to the gate the call was done in English French and the language of the flight destination so there really were no excuses If people try to blame the airport for this then they should be taking a longer look at themselves Im ultimately reviewing BVA for what it is a budget friendly space to travel for those of us who dont want to break the bank

I have mixed feelings about this airport Upon arrival the checkin process took almost no time at all and I was on my way in a matter of minutes Terminal signs presecurity were limited but easy enough that I was able to find the C security checkpoint quick enough Security was a different story The wait was brutal taking over an hour to clear On top of this the staff were not very fast chatting to everyone about travel plans flying etc Terminal signage postsecurity was much clearer and my gate was found quite fast Departure was also very efficient and boarding went by fast and I was departing on time Overall this airport has good and bad but its one of the better airports that Ive been to

An enjoyable flight It left on time and check in was easy The seat was quite comfortable for a short flight The staff were very friendly and efficient The food was surprisingly good as well The flight offered refreshments twice In fact more food then my flight on QANTAS from Sydney to Cairns

It was five and half hours flight They served only one breakfast After that they didnt offer anything unless we asked for a snack or drinks They should have offered another light meal two hours after breakfast Otherwise everything is perfect

Checked in amazing helpful staff her name was Nikki at London Heathrow Airport she was friendly and amazing service also told me my flight was delayed which I did not know and made sure everything was okay Highly recommend

The airport itself is good but the design looks simply ok The airport is big it has old and new parts the new part looks better It has many checkin desks fast security check and very nice that they have priority security check and priority passport control Some nice business lounges and good duty free

I read a huge amount of negativity about this airport prior to my trip there it was a five hour transit stop going from London to Bangkok I was certainly concerned reading all the previous reviews However I didnt experience any real issues The airport is very large so easy to find a quiet spot there are plenty of power outlets and getting online is extremely simple you just log on and take a pic of your passport Granted you wont be able to do very much online unless youve got one of the VPNs that work behind the great China firewall but if you have an iPad with a couple of movies downloaded the time will soon pass There was a reasonable amount of shops open both for coffee and souvenir shopping The train that youll need to take to get to your gate is frequent clean and fast Overall Ive been to more interesting airports but my message would be dont stress out reading the negative reviews I had no issues whatsoever

Nice small low cost but very aged airport needs full reconstruction asap Everything looks like the s but not nice way The floor was dirty so they need to improve cleaning as well Restaurant was closed so there was nowhere to even get a coffee Staff were kind and helpful Will fly there again as FR and W operate nice cheap flights otherwise no chance will be back

Very small but friendly efficient airport Not a great deal to do and not many shops particularly airside but staff are always remarkably friendly and helpful which makes a change from most other airports I visit

An hour delay no apologies nor explanations Quite some occasional turbulences again no word from the cockpit What compensated the whole flight was the incredible good seat pitch and the round of drinks and a cookie definitely much better than what some selfproclaimed fullservice airlines deliver

Privilege Style operate an old Singapore Airlines and I took their flight between Miami and London Gatwick as Norwegian were unable to run their new Boeing Dreamliner I see a lot of people complaining about Privilege Style however I had an amazing experience in their business class cabin I actually chose to fly with Privilege Style so I could experience the old Singapore Airlines business class cabin and I wasnt disappointed The business class cabin was in a configuration and was completely booked out however the seat I had was very spacious and I had so much room to myself The cabin crew in the business cabin looked after us like a true business class experience which I was not expecting We had a welcome drink and there were plenty of staff for the small number of people in the cabin I pressed the call button at one point and a cabin crew member came over straight away The food was very good too nothing special but it was better than I expected It was also served quickly too which was great theres nothing worse than waiting hours for your meal We had blankets and a pillow provided too really making this feel like a business class flight and I liked how the cabin crew stopped economy passengers from using our toilets As we flew over the Atlantic the cabin lights dimmed and most people got sleep Ive flown business class several times before and for the price I paid this is one where I got the most value Note that the entertainment system is a bit rubbish but I knew that and took my laptop preloaded with some films and my own noise cancelling headphones Im posting this because I did research before this flight online and couldnt find any positive reviews about the business class experience and for that reason I was worried about what it was going to be like I hope this review helps people who might be thinking about booking with Privilege Style

General Mitchell is a breath of a fresh air Its clean friendly and efficient Theres actually a classy little used book store and a museum full of model planes and blimps and whatnot If you get lost it is your fault my friend The whole place is like one of the models in the museum accurate well labeled and miniature Everything is right in front of you Theres an Amtrak station a block away minutes and to get to Union Station in Chicago is hard to beat This airport is tiny but its the easiest one Ive ever dealt with

Highly recommended airline offering excellent value for money I booked my flight from Bali to Doha via Xiamen and received three full meals a hour entry permit to explore Xiamen during my hour transit a free single hotel room and a free shuttle from airport to hotel all for It is simply incredible to believe that you can fly from Bali to China to Doha for only

This was an unexpected surprise due to my family thinking that we were going to fly Ryanair however in my opinion it was a pleasant surprise I have a really bad fear of flying so an incredibly nice cabin crew member sat next to me and told me that she loved flying and how long she had done it for and how safe it was She also said that she really enjoyed flying and the turbulence was enjoyable The seats were nice and the crew was amazing I didnt get any food but I loved this low cost airline

What great TSA staff have at St PeteClearwater Airport The lines moved smoothly and additional lines were opened when it became crowded The food court consists of one small shop where the food is OK Looking forward to going through this airport again on Sunday

The Buffalo Niagara Airport was quite an experience It was easily accessible and was fantastic with the hotels right across the road The staff were okay We were flying early in the morning so they might have been tired but they seemed alright The airport was larger than I expected The parking was easy and cheap Overall it was a nice experience

Chongqing Airport is one of the biggest in Southwest China The new terminal is just km away from the old terminal and is well connected by metro line The airport terminal is very spacious and well designed that incorporates with many new technologies Mine was a direct flight by Hainan Airline to JFK The departure area has all sort of restaurants and shops which makes the last minute shopping possible Facilities are very clean and well put My only concern is the long waiting time at the border control

Due to the relatively low number of flights planes dont have to wait circling around in the air or on the tarmac The airport itself is perfectly connected to the inner city and the central station trains from there take you to Munich Wrzburg and Regensburg in about hour to Frankfurt and Stuttgart in hours by a minutes metro ride Passport and security checks as well as baggage handling are a breeze Staff is very friendly and helpful

Recife Airport is definitely the best airport I have been through in Brazil The scenery coming in to land is impressive The architecture of the building is very modern and excellent use is made of natural lighting There is an excellent observation deck on the second floor with a good selection of restaurants and shopping outlets The first floor is departures and the ground floor is arrivals Selection is good landside and even airside there are enough options for an early flight including a hour coffee shop Security is extremely tough Be prepared to take off belt shoes wallet etc Checkin machines strategically placed and few queues although my departing flight was at am maybe the situation is different during the day I arrived at lunch time though and no problems either Excellent connections into Boa Viagem and downtown via bus Aeroporto Opcional passes in front of airport very frequent daytime only Taxis are also readily available a trip to Boa Viagem Beach shall be about R which is about USD The airport deserves more international traffic as Recife is a major tourist hub Current flights only to Frankfurt Condor Panama City Copa and Lisbon TAP A tip if you are flying out of Recife be sure to take some bolo de rolo with you Its a local delicacy a kind of guava cake

I go to Jacksonville airport a lot since this is my hometown airport It is a nice clean and small with only gates Due to the size you dont really need signage at all Despite the small size there is still a bunch of food options before and after the security checkpoint There is also some good shops like Brooks Brothers and a PGA Tour Shop There is also a big pavilion with rocking chairs right before security Its a great place to wait if youre waiting on an arriving flight There is also pretty good employees well besides the TSA people One time I had to go through the regular checkpoint instead of PreCheck and they only had one metal detector and one ProVision open It took about minutes to pass through because of this I got to my gate when they were calling the last boarding zone when I was supposed to board in the first boarding zone However a great airport and I recommend it

Checkingin for a seat flight without any other flights at the same time was never going to be busy Checkin staff who was also baggage handler flight dispatcher and Im sure other things was very friendly and efficient The small terminal had good restroom facilities car hire drinks and food dispensing machine Surprisingly large number of security personnel for a tiny airport I counted at least security staff Nice experience

From Jeju Korea to Taipei and back I was hesitant to fly with an unknown local Taiwanese company but I have to say that I was nicely surprised the service is good and plane clean The hostess are courteous and the planes looks internally and externally wellkept The flight was pleasant and trouble free even with a baby Far much better from the china eastern flight I took from Shanghai to Jeju which was baby unfriendly I would compare Far Eastern Air transport as Dragonair a bit more clean
Always on time Professional cabin crew Perfect weather and an overall pleasant flight Thank you FlySafair

Lovely little airport Check in was very quick as was passport control and security Good selection of shops after security Airport was very clean including the toilets A couple of dining options available and a drinking water dispenser provided to top up your bottles Mineral water can also be purchased for US Plenty of seating available by the gates On departure there are no gates just a short walk to the plane All in all a great little airport

I flew TokyoSapporoTokyo I was pleasantly surprised at the efficiency and professionalism of the staff The crew spoke English We departed and arrived ontime The great price combined with the excellent service ensures I will fly Skymark again

A pleasant airport Our flight arrived at and even though we had to do a COVID test at the airport we completed all the formalities and left the airport within minutes On departure the flight was at and at this time there were a reasonable number of international flights also departing however the check in and security checks were quite quick After security there is a large duty free shop as well as some smaller shops and foodbeverage outlets The terminal was clean and tidy Obviously the airport is not yet operating at full capacity but our experience was fine Only letdown was the poor WiFi

A long but pleasant flight Cabin crew were kind and friendly gave me snacks when I walked to back of the plane to stretch my legs Food was good The only hiccup was the website has glitches on some of the pages for online checkin when accessed from mobile phone I had to use iPad to find a workaround in the end hour call centre hotline based in Brunei was very useful and answered the call with no queue You dont get that efficiency from many carriers these days

A good airport Lots of places to eat including burger and many seats with places to charge you devices I sat there for hrs just streaming Netflix on the wifi May I say the wifi Is great Highly recommend

Guayaquil Airport is modern and clean but if you arrive on a domestic flight there is no transit You need to go out and do checkin and security Arrivals can be crowded and staff are not that friendly The one smile that I got was from the girl selling chocolates at the store inside

MSP Airport does a great job with stores and restaurant options and recently completed some moderate improvements in aesthetics to terminal They currently offer a total of electric parking spots which are spread out across sites It appears the planning team completely overlooked this aspect of the customer experience

Small airport in Kalimantan Borneo with basic facilities It has improved in Fast free WIFIPC power charger cafe fast food toilet praying room souvenir shop etc Comfort seat in waiting room They also have executive lounge Concordia

During the monthlong trip around Mongolia we flew MIAT three times twice on domestic routes UBNMoron UlgiiUBN and then the exit flight to Narita Japan On domestic flights we flew the CRJ jets small but quite comfy with basic but professional services good on time performances and speedy luggage delivery The exit flight to Narita was also on time crew was very professional and attentive food was ok and the only thing missing on the almost hr flight was the entertainment which was not working on our phones Overall we were quite happy with MIAT

Departure experience was relatively smooth an early morning flight on Ryanair so airport was very quiet Security was well managed clear markings on the floor to encourage social distancing However there was no coffee shop open so nowhere to buy a drink or a bite to eat Arriving back was very quick there were a number of staff members on hand to organise passengers no queue at passport control and bags were out within minutes however this was to be expected due to a very quiet flight and an empty airport Overall whilst the airport appeared clean we did not see any staff members cleaning while we were there with no hand sanitising stations available to passengers

The airline is convenient for the short trip between Bali and Lombok with few other carriers on this route There are regular flight schedules Due to passenger volume a twin propellor plane is used which are never as comfortable as a jet Overall I am happy the service exists however on this leg of the journey the plane had been sitting on the tarmac for a while and the air temp inside was extremely hot and even when in the air the air con was substandard and the cabin temperature was still warm to hot As is common with propellor aircraft there is no aerobridge which on this flight meant cross through rows of planes to get to the bus Both Air Wings flight departed and arrive on time which is good

Nothing special to write it looks more like a train station than an airport but its a small city anyway so thats fair Access from the city center by tram makes it the easiest cheapest and fastest airport to reach Ive seen in my life Fans of space will love the huge International Space Station model in the main hall and aviation fans will love the souvenir shop where you can buy many Airbus collectors items One thing they should put more power sockets

Perfect experience After having read the reviews on Fastjet I was very nervous despite friends reinsurance that the airline had improved dramatically in recent years Well everything was perfect The ticket was very reasonably priced Checkin online and baggage drop off were easy The flight left on time and arrived minutes early The air hostess was charming The snacks though not fancy were good and our chairs were comfortable The baggage was on the carousel by the time we arrived Very happy customers

Its a smaller airport compared to Mumbai not a problem actually Some toilets on the arrival hall are not good This airport has more shopping options now and its enough actually There are spa and lounge facilities available here The lounges are okay I have never experienced any delay to date Overall an above expectation feel It gets my job done
What a delightful surprise The best service good food excellent entertainment Very spacious seating Very good price for the ticket Its my new favourite airline I will seek it out in future for sure

Lots of good food and shops Amazing love piano playing and fun Wicked Weed food court However the reason Im writing is because this place is filthy I dont want to touch a surface I know theyre under construction but that doesnt account for counters and corners and floors that obviously havent been scrubbed in a long time Gross Embarrassing The survey asks if I would recommend this airport and my reply is mixed First off airport choice is pretty arbitrary as it just depends on where youre going and also some aspects are great The cleanliness however is terrible

I arrived in Nur Sultan Airport from Novosibirsk Russia and left to go to Almaty The Immigration control was quite fast and no problems in getting a day Visa on arrival The airport is relatively new and modern Security was efficient and effective I had a couple of hours between flights and wanted to recharge phone and computer There was plenty of seating but there were very few places and none adjacent to a seat where I could charge my computer I watched it from about metres away The airport has all the things that interest some people money exchange tourist souvenirs etc I seldom shop in airports

Smooth flight and comfortable seat Premium economy still a good value on Finnair The cabin chief was competent as I got a problem with only one choice of meal Im platinum and I was upset to see the poorest service during the dinner on board he went to apologize so its good but when you pay euros you expect a better service concerning the food The flight attendants have to be more smiley

So refreshing to be able to use Duerne instead of Brussels Less than minutes from plane to car this week and that included collecting a bag On return I checked in about minutes before the flight hardly any queue

I had forgotten what the airport was like but it was great very small and compact no air bridges to aircraft just a quick walk across the airfield Immigration was very easy and efficient as international flights seem to land one at a time The luggage was swiftly off the aircraft and minutes you are in your taxi off to your Hotel Check in again was very quick we arrived very early and were first in the queue your taxi drops you off curbside and you walk about paces and the checkin is in front of you Immigration was very quick minutes and you are airside very limited space and a sad sight of a Burger King Fortunately we went upstairs to the BusinessFirst Lounge shared by most airlines it was empty when we arrived but filled very quickly good tea and coffee a bit limited offerings but ample really Called when the flight was boarding chaos downstairs but they were calling priority boarding and eventually all went as planned

Pros Very good interiors and wellmaintained seats cleanliness lighting Ample space available between knee and seat in front of you Wellmannered and clear language English and Hindi speaking crew led by Ms Unnati Didnt have food nor used washroom so cannot comment on that Journey was comfortable and no bumpy rides encountered Communication from cockpit was also clear everytime Cons Boarding was not done in zoneseat number wise Quite some mosquitoes seen before take off which bit me and some passengers Crew applied some spray but wasnt enough Pricing was a big letdown as huge increase seen while booking on Feb for my journey date of Feb in a short span of time Slight delay in takeoff after closing of doors

Flew AR on various segments in November Rio de Janeiro GIG to Buenos Aires Buenos Aires Puerto Madryn rt and Buenos Aires Barilcohe rt using both AEP and EZE in Buenos Aires Pleasant experience on all flights All flights departed on time boarding process was well organized crews were courteous and complimentary drinks and a snack were served in economy No issues with checked luggage Would certainly fly them again

Used this airport multiple times for international and domestic arrivals and departures Nice and clean Airport staff are friendly Provides jet bridge at almost every flight In my opinion it needs more coffee shops eateries and lounges Parking spot is located conveniently close to the airport entrance

The airport and their airlines offer a wide range of European and North African leisure destinations but also large German cities such as Frankfurt or Munich Nice little shops and restauantscafes Staff are very friendly and the waiting times as well as the walking times are unbeatable Love flying fromto the Airport

Both legs of my flight were much better than expected The aircraft was clean and fresh The cabin crew were pleasant and efficient Check in was a breeze on both legs Flights departed and arrived as scheduled The seat was just fine for a hour flight I am a normalsized person I would certainly fly with them again given the overall experience

Shinchitose airport is really effective A lot of souvenir shops and wonderful musiam in the airport A brand new international terminal will be open in Great hotels and various amusement things are worth of expecting
Great Airport used it for a Ryanair flight to Stansted Small highly efficient great bar restaurant and shops A breeze to get through am going to use again Wish they were all like this

Panama City to Caracas a journey of hrs There was very little legroom but we were served quite a decent meal and considering it was a short flight I was impressed We departed on time but arrived min late

Small clean airport Close to the city centre If one arrives for a later flight in the evening arrive with a full stomach as nothing is open after It is an efficient small airport with quick security The TV is still on at full volume in the departure area

My husband and I have never used Newcastle airport before but I though we would give it ago and this time I need special assistance as Im waiting for spinal surgery and loosing the use of my hands and feet I booked it easily enough with Ryanair and the special assistance was easy to find and I found the staff very kind and courteous and nothing was too much trouble We arrived the hours before we travelled as per the warning message from Ryanair so the special assistance man took us through the process of Xray and boarding cards so easily and left us for a drink and they came back when they said for me and everything was perfect except the food area was slightly dirty but the special assistance people all I can say thank you for making my travel easy and you all were brilliant

Corpus Christi is fine small airport In remarkably good shape and well kept Very simple and easy to navigate TSA security was a breeze no lines and all staff were actually very firendly Not much offering presecurity but couple of shops and restaurants post security Easy to get to just west of downtown

I forgot my prescription glasses in the Duty Free in Tbilisi Following a few emails to the Duty Free department I received a positive response that they were found Two ladies did everything in their power to have them returned to me I cant fault these people they showed care and sympathy to my problems They are Natia and Inna Thank you so much

Overall very pleasant experience Landed in Terminal Kuwait Airways Holding on to a Singapore passport and it took me just mins to have my evisa stamp Very efficient Custom clearance done under mins and luggage out right on time I was out of the airport in mins Departure from Terminal Qatar Airways fuss free Few DFS stores and cafes Not much options but all good

Great experience at arrival Very friendly staff welcoming all the way Quick check of Thailand Pass with no waiting time as smooth through immigration The bags already on belt when we came to arrival hall

extra minutes in its schedule We landed at Taipei minutes late only after a wait of hrs took off for Vancouver on the second leg of my journey This flight was unfortunately delayed by minutes at Taipei due to baggage loading issues etc We landed at Vancouver minutes late as a result of the late take off The flight however was very smooth comfortable Cabin Crew was very good cleaned the toilets every hrs so they remained spic span were well stocked Entertainment system was very good though on SingaporeTaipei sector my Screen had no sound I had to change my Seat The food I always eat on flights is AVML Indian Veg Meal this varied in quality SingaporeTaipei meal was very good though it lacked Indian Bread bun provided No Plain Yoghurt I would rate it On the Taipei Vancouver Sector The Aroport international de Qubec is a good example to follow concerning quality of service and infrastructure Its clean well designed and the staff are professional and customer oriented

I was surprised when I arrived at Berlin Tempelhof how small the airport was However the facilities are there although in a small scale and the airport is relatively clean and friendly Not a bad airport just a bit out of date

I was extremely impressed with Providence TF Green Airport It is high up on the list of my favorite small airport and heres a lowdown on it The Terminal It is all very straightforward with everything well signposted and not complicated at all Security is efficient and the multiple times weve gone through there wasnt much line at all After Security there is a decent selection of Shops and Dining The shops include the standard souvenir and news shops plus a few interesting clothes and accessory shops Foodwise there is a small but good variety of places to eat ranging from a Dunkin Donuts to an Oyster Bar The seating in the terminal is comfortable and regularly equipped with charging outlets The WiFi is nothing special free for minutes but at least its there Connections Norwegian Air advertises the airport as BostonProvidence While Providence isnt too far from Boston it is still a good hour driving The RIPTA bus service passes reasonably frequently and is a good way to get to downtown Providence I recommend that or the Peter Pan Coach over the MBTA train as that passes infrequently and only works on weekdays To get to Boston using Public transportation I would recommend taking the Coach as the train not only rarely passes but it takes forever as it stops at every station along the route And there it is A nice little airport clean and with good amenities The main problem is the lack of connections especially late at night which might make an uber the only option I really recommend it though even as a lowcost alternative to Boston

The airport was great with chill music clean spaces and nice atmosphere overall We were departing in the early morning flying to Kyiv but still almost everyone stayed professional and kind despite the early hour The only thing that disappointed us was two workers at the passport control gate We were talking to them in English gave our passports but they did not even say hi Just went with the take off your mask as a form of greeting when they saw our document and realized we are from Ukraine First of all even if it was easier for them to talk to us in Russian it would have been nice not to hear such rude words and intonations Secondly and most important not every citizen of Ukraine knows or wishes to speak in Russian Which we clearly demonstrated by talking to the workers in English first Their responses and the looks they were giving us were not professional Again everything else was perfect and we enjoyed this little time we had at the airport

Handy and efficient airport and friendly service However complete disregard of Government standards in respect of refunds Coronavirus Car park booked and paid for in advance on non flex basis Refund refused despite HM Government Competition and Markets Authority direction Beware sharp practice

Nice medium size airport Looks new or revamped and spotless clean Easy to move around and offers enough services Serious but very efficient staff which is all I ask for Fast check in fast security even going through passport control was relatively fast it was a late fly though so there wasnt many people

Very cramped space for legs I am and you cant get enough space for legs so I put my right leg in corridor Arm support cant be lowered and not just on my seat I was flying with Delta Qatar and Turkish intercontinental but this plane was just overloaded with seats Entertainment choice ok Food was ok but also much better on other companies wine also ok Ladies and men cabin crew were great Funny and polite very useful must say one of the best Ive met

I read some scary reviews here which made me leave for the airport more than hours before my flight But after a very good journey on the excellent Aeroexpress train I have nothing to report DME is no Changi for sure but it is a completely average airport No big queues and from checkin to lounge it took me minutes max The bulk of it spent with a slow passport officer who did not speak English and was confused by my dual nationality and me living on a third country But the rest of the security measures XRAY of all luggages on entry second check of boarding pass and passport are on pair with other specially Asian airports Granted this is a Sunday afternoon so things could get busier during the week But this is it just an adequate airport Not one of the modern Shopping Centers you find these days but just a regular place to wait for your next flight Maybe the view from the lounge is different but I learned long ago to not leave home without my Priority Pass Contrary to some of the reviews here the airport does offer wifi and it does accept any international number Maybe this is one of the benefits of traveling after the WC

A pleasant experience The prices are much better be it food or dutyfree and the atmosphere is much more relaxed with friendly checkin staff and passport control agents No shouting in Russian and no highhanded treatment of foreigners Departures lounge can get crowded at peak times though and the catering options are nothing to write home about

Swanky new recliner seats around Gate but only if you are under foot or over foot tall At the headrest was painfully positioned forcing my chin onto my chest Shame because everything else is brilliant

It is absolutely unfair to give only one star to this airline the Tupolev plane is in good condition and perfectly clean the crew are efficient pleasant and helpful and last but not least it is always on time you can find many airlines much worse than that for instance Air China on the same route The route flown is the no route of Air Koryo linking DPRK to Beijing and this entitles you to some patriotic videos on the overhead screen The buns served are not too bad and drinks are acceptable for such a small trip All in all a good experience

Wow We were amazed at the transformation of this airport in the space of year since being taken over by a German company Previous check in desks removed and brand new ones on a different wall far more Check in was seamless and plenty check in desks A new security area which was quick and smooth apart from the aggressive female member of staff shouting at passengers and rolling her eyes brand new duty free area Such an improvement Heraklion airport in Crete could take some tips We were stesssed thinking about our return journey but the airport has vastly improved Arrival area is also spacious and easy All toilets in the airport have been renewed
This airport is small Traffic is quite convenient and the number of stores is small The airport is very clean and tidy and the waiter is polite

The Buffalo Niagara Airport was quite an experience It was easily accessible and was fantastic with the hotels right across the road The staff were okay We were flying early in the morning so they might have been tired but they seemed alright The airport was larger than I expected The parking was easy and cheap Overall it was a nice experience

I fly with IB express a few times a month Usually on time or even ahead of schedule Service on board is really good Welcome drink online entertainment full meal service with really nice food Drinks available during all flight I truly recommend them Only issue the comfort of the seat If you fly the old seat comfort nonexistent no headrest no recline If you fly the new Aneo seats are comfy for a hr flight to the Canary Islands they do recline and have headrest Good service for a low cost airline

This was my nd flight to FLL in months after a year absence This review is limited to Terminal Arrival was at the A Concourse gates which mean a rather long connectors to the BC concourses common area One huge advantage of FLL airport over the others is the car rental facility which is directly across the airport roadway from the terminal The renovated terminal is spacious brightly lit and has a central TSA Entry point for all concourses Each concourse offers dining options a plenty For Christmas Day travel there was enough seating for all with power ports and USB ports at each gate The bathrooms are very clean and maintained at regular intervals Security was a breeze with no wait time for the TSAPre checkpoints WiFi was easy to connect too and blazing fast The refurbished Terminal is a joy to travel through

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food
On my flight from Muscat to London WY I was seated on J seat The cabin crew by the name of Kim was very courteous smiling and helpful She was very calm and polite to passengers

Very clean aircraft The cabin crew were very attentive and nice Seat pitch was good aircraft cleanliness was OK but could use improvement The inflight meals were sufficient for a one hour flight I was served a chicken sandwich The presentation of the food was good and it also tasted nice as well Overall I would recommend this airline to anyone who is trying to visit Myanmar for a cheap price

Got to be one of the worlds smallest airports The terminal is the size of a large living room You can literally drive up to the front door and walk in This made the airport very efficient and easy to use but dont bank on having a gourmet burger before your flight You will have to make do with a snickers bar and an Irn Bru from the vending machine To be fair it was very clean and is a good hub for the northern extremities

The Seat I sat in seat A next to the window this seat was spacious and much better than other airlines Ive flown in this region There was ample legroom the width was reasonable and the window on the Embraer was large as normal The configuration of the cabin is interesting and is incredible due to lacking a middle seat The Service The staff were perfectly friendly kind and polite with us and offered us gingerbread men and water during the flight The gingerbread was better than I expected and the water was normal The Ground Service The flight was perfectly on time and we landed on schedule The boarding was normal and was completely seamless which was surprising at Gatwick Overall the flight was seamless and comfortable I booked this flight using miles so I cant comment on the price but I would definitely recommend Helvetic Airlines if you are flying to Switzerland over lowcost airlines like EasyJet in the same region

Im a frequent traveller and this was our first time using Air Astana from London to Delhi I read some great reviews nevertheless I was quite apprehensive to say the least Well how wrong was I Air Astana in my humble opinion is indeed providing amazing in flight service and great user experience We flew Airbus LR that appeared to be fairly new extremely clean and looked after Our economy cabin was looked after well we had nice amenity kit the food served was nice and tasty and with proper cutlery Equally choice of beverages was excellent too The crew is well trained and do their best to keep passengers happy On the improvement side we spent about hours in Almaty and found the airport to be quite small and quite basic which I think is a bit of let down and so I think thats the area they need to actively work on if they really want to get more customers flying with them I certainly will fly with them again and recommend it

Incheon Airport generally has a nice and clean layout making navigation straightforward However my experience today at Security Lane was quite disappointing Out of the three passport scanner machines only one was operational causing severe delays I joined the queue at PM and only cleared security at PM taking over hour and minutes to get through For an airport of this reputation such inefficiency was unexpected Thankfully I had arrived early for my PM flight or I might have missed it While the rest of the airport experience is great the management should urgently address such issues

Sharjah via Mukhalla to Socotra and back onboard nearly full Yemeni Bombardier CRJ plane Check in at Sharjah was a bit chaotic due to much luggage boarding the plane was guided by the station manager personally in Sharjah as there wasnt any seat allocation They have an inflight magazine During the hour flight to RIY a snack was served Crew very nice on the return flight leaving SCT the captain even explained everything what was visible from the windows The plane was in a good shape at least what was visible clean and tidy

This post World War II airbridge landmark is probably the best airport location worldwide Nowadays it is called Zentral Flughafen and that is because the Ubahn is only a minute walk From here it only takes minutes to get anywhere in the city The terminal is completely outdated but very charming Planes park literally in the terminal and boarding and deboarding happen always dry thanks to the roof of the hangar The toilets are clean there is a delishopbar and all major car rental companies have a desk Unfortunately THF is not smoke free passengers still smoke in the smoking area of the already small waiting areas at the gates

Great space Felt secure and secluded as a solo traveller Staff were great in a full cabin they were onto everything The wifi was dreadful though Food plentiful and tasty An hour and a half late leaving but with snow in UK thats hardly surprising

Passenger assistance is the best we have experienced very polite helpful and well organised thank you very much airport clean good to see it as drinking water fountain also impressed free bottles of water on arrival on inbound flight
