I flew Skymark Airlines from Kobe to Tokyo Haneda on August th and I must say that I was pretty impressed by the quality of the airline They do not provide any food but service is good I had too much luggage and they only charged me for the extra kilos I had checked Seats are very comfortable and legroom is better than most international airlines I guess its at least inches maybe Nice flight and on time I will fly Skymark Airlines again in the future when I return to Japan

As most of people here state the airport is brand new and clean but they schedule most of flights at the same time in other words the arrival hall becomes a nightmare We had to wait airborne for some minutes before we were allowed to land due lack of ramp space The airport is well connected with buses to town On departure everything was pretty much smooth but they let you wait outside waiting on the heat During peak summer season I would avoid Corfu if I were you

The apparent discrepancy in previous comments is easily explained The BSB terminals quality is strikingly different between the boarding gate area and the presecurity one The latter is really nice The citys highaltitude tropical climate makes for amenable temperatures almost all year around and makes air conditioning dispensable in the wide open entrance area which is a really pleasant place Checkin is usually fast and efficient except on late Thursday and on Friday because of the already mentioned busy traffic of Congressmen and their aides going to home states there is a fairly complete shoppingmallstyle food court with many options including movie theatres good shopping with not only the usual luxuryitem style but also plenty of those lastminute simple essentials Once past security however things change It wouldnt be bad were it not for the fact that the boarding gate area was simply underdimensioned for the traffic it gets Pray to get a jetbridged gate because the ground level boarding area for bussed remote positions is very small and can be really chaotic at times Arrivals are usually fine though enough conveyor belts and luggage arrives fast enough to ensure a quick turnover Signage could be better on arrival and transit areas Transportation is indeed a problem the buses mentioned are regular urban buses with no space for luggage and are infrequent Taxis are really expensive but are mostly the only practical choice But a lightrail line is planned for the next couple of years and that should improve things a lot

Feedback on my initial visit to MCI new terminal I am a Kansas City native this review is critical as it should be Overall impression is outstanding compared to the s era terminals It addresses the needs of a st century Midwest airport with all the modern necessities one would expect as a flying customer First impression walking in its big It spans wide and the design incorporating natural lighting with an abundance of windows is refreshing The evening sunlight streaming in through different angles really provides a nonrestricted feel as you walk about the terminal The respective airline checkin counterplacements are easy to identify and span the width of the front end of the terminal for easy access Security access is fairly streamlined and the entire process is able to accommodate large volumes of travelers nonTSA airport VMD corp more natural light as you progress through each arm of the terminal ABC with interior lighting not overbearing The walkways are wide and allow for excellent views of the tarmac exterior gates and various angles of the entirety of the taxiways and runways Additionally the escalators and walking escalators are positioned nicely and push you through terminal in a speedy manner More shops etc at each terminal branch providing basically anything the traveler would need The vibe and local venues are all a welcome addition and definitely fulfill the needs of the traveler Individual gates and structured well and offer comfortable seating and ample wireless device charging The one thing that seems odd is the placement of the gate flight monitors It is essentially in the seating area of the individual gates Why not place it directly behindabove the agent boothdesk for easy and quick access and explanation poor design decision Boarding the plane the traveler is treated to long glass jet bridges that allow for excellent views of adjacent aircraft and outside weather conditions This is a well thought out design that many major airports do not offer Overall the new MCIKCI terminal is a massive upgrade to the Kansas City area It has the opportunity for expansion and I would expect future modifications to address design shortfalls and customer feedback We concluded it feels like a mall when walking though the new terminal Three things need immediate addressing Mens restroom upkeep and sanitary conditions unacceptable Need to revisit the options of installing automatic hand blower machines and look at the cleaning schedules to ensure conditions do not deteriorate to the point of being an embarrassment Cleaning crews need to maintain a regular schedule on vacuuming the terminal carpet paper and debris everywhere Please explain how the gate flight monitors are controlled by the city How is this beneficial to the traveler or airline staff Local control to changemodify the monitors shouldnt even be a discussion This new terminal is supposed to represent the pride of Kansas City aviation

Congratulations everyone on the wonderful new airport at Bonriki The building is such an improvement on the previous facility and now provides travellers to and from Kiribati with a modern beautifully designed space to start and finish their Kiribati adventure I understand their are more features such as a cafe and lounge still in progress but in the meantime could airport management please think of a way to provide water to passengers in the departure lounge as we just experienced nearly hours in hot conditions without water Many thanks cant wait to return and see the next stages of the development
Arrived on full QF from Sydney on April Fantastic new airport that does credit to New Caledonia Clean modern and very quick from a full plane to bus transfer to Noumea
Kuala Lumpur to Pangkor Island return This is the most pleasant way of flying for those who love airplanes

I have travelled through Derry airport numerous times in the last two years with a young child and usually on my own I cannot express enough how helpful staff have been on every single occasion They always offer to help me with bags usually fast track me through security scan my boarding card and passport so that I dont have to stand in long queues especially if my child is sleeping and have even bumped me up to priority boarding again ensuring I am not standing in queues struggling with bags or a toddler Their customer service is second to none and they always make the journey pleasurable

Bremen Airport Terminal E is a big shed with Ryanair inside No doubt noisy in a hail storm its open and breezy Staff efficient Plenty of natural light skylights in the roof The light rail service line service from the station is great too Beware it does not take credit cards or bank notes over Euros functional

Es una aeropuerto pequeo pero moderno tiene todo lo accesible que se necesita para un viajero es rpido en lo que es migracin las malestas llegan rpido al recogedor todo limpio hay WiFi gratis conectores por muchas partes muy amable el personal buena seguridad lo Malo son los precios de las tiendas todo esos precios desorbitados pero en lo que respecta al aeropuerto muy bueno anunci de vuelos pantallas todo modern It is a small but modern airport it has everything that is needed for a traveler it is fast in what is migration the baggage arrives quickly to the pickup everything is clean there is free WiFi connectors for many parts very friendly and good security personnel Bad things are the prices of the stores with those exorbitant prices but in regards to the airport very good announcements with modern screens for flights

Superb This is by far the best business class product within Europe The meal was one of the best Ive eaten Cabin crew delightful Wine servings enormous and just nothing to correct in the product It is a shame that no other European airline comes close to this standard

Flydubai provides a pleasant and comfortable travel experience from Dubai to Kerala I am feet tall so I had plenty of leg room The food was tasty and sufficient and the service was good The positive experience is made better by effective boarding

I have faced very rude behavior from cabin crew from Kuwait to Cochin flight on at hrs Since I was traveling with my yearold son the air hostess insisted I keep the child on the seat but the child was crying so I requested the attachments to keep the baby on my lap she was quite unhappy and brought that belt and just threw it at my seat The rest of the flight journey was nice and comfortable

I believe myself to be semiwell traveled and have experienced many airport scenarios in my lifetime middle aged and will have to give kudos to Dallas Love Field TSA agents for their remarkable work getting me from the baggage claim area for general boarding all the way to my gate with time to spare in as little time as I can possibly fathom I actually witnessed a family who did not make their flight one prior to mine but same gate and persisted by raising their voices that the gate agent should have known they were there but because TSA took so much time they were late The truth later came out that they were ONLY in line for one hour on a holiday weekend That is exceptional but poor timing on their part Everyone in the aviation world knows that on a holiday weekend there is a hour minimum time preparation period to make your flight So a free plug for DLF consider this Saying all of this not only was TSA awesome in their timeliness but the gate agents kept their cool and handled the situation with excellence

The flights are frequently delayed but its a small price to pay for clean aircraft ample seat pitch kind crew and the lowest fares My flight from Melbourne to Kuala Lumpur was on an A with plenty of legroom and good meals Online checkin yields a good seat for me and their use of KLIA T makes for an easy and relaxing journey

Funchal to Porto Santo This minutes flight is a true experience Aero Vip carries out the public service obligation connection between Funchal and the smaller Porto Santo airport located on the island with the same name The outbound flight was on a vintage Jetstream turboprop airliner with the return flight being on a slightly older Jetstream In both cases the safety briefing was carried out by the first officer himself as the plane does not have any FA on board The outbound flight left right on time and touched down in PXO just minutes later The plane on the way back arrived late and we left PXO with some minutes of delay again reaching our destination in slight over minutes The planes interiors are quite worn out but overall the planes gave me the impression of being in a good mechanical shape If you take this flight to reach the beaches in Porto Santo as was my case the whole flight is a really fun and unique retroexperience for aviation enthusiasts which unfortunately comes with a hefty price tag EUR return It needs to be said however that the rates are much cheaper for residents who need this flight as a means to ensure territorial continuity

Yahukimo to Jayapura Flight was about an hour late quite normal in this remote place Plane was comfortable enough with reclining seats and even a box of tea provided unlike on the sole competitors flights on this route

PBHCCU CCUPBH Y class Check in staff at Paro very helpful friendly smiling Cabin crew similarly accommodating and friendly Clean cabin decent space for Y class Light refreshments and sandwiches veg or nonveg served on this short minute segment Every flight has been spot on time or slightly early Good announcements from cockpit to point out Himalayan peaks when near Paro Competitive prices A good alternative inout of Bhutan from Drukair

Flying from Cape Town to Dublin to attend a conference and later return to Chicago from there I was looking forward to my first chance to check out Hamad Doha Airport Qatar Airways was fine except we arrived late in Doha We had to take a crowded bus to the terminal and it took over a half hour There were traffic jams on the tarmac I then had to run a long way through jammed concourses and just made my connection to Dublin On the way I saw crowds of people a bunch of luxury stores and chain eateries and some trees and plantings in one area Color me unimpressed

I have no complaints whatsoever about the new airport in Wichita Lobby is wide and bright with helpful staff at the information desk There is a wonderful exhibition on the aviation history of Wichita on the second floor Go to the airport early so that you can read all the displays Not a wide assortment of food choices but good enough Car rental area is well organized and staff is welltrained A most pleasant experience there The signage for getting to the city center and on the highways could be better but I think that is the responsibility of the city not the airport A very pleasant airport to use

Flew them on the Frankfurt Sarajevo trip on board their B I found the airline staff professional and friendly which cant be said about the customs at SJJ airport most of whom looked downright angry and like they hate their job The BH airlines crew were great and boarding was quick and breeze The flight arrived a few minutes early and I found the cabin fairly modern and clean

Its a smaller airport compared to Mumbai not a problem actually Some toilets on the arrival hall are not good This airport has more shopping options now and its enough actually There are spa and lounge facilities available here The lounges are okay I have never experienced any delay to date Overall an above expectation feel It gets my job done

Overnight flight from KL to Shanghai on their relatively new B plane Was impressed on the cabin cleanliness and seat was pretty comfortable But would preferred to be on a wide body aircraft for a flight time longer than hrs Cabin crew were polite Food was ok But for the price I paid for it was cheaper than some low cost carrier Would not hesitate to fly with them again

If youre coming from a western country be aware that this airport functions a bit differently than what were used to First you and all your bags have to pass through security bags in the scanner you in a light body search and then you enter the hall where the airlines check in counters are You do not need to present a boarding pass to enter this first hall meaning you can come in with a friend or family member who isnt flying This hall has some chairs toilets and or shops After you check in and drop your bags with your airline you proceed to immigration At this point you can only get through if you have a valid boarding pass You get to a second hall with the duty free and a couple more shops and restaurants Last you move to the area where your gate is Theres different areas with different gates each with their own security line if you go to the wrong gate area like I did you need to ask airport staff to escort you out so you can go to the correct area This security check is the same as the first one bags on the scanners and you get a light body search Then you proceed to your gates waiting area where you have toilets and shops No one ever checks for liquids or electronic equipments and I even had my own bottle of water in my bag when I went through both security checks Men and women have different security lines so that man are searched by a male officer and women searched by a female one As for facilities there were enough chairs for everyone but chairs were not the most comfortable If you like shopping in airport this is also not the best place not enough offer of shops and even the duty free doesnt have much to offer The airport is generally clean and there are western toilets plus free water On arrivals immigration lines are often under staffed so prepare for waiting mins If youre looking to exchange money at the airport you need go back the stairs after you collect your luggage because the money exchange counter is on the departures floor
Madrid to Granada Excellent Efficient and attentive cabin crew Arrived and left on time New aircraft and comfortable seats Straightforward boarding and disembarking Highly recommended

I have flown Austrian twice from LAX to Vienna and it is maybe my favorite international airline at this point And I have flown quite a few international carriers out of LAX to points around the world Both trips were in economy but I chose exit rows due to being When not flying premium economy or business this will be the only way I fly The service on Austrian was impeccable the flight attendants kind and very attentive The seats were comfortable and the food was perhaps the best I have had when flying economy I cant say enough about it I do wish Austrian flew to LAX on more than just a seasonal route because I prefer nonstop flights and while I know I can transit through ORD an IAD year round nonstop flights are always the better deal What do you say Austrian LAX to Vienna year round

I flew from Blantyre airport a number of years ago and was struck by just how quaint the whole set up was It is a very basic airport not far off the common tin shack analogy that comes with most African airports There is very little to do and there is just a bar to distract you The best thing about Blantyre airport is the Duty Free shop A selection so limited it is almost refreshing Malawi Gin Whisky JW Cane spirit macadamia nuts coffee and nick nacks I bought to W light bulbs that had been turned into paraffin lamps Wonderful

Johannesburg to Gaborone with Air Botswana Fast check in at airport On time boarding and departure Full flight operated by an ATR Good Crew A good snack of crackers and local beef jerky served Landed on time Fast immigration and was out of airport in minutes Return flight on same day Again fast check in Fast Security control and immigration On time departure on a newer ATR Rather empty flight with everyone having an empty seat next to them Good snack and wide array of drinks served by a crew happy to do more than their best On time arrival in JNB Small airline but they know what they are doing Recommended on visits to Botswana

Although a low cost airline Shaheen Air was quite nice although the airport checkin was pretty bad with only one line and the agents taking forever The flight had a gate change times and we had a one hour delay announced at the last minute before boarding was to finish The flight attendents were very friendly during the flight and the aircraft was decent also the meal some chicken mayo bun with a chicken leg along with marble cake was pretty delicious and filling The plane was leased and originally from SpanAir so the cabin had grey leather seats but it was comfortable though Also a nice touch from Shaheen Air was the pretakeoff water which was provided and newspapers in English and Urdu
I flew AirAsia into here from Kuala Lumpar A friendly and efficient airport the connecting bus had me in Melbourne in about the same time as to Tullamarine as there was no jerking about

Used this airport several times over the past decade at various times of the day and on long and short haul flights A small pleasant airport where it is usually possible to find a quiet corner Staff are helpful and usually smile Dining is American fast food variety and expensive Pay the departure tax in advance at your hotel Avoid the postsecurity shopping as the prices are high

Brindisi Salento is a pleasant fairly new airport spacious enough for the level of fights The lurid yellowgreen fluorescent plastic seats are a bit much and I wouldnt want to encounter them with a hangover Transit from city centre by bus A costs cents buy tickets in airport or in town from the bar on the way from the railway station to the bus stop in Via C Colombo and runs half hourly The snack bar prices are silly Coffee more than in town bottled beer more draught beer only more but wasnt available If your flight is from gate which the Ryanair flight to STN was be aware that it is straight in front of passport control meaning that a lot of people cant get through passport control until boarding begins

This January was my fifth trip to PortauPrince and my first since I flew in on a DC just after the quake While the airport is essentially the same the service coming and going is very much improved Customs and security well organized Staff courteous Best of all the road and parking lot outside are way better controlled I was impressed at how much has been done without new buildings Cleaner more efficient and quite friendly Big compliment on the effort and results I returned to Canada via Fort Lauderdale which was a bad transit experience

Flying from Saint Petersburg to Prague Rossiya is providing an excellent service punctuality in time Professional cabin crew working so hard they accept Aeroflot points highly recommended I believe the company should be at least categorized as a Star airline

This newish airport is compact clean spacious bright and well designed I arrived from Dallas Plane docked at a jet bridge Quick and short walk to fast and friendly immigration followed by customs less than minutes plane door to curb Well managed safe taxi service with no lines On the return a similar smooth experience The airside offers a nice choice of shops restaurant and lounges Certainly the small scale makes this airport a joy to use for limited international travel Nice friendly staff everywhere

Overnight flight from KL to Shanghai on their relatively new B plane Was impressed on the cabin cleanliness and seat was pretty comfortable But would preferred to be on a wide body aircraft for a flight time longer than hrs Cabin crew were polite Food was ok But for the price I paid for it was cheaper than some low cost carrier Would not hesitate to fly with them again

What a lovely little airport the whole experience seemed organised with little to no queuing areas as passengers seemed to just self manage to the different areas of the airport From check in to departure the airport was very clean with little wrong on this front I found myself very impressed with the smiling security team as I went through pre security and main search area as well Arrivals was good as well with clean arrivals area straight from the plane I was really impressed with this airport when comparing to some of the UK airports it has a much higher standard Wifi runs on a free voucher system which worked a treat very easy with no need to sign up Shopping is not great as there is just a duty free shop and FB is limited and expensive Overall a very good airport

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

I flew on Ravn Alaska with my girlfriend back in February We flew from Anchorage to Homer and back with ease The flight was brief and enjoyable The staff were friendly and welcoming Checkin a breeze Boarding a breeze Baggage pickup a breeze The overall experience was fantastic Looking forward to flying with Ravn again and taking in those unforgettable Alaska sights

Small but efficient and clean airport There was not much rush and check in to gate was minutes in the evening I fly from this airport once a year and never have any issueso far Customs and immigration takes less time than any other airports in India experienced

I would like to share a positive experience I had with airport staff on December I came back from a weeklong trip to find that my car battery had completely died We called AAA but it was a long wait time due to the holiday weekend A very nice gentleman in an airport pickup stopped by to check on us and offered to jump start the car He was respectful and courteous and saved us quite a bit of wait time We will forever be grateful for his kindness and professionalism

The signs at Fuzhou airport are quite helpful since available in both English and Chinese The border security counter has a rating system where you can rate them based on your experience If you dont speak Chinese it may be slightly difficult to get around Queue was quite long and it took quite long to find your baggage However it was an OK experience The staff was very friendly and friendlier than I had expected

The airport is really modern and beautiful Its very tidy and clean and has a lot of signs and announcements and a lot of staff that help out with your luggage the staff are really kind and the airport is really clean

My husband and myself were at Alicante airport returning from a short break I am disabled following a subarachnoid haemorrhage years ago I really needed to feedback on my support from Carmen who reported she has worked many years in the assistance area she was so kind and helpful and made my journey much more settled I cannot thank her enough Regards Kath Robinson

The south domestic terminal in Anchorage is world class and beautiful This new terminal is very modern spotlessly clean provides amenities expected at an international airport and offers a view of the surrounding mountains that is breathless The displays of local wildlife native culture and art is unsurpassed by most airports in the world However the old north terminal which is now connected to the south terminal by a concourse is sad Anchorage is one of the five most busy airports in the world for international cargo airlines but not for international passenger service The few international airlines that do provide passenger service mostly during the summer months are forced to use the north terminal as US customs is located there All the comments seen on this site are about the north terminal made by international travelers and are undoubtedly true Wish they all could have been processed through the magnificent south building

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

Used to be very busy in the Soviet times since then reduced the traffic by at least At the same time the new terminal was built with more adequate waiting spaces It is rather modern and clean Food service is kind of slow Public transportation to the city is not on top and I used parknfly only once
Beautiful new terminal with excellent check in security and facilities very impressed
It is a shame that the people at security do not speak English This is an international airport For the rest it is okay food is good and it is reasonably clean

Late flight out on New Years day I love this small airport its quick to get though and friendly A surprisingly well stocked duty free shop with a good choice A small cafe before boarding I imagine its how airports were years ago and is a pleasure to travel through

I arrived on a national flight from Guadalajara The gates of the Tijuana Airport are quite modern with jetways at each gate There are restaurants and shops along the concourse It was necessary to have my passport checked by an immigration officer who saw it was a US passport and waved me through without looking at it The customs inspection was minimal The baggage claim area is OK When I checked in for my departing flight I found passengers were required to go through screening and customs inspection to enter the checkin area It is possible to exit and go outside while awaiting boarding time after you check in The street entrance to the airport is under construction and it is necessary to walk past the boardedoff areas to enter the terminal There is a bus station at the airport right by the terminal for shuttle buses to CA Overall this airport is not bad and will be very good once construction is completed

This is my preferred airport in SoCal for arriving atdeparting from which I do on a regular basis Big enough to offer connections anywhere in the US for flights to Europe yet small enough offer a quick friendly and efficient service tofrom your gate Drop off facilities outside the terminals needs to be improved but apart from that no real complaints

Flight SN on the st of October Efficient boarding welcoming crew and comfortable seats The flight left with a slight delay of but arrived earlier in Stockholm The highlight was the crew Charming well groomed cheerful and carried out an excellent cabin bag management during boarding The seemed to be enjoying their jobs and their enthusiasm was contagious It was a pleasure to fly them
Tu Moscow St Petersburg Creature comforts not up to modern aircraft standards but superb real experience Food quite good and service good Do it before the Tus become a thing of the past

I arrived today from Heho with a sick child probably from food poisoning and was helped like I never thought I could We were taken charge of by a great team of officers nurse doctor that took us to the airport clinic and took care of my daughter Everyone has been great and we are really grateful to each of you They will recognize themselves

My experience at the new Siem Reap Airport surpassed all expectations The staffs friendliness and proactive assistance elevated my journey Navigating immigration was not only expeditious but also conducted with an admirable level of efficiency The airports outstanding features combined with the exceptional service created an atmosphere of ease and comfort

Tbilisi to Baku Everything went smoothly here Boarding was quick and on time We were pushed back on time which also meant the flight left on time It was only a short hop of mins I will see how they are again when I fly hours plus on my next flight Overall No issues Airline very smooth and would recommend

The airport claims it has smooth transit and easy to read signs in English helpful staff and an efficient process My experience was the complete opposite After arriving and trying to find my departure process I was told to go back backandforth to the same places by people who could not understand what I was saying this took minutes to an hour and each time I had to rewait in line again So finally I said Im not leaving till you direct me to the right place

As a frequent flyer on the Kuwait Airways I would recommend it on there large aircrafts such as Ber Aneo or A and specially on business class even though it is expensive but you will get a good quality service My rating would be on there business first and royal class And I have also uploaded a photo of Ber business seat

Brussels to Milan Malpensa With only euros including drink and snack this flight was a real bargain CityJet flies this route on behalf of Brussels Airlines with a rare plane in the west the Russian built Sukhoi Superjet This turned out to be a rather silent seating plane with a good legroom The nice crew the punctual departure and a truly beautiful view of the Swiss alps made this flight a very nice one

When you get off the plane at Quito Mariscal Airport you are greeted with a stunning view of the mountains The staff are all very friendly and the airport itself is quite modern While there arent tonnes of bars and restaurants like the airports at home in Britain it doesnt matter Because the facilities are satisfactory and the staff behave the way staff should I arrived in Quito after transit in Panama which was a total dump with extremely rude staff so to arrive in my final destination where I now live and to be greeted to my new country in such a friendly manner by immigration and customs was lovely

I was very impressed by the level of care and support I received at the airport Having a severe reaction to an insect bite and no Antihistamine tablets with me The local team and Airport police went out of their way to help I wish I had noted their names they looked everywhere and obtained tablets for me while making sure I was comfortable and relaxed Thank you very much as the level of care and support at a busy airport was very welcome and impressive

I dont know what all the fuss was about Bad reviews about security dirty airport unfriendly staff no seating I experienced none of that In view of the negative reviews we arrived hours before take off and were through security in five minutes Very cheerful efficient and friendly staff Bought some items at duty free and the lady there was extremely pleasant and helpful Plenty of seating Good food and drink offers and both the airport and toilets were very clean Boarding process straightforward and stressless On return our plane landed about minutes behind schedule This unfortunately coincided with other flights landing at the same time so passport control was very busy but it only took about minutes to get through The staff there were smiling at I understand why passengers complain but its also useful to get positive reviews sometimes I hope my next experience of Leeds Bradford will be as good as this one

One needs more than arriving hours before takeoff time for international flights I would suggest Queues are terrible everywhere checkin taxes immigration And why taxes cant be paid by card On arrival migration services seem more efficient search me and luggage is delivered efficiently It is a pity not to be able to get money from an ATM in the international space only local cards seem to work On departure when you pass migration you get into a renewed part of the airport with plenty of space totally different from the departure area which is crowed Duty free shops are nice as well as the food offer Some dont like the patterns on the floor of the departure area but its one of the charms of Maiqueta airport Another one is the takeoff and landing especially at daytime I always enjoy the landscape

Excellent small airport Arrived from JFK and departed to JFK homepoint DTW Arrival It was raining so as a courtesy we were bussed to terminal ride minutes Passage through passport control took minutes The passport control officer smiled and welcomed me Ample shops landside I was able to buy postcards and stamps to mail them to friends Taxicabs to town do not have meters rate is fixed at euros Careful driver clean taxicab Departure minutes at security minutes at passport control Passport control officer smiled again why are US CBP personnel so unable to master the skill of smiling Airside only tiny snack shop Lovely sunny morning so we walked a few feet on tarmac and up staircase into airplane

Modern airport departure and arrival were quick efficient and smooth This not a big nor busy airport so there is never any big queues Immigration police cordial and friendly Almost feels like there is too much airport staff for volume of passengers particularly when departing staff in the multiple cafs looked bored I appreciated the clean toilets and multiple drinking water fountains where you could fill up water for free Duty Free felt was the biggest letdown very generic and poor Not much local Dhofari or even Omani products I think it could be better used to sell the country and region one final time before visitors leave instead of overpriced cheap souvenir tat or the usual generic Toblerone you can find at any airport in the world Even local products like the luxury Amouage perfumes were at the usual price with no deals which was a shame

Recently travelled with a broken ankle The staff were very helpful getting me on and off the plane The special waiting area was a nice touch because I was scared of getting knocked by other passengers

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

This airport is small so whilst access is good facilities are very limited Airside there are only vending machine so if you want anything to eat or drink best use the bar Landside Do not carry tins eg Duck Confit Pate etc that are greater than g in hand luggage they will be confiscated at security

Zagreb Airport is a small but clean airport The airport staff were generally friendly helpful and efficient Moderate queuing time Seating area was a bit crowded during busy hours and lacking charging sockets around seats Fast and free WiFi

Surabaya airport is a very quick and efficient airport On arrival the visa on arrival queue was very short immigration there was a short wait of about minutes by the time I was done with both the bags had already arrived Probably one of the quickest experiences for me from exiting the aircraft to curbside Similar experience on departure quick efficient checkin with Cathay Pacific short lines at security and immigration The terminal is spacious and has a lot of natural light from the full height windows on either side the restrooms were very clean Food options are limited to a Burger King and Starbucks the duty free has a good selection for a small airport The premier lounge which was in a temporary set up was the only disappointment Chose to sit at the Starbucks instead Free wifi at the airport is also quite good

Leon Bajio to Puerto Vallarta Punctual airline Small plane but confortable for a minute flight and very clean Excellent service and good attitude of ground staff and flight attendants They offer you a small snack on board free of cost The check in process at the airport was quick because the airplane has a passenger capacity

Small regional airport With just two terminals it is pretty painless to navigate Lines at the security checkpoint move fast I was told that a contractor operates the checkpoints In my experience staff was friendly and two or more lanes were open Some restrooms in the secure area were closed off due to renovations in progress Concessions were limited but there is a McDonalds a Subway a news store and a coffee outfit Because its a regional airport many code share flights are operated by smaller airlines flying commuter aircraft If youre not a fan of turboprop aircraft avoid Piedmont Air operating as US Air Express on DHC planes

Airport has a weird system for departure You have to go to a security check point outside the airport to be patted down manually by security guards while your vehicle luggage is sniffed by gaurd dogs Then you are dropped off at a terminal for security check again this time through electronic devices where you get a special colored sticker on your luggage Afterwards you proceed to a shuttle bus carry your own luggage that will take you to another terminal about a minute drive where temperatures reach degrees Celsius in the summer At the nd terminal a security check is done to ensure you have been security checked at the previous terminal Now some of this can be avoided if you have a special VIP pass that skips step And a VVIP that skips all steps The check in counters are ok about of them run by Dubais DNata Immigration is slow and queues are long Duty Free is small with tobacco chocolates and alcohol available One coffee shop available behind Duty Free After passing immigration but before your gate you pass through another security check point remove your shoes belts etc Plenty of seating at the gates plus one coffee shop although AC is never working in the summer and no wifi connection through out the airport Staff are all generally friendly

Beautiful state of the art equipment but some poor organisation despite lots of friendly staff Nobody tells you the procedure join this queue then shuffle along only to be told you should have gone to the luggage weighin queue first Weigh luggage then rejoin back of check in queue Told to go to security shuffle along for a bit then someone asks for departure card Leave security queue go to desk where you collect and fill departure card then rejoin back of security queue Suggest check in desk staff give you a departure card so you will know to fill it in before going through security Takes a while to shuffle through that and go through immigration departure check then security check All took about one and a half hours At gate we were divided into groups Not enough seats for group although most passengers are in this group Infrastructure is very impressive and no doubt they will eventually streamline procedures Sign posting would be a good start Shopping and dining facilities are mostly not yet open so I cannot comment on this aspect yet So first taste of new terminal not half bad Clean spacious excellent kit friendly staff but poor procedures

Felt like flying in the old days Flew this one hour flight from Kerman to Tehran in a packed sold out flight operating by an old Airbus A which was refurbished immaculately and very clean The flight attendants were nicely dressed and friendly It was rather hot at Kerman and I was surprised to find a cold bottle of water on seat back pocket for every passenger on this massive jet They a light dinner free of charge Over all it was the best domestic flight I have ever taken

Shanghai to Tehran return July Direct flight to Tehran Economy class Aircraft A Fare was quite good Checkin fast Cabin crew showed Iranian hospitality No individual inflight entertainment but fairly speaking since the flight was at night One toilet closed for whole trip the other two were not clean and almost out of tissue Food was enough and fine for me Many drink options Flying time was less than hours on my way to Tehran and less than on the way back to Shanghai Considering all the above I will certainly choose this airline next time for my trip to Tehran

Return leg of my round trip Again the great thing about this airline is the departure from Bangkoks main airport rather than the budget terminal across town Check in was done smoothly and boarding is by passenger ramp instead of being bussed about the airfield so is very convenient and quick Flight departed on time and was fairly uneventful Flight arrived minutes ahead of scheduled time The only let down of the journey was deplaning at Ha Noi was by ground service ramp and bus to the terminal

This is a lovely little regional airport barely minutes from Tours It took just a few minutes to clear immigration then off to the car rental office which is in a hut outside the terminal building in the car park Be warned that car rental here is scandalously expensive It cost over for days Anyway on my return I went to the small caf before security which offers a small but tasty range of snacks and drinks at reasonable prices Clearing security took a couple of minutes and boarding was a breeze All in all just how air travel should be in an ideal world
It was very great flying in Vistara today then any other Company I liked this because of several reasons like hospitality Seat comfort cabin staff service food Etc Keep it up

My wife was having trouble getting her handbag through security After much rummaging by the security officer he pulled out a penknife My wife was mortified The knife had belonged to her brother a farmer who had died some years previously She became visibly upset and the officer got quite concerned He said not to worry if we would go to the shop get an envelope and stamps he would post the knife back to her Got home from the holiday to find the knife duly arrived What a kind and considerate man thank you very much
Windhoek airport is small but clean and really well organized The only restaurant at the check in area is situated at the Arrival area food is fresh and delicious Facilities are quite good
I loved the flight and service the crew was very helpful and friendly Found the seats comfy and because of the low fares we booked make this trip to Iceland Thank you WOW airWe will miss you

At last Pakistan has an airport worthy of being a Capital City airport Very well designed with excellent drop off points Excellent flow of passengers although I do wonder if the queues would be very long at busy times as its a single double door entry All the checks and security are now excellent with polite and attentive staff and a great spaced out airport Toilets clean and well serviced Signs plentiful and useful Needs more commercial shops and food facilities but otherwise I loved it

CNFGRUMAO So I had a very early flight bound to Manaus paying extra for hotel was not worth it so I decided to sleep here The airport has being refurbished so there is a brand new section the information is clear and the lines are always small and after you get your boarding pass you can go through security and you will be very safe Cleaning staff are friendly and will even tell you the best spots to sleep They have chairs without armrests and cushioned seats The food is horribly expensive and everything closes at pm There is this good acai shop outside the check in area coxinhas and acai shakes are great there

Agree with Paul Groves fine little airport A word of warning if youre trying to tie in returning to the airport for a Ryanair flight give yourself plenty of time We had a number of passengers on our bus who had left it rather late to get back to the airport having had their flights rearranged and had opted for a few more hours in Oslo rather than being stuck at the airport big mistake

Was surprised how good it was Very nice and smiling crew bed quite comfortable good choice of drinks Did not really like the gluten free option as I got the same meal twice Ground service was a disaster

We arrived late at night nearly midnight so were exhausted We went through passport control reasonably quickly and the baggage reclaim was also very smooth Very modern airport and due to less passenger traffic very efficient Taxi to railway station was done in under minutes Very clean toilets included which is often a rarity Overall I would have to say I prefer Zhulyany over Borispol which I have been flying through for years due to its better connections to the city Though in London it is not very convenient as Wizz Air fly from Luton

Lufthansa operated by Germanwings from Barcelona to Berlin Tegel and back Both fights on time with very quick boarding and ground service First flight was a year old A plane was very clean and comfortable The return flight on a year old A despite the old age of the aircraft it was very clean comfortable and showed signs of great maintenance service You cold only tell that it was that old becouse it was considerably louder but the journey was very enjoyable The snacks are not very good but I can forgive that on a h min flight Great comfort in the seats with more legroom Great value for money and going to try Eurowings

We chose Eastar Jet because of its reasonable price for the round trip from Seoul Gimpo to Jeju First we made booking for pax name of one of us is lack one word so we submitted to correct Immediately I received a call from Seoul to let me know how to change and remind me via email On the day of flight theres a storm in Jeju so we hardly to landed We were afraid that we have to flight back to Seoul luckily we landed safe after few trial times On the return way days later at the airport we were informed that the flight was cancelled due to the storm But Eastar Jet told us that they would find another airline for us then we had tickets of Jin Air then boarding without any problem We were satisfied of services and staff of Eastar Jet from booking until last minute Thanks Eastar Jet for making our trip more memorable and happy

This is a very nice airport Pretty clean and very manageable My only reason for posting a review is there was no functioning water fountain neither for drinking or filling water bottles in the concourse Didnt work when we arrived still didnt when we left six days later Drumming up money for the concession stand Had to buy water for the trip out Bad look for an otherwise pleasant place

Ms Terri V who was the boarding agent for my flight provided phenomenal customer service when it was needed most When I realized that my lay over time from my connecting flight to my final destination was tight she was able to move me up four rows with no extra charge She was friendly patient and wanted to do what was right for the customer given my situation when many others may have not cared as much She is someone other boarding and TSA agents should emulate not just here in San Antonio but around other airports as well

Even though it is small this is one of my favourite airports Its a minute walk from the plane to the terminal baggage is normally on the belt as soon as you arrive in and the best part is the cafe not only is it cheap but they have excellent hot bacon rolls and the fresh cakes are excellent too If only public transport links were better though I have been told the National Express service to London will soon call at Kent International

Things have improved vastly since the new terminal opened and the new baggage claim is very good far faster than Edinburgh or Glasgow Return journeys can be a bit of a pain but the new departure lounge is reasonably good Airport staff weve found to be generally polite and helpful Our tips for a happier return trip Buy any food or drink in your resort Dont be in a rush to go through security to the departure lounge its much nicer outside or in the checkin hall If you smoke there is a smoking room in the departure lounge Think about investing in a portable balance for weighing your baggage as if you are overweight it could cost you
Very good array of shops ahead of security Very modern very clean Far nicer than the other airports that Ive encountered in Brazil

At first I was not impressed by the airport as from outside it looks small and not modern But once in I was happily surprised with the efficiency of the airport both in the arrival and departure halls The wifi woked perfectly The facility is simple but clean and fast to navigate through The airport business class lounge was a great surprise Beautiful design very attentive staff great food and drinks selection Well done CKY

Lovely experience through check in and security at around am this morning th July The chap at Tui desk was friendly professional and helpful All four members of staff at security were great Helpful friendly and professional Lovely atmosphere At the caf a lovely women served me Smile on her face Finally going through to boarding gate yet again a friendly cheerful and helpful lady checked me in am by this stage Its a small airport The shop and caf are small Im not here to shop or sit drinking Im here to have an ideally stress free start to my holiday The staff make this place Thank you

Love Ryanair efficiency Does what is says on the packet nothing pretentious Crew were great and even managed to go down with aisle with the trolley on a minute flight My th flight with them just wish they flew to Frankfurt theyd get all my euro business

A very big shout out to Jude and Liz at the checkin service desk as well as Tup the client manager on the flight I happened to leave a bag containing a priceless religious item at the checkin desk as we were running late for the flight And in my haste I left the bag at the desk I totally forgot about it and would have been extremely devastated and upset if I realised I left it behind Once we boarded the plane and settled in a very kind Tup and other staff member came up to us and returned the bag to us I can only guess that Liz and Jude realised I was a religious Jew and made the effort to return the bag to us on the plane before it took off My wife and I were so touched by this extremely kind gesture We spoke to Tup during the flight and expressed our gratitude but I wanted to leave this note of thanks to Jude and Liz too We always try and fly Rex your staff are friendly and happy so different to the other airlines we have flown on domestically And this incident just reinforces the good vibes we get when flying Rex

Domestic passenger Arrived at and departed on from Terminal No issues disembarking Having staff there to ensure passengers with baggage to reclaim dont inadvertently leave without collecting it is helpful On return it took a while to clear security With a number of airports across the UK now using the new scanners meaning liquids can stay in hand luggage its a pity Terminal had not restarted this Good range of shops and restaurants in departures with clear signage and ample seating Flight pushed back on time but there was a wait of about minutes as it sat in a queue for takeoff clearance From previous experience excellent for international travel as most major cities across the world reachable with a direct flight but Gatwick remains my first choice for regional travel

A couple of points firstly there is now a new terminal so most of the tips above do not now apply Agree about the prices for coffee etc they are outrageous They now handle more international flights for example to Bangkok so I would like to think they are better equipped for international flights now I have Never been stopped by the immigration people I find them very friendly Last point the taxis There is no doubt they are expensive They are on the clock but from the airport the clocks run fast From my old apartment it was km to the airport and on one occasion km back Better to pay rmb for the bus directly outside the airport then get a taxi from the Aviation hotel in the city Hope this helps
A small but friendly airport which is quite central The facilities are adequate for the size of the country It is clean and tidy and the staff are helpful

Las Palmas to Tenerife Not a great experience The plane had SwiftAir livery even though it was CanaryFly flight The plane was old and produced terrible noise during takeoff I have flown the ATR not once but it was only such experience The airline had a free seating policy It was OK as there were only people in the plane capable of The crew provided only water

This is my local airport and not a bad little place Yes at times TSA slows things down to a crawl but the TSA workers here seem to actually have a sense of pride and a sense of humor I have a steel hip and this has caused numerous delays in other airports but either they know me by now or they have their collective ish together Food offerings are decent and the Powells Bookstore is a great place to grab a book for your flight My only bummer is that it IS a smaller metro airport and thus fewer international nonstops

We arrived and departed on the BA flight from LGW Arrival was amazingly quick It took less than half an hour to deplane go through passport control and collect bags Being a Club World passenger undoubtedly helped but even so we were pretty impressed There was almost no queue to go through security at the time of departure lunchtime midweek so the process was painless Again we were lucky that it was so quiet A new business lounge has just opened by Gate Its rather small but has good food choice Getting to San Francisco is a cinch using the BART connector shuttle to Coliseum and thence onwards to downtown San Francisco In fact the whole experience is much better than at SFO And because of the competition between BA and Norwegian fares from the UK are very reasonable at present

Norman Manley Airport originally Palisadoes Airport is an old military field that like MBJ has grown As most tourist arrivals are via MBJ KIN gets overlooked when improvements are in the works Indeed an old tired airport with crowding a problem both inside outside the buildings There is an improvement programme underway for the airside facilities with pax facilities coming in second place Walking tofrom the plane is interesting but the smell of jet fuel can be nauseating Like MBJ the approach provides interesting views Kingston and surrounds notably the hills above town The drive in from the airport is a beautiful ride along the peninsula though if going into town will be through some rough spots Recent hurricane damage has been repaired for the most part Overall a far below MBJ in all aspects but workable
Pleasant short flight Plane was clean and on time Boarding was efficient Staff cheerful Very convenient to reach other Caribbean islands Will fly with them again

Tanahmerah to Korowai Batu This route is a governmentsubsidized one operated with tiny aircraft carrying only about a dozen passengers No advance booking possible but Dimonim staff were helpful in getting us on a flight the same day Departure time was uncertain but we eventually got on the plane Once aboard it was a great flight offering sweeping views of the rivers and rain forests below Cheap too

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

Yangon to Mandalay I have flown FMI Air four times now They provide one of the best customer experiences of any airline I have flown Staff is professional and friendly Lounges are wellequipped and comfortable Aircraft are clean In the often confusing and cattleherding feel of domestic Myanmar flight FMI stands out for the comparative serenity of the experience Flights are roughly USDleg more than competitors When you factor in lounge comfort and beverages good internet and the relaxed feel ar both departure and arrival its worth the extra money

A very pleasant airport Modern spacious very quiet the building has good acoustics to dampen internal and external noise Tasty food free drinking water you need to bring your own bottle Also interesting in the general area of the terminal you can spend time in the Flyport an interesting educational area about aerospace Efficient service smiling and helpful staff All in all highly recommended

Fantastic service from bag drop to landing and getting my baggage on the other end All staff played their role in providing the excellent customer service It was an early morning flight and it was really nice to start the day on the right track

Flew Star Peru from Lima to Cusco Pleasantly surprised after reading dire reviews here Departure was more or less on time in small rather old plane It was mostly empty too Seats not incredibly comfortable but very short flight anyway Price not a bargain but not terribly expensive no point booking in advance BTW as fares do not seem to really vary that much Flight was fine and service was rather good and polite onboard with snacks drink and luggage all included in fare No issues at all

A very small airport but well run It has stands which are all a few steps from the terminal building It is no where near Oslo miles south approx hours away The terminal building is a single storey with Checkin Desks on one side arrivals in the middle with belt and Security Scanning on the other side On the Land Side there is a cafshop supplying hot and cold snacks and other things and a seating area It is very small so everything is within easy reach but if more than plane is in at a time it could get busy Outside there is lots of car parking and car rental options along with transport to the local railway station for trains to various points including Oslo If you are visiting Oslo City Centre think carefully before using this airport if you want to access the locality it is a small friendly place

Got to be one of the worlds smallest airports The terminal is the size of a large living room You can literally drive up to the front door and walk in This made the airport very efficient and easy to use but dont bank on having a gourmet burger before your flight You will have to make do with a snickers bar and an Irn Bru from the vending machine To be fair it was very clean and is a good hub for the northern extremities

Its been years since I traveled through Terminal The refurbished Terminal is a world class modern airport terminal It is spacious brightly lit with plenty of seating and dining options aplenty There are oodles of power ports and USB ports at the gates however some of the power ports were not working Bathrooms are very clean The concourses are wide and directions easy to follow to baggage claim Security was a breeze with no wait time for the TSAPre checkpoints WiFi was easy to connect too and blazing fast The refurbished terminal is a significant upgrade to the old terminal

Albrook Panama City to Bocas del Toro After reading comments about this airline I was a bit worried but our flight with Air Panama was really okay Checkin at the airport was quick there were no lines My bag was kg so I had to pay dollars for the kg overweight Totally fine There are no infoscreens at the small airport of Albrook but as there are only leaving a couple of flights a day its obvious when boarding starts The flight left at so right on time The fokker used for this flight is old but seatpitch was okay for this minute flight to Bocas After a loud and bumpy take off the crew handed out some crisps and a soda After minutes of cruising with some wonderful views at the rainforest and Caribbean beaches the pilot started decent into Bocas airport After a soft landing and a short taxi to the small apron our luggage appeared within minutes We really enjoyed this flight in this old air Panama fokkerairplane

The airport is clean and not large Signposts are clear Passengers can get around easily Employees are friendly and helpful Security check is efficient The prices charged at food outlets are reasonable

I flew from YYZ to AMD via Doha old airport Overall experience is not so bad except transporting to plane by coach Embarking from and boarding to plane is by coach but overall management of coaches are good Security check is quite fast and not so much hold up Security personal are not checking for liquid in your hand baggage and line moves really nicely This is for transfer and not sure about passenger boarding from Doha Airport terminal is quite clean and roomy Good part is there is a nice play area for young kids and reasonably good quality free WiFi Washroom are no so clean mainly due to culture of people using them and mostly wet In rush hours it is crawded and also sometime close one in middle due to close off that area US bond flights Not so much food option but overall food is not so costly compare to European airports Ground staff are not that helpful but Qatar Airways staff are excellent I missed new terminal by only days
My mother travelled alone in Air Asia on June The flight was very comfortable Services were good Ground staff was extremely helpful Sincere thanks to the ticketing staff

A totally stressfree experience as sampled on a return charter flight from the Tampa Bay area Just eight departure gates but ample seating and a friendly barcafe No TSA hassle either A good gateway to Biloxi the Mississippi Gulf Coast and even Mobile AL Close to I

Due to a mechanical fault the plane that landed was too small for all of the passengers So the ground staff at Nevsehir had to work really hard to deal with about people who could not fit The staff in this small office tried so hard to identify the most urgent passengers who had connecting flights then they prioritised everyone The staff were faced with passengers who all thought they were the most important person in the airport We did not have a connecting flight and were lower priority So the team arranged for about of us to be bussed to nearby Kayseri airport our flight was going to be hours later than expected So the ground staff refunded the cost of our flight not once but twice We were able to collect the money from a counter at the airport immediately then we were upgraded to Business class which meant we were able to sit in quiet and cool comfort while we waited Then on the flight we were very impressed with the food and service and priority baggage service I know the fault was not due to the ground staff but they really tried hard and were very successful at getting people through to their connecting flights and what they offered us really helped ease the pain of our delay I am really impressed with the people in that small office I wish I da their names to thank them personally I highly recommend flying with Turkish Airways after this experience

Perfect trip throughout except for one strange thing that comes first I partly paid the fare with miles This can only be done via agent by filling the form on the site and waiting for the response Also miles paid booking doesnt appear at your regular account so some difficulties to access it Otherwise it was fine Online check in no problem Bag drop with automatic counter didnt work well but resolved within minutes on the regular desk Boarding efficient take off on time ordered meal arrived and was ok Landing on schedule Legroom is ok no problem with overhead bag allocation Toilets clean Crews nice and efficient The plane was clean cabin in good condition The room for improvement is booking with miles and legroom Tighter than Ryanair

Not Verified I loved this airport I have travelled to NY many times before always into JFK Now that I have discovered the wonderful Norwegian Airlines I arrived and departed NY via Stewart International It is a relatively small airport but efficient and confident There is no masses of hurrying crowds which are the tension you get at large international airports The airport is surrounded by greenery when you leave the terminal there is a brief walk across to pick up rental car taxis or the shuttle bus so relaxing For the journey home everything was relaxed fast and efficient As I mentioned it is a small airport the bar caf shop and duty free is in a small area Some people might want more but I found it more than enough All hands are on deck in the airport to get everyone on their way home Great little airport and great flights and price by Norwegian Airlines

My son who is epileptic had a seizure during the security check in We had already requested Special Assistance at the desk and the airport team were incredibly helpful and took us to a quiet room to wait until our flight was called They checked on us every minutes and arranged a wheelchair and preferential boarding once the Gate opened They also ensured that the crew were aware of our situation and forwarded the request for assistance to Gatwick

I fly weekly for business and flew in and out of GreenvilleSpartanburg for the last quarter of and a bit of Its a small airport with only one runway and one long concourse with arbitrary A and B separation The major airlines serve GSP but flights are limited I mostly flew on American which only seems to connect via Charlotte an mile flight First being so close to a major hub like CLT caused almost weekly delays as my flight was often held on the tarmac by CLT airtraffic control so we could fit into the traffic pattern I never actually missed my connections in Charlotte but did have several walkjogs across the airport to reach my gate while the final groups were boarding But GSP itself is nicely maintained with superfriendly staff They offered TSA PreCheck when I flew in and out I got to know the Avis rentalcar staff by name and theyd give me free upgrades Best of all if you use GSP you have to order a tuna melt from the snack counter on the lower level outside security They mix the tuna salad from scratch in front of you and make the besttasting tuna melt Ive ever eaten

After guessing at which line to wait for checking my luggage Im still waiting in a line that doesnt move for longer than an hour The reason the conveyor belt that moves the luggage is broken When I left Washington the same problem happened just that the IAD airport organized porters with carts and we didnt wait at all The disorganization level at this airport is outstanding

I recently flew with Alaska and had the best service Comfortable seats wifi and connectivity was excellent there was no entertainment screen but I was able to watch movies on my laptop and the choices were excellent Food was excellent cabin was clean landingdeparture was on time and relaxing the flight was on time value for money was awesome ground service was awesome I had a fabulous experience with Alaska airlines and will fly with them again

Paris Orly to PointePitre Overall good experience decent food friendly service on the inbound flight Outbound all of the crew disappeared at night difficult to get something to drink Some security concerns upon landing in Paris Crew didnt check the cabin at alltwo teens sleeping in lie flat position until touchdown No one to wake them up no one to remind them to put their seat in an upright position never saw that before Seats are ok but angled lie flat

This was the nicest transatlantic flight Ive taken and Ive been traveling to and from Paris a lot It was a very large and comfortable plane The flight attendant who took care of us was delightful The seats were very comfortable and went almost completely flat for an actual sleep The food was even decent We flew back on Air Canada which was fine but I was sad it was not the same as the way out I will try to fly with Corsair on my next trip in October Thank you

In spite of a delay of one hour at LHR the flights to and from Australia were the most pleasant that I have made on this route The cabin service is outstanding and my dietary requirements diabetic were met and were some of the best I have ever eaten The cabin crew at all times were top class

On our return from our Christmas break we sadly had a long delay in Milan Linate in transit due to the inclement weather in the UK which meant poor visibility at many airports and especially in London City where would be landing At first this was frustrating as we werent told about the delay until through passport control and at the tiny nonSchengen gate area after essentially having our boarding pass scanned for boarding The previous flight had been cancelled already and we could have waited in the lounge as status holders but the lounge is in the Schengen area before passport control However from then on I was surprised how well ITA had handled this after an minutes it became clear conditions in London werent going to improve for the day so ITA escorted us all through immigration via bus to departures where they arranged accommodation for the night During all this we got an automatic email with our new flight the next morning After a short wait at the checkin counter our names and room requirements were taken down given new boarding passes and within minutes we were able to head to our hotel near to the airport where a room and dinner was provided The flight the next day operated on schedule Other passenger who we met who couldnt be accommodated on ITA were accommodated on BA flights which I thought was impressive given they are competitor and in a rival alliance I was very worried initially but impressed in the end how well ITA handled these irregular operations and staff seemed to cope well this gives me a lot of confidence to fly with them in the future as they made it very stressfree Recommended

This is the first time in over a year I used this airport and I have to say that I am not disappointed Its facilities are fair very clean pleasant to stroll through and spacious The staff is pleasant and professional

This is a very nice airport Pretty clean and very manageable My only reason for posting a review is there was no functioning water fountain neither for drinking or filling water bottles in the concourse Didnt work when we arrived still didnt when we left six days later Drumming up money for the concession stand Had to buy water for the trip out Bad look for an otherwise pleasant place

Work required me to go on very short notice to London so I decided to fly with VLM which offers you three flights per day from Antwerp to London City with their Fokker Decided as well to fly from Antwerp as they offered reasonable prices for their flights while my usual airlines I usually take from Amsterdam or Rotterdam were extremely expensive for just flying of less than a hour Arriving a touch early at Antwerp Airport checkin and security were quite quiet so it was just a matter of a few minutes to pass both checkin and security while waiting to board Very small airport so dont expect much to do after security Once the aircraft was ready to board it was just minutes to be fully ready to start up and depart The Fokker they were using was surprisingly neat and clean from the inside for an aircraft of this age and was quite spacious to stand in the aisle After an ontime departure out of Antwerp the flight was quite smooth and the flight attendant started to serve us with a complimentary drink and snack of your choosing while the flight crew kept us up to date about their procedure into London City and the estimated time of arrival which to me was well done Turbulence appeared into approach of London and landing was ontime The most surprising factor of the flight was that the noise was quite low for a turboprop within the cabin After a ontime landing the boarding was quickly done in a safe and mannerly matter and all that was left was to wait for our luggage to arrive on our belt which probably was the longest wait

As a resident of Chattanooga I have used this airport on several occasions With just gates it seems to be a bit undersized for a city of However speaking from an architectural perspective it has more character than most airports I have flown through and is very clean besides There is virtually no chance of getting lost owing to the small size and simple layout The security checkpoint is neither intimidating nor cumbersome but the agents are thorough and will search your bags if needed CHA recently added a daily direct flight to DallasFort Worth and will soon follow up with direct service to Houston and Orlando Other cities with direct service to and from CHA include Atlanta Chicago Charlotte Washington DC Cincinnati and Memphis CHA really is a connected airport and getting moreso all the time apparently

We found Munich Airport to be an excellent airport very well laid out with two level gate system that seems to work very efficiently Very easy to follow signage good seating Check in and baggage drop off was well managed by friendly staff at Singapore Airlines service desks Gates and boarding in designated assigned groups seemed to work quite well Well presented airport

Airport uses a lot of natural light The design is modern especially the departure lobby the ceiling its so high The staff in the airport have good manners The luggage arrived quick and theres plenty of checkin counters too The bad thing airline lounges terrible

Having no low cost carriers until relatively recently between Bangkok and Taipei this was one of the few major Asian routes which meant a plane change in a third country to find a decent fare for budget travelers Now it is served by two V Air and Tigerair Taiwan On the basis of this flight both are excellent and put similar carriers in the shade The Tigerair Taiwan afternoon flight to Bangkoks Don Mueang airport was boarded efficiently using a bus gate and taxiing commenced minutes early FAs were smartly dressed and super efficient smiling as they carried out their duties My preordered meal was piping hot unlike on some fullservice carriers who serve from a trolley All in all a seamless and flawless flight

The current airport consists of two buildings The first houses the security scanners and the second an open air thatched building the manual check in Very pleasant for small groups A new terminal is being constructed and should be ready in a few years Like most things in Lamu this is a simple functional relaxed airport From the terminal you walk meters to the fast boats for the minute ride to Lamu Town or to Shela Beach

It is five years since I have been to the Crimea The airport terminal is new and quite spacious The arrival area worked well and I had free WiFi while I waited for my luggage to arrive from the plane As far as departure was concerned there were plenty of check in counters and the areas were quite well sign posted in Russian and English There are good areas for food and souvenirs both before and after the security clearance It is an airport which seems to work quite well and is a big improvement on the old terminal

A lowcost airline and they enforce bag weights and sizes and number of bags very closely Despite that if you buy early its a good value for travel in and around Kazakhstan Purchase bags early as they charge a lot at airport My flight however was fine arrived on time with no issues Overall satisfied for what I paid

Excellent modern airport that is complete There was a complete redesign and now it consists of concourses West and Central with the East Concourse still to be built The facility is modern and airy and nicely designed for post with lots of shops and restaurants post security Presecurity it is very tight particularly because people waiting for arriving passengers congregate at the two TSA checkpoints see CHOKE points For the passenger flying into or out of OKC is a breeze
Great airport Excellent shopping facilities Very clear directions Very helpful staff A cut above the rest of the small airports I have visited

I arrived at Yangon airport about am today Dec and proceeded to be processed through security Xray machines I was in a hurry and thus quickly pickedup my luggage but forgot and left my phone wallet and spectacles behind It must have been about minutes later at the airline checkin when I realized my mistake I was in panic and so backtraced my steps However I requested the wrong counter for my belongings But the officers were very helpful and apologetic that they could not find my belongings I then remembered the correct counter near row D and there the security officers were able to retrieve my belongings very quickly I believe they had followed strict procedures and had kept my belongings safe while awaiting my return to claim them After a simple verification I have all my items returned in good order I wish to thank security staff for their prompt and helpful assistance and making my return trip pleasant
