GRX is a small regional airport Boarding and disembarking aircraft is usually very quick due to the limited aircraft movements Passenger facilities are limited waiting areas are small no lounges minimal eating outlets and taxis are hard to come by which is surprising for an airport However some of the nicest security screening staff that I have ever come across always smiling and patient with passengers UK and US staff can really learn something here

This airport is very small for the number of passengers and airlines it is serving Everywhere seemed to be crowded and felt cramped I thought they needed more space for better facilities and customer service Transferring from the train coming from London to the terminal and between terminals was very easy and well signage The prayer room is available and wellmaintained and the toilets are clean Not a pleasant experience for shopping and dining as there are too many people in a cramped space

Siem Reap to Da Nang I purchased a flight without baggage I purchased baggage separately for AU with great difficulty via the Cambodia Angkor Air website I received the receipt on Messenger The receipt could not be located at Siem Reap airport I was forced to then pay US to get my luggage on board I have emailed the airline with the receipt and transcript but there has been no response On board I had never seen a refreshment trolley pushed along the aisle with such speed allowing nobody the opportunity to obtain a drink
The service is good as a budget airline Cabin crew is helpful I did not encounter any bad issue along my flight I will recomment this airline if oyur having a tight budget The fares are reasonable

With family in Brittany Im a regular user of Rennes St Jacques and have seen its traffic grow significantly in volume over the past decade What a shame that the airport itself has not been able to keep up The only passenger facilities are a small caf gift shop and once you get beyond security theres a popup snack stall closed on Sundays and a vending machine No shops eating establishments or even the token Duty Free Generally I pass through the airport quickly so this isnt really a concern but if you are unfortunate enough to be delayed its not fun My main issue is with the speed of checkin which can only be described as glacial When there are two or more imminently departing flights at the same time the queues barely seem to move at the risk of passengers almost missing their plane I speak from experience here Staff are pleasant and bilingual but absolutely inefficient at processing large volumes of passengers I want to like Saint Jacques its clean friendly and has a good bus service to the city centre but it hasnt really done enough to move with the times and comfortably accommodate its passengers If it had a choice of amenities expanded checkin with more staff and a better departure lounge it would be pretty much the perfect regional airport
London to Algiers There was a slight delay but the service onboard was excellent Clean very nice food and friendly personnel Very pleased with the whole experience Would fly Air Algerie again

Short hop from Nice to Calvi Hardly any people onboard Crew were not particularly friendly or welcoming but we were served a cookie and soft drinks Landed smoothy although slightly delayed due to a missed approach However tickets were cheap and luggage included All in all a decent experience

Absolutely love this airport Easy in and easy out Not jammed with people like the zoo at MCO Orlando Adequate places to get something quick to eat and comfortable seats to wait Only min from our place in Oviedo I just wish more domestic carriers other than just Allgiant flew into SFB Maybe international travelers dont care for it because its not a large airport but its great for us and I do recommend it

Dane County Regional is a cute little airport lying on the outskirts of Madison and it has had some of the best services I have ever experienced at any airport The airport is incredibly clean and attractive on the inside and the outside This includes nice modern architecture on the outside and mosaic flooring and stained glass handling lights It may not have as many stores as other airports but there is a store for nearly all travel needs such as a Cafe a restaurant a travel store and a Wisconsin Gear store I also noted that there were multiple stores under construction There are hardly any delays and MSN connects to nearly all large nearby airports which provides excellent connection availability The best part was the incredibly fast Wifi and charger ports in the waiting area

Flew into Alderney from Southampton A lovely little airport Very relaxed friendly staff and a good shop and cafe very good considering the airport is tiny Taxis waiting right outside the main entrance and it only takes about minutes if that to get from the aircraft to the terminal entrance Very good all round

Benghasi Domestic to Tripoli Domestic What a nice surprise Buraq Air is the year old private airline in Libya that operates domestically as well as to Cairo and Istanbul It is the vastly preferred carrier to Libyan Arab Airlines My flight from Benghasi domestic to Tripoli domestic was easy to purchase in town not on Sabre or Galilleo unfortunately and was just one way The domestic airport is nothing to write home about but is clean and Benghasians are very friendly with smiles all round This flight operated with a rather longinthetooth you know the ones with long cigarshaped engines but was clean and the cabin crew were polite engaging and presented themselves in smart uniforms smiles all round again This was an all economy configuration but legroom was more than European airlines in J class Soft drinks hot drinks and some cakes made a break during the minute flight

Moroni to Moheli Turned out to be a pretty decent airline Online booking worked well checkin and boarding was fine and the plane looked well maintained Its a very short flight just minutes or so so i didnt expect much but they still managed to hand our a bottle of water and some biscuits which i though was very nice Both flights on time

We booked different domestic flights tofrom and in Sulawesi with Lion Air as there were no real alternatives What I was afraid for having read reviews here already happened days before departure of our first flight as I got a message our initially booked first flight was cancelled and we were rebooked on a later flight From the flights booked were cancelled and we got rebooked Luckily I managed to arrange my pickup at the Makassar and Ternate airports where we already arranged travel Our flights from Makassar to Palopo and back were the only ones that remained as booked Palopo flights on an ATR twinturboprop had Wings Air owned by Lion Air flight numbers All other flights were on s Service on board of the flights was nonexistent but at least the flights were smooth and left on time as per the new schedule Also baggage reclaim went smooth but this of course shouldnt be an issue as all airports were quite small The positive note is staff at the airports were nice and friendly and always did their best to assign us seats with more legroom which was much appreciated

One of the nicest most modern airports in the country Decent array of shops and restaurants Not a large selection between security checkpoints and departure gates but that is typical and here it is still far better than at Fortaleza a city of similar size Airport is close to town especially beach areas so transportation is usually easy How many agents are actually working at the checkin counters can vary widely but I assume that is the responsibility of the airlines

Air New Zealand representative named Leanne was very helpful when I needed help to check in my ft surfboard she was helpful when I needed help to print out my boarding pass exceptional patience and excellent customer skills
Airline staff helped me with last minute web check in cancellation also helped locating the luggage and provided the best support and service for such hospitality and customer delight

Old airport but reconstruction going on Very efficient immigration on the way in with separate lane for business class Fast delivery of luggage as well took me less than minutes to be out of the airport Departure wise a little bit slower but acceptable friendly immigration and security people very basic business lounge Departure procedure efficient despite lack of discipline of Chinese passengers always trying to jump queues

The airport is a charming little place up on the Sunshine Coast There are only about flights a day going to Sydney and Melbourne It has recently been upgraded and expanded the gate area is much bigger and has food outlets and toilets It opens up on to the runway and provides nice views Its an easy airport to handle as it isnt too big to get lost in but isnt so small so as to feel cramped The butterfly sanctuary between checkin and security which must be walked through as it is on the pathway is a lovely touch and provides a unique atmosphere The ground staff are very friendly If heading up to the Sunshine Coast it is often cheaper and quicker to fly direct rather than to Brisbane and by far it is an easier airport to use

Moscow to Thessaloniki I usually use this company in my trips to Moscow Even if i was wondering about this new company that they use leasing airplanes i tried it and i want to say just one thing these are our lovely Greeks Every trip is small party specially when the destination is a Greek airport People are drinking free alcohol Greek wine they are eating and are enjoying their trip Staff is very goodThey use more than languages

Although it was busy Australia Day Public Holiday check in was quite easy The plane left on time and staff were efficient and friendly Only water coffee and tea is available for free but for a short flight I dont mind Overall a great flight and a pleasant way to end my Australia Day Break

An unexpectedly pleasant experience The booking process was a bit odd but after using several different credit cards one finally worked on the airline website for a ticket about euros less than any other airline Check in and boarding was smooth Two suitcases allowed at kg each Or one at a maximum of kg There was entertainment with several English language recent films Ample food provided The layover was fine No one was saying anything about not taking photos and it wasnt any more different than transferring in China Seemed the duty free shops take card now too

Flew STNBIO BIOSTN modern stylish terminal architecture some way outside Bilbao but perhaps the nearest bit of flat land to be found amongst all those hills No problems on arrival speedy passport check and luggage quickly up on the belt Same when leaving fact luggage drop and security control Airport is clean staff friendly and helpful Minor gripes no free wifi no post office to buy stamps souvenir shop did not have any postcards food and drink airside expensive lifts seem to have a mind of their own not enough seats on the groundside Bilbao well worth a visit even for a day but certainly a weekend

Pokhara to Kathmandu I received very good service by Yeti Airlines at Pokhara and Kathmandu airport on st Dec Due to fog my flight was delayed I had a connecting flight to Delhi from Kathmandu to Delhi at The Staff at Pokhara Airport were very helpful to my request to advance my booking to an earlier flight and ensured my luggage was loaded in the cabin itself so that I could get it first when I landed at Kathmandu At Kathmandu the staff unloaded my luggage and took me in the small van to the terminal so I could leave the airport quickly I would rate this as excellent service On my next trek in Nepal I would fly this airline again

The rum and pretty well everything in the duty free stores costs double what it costs in a grocery store in Managua Rum is about US in a grocery and in the duty free in the airport A pound of Case de Cafe coffee is about vs about in the grocery store However the duty free shops are the only place to buy legitimate Nicaraguan cigars as total production in the country is for export They are very good and very high quality but to be honest at times in the USA they cost less Random luggage searches on departure are almost always for locals rarely tourists The airport is really quite advanced for Central America currently departures are a bit of a hassle with the construction of that area arrivals are a breeze and rarely does it take more than minutes with immigration and customs both especially for tourists vs visitingreturning Nicaraguans Taxis to the city are clean and controlled if a bit slow vs a regular taxista and cost US with the drivers in the red shirts However if you walk to the street about feet the fare is around If you can negotiate in Spanish that is

We flew from Dubrovnik to Athens and then Athens to Zagreb on Croatia Airlines They were on time within minutes for both flights You drop your bag on the tarmac and they load it into the belly of the plane And then you pick it up directly from the tarmac after the flight so there is very little chance for lost luggage which I like They allow a smaller carryone bag as well They did not weigh our bag or try to charge us for anything extra We were allowed to pick our seats for no charge The seats are standard and comparable to Southwest airlines for leg room and space We were served water and drinks on both flights For the price we paid it was a great deal Some people might be nervous about flying a propeller plane but it was a very smooth flight in both directions with almost zero turbulence and a very smooth landing If you had to fault them for one thing it would be nice to have some in flight entertainment Other than that it was a perfect flight Definitely recommend

My husband and myself were at Alicante airport returning from a short break I am disabled following a subarachnoid haemorrhage years ago I really needed to feedback on my support from Carmen who reported she has worked many years in the assistance area she was so kind and helpful and made my journey much more settled I cannot thank her enough Regards Kath Robinson

Lovely airport With a three hour wait at this airport it was a lovely airport to spend some time before going through the gates Great food options and variety There was lots of seating with tables and we could have food from anywhere Great to keep the whole family happy I am not a big fan of designer stores so the fact that we spent time before security was ideal

London to Hanoi via Shenzhen Boarding was a little prolonged and we were called to the gate much earlier than needed on the London Shenzhen leg Both of my flights left slightly late The crew were friendly seat was comfortable and food was surprisingly good considering We had two full meals and drinks on the first leg and a snack box on the second The entertainment on the London Shenzhen leg had enough options to satisfy me though far fewer than other airlines The system was modern and worked well The Shenzhen Hanoi leg had no entertainment Crew announcements were hard to hear and very brief in English Transiting in Shenzhen was as chaotic as expected but took around an hour in total I had to follow signs to domestic transfers wait in a holding area to fill in some forms through immigration then headed upstairs to departures of my own volition My checked bag went all the way without having to collect in Shenzhen The flight was a bargain and I definitely would use again

Smaller more convenient airport for Seoul Arrivals process quick and easy short walk from the aircraft to Passport Control Down a set of steps to Baggage Reclaim Bags come reasonably quickly There are toilets within Baggage Reclaim Customs check and then the main Arrivals area The walk to the metrotrain was quite a long way but all flat to push baggage carts Ticket machines that take cash Express train to Seoul Station and other metro trains to most points within greater Seoul A quick and easy way to get into South Korea

Rio De Janeiro is a good aiirport but was very crowded during the Olympics The new terminal is awesome but GOL VIP lounge is poor the Plaza Premium Lounge is better The duty free is good but overpriced Customs and immigration officers are quite sympathetic and the airport is clean

Ground service is terrible compared to in the air Manual checkin process with no computers This airline seems to be the only one to have a lounge in the domestic terminal in Yangon Airconditioned and friendly associates offering a cheese croissant No bathroom inside so that was a drag People in Lotus class got a private van to the plane which was nice compared to cramming onto a bus Onboard the flight was pretty good The front of the plane is much quieter compared to the back Their inflight magazine was pretty decent and the english grammatically correct Even on short flights they gave you food On my YGNMDY flight which was about minutes they served a full breakfast Seats were pretty comfortable on par with United A first class seats I dont really see the need for inflight entertainment on such short flights

Almost everything I saw in New Zealand is well organized Auckland Airport is the exception We waited minutes to get through international departures due to long lines for boarding pass scanning passport co tell and security there were only lanes open for the latter plus one for premium passengers Really not up to spec if Auckland wants to be an international hub

The booking was easy via Zipair website reasonable price and good flight time The trip was pleasant in general the plane is clean new upgraded the staff were very friendly and polite and flight was on time But need to be more clear about the low price comes from not providing anything in return Like things are granted on other long flights hours for example a screen to watch movies games tv show this is unavailable on zipair there is WiFi to use on your own devices its not that strong anyway Other things are unavailable blankets no free non alcohol drinks even water I dont need to say food or snacks Thats all needed to be mentioned clearly on their website to be prepared ahead There are a few items available for purchase honestly the food could not be worse they bring it in small carton box water bottle thats it no tray no bread butter no dessert Otherwiseall good just needed to add these information and details make a plan to enjoy the trip

Small airport in Orange County NY that is a welcome alternative to Newark other airports if you can get a flight Fare was hundreds less flying to PHL connecting to IND rather than nonstop from EWR but lots of time spent sitting in airports It is clean staff are pleasant but not much to do Wish there were more nonstops out of this airport to major cities but I hear it is great if you are going to Florida

Incheon Airport generally has a nice and clean layout making navigation straightforward However my experience today at Security Lane was quite disappointing Out of the three passport scanner machines only one was operational causing severe delays I joined the queue at PM and only cleared security at PM taking over hour and minutes to get through For an airport of this reputation such inefficiency was unexpected Thankfully I had arrived early for my PM flight or I might have missed it While the rest of the airport experience is great the management should urgently address such issues
A decidedly mediocre airport Winnipeg and Quebec City are similar in size but are far advanced in terms of services on offer design and overall experience What happened in Halifax Depressing and sad

The airport is a charming little place up on the Sunshine Coast There are only about flights a day going to Sydney and Melbourne It has recently been upgraded and expanded the gate area is much bigger and has food outlets and toilets It opens up on to the runway and provides nice views Its an easy airport to handle as it isnt too big to get lost in but isnt so small so as to feel cramped The butterfly sanctuary between checkin and security which must be walked through as it is on the pathway is a lovely touch and provides a unique atmosphere The ground staff are very friendly If heading up to the Sunshine Coast it is often cheaper and quicker to fly direct rather than to Brisbane and by far it is an easier airport to use

I travelled from Coventry to Naples this year and found the airport limited but satisfactory The checkin area reminded me of the old days with cardboard flight destination signs and this was an area that could be easily changed for the better The lines crossed each other to the destinations and did cause some friction between customers The car parking was an experience but again was satisfactory I do not understand why the local bus companies especially those going to Leamington Stratford do not call in On returning the baggage was certainly a LOT better than Birmingham so a plus there In the departure lounge there was a good choice of food and drink at great prices no rip off here Also a small point The newspapers were out and available from about Birmingham they are still under wraps at Good value and friendly Hope they get permission for the bigger one soon

Bought a ticket around the world and finally I could try the JAL one of the Japanese airlines My trip was sublime I rate this as the best airline Cabin Crew were outstanding food was delicious wine are perfect As its Japanese it has the automatic toilets on board too Seat comfy Got rest got cocooned and now I know who to fly with

Budapest to Zrich Even though the F aircraft was rather old the comfort was very good The seats were very comfortable and had a lot of leg space The crew was very nice and had a beautiful uniform The onboard service provided was the same as on every other Swiss international Airlines flight The information given by the crew was accurate ond easy to understand I really liked this flight

A little and modest airport in the capital of Saxony Apparently the politicians and the government members of the state of Saxony gave it the right to exist to be able to travel by plane directly to and from Dresden and avoiding using the bigger and better airport in Leipzig one hundert of miles away I wonder if this airport is profitable at all Any how it is very clean and clear and it is the best way to get to Dresden from outside east part of Germany Airport staff seems to be much more bored then engaged

Flew Waterford to Birmingham on th January Nice little airport staff very friendly Small cafe before departure excellent coffee and light snacks Security and boarding very well handled An enjoyable experience

BMAMMX one way The flight was comfortable with professional and friendly staff The free food and drinks served onboard were top quality The central location of Stockholm Bromma was very advantageous for our city break but checkin and boarding was a hassle Checkin closes minutes before departure which means that half the passengers were cramming at the check in desks in the last minute Free seating onboard the plane resulted in more cramming after the security because everyone wants a good seat It was a real circus In my opinion min checkin deadline instead of min and allocated seats instead of free seats would have been optimal

Stockholm Vsters is a tiny airport located around minutes drive west of Stockholm The name is therefore misleading as Vsters is a proper mediumsized town in its own right The place has a very friendly easygoing feel to it There is very little to do save buy a cup of coffee or something stronger if thats to your taste but then I have never had course to spend more than minutes at the airport There are special very efficient buses to Stockholm and elsewhere which connect with incoming and outgoing Ryanair flights It is also possible to take a regular bus into Vsters A totally hasslefree calm place to begin or end a journey

This was an unexpected surprise due to my family thinking that we were going to fly Ryanair however in my opinion it was a pleasant surprise I have a really bad fear of flying so an incredibly nice cabin crew member sat next to me and told me that she loved flying and how long she had done it for and how safe it was She also said that she really enjoyed flying and the turbulence was enjoyable The seats were nice and the crew was amazing I didnt get any food but I loved this low cost airline

Hiroshima is a small regional airport with virtually all flights internal Japanese flights Most westerners visit Hiroshima using land routes from other cities so the airport is not as western friendly as bigger Japanese airports This means there are few public announcements in English though the standard of English for check in staff was very good The food concession stands also cater to Japanese tastes only so you are out of luck if you only like western food There are also no magazines or books in any language other than Japanese Surprisingly wide range of souvenirs though most wont be much use to long haul travelers eg frozen salmon steaks oysters etc Transport to downtown very good as a limousine bus leaves from outside terminal and arrives pretty much next to the Bomb Dome which most people are going to

I would like to share my positive experience with Egypt Air as this Airline have really exceeded my expectations Friendly and professional cabin crew with delicious catering Highly recommended and for sure will fly Egypt Air again

Departed from Bangalore to London on BA from the new T in Bangalore Terminal is clean fresh and very green There is a green wall and several waterfalls Not what I had been expecting in India Both security and immigration very efficient and egates used to enter the airport Admittedly it was am when I entered the airport and therefore very quiet Not all the concessions airside are open yet but many are Choice of several places to eat and a decent duty free area Most pleasantly surprised

I arrived in this airport for transit My destination is Bangkok Thailand In my opinion the airport is quite small and kind of boring especially if you have a layover for more than hours There should have been some facilities that make the airport more interesting for example a reading corner some cool spots for taking a picture fun games and more cafes or restaurants The good thing is its easy to follow the signs or directions and you dont have to walk that far to reach the gate transit area departure or arrival hall So it would be a great idea to make this airport bigger and larger with more facilities

My sister and I flew from LGW to Banjul I have nothing but praise for the cabin crew We flew out on th Nov at The crew were amazing we have flown many times and although some passengers were difficult they never wavered from the job in hand and seemed to be happy genuinely I wish I took the crews names as they were on the go the whole hrs

The cabin was too warm which made this short flight rather uncomfortable also it was a rather turbulent one They served a good sandwich with complimentary drinks which in my opinion is a very nice gesture Legroom was premium as were the seats

Used this airport multiple times for international and domestic arrivals and departures Nice and clean Airport staff are friendly Provides jet bridge at almost every flight In my opinion it needs more coffee shops eateries and lounges Parking spot is located conveniently close to the airport entrance

Singapore to Yangon Ontime departure from Changi terminal The economy cabin felt clean and the crew were friendly My expectation was for a basic and efficient service which was we got This was an evening flight so we had a basic dinner which was okay as good if not better than the Premium Economy meal from Melbourne to Singapore Same wine Sauvignon Blanc This time no other option so I opted for the red Comfortable good service no complaints

Shanghai to Kota Kinabalu Shanghai Airlines code shares with China Eastern Airline It was a new plane and the flight experience was good Although one of the air steward seems like he hates his job but overall it was a pleasant experience The meals served was exactly the one I was served on my trip to Shanghai Nothing special something to fill an empty stomach The seats are comfortable whereby the headrest was tiltable We were given pillows and blankets on the flight but the flight was kinda warm even though we flew during the night Coming from someone who cannot really stand on cold the flight was really warm Overall it was a pleasant flight nothing special to praise or criticize about at least it got me safe back home

Bragana to Cascais with Aero VIP Seven Air provides the services The pilot was very nice and made sure everyone was comfortable and explained there would be some turbulence which was normal Flight arrived minutes late

Glacier Park International Airport FCA in Montana USA is the best small regional airport I have visited After a very long journey from Sydney we were cleared very fast What impressed us was the security guard who stands on arrival exit door greeted us with a big smile and sad welcome to Montana On our return flights we were checked in very fast cleared very fast with smiles by TSA what a difference after LAXTSA The terminal and toliets are very clean

Flew TACA Airlines from Lima to Bogota Only the outside of the aircraft and the food carriage were TACA The rest magazine and crew were Avianca Food service for the and a half hour flight was great full meal Full service of drinks juices beers alcoholic I would fly with them again

STNGSE Arrived on Ryanair Single runway so only one plane can landtakeoff at a time Very compact with everything close by A very short stroll from the aircraft to the terminal where Passport Kiosks quickly processed everyone The Baggage Claim is one conveyor and there are limited toilet facilities before getting to Arrivals Hall Arrivals is midway between the Checkin Desks and the Security Scanning Outside the airport there is a taxi rank usually stocked with cars for each flight and the bus to the centre of Gothenburg Picnic tables are still outside on the grass where you can relax Security is OK and then a smallish Departure Lounge which is very busy if flights are going at similar times The Duty Free has various things but no alcohol There is a cafe selling hot and cold drinks sandwiches and similar and a small bar selling drinks There are Departure Doors of which Gate has Passport Control for nonSchengen flights NB Whilst Security is quick if there are two flights at the same time the process slows especially as most passengers travel with volumes of hand luggage that need liquids etc removed It is a good little airport and friendly in size

We had an absolutely delightful experience with Privilege Style The staff were very nice and accommodating Seating was exactly as expected and food was fine enough for a flight meal Thank you for a great experience We look forward to flying Privilege again

We flew from Liberia to San Jose This was an incredibly easy flight We left exactly in time and arrived a few minutes early in San Jose The San Jose Domestic terminal is a very easy and quick experience Absolutely no problems whatsoever I would highly recommend

I have flown here only on private aircraft The commercial airlines have yet to discover this often overlooked resource The parking and terminal buildings are great Reminds me of how Chicago Midway used to be before the most recent spate of reconstruction like a hometown feel Very clean facilities and the commercial pax I have spoken to all seem to enjoy it Mostly the lack of a commute to Chicago I think

Nice medium size airport Looks new or revamped and spotless clean Easy to move around and offers enough services Serious but very efficient staff which is all I ask for Fast check in fast security even going through passport control was relatively fast it was a late fly though so there wasnt many people

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap The cabin crew on our flight were amazing They were smiling and managed to provide every passenger with a beverage on this very short minute flight We will definitely be using Bassaka Air in the future due to the affordable prices cleanliness awesome flight attendants and speedy service

Brussels to Eskisehir with Tailwind Airlines Nice flight The crew was okay the plane was outdated The food was okay too not free or included though There wasnt any kind of inflight entertainment Great if you dont want WiFi connection or when you dont want to know where you are

I was with my mother at the entrance of the airport There was a young man named William He asked us if we needed help and I couldnt believe he helped us to get a wheelchair immediately That was awesome customer service compared to my experience in LA airport

Mumbai to Paris Excellent and clean Aircraft A Awesome Cabin service and cabin crew Amazing food and drinks Clean and comfortable business class seats even though they are not lie flat but comfortable sleep at an angle The highlight is excellent on board crew who took care of guests in an excellent manner Excellent AudioVideo system clean and neat restrooms I would like to say the most affordable business class product for a very quality product Would recommend all the way

Im impressed with all the improvements made at Dammam Airport Its easily my favorite airport to fly inout of in Saudi Arabia because of its compact size array of services retail and food and beverage outlets Its website and WiFi connectivity are also quite good and easy to use

Very early flight out of HK bussed from the terminal near gate downstairs so easy A bit of messing around at check in echeck in you need to show visas etc Plane spotless and staff attentive Bathrooms clean Return we prebooked one bag between us for the hold which we would recommend its about USD to do so whereas on the spot its more like US plane is immaculate and the staff responsive and quick Prebooked meals are served quickly and hot and cold drinks available Walked off to a far gate but train takes you to immigration Great for short flights and I feel they are better earlier in the day as more likely to be on time Seat is fine for a hour flight I would say Drinks arent extortionate nice cold prosecco for HK the app website is a bit tricky I joined it but had to do it all on the laptop first then open the app and register Sort of CX connected but not really Its a bit counterintuitive

This review is for T Arrival is smooth and quick as there are only few passengers and many open immigration counters There are counters for Chinese passport holders foreign passport holders APEC and crew as with other airports The signs and direction from arrival gate to the immigration baggage customs and exit are all clear A few steps from the immigration is the baggage carousel and then another few steps is the customs counters and then the exit There are taxi bays outside the terminal building and a bust waiting area I am not sure if the airport is connected by a train to the city proper as I did not use nor check it On departure checkin counters a less crowded as it ws an early flight There is a security check upon entering T and then another one after checkin and then a final and more detailed one after immigration There was no long queue and so I made it quick and fast to the boarding area Just at the back of the immigration is Gate which is my boarding gate and opposite it is Starbucks There are only few stores and restaurants Seats are not a problem as there are many empty ones The toilets are clean and well maintained Directions and signs are clear and understandable Visa and Mastecard are accepted The terminal is old but spacious The thermostat just needs to be adjusted as it is warm and it makes me feel uncomfortable The wifi si not working as well Overall I enjoyed this airport as an airplane enthusiast as it gives me a good view for plane spotting while waiting to board

SZBRDNSZB Return trip from Subang Skypark secondary airport in KL to Redang Island ATR looked in good condition could not have been very old minute flight a bottle of water and a refresher towel offered service punctual and friendly both flights on time A small airline but felt very safe flying with them

The toilets are the cleanest I have seen Im years The customs was quick and efficient I travel every year to Curaao and was a pleasure to see that they are much better than Schiphol Las Americas American airports European airports

Each time I have flown in and out it has been easy The lines moves quickly and everyone is friendly and helpful Upon arrival after passing through immigration you proceed to the baggage carousel and hope that your luggage has made it to your destination with you but dont try to walk away with your suitcase that easily someone will be standing by to check your baggage tag and your passport

Flight departed early Warm welcome by FA in business cabin Nice hot lunch served on first segment between Delhi and Kathmandu Printed menus New signature predeparture drink offered Clean airy cabin Regular updates from captain As usual spectacular landing in Paro

Getting through this airport was such a breeze our home airport is Pearson which is insanely busy We were able to apply for TSA cares for our autistic family Tameeka helped us from start to finish of security and was so warm and thoughtful in helping us navigate their first time through Highly recommend using this service if you have a family member with disabilities We applied for the same program at Orlando and no one helped us the staff were rude and the lady guarding the family and disabled line tried to turn us away Thoroughly disappointed especially compared to Buffalo We will definitely be flying out of Buffalo in the future

I have always found flying tofrom Sligo Airport a pleasure On a sunny day as one flies over Sligo Bay and comes into land is spectacular The airport is tiny with two flights per day to Dublin and two flights per day from Dublin It is served by Aer Arann The airport has has complimentary newspapers at the check in desk adn there is a little bar where a range of refreshments are served The staff are friendly and the service is first class There are no luggage carousels in the airport so all luggage is left in the Baggage Reclaim by hand One can be in the car after collecting their luggage in under a minute It could do with better signposting though and the roads to get to it are not the best but all in all a superb airport

TCI is a beautiful welcoming island with fabulous accommodations great beaches wonderful restaurants plenty to do etc However the government obviously has a policy of treating visitors terribly upon arrival and departure This was my wifes and my third visit and it has only gotten worse Evidently their desire is to cut down on the large number of tourists visiting by making arrival and departure tortuous you have succeeded Upon finally boarding our plane back to the US my wife turned to me and said We need to consider other options for our next trip I cant afford the mental cost of coming and going here I readily agreed and our plan for a fourth visit to TCI was quickly moved to the dustbin I strongly recommend that anyone considering a trip to TCI consider other destinations until this airport is improved

Great attentive and warm service at the check in in Paris Orly airport The agent even walked us to the special conveyor belt for extra large luggage Pleasant experience in the lounge enjoying breakfast with a view on the tarmac We boarded well ahead of time and as there are only seats that goes smoothly and without hassle A welcome drink was offered before take off and diner was served in two courses about hours later Before we landed a light meal quiche or sweet quality treat was served The stable WiFi connection allowed to work during the flight Seats are a classic business class seat which can be turned into a full flat bad Overall considering the service and the price I can really recommend La Compagnie

I wouldnt want to be a cheerleader for Ryanair So many things can go wrong But when things go right as they did on this trip I think it should be said that the airline provides a good service at a reasonable cost Most of the annoying announcements have gone and by paying a few pounds extra you can get a seat up front and take an extra bag on board The cabin crew were efficient and friendly particularly on the return flight where they were smiling and looked happy to be there

Berlin to Dusseldorf Eurowings flight operated by Germanwings This A was a different configuration then the first flight Legroom was less and was just enough for me m crew were smiling and good The flight delayed by minutes
TPEKHH one way Plane full but staff friendly on time and no complaints A bargain considering the onehour flight was only about USD

I fly this airline regularly between Yellowknife and Edmonton Staff is generally friendly and the complimentary food service is a nice touch but generally inedible Unfortunately they have the tendency to change your seats without notice and you will not find out until checkin time Much of the reason for this change is that if they notice a flight is only half booked they use half of the plane for cargo which eliminates the first rows of seats Thus when booking on Canadian North make sure you book the back row of seats between and you likely wont have to worry about your seat being changed Prepare to be packed in like sardines on most Canadian North flights though Seat pitchwidth is standard

Richmond International is a new stylish and perfect sized airport on the outskirts of Richmond major air carriers serve RIC flying to over domestic and international destinations in the USA and Canada The airport is mediumsized and easy to find your way around The security lines are short and hasslefree The airport atrium has a large glass roof giving the airport interior a very open feel A restaurant in the atrium has a large window with a full view of the apron for all the plane spotters Travel into and out of RIC is always hasslefree and fun

I want to make a sincere gratefulness to your information service staff I recently lost my passport on Feb and boarding pass before the security check Since it was late at night and the information kiosk on departure lobby was closed I called the hotline a kind lady staff name as Kuje who checked for me again and again if any lost report She also suggest me to contach to related staff THE PASSPORT WAS FINALLY FOUND Thank you Kuje San I hope this message could be read by you Cheers from Hong Kong

As most of people here state the airport is brand new and clean but they schedule most of flights at the same time in other words the arrival hall becomes a nightmare We had to wait airborne for some minutes before we were allowed to land due lack of ramp space The airport is well connected with buses to town On departure everything was pretty much smooth but they let you wait outside waiting on the heat During peak summer season I would avoid Corfu if I were you

Flew this route again last weekend Menzies the handling agent at EDI very helpful bag drop and boarding a breeze Where SunExpress excel is with their cabin crew who were helpful friendly and professional Also very well groomed Bugra and Ismet were excellent and an asset to the company I wouldnt hesitate to travel with them again and recommend

I very much enjoyed flying with SAS Very attentive and cheerful staff ontime departures and landings free coffee and tea service incl refill clean and modern planes A delightful experience My only little complaint is the ticket fare but after all it was in highseason and ok for such a good service

Surprisingly nice flight for a Chinese airline The business class named first class is of the usual type in China ie rows of seats with old seats and small reclining angle The crew was very attentive wine Chinese was decent and so was the food nothing special but ok Reading material is of course restricted to the China Daily and there is no individual entertainment but on a hours flight especially on a night flight this is not essential Flights both ways were on time I would recommend this flight as it is the only airline to fly directly between Bangkok and several places in the Shandong province schedule is terrible but it is still better than transferring

Been coming to GCM for years Yes tourism has increased based on reports by almost over last years which is fantastic for this beautiful Island But the airport although complete remodelled is poor at best Aesthetically pleasing it is too small and very uncomfortable Why go half way for something inadequate from the start Fortunately the entire staff are awesome and eased the pain Suggest a change in schedule of when flights arrive may assist even by minutes Two recent issues I dealt with The runway pothole was a total screw up From accounts in paper it appeared that new asphalt from night before was destroyed by a jet blast Asphalt needs to cure Second and personally involved is that our plane needed to wait one hour after everyone was boarded for maintenance to return a log book This made our connection for our next flight impossible with all the inconveniences associated How can you allow this calamity to occur is still not sitting well with me If you expect tourism to continue to visit your beautiful Island you need to improve

After guessing at which line to wait for checking my luggage Im still waiting in a line that doesnt move for longer than an hour The reason the conveyor belt that moves the luggage is broken When I left Washington the same problem happened just that the IAD airport organized porters with carts and we didnt wait at all The disorganization level at this airport is outstanding

Hilo International Airport was once THE airport on the Big island before Kona International Airport on the other side of the island opened in the ss Now Hilo Airport is a shadow of its former self with jetways no more than of which are in use at any given time The decor is kitschy s Hawaiiana and the terminal is warm and welcoming Hilo is one of the few US airports where the gate area and the ticketingbag claim are in separate buildings separated by an atrium The ticketingbag claim area has a bar a bookshop a souvenir shop selling Hawaiiana and packaged tropical fruit and a lounge area The gate building has no facilities The parking and car rental areas are just across the street from bag claim and the total walk from gate to kerb is only a few hundred feet Access to and from Hilo town is easy and traffic is usually light

CDGTIPOUA out ABJTIPCDG return Excellent flight to TIP clean new A with good food and friendly staff Flight to OUA similarly well presented Unfortunately the flight from ABJTIP was operated by Nouvelair on Afriqiyahs behalf other passengers also noticed the difference with grumpy staff and terrible food Happy to return to CDG with Afriqiyah again and more good service

The airport has definitely improved and it looks a lot more modern than it used to be before They have a decent dutyfree shop with a good selection of items I really liked the sports bar that they had there which was also showing the Fifa World Cup games live and the food was good too The airport staff is very friendly and welcoming and there are also stalls where you can get a massage There is also enough seating if you are traveling in transit

There were no drivers for wheelchair passengers We waited and waited In the end I went to desk twice The young lady on the computer was very irritable and no help I as a very old lady was beginning to panic as my flight EZY to Luton was due to depart in half an hour I think they got a lady staff from Security to wheel me to Departures I was nearly the last to board my plane Come on Palma Airport you need to improve organisation of Special Assistance The lady that wheeled me to Departures was lovely and helpful

Malaga to Birmingham I booked this flight online one week before flying I needed to book for adults one child and one infant However I found when checking prices it was cheaper make two separate bookings than the whole group at once I booked for two adults then another booking for one adult and two children This is unbelievable Also you arent allowed to check in online until hours before you fly unless you book a seat for euros each Which is a bit impossible as you are in holiday at this point Just another money making scam However we booked for free while in Spain and our hotel were kind enough to print our boarding passes for us The plane was clean but the seating is just too cramped My husband had sit with his knee protruding into the isle and the trolley kept knocking him when going past Food and drinks are too expensive luckily we bought some snacks and refreshments from the departure lounge before leaving Malaga The staff however are really helpful and Im sure they know its not the comfortable of places to sit for hours and do make an effort in making people feel welcome and providing a good service They were quick to help with the needs of my month old The pilot kept us informed of any changes as we were experiencing a lot of turbulence We were also informed as we approached the UK coastline and also times for arrival were given The plus side we didnt have any hold luggage and were able to check in infants pram at the departure gate Meaning we didnt have to wait in the long bag check in queues Overall we paid premium prices for seats on a below average quality plane Thanks to the stewards for their efforts in trying to compensate for this

Clean plane totally indifferent crew but what is absolutely amazing is that on such a long flight the flight attendants did not distribute a single drop of water to passengers except to those will to pay for overpriced items not even the cheapest low cost airlineand this was not a low cost would do better

Es una aeropuerto pequeo pero moderno tiene todo lo accesible que se necesita para un viajero es rpido en lo que es migracin las malestas llegan rpido al recogedor todo limpio hay WiFi gratis conectores por muchas partes muy amable el personal buena seguridad lo Malo son los precios de las tiendas todo esos precios desorbitados pero en lo que respecta al aeropuerto muy bueno anunci de vuelos pantallas todo modern It is a small but modern airport it has everything that is needed for a traveler it is fast in what is migration the baggage arrives quickly to the pickup everything is clean there is free WiFi connectors for many parts very friendly and good security personnel Bad things are the prices of the stores with those exorbitant prices but in regards to the airport very good announcements with modern screens for flights
This is a well designed airport There is no hassle from porters and taxi operators Checking in is very fast and efficient Arrival luggage handling is very good

My wife and I flew with Ethiopian from Toronto to Entebbe Uganda return We also flew Entebbe to Mombasa return within the time we stayed in Africa We found that the airline service was pretty much on time and we didnt miss any connections The meals were consistently good Most aircrafts were in fair to good in cleanliness The flight attendants were very good friendly and attended to all of our needs On our return flight my wife was injured and couldnt walk We made arrangements with the airline in advance and they attended to all of her needs advancing us to the front of every line and helping us with our luggage We were very surprised and well taken care of I found that the service by the attendants to be excellent but I feel that the work loads on the was enormous The attendants tried their best in serving our needs

It was an exceptional experience from start to finish The checkin process was efficient with friendly staff who were more than willing to assist Boarding was wellorganized and the flight departed on time Onboard I was impressed by the cleanliness of the cabin and comfortable seating The flight attendants were professional attentive and ready to help with a warm smile Their hospitality made the journey even more enjoyable

The current airport is small but efficient A new much larger terminal is being build Border and security control was fast and efficient All gates are currently in one large terminal with bus boarding only Staff was acting friendly and speedy Bus brings you to to city in for only Lei

Nimes is one of the most pleasant airports Ive experienced Its quite small is a favourable alternative to Montpellier for those of us whose eventual destination is in the Herault area not least because of its close proximity to the motorway and current absence of major roadworks It is a place to relax and stroll about while waiting to meet incoming friends and carparking is a doddle The flight to and from Liverpool with Ryanair is direct

Arrived early for check in and flew through very quickly as it had not yet offically opened Unlike last year when I was a little late and it took more than minutes while my Passport was checked and rechecked Immigration was quick took about two minutes and the security check was also quick I came through here last year and had to be pushy to get both to Passport Control and then through Security as otherwise qiven the queues I would have missed my flight The airport is quite spacious and there are a few shops I went straight to Turkish Airlines Lounge and stayed there until it was time to board the place This was straightforward This was my third time going through Vnukovo and the experience was similar to that of my first time

This is a small new and very well designed airport There is only one runway so there is never too much traffic The business lounge is excellent clean and there is always food and drink and the service is excellent

I have been to some of the worlds best star SIN ICN HKG HND airports but Sapporos New Chitose tops them all Why So much to do and enjoy Airport History Museum Royce Chocolate World factory openair Observation Deck Movie Theatre Onsen Sky Museum interactive airline stuff for kids and adults Hello Kitty Theatre Hotel amazing number and variety of food court options Aside from these frills New Chitose excels in what really matters to travelers Despite huge crowds SapporoTokyo is one of the worlds busiest routes terminal is spacious and easy to navigate Efficient checkin countersone dedicated to just school groups Spotless restrooms plenty of seats in departure areas Easy to use frequent every minutes JR train connections minutes to Sapporo Station Polite hardworking security teams Short waits on the runway for takeoffs

As you pull into Long Beach Airport the parking structure is conveniently located right across from the terminal Checkin and security screening took less than minutes in the afternoon hours Long Beach has an open natural and airy terminal You will find palm trees small birds and abundance of sunshine on this terminal There are enough seats for you to sit and relax Dining options are very good Free wifi also works well This airport does not use jet bridge so you will enter and exit the aircraft using stairs or ramp Baggage claim area is small but appropriate for an airport with a vintage look

My brother and I and Flew for the first time everyone was very helpful they even put us in the sky lounge which consists of a buffet and drinks They did no extra charge and they helped out through the whole time without necessarily babying us Thank you for the experience

Arrived from Bangkok on Thai flight and still bussed to the terminal in June Queues for visa on arrival handled relatively quickly and luggage handling dealt with promptly and efficiently Friendly staff with a relaxed atmosphere

The terminal is Sovietstyle and a little big for just or flights a day to Moscow and the occasional charter Checkin was slow with initially only one desk open but the service was friendly and efficient when eventually obtained With a blizzard on the tarmac it was unsafe for the bus to drive out to the plane Stumbling across the whipped up snow and ice is not something for the fainthearted The early offer of an onboard drink was appreciated

Small functional airport which is a bit drab for a holiday destination like Langkawi Clean but a bit rusty A decent common hall with shopping and eating before check in after baggage claim but next to nothing to do on the airside Still more pleasant than KLIA or Subang

Flight BA Durban to Cape Town was a disaster plane had technical issues and we were not able to use that plane I was informed visa a phone call from BA while on the way to the airport that there would be no Business Class on the new chartered flight Im not a snob but it was a surprise gift for my year old mother Long story short we flew on Global Air a chartered plane from JNB It was late and cramped but comfortable enough and staff very attentive We were offered ZAR flight voucher as compensation for no Business class The difference between the two classes was ZAR each per ticket Upon return I emailed Comair and was very expertly helped by David who did some bartering regarding refunds At the end of the day I was given a ZAR KululaComair voucher to be used for year as compensation Well done on customer service and well handled by all involved

Colombo International airport is a joke Never had such a horrific experience as a tourist on an international flight This airport is notorious for ripping you off and charging unconventional baggage fees for carrying a personal item such as a purse or even food They weighed our food and charged me over for my purse and food They even wanted to wear my jacket that I was wearing I do not recommend this airport and they are notorious for treating tourist like this as I was advised when I landed in the Maldives Sri Lanka in general is a phenomenal country with amazing people

Small airport with helpful staff In the arrivals hall there is nothing special On departure you can enjoy your time on the st floor snacks bar with some good choices The view to the apron is good from the departure hall The only negative side is that the air conditioning system is not good at all

JAL economy class is outstanding The seats are the widest in the business if a bit hard and the food was healthy and tasty Flight attendants were polite and attentive My only complaint is that the offerings on the inflight entertainment service were subpar it was hard to find a movie that rose above mediocre

Recently opened airport because the former airport in Matshapa is now being used as something else The new location is quite inconvenient because it takes more than an hour from Mbabane city centre and I would strongly recommend that you use the road from Johannesburg to Mbabane because it takes only four hours from SA Cost wise it is also efficient to use the road

I have to say this is the best airport I have ever used so straight forward and friendly helpful staff all the way Plenty of shops to have a stroll around and fantastic food Only an hour away from home with great parking I am sure this is my airport of choice from now on Absolutely love it great start to our holiday Thank you Doncaster Sheffield airport

RGN to Mandalay Airfare considerably less than other airline Flight was on a new airbus Checkin while chaotic went well Lots of airport staff Everything was done manually with paper and counters Cabin crew well dressed and pleasant Flight was comfortable and on time
Good airport nice shops and the seating is comfortable great restaurants very respectful staff and flights always on time

Egilsstadir to Reykjavk Check in was a breeze Waiting area very clean Boarding was very easy just showing ticket and photo ID It was a minute flight They served tea or coffee with a chocolate I really enjoyed the flight as I did not want to travel by road again I will fly them again

CPTGBE GBEJNB First flight a clean Bae in very good condition half empty with loads of leg room Food excellent for an airline and service find Second flight on an equally clean ATR with equally good snacks All flights on time Much prefer them to SAX or Airlink

Used T this time for both departure and arrival I fancy this strange facility with flavor of s after its recent refurbishment Overall clean and well looked after with all lifts and escalators and travelators working with meaningful food options bearable security queues and convenient transportation access via bus and monorail it does the job and does not irritate Well done

For an African bush airline I have to hand it to Mack Air for having its act together I arrived in Maun Botswana from Cape Town and after clearing immigration walked to the Mack Air desk where I saw my name posted The staff promptly and courteously took me in tow gave me my boarding pass and took care of my luggage Shortly thereafter the staff escorted me to my plane which was a very presentable Cessna Grand Caravan The pilot and a few other passengers arrived and soon we were off to the air strip and safari lodge The procedure was very much the same following the stay at the lodge when I flew on to Kasane Botswana The plane was spotless the crew very good and safety briefings were properly handled And at Kasane Mack Airs folks were on hand to see that I connected with my onward ground handler As a pilot and as a former airline employee I can honestly give Mack Air a fine rating It is a good bush airline with all the trappings of larger carriers I would fly with them anytime

Flew internal flights in Burma with this local airline Surprisingly new plane pretty much on time and with very pleasant crews Also served a good snack gave out towels although flights were only about minutes Was a bit reticent about using them but very pleasantly surprised

Convenient location only mins from the Mosque Excellent modern facilities Nice simple elegant layout with steelwork reflecting date palm trees Convenient location of cafetarias toilets and prayer rooms Friendly staff and security personnel Clean and tidy Ample seating facilities

I would like to sincerely thank flight Stewardess Irdina from royal brunei BI dubai to london for her excellent hospitality She was very attentive cheerful friendly helpful and professional Other crew members also giving excellent service to the passengers Thank you for making our flight more enjoyable meaningful and memorable Looking forward to fly RB again soon

AirAsia keeps getting better its hard to believe they are a budget airline The ground crew was efficient and accommodating the cabin crew was attentive and friendly and the seats were clean and comfy We chose the Thai vegetarian Penang Curry that was yummy Big tip for this flight Tokyo to Bangkok book a window seat on the right side of the aircraft if you want to get an incredible aerial view of Mount Fuji

Flew out of Maputo up the coast to Inhambane Found it to be clean well organised free of queues and with fairly friendly staff We used the domestic terminal which was largely devoid of facilities apart from a couple of shops but also virtually devoid of passengers A surprisingly pleasurable experience

Bornholm to Copenhagen The flight on halfanhour was smooth and on time Very relaxed boarding and in the air you are offered coffeetea and a piece of chocolate by smiling crew Seats OK aircraft clean and announcements informal Danish as also often experienced on ofter Scandinavian carriers DAT now serve several routes inside Denmark and have always been ontime Tickets on this route however somewhat expensive compared to earlier days

Good checkin and boarding excellent lounge but a disappointing experience with an unfriendly and ignorant worker at the security check There were only a few passengers at the airport no queue at the checkin counter The lounge was impeccable with a friendly staff a very good choice of snacks drinks and reading material The only negative moment was in the priority security line despite that there were no passengers in the line right after am The worker who checked my passport and boarding pass sternly told me that next time she would not allow me to use the priority security line if I dont present my Silver Finnair Plus card The Priority Security note was boldly printed in a big font on my boarding pass which she was holding in her hand so Im afraid to think she could not read English RIX in general is a good airport but the management has to teach priority security line workers to read and understand at least two words in English Priority Security

I flew fom Bergerac airport to Stansted today When i had cleared baggage body and passport check I went to the lounge to realise to my horror that I hadnt got my belt from the body check I spent minutes contemplating how I was shortly destined to be walking round London with my trousers falling down because I didnt have my belt on As we were summoned to the gate I was overjoyed to hear an announcement from Bergerac Airport or Ryanair saying that my belt had been found I am so happy I feel moved to thank and complement whichever staff or system meant that I was reunited with my belt Well done

Rex Airlines is a standout in terms of professionalism and helpfulness Their call centres are here in Australia staffed by knowledgeable and problem solving women sorry men I have just dealt with amazing women Rex is our airline of choice when it flies where we need to go It is hands down better than the other airlines based in Australia and is a reminder that an airline can work well and treat customers with personal and professional service
Loved this airport was friendly decor like someone said is s hawaiian Very comfy armchairs only thing missing was a bar Car hire easy to find and Hilo just down the road

Departure is very tedious Our flight got delayed not due to the airports fault but it took hours for them to get our luggage back Most of the luggage returned were wet and damaged Arrival however is very quick and easy

The airport is wellorganized secure and clean with nearly all services available The crew at Air Mauritius is extremely professional and they go above and above to execute their jobs in a courteous and professional manner Nishi the travel consultantpassenger service is amazing in terms of customer service and taking care of passengers with a smile and enthusiasm

arrivals and one departure Arrival is one part and departure is the other Super efficient clean and pleasant Taxis out front Departure area maybe could use more seating Interesting there was a ping pong table there and it was quite popular It has a relaxing feel about it Probably one of the nicest airports anywhere Arrival has a store where you can buy a bus card and load it for say or days travel

This is my preferred airport in SoCal for arriving atdeparting from which I do on a regular basis Big enough to offer connections anywhere in the US for flights to Europe yet small enough offer a quick friendly and efficient service tofrom your gate Drop off facilities outside the terminals needs to be improved but apart from that no real complaints

Pyongyang to Beijing with Air Koryo The departure and arrival were punctual staff smiling and friendly the aircraft including toilets was clean and there were magazines and newspapers at the entrance The food was a chicken burger but the drink selection was rather limited either water or one type of soft drink It is maybe not the most luxurious airline but the service for a shorthaul flight is better than European or American airlines I have used for the same distance

OV th March and OV th March AmsterdamTallinn Decent legroom nice inflight magazine and even boarding with a proper jetway at Tallinn for the return flight Good inflight service featuring a solid drinks menu with Estonias superb A LeCoq lager and Viru Valge vodka not a bad little airline at all I had flown them before in on a CopenhagenTallinn round trip with similar results
Fantastic airport I go in and out at least once a month Yesterday I timed my arrival and from walking off the plane to being outside at a taxi was seconds minute check in for departures

GSO is a very convenient and nice airport Parking is super convenient right next to the terminal which makes it nice when picking up people It is a nice and clean airport that I try and fly out of whenever I can I only wish that I could get more direct flights out of there

My Husband and I traveled on American Airlines Flight AA to New York from Florida We were extremely pleased traveling home on this plane This was mainly due to Flight Attendant DeJon DeJon made sure we were comfortable asked us what drinks we wanted and served us snacks and a very nice lunch Mostly he was so congenial and I could see he was working so hard taking care of the passengers My Husband and I are seniors and I can honestly say that we very much appreciated DeJon It made our flight enjoyable and we were glad we flew with American Airlines

Boarding an A was a unique experience and you will enjoy a pleasant flight thanks to the spaciousness and comfort The cabin crew were admirable and friendly the food was good and delicious Highly recommended

I am beyond happy with the assistance I received from this airline and staff I had back pain and an injury before my flight and walking at the airport was very difficult for me They immediately provided me with a wheelchair and a wonderful staff member who took care of me all the way until I boarded the plane The ground staff the crew and the entire experience were absolutely perfect I cant believe how kind helpful and professional everyone was I feel truly blessed Thank you so much

My family flew to Daegu from Gimpo From checkin to boarding service rendered by all staff were efficient and excellent Cabin was clean and seats were usual economy class comfy On our return flight from Daegu to Gimpo we were late due to traffic and could not checkin thru self serve kiosk We had barely mins prior to flight departure Approached counter staff for assistance First thing the staff did was radioed the Captain while processing the checking in and printing of boarding passes An agent came over to escort and assisted us throughout the procedure to ensure we boarded the plane without further delay All these were completed within mins and flight departed on time Our biggest compliment is towards the Captain for both flights Journey was smooth and landing was perfect which you dont even feel the plane has landed Flew with many major top airlines in the world but never had this landing experience ever before Cabin Crew rating great and comparable to top airlines Keep it up and will definitely choose and fly Air Busan on all my destinations where served by Air Busan

Rio de Janiero to Curitiba via Sao Paulo Really good experience really smooth inflight entertainment and free food and drink the cabin crew were really friendly This really beats European customer service the leg room is still the same but just the service outweighs it for me

Townsville is a delightful little airport They even use air bridges which was a surprise It is a little crowded as the area for departures arrivals is quite narrow but really very minor issue You exit down an escalator to retrieve your luggage which was pretty fast There is a cafe there and behind are very clean washrooms A positive experience no fuss whatsoever Departing this charming airport the security staff were the friendliest I have come across Lots of glass and places to sit in the departure area and all with a minimum of fuss Well done Townsville Airport I loved it Plus there was almost no traffic outside at all

Hong Kong to Kahsioung A quite nice flight It was my first time flying an Embraer jet I know it is small but the seat is comfortable and wide A delicious hot meal was served in a mins flight The crew is friendly and fluent in English The only bad thing is that the flight was delayed for hours

I work on a consumer programme for ITV and would be interested in hearing from anyone who was on the Phuket Air flight which had a reported fuel leak during a routine stop at Sharjah on Sunday rd April We would be interested in hearing your story Please send your contact details using the Comment Form at the bottom of this page and Skytrax will put you in touch with Sarah
The aircraft was on time from Manchester and on the return journey from Lourdes Bartres the aircraft left early The staff were a bit distant the food good overall OK

A small airport right in the east of the city center with a convenient metro connection readily available The terminal itself is small but well organized and has enough small shops for food and beverages Security queuing times late in the evening were nonexistent border control only inbound was equally fast Best airport if youve to be in London itself

Granada Airport is located about km west of Granada Single runway small terminal Regular buses run into the city If you arrive late no worries as it is only a short taxi ride In recent years the number of flights have increased Mainly to Madrid and Barcelona but with also Liverpool Stansted Melilla The usual facilities for a small airport so dont expect too much

New airport opened around and much better than the old airport at the military airbase Plenty of checkin counters and smooth handling in security check First class lounge good As most Chinese airports it is noisy from continuous announcements

Was on flight with Vietnam Airlines from Hanoi to OsakaKansai on its business class Nothing to complain as ground staff cabin crew were professional and offered the best that they could Seat was comfortable I chose the Japanese breakfast and found that it was somehow delicious Inflight entertainment surprisingly was excellent with new movies and music album No WiFI onboard even in business class which may be something the airline should consider to improve

Ljubljana Airport has undergone a major update over the last few years and has increased in size quite substantially Line of sight signage is good making navigation around the airport very easy Arriving from a Schengen country results in a very fast entry procedure to the country Departing was also a breeze with very friendly and efficient staff we were checked in through security customs and in the lounge in very short time Waiting areas are comfortable and duty free shopping and other outlets well staffed and spotlessly clean

Excellent airport clean spacious excellent traveler services quick luggage check and very friendly staff easyaccess panoramic terrace with degree view of departures and arrivals restaurants and shops with normal prices are positioning several lowcost airlines and it is the base of AirAsia Japan I hope it will increase international connections and always maintain this trend having for several years won the best regional airport in the world

Cartagena to Cali Paid the ticket pesos equivalent to mBP or EUR We left on time we arrived before the scheduled time Some people judge an airline when they spend peanuts for it I find Vivacolombia exceptional for what you pay

You know its a shame that this beautiful airport cannot supply enough helpful staff to assist with directing you to the right place in order to make your connecting flight If only there were those who could advise you what you need to do when you DO have a boarding pass in your possession and that you must take a bus to another part of the terminal to board your connecting flight The whole experience almost tainted the start and end to a brilliant holiday

Clean and efficient I was very impressed with Elmas airport Staff are friendly and the airport is very well connected to the city centre by bus The fare is only Only one negative point once youre past the international departures hall there are no shops only one small cafe near gate otherwise this is one of the best regional airports I have visited so far

Small airport dating back to the early days of aviation when the thinking was that would be aerodromes in most towns Today BUR is convenient airport for those wishing to avoid LAX You pick up your bags from the baggage conveyor belt outside the terminal

Almaty to Karaganda Purchasing a ticket days before the flight from Almaty to Karaganda was super fast and cheap Airplane looks new and clean Service exceeded my expectations Cabin seat was quite comfortable Menu of snacks teacoffee and other bevarages is affordable One unusual thing is while checking in they sort flyers based on their seat numbers to make it easier to board a plane
Thai smile offers convenient service through their app and self service at Suvarnabhumi Airport with staff support The time of flight is in time Staff gave service with hospitality

Small airport and gateway to the Antarctica Ushuaia is a tourist destination and claimed by Argentina to be the southernmost city in the world Check in is straightforward on street level You go up a flight of stairs for security check and to your gate Ample sitting space There were a couple of small shops selling souvenirs Jetways to aircraft On the main floor there is a large duty free shop selling the usual international brands of chocolates perfumes and liquor Also a cafe for food and drinks Arrival is straight forward Luggage arrived quickly in baggage claim and put through a casual security check Taxi dispatcher at exit arranges for passengers to get into vehicles for their respective hotels English widely understood by airport workers They are also very helpful The town is very close by visible from the entrance to the airport aned reached in minutes The airport caters to the huge tourist flow there Views from the airplane while landing and taking off are dramatic with scenes of the Tierra del Fuego archipelago spread out Window seat is a must Nearly all the flights to Buenos Aires from Ushuaia are to the capital citys domestic airport which is far away from the airport that caters to international flights to the US and Europe

CHA has the misfortune of being too close to Atlanta Over half of Chattanooga flyers drive to Atlanta or Nashville or Birmingham to fly However CHA offers competitive fares and I would guess most flights now are regional jet The airport itself is beautiful with a large copper dome as the facilitys trademark in honor of the citys railroad heritage CHA is a modern stateoftheart airport and is where I choose to fly out of even though I live in the northern Atlanta burbs

What a pleasure We arrived into Murcia on the nd June and greeted by cheery ground staff straight to passport control a little queue at passport control nice and polite customs officers Went to baggage belt and there were a few others in front of us but mins at the most wait for our baggage Through the exit and outside in under half an hour how amazing was that The return journey went just as smoothly I was blown away by this efficient friendly and calm airport staff are amazing

The airport is very new and modern I have flown through this airport multiple times but this is the first time at the new terminal It is a lot larger than the original terminal There was finally free WiFi and it was pretty fast considering the internet in China It was mainly based off of Shanghai Pudong the airport I was actually flying to and had the identical announcement system that PVG terminal had Although there were a few foreigners including me it felt very open and very welcoming
