Surprisingly good experience Cabin staff were unbelievably attentive and helpful Food and beverages were excellent for airline food Boarding and deboarding were well organized Only downside was business configuration was and flat bed was not as comfortable as on other airlines

Chisinau airport is the only international airport of Moldova and sometimes seems to be out of proportion with the growing traffic But anyway despite its small size after the latest restructuration it became a very efficient and easy to fly from The ground staff are very productive and manages the traffic with a great dexterity The number of shops and food choices remains low but its not really an airport of transit The main flaw of Chisinau airport is access to and from the airport without real shuttle service provided There is a minibus marshrutka route to the railway station but it doesnt service all night long and you often need to require a taxi very cheap Airport is very clean and staff is very professional

I cant express enough how grateful I am for the exceptional help I received from Hilary the gate check agent at Spirit Airlines I was in a complete panic after losing my cell phone at the airport With no way to contact my family and let them know when Id be arriving I was extremely stressed and worried that theyd be concerned about me Hillary noticed my distress and went above and beyond by offering to let me use her personal phone to send a quick text to my family Her kindness thoughtfulness and willingness to help me in a moment of crisis made all the difference Thanks to her I was able to let my family know when to pick me up and I could finally breathe a sigh of relief Never did find my phone but there was a silver lining Hillary truly saved the day for me and I cant thank her enough for her generosity Spirit Airlines is lucky to have such a compassionate and dedicated employee Thank you Hillary for turning a stressful situation into a manageable one You have no idea how much your help meant to me

Great Airport We travelled from Manchester and from landing to leaving the airport it only took us minutes For the return flight we checked our bags in minutes and took just another to get through security etc The departure lounge is bright and welcoming and boarding just took a few minutes Good experience I wish more airports were like this

A nicely laidout airy and spacious airport with excellent facilities and courteous staff a proper Estonian showpiece With TLL only km from the city centre taxi fares are very reasonable Security was efficient and from a UK perspective refreshingly unofficious

Excellent service I flew on a hr m flight and the crew were excellent from boarding to disembarking The crew offered a complimentary snack onboard the seats are comfortable and the flight was smooth There were no delays or inconveniences during the flight The seats recline and although they are a bit old they are still leather and big so its very comfortable The crew helped me find my seat and they had a great attitude when I ordered a glass of water twice I will fly with them again recommended

Auckland to Shanghai via Chengdu The food was very good from a Chinese perspective The service was impressive The crew members were nice and passionate Also for transit in Chengdu the passenger is able to claim yuan voucher free hour baggage storage free transit commendation in Chengdu Based on this price you cannot ask more Thank you Sichuan Airlines for the wonderful memory

Very satisfactory flights Adequate leg room with blocked off seats Rapid checkin and security Good three course hot meals both ways Swiss had subcontracted to Baltic outbound and Helvetic for the return with little noticeable change in service

Very small airport but there still are jet bridges which was surprising Everyone I met was so friendly and welcoming The bags were out very quickly Just remember to arrange the transport before arrival

Flew in and out and had no problems despite the fact the airport is partly under reconstruction On arrival our plane parked close to the terminal and bags soon arrived on the single very small belt Car Hire has moved across the road and is a short walk away Plenty of buses and taxis were there to meet passengers Departure checkin was quick the lounge has enough seats for flights and there are adequate cafes and shops to keep most people content This is a small rural airport which works well and gives a flying experience like it used to be in the old days

This is a small yet spacious airport with two terminal piers jutting out in a Y shape There were ample seating space plug points to charge your phones and also an enclosed section with desks and chairs to do any work on your computer Large glass windows afforded views of the runways and let sunlight stream in Bathrooms clean TSA security was thorough Check in counters are opened a couple of hours before a flight and I found the staff friendly Car rental booths are in the baggage conveyor belt section and long term parking is just outside the terminal as are the parking lots for rental cars minimal walking required Very easy and fast entry and exit intoout of terminal Driving directions to airport were clearly marked Only a couple of shopsstores for food and drinks A selection of Wisconsin beer was available in the restaurant but not my favorite Leinenkugel Overall a very pleasant airport

VeronaTimisoaraChisinau The flight from Verona departed almost hours late resulting in hours late arrival at the final destination The company didnt provide sufficient information as to the causes of delay Voucher provided for food and drinks doesnt get you much in Verona airport I should commend them for holding the flight TimisoaraChisinau on the tarmac until a number of connecting passengers flying from all over Italy made it to Timisoara Onboard the service was good Offered hot meal alcoholic drinks and good attitude from flight attendants despite the stress and extended working hours caused by the delay Service on the TimisoaraChisinau leg also good Overall three stars Two stars for handling the delay and stars for service attitude and the fact that they did get us to the final destination on the same day despite a long delay

Airport conditions are fairly reasonable given the recent difficulties Do try to have your visa in good order before arriving Visa on arrival is only possible if it has been arranged in advance and takes some time to issue at the airport Apart from that the arrivals process is OK Just follow everyone else Departing is also not too bad However as has been pointed out the signs are all in Arabic so it can be difficult to know where to go Check in is a little chaotic Finding the departure lounge may not be that easy Staff are actually quite helpful and polite There are a few shops and a basic business lounge Wireless internet is available and works quite well

Staff were very helpful Both of the officers help me get my phone which I lost in the airport They managed to contact me to retrieve back my phone although I am already departed to my destination Thank you so much

Airport is easy to reach by metro train and taxi Check in area and departure area have been perfectly clean In the check in area only few shops and restaurant available departure area have more choice but I did not use them as I used the lounge Check in went fast and efficient same for security check Staff was professional

Stavanger is a comfortable and bright regional airport Arrival is hasslefree with short walking distances and quick luggage delivery Departure is easy too with selfservice checkin machines Although I flew on a busy Sunday afternoon waiting time to clear security control did not exceed mins However the departure lounge clearly lacks seating areas An airport bus connects the airport with the city centre every mins note that it only accepts cash and no credit cards

A small airport serving the Transylvania town of Sibiu Its a walk boarding only one constructed new in an off the shelf design barebone Operation is fast and efficient staff is a bit reserved but friendly and professional Romania is now a Schengen country so no more border control to most EU flights Airside theres one food and beverages shop and one dutyfree Both are nothing to rave about There are taxis to the city and a modern bus which is cheaper

Rode Intersky from SalzburgZurich As it was a short flight I wasnt expecting much I expected wrong Usually airlines with a fleet this small or flights this short wouldnt have as a excellent service as this airline Outstanding selection of drinks and more than two selections of free snacks The flight attendants were kind and the takeoff and landing were smooth as if the plane were a jet and not a prop Would definitely fly them again

I have been through Abidjan a few times and whilst I was impressed on my first visit progressive improvements since then mean that it is definitely the best airport I have been to in Africa There is now decent and free wifi in the departures area a comfortable new cafe and the information boards are clear

Tehran to Cologne with Iran Air A wonderful airline with good service The flight took hours and we had meals breakfast with breads and a lot of other things and lunch was chicken with saffron rice and a small salad yogurt and a cake Drinks were also for free My seat had enough space and it was comfortable A small delay of minutes but that was because some passengers were late

The Algiers airport terminal was not so good because they dont have many shops or restaurants the toilet was not clean and design of the building was not good But the new Algiers airport terminal was so big with a modern design and the second name of this terminal is the door of Africa that means it connects Africa with the world terminal has so many shops or restaurants and it was comfortable in the vip lounge

After a week away we returned to Atlanta and couldnt find our vehicle Somehow the parking space location was deleted in my phone Nokuthuba Bray found us wandering around trying to find it It took about an hour but she went above and beyond to find it We are grateful for her great effort

Pleasant surprise Planes were new and clean Staff was attentive and efficient Flights were on time We prebooked meals which were quite nice We booked during holiday season so tickets were on the more expensive side but all in all good value Would fly with them again

We boarded on time but we had hour delay due to traffic at ATH get too hot so crew open doors again and served water Plane was nice and clean Crew were very friendly We landed with half an hour delay Nice inflight service for hm flight

This was my first time on EVA Air and I must say that it was a highly impressive experience Yes it was pricey flying premium economy but at this will be the only way to fly when traveling to Asia from here on out unless traveling business I found the premium economy cabin to be more than satisfactory The seats of course were not lie flat but they still had enough pitch to be comfortable And the one thing that stood out were the cushions in seating There was enough padding that I wasnt even remotely uncomfortable throughout the entire flight I arrived in Taipei from LAX comfortable and refreshed The service was good and the food though not Michelinrated was still perfectly fine I would fly them again While some may say its not different enough from coach to make it worth the money when youre it makes a big difference Ive flown economy to Asia and never again

I have used the comfortable Cr Colombo Airport in Genoa at least times in the last years Small comfortable no crowd no queue security check is not the standard paranoia of the EU just lazy smiles Friendly staff excellent shop excellent coffee shop fantastic quality of espresso good grappa and beer reasonably priced And not to forget it is comfortable to rent a car and drive anywhere in the Ligurian Coast easy car return the Airport is before Genova on the road One of my favorite airports

Airport on Arrival no problem We hired a car and having found the car hire desk we were directed to the car pick up point which turned out to be a considerable distance away No shuttle service You just have to leg it If it had been raining we would have been soaked Cant imagine what it must be like for people in wheelchairs or families with pushchairs plus luggage Car hire needs to be closer to the terminal or shuttle service provided Departure was not good We had to leave our bags to be scanned go to the other side for Security check which meant leaving our bags and personal belongings unattended When called for our flight we were herded into a holding pen not enough seats stood for minutes while members of staff called out peoples names to re check their flight details this was done in a very unfriendly and unapologetic manner Took the shine off what had otherwise been a very pleasant trip to this beautiful island

Probably the best island airport in the Indian Ocean Well designed structure the only challenge is the long queue in the immigration hall The authorities need to arrange extra officers during peak timings

The Plaza Business Lounge at Brisbane Airport was comfortable enough with a range of food and drinks but no tonic for a GT There were very few toilets in the lounge though On board the A the seat was comfortable and the service was friendly and responsive My vegetarian meals were good but breakfast was served far too early interrupting sleep The plane for the connecting service to Sapporo was an unreconstructed A with oldstyle business class seating but comfortable enough for a hour flight The service and vegetarian food out of Taipei were both excellent Overall China Airlines is a good way to travel between Australia and Japan at a reasonable price

The airport is clean nicely compact and easy to navigate once on the property It has clearly been renovated in the relatively recent past and that is seen in how spacious the security area now is and how modern the architecture now is Checkin was quite easy and hasslefree Security is quite timeconsuming tedious trudge if you dont have TSA PreCheck but if you do have PreCheck youre pretty much golden There are several pretty nice stores and restaurants postsecurity nothing fancy nothing even particularly Texan but satisfactory However I cant bring myself to particularly like this airport Unless the much nastierinalmosteveryway Bush airport across town which has friendly personnel the people that work at Hobby seem to have taken on a mission to be snarky and powertrippy toward passengers From shuttle bus drivers to ticketing agents from TSA personnel to store clerks and from restaurant employees to gate agents hardly anybody at Hobby seems to appreciate the fact that they actually work at a fairly beautiful modern airport If Bush employees can have a positive attitude so too should Hobby employees but maybe thats asking for too much Furthermore this airport does have some of the worst signage Ive ever seen at least approaching the airport and within the terminal presecurity the quality of the signage is great but the directions can be confusing Also the economy parking lot fills up easily and often forcing unfortunate drivers to park in the parking garage adjacent to the terminal which costs something like USD daily All in all this airport has a lot of the aesthetic measures on point but the management there seem to fail to remember that airports always serve as introductions to cities and regions Are snarky and powertrippy personnel who they really want to represent Houston and Texas I really want to like this airport but I just cant What a shame
Tu Moscow St Petersburg Creature comforts not up to modern aircraft standards but superb real experience Food quite good and service good Do it before the Tus become a thing of the past

Because LH flights from FDHCGN are now to FRA only and at inconvenient times followed by connections to CGN by train I elected to fly InterSky instead Very clean aircraft and professional service throughout But for an Economy one way ticket price of they could surely provide at least a free cup of coffee Poor value everything else fine

Yangon to Mandalay Really good flight the seating was and actual seat numbers given on boarding pass plenty of space even at inflight catering offered light snack and good coffee Nothing to worry about despite ATR aircraft type and would definitely fly again

Gatwick to Monastir return We took off on time both ways the aircraft are dated but seat was comfortable Food going was fine but only a stale sandwich coming back Crew pleasant The toilets are a lot to be desired and we made sure that we used the airport facilities before boarding on the return flight

I fly in and out of here regularly and am very impressed For a small airport TSA is efficient and does not do a lot of unnecessary screening just to have something to do as at other small airports The gate crews work very hard to get you out ontime and luggage retrieval is easy Rental car offices are next to baggage claim and other than Budget are extremely helpful There is a coffee shop upstairs as well as a barrestaurant everyone is friendly here and pricing is reasonable Two minutes from I The place seems pleasantly ignorant of airport hassles that have descended upon much of the industry
Great Airport used it for a Ryanair flight to Stansted Small highly efficient great bar restaurant and shops A breeze to get through am going to use again Wish they were all like this

Im a Connecticut resident and use Bradley a halfdozen times a year Terminal A is perfectly serviceable nothing fancy but it does the trick Luckily most carriers use it Terminal B which I understand will be closed at the end of cannot be demolished fast enough It is an eyesore with next to no services I guess its only advantage is for people who wonder what air travel used to be like in the s and s They can see firsthand in Terminal B I wish BDL had service to longer haul hubs like DEN and SLC but I guess there isnt enough demand Nonetheless Im perfectly happy using the airport Its smaller size means fewer delays quicker deplaning and some breathing room

I fly into and out of Albany a few times a year on business For my money its one of the most efficient airports in terms of securityTSA in the country They get you in out and on your way with very little hassle the way it should be The airport itself isnt huge and doesnt have some of the amenities of a larger hub but as a traveller Im looking for efficiency and thats what Albany Airport provides

I usually travel to Tenerife South and North airports several times a month The most important thing for me is the fastest way thru security and food services On both airports usually time waited for security screening is less than min average time min staff polite and very helpful The food and services offered in Tenerife South is much better than the older airport in the north of the island I have used both airports VIP lounge They are nice have lots of food and drink and usually are ok Sometimes during peak season can be a bit crowded or even full

Clean plane totally indifferent crew but what is absolutely amazing is that on such a long flight the flight attendants did not distribute a single drop of water to passengers except to those will to pay for overpriced items not even the cheapest low cost airlineand this was not a low cost would do better

The Algiers airport terminal was not so good because they dont have many shops or restaurants the toilet was not clean and design of the building was not good But the new Algiers airport terminal was so big with a modern design and the second name of this terminal is the door of Africa that means it connects Africa with the world terminal has so many shops or restaurants and it was comfortable in the vip lounge

Travelled with my brother and mother The travel operator booked the flights I never heard or know this airline before The route flown was domestic from Tehran Mehrabad to Shiraz We were dropped at the wrong terminal Apparently Kish Air operates from Terminal We were dropped to Terminal Ground staff at airport were polite As we brought a wheelchair the ground staff required the wheelchair to be shrinkwrapped Airport wheelchair requested without much fuss Flight was a little delayed minutes Airport ground staff were fantastic during the boarding process My mother used a disabled friendly vehicle Aircraft was an old MD Chicken pickle sandwich and peanuts served during flight with orange juice box Cabin crew very friendly The toilet was foul The water did not work in the tap or closet Upon arrival in Shiraz once again excellent airport ground serviceKish Air flight crew and captain also friendly and welcoming

Not a shining example of modern airport technology but it works Arrival was quite easy since by the time our visas had been processed the queues had gone Departure very easy with short queues The only downside would be the fact that smoking seems to be allowed everywhere and ashtrays are not in use Hence the cafe is rather uncomfortable Everyone was very friendly and helpful

nd largest airport in Philippines has terminals T is for international flights Checkin Level has main banks of Checkin counters AD at the back is the Departures area firstly Passport Control with manned counters and then Security Scanning both of which were quickly achieved Main Departures has the usual array of shops and duty free shops and cafes Some views of the gates and airfield There is lounge which covers most of the carriers premium customers its tired but has a reasonable selection of food on offer and seats with view of the apron Airport busy but did not feel overcrowded

I flew on TWay from Seoul Incheon to Singapore I was a bit surprised to find a usb charging port on my seat for a low cost carrier and free of charge some more The tray table included a personal electronic device holder which allowed me to use as a stand for my phone Seat was very comfortable on A in a seating configuration with leather padding for a low cost carrier Flight landed early in Singapore didnt feel so much turbulence also not very strong turbulence so quite a smooth flight

The cabin crew on my recent Malaysia Airlines flight were exceptional During boarding the lead crew in red colour is standing at the gate to warmly welcome all passengers with a great smile the crew demonstrated a level of hospitality that exceeded my expectations The lead crew manager in particular stood out helping the team with economy class drink service even after finishing their duties in business class This showed impressive leadership and teamwork During the meal service the crew team carefully put ice in the cup They remember my request As the economy class toilet is full of passengers the lead crew member guides me to use the business class toilet The announcement is very clear with a warm feeling of hospitality in dual languages I ordered a special nonvegetarian meal on my flight and I was thoroughly impressed The chicken dish with Malaysian sauce was delicious I would rate the meal quality as starsThe boarding process is smooth and well organized The webcheck in is easy to use My flight is from Bangkok to Singapore via Kuala Lumpur I can get two digital boarding passes from digital checkin without any system issues The autocheckin feature is available too This aircraft does not have IFE as it is a hours mins short haul flight However all passengers can connect to MH studio by their own devices There are many entertainment selections from movies TVs The only reason I dont rate five star is to compare with Singapore Airlines Emirates and those global premium carriers that provide IFE for all flights However it is value for money for the level of entertainment I received I would not hesitate to fly with Malaysia Airlines again and would highly recommend the airline to others

Dhaka to Coxs Baza Booked a discounted ticket more than a month ago Didnt expect too much Just on time departure arrival Thats what I got Boarding luggage handling was smooth Cabin crew wasnt exactly cordial but professional enough It was a min ride but the captain was able to make it bumpy despite clear weather Cheese sandwich cake was good enough for a shorts haul flight like this but as expected no IFE Aircraft was manufactured in so common for local Bangladeshi carriers But the seats were good pitch even for a Dutch national who flew alongside me was well over Hope for a similar experience with Regent next time

In the last years Lusaka International Airport has been going through a re development programme which has seen an upgrade in its infrastructure The old style check in counters have been replaced and updated The airport has received new ground handling equipment escalators and lifts Having been invited on a press tour of the facility i got to see first hand what is happening The airport is very clean cleaner than some more developed airports I have seen in my travels

Domestic Terminal is older than the International Terminal and was clearly the airport in the past Only few in and out on domestic flights The planes are parked on the apron and usually passengers walk to and from Arrivals is through the single gate to the Baggage Spur not a circular belt so things can pile up if there is a lot of luggage There are toilets before the Arrivals Hall The whole terminal is a single story with Arrivals at one end and Departures at the other end There are no facilities in the Departure Lounge after Security Within the terminal there are a couple of shops selling snacks and souvenirs and a Money Changing booth The whole experience is pretty good not many flights and a generally relaxed friendly attitude You would not believe you were in the Capital City
Windhoek airport is small but clean and really well organized The only restaurant at the check in area is situated at the Arrival area food is fresh and delicious Facilities are quite good

I would just like to convey my sincere thanks to Shaye Qantas Broome I flew from Perth to Broome on the th June QF my luggage flew from Perth to Karratha due to an airport error in Perth The Qantas staff were very understaffed my luggage ended up on the wrong flight When I got to Broome I realised the mistake contacted Shaye whilst she herself was understaffed extremely busy she found time to organise to have my luggage located sent back to Perth then flown to Broome by am next morning If all airline staff were as conscientious genuinely caring as Shaye then the airline industry would have much greater respect from its customers

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

I cant remember when the last time I was here but nevertheless it was a pleasant surprise to use the airport again Many places to have food and the atmosphere was pleasant Just one thing that I disliked was the toilet in the common area It was really smelly and should be dealt with immediately

Montgomery Regional Airport Dannelly Field has been completely modernized and is one of the most attractive small airports in the US Checkin in close to the curb and security is efficient Food and drink groundside and airside is basic Deplaning is easy and baggage claim is close to the street Parking is reasonably convenient unless you are travelling mid week It can be a longish walk to the terminal

Excellent security Left my laptops by mistake at security and went to my plane I noticed once in the plane While I couldnt deboard the staff and pilot called security and they were found and brought to lost and found A friend picked them up days later

Travelled again with SunExpresss for a short break to AYT I dont understand the negative reviews as they are totally at odds with every experience I have had with this airline The cabin crew both out and back were fantastic Very friendly polite well groomed and nothing was too much trouble I would not hesitate to travel with them again

The airport has a nice design but it is not well maintained and you always feel its aging fast The waiting time to reach immigration might take more than an hour in summer while bags might take on average minutes in nonpeak times Duty free is good and the RJ lounge is very good with plenty of options Toilet and hygiene facilities dont have consistent standard

If you like large airports with lots of shops restaurants and people then Sanford is not the sort of airport you would appreciate However if you prefer a small regional type airport that you can pass through quickly both in and out without stress then I strongly recommend Sanford We now look at TUI flight options first simply because they use this airport The staff are friendly including immigration and security and yet its only about miles north of Orlando and roughly a minute drive to the Disney resorts We havent been here since but I can confirm from the time we started queuing for immigration to collecting baggage was only minutes Compare this to Orlando International where you would probably be held in a holding area due to congestion
Seattle to Dallas Great flight and spacious cabin Had a connection from Vancouver Staff went above and beyond First class meal was very delicious and the crew was extremely nice

TUNTIP Checkin at Tunis was efficient and staff generally friendly Boarding at the gate was chaotic While on the runway the plastic emergency exit covering came off The pilot came and put it back on Plane then proceeded with takeoff The food was standard and staff friendliness on board ok although only with limited English skills Onboard announcements were in Arabic only The interior was worn emergency cards in seat pockets were still from the former owner of the plane a defunct French airline

I was transiting with Air China in Beijing Capital Airport Terminal Most international flights operate from Concourse TE but some use TD In my cause both arrival and departure were from TE On transit passengers need to go through document and security and customs check The walking times are not really long and mostly travelators are available There are transfer service checkpoints one from each side of the concourse The crowd is not really well organized and staff is not really helpful Not everyone speaks English which is quite frustrating when you actually need to communicate with airport or security staff Arriving early in the morning get ready to spend h queuing for transit Other than that I have to note that Terminal is very modern by its looks and layout The ceiling is high which makes it seam like the airport is free and spacious Walking distances are not too long Most gates are accessible in less than minutes of calm stroll Between TE TD and TC there is an automated people mover train which is easily accessible after security I didnt use it but I located its station and observed it a little There are few restaurants which in my opinion are quite reasonable priced Early in the morning only few Chinese restaurants and Western cafes were opened The food is actually quite delicious I would note good availability of seating spaces Some are equipped with universal power outlets and USB chargers If you want to use WiFi better use WiFi kiosks as SMS sometimes doesnt go through Be aware that you wont be able to use most messengers and social networks Also it was nice to have drinking fountains within short reach from most seating areas I would suggest considering Beijing Capital Airport as transit hub for Asia Clean and modern airport with all the necessary facilities for longer transits

ADD YOUR COMMENTS Very pleasant and open design Arrival was easy and there was absolutely no hassle once we cleared the secure baggage area Marked taxis were available outside Check in was conducted in a secure area which you cannot leave once you enter so ensure you are not hungry because nothing other than a small cafe and some duty free stores are available on the gate side Compared to other airports in the region this one is very good

Living in Geelong this airport is great mins from my parents place and traffic is rarely a problem Check in is quick quicker with no bags check in online the night before stroll through security and a short walk onto the plane Only criticism is that the airport is small gates and only bar cafe and newsagents Hopefully with the new International terminal theyre cleared to build theyll upgrade the domestic terminal too

What is happening with some Italian Airports As Florence and Pisa Bologna is completely and horrendously overcrowded One cannot walk around at the gate area which is immediately after a socalled DutyFree With people queuing to get on a plane or for a sandwich or coffee there is no space to get anywhere without pushing your way through The worse there is absolutely no air to breath with all these people standing around Probably much is because of some low cost airlines which let you queue well before effectively boarding planes but whatever it is Bologna should think about some solution as it is an ordeal A pity because personnel is generically very friendly and there are lovely food options in the terminal

Arrived in Paro airport at pm There WERE flights that had arrived Immigration was quick and the staff were very polite We got our bags and we left the airport in less than minutes For our departure check in took minutes and immigration another The departure lounge is small but adequate Lots of craft shops and a few places to eat Very casual airport and the staff are very friendly The cafe food was however awful but the coffee was nice Wifi available but kept disconnecting All in all a charming little airport for this stunning country

This review is for Terminal Terminal is dramatically different RGN has undergone vast changes during the last years There remain remnants of the underdeveloped facility that once was but the outside world has arrived in Yangon and at least as far as the airport is concerned it is a good thing CustomsImmigration at both arrival and departure is reasonably fast On the absolute worst day you might wait minutes but an average wait will be minutes or less Lines at check in counters move quickly which is terrific Departure lounges are a lot nicer than they once were Now they sport clean comfortable spaces dependable WiFi and food that works in a pinch Restaurants in the airport are not great but if you want a decent cup of coffee some KFC a Burger King something or other youll be ok Souvenir and duty free shops still have a long way to do Alcohol and cigarettes are fairly priced There are perennially empty luxury clothing brands without customers There are a couple of small boutiques selling attractive textiles carvings local bath products delicious local coffees etc Services are generally more than adequate in the predeparture areas There is a bag wrapping counter for flimsy luggage convenience stores plenty of seating free WiFi etc Taxis downtown should be priced out before you leave Money Change desks offer the exact same rate as all the other places in the country so theres no reason to hold on to your foreign currency The airport is still a work in progress but leaving and arriving in this amazing city is a lot less unpleasant than a few years back

Bennett at the TSA first check point was so incredibly sweet to our son and his attitude was great Im sure everyone that works for the TSA feels this way on the inside but he was clearly showing it to us on the outside Keeper

Guayaquil to Baltra I wish to say a few positive words to review my trip to Galapagos with this nice airline which proved to be punctual reliable and with great customer service I had to anticipate my return flight from Baltra to Guayaquil so I decided to call the customer service on their international line I was a bit scared as reding the previous reviews I was expecting the worse Actually the customer assistant on the phone not only spoke perfect English but also managed to help me with the change easily and at no additional cost In few minutes the new ticket was delivered to my email together with all the information regarding the entrance requirements to Galapagos The whole checkinboarding process was easy and quite fast both ways and departure and arrival time perfectly punctual The plane was probably a bit outofdate but the crew and the pilots did their best to make the flight as pleasant as possible Drinks and a snack were served during both flights and we got lots of announcements from the cockpit Smooth takeoff and landing completed the journeys so overall a nice experience and nothing to complain I have to say that I travelled much better than with other airline companies

Mumbai Airport never fails to impress me from the dedicated drop off options or the overall efficiency It is my favourite major airport to travel from I am more impressed with arrival facilities but even departure is as good as it gets Only fundamental issue is its very overcrowded

Not good for transit passengers Staff are polite and helpful but nowhere to relaxsleep in a darker and quiet area No ATMsshopsfood outlets just a cafe upstairs Toilets clean Electric socket near where I was sitting didnt work I obtained wifi with the help of someone as there seems to be no airport wifi This lounge is just a square room brightly lit with toiletschairs and a few coffee tables Please improve our flying experience

The security staff were incredibly slow and seemed to be more interested in personal chats than getting customers through the security process as quickly as possible Why not be more proactive you will get less tension with customers shorter queues and a better job satisfaction You dont need to be unfriendly and impersonal

The improvements I mentioned in were completed on schedule and have given this airport a new and modern feel Unfortunately the upper level is no longer a viewing deck area However a new restaurant with a view of the airfield was installed on the ground floor Facilities are top class considering the size of the airport A brand new baggage retrieval area was added to the airport The layout of the airport works well Staff are still just as friendly

Pleasant and easy check in Perfectly organized boarding Clean and new aircraft Spacious seat distance however seat width not as wide as other carrier on this route Pleasant crew Very good food which however was served a bit late At arrival fast border control and bag arrived rather soon however priority sticker did not give the bag priority delivery

A small yet very convenient airport in the south of France From the plane to the exit takes no more than min Signaling shopping etc is all fine given the size and role of the airport Its not the most modern airport but everything is well maintained Theres a convenient bus service to the city center

UIOCCS There were no problems to speak of nor was the experience extraordinarily positive First off I should say that I had problems in booking via the Santa Barbara website and so had to visit their agency in Quito I had my bags fairly thoroughly checked by migration people in Quito but thats understandable given the flow of drugs in the region The flight itself was fine Boeing no obvious neglect crew were friendly enough food was decent We did leave about mins late At the Caracas end our bags were slow in arriving It seems that there are problems but you may get lucky and avoid them as I did

It makes my day to be served by caring thoughtful polite and lovely stewardess that hard to come by as far as SQ is concerned serving own homeland A great applaud to Natalie For the moment we step into the plane and settle down this lady greet us with broad smile I am so grateful of her coming to my rescue to help me ease my gastric by going the extra mile to get me biscuits and hot drinks when they are busy out of their normal routine and SOP Caring enough to come by to check on me that Im well When we ask for drinks that help to soothe my daughter vomiting other staff just cant help and said they cant do anything Here come our hero Natalie whom with her sincere thoughtfulness and care to fetch my daughter a hot peppermint tea which is not serve in economy class Hopefully the next round I will meet her again She deserve to be the one wearing green uniform Well done Natalie You are a role model for rest to follow

I recently had the pleasure of flying with Japan Airlines on a flight to Tokyo NRT and was incredibly impressed by the exceptional customer service I received from Ha a ground staff agent From the moment I approached the checkin counter She was incredibly friendly helpful and professional She went above and beyond to ensure that my checkin process was smooth and efficient Her genuine care and attention to detail made me feel truly valued as a customer She went out of her way to make my travel experience as pleasant as possible and I am incredibly grateful for her assistance I was so impressed with her service that I immediately sought out her manager to express my appreciation I am confident that she is an asset to Japan Airlines

LimaCusco and three other internal flights within Peru All flights on time and quality of aircraft pilots as in landing and take offs was exceptional Aircraft were almost new As all were clean including the toilets which cannot always be taken for granted on an aircraft that is subjected to multiple take offs and landings during the day FAs very professional A very good experience

Dusseldorf to Paris CDG return on Embraer E jets The plane was very clean x configuration as standard with extremely wide seats I am cm on pounds and the seats were wide and long enough for my legs There was enough leg space including space for luggage below the seat Some people had trouble finding space for their luggage overhead but that is a problem on regional jets Shortly after takeoff the first round of drinks was served water and coffee without charge On the next run through about minutes later we got pretzels and salted peanuts Overall I am impressed by HOP and would recommend it Great staff outstanding service and a very pleasurable seating experience make it the perfect option for short trips

Friedrichshafen Hamburg It was one of my best experiences on a regional flightairline Aircraft was clean The crew CheckIn to cabin crew was very polite as well as highly professional Flight attendant made clearly understandable announcementssafety demos The only downside is that Intersky asks passengers to pay prohibitive expensive prices for onboard drinkssnacks But since they consider themselves as a low cost airline truly providing LCC price level it was no surprise and everybody is free not to buy anything

Travelled last month from Subang to Penang Flight was great Flight attendants were friendly and welcoming No in flight entertainment but there were magazines Only serve Peanuts fresh baked bread a mineral water and a wet towel for each passenger Baggage allowance was also ok as the limit was Kg Price was also cheap as I only paid RM for a one way flight One my return flight to Subang there were only passengers and the flight still continued even thought not even of the plane was full I would recommend the Airline to people who want to travel in Malaysia

This was the first time we had used Coventry Airport to travel to Barcelona Having been used to departing from the larger airports oh how we laughed The porter cabin style check in and the cattle shed style arrivals made us laugh and laugh The coffee shop was like having a cup of tea in your front room What fun to be escorted to the plane by the same person who checked us in we wouldnt have been suprised if they had flown the plane too The only hitch was when we arrived back there was already a flight in we were held on the plane while they found someone to escort us to the so called terminal We giggled at the thought of someone shouting Stan Can you leave the loo cleaning and get the next lot off the Barcelona flight We will be using Coventry again if only for a good laugh
Madrid to Toulouse Once again a punctual and comfortable flight Good legroom on time departure and arrival On flight entertainment was however not working you have to pay for anything on board

Our flight arrived very late and the hotel shuttle stopped running Bryce was very kind to help us find transportation to our hotel He went above and beyond his job to make sure we arrived safely I was very satisfied

FCOTSRIAS Business Class Checkin in FCO terrible just counter minutes waiting time No lounge offered Inflight service with very friendly and attentive staff good food Transit in TSR as well despite of being a small and old airport was ok Here again very polite staff

Tibet Airlines offered great service and comfortable seating with ample legroom Chengdu to Lijiang is a relatively short flight of hour but crew were very accommodating They had inflight entertainment showing on screens in both English and Chinese Water only served on this flight but would recommend Tibet Airlines

Manchester to Tripoli Airbus A Plane was a little old and tired looking Only passengers on board and I was the only one in Business Class Seats were OK food was fine The flight took off on time and arrived in Tripoli on time Based on costs and timings this was very good value compared to British Airways

Flew with Alitalia on both arrival and departure used jetbridge which was a plus It is compact and functional There is train service to city center Its quite convenient Security line moved quite efficiently during my Saturday morning departure The space is quite small on airside Seats are located at the gate where boarding passengers would walk pastline up while you wait Bari will need to expand the airport very soon

Arriving at Miami International Airport to return to Rome we had the invaluable assistance at the automatic checkin before the Air Canada desk so I dont think an Air Canada employee helped us so much to understand how we had to make our boarding passes and what to do with our luggage Thanks to him the passage through this airport seemed delightful

We were initially a bit disappointed when Etihad did not use its own aircraft on the route between Abu Dhabi and Jakarta but used wetleased Wamos equipment However the entire experience was good Clean and spacious plane with pleasant configuration so ideal if you are traveling with people The staff was professional and friendly They carried out very thorough safety checks before departure and landing The only real downside was the entertainment Little choice and that should really be different no flash path information Furthermore only praise for Wamos A Basic experience on time and comfortable

Victoria Airport on arrival the terminal was easy to find clean and well laid out Friendly and helpful staff who went out of their way to guide you checkin was a breeze and no surprises with our luggage Even the customs staff shared some humour with us On the other side of security it was just as impressive with clean well laid out waiting areas and washrooms Water fountains available that you could fill up your water bottle from and not have to pay the rip off price for bottled water like at other airports We will definitely use this airport again in the future

Small airport by international standards Immigration and customs smiling and welcoming Departure easy with only one aircraft departure tax has to be paid and quite rigorous security procedure but done with typical Cook Islands good nature Walk from terminal to aircraft across tarmac necessary Could be a wet one in a tropical downpour

This is a small but friendly airport The checkin area is not air conditioned and is hot Checkin was efficient immigration and security were efficient with hardly any queues In departures there were two food and drink outlets a dutyfree shop and several other shops Boarding was efficient

Outstanding Customer Service from Air China Jakarta Airport Ground Staff On October nd I arrived from Sydney to Jakarta Qantas planning to board within hours on Air China CA to Beijing then to Madrid and Sao Paulo Due to Qantas airplane problems the Qantas flight arrived hours late leaving me with only hours to board Air China Unfortunately Qantas refused to give any assistance to facilitate the very short time for check in Talking to the Indonesia immigration agent he called Air China ground staff who sent an agent with a mission to help meI did not have a Visa on Arrival no boarding card and a checked luggage at Qantas The agent did everything to make me board the Air China flight talked many times to the immigration officers called Air China office to send a letter to the immigration and ran times to the Air China counter to try to solve all bureaucratic issues The agent and other Air China agents issued all documentation needed and ran with me and my luggage through Jakarta terminal be able to catch the flight Boarding the Air China flight CA in such a short time was a small miracle that was possible because of the competence and excellent service of Jakartas Air China ground staff

The flight attendants are top notch service is gracious and consistent Little things like coming by often to take trash asking your preferences clearly and sincere friendliness that I think is sadly lacking in some airlines these days I dont know how they manage to do it but the eggs are truly good Also this is the only airline in which I was served a dish I tried to recreate once I got home a corn salad with red onions and feta Delicious They do not serve typical Korean food but all I ask of airline food in economy is that the food not be disgusting Air Premias dishes can actually be described as good The legroom in economy is by far the biggest selling point of this airline Even though their entertainment options are severely limited I am completely happy with economy on Air Premia

I am so impressed with Air North The last time I flew with a different airline I remember waiting ages for drink service that only came around once and paying something ridiculous for a small snack But Air North blew that experience out of the water Complimentary food and drinks are one thing but this was only a hour flight and they kept us busy the whole time serving drinks a lovely sandwich a cookie and then more drinks I was positively full at the end of the flight And when I complimented the cookies oatmeal chocolate chip served warm the very lovely stewardess Keely got me and my sister my travelling companion a few for the road She gave us good tips for visiting the Yukon too The airline was clean flight was smooth and service was fantastic I wish Air North flew everywhere they would be my first choice every time
Wonderful Right size efficient super clean reliable in all weather conditions and wonderful ergonomics

Islamabad to Manchester Very prompt check in for Shaheen Air No hassle Boarding very professional and well organised Friendly cabin staff Clean very aircraft Good quality food served lunch Asian style and evening dinner European style and plenty of cold drinks coffee tea Little treats like chocolates also served during flight Food served on time and promptly This flight had free Wifi which worked well Generally very happy with Shaheen Air I would definitely recommend and I would fly again with them
A smallish airport with limited facilities but clean and comfortable
A reliable airline with excellent service from checkin to boarding to in flight service Gracious staff Prompt at times early Amazing and use airbridge in Bangkok

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap The check in was fast and the staff friendly The departure arrival were punctual and the aircraft made an average good maintained impression The seat distance was sufficiently good Despite the short flight there was a small bite and water Overall a good experience

Why do we always want to fly the big airlines VLM has the efficiency of a budget airline the service of a high value airline and the punctuality of a German airline They have friendly staff and after landing you are out of the airport in minutes Moreover book well in advance and you have a very attractive fare

Never had any problems flying in and out of John WayneOrange County Airport Its clean security is quick and efficient and has that laid back atmosphere that is OC Its very convenient even when it comes to flying internationally you can get almost anywhere in the world with no more than one stopover At times Ill fly out of LAX if Im not in the mood for that stopover but OC always offers a pleasant alternative for convenience and efficiency Because of its curfew a lot of planes depart first thing in the morning so getting there early is advised But overall a great airport

We booked our return flight as a direct flight which was canceled and then simply staying in Paris We started more than hours later missed our connecting train were poorly provided with drinks unfortunately not a great experience Our direct flight to Colombo from Frankfurt was great very nice staff super on time
On time departure Excellent value and they gave a meal on a hour flight We arrived mins early Staff was professional Bags delivered in a normal amount of time

My experience at the new Siem Reap Airport surpassed all expectations The staffs friendliness and proactive assistance elevated my journey Navigating immigration was not only expeditious but also conducted with an admirable level of efficiency The airports outstanding features combined with the exceptional service created an atmosphere of ease and comfort

For departures Algiers new airport is fairly spacious functional and the staff is friendly I might have been lucky but I found the police controls and security to go fairly quickly Shops are limited but I found them sufficient also they are open very early and close late The choice of restaurants is limited to for each hall and they are of the same provider They offer reasonable selections of light eating and drinking On arrivals I find it inadequate to have to walk down stairs after coming off the plane I did not see an elevator available The wait for the luggage is too long I was told it was due to the luggage scanner being undersized for the traffic One important deficiency is the absence of English signs they are all in French and Arabic only A shame for a brand new International airport Over all I was satisfied mainly due to efficiency at departure and the feeling of space which is lacking too often in aging European airports

KIVKBPODS Both flights were codeshared with Aerosvit but operated by Dniproavia planes KIVKBP Embraer that has seen better days KBPODS plane was an oldlooking Boeing Service onboard was good Offered drinks and a double sandwich despite both flights being under hr Flights departed on time They almost lost my luggage on the first flight as it was sent to connecting flights but were able to locate it relatively quickly and hand it back Overall a relatively good experience for the price paid

Excellent safe clean on time and we got a hot meal on board which I did not expect given the fact that during the ticket purchase I was prompted to buy a meal which I did not want to do They are a little bit expensive but the flight took a long time hrs Excellent service thank you

Landed H from CPT and out in mins as no baggage Long walk as aircraft parked far Very nice and clean airport Really like the wide choice of outdoor restaurants in the garden Pup and go vehicles move fast Police and security officials visible

Hannover is a medium sized airport with all facilities you expect Great plus are the short ways good signage short waiting times at the checkin security and baggage delivery Always very clean Easy to reach by car bus or train They have a good selection of restaurants like high quality Mvenpick or even McDonalds supermarkets decent duty free and a great aviation exhibition Welt der Luftfahrt and observation deck When you fly Lufthansa or Star Alliance and have a status you get access to a stylish lounge with great apron views A nice airport I like to use a lot
Flew in and out of here on flights to and from Sao Paulo A striking modern terminal with reasonable facilities Very pleasant

A small but efficient airport with a good tax free selection As mentioned before the transfer time to Oslo is long about hours more to downtown Oslo compared to Oslos main airport Gardermoen as this is not really an airport meant to serve Oslo However it costs about the same to get to Torp as it does to get to Gardermoen due to the outrageously expensive but very efficient Airport Express Train going to the latter airport When choosing between coach and train to Torp note that the train takes slightly longer and is about NOK more expensive but more comfy and a beautiful journey at times

Once again American Eagle operated by Republic Airways delivered a reliable safe and comfortable flight from Washington DCA to Philadelphia Republic continues to uphold American Airlines commitment to excellence providing a seamless experience despite minor operational challenges Our departure was delayed due to traffic changes at DCA following recent tragic events but the crew handled the situation with professionalism and care Their dedication to passenger comfort and safety was evident throughout the flight ensuring a smooth and reassuring journey While delays are never ideal the priority is always arriving safelyand thats exactly what happened Kudos to Republic Airways and the outstanding crew for their continued commitment to quality service
Excellent experience at this airport Not just departing but upon arrival as well Very smooth quick organised and excellent staff Look forward to returning soon

Kuala Namu International Airport is it is the second largest airport after SoekarnoHatta International Airport but the first airport which has a direct rail link to Medan city the capital of North Sumatra Kuala Namu is the most comfortable and the most modern airport in Indonesia

I was down with flu and surprised when I checked in and cleared passport that the airport did not have any pharmacies or clinics inside the airport This is the first time in a long history of travel that an airport doesnt have these facilities Very disappointed

I was impressed by the cleanliness and orderliness of this airport Even the porters and staff act professionally Big space check in counters not cramped You dont have the feeling that youll be harassed nor cheated Considering this airport on my future flights

Praslin to Mahe Over zealous security screening at Praslin when they noticed we had packed a small pack of batteries in our hold baggage Had to take out every item of clothing until they were found and no time to repack On check in we thought we had prepaid for excess baggage via our travel agent only to be told it had not gone through Staff could see that we had completed the process but still charged us the airport price rather than the online price Staff completely unhelpful and appeared to take great pleasure in making things as difficult as possible Would not give us any assistance of any contact details Currently taking up the issue with their customer services and the office of their CEO Flight cramped and noisy recommend ear plugs and very warm Plus side it was shorter than most bus journey I normally take No assistance offered by ground crew getting on or off the plane with flimsy hand rail and low doorway

We were originally booked in Premium Economy with Air Canada Due to a substitution of aircraft we were switched onto Omni in economy class While the aircraft was fairly old and we were delayed hour in takeoff everything else was fine Seats were comfortable food was okay and cabin crew were very friendly and efficient Air Canada processed the promised refund due to us being downgraded We would be okay with flying Omni again but prefer flying on an aircraft with a premium economy cabin

Istanbul to Tripoli This airlines is decent and I was served particularly well The food and beverages were great and the in flight entertainment contained a lot of movies to watch Also the WIFI was pretty fast and effective

Small airport in Orange County NY that is a welcome alternative to Newark other airports if you can get a flight Fare was hundreds less flying to PHL connecting to IND rather than nonstop from EWR but lots of time spent sitting in airports It is clean staff are pleasant but not much to do Wish there were more nonstops out of this airport to major cities but I hear it is great if you are going to Florida

Flying from AEP to IGU in Prem Economy I was nervous about what to expect on Aerolineas I have to say that I was really pleasantly surprised once we got on the plane Check in at Business was a breeze Security and Boarding was polite chaos They had two flights going to two locations boarding at the same gate at the same time However the premium economy was great simple but worth the extra The seats were comfortable and clean think that armchair type of seats you use to get in business class Service on this flight was friendly on others it was nonexistant They provided a sandwich and soft drinks The best thing though is on every Aerolineas flight my bags were on the carousel as I arrived there They have some amazing expedited system to get premium bags off which is great

Zurich to Dresden via their hub in Dusseldorf Both flights on As Checked in in ZRH without any hassle or feeling entering a lowcost carrier Gate bridging in airports convenient and saved time Flights were both precise on timing and arrival Luggage inscribed transferred and delivered within Minutes on final destination Transit in Dusseldorf smooth Payable catering service onboard rendered several interesting options from printed menu leaflets The airline was better than most reviews indicate I must render them credit at least out of If I had access to their lounges in ZRH and DUS the trip would have been perfected Not cheap but reliable no faults and could fly them again

Bradleys new A terminal is fantastic Finally we can show pride in our states airport and hopefully swing travelers to Hartford rather then Boston or New York As said before the old B terminal thats serves American and Indepence is really worn down Signs of TWA and Pan Am still are posted throughout the terminal which is more or less one giant hallway Security is quick and all the checkins are well light and clean New parking garage makes getting to terminal A even easier Just need to do up B and we can be a worldclass airport
The airport is new modern and colorful Everywhere is clean There are nice looking green areas with flowers and trees outside The employees were polite and smiling

A small airport for the tiny capital of Montenegro so that means big queues for border control no online check in hardy any shops or food and beverages Staff were friendly and correct Best to prebook a taxi in order to get to town which will be around euro

Our flight from Murica to Bournemouth was cancelled and the holiday was a disaster but the staff at Bournemouth were so helpful they kept me up to date with information they sorted all the car parking out and made sure we all made it home without any major issues The thing was no matter how many people say about the drop off fee of so what for a local airport min drive parking min walk to the building nice and calm and relaxing food was amazing now they have costa so what else would you need

Arrived at the airport and one of the customer service agents was very helpful He helped me with picking up my luggage connecting to WiFi and was very friendly His name was Houssem Thank you so much for all the hard work

Leonardo da Vinci Fiumicino Airport is a huge welldesigned welldecorated airport with clean and huge facilities I waited there for hours as the checkin security check and immigration were completed early However I spent good time as the airport facilities made easy travelers to navigate and browse for shopping and restaurants Airport staffs were good They speak English well Only bad thing is that travelers have to walk long to get into the boarding bridges

What a lovely place The tiniest airport an aerodrome actually I have been to People are lovely they take care of you There is a bar free wifi if it doesnt work in some areas ask for the airlines it is kept clean The only thing is getting there taxi only as far as I know

Manston is an excellent small airport The staff immigration customs and police are friendly but still professional Checkin was handled well Security was a little laborious but was thorough and in no way objectionable There is a small shop and a barcafeteria which considering the short amount of time needed to check in is all that is required A great option for those traveling to or from the south east corner of England I hope the route to Amsterdam is successful as it is so much more pleasant than flying from one of the big London airports Heathrow in particular I have heard that a rail link will be coming

Seat C A swift flight mainly with Sleep as it was an overnight flight Airplane was clean although the business class seating looked very old well worn arm buttons and seat capsule panelling The Bahrain Gulf Air lounge was a super treat with Dinner options such as Pizza and Lasagne all were very good I certainly look forward to booking my next Gulf Air flight

Funchal to Porto Santo This minutes flight is a true experience Aero Vip carries out the public service obligation connection between Funchal and the smaller Porto Santo airport located on the island with the same name The outbound flight was on a vintage Jetstream turboprop airliner with the return flight being on a slightly older Jetstream In both cases the safety briefing was carried out by the first officer himself as the plane does not have any FA on board The outbound flight left right on time and touched down in PXO just minutes later The plane on the way back arrived late and we left PXO with some minutes of delay again reaching our destination in slight over minutes The planes interiors are quite worn out but overall the planes gave me the impression of being in a good mechanical shape If you take this flight to reach the beaches in Porto Santo as was my case the whole flight is a really fun and unique retroexperience for aviation enthusiasts which unfortunately comes with a hefty price tag EUR return It needs to be said however that the rates are much cheaper for residents who need this flight as a means to ensure territorial continuity

Was transiting between fight from Brisbane to flight to Townsville with wait time of three hours Boarding areas large enough for amount of passengers Lots of windows with views over runway Shops and eateries limited but probably appropriate for airport this size Check in area clear Security staff friendly and talkative Noted the airport has a new Ibis Airport Hotel nearby and looks rather flash Had a pleasant time while at this airport

Taupo is a tiny regional airport servicing the central North Island of New Zealand When I say tiny I mean tiny arrivals departures check in security lounge and facilities are all in one room Its serviced by the regional arm of Air New Zealand and is a a great option for getting into the Heart of Lords of the Rings country Theres rarely any queuing the staff are very friendly helpful and polite Bags are delivered just a few minutes after stepping off the plane Food and drink options are limited Theres a cafe but it seems to closed more often than open

Overall quite satisfied with this flight The service of the flight attendants was very good very attentive and thoughtful which made me feel their attentiveness and warmth The cabin seats were a bit hard the entertainment system was partially out of order the movie selection was relatively small the route was long and there werent enough movies to watch I am quite satisfied with everything else and would recommend this airline to my friends

Oldest airport that is still in use but great The mother of all airports has an impressive architecture huge size and is very close to the city Unfortunately SN Brussels airlines is the only largest airline flying there together with some local airlines Unfortunately they want to close it in the next years but the building will not be destroyed

I had my period during the departure and didnt have sanitary paper with me My departure was from Terminal and after entering it there was no place where I could get it It is important that such things as sanitarny paper or diaper for babies are available to buy on an airport It should be available in the toilet or in one of the shops I had to ask several women which were also waiting for a plane whether they have sanitary paper It was uncomfortable I found sanitary paper cause one of the women had it but I could be less fortunate

Durbans new airport King Shaka International was opened for the World Cup It was designed as a stateofthe art regional airport for Durban KwaZuluNatal region The is plenty of space for stopping in the dropoff zone with direct access to the terminal There are seperate checkin islands for BA SAA and Emirates The departure concourse is spacious with enough seating for waiting passengers In the arrivals hall there is a food court with a Piazza some shops a Woolworths banks and post office Also a tourist information office After security there is plenty of space Unfortunately some lounges were closed due to renovations but this is only temporary The domestic terminal has plenty of space so a quiet corner for reading or working is not a problem If more international arrivals departures materialise then the current departure gates could prove to be a bit underdimensioned in the future

ADD YOUR COMMENTS Very pleasant and open design Arrival was easy and there was absolutely no hassle once we cleared the secure baggage area Marked taxis were available outside Check in was conducted in a secure area which you cannot leave once you enter so ensure you are not hungry because nothing other than a small cafe and some duty free stores are available on the gate side Compared to other airports in the region this one is very good

A small but efficiently operating airport Arrival was smooth and fast even when there was an additional covid document check There are enough small shops and food and beverages available Transportation is best done by train which will cost only euro

Great service safety standard met Comfy seat and nice snacks The staffs in all aspects are very kind and very helpful Sad it will merge with Thai Airways

Not a bad little airport Plenty of space and seating if you need to wait a while But like all most Chinese airports the departure shops are terrible and expensive Bring your own snacks drinks or something to read Nothing to see there but it is comfortable enough

I flew into and out of Moscow Sheremetyevo Airport in December for the first time and was quite impressed with arrivals and maybe a little less so with the departure process Arriving and clearing customs and security and getting bags was all pretty straight forward and easy enough and efficient Signage for me was great and easily navigated to the bag carousels and also found an ATM before exiting to take out some cash Plenty of food options once exiting and then I easily followed signs to the Aeroexpress train from the airport to Moscow Belorussky about a min walk through terminalI bought my train ticket online prior and scanned the barcode and all worked fineSo transport to and from the airport is easy on the way back I took a Yango ride and it pulled up easily right in front of terminal On the way departing security is pretty tight but to be expected you go through two screening stations and again check in pretty seamless except for the fact your Departure Terminal indicated on the board may not be the one you finally need to go to as I found out Ended up having a fairly decent walk from one terminal to another Once that finished then we headed to the aerobus as is common in Europe to be driven to the plane waited for about mins with open bus doors for late passengers in Moscow winterthen the drive started and instead of a couple of minutes it turned into about minutes driving from one aide of the runway around the end and over to the opposite apron to the plane But for me all an adventure but just be prepared for a bit of a walk and maybe an extended bus ride Overall a nice clean airport that was very functional and not overly crowded when I went through and easily accessible and a good range of eateries and amenities

I was browsing airfares for a late November trip and I stumbled across a business class fare on JAL for much less than it usually sells for Approx USD for TorontoChicagoTokyoBangkok return YYZ ORD was on AA Considering I usually pay about for economy with my extra golf bag this seemed like a no brainer and I pulled the trigger on that fare the very next day That decision was the correct one Ive just returned from the trip which is an annual one and Ive never crossed half the globe and had it feel so easy A fully lie flat bed all the way except TorontoChicago and a completely private one at that The food was great the service was great the lounges were great check in priority and fast track immigration in TokyoBangkok It was as easy as travel can be Ive flown JAL in economy before and even then I thought it was a superior experience than our local option Air Canada which continues to disappoint every time I recall even in economy the seats were wider fewer total seats across instead of and the meals were better Well business exceeded expectations even after YouTube reviews had set them sky high I have no reservations about wholeheartedly recommending them If I were to nitpick and I was fully expecting it as everyone seems to mention it is that the cabin is kept too warm So I packed shorted and a tshirt for sleeping in It was manageable

Hong Kong to Xian Being the second time travelling with Cathay Dragon my impression towards this airline is greatly improved In my flight to Xian except for my IFE that failed to show the flight map everything just went right and nothing special happens the cabin crew also provided good service to us However as things went wrong in the return flight back from Xian to Hong Kong the excellence of the Cathay staff is well demonstrated As the Hong Kong Airport Authority restricted flights from landing in Hong Kong that day after we entered the cabin with the door closed we were still not sure whether we can fly The cabin crew reacted professionally to answer many enquiries from passengers meals were served on ground and we could just wait for further notifications from the pilot Finally the flight was delayed to the next day we were then forced to leave the cabin and went back to the airport the only thing that made me discontented is that there was no any compensation from the airline though the airport restriction issue is not the problem of the airline In the delayed flight next day we saw the same crew and they also showed how professional they are After knowing that it is the birthday of one of our friends they even provided snacks and gifts to us Their quality of service was just awesome and left us very deep impression It is really an unforgettable experience travelling with Cathay Dragon and it is definitely a yes if I have a chance to travel with them once more

On our flight with LAN we had to change flights in Sao Paulo to TAM Airlines retrieve our luggage and check it in again as we were flying a domestic flight to Rio and then to Santiago There wasnt much time between the connections in Sao Paulo and going through immigration and changing terminals made it almost impossible With minutes before departure we didnt have our luggages checked in and there was a big line at the counter The staff on ground made a great job in checking our baggage and then taking us to the plane in a minibus as we were the last ones to board The luggage arrived safe in Santiago and both flights were on time On the way to Rio there was a new A with lots of leg room and for Santiago an old A which gave us a lotof trouble with many turbulences The food served on TAM wasnt different from the one of LAN but the staff were extremely friendly Still the experience in Sao Paulo looked very chaotic to us and we would prefer LAN for further flights

A small but tidy airport adequate for short transits The securityxray procedures for transit can be time consuming if more than one flight arrives at once Expect an hour of queueing to get through the security If you have a short connection staff will call you out of the normal queue just in time for your flight For longer transits there is nothing to do in the airport and little food The only coffee shop airside was closed in December A transit visa is available on arrival for AU and costs BN Money exchange is near the immigration area and easy Meter taxis are supposed to be available but on my pm arrival none were available unmetered all charge BN for even the shortest trip On my return the next morning the hotel booked me a car for Overall a transit stop in a budget hotel adds AU to your trip Unfortunately the new schedule with Royal Brunei since Oct now require long stopovers and overnight transit in Brunei when connecting to SEA destinations and this now makes other more expensive airlines a more attractive option Dry flights and inconsistent alcohol rules may also influence travellers Immigration staff are slow poorly organized and lazy Visa stamps tend to take up a full passport page where they could use only a third like other countries This trip was minutes waiting at immigration Business Class lounge is quiet and comfortable for short stops Has shower facilities but nowhere to sleep Food is hit and miss depending on time of day and number of guests No alcohol in the lounge An airport to be tolerated rather than enjoyed SingaporeKuala LumperBangkok are all far better options
