Arrived here for the safari and climb up Mt Kilimanjaro Arrived around hrs you walk into a big room with two areas I have a visa and I do not have a visa So we got in the no visa line Well actually it wasnt so much a line as a big confluence of people and soon we found out why there are multiple windows you need to go to before passing through customs to collect your baggage I had read a blog about the visa scenario at JRO before I left so I had an idea of what to expect but upon returning home I reread the blog and realized that I didnt retain all of what was stated It was all there but like most things in life experience trumps book knowledge You need to get in the far right line first to pay for the visa for USA for non USA Bring large bills preferably new I had been told this prior to the trip so I came prepared with new bills circa or maybe it was Bottom line they werent from before which is the cut off year for American bills accepted in Tanzania After you pay you go to the nd line and get your photo taken and the visa is placed in your passport Get through with that and you realize you still cannot see your baggage you need to go to the rd line for fingerprinting By this time all of the I have a visa people were gone so there were more lines available for this last step All in all it took us minutes from the time we entered the room to the time we saw our baggage Yes its a long time but if you purchase your visa before travelling you only save maybe minutes and you need to consider the fact that you have to mail in your passport for an extended period to receive that visa Add to that you need to purchase the passport photos for the visa for us its worth it to spend the extra time in the airport and never allow your passport to be sent in the mail You save money on the photos because they take your picture at JRO The return leg went very smoothly you get in line they run all of your bags and you through security then you turn in your checked baggage and go through security again with your carry on took about an hour and we were at our gate no worries

On time departure from Larnaca to Leipzig Very friendly crew I was surprised that of them including first officer was from Greece and Cyprus Very nice and colorful aircraft that makes your day Wind in Leipzig was not calm it was about kts Perfect landing

Departure was fairly easy and quick and there was an English guide for completing the customs form You can only spend local money in the cafe or burger place but duty free only accepts dollars and euros Escalator up to departures and not big inside but okay and clean Arrival is very slow so be patient There is no queuing at passport control so I just took a seat on the side and waited until only a few people left and was much easier At customs you need to complete two forms and I couldnt see an English guide whereas there was one in departures so ask a local or fill it in best as you can and customs officers will help with rest There is a separate queue for tourists and they speak a little English make sure you keep the second copy as you will need it when you come to leave the country Taxi ride into centre around Som ie but youll need to haggle a lot Overall its a fairly small airport and arrival does take a long time but it seems they are trying to improve things all the time

The airport is mid being rebuilt arrivals still in progress but departures all complete Departures was very quick no checkin or security queue it was a Tuesday but our plane was fairly full Great clean toilets friendly staff the only major fail is despite it all being brand new there is nowhere near enough seats expect to be sitting on the floors also not much food on offer if you cannot eat wheatbased food groups

Port Elizabeth airport is small and friendly Best thing about it is that it is so close to the main seafront area you can be on the beach about minutes after leaving the airport if you want Slight disadvantage once you are on the beach is that planes go right over your head Also very close to CBD and the pleasant suburb of Walmer PE known as the Friendly City and the airport gives it a good introduction

Pensacola isnt a fancy airport but its fine functional and beautiful Even the exterior architecture greets travelers in a way that reminds them of the waves and big skies of Florida This is also a better alternative in my opinion to flying out of other Gulf Coast airports such as Mobile Tallahassee and GulfportBiloxi Pickup and dropoff are a breeze Checkin is hasslefree Security is a breeze and even more so with TSA PreCheck Dining and shopping options arent ample but do get the job done nicely remember PNS is a small airport Boarding the flight is easy Pensacola is just a very modern efficient airport one that reminds me a lot of other smaller airports like Louisville however no small airports in this country set the world standard like Wellington and Christchurch both in New Zealand do

This is a very small airport but it is clean convenient and easy to get around Passing through security was a breeze no big queues to wait at The waiting room was easy to find and it was nice clean and comfortable There isnt many places to eat or shop but I really dont care for that Airport staff was ok they arent the friendliest out there but they werent rude either It is a shame there is no public transport access to the airport except for a mini bus that links to the major hotels but not to the city

A very new airport with few flights Lots of parking and an outdoor cafe Checkin easy because it is not very busy once past security the gate area is small but with plenty of seats Duty free is expensive priced in US costa coffee pizza ice creams and a cafe provide more food than at many airports Toilets are clean Free WIFI is good and fast Buses to the planes no airbridges at all Very good for an Egyptian airport

Upon leaving Europe back to Los Angeles my flights had me departing LJU to connect at CDG for my flight to LA For some reason my travel agent had booked the two flights separately under two different confirmation numbers while in Slovenia I had called the airline and even the hotels concierge did as well and we both found out only the gate agent can make sure and both flights are listed as one continuous trip mainly for the sake of routing checked luggage all the way through The gate agent with the assistance of a coworker easily got this done and I was only charged for an extra checked bag my initial flight was in economy while my connecting flight was in business Thankfully both flights were on the same airline in the end everything went smoothly Upon arrival at LJU I was amazed how much of a small town airport feel it had You could walk through the entire airport in minutes There were only about four checkinticket windows and no one was in line Proceeding to security there were about three rows to enter through and once again no one else was in line My time initially at checkin took about minutes to get my flights worked out and to pay the extra checked bag fee and then within ten minutes I was through security and enjoying a drink near my gate A very laid back and friendly experience Sort of a calm before the storm I would have at CDG in three more hours

A small but very nice airport just km from the city center The distances are short checkin hassle free and handling staff very friendly I was very happy to hear international traffic had been approved about a year ago Nowadays there are international flights to Brussels and Copenhagen I really support the development of this airport because of the proximity to the city center the short distances and a problem free handling

Getting in yesterday was ok except for having to walk great distances when my partner and I have hip issues Being offered a ride on an electric cart that did not happen Then today we sat in the check in area for more the an hour waiting for someone to push our wheelchairs to our gate We were taken to the head of the line only to have to wait But everyone was very nice

Brand new airport On the positive side for Chinese standards it certainly is welldesigned and wellconnected Bright and clean checkin area Good choice of restaurants and cafes both before and after security controls As to the negatives the security controls are quite inefficient and slow the airline lounges are all quite poor and certain gates from upward are very far up to min walking

This airport was previously known as London Manston which is a bit of a joke because of how far it is from London However with a name change new terminal and new budget airline EUJet has started to raise its profile I travelled through there on the way tofrom Amsterdam The airport is small which works to its advantage Check in was very fast and the staff very helpful The car park is right outside the terminal entrance and is very cheap day or week The small cafeteria is good and clean The aircraft are right out side the terminal so no long bus rides or endless walkways On the way back it took less than minutes to reach my car from the time the wheels touched the ground I had no luggage All in all a very good experience

I traveled to Bengkulu Indonesia to visit friends for the first time in November Flew on Lion Air Upon arriving at the airport we deplane using stairs and walked on the tarmac to the arrival building It was late afternoon with the sun just about to set The airport building is very quaint Nice outdoor gardens greet you and on the day I arrived a nice afternoon breeze Slowly make the way to the inside of the terminal where one luggage belt half inside the terminal and a portion outside the terminal awaits The luggage eventually arrives and it gives you time to see the pictures of some of the sights to see in Bengkulu Once luggage in hand you go outside where there are various options for transport to where ever you are going I was met by friends that took me to the hotel Two weeks later I left Bengkulu and experienced the departure area You go through the usual security immediately upon entering the terminal say your good byes outside the door then walk to the check in desk where you obtain your boarding pass and check your luggage English is not widely spoken at the airport if at all but I had no issues whatsoever You then go to the gate area nice seats air conditioned tvs bathrooms and probably restaurants though I left on the first flight out and I not see anything to buy food or drinks Eventually they called the flight once again no English and we boarded the same way nice walk outside to the waiting aircraft All in all a really nice experience in this airport

I am a big fan of this airport It has only four or five checkin desks and lots of plants and pine furniture in the small departure hall It feels quite homely The staff at check in and at the small cafe have always been pleasant when I have flown from here I have also flown from Vasteras when the weather conditions have been dreadful very cold and heavy snow and everything at the airport and the shuttle bus from Stockholm have functioned with typical Swedish efficiency

Iconic scheduled flight to TenzingHillary Airport in the Himalayas Boarding at Kathmandu was very prompt The flight itself is an experience Fairly strict baggage weight restrictions due to the small size of the aircraft and very short landing runway Surprisingly given the tiny size of aircraft there was still a member of cabin crew onboard giving safety instructions and handing out sweets during the flight The cockpit was openly accessible and viewable from the cabin giving stunning views of the mountains and the landing sequence

Excellent airport Arrived at am on the BA London flight First time visit to India so I stopped off at the biometric finger print machine queued for minutes and completed he task in mins Went to border control There is a separate queue for business class travellers and they checked my boarding pass I could have done the finger prints here The agent wanted to see my eVisa print out Kind of defeats the object of have an eVisa But processed and passport stamped and quickly through By the time I arrived at the baggage claim my luggage had already arrived I then exited to meet my pre booked driver Took about mins from getting off the plane to getting into the car Departure had to get a ticket check before entering the terminal I have checked in online but mobile boarding pass not available Had to show the eTicket on my phone to get into the terminal I also had a print out of the itinerary Check in business class for BA flight to London only agent so about mins spent Dedicated business security lane was reasonably efficient Went to the Encalm business lounge to find a queue but this was the Priority pass queue the agent called business and first class travellers to the front I was then redirected to another lounge Enclam Prive I dont know what the differences are but I needed an airline invite to get in Nice big lounge with a huge choice of food some cooked to order Efficient boarding in groups and policed very well Overall a great airport experience
Comfortable enough flight which was fairly on time We were surprised that there was no catering on this flight of about hours Only took hand baggage

Launceston Airport has seen a large redevelopment program completed over the period At the northern end of the terminal are checkin counters for Qantaslink Jetstar Virgin Blue and Tiger Airways which has created more room than before Southern end of the terminal has two baggage carousels added with car rental counters opposite for Avis Budget Europcar Hertz Thrifty Red Spot New upgraded retail outlets are provided in the central section of the terminal which are Newslink Long Bar and Hudsons Coffee This central area has been expanded with a greater amount of room making it easier when more than one flight is in at the same time New security area directs passengers downstairs to new roomy departure lounges which are now at the lower level Windows at the central section and the departure lounges give visitors and passengers great views of the mountains east of the airport This redevelopment has made Launceston Airport a lot more user friendly than previously

Excellent airport Well organized Airlines and security staff are friendly and professional Good customer service The airport building is very clean and modern Good parking indoor and outdoor next to the terminal Easy to go around In conclusion a place were its pleasant to go

Domestic h flight from Ulaanbaatar to Dalandzadgad in South Mongolia on Hunnu Air in July Checkin and security clearance at the old ULN Chengis Khan Airport reasonably swift Departure and arrival on time Very pleasantly appointed ATR in good state of repair Friendly flight attendants Coffee water snacks All announcements in Mongolian and Russian I guess Cabin crew also speaks no English

Taoyuan International Airport provides a comfortable travel experience with modern and clean facilities and very friendly and professional staff However its worth mentioning that security and checkin queues do tend to be slightly longer during peak hours which may impact some travellers schedules It is hoped that there will be further improvements in the future to provide a smoother traffic experience

Nice airport Fairly modern The washrooms were clean and well maintained Its a fairly small airport There seemed to be a lot of security around the day we departed Airside international there is not much choice of food however I noticed across the road seemed to be popular with locals There was a coffee shop ouch for an iced coffee also some food there very expensive Going through security etc you go upstairs via escalator The oddest sight all booths open for both security and immigration yet we were the only ones there First time thats ever happened and I suspect last There were a few places to eat or drink airside and they seemed ok although we were not hungry Definitely liked this airport A very positive experience

Nice and clean airport As an avgeek I love watching planes and there are so many big windows next to restaurants to watch planes Security wasnt long The checkin staff were really nice On arrival Immigration was really quick and baggage claim was surprisingly quick Very quick and free wifi

Yangon to Mandalay Really good flight the seating was and actual seat numbers given on boarding pass plenty of space even at inflight catering offered light snack and good coffee Nothing to worry about despite ATR aircraft type and would definitely fly again

I fly weekly for work and Gerald R Ford Intl Airport in Grand Rapids is one of my two homebase airports Its served by American Delta United Southwest and Allegiant and has nonstop flights to twentysomething destinations I primarily fly American and mostly take flights that connect through Chicago OHare or DallasFort Worth GRR is a larger regional airport with two concourses of gates each but not a large airport by any means I can park in the garage walk in clear security TSA PreCheck and walk to my gate within minutes of driving into the garage I love that kind of convenience Employees are friendly and helpful pretty much across the board at the airline counters security and at the gates GRR recently finished a fairly large renovation in late They now have one central security checkpoint and a central area with new shopping and dining including a local brewpub Starbucks and a Michiganthemed souvenir shop There are also new lounge areas childrens play area and a business center not to mention new large restrooms In general GRR operates on time which is key for me Most delays Ive experienced have come from aircraft delayed at their originating airport mostly OHare Im basically comfortable relying on this airport for my weekly business travel needs

Before two years I used to fly with them and it was a pleasant one Now its far behind that quality I enjoy Now there is no comfortable space between the two seats Very difficult to sit if the front seater reclines his seat to mine Also there is no entertainment option QR code is not visible Every airlines targets only for maximum profit not the comfort of the pax All other things are okay

Flew Air Niugini because of the B very nice cabin in a xx configuration Took seat A bulkhead seat very comfortable with heaps of leg room Staff were amazing and very attentive food was OK entertainment was enough for this flight of approx hrs

Yahukimo to Jayapura Flight was about an hour late quite normal in this remote place Plane was comfortable enough with reclining seats and even a box of tea provided unlike on the sole competitors flights on this route

Ryanair flight operated by Lauda Europe was on time Legroom wasnt great but was only just slightly worse than the same route with Austrian Airlines The crew were awesome a special shoutout to the female crew member who managed the iceinthecup situation for me I would happily fly this airline again its about the same as Austrian Airlines except you dont get a free small chocolate Recommended

PortoOslo th Aug on a B Ticket purchased on DYs homepage CheckIn online not possible on computer but need mobile app No extra costs having BPs printed out in the airport Large handluggage were accepted regulations appear strict but are not enforced in any aggressive way Airport crowded and incredibly hot in sunny afternoons Boarding in groups is a nuisance as the groups get amalgamated into a large cramped pool before final boarding Those passengers called last upon for boarding de facto became the first to board Onboard spacious well bolstered seats better than for most other airlines yes Direct flight almost took hours I got a prepaid hot meal served which was nice and tasty Full flight A significant boarding delay of hour created congestion at gate and caused late arrival of more than one hour No IFE but WiFi worked

Singapore airport is magnificent and extremely wellmaintained with its facilities gardens waterfalls etc but arriving in the country has been made very difficult for Nordics There is no one at the immigration department upon arrival you first have to fill out a variety of information in English on a small computer which can take up to an hour If the machine accepts everything be happy There was no one to assist you in the queue of dozens of people at the machines And if you are accepted you go to another automatic machine where you present your passport and other necessary documents Your bag has been spinning for a long time waiting for you to pick it up from the belt When leaving the country everything seemed to be OK but then the departure security check began which was anything but friendly The border control officers who were clearly enjoying it gave orders and ripped off the jackets of older people who did not obey at the same second A militarystyle manly arrogant woman took my passport and boarding pass away because they noticed my diabetes pills everything was drugs to them Then I was ordered aside and subjected to various tactile tests with a digital device They couldnt didnt care to read prescriptions Overall it had the feel of being in the military chain of command

Only good thing about Bangalore airport terminal is it is beautiful and clean No other facilities available like other airports It does not have much food stalls and shopping area near GATES Moreover toilet are very far from gate location Less seating areas

Departure from Memphis The airport was ok I regard it as the best airport I experienced during my trip much better than Newark EWR and better than Chicago OHare ORD The stores and restaurants was plentiful but the airport is quite small The staff was friendly and efficient It was also quite clean much better than the other airports I passed through this trip in the USA It was easy to navigate through too Many small airports are better than their reputation
Worst company Never gonna take this company again I should have look at the reviews before booking Hate their service The price can be good but youll prefer any other companies its a promise

Big enough to serve all of your needs yet small enough and easy enough to get in and out of What a contrast when compared to Kansas City and Atlanta where my journey originated They have a childrens play area great local restaurants beers coffee etc It is about the same airfare to fly into Milwaukee often times as it is to fly into Chicago with a lot less hassle

When we arrived at Luxor airport got off the coach all I can say was what appeared like a pack of wolves were waiting to help with bags Now Im a ft stone bloke so am well capable but even despite this I ended up almost having to wrestle my bag away from a very eager helper who all the time was whispering under his breath drink please interspersed with something It appeared as if there was a supervisor or someone that they didnt want to hear their requests if so they were spectacularly unsuccessful in stamping out this sort of overaggressive help Having managed to wrestle free of the initial wave of helpers get inside the building once again there was another helper to lift bags onto the xray belt This time however as he didnt have any English phrases apparently the helper was saying something in Egyptian again whispering while showing me an Egyptian Pound note folded in the palm of his hand as a prompt Having now managed to get through these levels of assistance there was of course another helper at the other end of the xray machine who was equally helpful in taking the bag off the belt similarly looking for money Next up was the checkin desk itself yes you have guessed it there was yet another helper at the head of the queue to again lift the bag onto the checkin conveyor There is a sign on display at the desk stating that all baggage assistance was free of charge but this was clearly not having any effect on the various helpers that have to be negotiatedovercome Finally naturally there is the customary help in the toilets where even though I am at yrs of age well capable of washing drying my hands I was presented with some toilet paper with the by now customary demand for money All in all never again

Osaka to Busan Great value budget airline Web site and onboard magazine promise free water but none was offered Checkin at KIX was about minutes checkin at PUS was zero with no other customers in sight Offered decent seats even though we hadnt prebooked them Outward flight was delayed due to air traffic control restrictions at KIX but landed on time due to timetable padding Return flight left early but landed slightly late after circling around western Japan for ages Boarding on both flights smooth Bus to terminal at PUS but sky bridge on return flight Perfectly adequate and reasonably efficient for a budget airline and a onehour flight Would use again

It always a good experience to fly from to Nuremberg airport because you have short ways It is connected with the metroline U so you are in minutes at the city centre You can eat some local stuff The staff is friendly and helpful The most important to the end WIFI is free

I forgot my prescription glasses in the Duty Free in Tbilisi Following a few emails to the Duty Free department I received a positive response that they were found Two ladies did everything in their power to have them returned to me I cant fault these people they showed care and sympathy to my problems They are Natia and Inna Thank you so much

One of the better airports in Africa I made use of the pay lounge at USD where they served snacks and drinks I had a medical situation was referred to the medical station and received good medical attention
Kaohsiung International airport are one of the best airport to entry Taiwan Now with all the transportation by subway which can easy get from Kaohsiung down town to Kaohsiung airport in mins

Travelling in and out of Launceston Airport proved a pleasant experience Since the terminal is still fairly new everything seemed to be in very good working order Facilities were very good having large coffee shops and well stocked souvenirgift shop selling real Tasmanian and Launceston branded items Check in and customs were hassle free No time lost waiting for luggage or taxis

BudapestVenice Marco Polo Malev put me on this Moldavian Airlines flight without warning of a code share Proved to be a fairly pleasant flight in the end Food consisted of a chocolate bar and a glass of Hungarian red wine On the way back the flight was a little late arriving and they clearly rushed everyone on without having time to clean up The connection between Malev and Moldavian airlines is confusing The pilot thanked us for flying with Malev but the stewardesses were in Moldavian uniforms and the plane was clearly Moldavian

Used Estonian times in the last months AMSTLL vice versa Pleasantly surprised CRJ with a lot of legroom Charming staff Disliked the practice of sending economy passengers to a kiosk in TLL to get a boarding pass where you pay euros Once had a delay of minutes which the captain explained announcements over the speakers were very distorted and hard to understand Boarding at TLL was a mess The plane was a bit late arriving disembarking passengers refuelling no bridge from the gate people kept waiting Catering was okay but you pay through the nose of course No visa cards just cash

Zhuliany airport is located close to the main business district of Kiev Very small and cosy it is pleasant to fly to and from there on international destinations as everything is done very fast However the airport is not made for international travellers who dont speak Russian or Ukrainian The airport has a bad connection to transit system but taxi fares are attractive and solve the problem if your driver as of January asks you more than to go to the city center then he is abusing you Security and passport check staff are professional and polite The domestic terminal is much more simple and has no service at all for passengers

Contrary to what I had expected to find at a small domestic airport the terminal was beautifully clean well laid out with the benefit of some shops friendly staff who helped us through the security and check in process Ladies toilets both Indian and Western style were acceptably clean AC was okay if you were standing under it I would have no hesitation in travelling through this airport again on future visits to India Well done to those who maintain the Airport keep up the good work

Staff all very helpful in particular a lady from the special assistance team She went above and beyond what a lovely lady who clearly is very devoted to her job role We would choose to fly from Eindhoven airport again as our experience was so smooth and professionally handled Thank you such a small thing to say I hope this gets back to the whole team

Upon arrival at MRV discovered a new arrivals hall since my last visit in October last year Baggage very quick into hall Outside a pleasant array of kiosks should you need anything food wise Departures hall is spotless and some nice Caucasian shops to spend your Rubles in Security quick and easy and departure lounge has a nice cafe and a few more shops A pleasant experience before the hassle of Domodedevo

NurSultan to Almaty return I bought the tickets on the companys website Initially I planned to travel with just a hand baggage but the day before the flight I managed to add a baggage on the website for tg The flights were excellent Flight attendants sold buy onboard drinks and snacks Arrival was just on time The ticket price turned out to be cheaper even than the Talgo train

We found Banjul airport very efficient and friendly As we were on foot from the main road we were expecting a long walk to the terminal but we shouldnt have worried as within m of the airport entrance we were asked if we would like a lift in a chauffeur driven car taking the security supervisor to work We gratefully accepted and on reaching the terminal he insisted on helping us check in quickly as we had no hold baggage Boarding cards in hand we rapidly went through security and mins later were sitting in the pleasant open air departure area and ordering a couple of beers and a sandwich Service indeed and for the most part delivered with a smile

Use the airport regularly and its great parking facilities are next to the terminal so no need to go on a five mile cross country slog with children in tow nor wait for a packed shuttle boss and try and cram all luggage and children on board As stated before the airport is small and basic understatement but then again I dont use airports to sit in or spend all my holiday money in shops before i even depart the UK something which I think happens at many of the larger airports A very short walk from the terminal the interim passenger facility as it is more technically known to the plane and then you are away on your flight Coming back is so easy as well the arrivals area is a seperate building from departures If two planes arrive at the same time then I am under the impression that one has to wait for a short period of time foir the arrivals area to clear However after disembarking getting through passport control and getting to the baggage claim belt we were waiting for about two minutes and then hey presto the bags started coming through Again a very short walk to the car park ever present taxis and an hourly bus service tofrom the railway station and city centre are also available and we were offhome within minutes of landingat a bigger airport just down the A I have been waiting for minutes just for the baggage carousel to start revolving All in all it is basic but it does exactly what it says on the tin its a building well two buildings for passengers getting to or arriving from a city by air and it does this with minimum of fuss and least amount of time In some ways it is a good alternative for any inbound passengers wishing to avoid the congested London Airports the bus to the railway station and frequent trains to the centre of London could have you in the capital very easily Heres hoping for the new terminal an increase in services and more airlines I know I shall be a regular user of Coventry Airport and so shall my friends family and colleagues for many years to come

Im a frequent traveller and this was our first time using Air Astana from London to Delhi I read some great reviews nevertheless I was quite apprehensive to say the least Well how wrong was I Air Astana in my humble opinion is indeed providing amazing in flight service and great user experience We flew Airbus LR that appeared to be fairly new extremely clean and looked after Our economy cabin was looked after well we had nice amenity kit the food served was nice and tasty and with proper cutlery Equally choice of beverages was excellent too The crew is well trained and do their best to keep passengers happy On the improvement side we spent about hours in Almaty and found the airport to be quite small and quite basic which I think is a bit of let down and so I think thats the area they need to actively work on if they really want to get more customers flying with them I certainly will fly with them again and recommend it

Very small but friendly efficient airport Not a great deal to do and not many shops particularly airside but staff are always remarkably friendly and helpful which makes a change from most other airports I visit

My adult daughter had just returned from her connection in Las Vegas to Baltimore Airport in route to her final home destination in Maryland My daughter had difficulty locating her car and had gotten on the wrong airport bus Now normally this is frustrating for anyone but my daughter is autistic so trying to problem solve while in a heightened emotional state is a big struggle for her Morgan is higher functioning and prides herself on how independent she is but after a night of flying across country and running to connection flights she was feeling defeated and concerned about finding her vehicle as the sun was going down A bus driver named Chris on bus was her guardian angel He went out of his way to get her to the correct bus before it got dark when the main office confirmed they were too swamped to assist He even had to deal with an angry traveler yelling at him for taking the extra time of getting Morgan to the correct bus connection although Morgan said he was very efficient and quickly navigated her to the correct destination Thank you Chris your kindness is noticed and the world is a better place because of people like you

Flew on Loganair on flight No LM from City of Derry Airport to London Heathrow It was an early morning however checkin was fast and efficient Check in staff were very friendly City of Derry airport is a small regional airport however the service for early morning check was good We took off on schedule and during the flight there was tea coffee and biscuits serviced The cabin was extremely friendly and welcoming We land in Heathrow ahead of schedule and luggage was delivered very quickly I was very impressed by the service provided Loganair on this flight

From and to Singapore on Silk Air This is a functional airport which in the Philippines is high praise Security checks are numerous and slow as everywhere in the Philippines but because of the small number of international passengers moves quite quickly The same can be said for checkin baggage claim and immigration Toilet facilities are sufficient and clean On the downside for those who need shops there is only one very small cafe before immigration and a kiosk selling very basic items in the gate area All in all a good facility in the Philippines

Ground staff of LAN was ok not overwhelming nice but ok Seats in row ok IFE slow and quality ok Service of FA was good friendly and attentive Quality of food as you can expect in eco We had a transit at GRU to SCL and had to pass a security check where our water bought at FRA was taken Strange Upon arrival at FRA I had a damaged piece of baggage But the ground staff wasnt interested in any way of alpologizing but pointed out the rules for such case only Overall nothing special but a decent choice to travel to South America on long haul

I have flown Atlantic Airways numerous times between the Faroe Islands and Copenhagen The flight attendants are some of the best around and they consistently go out of their way to ensure that passengers have a good experience The new Airbus is more comfortable than the older planes The airlines offers free alcohol and above average coffee Food however is below average
This airline has impressive cabin staff and a very efficient ground staff never need check in more than minutes before my flight even in Tokyo

The flight was a bit late departing from Gaya but I wondered if we would even fly given the dense fog The flight was beautiful scenic in a half empty cabin with cleanest and beautiful interior The crew distributed snacks and drinks quickly and we could enjoy our view Everything was really nice and their flight magazine is informative of the country and sites A really beautiful experience

Great experience Early check in possible and done quickly staff super friendly Security fast and lets you go faster with a baby Nice tax free zone that you can actually enjoy as the check in and security is done quickly At least two amazing playgrounds for children great cafes everything clean

Glacier Park International Airport FCA in Montana USA is the best small regional airport I have visited After a very long journey from Sydney we were cleared very fast What impressed us was the security guard who stands on arrival exit door greeted us with a big smile and sad welcome to Montana On our return flights we were checked in very fast cleared very fast with smiles by TSA what a difference after LAXTSA The terminal and toliets are very clean

I flew with a friend to Iceland from Toronto for a day trip We were attracted to wow air because of the cheap price and direct flight to Keflavk international airport near Reykjavk It is important to note for travellers that you do have to pay for a carry on bag and pay for a checked bag so my friend and I packed our checked luggage together and split the cost however make sure to pay attention to the weight The website advertises that it needs to be kg and as long as we were under kg the attendant was fine with our bag On the flight itself there is a decent amount of space for a backpack under the seat in front and for the price youre paying its great I was blown away by the customer service on the flight there I am a very nauseous flyer typically I get motion sickness on any moving vessel I took a different type of gravol than normal and needless to say ended up vomiting times on the hour flight After the nd time I vomited they offered to move me up to premium class but I declined After the rd time they offered again to move me where I had more space to be comfortable and where there would be less intense turbulence They were so attentive and kept checking up on me to make sure I was okay They offered me cups of ice continuously and ginger ale and made su

The renewed Helsinki Airport is probably one of the best in the world at the moment The airport itself is not only beautifully designed but it works like a dream The departure lobby is equipped with multiple automatic bag drop stations with staff to help you with them The security was fast and smooth with the new machines The airside of the terminal is very clean and easy to find where to head to The variety of shops and restaurants is great too The passport control is quick with both robotic and manual checkpoints

The booking was easy via Zipair website reasonable price and good flight time The trip was pleasant in general the plane is clean new upgraded the staff were very friendly and polite and flight was on time But need to be more clear about the low price comes from not providing anything in return Like things are granted on other long flights hours for example a screen to watch movies games tv show this is unavailable on zipair there is WiFi to use on your own devices its not that strong anyway Other things are unavailable blankets no free non alcohol drinks even water I dont need to say food or snacks Thats all needed to be mentioned clearly on their website to be prepared ahead There are a few items available for purchase honestly the food could not be worse they bring it in small carton box water bottle thats it no tray no bread butter no dessert Otherwiseall good just needed to add these information and details make a plan to enjoy the trip
Regional airport not that busy Efficient checkin Services pretty basic but everything works Newer TG Business Lounge very nice
Mannheim to Berlin Great experience flying like in the past good service no queues customers first I can recommend

Was departing New Orleans two days after jazzfest Had no problems with queueing anywhere Had some time to kill before my flight and sat outside in a cool spot close to where buses depart Spent some time chatting to n airport employee Absolutely delightful polite young man

I usually fly budget so dont expect too much Had my first flight with Mihin Lanka from Chennai to Colombo Plane was not new but Im glad the flight was only hour as the seats felt like they had lost all their padding The flight went smoothly except the Stewards did not offer any option to purchase refreshments It may seem unnecessary on a short flight except by the time you have got to the airport and followed all procedures a few hours have ticked over and some refreshments would come in handy Probably what concerned me most was the fellow passenger pouring a hot drink from his flask to his wife How did that get through security There was someone on his mobile phone as we were landing The other fellow who grabbed his luggage and made his way to the front door before the plane had stopped

The airport is wellorganized secure and clean with nearly all services available The crew at Air Mauritius is extremely professional and they go above and above to execute their jobs in a courteous and professional manner Nishi the travel consultantpassenger service is amazing in terms of customer service and taking care of passengers with a smile and enthusiasm

I was pleasantly surprised I didnt run into any issues the other reviews described Yes I did need to go through immigration again but there were absolutely no lines at pm on a Thursday Every counter or checkpoint I went through whisked me through quickly and efficiently I had plenty of time to sit down for dinner before my flight and check out some of the shops The airport is clean and modern Some of the seating areas at gates are not that comfortable average but some looked better

Cape Town to Johannesburg The SLOW lounge in the Cape Town domestic terminal is a maelstrom of activity around lunchtime but at least theres an impressive spread of food Boarding was the now usual queuing on the ramp and airbridge but passengers were sensibly allowed on at both ends of the plane Service was efficient although lacking BAs homegrown friendliness The Comair fourcourse meal was adequate but not up to the best that Club Europe offers A late departure was compensated for along the way and our bags were moreorless first off the carousel Overall a decent flight
Sorong to Jayapura Flight left almost on time Aircraft clean and comfortable with friendly crew and many empty seats at the back Inflight meal only a cup of water and a little breadroll

Izmir airport is way over priced for food and drinks Most of the food outlets were empty and I cannot understand why the airport magagement dont make it more affordable I would probably use it rather than bring my own food as I will not pay these extortionate prices The airport is clean and very thorough security wise Their WiFi near impossible to get as you need a Turkish phone to recieve the special access code they send you giving you only hours of access The access code procedure was so difficult I couldnt even make out the verification letters even with my glasses on Their tightness with the WiFi doesnt do them any favours Very petty on this point

Friendly ground staff at checkin Immigration a breeze Duty free shop limited though Smoking area present in departure lounge Some restaurants available for those feeling peckishat cut throat prices considering the price VIP lounge looked cozy enough didnt go in Departure area great for plane spotting All in all a clean facility well run not overwhelmed yet

It was my first time in Yemen and flying Felix Airways The flight was only min but it was enjoyable The staff were friendly and the plane was in a good shape in addition to a comfortable seat and a nice route

Not Verified I loved this airport I have travelled to NY many times before always into JFK Now that I have discovered the wonderful Norwegian Airlines I arrived and departed NY via Stewart International It is a relatively small airport but efficient and confident There is no masses of hurrying crowds which are the tension you get at large international airports The airport is surrounded by greenery when you leave the terminal there is a brief walk across to pick up rental car taxis or the shuttle bus so relaxing For the journey home everything was relaxed fast and efficient As I mentioned it is a small airport the bar caf shop and duty free is in a small area Some people might want more but I found it more than enough All hands are on deck in the airport to get everyone on their way home Great little airport and great flights and price by Norwegian Airlines
Small but good airport the usual Japanese quality clean efficient good staff Places to shop and eat and have lots of charging spots Its so convenient to reach from the city center
Flew in and out of here on flights to and from Sao Paulo A striking modern terminal with reasonable facilities Very pleasant

Nice to Rome was only CAD total compared to other airlines charging close to per person for the same route We did expect to be a baggage fee as they charge you Euros per kg over kg but pleasantly surprised to only be charged an additional Euros total Plane clean staff were very nice The reason everyone lines up hour before the flight we didnt figure this out until too late is because seating is not assigned That being said our seats were fine and flight was great Only complaint was that the flight was hours late in arriving In their defence they had emailed our home email address a day or so before to notify us but we didnt have access to our home email so didnt find out until we arrived at the airport

One of my party fell ill on arrival at the airport an airport attendant was absolutely fantastic she immediately got a wheelchair Helped check in luggage and seen us through check in and security and seen us on the flight safely She could not have done more

Seattle to Edmonton returning Bombardier Q plane small but with comfortable seating even for a sixfooter as I am Great cabin crew and nice free drinks An inflight snack might have been nice but overall a pleasant experience

A newly started airport in North Bihar catering large population of North Bihar and even some area of NepalThe airport is actually an operative airport of Indian Airforce and runway is simultaneously used for civilian service The Terminal being used is a temporary one and a new terminal will come soon is years This airport should be seenused for service and facilities but for logistically importance for reaching some of the most undeveloped area in India with ease Terminal is one of the smallest in India but managed nicely no parking available have to park outside the campus on the road from main gate the terminal is just min walk so not an issue trolleys are there washroom are clean there is one tea and snacks shop just near main gate in the campus and use that if you need anything after that wont find anything inside Hope they construct a new terminal soon Though cabs are available outside but no option of prepaid or authorized cab inside better to book cab in advance
This is a really nice airport the arrival and departure terminal are separate which is very convenient The airport hotel was amazing

Ive traveled through this airport quite a few times due to its location bw Boston and New York Overall its a quiet airport that never seems to be too busy Theres a reasonable share of shops but none too interesting Flights are generally on time in my experiences and airport staff are helpful although you most likely may never need to utilize their assistance The signage is perfectly laid out and food cafes are sprinkled all over The new terminal and parking garage are super convenient

Orlando to London Gatwick Flight was booked for Norwegian We learned shortly before flight that we would be actually flying with HiFly Did a quick internet search and did not find any alarming negatives We were surprised to see a plain white jet pull up to the terminal We were informed that the flight would be minimally delayed by the crew The boarding process was as smooth as rude impatient customers would allow the crew handled it well The flight attendants were young fresh energetic efficient and very nice a nice change for us The flight crewcaptain informed us right away about the flight route that we were navigating around a storm that he apologized for the initial delay but that he believed we could make up the time He did just that The seats and food were what we expected in economy class so no real complaints there as I choose not to pay for upgrades All in all very favorably impressed with this airline

RGN to Mandalay Airfare considerably less than other airline Flight was on a new airbus Checkin while chaotic went well Lots of airport staff Everything was done manually with paper and counters Cabin crew well dressed and pleasant Flight was comfortable and on time

Narita to Naha Okinawa recently Flight was excellent On time clean new aircraft and great flight crew Check in and boarding no issues Professional and friendly staff Highly recommended for travel in Japan I am a world traveller and have flown many airlines Skymark is by far one of the best

I flew into Kasane International Airport onboard Mack Air a Botswanan bush airline that principally services safari lodges in the Okavango Delta area Kasane boasts a nice new and pleasant airport in spite of it seeing much more than people arriving to go to or from various safari lodges Passangers walk from the airplane into the baggage claim area which though not large is efficient and is air conditioned As we did not require an immigration or customs inspection passengers moved directly from the baggage claim area into the main terminal hall This too is very nice air conditioned clean and pleasant and transportation services are available Airport staff are friendly and there is a small shop where one can buy snacks and drinks Though small and not very busy Kasanes airport is a pleasant surprise and is from all I can tell efficient clean and staffed with pleasant and helpful folk
This quick and easy flight was made so enjoyable by the inflight quiz that Air New Zealand have on their shorthaul flights Nice inflight snacks and great crew

I fly weekly for business and flew in and out of GreenvilleSpartanburg for the last quarter of and a bit of Its a small airport with only one runway and one long concourse with arbitrary A and B separation The major airlines serve GSP but flights are limited I mostly flew on American which only seems to connect via Charlotte an mile flight First being so close to a major hub like CLT caused almost weekly delays as my flight was often held on the tarmac by CLT airtraffic control so we could fit into the traffic pattern I never actually missed my connections in Charlotte but did have several walkjogs across the airport to reach my gate while the final groups were boarding But GSP itself is nicely maintained with superfriendly staff They offered TSA PreCheck when I flew in and out I got to know the Avis rentalcar staff by name and theyd give me free upgrades Best of all if you use GSP you have to order a tuna melt from the snack counter on the lower level outside security They mix the tuna salad from scratch in front of you and make the besttasting tuna melt Ive ever eaten

I booked this flight solely because it was by far the cheapest option for me to get to my destination on new years eve I hadnt known much about Garuda Indonesia before except for the fact that its a star airline I must say I was pleasantly surprised Everything from checkin transfers food and service was excellent I was travelling with my elderly relative for whom wed requested a wheelchair for who was escorted by hand to her seat upon boarding something which Ive ever seen on another airline We had a very tight connection in Jakarta minutes which was managed very well by ground staff at all airports The ground staff at Melbourne Airport assured me that our luggage would be loaded onto the connecting flight I was panicking when our flight from Melbourne departed slightly late due to our already tight connection but the ground staff at Jakarta Airport were preprepared and were ready waiting for us to escort us quickly to our connecting flight and we thankfully made the connection Overall a great experience

I have flown tofrom RDU times now at different times and hours during I must say that it is one of the best run midtier airports in the country Beautiful and thoughtful design airy and welcoming extremely clean and efficient The security wait times have always been under mins Decent food and shopping options too Its hard to fault this one just needs to step up when it comes to wifi and entertainment options Otherwise its a great airport

We flew out of Manchester Airport on th January under very trying weather conditions The journey to the airport at am was quite fraught what with fogsnowice Our taxi driver did a great job even getting us to the airport with a challenging journey We were frankly impressed to walk into T just after am to find any number of Jet ground staff waiting to greet us I have no idea what they had to go through to get to the airport but they would all have had a snow day excuse not to turn up I asked the girl at the check in if we would actually be going to Barcelona for my husbands th and she said course you will with a broad smile Boarding was pretty much on time but then we had to sit for a while for deicing which pushed us back hours Not a problem looking at what was outside the plane Good flight outbound Crew very amenable Do wish they would look at the in flight menu now we travel a few times a year with Jet and are not mad on the food or drink offerings Maybe a refresh Inbound flight to Manchester was what you could call challenging We arrived at the airport just over hours early to find that the plane was still on the runway in Manchester The airport was closed due to snow and so it remained there for over hours Jet sent us a euro voucher each attached to our boarding passes for refreshments We looked around but a basic sandwich in the terminal was over euros This voucher should be at least euros now At last we saw the plane had left Manchester and it made good time landing We had a wave from the pilot on boarding which cheered us up We were about hours late but no compensation as weather and not airline related fair enough Just before landing at Manchester we were advised from the flight deck that a wave of fog had moved in over the airport We then completed or circular routes around the moors waiting to land Having never experienced an ILS landing in fog before it was frankly amazing considering that there appeared to be no visibility at all from the aircraft When we landed we couldnt even see the terminal buildings from the plane and the runway markings came into view just as the plane touched down So Jet did a fantastic job getting us to Barcelona in the worst weather conditions in many years and despite airport closure and fog got us back into Manchester and on the ground Thats what the pilots get paid for they probably should be paid rather more Our quibbles about the in flight food pale into insignificance when youre not on a summer flight to Greece

This was my first ever solo international trip on a new airline and I must say I came with the mindset that they would be inferior to the Japanese carriers that I always trusted However Starlux quickly proved me wrong and made me feel guilty for having such a narrowminded mindset Checkin in San Francisco took less than minutes and so did TSA PreCheck Boarding was orderly and not chaotic and once I stepped inside the plane I was welcomed by a friendly cabin crew The cabin designed by BMW Designworks was absolutely glamorous luxurious and clean My seat K was absolutely comfortable with plenty of features and items waiting to be used in this hour flight Blankets pillows headphones and even a bag of amenity kits were provided The IFE screen was the size of my laptop which was something to marvel at Starlux really took into account the fact that every person has their own favorite way to access and scroll through contents which was why they programmed the IFE to let users decide how the contents will be laid out The contents were plenty and the system itself was very responsive The crews were absolutely fantastic to the point that I must say they were too kind in a good way because they went as far as giving me a bag of souvenirs for free and a thank you card If there was anything that was worth calling out on this flight it was the food The dinner I had the roasted chicken with potatoes with chili sauce was a bit too spicy for my liking but was still delicious and the fish congee I had for breakfast was absolutely tasteless and it killed my appetite I however appreciate the continuous service of beverages rice crackers and light snacks every to minutes Landing in Taiwan was minutes ahead of schedule and I was immediately sent to the next flight without any nonsense The flight to Singapore again operated by an A with the same glamorous bodacious and comfortable cabin IFE and seats also had the same kind nice energetic and compassionate cabin crews who again went as far as giving me extra drink and souvenirs but the thing that made this flight slightly better than the previous was the fact that the deconstructed beef bibimbapstyle food that I had was absolutely divine WiFi on both flights was functional but it did take a while for me to connect although after further investigation it was an error on my phones behalf Landing in Singapore was slightly behind schedule but the fast baggage delivery made things much easier When I purchased this ticket Starlux gave me the third cheapest option and for the price I paid they surpassed my expectations and surprised me With the exception of the food that I got during my SFOTPE leg I enjoyed every single moment of my first two flights on Starlux Airlines and these two flights were the first two flights where I actually felt like I did not want to leave the plane and wanted to stay longer inside it Starlux was that good and everyone who had never tried it should try it ASAP You will not regret spending a thousand dollars on this airline

Old airport but reconstruction going on Very efficient immigration on the way in with separate lane for business class Fast delivery of luggage as well took me less than minutes to be out of the airport Departure wise a little bit slower but acceptable friendly immigration and security people very basic business lounge Departure procedure efficient despite lack of discipline of Chinese passengers always trying to jump queues

I travel from Limoges to and from Paris The terminal is a little bit small but it is very clean There is a not a very long queue time and the staff were very proactive At this airport there is one bar and one restaurant but there are no lounges or dutyfree The boarding area is very small and there is not much seating This is a little but very efficient airport

Though it is small it is one of the best efficient and beautifully designed international airports in the Philippines Been using it when I am visiting for business and leisure and Im not disappointed everytime I used this airport I do hope the government will expand this soon

A late night flight pm delayed by almost minutes is not the most pleasant beginning to the journey especially given the horrible Encalm Lounge in Delhi dirty crowded rubbish food However the onboard experience was amazing the A has lieflat seats with large IFE screens which is a treat since I could sleep comfortably for over an hour in a less than hour flight The cabin crew were prompt helpful and very attentive Upto food choices and a pretty good spread The IFE screens were great and the entertainment catalog is good enough for a short domestic flight but would be a bit boring for a hour or above flight However baggage claim experience was not the best despite the baggage being priority tagged it arrived after of the copassengers in the flight had received their bags and when you are running over an hour late it was a bit frustrating

Departed and arrived at Darwin on an international flight from Dili Timor Leste As we were the only flight out and then back in an Airnorth Embraer seating passengers we had the international part of the airport to ourselves Darwin Airport has been refurbished over the last couple of years and is now a midsized regional airport with good facilities There are two times of day around am to pm and pm to am when due to the peculiarities of Australian airport curfews down south Darwin Airport is very busy But it still copes Outside these hours it is quite relaxed with short queues I find the ground staff and even security to be polite efficient and even cheerful and there is an adequate range of food and shopping outlets Virgin and Qantas have good lounges in the domestic section of the airport there is a small paylounge once you have gone through passport controls and the usual nonsense of the obstacle course of an overpriced duty free shop blocking the way between immigration and the departure lounge On this occasion as previously from checking in to the departure lounge took about twenty minutes and a similar amount of time between landing and catching a taxi

This is my home airport whilst small it has a basic array of services and amenities you would expect from a larger airport The terminal looks pretty fresh and is thoroughly modern There isnt much landside although there are a couple of shops and restaurants for basic needs The security areas move promptly and the transborder security is easy to get through because there arent that many US departures Once youre airside the domesticinternational area is quite good with a decent array of shops and restaurants This is a small airport so youre out of luck if youre hoping for luxury goods but you can find many of the basic items you might need The seating areas are bright with plenty of glass to let in the prairie sunshine There are two lounges including a small but comfortable Maple Leaf Lounge Transborder is a different story While its an improvement over the tiny TB area in the old terminal its still a very small space with only one restaurant TGI Fridays and a Tim Hortons kiosk that only sells coffee donuts and not much else Baggage claim runs efficiently although its not in a secure area which always makes me nervous Customs tends to process people quickly Transportation is easy with a good array of car rentals onsite and very convenient bus transportation downtown The airport is not that far from the city centre so a bus is actually a pretty good option Also there is free WiFi and washrooms are generally clean and well kept if somewhat small There are three airport hotels a short walk outside and at least two of them have restaurants All things considered Winnipeg Airport delivers what you would expect it to

The Seat I sat in seat A next to the window this seat was spacious and much better than other airlines Ive flown in this region There was ample legroom the width was reasonable and the window on the Embraer was large as normal The configuration of the cabin is interesting and is incredible due to lacking a middle seat The Service The staff were perfectly friendly kind and polite with us and offered us gingerbread men and water during the flight The gingerbread was better than I expected and the water was normal The Ground Service The flight was perfectly on time and we landed on schedule The boarding was normal and was completely seamless which was surprising at Gatwick Overall the flight was seamless and comfortable I booked this flight using miles so I cant comment on the price but I would definitely recommend Helvetic Airlines if you are flying to Switzerland over lowcost airlines like EasyJet in the same region
The new terminal is really fresh and at the domestic departure some airlines merge in the same area and you can check in at any queue Everything looks good

I specifically chose to fly with TransNusa to try out flying on the COMAC ARJ of which the carrier currently operates two of these aircraft at the moment and is also the first airline in the world outside of China to operate this small commercial jetliner Thankfully there wasnt much of a negative experience everything from checkin to boarding to the inflight experience was prompt and precise even if it werent spectacular As TransNusa opts for a singleclass layout the aircraft has a capacity of passengers seated in rows of The smaller capacity of the aircraft meant that boarding and disembarkation was completed fairly quickly and smoothly Arguably the only sore point of the flight was having to use a bus to board the aircraft instead of using an aerobridge TransNusa includes kg of checked bags as part of the basic air ticket so thats a nice gesture to have Despite having to land in heavy rain at KLIA the entire journey was uneventful and decently pleasant and it suggests that the COMAC ARJ will prove a contender in the regional small commercial jetliner market in the years to come

Flew Waterford to Birmingham on th January Nice little airport staff very friendly Small cafe before departure excellent coffee and light snacks Security and boarding very well handled An enjoyable experience
Very comfortable and the staff were really nice our flight was not delayed it was wonderful flying with HiSky as it was my first time flying with them and had a wonderful experience

Bahrains new airport has given me a satisfying experience as I found the place really simple big enough and neat I must say that it seemed also like a planespotters paradise since they have these huge glass windows that gives an almost unobstructed view by gate area and also a rooftop experience from The Terrace In my point of view the only downside is the limited Internet and when you have not enough money to spend for food Im also glad that the playroom at the bottom of their huge central LED screen is free for everyone to enjoy and wheelchair accessible as well which is absolutely a big plus Also the airport didnt seem too crowded and I hope it stays that way

Ive flown through this airport or times now and its always a good experience Its a lovely modern building the staff are very helpful securitycustomsimmigration has always been quick and painless It only takes mins by train they have a decent airport hotel located in the domestic arrivals terminal and its always spotless

Nanjing to Kunming on a new B As I was sitting in in seat F had a lot of legroom Cabin crew was excellent I was served a tasty dish on the hour flight For the return flight the ground staff Ticketing Desk in Kunming was outstanding

I flew in January with Edelweiss from Zurich to Cape Town with my friend Everything was excellent from the very beginning The crew was very nice and helpful answered all my questions accurately and professionally On the way from Cape Town we transferred to another flight in Zurich to Budapest The crew informed us about the ground gate the time of departure and all the necessary information needed for the transfer The food was fine the whole flight went quickly and I was very satisfied I will definitely choose this company for future flights The aircraft was clean tidy and everything met my expectations The toilets were also in great condition and clean The crew at the airport was very nice and helpful
Beautiful airport in Orange County with incredible ease to all major interstates Airport sits off the and is perfectly situated for Los Angeles visitors Large airport with a small town feel

Traveled to Manaus many times found the airport good with easy access to car park Staff nice security not too long a queue shops etc are standard airport stuff Would recommend early arrival and double check all documentation you need to travel Stop to look at the turtles outside the terminal in their own pond
Small airport with few but good services Reasonable time to check in and pass passport checks Excessively expensive duty free It offers a good free wifi service also available outside the air side

Manado airport is one of the best in Indonesia It has a small delay rate and has a very good view from the waiting room The airport terminal faces east of Manado and oversees the beautiful nature and mountain ranges with the planes takingoff and landing
Very nice airport Small short ways with quick checkin short TSA waits short Gate walks and free wifi for minutes

My first time flying with Malindo now Batik Air Fabulous experience smooth checkin luggage included Friendly attentive staff Much more comfortable seats that either Air Asia or Jetstar Good pricing I have already booked another flights Impressive economy airline for the price you pay

The Airport is clean and well put together Food options have increased after adding KFC and TGI Fridays alongside Burger King The guy at the checkin counter gave us a hard time because he kept enquiring about our Singapore Visas even though for Bahrainis going to Singapore there is a Visa on Arrival and I kept telling him that Id been to Singapore times already and Id never had to apply for a predeparture Visa but he kept asking his colleagues about it The staff at the Pearl Lounge were friendly and I loved the free Evian Bottles

Competent and efficient flights Delay in Geneva handled well captain came to boarding gate to explain Comfort seats had good leg room even on a A sandwich and drink served on each flight of just over an hour

New airport building opened in August Large and airy construction gives a positive feeling to airport experience International Arrivals involve a bit of walking to the Baggage Reclaim and International Arrivals which happen on the ground floor Car Rental Caf and Bureau de Change all within the terminal building Bus Taxi and Tram are out by the front door Undercover walkways connect to short stay car parks Departures are on the st floor with the usual automated checkin Security pretty quick with more capacity when things get busy The Departure Lounge overlooks the end of the runway and has air bridges to most departure gates some bus departures for small aircraft parked remotely Good selection of shops and cafes A big improvement on the old terminal building

Dane County Regional is a cute little airport lying on the outskirts of Madison and it has had some of the best services I have ever experienced at any airport The airport is incredibly clean and attractive on the inside and the outside This includes nice modern architecture on the outside and mosaic flooring and stained glass handling lights It may not have as many stores as other airports but there is a store for nearly all travel needs such as a Cafe a restaurant a travel store and a Wisconsin Gear store I also noted that there were multiple stores under construction There are hardly any delays and MSN connects to nearly all large nearby airports which provides excellent connection availability The best part was the incredibly fast Wifi and charger ports in the waiting area

An excellent short flight with great onboard service from a friendly attentive cabin crew Leg room was ok and the seats were comfortable enough for a short flight Overall a good experience and good value
Plane clean and on time Ran out of water after row economy Its a short flight so bring back water in seat pockets of you cant cope No coffee tea or drinks for anyone

I fainted in the flight and where some crew may have panicked in some cases this crew handled the situation very well Provided me with all the necessary assistance and first aid and was very kind and humble till the end

I enjoyed lengthy stop overs here on a recent flight to BKK in Biz class with Gulf Air The airport is amazing clean and transit was smooth The lounge was fantastic and food and drinks were excellent Staff throughout the airport were amenable and friendly Overall it is a much less stress free and agreeable experience in comparison to transit through Doha or Dubai

Easy to get around It was the perfect size for someone on foot The staff seemed like a small town community Everyone seemed to be in effective communication with each other Traveler satisfaction was clearly a priority for the staff at Akron Canton airport I felt a good positive energy there I liked the choices of food and beer that were available throughout the gates I liked how well my emotional support dog was greeted and welcomed into the airport and on all three flights I took home I will fly to and from this airport in the future

Bangkok to Yangon What a pleasant surprise Clean aircraft Pleasant professional and efficient crew Ontime performance Tasty snack for the short flight Even the preflight service was great email requests for special requests were answered within an hour True star service

Flew Larnaca to Manchester on the th July Excellent flight arrived in Manchester early after a perfect flight All crew pleasant and attentive Food on board was very good also the in flight entertainment Have flown Cobalt several times and will continue to do so when travelling to Cyprus
Beautiful airport in Orange County with incredible ease to all major interstates Airport sits off the and is perfectly situated for Los Angeles visitors Large airport with a small town feel

Graz is an excellent small airport which has expanded in the last few years and now sees scheduled flights to as far as Luxor as well as German and Austrian destinations plus the UK with Ryanair They have the best answer yet seen to long security queues they immediately open another scanner when the queues build up again yet another sometyhing some of the bigger airports would do well to emulate A good restaurant is available although once passing through security snacks and drinks are all that is available They also prove that Priority Boarding can work with buses being used with Priority Boarding passengers be directed to one bus which goes to the aircraft first Only when those people have boarded do any other buses leave for the plane The train service has improved greatly over the last couple of years although still sparse on Sundays with at least an hourly service into Graz Staff always seem to be very friendly as well based on around a dozen trips through there in the last two years

HELOSL Checkin was rude and dismissive but otherwise the flight had very nice crew and the plane was spotless clean as well BOB meal is cheaper on Blue than on SAS due to the currency and I found the quality to be rather reasonable as well Ontime departure and arrival in Oslo Ticket price was great as usual

Business classenjoyed a drink of champagne and some refreshments upon taking a seat and theres plenty of room to stretch out Particularly on their trips from Dubai An amazing collection of Englishlanguage movies spanning every possible genre

I expected the worst but to my surprise its one of the smoothest flight I have ever hard Everything was good other than the seats that needs a mattress to make them comfortable for sleeping The staff were good I will fly it anytime I prioritise feeling safe

Genoa airport compares extremely well with our huge overcrowded and understaffed London airports It is nice and small with lovely shops and good cafes There are no long queues at check in or security and staff are friendly and helpful A pleasure to visit

I used Wakkanai Airport to fly out to Tokyo Haneda It is located about minutes away from Wakanai city There are only four flights per day by All Nippon Airlines two in and two out to Haneda and a city in Hokkaido The three storey building is clean modern and spacious Checkin is on the ground floor second floor is the arrival and departure gates and third floor is the viewing gallery Gift shop and a small restaurant are on the second floor just next to the securitydeparture The airport is on an open field with no other buildings nearby Wakkanai Park which the Japan Cup sled dog racing is held here annually in the winter is opposite the airport Like most Japanese regional airports Wakkanai airport is very much under utilized The ground staff are polite and efficient

We had an absolutely delightful experience with Privilege Style The staff were very nice and accommodating Seating was exactly as expected and food was fine enough for a flight meal Thank you for a great experience We look forward to flying Privilege again

ODSIEV on a new ATR having small screens for the safe announcements and you can see some comics during the hour minutes flight Flight was full but service was ok they offered refreshment Staff were very friendly and we were on time Overall very nice experience

Convenient location only mins from the Mosque Excellent modern facilities Nice simple elegant layout with steelwork reflecting date palm trees Convenient location of cafetarias toilets and prayer rooms Friendly staff and security personnel Clean and tidy Ample seating facilities

Ground staff of LAN was ok not overwhelming nice but ok Seats in row ok IFE slow and quality ok Service of FA was good friendly and attentive Quality of food as you can expect in eco We had a transit at GRU to SCL and had to pass a security check where our water bought at FRA was taken Strange Upon arrival at FRA I had a damaged piece of baggage But the ground staff wasnt interested in any way of alpologizing but pointed out the rules for such case only Overall nothing special but a decent choice to travel to South America on long haul

I returned this week from Tyumen to Munich Another B this time with vintage business cabin and seats As I was alone in the section I missed the Europeanstyle seats that would have allowed me to completely lie down instead of sitting with a recline Crew were smiling and helping with more polyglot aptitudes than during my preceding flight Excellent tasty lunch with Sardinian I checked red wine Takeoff and landing right on time I shall not hesitate to fly with UTair again
