Portlands airport feels slightly dated not run down by any means but still pleasant and functional enough A lot of construction taking place at this time in the checkin area I guess in an effort to modernize the airport and expand passenger capacity The terminals themselves again are a little dated but still nice enough and functional TSA PreCheck operates smoothly here even where there are a lot of PreCheckers in line Personnel whether theyre working at checkin for TSA in a restaurant or at the boarding gate are usually super bubbly but still professional helpful and polite PDX is neither stellar nor bad its aboveaverage but with a lot of potential And its better than SeaTac

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Travelled from here to Canada via Amsterdam apart from hideously expensive cafe its always a pleasure to travel from here Check in and security excellent and baggage pick up very quick its small size makes it virtually stress free

The airport is pretty clean Though its small its pretty cute like a park or resort This uniqueness suits the vacation vibe of the beautiful island of Koh Samui Different types of seating areas are available there are a few shops diners and a caf Checkin and immigration were both very efficient A courtesy corner full of snacks and drinks is available for free to all passengers However I wasnt able to connect to the airport WiFi

JAL economy class is outstanding The seats are the widest in the business if a bit hard and the food was healthy and tasty Flight attendants were polite and attentive My only complaint is that the offerings on the inflight entertainment service were subpar it was hard to find a movie that rose above mediocre
Kiev to Odessa but they serve sandwiches and the whole range of beverages B clean Plenty of legroom Flight was ontime Its worth the money

BOGMZLBOG I took them from Bogota to Manizales when I was visiting Colombia in December The crew was fantastic airport staff was polite The planes were new comfortable and service was great Tickets were very reasonable but book them early through the website to take advantage of the promotional fares which could equal US round trip depending on where you are going and how early you book
Havana Cayo Coco return A one hour flight with an old ATR turboprop Seats surprisingly comfortable and we were offered a free drink plus candy onboard Nothing special but we arrived on time

This review is for Terminal Terminal is dramatically different RGN has undergone vast changes during the last years There remain remnants of the underdeveloped facility that once was but the outside world has arrived in Yangon and at least as far as the airport is concerned it is a good thing CustomsImmigration at both arrival and departure is reasonably fast On the absolute worst day you might wait minutes but an average wait will be minutes or less Lines at check in counters move quickly which is terrific Departure lounges are a lot nicer than they once were Now they sport clean comfortable spaces dependable WiFi and food that works in a pinch Restaurants in the airport are not great but if you want a decent cup of coffee some KFC a Burger King something or other youll be ok Souvenir and duty free shops still have a long way to do Alcohol and cigarettes are fairly priced There are perennially empty luxury clothing brands without customers There are a couple of small boutiques selling attractive textiles carvings local bath products delicious local coffees etc Services are generally more than adequate in the predeparture areas There is a bag wrapping counter for flimsy luggage convenience stores plenty of seating free WiFi etc Taxis downtown should be priced out before you leave Money Change desks offer the exact same rate as all the other places in the country so theres no reason to hold on to your foreign currency The airport is still a work in progress but leaving and arriving in this amazing city is a lot less unpleasant than a few years back

The brand new terminal is now open and is spectacular Any deficiencies from previous reviews are now remedied More gates with jetways more shops and restaurants Check in was seamless as was immigration facilities Clean and modern and when the new train system is functioning it will be easy to get into the city

Late evening arrival into CFU on the th May arriving minutes early from EMA Deplaned quickly and minimal delay at passport control only due to people disembarking at the same time there were also several friendly assistants to help manage the queue and answer any questions Baggage was starting to appear on the carousel as we entered the collection area so again no great delay and straight out to waiting transport On our return journey early evening departure th May small queue for checkin and baggage drop Plenty of friendly JET staff to assist and pre tag cabin baggage so maybe a minute delay but the queue was inside the building and checkin desks open Security again was very quick with only about people in front of us whilst I wouldnt say the security staff were unfriendly they were perhaps best described as efficient Then into the departure lounge with more than enough seating for all the waiting passengers from various flights with a variety of shops and food and drink establishments available Again passport control to gates was fast and friendly with no great delay and even at the gates there was food and drink available which looked very appetising Flight boarded quickly and departed about minutes behind schedule It has to be said that since the completion of the refurbishment of this airport the experience is vastly improved The toiletswashrooms are no longer an area to be feared and requiring a bio hazard suit to use The whole airport is clean and bright with sufficent staff on hand There is also a greater choice of food and drinks available So a really pleasant and relaxing experience flying into and out of Corfu compared with previous occasions

I would like to express my extreme gratitude to staff who managed to retrieve some personal items belonging to my son I which we left onboard plane on flight in from New York early last Wednesday morning Due to their quick actions we managed to reclaim these items from the plane before it headed out to Heathrow on next flight They were extremely efficient very friendly two great ambassadors for Shannon airport We are very grateful to them both for their assistance in turning what could have been a holiday disaster into a very pleasant experience with Shannon airport They both deserve special recognition for their excellent customer skills

Moscow Domodedovo to Minsk My previous experience with this airline was quite negative but this time there were almost nothing critical to complain on The procedure of online booking and check in was smooth and quick recently Belavia introduced lowcost tariffs without checked baggage etc which allowed to make prices more reasonable Ground procedures in Domodedovo were rather slow but this is not an airlines fail Onboard experience was great I was lucky to get modern aircraft because Belavia still operates some ancient Boeing Classic but this time it was a new B instead Cabin crew were awesome There was even a meal service hamcheese sandwiches despite the flight is just h long What was rather disappointing bussing to terminal instead of jet bridge both in DME and MSQ Maybe they have a reason for this but in both airports I saw a lot of vacant jet bridges Also cabin was very cramped like in lowcost carriers Possibly they are managing to cut costs in such a way I criticize Belavia often for cosmic prices on European destinations for old aircraft for monopoly on flying to MSQ from several destinations especially European for Sovietstyle of management that one can face sometimes but this particular flight was rather nice

Arrived at the airport and one of the customer service agents was very helpful He helped me with picking up my luggage connecting to WiFi and was very friendly His name was Houssem Thank you so much for all the hard work

When I landed in Anchorage late at night the first thing I noticed was how busy the terminal was I was really hungry after a long hour flight from LAX so the first thing I did was grab something to eat from Cinnabon one of many restaurants at this airport Baggage claim experience was smooth Taxi was readily available outside for transportation to hotel While returning back I had a very smooth checkin and security experience If you enjoy watching beautiful scenery and planes Anchorage will not disappoint As you walk around the terminal you will notice many photo opportunities both inside and outside the terminal

Bluegrass is an amazing airport that I have flown into and out of numerously with nothing but positive experiences until this July To start Ill tell what all I like about Bluegrass Firstly pickup dropoff and parking are almost a joke theyre so easy Absolutely no hassle ever Secondly the terminal was fairly modern to begin with even before the remodel about a decade ago and now its a wellflowing wellorganized airport as if it already wasnt Thirdly while there are very few shopping and dining options and theyre really only open during peak traffic volume hours this is to be expected for such a tiny airport what options are available are of pretty high quality plus Dunkin Donuts at least last time I checked Fourthly baggage claim is efficient even by tiny airport standards That said if nothing is open presecurity theres a piddly little coffee and hot chocolate machine that doesnt seem to work and when it does it doesnt seem to work right Fifth personnel from airport checkins to security to gate agents to store staff are usually very friendly attentive and kind its like Bluegrass is a sort of big small town Sadly however when I flew out in July there was an exception to that friendliness When I flew out the TSA PreCheck line was closed so I had no choice to go through the regular TSA line Okay fine but the guy who checked my drivers license barely even moved his eyes The officers at the scanner were more pleasant but still made me take almost everything out of my backpack thankfully I didnt have much to take out but I dont remember having to empty out so many little details from my bag while flying anywhere around the country or world It was just a bazaar experience Thankfully security are still efficient and the gates are only a minute walk from security so I still made my flight in the nick of time but that particular experience was just aggravating Overall Bluegrass is a fine airport that sets the gold standard for what tiny but very functional airports should be but I sure wish all of its TSA folks understood the concept of PreCheck

From Zanzibar to Arusha ATR arrived on time from Dar el Salam Friendly staff and they offer snack and juices and alcoholic drinks On arrival our suitcases arrived in a short time Overall good experience

Tontouta Airport is a building dating back to the s offering basic facilities However it is undergoing an amazing expansion and facelift which looks promising modern with pleasant architecture and more userfriendly The new airport should be completed by On arrival pax climb down steps and cross the airparking zone to enter the airport There are fivesix immigration booths open per flight however the quarantine service is small and slow Tontouta airport is a no smoking area The departure hall is of reasonable size for the current traffic and the ground staff is friendly The caf is expensive and basic but it could be worse The whole airport is a free WIFI zone On departure after checking in the luggage pax often wait long minutes in a line to perform the immigration and security controls The police and security staff are usually friendly enough though cruelly lacking the ability to communicate in English The boarding lounge where the gates are located is well air conditioned though boring The main features being a largish dutyfree shop and a caf on the st floor The business class lounge is comfortable and obviously more interesting There is a postoffice and a bank in both arrival and boarding lounges for money exchange however the only ATM distributor is in the main hall across from the souvenir shop

Long Beach is a great little airport It has the most efficient TSA checkpoint I have ever seen with the longest line ever being about three minutes and I fly through here quite often While the south concourse is the only gate area I have used I am sure the airport is the same throughout the terminal The staff is great and friendly and you can chat with everyone The gate numbering can be a bit confusing but so long as you dont immediately exit the terminal to the left you should be fine They even give you an umbrella when it rains to walk onto the plane

I have been flying from Mangalore International Airport domestically for a very long time Ill be honest the checkin baggage claim or the security is just literally the same like any other airport with less people The airport is calm and clean Restrooms are provided The only drawback is there is no source of recreation and entertainment here We have a couple of eateries but very very very limited WiFi is provided But when we speak about shopping Dont depend on Mangalore Airport it has nothing Trust me nothing The last time I visited there was a food stall at the ground floor and an umbrellaraincoat shop and a metal item store at the first floor That is it No clothes no alcohol no McDonalds etc But all in all its a good airport I mean its catering for the needs of Mangalorians Arrival also went very smooth

This is a good smaller airport to fly in and out of The terminal is new and it shows Also staff are friendly and helpful This terminal is also well located as it is actually on the outskirts of the city not outside of the city In addition it is served by local transit However there is one accessibility issue While the lanes for commercial providers are covered and wide there is only a lane uncovered pickup area on the arrivals level for private vehicles This results in congestion during heavier arrival times

Departure from Louisville was excellent the First Class checkin was efficient and fast with great service from the American Eagle ground staff Security was quick about ten minutes to line up and go through the security they are using the new body scanners now which improve and speed up the process The TSA staff as polite and very professional and ensure that your time with them is minimal as well as ensuring standards are kept After security the Lounge is good with excellent views over the runways aircraft Boarding areas are clean and airy with plenty of seating for passengers

I am only writing this review because so many things are off about this airport I definitely expected more as its a huge airport with tons of revenue from the gaming here The companion care restroom was locked as someone who needs this restroom and cannot use the other ones I was waiting for about minutes I knocked several times After minutes I called the courtesy phone operator concerned that someone was in there and unwell or unconscious No one responded then another person called on his own volition and still no one came This is a HUGE security concern After minutes a line was forming so I flagged down a lovely custodian who unlocked the door and discovered thankfully no one was inside He explained It was locked in the night to prevent people from sleeping in it The fact it was not unlocked during the night in the morning means this airport was not ADA compliant and the fact that no body came after securityrelated calls were made to the operator means this airport does not have quick response to security concerns Its filthy theres food crumbs coffee dust and crud on every surface and many chairs The charging stations barely work at least in the AA terminal and nearly all of the USB direct ports are full of grey putty while the ones that arent full of putty dont charge and are loose and broken The staff here are lovely but the facilities are dismal and frankly this place is a security nightmare As a bay area resident I will never fly through here again and will never recommend this airport with a definite preference for connecting CLEAN SAFE airports like Denver IAHHobby Atlanta or Chicago

Nice surprise as an Italian I appreciated a lot the food which could be bought on board Pasta alla Norma Red wine Valpolicella Professional and friendly staff tasting and authentically Italian food Proud as Italian to feel these kind of attentions to flyers Strongly suggested

I flew on Ravn Alaska with my girlfriend back in February We flew from Anchorage to Homer and back with ease The flight was brief and enjoyable The staff were friendly and welcoming Checkin a breeze Boarding a breeze Baggage pickup a breeze The overall experience was fantastic Looking forward to flying with Ravn again and taking in those unforgettable Alaska sights

I agree entirely with Fernando Immigration staff also very helpful as well as friendly and efficient Only problem now is the collapsed bridge on the road to Caracas A diversion has been made but is only two lanes and is operated on a tidal system Can add an hour or two to the journey

IND is one of our two main options along with CVG when flying Both are excellent Traveling from Indy this week reminded me why I like it In morning and afternoon there are multiple good choices and most are reasonably priced in comparison to many other world airports crowds are nowhere near some airports so it is easy to move around TSA has always been friendly and efficient unlike some airports restrooms are generally cleaner than many other airports We do wish there were a couple of direct flights options to Europe but for flying domestically we like IND

The main issue I had as a transit passenger at Douala International Airport was that you cannot go strait to international departures after arriving on an international flight I had electronically checked in for my connection flight already I arrived from Malabo on Ethiopian and traveled onward to Johannesburg on South African Airways I had to enter through customs and got issued with a transit visa free and then had to exit through customs again to international departures Once in the departure terminal there is a business lounge that you can also enter for US if you travel economy It looks like they are busy upgrading the place so all considering it is ok
Flew Tokyo Narita Sapporo Tokyo Narita Flight from Narita was on time while from Sapporo to Narita was delayed for hour Overall flight was ok Ground staff very professional
Yangon to Lashio in November ATR plane Allocated seating and good snack served with excellent customer service Would fly with them again any time

There are substantial and ongoing improvements to Freetown Airport They have been rebuilding the terminal building around the old structure for the last few months Departure and arrival procedures are now quite painless compared with the hot and basic conditions before The check in area is large and clean and I did not have to queue for long They could still do with increasing the air conditioning in that area though Security is good and immigration is using new computers and biometric systems The departure lounge is now quite big and comfortable There are a few well stocked duty free shops The original restaurant is still available as well as a new one upstairs The new one is not well signposted Overall a big improvement FNA now compares favourably with other airports in Africa

Porto to Paris Orly on ZI A on March First time on this airline and Im a little bit unimpressed with checkin at Porto Airport No effort to direct passengers to correct boarding desks hence I ended up in the webcheck inbagdrop queue with passengers who had not even checked in online Thankfully queue was processed within minutes and got to the gate with plenty of time to spare My seat was next to the emergency exit so I had plenty of legroom Seat itself was comfy and perfect for a nap Crew extremely professional and always had a smile on their faces Flight took off on time and landed smoothly in ParisOrly minutes ahead of scheduled arrival time Once on the ground we were told by the cabin crew that the captain of this Aigle Azur flight had piloted his last flight so we promptly congratulated him as we departed the aircraft All in all Aigle Azur was worth the money that I paid Not sure if Ill have another chance to travel on them again but if they have routes that I want to fly Ill keep them in mind

The obligatory show of your boarding pass on boarding the plane Dont expect duty free air conditioned waiting areas business lounges or facilities smiles hello thank you goodbye catering information desk assistance even from airline representatives or toilet facilities and you wont be left disappointed But once outside the Worlds Worst Airport you will meet the most pleasant courteous and honest people that I have ever personally encountered Welcome to the real Sudan

Nice clean and quiet little airport with good cafeteria Also the departure area has free Internet if you need to check your email before boarding I thought that was a nice touch We flew out of Plymouth on an Air Southwest flight and their staff are wonderful The only downside for us was an overzealous security officer That aside Plymouth has a lovely little airport and a super airline in Air Southwest will certainly fly with them again

Conakry is in no way a modern airport even quite old But its management is stunning I have been through this airport a great number of times over the years and am always impressed by its efficiency especially arrivals In minutes you get through immigration and then at the luggage carousel something Ive never seen in the possibly airports I know luggage trolleys are already positioned in front of the carousel so very convenient Unfortunately to leave the airport is somewhat difficult especially for elder people as you have to push you trolley on a pretty steep ramp before exiting the airport Also departure area needs to be modernized

Being first time flyers with Rex we were delighted with the personal service at airports and in the air Assisted with booking in luggage and seating details Being tall enough leg room to be comfortable We would choose to fly rex whenever possible

There are two options for getting from Dar es Salaam to Zanzibar a twohour ferry journey or a minute flight The main airlines flying this route are Auric Air and Air Tanzania Ordering the ticket via Opodo was easy and the airline operates from Terminal a small building about km from the main terminals Checkin was efficient and the waiting room had several powerful air conditioning units You could even buy food and drink Tickets were checked and we were walked across to the Cessna It had three seats in each row and although tight it was not uncomfortable It only had a pilot and we flew at about feet giving us a clear view of the sea and then the island It ended with a very smooth landing close to the terminal

The flight was great However it could still improve Bring your own tablets as the IFE systems were kind of laggy and the choices were very limited The seats were quite hard and on my nd flight the seat recline was broken so I had to manually force it back to the original position The food was wonderful and so were the staff

We were on a chartered flight taking a group of very special kids to Lourdes in France Team were so friendly and welcoming Lovely comfy accommodation clean and spacious Lovely touch was a special package snack for our VIPs Thank you Titan

Heho to Yangon The aircraft was pretty new and very clean We have been greeted with a smile and the personnel was kind and professional We have been served some basic breakfast that for such a short flight was appreciated Flight on time and overall very comfortable and enjoyable experience

A small airport serving the capital Its a bit of a chaotic place long queues staff arent the friendliest and generally messy The terminal itself is clean tho and seating is comfortable As its the only major airport in the country this it what they can offer Taxi trip to the center is lek

Flew via Halifax on way from Heathrow to Toronto As its a pretty small airport theres not that much to do apart from look at the lobsters in the lobster shop we couldnt believe it when so many people were boarding planes carrying lobster boxes There are a few eateries both land and airside which are not wildly overpriced just average food on offer Tim Hortons provided a decent sandwich Overall we quite enjoyed the hours we spent there though If you go up the lift in the main concourse area theres a small viewing platform room which is a calm and relaxing place to be We watched the few planes that came in and out for minutes before going through security Everywhere there are plenty of staff to offer help all dressed in lovely tartan uniforms and without exception totally friendly There is also free wifi so we took full advantage of that We did ask one member of staff if we had time to go and see Halifax She replied in a friendly but blunt way Youd have to take a bus to get there and theres not really much to see anyway Its small but clean efficient and did the job for the few hours stopover
Nepal Airlines is a cheap option for direct flights from Nepal with good service Nepal Airlines improved its service over time The cabin crew were professional and meal served was good

Copenhagen to Keflavk in Saga Class on a MAX Saga Class is Icelandairs take on Business Class comfortable though not quite a true premium offering The seats are spacious with generous pitch though they do not recline into a flatbed That said for a short threehour flight this is hardly a drawback Service was quintessentially Icelandair friendly efficient and professionally businesslike Among options connecting Iceland to Europe and the Nordics Icelandair remains the most comfortable premium choice Complimentary WiFi was a welcome perk for Saga Class passengers though connectivity proved inconsistent

Really good experience Security was busy but extremely efficient I was travelling with far too many laptops locked in security bags long story which obviously raised eyebrows Everything got searched lots of questions asked but so friendly and professional that it was really no hassle Couldve been awful but was actually as pleasant as it could have been Great burger surprise at Carls once airside Seating around the gates is a bit uncomfortable but its there and theres enough of it The gate itself was efficiently managed and theres room without a horrible crush All in all a good experience and one Id be happy to repeat
This airport is small Traffic is quite convenient and the number of stores is small The airport is very clean and tidy and the waiter is polite

Absolute and stunning perfection in everything Crew are the best wonderful and polite people who are there to make your journey a great part of your day Please treat your crew nicely they are literally one of the best and I fly a lot times a month

The airport has basic facilities and I think it works when it has little traffic The staff are nice and friendly There are very limited options if you want to eat something at the airport After the security there are only two cafes without good meal options The seating at the gates is limited Most of the gates are located upstairs with limited space Considering the fact that passengers arrive and depart from the same gates they sometimes get very crowded

Thessaloniki to Athens I was pleasantly surprised by the service on this short flight approx min Service was quick good selection of drinks and small candies and biscuits Friendly staff aircraft was clean The crew are ready to assist the passengers I will be happy to fly them again

As much as people complain I found entering Pearson to be a breeze The whole process of disembarking walking and clearing immigration went quickly and I was through within minutes most of that walking and enjoying a coffee while I waited for my bus The staff were courteous and pleasant On my departure once again seamless with efficient customs officials Terminal has improved the seating and I was impressed As always the beer is overpriced but tell me an airport where it isnt The PA announcements were very clear a bonus compared to a good number of airports I have been through Maybe it was just the day but the complimentary WiFi kept kicking out after minutes or so Overall no complaints

Flew last week from Munich to Tyunmen TJM Siberia B with Europeanstyle business cabin middle seat free Smooth checkin my coat was taken by a smiling attendant but no help to put my kg luggage in the locker No entertainment during the hours journey redeye but more than decent meal with appetisers and good Chilean wine I hope that my return flight in two days will be at least as peaceful although the linguistic capacities of the crew should be improved

Barra is an amazing airport its tiny shed like and has few facilities The most people there at one time will only be approx as the flights are operated by little twin otters What makes Barra great is the runway its the beach The approach and landing experience are a must Also once youve got off and collect your bag from a shelter in the car park youve got a maximum of metres to walk to your car taxi or bus they meet every flight and are a good way to get around the islands

Xian to London on th Feb Aircraft only years old Good amount seat recline with charger available however the entertainment system need an upgrade It is the coronavirus outbreak at moment the crew did an excellent job measuring temperature and disinfected the aircraft Excellent cabin service I went back to spoke with cabin crew they are willing to share their stories and experiences The lack of entertainment system is covered by the excellent crew service

A pleasant airport Our flight arrived at and even though we had to do a COVID test at the airport we completed all the formalities and left the airport within minutes On departure the flight was at and at this time there were a reasonable number of international flights also departing however the check in and security checks were quite quick After security there is a large duty free shop as well as some smaller shops and foodbeverage outlets The terminal was clean and tidy Obviously the airport is not yet operating at full capacity but our experience was fine Only letdown was the poor WiFi

Myself and family travel via Liverpool Airport two to three times a year It remains our first choice since we began using it ten years ago where previously we tended to travel via Manchester Liverpool is smaller than most international airports but this has its benefits less crowds less queuing and easy access The staff throughout the airport are friendly and ready to help The signage is easy to read and well proportioned Lifts are available Liverpool recognises the Sunflower scheme Our experience has been security is strict but quick and friendly to get through Prices are typical airport prices for a small bottle of water reasonable I suppose when considering the ridiculous prices airports are allowed to charge where ever you go I can only presume it is down to airport owners and the high rents they charge The only shops I ever see that are really busy are the food beverage and drinks outlets Again our experience has been food is fresh and well prepared The one downside are probably the toilet facilities a bit smelly and like most airports today no free drop off zone Why airports in the name of security are allowed to charge astronomical prices for parking I have never understood Captive audience I suppose All in all I would give Liverpool Airport stars out of Freshen up the loos be the first actually run an airport for the passengers benefit in pricing and parking and you get a

Ive used within China different airlines Air China Spring Airlines Shenzen Airlines and Kunpeng Airlines Clearly the best one was Kunpeng Airlines Although the flight had a delay of hours bad weather at the airport from which the airplane came information at the airport was good boarding really fast after the airplane arrived Nevertheless it was clean inside and the crew was very friendly As it was a short flight only minutes I expected less or no service onboard Was surprised that they offer a drink and a small meal The airplane itself seems to be a new one

Went on holiday in May flights where changed by TUI so we ended up flying with Titan Airways I must say they were fabulous beautiful planes and the staff were friendly and great with my little girl who is years Would love to fly with them again

A big thank you to staff of Skywest Airlines at St George Airport and on flight DL Wednesday May My age related reduced mobility and endurance makes travel more difficult than in past years and I had dreaded this flight However Skywest staff made it one of the easiest flights I have had in years of travel The male attendant in the boarding lounge saw my cane and luggage and without my asking came to me and asked if I would like help which I accepted gratefully On boarding the female flight attendant also immediately took my luggage and placed it for me On deplaning a male staff member offered to handle my luggage and proceeded to get me through the arrival lounge and to a wheel chair where I was taken all the way to the outside taxi stand Given that the Skywest lounge at SLC airport is far removed from the baggage claim and taxi stand this was more than just a convenience I was able to arrive home without being exhausted Kudos to the above mentioned Skywest staff a team of champions

Apias airport has been upgraded and presents a warm pacific feeling The immigrationcustoms staff should be taught to smile though especially after tourists are sold on the idea of a friendly pacific paradise proudly operated by the friendliest people on earth

This is a small but tidy and well run airport that I suspect will increase in demand in near future Everything is laid out well there are modest food and drink facilities clean toilets and small offices for several car hire firms Hertz Europcar Sol etc An excellent starting point for exploring northern Spain Currently Ryanair flies there twice a day from Stansted and I believe Liverpool Good overall

I am flying FDHDUS regularly and I am fully satisfied with this airline Due to the smaller sizes of their aircrafts the flight takes some time about hr min but service onboard is excellent Good regional snacks and plenty of drinks are served during the flight Ground handling in FDH is very quick and efficient Prices are high but still recommendable

One of the best flights I have been on between Oslo and Billund I didnt know that this kind of service still exsisted Excellent food and service I know it cost a bit more but it is well spent money I do recommend this airline which operates flights on behalf of British Airways

Nice airport corresponding to the Chinese standard no frills but essentials are there If you fly international no need to arrive early as the checkin counter is opened just one hour before flight time If you arrive early it is difficult to find a seat Not very friendly immigration people but nice lounge with good wifi connection and unlimited Internet access Plenty of outlets to satisfy the western appetite Starbucks KFC etc

Birgi Airport has recently had a makeover so new there were no arrival or departure boards In many respects it reminded me of Pisa Aeroporto before it got too big On arrival I was nearly the victim of a potential scam Unlicensed taxi drivers gather around the door to the arrivals hall They spot your name on a card being held by a genuine tour company As you come into the arrivals hall they call out your name and when you acknowledge them they claim to be your pre booked taxi Fortunately I noticed my name on a card being held by representatives from the genuine company I had booked with For departing flights eat before you set out for the airport At checkin there is just one very small snack bar and shop Panini and water just over EUR and not a great deal of seating Everything was clean and new but facilities are extremely minimal with only vending machines for refreshments after security Waiting in the gate area the seating is insufficient to cope with the number of passengers I thought it was also very warm but probably not so for your average Sicilian Access to aircraft is by descending several flights of stairs and then crossing the tarmac on foot

Richmond is a medium size airport that has recently been extensively renovated My experience flying in and out was very pleasant RIC is a human sized airport so it is easy to get around Baggage recovery was fast and painless with our checked bags appearing only about five minutes after we had arrived at the carousel The rental car desks are conveniently sited and the rental car garage is a two minute walk from the terminal Our total time from landing to driving off in a rental car was less than thirty minutes The airport is well connected to the adjacent Interstate highway so the airport is easy to get into and out of On departure checkin and security was quick and painless There is a restaurant in the secure area offering a view of the ramp a pleasant thing for the travelling aircraft buff Overall I was very impressed with Richmond airport and would use it again anytime

Very little queueing times in both the domestic and international terminals Jacksons International has just undergone some big renovation work and is looking excellent with great shopping and cafs Jacksons Domestic still needs a bit of work especially in the departures hall but I understand plan are afoot A pleasant airport to transit
Yangon to Lashio in November ATR plane Allocated seating and good snack served with excellent customer service Would fly with them again any time

Fuerteventura to Las Palmas with Canaryfly and a really good value company The most basic seat price included kg hand baggage and kg hold baggage plus basic refreshments Checkin boarding and flights were all totally without incident A minor request tea would be a nice alternative to coffee The outward flight was no more than half full and the flight back cant have been more than a third full With so many nonSpanish local residents and visitors I think it would be a very worthwhile investment for them to provide their website into English It was clearly the intention the icon is there but Im sure it would pay off to do it sooner rather than later The market is surely there but Ive spoken to many local residents who had never heard of the company

Toronto to Paris via Reykjavik with WOW air The plane was smaller than any trans Atlantic flight that I had flown in the past but the boarding process was so smooth Although food is available for sale the crew were very friendly

The airport is very big so you better arrive early if you have international flight Immigration queuing might take more than an hour and duty free is very far away from lounges and gates so you might have to choose between duty free or visiting the lounge Staff are generally friendly even under pressure

Our flight was on time checkin was smooth The staff on board were friendly I highly recommend this airline despite several negative reviews I think it is much better than many European low cost airlines Il nostro volo stato puntuale il checkin stato veloce Il personale a bordo stato cordiale Consiglio vivamente questa compagnia aereanonostante le diverse recensioni negative penso sia molto meglio di molte low cost europee

Last time I was in Xian Xianyang airport was in I have visited many times before There was always a Scrum outside the airport building for tickets and to board the airport buses for downtown Returned this year a lot has changed with the airport and getting tickets for the buses You now go to a ticket booth inside the building Then a waiting room for your respective bus What an improvement

Durbans new airport King Shaka International was opened for the World Cup It was designed as a stateofthe art regional airport for Durban KwaZuluNatal region The is plenty of space for stopping in the dropoff zone with direct access to the terminal There are seperate checkin islands for BA SAA and Emirates The departure concourse is spacious with enough seating for waiting passengers In the arrivals hall there is a food court with a Piazza some shops a Woolworths banks and post office Also a tourist information office After security there is plenty of space Unfortunately some lounges were closed due to renovations but this is only temporary The domestic terminal has plenty of space so a quiet corner for reading or working is not a problem If more international arrivals departures materialise then the current departure gates could prove to be a bit underdimensioned in the future

Easy to access by train Plenty of shops and eateries even convenience store Lots of toy machines Clean and enjoyable to wait for our departure Signs are clear You can enjoy lunch while watching the airplanes take off Weve got our last minute omiyage shopping like handkerchiefs japan only cute snacks and satisfying lunch

Monday th April what an absolute disgrace hours to get through security after being told minutes lifts out of order another reserved for staff when you escaped the great long queues conveyor belts working out of very little staff available On return hour wait for luggage an absolute disgrace A final comment I will never use Birmingham again and yet only minutes from home and have used this airports many many times and many times had problems but no more East Midlands much better
Good airport international terminal T is nice spacious clean The only problem I see is the fact that the interdiction of smoking is not always respected

Very slow running late on our arrival and departure nearly missed connecting flight back home because of slow progress at Male airport Lovely Maldives you are amazing but please step up your services and speed at the airport

Checked in amazing helpful staff her name was Nikki at London Heathrow Airport she was friendly and amazing service also told me my flight was delayed which I did not know and made sure everything was okay Highly recommend

Why do we always want to fly the big airlines VLM has the efficiency of a budget airline the service of a high value airline and the punctuality of a German airline They have friendly staff and after landing you are out of the airport in minutes Moreover book well in advance and you have a very attractive fare

I chose this airport for my summer holidays back in as a familiar airline started operating a scheduled summer route and provided very appealing promo prices It seems that is airport is mostly used by charter and low cost airlines providing allinclusive offers to leisure destinations However you can still find some scheduled international routes operated by bigger European airlines throughout the year such as Air France of course but the prices usually go through the roof meaning you can buy a train ticket to Paris and fly from there at half the price The current trend is that bigger European airlines will use this airport just for a couple of months per year mostly for the summer season That being said the airport is very small but on the other hand there is also not much traffic so it is as big as it should be I suppose It is very easily accessible from anywhere within France or northern Europe This is because Lille is a train hub in northern Europe you can use the Lille Europe train station in Lille to reach multiple European capitals There is a bus shuttle from Lille Europe train station to Lille Lesquin airport for euros allerretour or euros single journey not very cheap but not expensive either The airport is also very nice from the outside and the inside and you have perfect view for landings and takeoffs while waiting in the gate for your flight The airport has a very informative website a facebook page and a twitter page There could be more adequate toilet facilities in the gate I was waiting the was a single facility with just one or two toilets inside I do not remember correctly On the plus side the facility was spacious and appropriate for people with mobility issues eg wheelchair

Tulsa is a nice small to medium sized airport It now has free wifi available throughout the airport Only or so airlines fly out of the airport and it seems quite a few flights have been cut the past years or so The lines for TSA are rarely bad anymore I have been through security in less than mins after arriving at airport Obviously there are times when it is busier New seats at gates have plug ins available and this is a very nice touch

I thought this airport was lovely Outside are the cobbled roads and tram link into center In the main airport terminal the facilities are excellent They have a truly amazing viewing deck with information about the space programme and aircraft using the airport Security was quick efficient and friendly and boarding immediate to the aircraft I feel Bremen airport gives passengers the proper respect they deserve even when travelling a budget airline

I fly this airport several times per year The name and location sounds like a bigger adventure than it actually is The airport is small so boarding an A is already something that keeps everybody busy However there are not that many flights ground staff are friendly and helpful

Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport is a welldesigned and highly efficient airport that makes traveling a seamless experience The terminal layout is intuitive making navigation easy and stressfree With a wide range of dining and shopping options passengers have plenty of choices to enjoy before their flight The airport is clean modern and offers a comfortable atmosphere with ample seating and wellmaintained facilities Security is wellmanaged ensuring a safe and smooth travel experience Whether youre on a quick layover or starting a journey DCA provides convenience comfort and efficiency at every step

Seat C A swift flight mainly with Sleep as it was an overnight flight Airplane was clean although the business class seating looked very old well worn arm buttons and seat capsule panelling The Bahrain Gulf Air lounge was a super treat with Dinner options such as Pizza and Lasagne all were very good I certainly look forward to booking my next Gulf Air flight

ODSIEV on a new ATR having small screens for the safe announcements and you can see some comics during the hour minutes flight Flight was full but service was ok they offered refreshment Staff were very friendly and we were on time Overall very nice experience

Brisbane to Honiara return on Solomon Airlines IE flying on a Qantas code share QF in economy An aging but wellmaintained A which does the journey in a shade over three hours Flying on a Qantas Code Share and with premium FF status my luggage was booked through to my final destination and I was able to access the Qantas Business lounge in Brisbane and the Belama Lounge in Honiara Seats are leather and well spaced by economy standards with sufficient leg room There is no inflight entertainment but the meal service was generous for a relatively short flight with constant refills of wine available The cabin crew are among the friendliest I know and give very good service The only competition on this route is Virgin with a similar fare structure and limited service so airfares are not particularly low but if purchased well in advance are not unreasonable for a fairly lowtrafficked route
I found very good customer service by each and every worker at the airport whom we dealt with Wifi facilities were excellent with no interruptions Overall it passes the required tests

Three trips between CCS and BLA I found Conviasa to be clean modern friendly and welcoming My Spanish is functional but quite basic and when I struggled there was usually multilingual staff even on the short hop from Caracas to Barcelona and back Luggage allowance on this flight is a generous kg and a free drink is provided despite the flight time being only minutes Seats comfortable with more room than I was expecting All in all Conviasa offer a superior albeit slightly more expensive service on this short route than do their competitors Avior

Still a well organized airport We use the new international section Clean and simple to use Good staff security and customs Just expect that more international flights will be available soon from Qubec

Not good for transit passengers Staff are polite and helpful but nowhere to relaxsleep in a darker and quiet area No ATMsshopsfood outlets just a cafe upstairs Toilets clean Electric socket near where I was sitting didnt work I obtained wifi with the help of someone as there seems to be no airport wifi This lounge is just a square room brightly lit with toiletschairs and a few coffee tables Please improve our flying experience

Very efficient and pleasant airport Check in was quick and used the executive lounge I have used many but this was excellent One of the very best Food and drinks of good choice and a high standard Served to you rather than self service Comfortable and lovely friendly staff who couldnt do enough for you

Its very small but convenient airport There is small duty free area and coffee bar in upper floor after immigration and also one coffee bar before immigration Toilets are clean Immigration procedures on arrival and on departure are simple and fast

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

Ive been in CCS many times and the improvements made to the airport are incredible Very friendly and helpful staff Still it is not a modern airport but manageable considering the amount of passengers The only bad thing is that they are not paying attention to the security and when you are in the arrivals hall a bunch of people come and ask you if you want a taxi or maybe you want to buy the local currency I undestand this due to the political situation the country is facing but as I always say it could and must be better

This review is for International arrivals and US Departures Ive used this airport in December and then again in March In general a much better experience this time around On arrival sufficient immigration desks were staffed and customs was quick enough so that I was in my hotel within minutes of touching down On departure the new US Departures terminal is much improved from the older version Check in and security is quick and efficient The only place where there are lines is the US immigration pre clearance Airside the terminal is quite pleasant with lots of shops restaurants etc While the main restaurant Kafe Kalik I think is pleasant with outdoor seating I would not recommend ordering food there unless you want to risk missing your flight they took minutes to bring our food

This is a very large and well maintained airport located in Virginia Given the size of this airport with its main terminal and then midfield terminals give yourself plenty of time to get to your gates especially the midfield terminals On arrival I had to take the mobile lounges to the main terminal The mobile lounges have frequent service from midfield terminal to main terminal No more than a min wait Restrooms in baggage claim are were very clean Departure was from Terminal C which necessitated using the labyrinth of escalators to get to the AeroTrains which run underground When I lived in Centreville VA Dulles was my airport of choice over Reagan National

Old airport looks like a s relic which it is Only used for transfer which was so simple just a short walk In that sense convenient but not much to do air side and unable to comment on passport or check in services Staff pleasant and very helpful So my one hour in the Seychelles was smooth and pleasant Departure area airconditioned which was handy in c humid outside temps

Just had to leave this review on th May returned from Rhodes and my flight was delayed two hours Just after midnight left baggage reclaim to go to my car I had a flat battery and was unable to get into my car It was exceptionally cold and all I was wearing was shorts and a tee shirt I returned to the terminal where I met the staff at the parking desk At this time the terminal was empty and they were locking up The staff came out and helped me gain entry to my car but I had a two hour wait for the Green Flag breakdown The staff waited with me almost an hour and had to go home leaving me alone in the car park freezing cold but not before he returned to his office made me a hot cup of tea and brought it to me in my car A beautiful act of kindness and one I will never forget

The flight was a very good price the plane was in great shape and the cabin crew were excellent The food could have been better and they ran out of wine quite early but overall a good experience and Id definitely fly with them again If you have a layover book a lounge at Shenzhen airport the food was good and the shower included in the price made a massive difference to a long journey

There is a reason why this airport was ranked among the top airports in the country Its very easy to navigate the facilities are very clean and there is free wifi for minutes Security is a breeze with the lines moving very quickly The TSA staff are pleasant and friendly There are several food options here ranging from fast food coffee to sit down restaurants Wolfgang Pucks and the Providence Oyster Bar are highly recommended There are also a number of retail shops with Brooks Brother among the more prominent ones Plenty of restrooms which are not only clean but maintained at regular hourly intervals

Rarotonga to Aitutaki The flight with Air Rarotonga was a pleasurable experience spotless clean aircraft with much space for legs an excellent and friendly service coffee was served on that short flight on the small plane and even the small airlines brochure and a daily newspaper was offered to read by passengers I was impressed by the overall quality of the service

Good shopping for such a small airport Clean and clear Cheap car parking compared with Schiphol When arriving plane parked in front of terminal and was outside the building with my checked bag in minutes

BDL is my hometown airport I found plenty of kiosks for checkin at US Airways and went through security quickly On the airside at US Airways gates very limited options in terms of stores and restaurants and the good shopsrestaurants are at the other side of the terminal Upon return finding luggage is easy and the pickup for valet lots is fast the amenities are limited but the airport is streamlined and easy to use I prefer BDL plus connection to a direct flight from BOS or JFK anytime

The airport is fine and clean food was good and getting through the security was fine However the so call dutyfree store is another matter everything was way over priced For example the Local Rum Appleton years old was over USD That is very expensive to pay that kind of money in Jamaica for local rum on a dutyfree when you can buy the same in Ontario Canada one of the higher liquor tax jurisdictions for under USD All of the products on the dutyfree were way overpriced You can get the same rums in the USA at the supermarkets for less from the dutyfree store of Montego bay airport I purchase a Cuban Havana Club year old in Havana on December for USD

Gatwick to Joburg troubles just beginning to brew in Libya The start seemed off putting when I noticed an extra three hours on the flight time from Tripoli to Joburg which the booking office could not explain also when I was not on the reservations list at checkin However the latter was sorted without hassle Service on flight to Tripoli was fine plane new and clean food good However we landed in a sandstorm which was worrying Fortunately we were herded along to the departures lounge as all signs in Arabic Onward flight delayed by a couple of hours due to sandstorm Toilets at the airport were inadequate in number but reasonably clean We were then taken on what felt like a mystery tour on an airport bus down a dirt road turned out to be to the other end of the runway where our plane sat all on its own amidst military aircraft The three hour extra time was now clear as it was a much smaller plane than expected a few passengers had seats allocated on row numbers which were not on the smaller plane however there was enough room and extra for everyone boarding Once again food and service fine There was a refuelling stop at Kinshasa During my week in S Africa the revolution in Libya took off I expected to lose my money and have to rebook myself back on an alternative carrier However when I contacted Afriqiyah in Joburg they said I was rebooked on Egyptair travelling back same night as my original booking They sent me email confirmation and my trip home went smoothly The Afriqiyah staff were helpful and efficient in spite of what was obviously a stressful time for them On the basis of value for money Afriqiyah is excellent but be prepared for a journey with a difference

I fly from Amsterdam to Norwich and back regularly The airport is always a breeze Check in never has a queue security never has a queue You can arrive minutes before a flight and its never a trouble Staff are nice and friendly There isnt a massive selection of things to do airside but you wouldnt expect there to be The development fee is bizarre but certainly not unique to Norwich Go to a small airport get a small airport experience Norwich appears well run and is always a pleasure to fly through If you want a big airport experience go to a big airport Ill happily take shorter waiting times and friendlier service and stick with Norwich
Special appreciation to the cabin crew Sonika I was super impressed with her fluency in announcements all three different languages and it was just amazing to hear her out

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

I could not believe this was the first time I had arrived and departed from Tokyo Haneda Airport When I first arrived immigration was straightforward and I was very impressed When I was leaving checkin was also pretty straightforward and the whole Terminal was massive with great lounges shops and food Plus I got to do plenty of plane spotting from lounges

Airport on Arrival no problem We hired a car and having found the car hire desk we were directed to the car pick up point which turned out to be a considerable distance away No shuttle service You just have to leg it If it had been raining we would have been soaked Cant imagine what it must be like for people in wheelchairs or families with pushchairs plus luggage Car hire needs to be closer to the terminal or shuttle service provided Departure was not good We had to leave our bags to be scanned go to the other side for Security check which meant leaving our bags and personal belongings unattended When called for our flight we were herded into a holding pen not enough seats stood for minutes while members of staff called out peoples names to re check their flight details this was done in a very unfriendly and unapologetic manner Took the shine off what had otherwise been a very pleasant trip to this beautiful island
The flight was good but it lacked in terms of inflight entertainment and food plus the wifi service which was without any surprise very bad Still it was a decent flight overall

Tel Aviv to Minsk Amazing flight no delays we boarded quickly clean aircraft really comfy seats and the food was great choice between sausages and beef and we got a waffle cherries bread with the the meal Staff was really nice no complaints

Flew with LC Peru from Cusco to Lima H flight Small Boeing old Lufthansa Legroom was limited but okay for the duration of the flight They offered one drink and a small snack two cookies Flight was smooth the price for the ticket was low included one piece of bagage of KG Crew friendly and efficient Plane was old it was ok Overall good value for money Short flights are ok plaen looks good and seats were ok Dont expect to much but I would recommend this airline for domestic flights in Peru

Love Ryanair efficiency Does what is says on the packet nothing pretentious Crew were great and even managed to go down with aisle with the trolley on a minute flight My th flight with them just wish they flew to Frankfurt theyd get all my euro business

A comfortable nononsense flight which was delayed by about minutes while departing but made up for most of the time difference by the time one landed The crew was courteous and professional the seating comfortable and there was a snack service consisting of a packet of Lays Chips and a Juice which was quite ok for the short flight The luggage arrival was also fuss free and ontime Overall quite a nice flight

Airport is away from city and not good public transport available better to use cab Not too busy most of times so not long queue at entry check in and security mostly min to complete all formality Limited food options needs more there is one lounge but one of the smallest and least food options i found in India only suggested if having complementary lounge access Shopping options is also very limited only recommend tea shop if didnt got time to buy tea in city which is famous for Toilets needs to be more clean Shortage of sitting space on both floors Free Wifi only for min This airport need proper maintenance now

My experience was very smooth no flight changes or surprises in the departure flight In the arrival flight there was a security threat in Beirut Airport resulting in flight delays for ALL airlines The way Ajet dealt with the situation was outstanding and professional Given the unintended delays we missed the next flight Without even asking and as soon as we arrived to their desk they fixed the flight for the next day and offered us free transport hotel and meals The air and ground crew is very nice and helpful The only setback is in communicating with the Airport employees in English Until this improves communicate with a smile and nice attitude and youll get what you want eventually

Lufthansa operated by Germanwings from Barcelona to Berlin Tegel and back Both fights on time with very quick boarding and ground service First flight was a year old A plane was very clean and comfortable The return flight on a year old A despite the old age of the aircraft it was very clean comfortable and showed signs of great maintenance service You cold only tell that it was that old becouse it was considerably louder but the journey was very enjoyable The snacks are not very good but I can forgive that on a h min flight Great comfort in the seats with more legroom Great value for money and going to try Eurowings

Mykonos to Thessaloniki A short super enjoyable flight Everything went well on both flights the planes were nice and clean crew presentable professional and helpful and the flights on time short and so enjoyable I kept looking through the windows at the islands we were flying over beautiful Both flights were under minutes long we even got a small bottle of water coffee a cookie and a wet towel I can totally recommend Ellinair

Arrival was great I was at passport control within minutes of landing On the way back it was another story I couldnt do the online check in and I found out at the airport that its not provided when you fly from Bergerac You have to queue with everybody in order to get your boarding pass even if you only have hand luggage Ground personnel very slow until the call was made to invite people for boarding They then suddenly were very quick The toilets arent provided with coat or handbag hangers which I find not practical

Felt like flying in the old days Flew this one hour flight from Kerman to Tehran in a packed sold out flight operating by an old Airbus A which was refurbished immaculately and very clean The flight attendants were nicely dressed and friendly It was rather hot at Kerman and I was surprised to find a cold bottle of water on seat back pocket for every passenger on this massive jet They a light dinner free of charge Over all it was the best domestic flight I have ever taken

It is clean quick and efficient passport control Landed at was driving off at My return leg was the same desks open for the flights that were going to London around the same time with CTA Very cheap cigarettes and alcohol airport staff are friendly and helpful The chap that said announcements were not made in English is wrong all flights are announced in Turkish and English You can hardly miss your flight as there are only gates A small airport with only around flights coming and going in one week but very efficient

Good shopping for such a small airport Clean and clear Cheap car parking compared with Schiphol When arriving plane parked in front of terminal and was outside the building with my checked bag in minutes

Bydgoszcz airport is very small but there are many people traveling through it daily There are no shops only one cafe and newsagents both in the duty free area Security checks are usually fast and check ins go smoothly This city would benefit from a much bigger airport and hopefully it will soon have one

Excellent service Nothing to complain Theyve served an excellent food during the h long flight and was delicious All the flight attendants were polite and worried about the cleanliness and support all the passengers aboard There arent delays and the luggage have arrived perfectly fine A Grade

This is a wonderful airport Staff providing good services to pick up luggage when arriving It has a good transportation centre with taxis bus routes to downtown and shuttle buses to other cities near Wenzhou Many shops in the airport selling products with affordable prices Wifi is fast This airport is expanding to have another much larger terminal by

This review is limited to Terminal A I havent flown through Terminal A in years but it still remains a very modern airport terminal It is spacious with plenty of seating and dining options especially at Gates A There is a rather long underground walkway from these gates to the main terminal A The walkway is beneath the tarmac and runways We dined at Legal Seafoods before departure to DFW Excellent food The terminal was very busy given the snowstorm and delayed flights Bathrooms were okay but could have been cleaner WiFi was very fast and easy to connect too Kudos to Logan airport snow clearing crews and the crews deicing planes Our flight to DFW was delayed but we managed to take off Throughout the storm planes kept taking off and landing

I was impressed and there is room for improvement Both sectors departed and arrived on time Suprisingly Calm and efficient boarding the Aircraft which was pristine two very hard working and happy Crews With a rather Comfortable seat On Both Sectors the Aircraft appeared full I tried to be a smart snagging a decent seat at online check in Many carriers allow you to select an alternate seat should you be allocated a poor one Omar Air do not and I had H and F in the aft cabin right at the rear of the Aircraft The Forward Cabin is far more appealing and it served me right Seriously consider paying for a seat there That said if wasnt onerous Should they address two things they are up there even nicer than the usual elite Middle Eastern Carriers A spectacular dawn arrival into Muscat was an unexpected treat and what a delightful Airport Please address Economy Catering Plastic cutlery Tray looks cheap and nasty and it was sparse Two choices including the apparently notorious Chicken with Rice which is exceptionally unappealing Same meal on both sectors IFE Such a shame as the Screen is of exceptional quality Content falls well short of the competition here Despite the Mealplan and Tedious IFE Id still recommend

Morning flight Kiev Odessa a new clean Embraer It was a very pleasant flight with free candies and beverages served by smiling crew Departed on time and arrived early Check in in Kiev quick and easy The atmosphere and attitude quite relaxed and pleasant

Hartford airport is very small I arrived hours before my flight because I was coming from Vermont and wanted to allow for traffic but that was way too early for what was available at the airport The hall immediately past security has plenty of restaurants to choose from along with a number of rocking chairs that have a nice view of the apron The Gates concourse also looked like it had been recently renovated and also had a nice selection of restaurants and shops However the presecurity areas and the Gates concourse were dark and dim and were unpleasant places to wait Fortunately everything at this airport is very close so if your flight leaves from Gates you can wait in the postsecurity hall and go to your gate at the last moment Still itd be nice if the airport would renovate the Gates concourse and the presecurity areas so that it looks as nice as the Gates concourse

Baghdad airport is OK It works without too much hassle It is a reasonably modern building There are linked terminals which you can easily walk between both airside and landside There is a restaurant landside and small cafes both sides Capacity is limited airside though Usual facilities landside mobile phone companies ATMs exchange etc If you have a long transit it is better to stay landside and visit the restaurant There are moderate queues for security and immigration can be a bit slow If you are not on Iraqi Airways there may not be any business lounge available certainly not for Turkish anyway

It is a nice and small airport but it is in compliance with the city and the air movement in the region The most negative point is the few stores and food options There are checkin machines and circulation is relatively fast

This was a lovely flight from Hobart to the Gold Coast on Tigerair Boarding was orderly We walked to the plane and boarded through the rear I had row to myself in the second last row I will travel with them again

One of the best African airports that i have ever been to I had worries at first before going through terminal but to my surprise the whole experience was stressfree and enjoyable The airport atmosphere was very pleasant the checkin was quick and courteous the duty free shops had some good and reasonably priced items and there were also some decent looking food outlets the washrooms are well maintained and staff were friendly despite their limited proficiency of English language

Wonderful experience they saved me from missing my flight I was traveling with my family in China and this airport was my second transit trough this country My first encounter was with Chongqing airport which was significantly worse because my flight was unexpectedly cancelled and they just barely managed to book another one I still had a little time but I was worried if I could make it in time With just minutes left I rushed to find my check in and when this amazing staff found out how little time I had they literally enscorted me and my family to my gate They were communicating with walkie talkies so we were being preferred throughout the way to catch our flight The most pleasant staff ever I will be forever thankful

I had a problem with the immigration I somehow missed the immigration check after my evening flight from Hanoi to Luang Prabang my responsibility of not having checked if I had a stamp The next day I went back and they charged me on top of what I already paid made me sign a paper written in Laos not a copy or a picture I was able to take after I asked I paid as there were no other option They were not nasty but not kind they kept telling me its my fault for not checking No sharing the responsibility or acknowledged that they might have not done a proper job on their hands So check your stamps before you leave there are different separate lines to do one for the visa the other for the immigration stamp and be aware that they can play the game they want At the end all is good you pay and you have your passport back with a big smile from their side

On December st I had booked a flight for my dad and his brothers to Cape Town I joined them we were helped by Thabile Mchunu at Counter and she was absolutely amazing My elders had never taken a flight before and he kindness and friendliness was amazing and helpful to calm the nerves

Minsk to Gatwick The airport in Minsk looks like it has been renovated recently and it was modern and efficient Boarding was slightly delayed but we got to Gatwick on time The aeroplane was fairly comfortable and you get a bit more room in an Embraer which has a x seating configuration The food and beverages were quite good and the aeroplane had some cool branding featuring a tankbased computer game that was developed in Belarus Cabin crew were a little gruff and could have been warmer and more welcoming but overall its a decent product and good value for money

Impressed by this airport apart from the queue at Passport control It took ages once through to Departures everything was fine Duty Free was reasonable and plenty of places to get a drink or something to eat

I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the plane left on time The staff were friendly and professional The seat was very comfortable The meal was tasty with a very good wine Although the flight was short I would have preferred a more substantial meal Otherwise a very pleasant start to my vacation

The flights are frequently delayed but its a small price to pay for clean aircraft ample seat pitch kind crew and the lowest fares My flight from Melbourne to Kuala Lumpur was on an A with plenty of legroom and good meals Online checkin yields a good seat for me and their use of KLIA T makes for an easy and relaxing journey

A very big shout out to Jude and Liz at the checkin service desk as well as Tup the client manager on the flight I happened to leave a bag containing a priceless religious item at the checkin desk as we were running late for the flight And in my haste I left the bag at the desk I totally forgot about it and would have been extremely devastated and upset if I realised I left it behind Once we boarded the plane and settled in a very kind Tup and other staff member came up to us and returned the bag to us I can only guess that Liz and Jude realised I was a religious Jew and made the effort to return the bag to us on the plane before it took off My wife and I were so touched by this extremely kind gesture We spoke to Tup during the flight and expressed our gratitude but I wanted to leave this note of thanks to Jude and Liz too We always try and fly Rex your staff are friendly and happy so different to the other airlines we have flown on domestically And this incident just reinforces the good vibes we get when flying Rex

Very nice very small domestic regional airport I arrived from IAH Houston on a tiny little Saab and I collected my luggage and was outside in about minutes I also departed there for IAH with eventual connection to LHR and was surprised by the very welcoming attitude of the Continental staff The security staff seemed less happy to be working but I was through in under minutes Its a nice little airport with a nice little cafe and a few static displays to look at Its also used by USAF so its common whilst waiting for your flight to see an FA land or depart

Stansted to Tivat Overall this is a decent airline The cabin staff speak English the plane although old is fine for a short hour flight and the journey was comfortable A few pointers only one of the toilets in the plane were working which was annoying there was a basic selection of drinks and a simple cheese sandwich we took off over hours late but it was unclear if this was the fault of the airline or the ground staff on this flight we arrived too late to land in Tivat it has no night facilities so we had to land in Podgorica They did in the end put a bus for all of us to reach Tivat although the delay was significant
I am not sure when you went to the airport in maracaibo but things have change a lot Prices are not as bad and there is lots of choices to eat and drink very reasonable

Flew Bangkok to Paro roundtrip both flights via Calcutta Outbound I was in Economy Plus and the legroom was excellent The breakfast was well served hot and tastyfar more substantial that is offered on many other carriers On the return I was upgraded to business and the leather seat was roomy and comfortable The meal lunch was good but the performance of the crew was truly worldclass I have to say that I was very impressed by the professionalism and demeanour they displayed In business one is given access to priority clearance in Bangkok which worked well but still a long wait for baggagethough mine was the first bag out Excellent offering overall

Rotterdam airport is small but very easy to get to as I live only min away People are very friendly and helpful I travel on average x per year sometimes more normally I only have hand luggage and have only once encountered extra checks and body search I find check in and arrivals no problem and never had to wait very long I do think it could use a few more shops and especially as I fly early morning it would be nice to have some kind of breakfast that is not too expensive

A relatively large regional airport for a small town However Darwin is the state capital of Northern Territory We checked in for the flight went through security and then waited for the flight to depart There were no hassles or problems Everything went smoothly
