I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the flight departed on time The staff were friendly and efficient The seat was comfortable too Only tea coffee and water is available free of charge which is no big deal given its such a short flight

Copenhagen to Vagar in the Faroe Islands with Atlantic Airways RC A aircraft Friendly checkin received baggage tag and headed to the gate Flight boarded in an organized fashion and flight attendants greeted each passenger as you entered the cabin Nice colors and comfortable seats Lots of legroom actually was very surprised Ontime take off and hours to the Faroe islands soda water and coffee serviced complimentary but purchased wine and food was reasonably priced Inflight entertainment was just the flightmap but had my DVDs to watch Landed a few minutes late in crazy wind and rain but the landing was good Parked farthest possible on the tarmac from the entrance to the terminal so we all got wet but that is how it is there Bags off in a reasonable amount of time Oveall a very good flight and for the price a good deal

I recently flew in Singapore airlines Everything about the airline is premium Check in experience the gate allotted to them time performance crew Flying in A was itself unique experience Seating comfort could have been better though otherwise its a out of

Travelled from here to Canada via Amsterdam apart from hideously expensive cafe its always a pleasure to travel from here Check in and security excellent and baggage pick up very quick its small size makes it virtually stress free

Gatwick to St Petersburg I was slightly apprehensive about travelling with Rossiya Airlines but need not have been This was full flight from Gatwick to St Petersburg on an A The plane had seen better days but was clean When I checked in I asked for an aisle seat and was denied one Boarding was very quick and I soon found myself in a rather uncomfortable seat for the just over min flight The cabin crew were very nice people and efficient The service included a complimentary sandwich and drink which was appreciated I plan to visit Russia again in August and will gladly use this airline The friendly staff won me over Disembarkation was via a bus transfer to the main terminal

A first class airport with a good range of facilities There does not seem to be the usual hectic atmosphere of most airports bringing back the pleasure into flying Decent food at non ripoff prices particularly recommend the caferestaurant on the mezzanine floor

I was a little nervous to fly after reading some of these reviews but my ticket was already purchased so I went for it Best flying experience Ive ever experienced Both the Pendleton airport and Portland airport were easy to find and they both werent in the major airports so didnt have to deal with TSA or people Check in was simple and from check in to boarding was quick Take off and landing for both flights were great best Ive experienced and little to no turbulence Im wondering if the negative reviews were for flights taken during the months with crazy weather which would make sense as to why it would be scary so Ill probably stick to boutique air during the months with good weather My flight home got delayed a couple hours but it honestly wasnt a big deal and they called and texted hours prior to inform me Overall best experience and Ill definitely be utilizing boutique air more Definitely recommend

What a wonderful feeling entering the Bermuda airport Friendly thoughtful staff and the wonderful band playing Bermuda is Another World were quite the contrast to American and Canadian airport experiences My wife and I just returned from a wonderful stay in Bermuda if possible tell the band that their beautiful music is still in our heads a week later
Professional courteous security Definitely a credit to the management and the leadership team Well done Definitely recommend the team for their professional approach and execution of their duties

A long but pleasant flight Cabin crew were kind and friendly gave me snacks when I walked to back of the plane to stretch my legs Food was good The only hiccup was the website has glitches on some of the pages for online checkin when accessed from mobile phone I had to use iPad to find a workaround in the end hour call centre hotline based in Brunei was very useful and answered the call with no queue You dont get that efficiency from many carriers these days

I am convinced that anyone that has anything bad to say about Stansted is either paid delusional or a banker that hasnt got anything positive to say about anything Ive travelled to airports so not quite as many as some people but Ive been to enough to say that Stansted is bloody marvelous at what it does Its simple clean efficient has a beautiful single terminal building some of the fastest security queues Ive ever seen no matter how many people its trying to push through Stansted is quite simply operationally one of the best ever and Ive never had to wait more than minutes departing Even arrivals moves ridiculously fast and while sometimes you can wait in a queue that looks lengthy to enter the country it never takes that long The people working at Stansted know how to move Its an absolutely marvelous display and it always astounds me whenever I go Its a well signposted airport very easy to navigate the quiet area is fantastic loads of shops and food options My only MINOR criticism is that it can sometimes be difficult to find a place to sit down upstairs but other than that its absolutely a class airport

As I live in Belo Horizonte this is the most used airport by me Before the renovation this airport was very bad but now after the renovation it looks great it is clean the queue time is good there are many options for shopping and eating and the airport is spacious The only problem is that it is far from Belo Horizonte city centre

Gatwick to Denver I was placed on a Wamos flight by Norwegian and almost cancelled due to all the terrible reviews but I didnt find it that bad at all We brought our own movies to watch and our own food which I normally do on a flight anyway as I like healthy stuff Ive had worse legroom on other flights and the staff were more friendly and helpful than many others Ive known and I fly a lot The plane was pretty old but perfectly functional The staff were so great that I told them Id write a review because I felt that the pasting theyre getting online is unfair and makes us travellers look rather spoilt to be honest

I never thought I would find myself reviewing a TSA department but I felt compelled to after my recent positive experience My family and I were unexpectedly transiting through Newark on June We had several mishaps happen beyond our control after an extended travel day hours The TSA department at Newark airport in particular a man named Fontaine helped greatly alleviate our stress and help expedite us through the security line and airport correcting the mistakes of our airline workers I cannot begin to tell you how appreciative I am for their help empathy and services

I had to fly from Alicante with a fractured leg The staff and facilities were absolutely amazing Please can you teach Edinburgh Airport how to facilitate and treat disabled passengers Thank you so much Alicante

This was the busiest I had ever seen Sydney Airport but things ran smoothly the staff were very efficient getting everyone through security and was very impressed to how friendly the security staff were that is really appreciated I was also impressed when my flight with Air New Zealand was ready to board they called the Business class passengers first and policed it by checking everyones boarding pass which is good as one pays a lot more money for Business Class so should have the privilege When departing Auckland it wasnt policed hence so many more people were in the line An impressive airport overall

Tular to Antananarivo Quick Checkin on time plane a bit old refreshments and a snack served friendly flight attendants The fare was somehow high but this is Madagascar You shouldnt come here if you are pampered by lowcost carriers

One of the smaller airports by Chinese standards but a very positive experience for the passenger Good signage short distances to walk from plane to baggage carousel and a mere minute wait for luggage to be on the belt Good public transport to greater Qingdao region including resorts area by the sea Beware of taxi touts go to the official taxi line where you get a taxi from a dispatcher who registers the ride and also hands out a complaint info card just in case When departing from Qingadao dont come to the airport too early Checkin also for international flights is min before scheduled takeoff and there is not much to do in this airport Just some shops and two socalled coffee shops with a limited choice of snacks Found out too late about a VIPlounge which is hidden in a corner to the far right of the international departure lounge Access charge is yuan but had no time to use it Friendly airport staff quick security check plenty seating at gates one restaurant one coffee shop and one airline lounge airside duty free and souvenirs Facilities clean and well maintained All in all a very positive impression

Small but good airport I visited it two weeks ago and I found it to be clean Its true that there not many people principally fligths of SAS and Norwegian but I liked it especially the after control zone where two barrestaurants The checkin zone is clean and well organized with an active information point Positive general impression from this airport

Heho to Yangon The aircraft was pretty new and very clean We have been greeted with a smile and the personnel was kind and professional We have been served some basic breakfast that for such a short flight was appreciated Flight on time and overall very comfortable and enjoyable experience

I flew in on Lufthansas twice weekly flight via Samara no February st They are the only international carrier Apart from immigration refusing to acknowledge the computer generated form from the Russian Federations London Embassy which meant I had to fill one in by hand everything was fine I was in and out of the airport inside halfanhour

Flight was ontime small propellerdriven aircraft seats Large cabin bags do not fit into the overhead compartment they are stored in the front of the cabin The seat was comfortable enough for a shorthaul flight staff was friendly and helpful Would fly within again

Over the years have had the pleasure of travelling through this airport surely the best planned facility of its size anywhere in the world Maybe all wouldbe new airport planners should pay Norfolk a visit to see what a well designed airport should look like and thats not even mentioning the surrounding beautiful botanical gardens a very pleasant change from the usual grimy industrial areas adjoining most airports

I take Horizon often between Seattle and Portland after arriving from the UK and always find staff very helpful My last connection was late from LHR due to weather and holding separate tickets was a worry however Horizon staff did all they could to rush me through and I made the original connection Ground staff friendly and nice crew Flight down was operated by a CRJ its a quieter cabin and seems faster not sure it is though but the cabin feels smaller and return flight by Q was much more comfortable Cabin crew nice and you still get a free drinks service on a min shuttle great touch

Quiet new airport opened in Check in was efficient Distance to Alona Beach only a few minutes Therefore very comfortable for people staying at the beach There are only few food stalls available Overall a fast and efficient airport

Recent Improvements have made this small airport quite reasonable There are a few dining and shopping options and the area is fairly large and pleasant They still play terrible elevator music Free internet is a bonus The airport is conveniently located to the city but there is no public transportation available Parking is day bit it is often difficult to find a spot
Francistown Johannesburg September Good short flight efficiently run with good crew On time and no problems

I flew in one of Sky Expresss ATR aircraft from Kythira to Athens The ground staff at Kythira airport and flight attendants were very friendly and professional The aircraft was old but clean and comfortable enough Boarding was completed on time and the door closed That the takeoff was delayed by an hour was not the airlines fault A clearly annoyed pilot explained that there was some sort of lightning air traffic control strike at least that is what the other passengers told me because the explanation given by the clearly annoyed pilot was given only in Greek Otherwise the flight was perfectly enjoyable and I have no complaints about the airline Inflight service on the minute flight consisted of a predeparture sweet a bottle of water and a small biscuit

Corruption and extortion are alive and well at this airport Both myself and four colleagues in the following days were asked for our passports and then dollars to return them from officials at this airport It has been a while since this last happened to me in any country at any airport but this place stands out Who would want to visit this place for business or vacation Never again

I would just like to convey my sincere thanks to Shaye Qantas Broome I flew from Perth to Broome on the th June QF my luggage flew from Perth to Karratha due to an airport error in Perth The Qantas staff were very understaffed my luggage ended up on the wrong flight When I got to Broome I realised the mistake contacted Shaye whilst she herself was understaffed extremely busy she found time to organise to have my luggage located sent back to Perth then flown to Broome by am next morning If all airline staff were as conscientious genuinely caring as Shaye then the airline industry would have much greater respect from its customers

Went to Anchorage in late Airport has some restaurants on the security side of the airport but not a good choice and the quality was not too good The gift shops on the other hand are excellent especially if you are looking for Native American art Be warned that quite a few souvenirs are like snow shakers with water which will be taken off you by security if you need to pass through them again Information screens were useful Plenty of seating and quite a view out of the terminal window

It was an easy online check in Due to other company flight delays I was short on time to drop my bag in When I arrived it was too late for me to print my bag tag Ricky at LAX directed me to an operator who printed my tag and checked my bag in Flight was also great Service when needed but nice and quiet during the night to sleep I recommend Delta Air Lines

This is a nice and modern airport at the moment they are expanding the airport so there is a lot of building going on but in the departure area you will not notice this very much The Airport has got free Wifi and a small restaurant with shop on the land side Airside you will find a small shop with prepacked sandwiches and hot dogs and other small stuff a small duty free shop is also around but not very cheap There is no Lounge to be found at the moment but after the expansion is completed there will be one available around May Checkin procedures are fast and the waiting area after checkin is fine with a view on the tarmac All in all a nice modern but small airport with expensive restaurants and shop

Small plane E it was but everything moved along efficiently Decent legroom nothing to rave nor complain about but more importantly the boarding process was seamless and so was the disembarking process Baggage arrived with zero issues Worthwhile noting that tickets were expensive though Despite all the negative reviews here its one of the only options from La Paz to Uyuni other than the Todo Turismo tourist bus which we took on the way back and was pretty decent as well so where flights are concerned just cross your fingers and hope for the best Do not be afraid after reading all the negativity here Not all is bad

Malm to Stockholm I rebooked on Malm Aviation due to SAS strike in Sweden What a sharp contrast to SAS Checkin was painless using the selfservice machines Flight was operated by an Avro RJ with comfortable seats and sufficient legroom Cabin crew was efficient and smiling But the nicest touch was the free snack on board tasty roast beef sandwich orange juice coffeetea I was rather impressed by the cabin service on this hourflight The only negative point is the free seating policy as usual it resulted in a freeforall at boarding Malm Aviation is a very nice niche airline and I would strongly recommend it

I upgraded from Economy to Economy Sleeper on this hour flight This gives you a row of three standard economy seats to yourself in a separate and quieter segment of the cabin between economy and business You also get a mattress pillow and duvet the idea being that you can sleep across the three seats This does not really work because If you try to lie flat your feet stick out into the aisle If you prop yourself up sitting with your back to the window the inner arm rest sticks into your back The mattress which is meant to be attached via straps to the seats slides off easily when you move If there is turbulence and you have to fasten your seat belt it is not possible to do this while lying horizontally across the seats Standard economy seats lack the depth needed lie down comfortably across them You cannot watch a programme on the entertainment system in a horizontal position I tried for a while to find a comfortable position but gave up in the end and just sat in my reclined seat Its a nice idea and was worth a try but it does not deliver It was quite a costly upgrade too and the airline would be better served converting that midsection into proper premium economy with more comfortable and spacious seats Of the rows on each side of the cabin only two were occupied which perhaps reflects the point I am making about value for money The service throughout was excellent and my review and ratings refer specifically to the Economy Sleeper offer

Living in South Florida and used to departing from and connecting through massive airports GRR was a breeze Now the new parkingbuilding is fully functional and beautiful it is all in a natural colour of brown The checkin area itself is nothing to admire and very basic Than you walkup to a shortramp and there you are Steps away from all the terminals This area does have a small foodcourts with the basic pizzaburger fare It also has floortoceiling windows bringing in plenty of natural light GRR had a major problem its airfare were outrageously expensive even the discounted ones However after lowcost Allegiant started servicing Grand Rapids tickets prices dropped dramatically even last minute ones This can only bring more business to West Michigan

Piarco to Grenada A nofrills airline though efficient Staff at check in at arrivaldeparture were polite very helpful and efficient I experienced difficulty in accessing and using the online check in service though this proved to be no obstacle at the check in desk The aircraft while obviously wellused and aging somewhat allowed reasonable legroom Im and was comfortable enough to doze through the flight

Terminal is the area I am reviewing this trip We used the short stay car park as you can walk undercover into the terminal Very easy although not the cheapest option Finding the Aer Lingus checkin was simple and as we stood in line the single checkin operator asked for passengers for Belfast to come forward first which was great The airline uses T for short hops to Belfast and Dublin the main activity for long haul is in T Security was very quiet and efficient for those of us who understand and stick to the rules One family was annoyed at having to surrender much of their liquids and cosmetics because they did not know the rules My partners bag was sidetracked for search Apparently her paperback novel attracted their attention Mine thankfully did not so go figure Once through we ran the gauntlet of the Duty Free maze and found our way to the Aspire Lounge included with the economyflex ticket Boarding was simple with the ATR aircraft having only seats Returning the aircraft was parked very remotely for some reason and we were bussed to the terminal at times I thought we were on an executive allareas tour By the time we got there the bags were on the belt and we were away

I love Air North and use them whenever its convenient between Kelowna and Vancouver Very reasonable fares which includes two checked bags and advance seat selection for Always on time friendly staff and I love the vintage s Its like what flying was like decades ago much nicer and more relaxed

Hong Kong to Kolkata An excellent flight where I was doted on by two very amiable and helpful cabin crew members It helped that I was one of just two passengers in the business class section which had seats in two rows of x A menu card was provided and my selection was tasty and filling A good complement of drinks and spirits was on offer However they have not changed their dessert a small cup of Haagen Daz ice cream in at least years It is always served solid frozen I passed on it and had some port wine instead The flight departed on time from a satellite terminal which was reached by a short bus ride from the main terminal Arrival was on schedule Indian government landing cards required of foreigners were provided on board The seats are traditional business class recliners and were reasonably comfortable Boarding was smooth intermixed with main cabin travelers through a jet way Ipads with a small selection of films and shows were provided soon after take off It was difficult to slot them into the metal clasps on the back of the seat in front of you you needed to hold on to the ipad to watch your program Magazines and newspapers on offer Lots of storage space overhead Leg space could be a tad extra once you recline fully your toes juts on the bottom of the front seat Announcements were made in clear English and for a very thoughtful touch also in Bengali the language of the destination city Cathay Dragon had a duty free catalog and three of my four selections were available for purchase This is one aspect of travel I very much enjoy as it lets me pick up last minute gifts

I enjoyed my flight Check in was easy and the plane left on time Staff were very pleasant and helpful Food was a small snack and soft drink which is fine on so short a flight Overall a very pleasant flight

Great employees service schedules but I have stopped flying with Horizon because they are now using Turbo Prop planes Q Its slower has more noise and vibration and most of all they cannot fly at altitudes where the ride is smooth This is compared to the full size jets that Southwest flies on the same routes as Horizon I used to have the credit card had Frequent flyer status and earned oodles of miles Those days are gone

Like many airports food and drinks are much too expensive I do therefore I also do not want to buy water It is not allowed to take bottled water through customs so most airports have free tap drinking water Also this airport But they are all disconnected I find this outrageous To have access to drinking water is a right

Narita to Naha Okinawa recently Flight was excellent On time clean new aircraft and great flight crew Check in and boarding no issues Professional and friendly staff Highly recommended for travel in Japan I am a world traveller and have flown many airlines Skymark is by far one of the best

Munich to Bologna and Pisa to Munich both on an Embraer economy Both flights handled efficiently southbound on time northbound delayed by about mins on departure due to to late arrival of incoming flight there had been thick fog at MUC early that morning which had sent things adrift for much of the morning However support given to those with tight connections Modest inflight service snacks and drinks wine came in proper glasses Air Dolomiti worked okay for us

I was a disabled passenger on the Tui flight departure date which eventually took off All Madeirian staff at the airport were polite very helpful in particular the disabled Assistance staff The poor weather affecting the departure will not deter my family from coming back to Funchal All the very best for the new year

The only international airport of the tiny island of Malta The building isnt the most modern one its renovated but doesnt offer enough seating or space at all especially during peaktimes Security was fast tho and they use the latest equipment Theres the usual food beverage all British shops and some dutyfree Malta has a huge busnetwork and the airport is served by several buslines too Staff is friendly and speaks fine English Dont forget to bring your Britishstyle power connector because European ones are hard to find

The flight from Kiev to Tel Aviv was delayed by about an hour and a half You can print your boarding pass at a selfserve counter in Kiev which is nice if you dont have access to a printer the queue for check in is long because of the extra security The security personnel were very friendly and professional The aircraft was clean I got a salad which was tasty and inexpensive Legroom is very tight my knees were touching the seat in front of me The crew were friendly and proactive with customer service but lacking when it came to safety and controlling passengers During the safety check they ignored a man talking on his phone as we taxied On landing in TLV many people started running down the aisle and opening the lockers while we were still braking on the runway The crew didnt say anything for a few minutes which only encouraged it Even when they did make an announcement it was ignored and they took no further action I would avoid flying them again particularly on this route where fares are cheap anyway on the way to Kiev I flew with Aegean for only a slighter higher fare and they were excellent

This is a small airport Single terminal concept Security was quick and since my flight was to Sao Paulo it is internal and there is no passport check All the gates are in a single long corridor Distances to walk are short The shops and cafes directly face the gates so you can drink a coffee and see when your gate is boarding The free WIFI was excellent Good stress free experience airport

Just wish to say that the check in and wheelchair assistance at Malpensa was really excellent and one of the best that I have experienced as a recent wheelchair traveller Staff were very helpful and efficient The only issue that I would raise is the state of the toilets

Noumea to Tokyo in economy and it was a good experience for a hrs flight The crew was warm and welcoming The seat was comfortable with a lot of space for my legs and the entertainment system was complete However the A cabin looked quiet old but these aircraft have to be replaced by mid The food was correct but not exceptional Overall it was an appreciable flight

The Airport was quiet and everything went really smooth The staff were professional and did not give me a hard time while checking in and during customsimmigration Toilets and lounge were clean and comfortable to use The wifi was also very reliable

Exceptional Service from Ground Crews I recently had an experience that despite starting off on the wrong foot turned into a testament to the incredible dedication of the airlines ground crew Unfortunately we mismanaged our time and ended up missing our flight It was a stressful situation for our family of four and we were worried about what would happen next However the ground crew went above and beyond to assist us They were understanding and reassuring immediately helping us to rebook our tickets What truly impressed us was their effort to ensure that we could sit together on our new flight The staff worked diligently and communicated openly throughout the process making a stressful situation much more manageable Thanks to the remarkable support from the team we were able to travel together without further issues I cant express enough gratitude for their exceptional service It truly made a difference in our travel experience Highly recommend this airline for their commitment to customer care
Flight RGNTVYMGZ on an old ATR Plane very worn from the inside and outside Cabin crew very friendly and efficient Small snacks and drinks offered on each sector Recommended

This is a small but tidy and well run airport that I suspect will increase in demand in near future Everything is laid out well there are modest food and drink facilities clean toilets and small offices for several car hire firms Hertz Europcar Sol etc An excellent starting point for exploring northern Spain Currently Ryanair flies there twice a day from Stansted and I believe Liverpool Good overall

Positive departure experience at Seville airport on Oct for a domestic flight After reading previous reviews I was wary of flying out of this airport but our experience was perfectly good Before the security checkpoint we found a pleasant caf for lunch Going through security was quick and easy Restrooms were clean and a cleaning person was busy at work keeping them so A push button rating system for the condition of the restroom was outside the door so perhaps Aena has received the message from prior reviews and is trying to do better No complaints at all about this airport

Went to Dubai for business with my wife and got a flight to Al Maktoum International DWC Brand new airport parts of it still in construction Much easier than DXB to go through has less shops though Not much variety for eating but enough for duty free Airport staff much more attentive that at DXB this to be expected though considering the traffic volume is much less than DXB Only downside is that it is far away from downtown Dubai if got business there I would give a high score as it is a brand new airport and facilities are improving all the time A pleasant experience overall

A very small airport no airways you walk on the tarmac to the terminal if like most people you need to buy a visa there is a line manned by only people and no organization at all then the customs man grunts at you or makes you open everything but then you are out and in one of the most beautiful places on earth

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Very good

Departure experience was relatively smooth an early morning flight on Ryanair so airport was very quiet Security was well managed clear markings on the floor to encourage social distancing However there was no coffee shop open so nowhere to buy a drink or a bite to eat Arriving back was very quick there were a number of staff members on hand to organise passengers no queue at passport control and bags were out within minutes however this was to be expected due to a very quiet flight and an empty airport Overall whilst the airport appeared clean we did not see any staff members cleaning while we were there with no hand sanitising stations available to passengers

Its a LCC and as such they do a great job Check in was smooth Without major hassles The flight departed on time only to be held up by the tower for half an hour due to traffic The seat was comfortable They did something strange for a LCC They fed all of us a free meal It wasnt the best meal But it was a hot chicken Meal And also due to some social media content They gave everyone on board a free gift of a tshirt Im sure that was a once off But all in all great flight experience Note no wifi and no screens But thats minor now days Because we all have Content

Flew Air Nostrum from Madrid T to Ibiza Nice short flight on a sunny afternoon Fast dropoff baggage a gentle Iberia staff member helped us to print boardingpasses halfhour late boarding walked to the plane Comfortable seats very kind cabin crew Flight itself was great splendid manned by a Ladycaptain So we started our summer holiday relaxed One week after second leg Ibiza to Valencia mins flight on turboprop Bit cramped seats bit noisy but for a such a short time wasnt important Final approach was rather steep but landing was OK Both flight were on time less than mins late arrival uneventful luggage claimed fast and in good situation decent priced I will not hesitate to use Air Nostrum for Spanish domestic flights in the future

I had an early morning flight from Terminal to CKG Arrived early due to the scheduled shuttle from my hotel The security arrangements here are very tight but not overbearing CheckIn was simple enough while I virtually had to empty my carry on of all electronic items for separate scanning Once through I headed to the Hainan Airlines lounge but it only opened at am so I waited for minutes Then I had a wait until am until breakfast was served but it was plentiful and delicious My aircraft was at a distant stand so I had to board a bus but the boarding process was smooth and simple

Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport is a welldesigned and highly efficient airport that makes traveling a seamless experience The terminal layout is intuitive making navigation easy and stressfree With a wide range of dining and shopping options passengers have plenty of choices to enjoy before their flight The airport is clean modern and offers a comfortable atmosphere with ample seating and wellmaintained facilities Security is wellmanaged ensuring a safe and smooth travel experience Whether youre on a quick layover or starting a journey DCA provides convenience comfort and efficiency at every step

The airport is functional and adequate for a shortish stay But it is unbelievably expensive There is a simple measure for this Terminal Heathrow The Perfectionists Cafe Heston Blumenthal proud holder of a few Michelin stars food delivered by friendly waiter etc Burger San Jose airport Smashburger fast food burger in plastic tray And sadly that sums up too many experiences in Costa Rica I spend a lot of time here and the feeling that everything is horribly overpriced just grows and grows The airport is a good example of that feeling they are abusing their visitors

Flew into Alderney from Southampton A lovely little airport Very relaxed friendly staff and a good shop and cafe very good considering the airport is tiny Taxis waiting right outside the main entrance and it only takes about minutes if that to get from the aircraft to the terminal entrance Very good all round

Flew Monarch from Alicante to Gatwick on the ZB on the th May on board A GZBAK Seated in row seats were very comfortable and leg room generous Cabin crew really helpful and also very cheerful Flight left on time and also arrived promptly despite a missed approach initially into LGW Overall a great flight experience and far more superior product to some of the other UK based low cost and charter airlines My only criticism and something I was not happy with was that Monarch do not appear to apply a crew rule in the cockpit at all times

Its mainly a domestic airport Internal sign and direction system is clear and well arranged Immigration check procedure is efficient The Japanese officers are well organized Public transportation from Komatsu airport to city downtown only relies shuttle bus The schedule is not frequent The time interval is often more than one hour

As living in the north of The Netherlands Bremen airport is a good alternative for Amsterdam Recently flown from the new low cost Ryanair terminal Its basic clean and blue There is a multipurpose shop which sells everything from a to z at somewhat inflated prices and small coffee shop Seating is mostly in plastic chairs which you could find at your local dentist Reasonable but we had an early flight so it was not so crowded Would not like to be there when its get full There are also some paid internet terminals The airport is well situated from the city center and freeway from the parking garage you are within minutes in the main terminal building Bremen is still a great small airport but they need to get some other low cost airlines on board besides Ryanair

London Johannesburg via Tripoli return I took the precaution of travelling hand luggage only and making sure not to use the bathrooms during the stop over at Tripoli and was pleasantly surprised The service matched any Ive travelled with over the years and at half the price Considering they offer the option of twice as much luggage in the hold as any other airline Ive travelled with I might even travel with lots of luggage next time

Flying Izmir to Ercan The International section is Very clean and modern Quick and efficient passenger service from checkin through passport control and all the way to boarding Its always a pleasure to use Izmir Adnan Menderes airport for arrivals and departures internationally The duty free shops are spacious and have many shopping options The toilets are clean and stocked I have no complaints always hasslefree flying out and through Izmir The WiFi is also a bonus very fast and user friendly to access

Cochabamba is a very small international airport some flights of Boliviano de Aviacion arrive from Buenos Aires Sao Paulo and seaonsally to Madrid It has enough space for the flights and people who use this terminal One of the most interesting things about this airport is its food court has plenty of choices and types of food and best of all if you are traveling on low budget there is a public transport service that will take you straight to town for almost nothing cents If traveling for tourism or business there is no other choice to get to the center of Bolivia Wifi runs great and its totally free

Gothenburg to Cambridge with SunAir a franchise partner of British Airways Aircraft are painted in British Airways livery and operate under BA flight numbers The flight was only half full making the seat Dornier more like a private jet than a small airliner Full meal and bar service on this hour flight Crew very good

Most of the airport was hot Only felt moderately cool at the quiet area which wasnt quiet at all It was right next to noisy escalators and on top of an area where staff I assume they were staff would congregate and loudly converse The rest of the time I thought staff were loudly and the airport was nice enough Lots of restaurants and little shops although most closed at night I arrived and was in transit for hours Outlets everywhere and potable water available

Brisbane to Toowoomba and I was amazed at the service provided by this small regional airline Skytrans Airlines Even though the flight in a small propjet was only minutes duration we were given bottles of water and packets of potato crisps Returning the next day service was equally as good Would recommend this airline

A great small airport Staff pleasant even down to the security staff which makes a pleasant change from the usual boredrude staff in most airports Free internet in departures and from landing to leaving teh front door only mins A bus to the city would be good

Had an excellent experience travelling through Dublin airport to Miami The security was efficient We precleared US customs and immigration which took minutes saving us from having to do it through Miami There was a good choice of food and drink but very limited once you enter the US zone

Little expense has been spared to make DRS a spacious and stateofthe art An allround highly agreeable experience with the added advantage of DRS being very close to the city centre A halfhourly rail service connects DRS with Dresden Hautbahnof a minute journey with several intermediate stops all for a princely EUR oneway fare BA has recently launched an LGWDRS service great views of the heart of the city on the landing approach from the starboard side but the airport remains somewhat underutilised

Came to Dushanbe airport at around am for my very early flight to Istanbul The new terminal is small but functional and easy to go through Not plenty to do but the airside cafe is quite nice with good selection and the free wifi was actually quite fast Duty free shop has the typical selection you see everywhere and some local products Plenty of places to sit down unless more than or flights going at the same time its not a very busy airport

Great airport small and friendly Not too bothered about duty free shops its an airport for quick in and out like most should be flights seem to be moving to Alicante but lets support this little airport and its staff Car hire very easy
This airport was very efficient no lines or delayed services There are a lot of shops where you can shop and places where you can have a bite Delicious coffee and bakery items to buy

My flight had been delayed so I arrived later at the airport however checkin had closed as checkin times had not been amended The security team were really helpful in scanning my bike box and ensuring it got to the gate to be loaded on the plane The team were very friendly and supportive with a great result Thanks
A very nice small airport with all that is needed except a coffee shop if I remember correctly Access is easy and clear the terminal clean and there is free parking

Unexpectedly Good I wasnt really sure what to expect and feared a tricky experience but in fact Fiji Airways were excellent I paid for extra legroom on the first leg but even on the long routing from Nadi to Vancouver the standard economy seat had excellent legroom Ive been more cramped in Qatar economy than this especially their recent seat config So this was a real bonus Crew were good and friendly I guess the weaker points are the food which is pretty basic and entertainment Both flights were ahead of schedule Id definitely fly with them again

I have never experienced such patience ever since I started travelling I became late because as we got to the airport my year old son fell and injured himself and had to take care of him The two ladies working at the boarding gate that afternoon called me twice to check up and make sure we got onto that flight and waited until the last minute before they closed check in I was in awe of their patience and care for me as a passenger this has never happened to me before especially to go to the extent of calling me Genuinely grateful and can never thank them enough We need more of this kind of understanding with airlines Best flying experience ever

This airport is improving In recent days they had added more space and departure gates also arrival area and baggage belt Security checks is most of the time relatively smooth not so long queue clean toilets Need to improve food options and also lounge experience

One of the easiest domestic airports to figure out Just a couple of restaurants but each one has great selection of food Theyve been getting better flights and it is transitioning to more of a transit type airport Staff is scarce but ticket counters are fast to checkin and the security line is real quick minutes at the most I now start my journey to any destination from here

BMAMMX one way The flight was comfortable with professional and friendly staff The free food and drinks served onboard were top quality The central location of Stockholm Bromma was very advantageous for our city break but checkin and boarding was a hassle Checkin closes minutes before departure which means that half the passengers were cramming at the check in desks in the last minute Free seating onboard the plane resulted in more cramming after the security because everyone wants a good seat It was a real circus In my opinion min checkin deadline instead of min and allocated seats instead of free seats would have been optimal

I had flights with this airline and found them to be very reliable st Maarten to Statia and St Maarten to Saba and back planes are very small but perfect for these minutes hop ground crew were friendly and even tagged my bags to Antigua on a codeshare with LIAT I was surprised they all arrived without major problems they are quick and professional sometimes slow sometimes not The prices are very high though The only worriesome moment I had with them was when one of the pilots shouted agressivily at the other just before engine started

First time from and to the new A terminal Didnt believe it but everything worked excellently No queues at checkin security passport control customs Bus gate had enough lift capacity so went down without wait On arrival baggage was on the belt in minutes and then in minutes off the airport Again no wait at immigration Food choices are fine both airside and landside Take into account this is just minutes some km from downtown Good choice and far superior to overcrowded Borispol with long queues dingy terminals and km from the city centre

TallinnAmsterdam is a short flight but crew were nice helpful and were able to understand at least languages they helped my Dutch Grandmother who speaks no English Amenities not normally provided but because flight was near empty they gave out snacks plus complementary tea and coffee They also allowed us to sit in vacant seats which was nice In general a nice trip and much more than was expected for basically a regional airline

Port Elizabeth airport is small and friendly Best thing about it is that it is so close to the main seafront area you can be on the beach about minutes after leaving the airport if you want Slight disadvantage once you are on the beach is that planes go right over your head Also very close to CBD and the pleasant suburb of Walmer PE known as the Friendly City and the airport gives it a good introduction

Small airport well organized and easy to get around The staff are not even remotely nice and not very fast at handling all the procedures The terminal is nice clean but lacking heavily on options to eat specially after going through security Not enough places to sit and waiting areas are small

Airport was new and very nice Immigration friendly and welcoming Nice first impression on Egypt upon arrival Washroom need to be cleaned regularly though Other than that its a very nice airport for travellers to Alexandria

I came here twice an hour layover and an hour layover im from Australia and was seeing some of Dads family in the UK I didnt have that high hopes for China i didnt know what to expect but wow The airport is massive yet its so empty it obviously very government controlled or something staff spoke like barely any English but they were alright i guess Security the first time took forever to que and it was insanely hot the second time was extremely quick though We stayed in a business class lounge because the lounge we paid for was before security the lounge was good it had great food and was nice The airport is pretty intimidating to be honest very foreign barely friendly to foreigners Couldnt wait to get back to Australia

Unexpectedly Good I wasnt really sure what to expect and feared a tricky experience but in fact Fiji Airways were excellent I paid for extra legroom on the first leg but even on the long routing from Nadi to Vancouver the standard economy seat had excellent legroom Ive been more cramped in Qatar economy than this especially their recent seat config So this was a real bonus Crew were good and friendly I guess the weaker points are the food which is pretty basic and entertainment Both flights were ahead of schedule Id definitely fly with them again

The Papeete airport PPT has to be experienced to appreciate how fortunate we are to have competent wellrun modern airports throughout the world Its not third world Worse It is an astounding perfect storm of incredibly slow TSA total indifference indecipherable in so far as where to go how to get there The one happy experience we had was the people the airport service employees Im in a wheelchair they were friendly helpful and made up a little for the amateurish functioning of PPT Our larger issue was United Airlines They cancelled our return flight at am hours after departure timeand immediately a wheel chair attendant showed up to deliver us to two of a few hundred cotsno blanket pillow waterin a warehouse near the airport I looked at a picture of a prison cell and the bed was superior to what United provided for us We never saw a United person in the multihour process Never again will we fly United OR go through through the Papeete airport PPT

The cabin crew were amazing They really took control of the cabin and looked after all the passengers The thing Ive never seen is how they controlled the disembarking of the plane ensuring specific rows would get up in an orderly fashion Ive flown Kulula for over a decade and theyve really upped their game

The meals were very good and the portions generous The crew were efficient and were on time both ways Seating assignments seemed ambiguous but my family of four ended up with one window seat on return to Vancouver from Amsterdam which was a nice surprise None of my children had any complaint throughout the two long journeys and that would be the measure of a pleasant flight experience by my standards I would fly with Martinair again in future

I chose this airport for my summer holidays back in as a familiar airline started operating a scheduled summer route and provided very appealing promo prices It seems that is airport is mostly used by charter and low cost airlines providing allinclusive offers to leisure destinations However you can still find some scheduled international routes operated by bigger European airlines throughout the year such as Air France of course but the prices usually go through the roof meaning you can buy a train ticket to Paris and fly from there at half the price The current trend is that bigger European airlines will use this airport just for a couple of months per year mostly for the summer season That being said the airport is very small but on the other hand there is also not much traffic so it is as big as it should be I suppose It is very easily accessible from anywhere within France or northern Europe This is because Lille is a train hub in northern Europe you can use the Lille Europe train station in Lille to reach multiple European capitals There is a bus shuttle from Lille Europe train station to Lille Lesquin airport for euros allerretour or euros single journey not very cheap but not expensive either The airport is also very nice from the outside and the inside and you have perfect view for landings and takeoffs while waiting in the gate for your flight The airport has a very informative website a facebook page and a twitter page There could be more adequate toilet facilities in the gate I was waiting the was a single facility with just one or two toilets inside I do not remember correctly On the plus side the facility was spacious and appropriate for people with mobility issues eg wheelchair

Palonegro to Cucuta with Easyfly Was put on this flight after Satena cancelled one of the legs I was hesitant since I had to make it to CUC that day The JS are quite small yet efficient planes Easyfly ground staff at Palonegro was quite helpful and professional Flight was smooth and punctual No complaints at all Despite the short duration of the flight minutes refreshments were offered Would consider it if needed

Like many airports food and drinks are much too expensive I do therefore I also do not want to buy water It is not allowed to take bottled water through customs so most airports have free tap drinking water Also this airport But they are all disconnected I find this outrageous To have access to drinking water is a right

Air Cambodia formerlyCambodia Angkor Air I felt quite sad for this airline because although the cabin crew were amazingly calm relaxed and friendly it seems that despite using smaller aircraft ATR s I understand they are really giving it their all to provide a decent level of service for such a short flight even though a cup of water was all that was provided I very much doubt if Ill ever fly with them again but I wish them all the very best

Offered sandwich and drinks at this very short flight I love flying on Embraer planes in a short regional flights as they are very comfortable Staffs were OK both on ground and on board All in all it was a good flight in terms of schedule service ticket price

BrusselsAleppo DamascusBrussels Cheapest tickets to Syria direct flights from Brussels to Aleppo and Damascus friendly crew adequate food Although older Airbus they were clean and looked well maintained and a lot of legspace

An unexpectedly pleasant experience The booking process was a bit odd but after using several different credit cards one finally worked on the airline website for a ticket about euros less than any other airline Check in and boarding was smooth Two suitcases allowed at kg each Or one at a maximum of kg There was entertainment with several English language recent films Ample food provided The layover was fine No one was saying anything about not taking photos and it wasnt any more different than transferring in China Seemed the duty free shops take card now too

GOTAYTGOT We choose this airline because it was a part of a charter trip We went on a seat A its was quite big It was as you expect in a economy class airplane not much legroom quite cramped The seats were quite nice but you will notice that they have been there for a while but it works fine The cabincrew are very friendly and nice The food onboard was okay You cant expect that much from an airline in the food section We thought we were going to get breakfast as we flew at in the morning Instead we got meatballs in a sauce which was really nice

BOSMKE I have flown to and from Mitchell countless times I grew up in Milwaukee and moved back here in June I agree with other reviewers that it is a clean friendly wellrun airport What stuck in my mind was how swiftly and well the baggage is handled I flew Southwest and sat fairly far forward in the cabin walked directly to the baggage claim area and by the time I arrived my baggage was already on the carousel This is something of a record in all of the flights I have experienced over the past few years at the other end is Copenhagen Kastrup in July where I waited close to minutes for the baggage to arrive with my own valise arriving some minutes later There is also a rapid bus to downtown with the stop now just outside the baggage claim area now that renovations of that area are completed There are also a couple of good Bartolotta restaurants on the concourses Piccolo Pizzeria and Nonna Bartolottas which I have enjoyed on previous departures All in all Mitchell is an excellent airport Now all they need is more nonstop flights

The airport is clean very functional and not too big to the point it becomes customer unfriendly As expected most products available to buy are well overpriced Passport control and security was a breeze

Good airport with facilities to cater for the number of flights Slight delays on arrival due to fruit and vegetable quarantine but no problem read the notices and listen to the announcements makes it easy It does the job
Friendly of the staff a new huge mall had been opening Mall del Soll This is the modern and fully functional airport with the biggest mall of the country and four hotels between stars

MontpellierMditerrane Airport is a tiny but nice airport Facilities are clean some computer charging desks are available reasonable amount of seats can be found at the gates Shopping and eating options are according to the size of the airport The airside area also features a lovely terrasse taking advantage of the sun drawbacks however The terrasse does not offer a direct view on the movement area and its the spot where all smokers endup Bagages delivery on arrival was a bit long especially for such a small airport Traffic right outside the terminal can be abot messy as the pickup dropoff zone seems to be on the street so cars are jammed Wifi connection procedure should be simplified and streamlined

Intersky is another airline charging high prices for regional services using and chartering cheap airlines Just flew back from SZG to ZRH Friendly stewardess and good service captain did not say a word Even though Intersky is the only direct Service between SZG and ZRH I would rather fly LH via Frankfurt

Dusseldorf to Paris CDG return on Embraer E jets The plane was very clean x configuration as standard with extremely wide seats I am cm on pounds and the seats were wide and long enough for my legs There was enough leg space including space for luggage below the seat Some people had trouble finding space for their luggage overhead but that is a problem on regional jets Shortly after takeoff the first round of drinks was served water and coffee without charge On the next run through about minutes later we got pretzels and salted peanuts Overall I am impressed by HOP and would recommend it Great staff outstanding service and a very pleasurable seating experience make it the perfect option for short trips

I arrived in Lilongwe for a work training we were facilitating and spent one night in Lilongwe and proceeded to Blantyre the following Monday afternoon When I arrived at Crossroads hotel where would stay until the coming Saturday morning I realized I did not have my passport wallet with forex and most importantly my passport and an older one I immediately alerted the hotel and the driver said he would check By the time I got to my room there was a message from Victor the Airport Manager who tried calling on watsap so I immediately responded He assured me they had everything and the next morning I went to collect it Sure enough every last note was still there I waited for a security officer to confirm that nothing was missing and signed off The honesty kindness and sheer humanity displayed was so moving I am deeply grateful to Angel for her assistance and the Airport Manager You guys are really incredible
Excellent flight left on time and arrived on time Amritsar to Kullu Small aircraft which was about full Great price no complaints from me and would happily fly with them again

Good transport connection via BAB Moderate parkingrates close to the terminals CheckIn only minutes prior to departure Short distances More than daily flights major Star Alliance hubs MUC and FRA and direct flights to holiday destinations Daily lowcost flights to London STN Vienna Rome FMO is a good choice for travellers in northern NRW western Niedersachsen and eastern Holland who want to start their journeys business travel as welll as holiday travel relaxed and in a friendly atmosphere
TFNGMZ return on ATR Very good minute flights Served cup of water and chocolate bar Great views of a snow capped Mt Teide on left going and right returning

Check in was fast and efficient Boarding was set out in groups the gate was small but boarding was very speedy Our seats were in economy but the IFE screen was larger than most economy cabins Ive been in Seats were comfortable and legroom was okay The cabin crew were so friendly and attentive We were offered drinks and snacks to begin with followed by a sandwich then a hot meal before landing with a few more drink and snack services in between Ive flown with Virgin to JFK a few times and wouldnt hesitate to fly with them again Never have any issues and staff are always on hand to help

This is a nice little airport as previously stated and one minor comment which persons using it for the first time should appreciate is that there is no ATM or machine for buying tickets for the connecting buses into Stockholm although the information desk is helpful and do accept most credit cards They will try to assist in anyway possible So be prepared

I was surprised with the cleanliness and efficiency of the airport in Guayaquil Really modern and easy to navigate I liked the zen garden at the domestic arrivals which really was a nice touch Toilets were clean Passport control very organised and staff are polite also duty free staff were very helpful Nice WiFi and view of the runway watching planes goes by Happy using it

My favourite airport Fast efficient and very pleasant Easy to get to easy to navigate checkin and security is always fast and friendly and the lounge above Security is great Extremely roomy and classy great for work or relaxation even offers open smokers cabins that dont feel like a cage and a chess game for those with plenty of time Almost everywhere in the airport can you overlook the runway and the whole place is just modern roomy and open The airport size is an advantage without doubt the distances between parking checkin security lounge gate and flight are minimal so getting in and out is always a pleasure Much better than Copenhagen in almost all aspects

Basically a well designed terminal that requires upgrading Immigration and visa on arrival procedures are quick as foreign passport holders go to separate counters both for arrival and departure Luggage delivery is fast but then you will have to queue for at least minutes as every piece of luggage has to go through the only screening machine in the customs hall No taxi or airport shuttle is available and you will have to rely on touts or on military staff very friendly to help you find a vehicle to take you to town unless you have prearranged transport with your hotel Departure hall is not airconditionned and was infested by mosquitoes out of duty free shops were closed and the single airline lounge has been closed for a long time One positive point all areas including toilets are kept very clean

The airport is big upon my arrival I passed through the electronic gate and it did not take more than a minute to complete my entry procedures into the country and it was more than wonderful The treatment of the airport staff is wonderful we received our bags quickly and there was no delay Upon our departure the treatment was also professional friendly and fast from the staff and there was no delay in stamping passports security check or check in We tried two restaurants to eat at the airport and the food was very tasty travelling through Dubai Airport is a wonderful experience

Koh Samui is usually an excellent airport the tropical ambience laid back staff garden setting and impressive views of the planes make this a quirky experience The recent floods and mass cancellations have regrettably brought this airport to its knees however Under normal conditions I thoroughly recommend this establishment

Interesting experience This airport is very close to the city mainly for domestic flights and is extremely busy However even though really crowded all queues seem to move very quickly A reasonable mix of retail outlets and I thought the prices were OK Plenty on taxis on return there are prepay ones but for journeys into the city a metered cab is fine

On October th we flew from Vienna to Karpathos which turned out to be the last passenger flight with this Airline to this destination due to the sad development The crew worked flawless as ever and was extremely friendly despite the fact that they are not quite sure about their professional future Not a single mention came up about that but you could see and sense their feelings We are exceedingly angry about the fact that many thousand passengers loose their money and some thousand well working employess lose their job Many many thanks and good luck for the crew and all the other employees of ABNiki

The toilets are the cleanest I have seen Im years The customs was quick and efficient I travel every year to Curaao and was a pleasure to see that they are much better than Schiphol Las Americas American airports European airports

Pretty new terminal opened about a year and half ago Its an improvement on the old terminal Not many flights and of them from Ryanair Basic regional airport that does the job not huge lines to check in or pass security Dont go through security unless your flight its about to depart since in the air side there is only a little barcafeteria and two vending machines not too many seat if there are two flights at the same time In the land side good bar and resto Bad Bus connection to the city and expensive taxi service EUR to centre So overall small nice airport that allows you to show up h before your flight departs without risk of missing the plane

I passed through this airport in July They had done a lot of improvements since the first time I flew through in and I know that its not totally finished now The price of food and beverages is pretty expensive The airport looks good and clean The staff are professional

Bari Airport looks new but they have not yet found a way to avoid a minute wait for security checks Leaving tourists in a minute queue for security is not a good way to attract tourists If the queue is minutes on th April what will it be in July and August Puglia is a great region to visit and Bari is an excellent gateway Pity the local autorities cant run an airport

Flew this route again last weekend Menzies the handling agent at EDI very helpful bag drop and boarding a breeze Where SunExpress excel is with their cabin crew who were helpful friendly and professional Also very well groomed Bugra and Ismet were excellent and an asset to the company I wouldnt hesitate to travel with them again and recommend

Clean airport Fairly good coffee and muffin place inside The cafe takes Som or US Power for charging stuff in the cafe Duty free a bit sad separate security screenings but all fast enough minutes from kerbside to airline gate better than many civilised airports Bags checked there arrived ok at destination on time after flights Take off minutes late without explanation The indicator board was never altered The information desk had no better advice Maybe the airport could insist airlines provide up to date information The waiting masses were getting restless One announcement was made in a language that may have been Korean but none of the Korean passengers could understand it It was not English or Uzbek

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

Once again I booked with LAM Air Mozambique although this time the flight was operated by the South African carrier CEMAIR It was actually a pleasant surprise as I found the crew to be very friendly professional and concerned about keeping us informed and safe throughout the journey The flight was short and was operated by a Canadair CRJ which is a secondhand aircraft most likely purchased from Lufthansa as some of the information was written in German The carryon space is very limited and I had to place my backpack under my seat as I would have to check it in They provided a snack box for free The flight was very quick and basic If I ever fly to South Africa again I would give CEMAIR a chance

This ugly block is straight out of Stalins era although a new terminal is going up alongside The old one is tatty Two gates A B A few little shops a bar and no smoking inside VIPs are called earlier than other travellers and in my case to a different gate Keep your eyes peeled I tried my Skyteam Platinum card on the VIP gate and it worked The VIP lounge plumbs new depths Seedy styling and furniture with a peeling linoleum floor and no smoking there either And you have to pay for everything even a coffee but the range of food and drink is quite reasonable Still we did get our own minibus to the aircraft and we got on first To be fair the folks around the place are friendly enough

Qazaq Air from Almaty to Shymkent returning a few days later Very good value considering tickets were booked less than hours before departure Nice new aircraft and smartly attired crew who were all trilingual Baggage is included in the ticket price and hand luggage was not strictly monitored but since both flights were not full there was plenty of space in the overhead lockers Check in at both ends was perfunctory and more or less wordless but the flights were punctual the return flight leaving minutes before the scheduled time of which was greatly appreciated by all on board There was even a snack service with a good choice of drinks all included in the ticket price Another retro touch was the basket of sweets offered round before take off I would definitely fly this airline again and hope they expand their destinations The only thing I would say against them is that at present their small fleet seems to mean that certain routes are served with en route stops that added to the slower speed of the Q aircraft could make some trips around Kazakhstan quite arduous Overall though excellent and amazing value

Its nothing too special but it was definitely an affordable price The inflight food and beverage was comprised of a juice box and bottled water The customer service is ok There was in issue with the website where it continually declined my card but it actually charged my card every time I attempted meaning with four attempts there were in false charges Fortunately the customer service could be reached by WhatsApp and they were able to refund me for the imaginary flight bookings

Returned from a week away in the Algarve We landed around on Friday My partner had a big problem with walking huge pains in her right leg A ramp had been put in at the rear of the plane for her to get off of by way of a wheel chair Young lad by the name of Oliver was her helper in this Walked us through passport and customers He asked where we were parked I had cases and small bass on a trolley He took us all the way to where our car was parked Massive thank you to him for going beyond what he would normally do if he was much busier
Departed on october to Paris Orly abd back on October Airport very clean opened early in the morning Check In and Security Checks are easy early in the morning

A small airport with a modern purposebuilt terminal with direct raillink from the city With only one flight to serve on a Sunday afternoon service all round should have been and was excellent Plenty of seating although that in the bar was a bit utilitarian

All flights were on time and comfortable Cabin crew were friendly and welcoming On board snacks to buy were good value Seat pitch good average Last year we few with this company from Madrid to Malta and return Both flights very good

Originally booked through Canaryfly Upon arrival at airport we saw that our flight was cancelled We didnt receive any notice but it turned out very smooth as we were already booked on a Binter flight at the original time To us it seemed as this happens frequently and they have a good system in place The flight was enjoyable and the cabin crew did a very good job

Used Zhulany for arrival and departure domestic services No queues things went fast From car to plane in minutes and minutes from plane to car no hold bags The domestic terminal B looks bad but the new International terminal A is a good quality facility Overall ok but just for regional low cost flying

Hobart Airport is much more user friendly now though the terminals have not been connected so Jetstar passengers are still relegated to the old botched international venture built for the old Ansett The new catering in domestic is good but It is shameful that there is no WiFi intenet access anywhere It would cost a few hundred dollars at the most for the Tasmanian Government to give free WiFi access at Hobart Airport and so reinforce the image it is trying to give as a progressive State It is doubtful that a private company will ever do it and Tasmania would top all the other states in lateral thinking if it did it for free

Just like winning the lottery there are some things that you just do not expect to do Giving Kabul airport a good review is one of them But here it is I have been travelling to Kabul for many years and have always hated the airport battle But the new airport is different If all you want to do is got on and off of a flight quickly and efficiently Kabul airport does that very well The hour queues at immigration are gone More like minutes now Baggage reclaim is as good as anywhere else in he world It took about half an hour from landing to being out of the airport No problems with check in either My Turkish flight left exactly on time Dont expect too much in the way of shops or business lounge in the departures area but it is adequate Wifi Internet is working well and free There are lots of security checks on the way into the airport Expect lots of Xray checks and various vehicle and body searches That is just a part of life in Kabul these days Overall a good and efficient experience and a big change from the old Afghan way

We had quite a lot of time to kill in this airport and it didnt disappoint There was a restaurant right in the middle of the terminal that was delicious and decently priced Unfortunately the wifi was not working no matter how many times we tried but they had this nice area called the library we sat in that was pleasant and helped the time pass

Hong Hong to Budapest via Shanghai Flew on A on HKG to Shanghai while in a newer B on the long haul to Budapest China Eastern marketed flights The long haul leg was flown by their daughter company Shanghai Airlines to Budapest Amazing experience pure adventure Bought this ticket some months earlier for the high season to Europe as a huge bargain for USD including x kg of luggage which is welcomed near Xmas It costed me in addition positioning and depositioning flights to which I volunteered as I needed the extra miles for my elite status However I was notified months before travel by my online travel agent Travelgenio that the return flight from Budapest was preponed by hour Then I was forced to change as I would not be able to arrive in time for the new departure I then decided to change plans completely and celebrate New Year in Budapest instead of Vietnam Thus I postponed my return travel from Budapest by days This was done by emails to the Travel Agent no response and then phone calls to Ch Eastern in Brisbane and Shanghai Eventually it went smoothly and I was changed to my wish without added costs apart from changing onward flights beyond Hong Kong with another airline That even allowed me to do another cheap detour to Hanoi on my way back to Hue The homepages of China Eastern and Shanghai are difficult to penetrate and to book or change bookings from Unless one has a Chinese telephone number However days before departure I could access seating and chose freely my favourite seats even got of legs in exit seat However one cannot access the entire booking unless registered with CEs flyer program in which I am not interested Apart from that it was a good adventure a complicated travel where everything could have gone wrong but all went smooth Arrived in Hongkong early and was able to checkin hours before departure as the airline have many departures daily No queues at the checkin and the ground staff were good and answered questions though fearing speaking English Two BPs issued immediately Flying HKGPVG is considered as international flights though it could be considered as domestic That give the advantage of not leaving transit while leaving HKG and passing PVG First flight was on an aged A Extremely controlled and organised priority boarding at gate where all business and elite flyers were boarding entirely before the remaining passengers Onboard newspapers and channels of music were offered bring own headset Shared monitors showed some educational movies Food was limited to a tidy pack of biscuits Drinks were unlimited water tea coffee beers but only for hour out of the hour long flight during ascend and descend all services were closed down until Minutes after kickoff and again Minutes before landing That leaves passengers with very limited time of service FAs were fine The second flight were by Shanghai Airlines Boeing It was a very positive surprise and was faultless Modern aircraft good food and service hot meals offered at dinner and then again at breakfast Frequent drink rounds Button calls answered quickly and needs were addressed instantly Individual IFE on touchscreen monitors was very easy and quick to operate with a good number of Western and English translated movies Toilets clean Both flights took off earlier than scheduled

I found the airport to be more than adequate We were there in July and it was busy but check in was OK as was security The waiting area is small and there are not enough catering facilities but the roof top terrace was brilliant it was a pleasure to wait for the plane for once and you can have a cigarette in peace The toilets were clean and tidy wastebins emptied frequently so all in all not a bad airport have certainly spent time in much worse

Dulles Airport is located in Virginia and bit far from Washington DC Very large and wellmaintained airport very clean Few sitting places Immigration process takes long time Boarding bridge works as bus to the airport terminal Taxi and bus services are there

A small pleasant and friendly airport All the staff are really nice and now even the younger staff at security are very friendly which wasnt typical before the pandemic The procedures are very fast However during peak times there is absolutely not enough space around the caf and dutyfree shops in the Schengen section even after the recent terminal upgrade I really miss the newspaper stand in this area I would especially like to praise the staff at Little Slovenia in the NonSchengen section Its truly a small oasis of kindness and wellbeing

Very small airport but there still are jet bridges which was surprising Everyone I met was so friendly and welcoming The bags were out very quickly Just remember to arrange the transport before arrival

Manston is an excellent small airport The staff immigration customs and police are friendly but still professional Checkin was handled well Security was a little laborious but was thorough and in no way objectionable There is a small shop and a barcafeteria which considering the short amount of time needed to check in is all that is required A great option for those traveling to or from the south east corner of England I hope the route to Amsterdam is successful as it is so much more pleasant than flying from one of the big London airports Heathrow in particular I have heard that a rail link will be coming
