I recently flew round trip from San Francisco to Clark international with a layover at Taoyuan International both ways Because of my own financial resources I flew economy class on all legs of the journey I did pay for an aisle seat on the two transPacific flights I flew to the Philippines in order to speak at a conference and needed to find the most economical way to get there I was pleasantly surprised to find that EVA Air offered a roundtrip option for about half the price After checking some reviews on YouTube I booked my trip using the EVA Air website The process was easy and took very little time To say that I was pleased with the experience would be an understatement I am tall and not a small person I found the seats to be comfortable with plenty of leg room The customer service was excellent and the flight attendants were friendly and professional I received two meals on both of my longer flights and surprisingly one meal on each of the shorter hour flights All the meals were well prepared and quite tasty The inflight entertainment was a bit limited but adequate Overall I would recommend using EVA anywhere they fly
The cabin is clean Flight attendants are friendly and polite Seats are comfortable and can be reclined easily The food is delicious Flights departed on time

Departure is very tedious Our flight got delayed not due to the airports fault but it took hours for them to get our luggage back Most of the luggage returned were wet and damaged Arrival however is very quick and easy

Durban to Cape Town with Comair This is a hour flight which was full The business class seats were the same as economy but with a little extra legroom and the middle seat was empty The FAs were mature and friendly There was a full bar service and light lunch was served The aircraft was clean left on time and arrived on time A relatively smooth flight unlike BA they serve refreshments and full bar service on this short haul domestic flight

An excellent Domestic terminal very large and clean The security screening upon entering the airport for a am departure was fast and thorough Plenty of check in counters and efficient agents manning them The food is very expensive but I dont buy at the airport so no problem A very nice airport all in all

Flight to Karachi from Multan The Airbus used for the journey was old and there wasnt any IFE present but the cabin had a nice ambience to it The flight attendents were very nice and pleasant The IFM was so so but you cant complain about it Take off and landing were was smooth I will definitely be flying with Shaheen International again

Special assistance staff went above and beyond to help us after huge road delays meant we were late arriving at the airport Cant thank them enough Airport itself was very clean easy to navigate lots of choice for food and drink Fantastic staff
Melbourne to Nouma Surprisingly very good airline and good business seat for a three hours flight Very good staff and very good product in business Among them Nikko Japanese whisky

Ive flown in and out of BJX a half dozen times and have no problems Take along a book or knitting as there are only a couple of souvenir shops but they are colorful and reasonable My destination has been San Miguel de Allende the art colony thats popular with US citizens

Yangon to Mandalay with Golden Myanmar Airlines was very pleasant and positive The airline online booking system was good checkin counter staff very friendly and the checkin was easy The flight left the gate as per schedule and the flight was comfortable Cabin crew were friendly and efficient Passengers were served with light snacks during the approx hrs flight

I fly this airport several times per year The name and location sounds like a bigger adventure than it actually is The airport is small so boarding an A is already something that keeps everybody busy However there are not that many flights ground staff are friendly and helpful
Totally not as bad as all the reviews had us expecting No printed boarding pass needed They just gave us one Ryanair No long waiting time Only thing too cold and no smoking area after security check

MADTFN Departed a bit late due to chaotic boarding process But arrived on time due to shorter flight time than usual Except for that issue fligth went well Crew really nice and worked hard Seat ok just economy with a bit recline and comfortable They served a full warm breakfast On board IFE available to use on you personal device nice choice of moviesshows Good service for the Iberia low cost carrier

I had a great experience here Check in was quick and polite immigration and customs were very efficient and there was a good range of shops and restaurants I fly here quite often and it is nearly always a good experience

HELMUC on tired MD Took the Internet upgrade opportunity for to Premium Economy Worth it on ground service Quick checkin Fast Track at Security as Economy Pax had a long queue for both The SAS Lounge in Helsinki very basic Cabin crew friendly nice breakfast However no English newspapers available and no comments at all to the flight from the cockpit The price for the upgrade is ok as I had rows for me alone in contrary to the Economy cabin which was full Otherwise you are flying Low Cost with a high economy fare

Trip VerifiedI decided to opt for an extra legroom seat up in Economy but the website nor app was allowing me to book the seat or make a payment I reached out to customer care on email but the agent said that I can book the seat during checkin so to ensure this I woke up at midnight but the transaction did not go through the second agent was also equally unhelpful and recommended waiting couple more hours I stayed awake and tried again but no luck the third agent then told me that this can be done only before checkin and tried to fob me off with an apology to settle for a seat at airport checkin Finally the third agent was able to help and I got a good extra legroom seat and thankfully the rest of the journey from Maputo to Doha was great except for the food quantity which is really not adequate for me The entertainment selection was not the best but overall this leg was quite comfortable The crew onground and inair were quite good The Doha to Bombay leg was less comfortable given that this leg is operated by Indigo The Indigo service is not up to expectations there is no IFE the food offered was a tasteless sandwich and some chips If you are booking on Qatar Airways tofrom India check that the leg from Doha to Qatar is operated by Qatar Airways and not Indigo I have nothing against Indigo and am perfectly happy to fly them for short domestic flights in India but anything longer than a hour and half with them makes for an uncomfortable flight

Its been decades since I last traveled through Nashville The transformation of this airport is amazing The international arrivals facility has Global Entry but no Mobile Passport Control Give yourself plenty of time at least hours to make connecting flights The lines care very long and the distances from the gates to Immigration and Customs are very long The terminal was very crowded however with wheelchair assist we were able to breeze through Immigration The only drawback is that one has to exit the secured area and go through TSA security all over again with very long lines Once youre through the security one is met with wide open very clean and brightly lit concourses with dining and shopping aplenty Restrooms were very clean The free airport WiFi was easy to connect to and very fast

Excellent airport having recently done a roundtrip from Dundee to Birmingham It is really convenient for those working in and around Dundee with reliable flights from both Flybe and Cityjet Air France If you need to get away from Dundee Birmingham and London are ideal for onward connections and you dont have the hassle of having to drive to Edinburgh pay for parking and the long check in times Here you can checkin mins prior to your flight
Short but pleasant flight on time Friendly crew cheap tickets clean plane and for a such a short flight a good snack was offered Boarding and deboarding fast

I would not call Terminal of Sofia Airport a terminal for international flights This T is more like an intercity bus station unclean with insufficient seating with only three kiosks called I dont know why Duty free provided that the prices in them are equal and in some cases even higher than those in stores in Bulgaria Boarding organization is bordering on ZERO The socalled gates are indicated by some signs but in no way are they separated into separate areas Duty free

Guangzhou Baiyun Airport is the most impressive airport for me The ground staff of China Southern Airlines are very warm and have a good attitude This aspect is much better than many domestic airports Since I booked the hotel next to the boarding gate I needed to get the ticket to pass the security check and customs one day in advance The staff of China Southern Airlines helped me to coordinate with the customs and security check departments and finally I checked into the airport transfer hotel successfully

A huge airport with multiple terminals and layers thereby distances are big Large lifts and automated people movers do help a lot Border control was fast and efficient they hand out a sim card for free on arrival Security was efficiently organized too Staff is mostly friendly and helpful Transport to town can be by metro busses or taxi It easily takes hour or more

Bangkok to Taipei Having now taken four flights on V Air my comments remain virtually the same as my earlier review I arrived at the newly opened international terminal at Bangkoks Don Mueang airport about minutes prior to the scheduled departure Checkin took less than minutes even though the plane was around full The aircraft pushed back minutes late but arrived precisely on time The seat is comfortable with more leg space than is usual on budget carriers my preordered meal of chicken teriyaki was excellent and the FAs are efficient and cheerful One even came to my seat to welcome me back having seen me on my last flight almost months earlier I wish all budget carriers were of a similar standard

Flew with this airline today from Sapporo to Kobe and the leg room was larger than most airlines Ive flown with and the service was impecable For a budget airline it included kg luggage as well as a complimentary small snack and coffee during flight I however purchased a Coke and Soup for yen approx AUD Unlike most Australian airlines the cabin crew remained inside the cabin for the majority of the flight making sure everyone was okay and at one stage offering lollies to any needy sweettooth pax Id fly with them again and can safely say they were the best budget airline Ive flown with

The airport is very small so there is a lot of queuing Check in was fairly smooth once it opened and the check in lady was helpful and efficient Oversized baggage also taken at the desk which is good when youve got ski equipment There was then a long wait until we were announced to go through security Waiting area was limited and the food sat in a semi outside area where smoking was allowed There was a very long windy queue through security Limited facilities before and after security There is no lounges available

DubaiKabulDubai in early December Kamair continues to be OK Both flights were close to being on time the only small delay down to Dubai air traffic They are now doing the luggage security check in Kabul which means you have to point out your case before it is loaded onto the aircraft Dont forget to do this if you want to see your case at your destination

Return leg was an older model configured in Business about half full Actually the seating is better than the configuration as you have more feet room Food was really good especially the Salmon Cod and Prawn ceviche a true delight The bed was comfortable and the service attentive movie choice the same as going out days previous One criticism is that priority bags do not come out first I awaited mins for my bag to arrive and nearly missed my connection although arriving at and a departure on next flight at The second leg on older plane entertainment system not working at all Breakfast and service was good arrived on time and again no priority bags first This is one area they need to work on Hence Ground service only star
It is clean modern spacious and well designed The efficiency of security is high The WiFi connection is good Employees are helpful and polite

We were totally amazed by their services since none of us have ever heard of this airline The trip was arranged by the travel agency who arranged our tour Even during a short trip they provided us gourmet sandwiches and a warm cookie while beverages was served twice which is far much better than what we experienced from those larger airlines How we wish they can cover more routes

This airport is great Always clean lovely staff few delays and good food The information desk woman was very welcoming and we had a lovely chat Wifi access was good As small airports go Bluegrass is pretty much the model of what a small airport should be Shopping options are limited but you have a nice bookshop and a good bar after security the car park is a minutes walk from the terminal and the surroundings are well kept In years of traveling through Lexington I can think of nothing negative to say about this airport and its staff Even the TSA security check has always been pleasant

Very small airport with not many destinations to fly to from Free parking in front of airport very fast check in One restaurant coffee shop with nice local food Arriving at Antwerp airport it will take you around to after disembarking until you receive your suitcase and are in a taxi home

An unexpectedly pleasant experience The booking process was a bit odd but after using several different credit cards one finally worked on the airline website for a ticket about euros less than any other airline Check in and boarding was smooth Two suitcases allowed at kg each Or one at a maximum of kg There was entertainment with several English language recent films Ample food provided The layover was fine No one was saying anything about not taking photos and it wasnt any more different than transferring in China Seemed the duty free shops take card now too
A smallish airport with limited facilities but clean and comfortable

REX have always been professional I never took much notice of airlines I just know who I will no longer fly with In my recent trip with REX the light bulb went on I understood the Guest ethos that had been taught to me through employment as a driver for luxury travel With REX I finally got it the Guest Experience No other airline has made me feel this elusive Guest experience Ive had some absolute shockers I am now a nervous flyer Not a heart string pull try flying home with your step sons ashes and being treated poorly in the USA which you are transiting through Suffice to say I hate flying This recent trip I engaged brain I saw it and was the recipient of their incredible service The thing that makes airline travel easy seamless safe treat people with respect Dont immediately treat then with disrespect because of a judgement And this is REX

Manado airport is one of the best in Indonesia It has a small delay rate and has a very good view from the waiting room The airport terminal faces east of Manado and oversees the beautiful nature and mountain ranges with the planes takingoff and landing

Departure hall clean spacious and air conditioned Well organised queuing system with KLM staff tagging hand baggage in advance to make check in run smoothly Each airline had their own desk Security fast just remember to have your red immigration card Food outlets fine but limited Shopping limited as two shops sold the same items Duty free had a good range of perfume and drinks but beware if you are European and outside the Eurozone prices are more expensive for cosmetics than what you would pay in High Street shops Didnt fully investigate alcohol but you need to look carefully for offers and compare them to a local supermarket We werent travelling with children but I didnnotice any play facilities on offer Seats OK Arrival Hall just had fans but didnt have to wait long for luggage There are toilets in the baggage reclaim hall these were clean and well maintained For a small island a really good airport

Sawyer is a small airport in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan with flights to Detroit and Chicago provided by Delta and American respectively There is a small store selling Northern Michigan University paraphernalia some basic snacks and coffee The major car rental firms have desks in the terminal with the cars parked just outside The parking is excellent you walk out of the terminal into the parking lot Less than a minutes walk from the airport entrance to the security check area The terminal has excellent free wifi service courtesy Northern Michigan University Very friendly and efficient staff Taxi service is available to the city of Marquette about miles away

Larnaca to Athens This is registered as a Cypriot airline yet it seems that they are against the local language in that safety instructions are given only in english On this airline it is impossible to select a free seat only paid seats can be selected via web The aircraft was more than perfect clean but was not near jetways and bus was used for boarding In flight magazine price list and safety instructions were overused Nothing was offered during the flight if you want a drink you pay for it
A reliable airline with excellent service from checkin to boarding to in flight service Gracious staff Prompt at times early Amazing and use airbridge in Bangkok

Tenerife Norte to Gran Canaria Excellent airline clean and new plane They offer a chocolate snack and a glass of water and a candy just before landing all this in a minute flight There is even a wifi entertainment system on board The best airline I have used

Rex Airlines is a standout in terms of professionalism and helpfulness Their call centres are here in Australia staffed by knowledgeable and problem solving women sorry men I have just dealt with amazing women Rex is our airline of choice when it flies where we need to go It is hands down better than the other airlines based in Australia and is a reminder that an airline can work well and treat customers with personal and professional service

This is a small airport to say the least It only has gates and this is after it is being modernized and expanded Construction is still going on so it can be a bit noisy Security is fairly painless There is only one restaurantlounge airside or curbside Hopefully this will change when construction is complete Airside has floor to ceiling windows affording views of the spectacular Tetons Almost as impressive is the array of private jets lined up toward the south end of the airport If you fly here be sure to take a daytime flight in and book an F side window seat for a jawdropping view of the Tetons on approach

Just like winning the lottery there are some things that you just do not expect to do Giving Kabul airport a good review is one of them But here it is I have been travelling to Kabul for many years and have always hated the airport battle But the new airport is different If all you want to do is got on and off of a flight quickly and efficiently Kabul airport does that very well The hour queues at immigration are gone More like minutes now Baggage reclaim is as good as anywhere else in he world It took about half an hour from landing to being out of the airport No problems with check in either My Turkish flight left exactly on time Dont expect too much in the way of shops or business lounge in the departures area but it is adequate Wifi Internet is working well and free There are lots of security checks on the way into the airport Expect lots of Xray checks and various vehicle and body searches That is just a part of life in Kabul these days Overall a good and efficient experience and a big change from the old Afghan way

Quite a small airport compared to the Dubai or Abu Dhabi International Airports Only half a dozen or airlines serve this airport On arrival myself and wife senior citizens were treated with compassion and helped by the airport customs and immigration staff No difficulties faced by us we found the airport quite peaceful neat and tidy I wish more flights were available to and from this Airport in UAE Travel to city center of Al Ain a charming city in the midst of the Arabian desert was also a pleasant experience with hardly any traffic problems
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Very good

The arrivals hall at the international terminal is clean and tidy but does not cope well with any more than large aircraft arriving at the same time It can take over an hour to clear customs and there is only one baggage conveyor The only ATM is after passport control and you will need PGK if you wish to purchase a visa so it pays to have your currency ready before you depart for POM The departure lounge is also very clean and tidy and customs and immigration are efficient However if you wish to do shopping there is only one very small duty free shop and an even smaller cafe after customs and security

Horizon Air from Seattle to Eugene roundtrip No complaints the crews were great planes clean and on time in both directions As with all of Horizon Air flights free beverages including wine and beer are provided The aircraft was perfect for the less than one hour flight to SeaTac quite fast actually The skies were clear and the view was perfect Nice job all the way around

From Zanzibar to Arusha ATR arrived on time from Dar el Salam Friendly staff and they offer snack and juices and alcoholic drinks On arrival our suitcases arrived in a short time Overall good experience

I flew from Marseille to Ajaccio Overall I was satisfied The outbound leg was carried out with an ageing but very well kept ATR and the return with a recent A Both flights were on time and the crew was polite and smiling Given the short duration of the flights both around minutes the inflight service consisted solely of drinks but thats fine The basic fare always includes a checked in luggage and the price was correct I spent euros return to fly on midJuly booking just weeks prior to departure The only minus was the long waiting time to collect the luggage at AJA minutes despite having just aircrafts to unload but I dont blame it on Air Corsica

Ottawa Airport is one of the best airports I travelled from The security line is fast the airport is clean and you dont have to wait one hour just to get to your gate Its a well made good looking fast and efficient airport

Paro International Airport is located meter above sea level so flights can only fly in the morning I took a Druk Air flight from Bangkok and the other time I took a flight from Kathmandu I prefer flying from Kathmandu because I could see Himalayan Mountains if the weather permits Paro Airport has very basic amenities because they have two carriers flying in and out It replicated Bhutanese traditional architecture and it looked very beautiful as I was walking into the airport

Fantastic well functioning airport all the shops and facilities you need it took almost no time to get through passport control and security check friendly staff all in all an exceptionally good experience

Beijing to Pyongyang The aircraft was clean cabin crew friendly and the flight on time You get the Pyongyang Times to read aboard I flew for the first time this type of a Tupolev and found not much difference to some other aircraft The food was acceptable The selections of beverages could be better

Contrary to all of the recent negative press about airports and their staff our experience flying and coming back in was seamless Given the pressure that all airport staff are under they are doing an amazing job and are doing it with a smile We travelled down to Newcastle from Scotland and stayed in the Premier Inn the night before I would have no hesitation in using this airport again Well done to all of the staff

Overall our experience my wife and myself in transit twice in KGL has been satisfactory certainly compared with airports in the region with regard to seating not very comfortable but OK cleanliness including toilets signage and announcements attitude of official personnel security and boarding procedures Free WIFI did not work However we have been ripped off when purchasing goods from the VIVA GLOBAL DUTY FREE SHOP billed much higher prices than advertised no receipt received for some goods which we also paid far too much in USD We did not have our luggage on arrival at destination travel with Rwandair to BRU our suitcases arrived early next day via another company but we had to collect them from the airport since Rwandair does not have a policy of sending delayed luggage to the home

On June airport started renovation of taxiways as well as the installation of a new apron The inside of the airport is very clean it is easy to orientate the construction of a new terminal will begin The runway lighting is bad but will also be updated soon I very much hope that everything will be fine and that it will be easier and safer to travel

I had a wonderful experience flying with Vistara Airlines recently and I cant praise their staff enough especially Ankush and Manisha From the moment I arrived at the airport they made the entire checkin process incredibly smooth and stressfree Ankush was welcoming and guided me through each step with such professionalism making sure I had all the information I needed His calm and friendly demeanor made a normally hectic process feel easy and seamless Manisha was equally attentive helping me with my questions and ensuring I felt comfortable with every detail of my journey Their teamwork and dedication truly reflect Vistaras commitment to exceptional service Not only did they make the checkin experience smooth but they also set a positive tone for the rest of my trip The flight was equally enjoyable with clean cabins comfortable seating and excellent inflight service Thank you Vistara and a special shoutout to Ankush and Manisha for going above and beyond to make my journey a pleasant one I highly recommend Vistara Airlines for their superb staff and topnotch service

Berne Airport Airport of the Capital of Switzerland is a regional airport with connections to Europes major cities Also connecting to the international hubs of Munich and Amsterdam CheckIn time only minutes prior to departure time Airport Authority is building a new terminal which will be opened by may Temporary terminal is in use until the opening of the new terminal Staff is very friendly The motto is to serve the passenger from leaving the taxi or public transport until boarding the aircraft

Singapore to Davao Pretty decent flight with a very well organized crew Happy to serve and with a smile from crew members The style of the seats is a bit old fashioned color of the seats There is no entertainment on the plane but you can connect to the WiFi and get the movies on your device but only if you have the SilkAir app Silk air should let us know in advance before you get a h flight

Unscheduled visit to this fantastic little airport Staff member on the front desk helped me with my bags right through to departures I have broken my wrist cant thank her enough for great customer service Then through to feel spoiled in the aspires lounge by the host with the most Brilliant service I shall definately return to this super place again

I flew fom Bergerac airport to Stansted today When i had cleared baggage body and passport check I went to the lounge to realise to my horror that I hadnt got my belt from the body check I spent minutes contemplating how I was shortly destined to be walking round London with my trousers falling down because I didnt have my belt on As we were summoned to the gate I was overjoyed to hear an announcement from Bergerac Airport or Ryanair saying that my belt had been found I am so happy I feel moved to thank and complement whichever staff or system meant that I was reunited with my belt Well done

Going to Washington Dulles Airport is easy when departing and arriving regardless of connectionsgood staff lounges and great AeroTrains and Mobile Lounges to connect different terminals They have good food in various terminals and airline lounges

Used Hamilton Airport as an alternative airport to Toronto A much smaller airport than Pearson a good thing resulting in much less walking and waiting and much easier to get in and out of A great option if youre visiting Southern Ontario or Niagara Falls if you want to avoid the Toronto traffic and is km from downtown Toronto Not the greatest airport for public transit links to Hamilton and Toronto and beyond likely due to the airports small size Airport was slightly built on the cheap has exterior siding and drop celling interiors reminding me of a bus terminal and has very limited foodshopping options Despite these minor complaints overall a good alternative to Pearson for direct flights and would use it again
This is a well designed airport There is no hassle from porters and taxi operators Checking in is very fast and efficient Arrival luggage handling is very good
The flight was good but it lacked in terms of inflight entertainment and food plus the wifi service which was without any surprise very bad Still it was a decent flight overall

I recently had the pleasure of flying with Eastern Airways from East Midlands and I must say that the experience exceeded my expectations in terms of genuine warmth friendliness and personability Right from the moment I stepped foot on the aircraft I was greeted by a genuinely friendly crew who exuded a warm and welcoming Throughout the flight the crew members went above and beyond to ensure the comfort and satisfaction of the passengers What truly set this flight apart was the crews personable approach They took the time to interact with passengers on a personal level engaging in friendly conversations and offering helpful recommendations It felt more like flying with a group of friends rather than being mere passengers This personal touch made the journey feel special and created a pleasant and memorable experience In conclusion my experience with Eastern Airways was characterized by a genuine friendly crew who made the flight enjoyable from start to finish Their warm and personable approach created a positive atmosphere and left a lasting impression I would highly recommend Eastern Airways to anyone seeking a memorable and pleasant flying experience

I flew one way from Melbourne to Canberra I paid extra for more leg room and extra for priority boarding It came to The flight left on time and arrived on time The seat was comfortable The staff were courteous Based on my experience I wouldnt hesitate to fly with this airline again

This company is horrific We had a cancelation of our flight back home and this airline refused to refund our money Fly Maya Island Air They are exceptional less expensive and very flexible The planes are also shady You will not regret flying Maya Island Air Have a wonderful and safe flight

Vladivostok is a fairly modern airport built in the last years it has lots of space for check in and a decent departure area There is one major problem though there is limited foreigh language support if you are a non Russian speaker If you have problems with your baggage all the forms are written in Russian with no translation all the support staff only speak Russian The people at check in have limited English language skills enough to check people in but I estimate of staff in the airport only speak Russian If you dont have any issues when you fly into or out of Vladivostok then it is a nice airport to travel through but if you do have any problems it can be a nightmare to try to find any people willing to help you they just dont care if you have an issue

I flew Brisbane to Honiara on the th April Flight Left early was only full and arrived minutes early Add kg of luggage good plentiful food and beer what more could you want Entertainment was poor but its only a hour flight so I survived Staff friendly which is much more than I can say about the BA Qantas staff on the Flights coming out from Ireland

It is a second tier nonhub airport so traffic is lower As others have noted it is surrounded by a botanical garden so the setting is beautiful Recently all of the food options were significantly upgraded Security moves quickly and efficiently The arrivals area is large and conveniently located next to the parking garage for a quick departure Rental car counters are right in the arrivals area Which brings me to the only negative waits for checked baggage are noticeably longer than almost any other airport Figure on a minimum minute wait Would recommend getting your rental car while you wait on your bags

Ive flown in and out of Pau several times Its a lovely airport with a pleasant smallness about it The only downside for me is that from the UK it is only served by Ryanair On principle I will no longer fly with them If any other UK carrier starts using Pau I will happily fly there again

The usual service everything ok Lounge at Madrid airport is just great Late boarding and late departure due to traffic control arrived min late On board crew is just great as usual very attentive full lunch served with open bar Seat comfort nothing special but fine for a hr flight Everything worked out well they need to pay attention to punctuality

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

Both terminals are badly designed and difficult to get around Getting to baggage claim on a WestJet arrival means going up and down a flight of stairs or escalator about times The most ridiculous way to baggage claim I have ever seen No one to help at baggage carousels It is worth the drive to Buffalo Niagara International Airport if you are going to a US destination from Toronto That airport is clean easy to get around and very nice people working at airline counters TSA etc

Faleolo airport in Apia Samoa is a small airport We found immigration customs etc very quick and efficient as well as baggage handling At the moment the airport is not really pretty to look at but a new terminal is being built which should be spectacular when completed Its really refreshing to be able to walk through the airport on arrival departure and not be forced to navigate through a giant shopping mall like at Sydney The airport has done duty free shops which you are free to go into or not go into rather than having to go through them to get in out of passport control a few small food shops reasonably priced and a bar Parking is Samoan Tala Staff at the airport are friendly welcoming and helpful The only negative side is that there is no air conditioning outside the security areas and check in is a bit uncomfortable when its humid

My trip to Belize took me through BZE times It is a classic sleepy room airport an updated arrivals hall with a mechanical carousel a communal departure area serving the or gates glass doors really that lead to the tarmac separated by the small warm somewhat chaotic checkin area Some staff were friendly and enthusiastic security checks were minimal Few large jets come to BZE but they do seem to be timed near each other Most flights are prop planes to the interior and the offshore reefs There is a pleasant open air deck that allows views of arriving and departing passengers walking to and from their planes There is nothing else to do while waiting for your flight Bring a book Amenities are few tiny gifts shops snack bars and a cafeteria A good place to people watch Very stressfree and it serves its purpose Ambergris Cay was our real destination Well worth the trip

Im very fond of this airline this was my fifth time flying on the BeirutLondon flight and there is a real consistency in terms of service food and comfort The plane is very new the seats spacious and the IFE is good Flight was ontime Crew were friendly and polite and the meal was satisfying there was a choice between mains Wine and beer was offered and I had no problem at all getting some additional topups during the hour flight A good flight on a very nice and littleknown airline

I would like to share a positive experience I had with airport staff on December I came back from a weeklong trip to find that my car battery had completely died We called AAA but it was a long wait time due to the holiday weekend A very nice gentleman in an airport pickup stopped by to check on us and offered to jump start the car He was respectful and courteous and saved us quite a bit of wait time We will forever be grateful for his kindness and professionalism

TIPBEN on a nearly new Canadair regional jet with leather seats and decent pitch Very happy with the short flight New terminals are being built at both ends sorely needed Otherwise would fly them again

We have been using this airport several times a year for the last ten years Over the years the facilities have progressed From a field for a car park to a proper hard standing area with security The terminal is up to scratch for a small airport generally very clean with all facilities We particularly like the short walk from the arrivals entrance through security to the gate Announcements are clear and there are plenty of arrivaldeparture screens We dont use cafes or shops in any airport but they look to be appropriate for the size of the airport Car hire and baggage reclaim very easy Plenty of taxis usually outside but can be a queue at peak times This is our favourite airport hate Alicante and Gatwick

I have a been a frequent traveler of AustinBergstrom Airport AUSKAUS since the airport opened back in I have seen the airport grow and change over the years The changes over the years have been for the better Notable things about AustinBergstrom International AUS there are two terminals the main Barbara Jordan terminal where all the restaurants lounges and stores are and the South Terminal currently Allegiant and Frontier Airlines there is a family viewing area outside the airport for watching planes and having a picnic There are currently lounges AA UA DL and a Chase Sapphire Terrace there are many good places to eat including many local restaurants my favorite are Taco Deli Salt Lick BBQ Second Bar Kitchen Annies and Juiceland it takes about minutes to walk from one end of the terminal to the other along the way you will see lots of places to eat drink and shop Pros clean great dining bars and rest areas The Delta lounge is the nicest lounge in the airport Cons restaurants close early so if you arrive on a lateish flight you will not have food options

After reading several negative reviews on this page regarding LPA Gran Canaria airport I wish to make a defence I find the airport similar to many of the Spanish airports operated by Aena in that it handles the volume of passengers proportionately and professionally Bear in mind the vast majority of passengers passing through the airport are there for leisure purposes this has always been a difficult balancing act to please the foot traffic Knowledge and preplanning are the key to success Informative information can be found online about the airport for example httpsgrancanariaairportcom is just one example Especially in this day and age with covid and the uncertainly about travel with changing restrictions it is paramount that planning ahead to provide a heads up of potential problems and issues is a must

This airport is functional Not what one would expect of an international Airport It is NOT a beacon of luxury as another review indicated Obviously a joke The staff is mostly courteous some are abrupt and seem tolerant with an air of irritation they keep to themselves Definitely not friendly or welcoming I had hours to spend here let me just say if you are hungry get a small snack and hope your flight crew serves you something you can eat One actual restaurant with a long line and I passed by several times to get a view of the food understaffed and very long wait times to get a seat and have food brought to you I saw several tables waiting about minutes without anything The souvenirs mostly cheap junk I passed The decor Missing or dated Interesting picture of a woman serving tea at the Dublin airport in the s I believe ATTENTION ENTREPRENEURS There is a huge opportunity here Travelers with money and nothing really to spend it on Food Souvenirs Coffee Restaurants Even a good bookstore All modern endeavors would make a killing There is one decent coffee place The pastries are not fresh or very good Save yourself for Italy or France I dont normally rate things so poorly and i personally enjoy my time wherever I am and enjoy different experiences This airport though could be so much better with a refreshed management vision Safe travels

I used Wakkanai Airport to fly out to Tokyo Haneda It is located about minutes away from Wakanai city There are only four flights per day by All Nippon Airlines two in and two out to Haneda and a city in Hokkaido The three storey building is clean modern and spacious Checkin is on the ground floor second floor is the arrival and departure gates and third floor is the viewing gallery Gift shop and a small restaurant are on the second floor just next to the securitydeparture The airport is on an open field with no other buildings nearby Wakkanai Park which the Japan Cup sled dog racing is held here annually in the winter is opposite the airport Like most Japanese regional airports Wakkanai airport is very much under utilized The ground staff are polite and efficient

We were initially a bit disappointed when Etihad did not use its own aircraft on the route between Abu Dhabi and Jakarta but used wetleased Wamos equipment However the entire experience was good Clean and spacious plane with pleasant configuration so ideal if you are traveling with people The staff was professional and friendly They carried out very thorough safety checks before departure and landing The only real downside was the entertainment Little choice and that should really be different no flash path information Furthermore only praise for Wamos A Basic experience on time and comfortable

Despite a delay of about minutes overall it was a good flight Check in was easy the flight attendants were friendly and efficient and the plane was clean and comfortable The only free beverage was water which was no issue on such a short flight

Free food and snacks provided Great wifi Nice comfortable chairs like a business lounge I was able to walk to my accommodation which Ive never done before Very easy access to Toronto with a short free ferry ride and then streetcar available on Bathurst St Very nice small airport

Tiny But stunning location Barra Aiport sits on the edge of a wide beach on the Scottish Island of Barra Twice a day once in winter flights from Glasgow and Benbencula land on one of the three runways But these are no ordinary tarmac runways These are marked out on the sand of the beach and only when the tide is out The flights are the only British Airways flights where the timetable is marked subject to tide The terminal a proper little toytown terminal complete with tiny terminal control tower big burly firemen and one checkin desk No compromise though on safety checks and procedures Be sure to be here in good time to watch the incoming Twin Otter fly in and land on the beach The tiny cafe sells lovely home made organic snacks and the whole experiences is a joy if you have only been used to the hustle and bustle and chaos of some large well known international terminals If a glorious sunny day checkin good and early and take time to stroll three hundred yards up over the dunes to see the other stunning beach close to this amazing little airport

I flew on TWay from Seoul Incheon to Singapore I was a bit surprised to find a usb charging port on my seat for a low cost carrier and free of charge some more The tray table included a personal electronic device holder which allowed me to use as a stand for my phone Seat was very comfortable on A in a seating configuration with leather padding for a low cost carrier Flight landed early in Singapore didnt feel so much turbulence also not very strong turbulence so quite a smooth flight

Small international airport International flights limited to a few charters from China Arrival hall domestic has only one conveyor belt which did not work on the day I arrived so luggage were brought in very swiftly by handcart Taxi and shuttle bus available to city center km away Domestic departure hall is adequate and departure gates have sufficient seating a coffee shop and wifi

I was a little worried after booking Island Air due to some of the reviews I have read about latecancelled flights Our flight was on time I did notice that on days when the weather was very poor that flights were showing some delays but I guess this would be in common with most airlines flying around the islands The quick minute hop was pleasurable and stress free Island Air operates from the commuter terminal at HNL In reality it is just them and another small airline that shares the facility No lines at check in no lines through security Once airside free wifi available throughout as well as free newspapers and even coffee Onboard had great views and even some commentary en route by one of the flight attendants pointing out points of interest Was a nice touch Served either a bottle of water or a cuplet of juice Bags US each to check in appeared on reclaim belt within a minute of arriving in the baggage hall All staff in the airport and onboard were really friendly

I recently flew UL with family from MELCMBMEL return Given the many negative reviews seen here I was expecting a very poor product But to be honest I was pleasantly surprised Of course there is certainly room for improvement the seats could be more comfortable upholstery needs to be changed arms loose or broken needs an overall clean At times the quality of annoucements were not the best Boarding in CMB was a bit disorganised considering the flights were very full on both sectors But the IFE system for me and everyone around me was working in both sectors many reviewers here are complaining about it not working A decent selection of movies TV and music Good head sets Food was average airline food cant complain Cabin service was very professional helpful efficient and attentive Bagage was delivered to belt on time Checkin at both ends was OK Will definitely consider again I got what I paid for For those complaining please pay more and choose another airline

Small airport in the West of Ireland People and staff very friendly New bathrooms in lounge Food expensive Duty free was very big but there are no bargains for people travelling to US as items like perfumes are actually more expensive than sites in US We used to get bargains in duty free but not any more

I could not believe how quiet the airport is now Ryanair have decreased their flights checked in with baggage in less then minutes and through security to departures in no time Once airside there is not much to do but there is several duty free shops a caferestaurant and a SubwayMcDonalds outlet as well as two outdoor smoking terraces All in all a nice clean little airport with helpful and friendly staff

I flew China Airlines of Taiwan from Vienna to Taipei in December with an onward journey to Bangkok and Taipei to Vienna in January in their business class The cabin of the A was kept clean and the equipment is modern despite not having a privacy door the privacy was great A is definitely my favorite airplane I have much less jetlag after long haul flights I heard the airline is upgrading its product in years Service on both flights was truly first class Very engaging and friendly and nothing is too much trouble for the crew On the outbound flight the crew working in my section was super professional on par with the standard offered by Singapore Airlines On my return journey Magret was super friendly and take personal care of the passengers The cabin manager on the return journey was also very pleasant and helpful Food onborad was excellent China Airlines unlike its competitor EVA or Starlux doesnt offer an intensive menu but the food and drink quality is really good On the way back I chose the course prepared by a Michelin star restuanrat in Taipei but my favorite is always the special vegetarian food which is also Michelin star and you need to preorder online The lounge in Taipei is either very busy morning peak hours and also evening or very quiet There is no natural light so it is dark However it is tastefully decorated and the food was very tasty Service like their onboard standard was very personal and friendly There is always a queue for the shower due to the terminal size the lounge isnt large Hopefully this will be addressed once Terminal opens so make sure you put your request in early Onboard wifi worked well and there is no data cap that is a huge bonus Now comes the cons the business class seat on A is equipped with a very large and clear monitor but the entertainment choice is fairly limited not sufficient moviesTVmusic to keep me occupied Also the seat and amenity is great especially the duvet but when the seat is fully flat the leg space becomes a bit constrain

Rhodes to Birmingham We would just like to say a big thank you to all the crew on our aircraft from Rhodes to Birmingham that brought us back on the th September due to Thomas cook not trading anymore The staff was so friendly and professional Thank you once again

Portland to Klamath Falls one way Flight was delayed about an hour due to the need to get a part for the aircraft from another plane Ground staff did their best to keep passengers in the loop Aircraft was clean enough but is clearly an old plane Onboard service was friendly and professional The single aisle row seems to be the most comfortable

Things have improved vastly since the new terminal opened and the new baggage claim is very good far faster than Edinburgh or Glasgow Return journeys can be a bit of a pain but the new departure lounge is reasonably good Airport staff weve found to be generally polite and helpful Our tips for a happier return trip Buy any food or drink in your resort Dont be in a rush to go through security to the departure lounge its much nicer outside or in the checkin hall If you smoke there is a smoking room in the departure lounge Think about investing in a portable balance for weighing your baggage as if you are overweight it could cost you
Contrary to another review there are good facilities after passport control Including shops Bistro and cafe Very clean and definitely not a shed

Use the airport regularly and its great parking facilities are next to the terminal so no need to go on a five mile cross country slog with children in tow nor wait for a packed shuttle boss and try and cram all luggage and children on board As stated before the airport is small and basic understatement but then again I dont use airports to sit in or spend all my holiday money in shops before i even depart the UK something which I think happens at many of the larger airports A very short walk from the terminal the interim passenger facility as it is more technically known to the plane and then you are away on your flight Coming back is so easy as well the arrivals area is a seperate building from departures If two planes arrive at the same time then I am under the impression that one has to wait for a short period of time foir the arrivals area to clear However after disembarking getting through passport control and getting to the baggage claim belt we were waiting for about two minutes and then hey presto the bags started coming through Again a very short walk to the car park ever present taxis and an hourly bus service tofrom the railway station and city centre are also available and we were offhome within minutes of landingat a bigger airport just down the A I have been waiting for minutes just for the baggage carousel to start revolving All in all it is basic but it does exactly what it says on the tin its a building well two buildings for passengers getting to or arriving from a city by air and it does this with minimum of fuss and least amount of time In some ways it is a good alternative for any inbound passengers wishing to avoid the congested London Airports the bus to the railway station and frequent trains to the centre of London could have you in the capital very easily Heres hoping for the new terminal an increase in services and more airlines I know I shall be a regular user of Coventry Airport and so shall my friends family and colleagues for many years to come

Connected through this airport with Delta It seems slightly older and smaller than Narita Passing through security was quick and painless The place is clean and has an open and bright feeling There are standard airport shopping opportunities if you are interested The meal options seemed severely limited which would be my only real complaint however I believe it is a large complaint because airplane food is awful

Kaohsiung International Airport is great but small There are some shops and restaurants The biggest point is that the airport is clean quiet and efficient the directions are clear as well Besides this international airport are really near downtown Kaohsiung The subway system is partially done recently you can take the KMRT to any place in downtown

Excellent service I flew on a hr m flight and the crew were excellent from boarding to disembarking The crew offered a complimentary snack onboard the seats are comfortable and the flight was smooth There were no delays or inconveniences during the flight The seats recline and although they are a bit old they are still leather and big so its very comfortable The crew helped me find my seat and they had a great attitude when I ordered a glass of water twice I will fly with them again recommended

NRT to TPE with JX on AUG and back with JX on AUG in Business Class for both legs I had always wanted to take a Starlux flight Before boarding at NRT I spent time in JAL Sakura lounge as Starlux doesnt have its own The inflight meal on the flight bound for TPE didnt satisfy my appetite Concretely speaking a grilled pork shoulder in sauce was tasteless I regretted not having preordered it Also champagne was served not so cold For my part I am not so interested in inflight entertainment On my return from Taipei prior to boarding I entered the Galactic lounge at Taoyuan airport T What surprised most was that they offered an a la carte menu on which I found an appetizing salmon steak and ordered it How tasty The dish served on the flight one similar to beef steak was totally different from the previous one It was superb The generous flow of chilled BOLLINGER champagne delighted me well Meticulous services offered by a Japanese flight attendant are worthy of a special mention Though this was a short haul or a hourandminute flight I could not help wishing it would be much longer Both flights were punctual

Ive been through this airport several times and I must say its incredibly clean and sparkling and definitely puts Gatwick to shame The people of Tunisia are very friendly which adds to the overall positive experience However I have a concern regarding the pricing While all airports tend to charge fees the prices here seem a bit exorbitant I wonder why this is the case Additionally I have a personal issue with the height of the walkway that crosses about meters up I understand this might not be a problem for most but it would be great if the sides of the walkway could be covered for those of us who arent fond of heights Other than these few points its an excellent airport with great service

Arrival Nice short walking distance to baggage claim Fast baggage delivery Comfortable smokers lounge next to baggage claim Relaxed atmosphere but still very efficient operation Car rental easy to find so is the carpark for rented cars Departure Easy car return Clean cheap airport hotel fit for purpose Several breakfast options in the checkin hall Easy and friendly checkin So is security check I got a feeling that they had though about everything in this airport and that maybe that is the reason why everything worked so efficiently the staff had energy to smile and the atmosphere is so relaxed

A very small but easy to navigate airport It is small to the extent it could kind of be a bus station I arrived in Mexico through SLP but did not depart from this point thus my experience is based on arrivals only However I could see almost the entire airport anyway Upon arrival I was greeted with very friendly immigration officials I left my information documents that I was given to fill out enroute on the plane I didnt realise until I got the counter and went to hand them over The friendly official was extremely helpful and gave me replacements and helped me fill it in as I looked tired My bags arrived very quickly through the small carrousel and I was able to pick them up and move to a customs check point At this point you are randomly picked for checks I was picked however I was dealt with by another very friendly and helpful official who made me feel very welcome to Mexico Finally I took a taxi to my hotel Once out of the control area there is an area with information and helpers on hand to get you a well priced taxi or bus into town Overall a great little airport that punches well above its weight that could serve to much larger airports as an example of good customer service

Friendly little country airport in Australia Quiet clean terminal building with enough space for passengers using the frequent Regional Express Airlines Saab services This airport is well positioned between the towns of Narrandera and Leeton and has easy access to the main road to these centres It also has rental car services Best of all it was quiet and peaceful so one could do some work while waiting for flights no blaring television in the corner as is often the case these days Pleasant airport checkin staff at Regional Express as well

Used this airport recently It is nice and efficient Managed to retrieved luggage within mins There are about belts at the arrival hall We booked a taxi at the taxi counter for M for our min journey to the hotel At Langkawi there is no meter in the taxi they offer fixed prices unlike KL Check in at Air Asia counter fro flights to KL was quick Passed through immigrations within minutes They offer an only lady immigration as well Plenty of Arabs in the airport and was told that it was their peak holidays season There is a number of shops and food outlets Overall its a nice airport
The check in was smooth Signs in English are sufficient to direct the passengers The ambiance is great and its facilities are enough to give comfort to its passengers

I booked London Mexico City London Business Class tickets Outgoing flight gave us access to the Virgin lounge at Heathrow and it was excellent Return flight had problems could not check in or select meal online using iPad their website only works on Microsoft Though in transit I had to go through immigration baggage reclaim and security before handing back my luggage to be loaded on the flight home Refused admittance to their Heineken lounge because I presented more than hours early just arrived on their flight from Cuba Lounge was noisy cramped and spartan when I did get in But flight was good

San Andrs to Medelln LA July That was my first flight with the old LAN Colombia now LATAM Colombia The flight departed at and arrived slightly early at The crew were very polite I asked if I could change my seat and I wanted to see what they would do however to be honest they were so friendly and the flight attendant took me to another seat The catering was a little box with a bag of chips two candys and a packet of biscuits inside which I thought was quite generous catering The complete flight was a nice and warm experience

Excellent airline Flights outbound and return were on time if not early Service and staff were helpful and friendly and the plane was very comfortable Definitely recommend them The only negatives the film choice was not great for an English speaker and there was if anything too much food served
I loved the flight and service the crew was very helpful and friendly Found the seats comfy and because of the low fares we booked make this trip to Iceland Thank you WOW airWe will miss you

I have flown from Sligo airport a few times in the past A very clean and well maintained airport and a pleasure to fly from Very freindly staff and parking very cheap and beside the terminal Security fast and efficient Cafe bar and toilets are open to left of check in area Sligo airport in a sense can now be called an international airport because of new flights to Manchester in the UK Expansion of the runway is in the pipeline and the airport hopes to have a new route to London in the future Aer Arann serves the airport with all flights a good airline with cheap return flights and usually always on time Always a taxi near by the main entrance and bus service available from strandhill town into Sligo city centre that is about miles away Road network is basic but acceptable Overall a pleasant airport

Small airport arrival was smooth half hour queue at immigration but bags waiting for uson departure ten minutes from check in to be sat at the gate on comfortable seats and soft carpetairport is very clean and did not come across any rude staffin fact they were very polite

Praslin to Mahe Over zealous security screening at Praslin when they noticed we had packed a small pack of batteries in our hold baggage Had to take out every item of clothing until they were found and no time to repack On check in we thought we had prepaid for excess baggage via our travel agent only to be told it had not gone through Staff could see that we had completed the process but still charged us the airport price rather than the online price Staff completely unhelpful and appeared to take great pleasure in making things as difficult as possible Would not give us any assistance of any contact details Currently taking up the issue with their customer services and the office of their CEO Flight cramped and noisy recommend ear plugs and very warm Plus side it was shorter than most bus journey I normally take No assistance offered by ground crew getting on or off the plane with flimsy hand rail and low doorway

I flew from Blackpool airport to Belfast for the first time I always fly from Liverpool to Belfast with Easyjet but the flight times were better and it was slightly cheaper to fly with Jet from Blackpool I was expecting a small airport with limited facilities but nothing prepared me for the facilities here Parking is free which was a bonus for me when booking on arrival however both car parks P and P were full and ended up abandoning my car on a grass area known as an overfill car park This was a minute walk to the airport On arrival there was nothing before the departure lounge The cash machine was out of service and WHSmiths closed Paying the airport charge was no problem and I was assisted with my baggage tag by a very helpful Jet worker The worst experience was going through security where the staff were extremely rude not just with me but with an elderly couple in front of me I agree that security needs to be strict but not intrusive and this was made a much more uncomfortable experience by the rudeness and lack of customer service with the staff I will never be using this airport again and even after a drink from the limited choice in the cafebar I was still reeling I can safely say this is the st and last time I will use this airport
Checkin for the flight was on time the reception by the staff was excellent confidential space The control is efficient and fast the boarding lounge comfortable

Handy and efficient airport and friendly service However complete disregard of Government standards in respect of refunds Coronavirus Car park booked and paid for in advance on non flex basis Refund refused despite HM Government Competition and Markets Authority direction Beware sharp practice

Dundee Airport provides a convenient link direct to London City Birmingham Belfast The airport is small and there are no shops There is a Costa coffee stall and the airport terminal is modern and comfortable I would recommend flying from Dundee Air France now provide the Dundee to London City route and Fly Woosh the Birmingham Belfast services My only gripe lies with the airlines themselves who do not seem to realise that if they lowered their weekend prices they could cash in on a lucrative leisure market which is put off by the high prices Dundee to London route is only worthwhile for leisure if booked way in advance and you can fly out with peak periods

A very easy and pleasant airport to use On arrival I was able to exit the terminal in less than five minutes In the arrival concourse is a staffed information booth a shop closed when I arrived at night and rental car booths Taxis waited outside I called a Uber Departure was likewise very easy I printed out my boarding passes from a machine The shop gifts snacks and reading materials was open University of Notre Dame paraphernalia was noticeable TSA security check was unhurried and polite After security there are a couple of good places to eat and drink The bathrooms were clean The concourse was airy with high ceiling and glass panes that allowed you to watch tarmac and runway activity The airport is about a minute drive from downtown South Bend

The airport has been and still under going renovations The issues with no food past security have been fixed The wait times are typically very short Security can become long on Monday mornings but typically it is very quick as well Walking distances to and from gates as well as to and from parkingcar rental are rather short There are no miles walks to gates or otherwise The biggest issue with the airport is the quality of staff at food outlets but that is not much different at a lot of airports Overall it is a very good midsize airport

Windhoek to Frankfurt After having read reviews I was prepared for bad service and problems during the flight but luckily everything was fine and I am quite happy with the overall experience The aircraft is spacious and clean seats are comfortable and have a pillow and a blanket for each passenger The crew was very friendly and not so good cop bad cop The food was quite good however it might have been better maybe a dessert could be added Big selection of drinks but only one type of juice orange On the long overnight flight dinner and breakfast have been offered During the flight the crew also offered water The entertainment system is still not working it seems to be a persistent problem that the airline is not willing to solve

We used the airport facilities both for international arrivaldepartures and domestic sea plane The international part was no so bad at all the Covid Clearance was fast and correct luggage arrived within a reasonable time and all worked pretty well Not really first class but not as bad as some reviews should indicated Staff was courteous and friendly The transfer tofrom the sea plane terminal was bumpy literally speaking and luggage handling somewhat chaotic but somehow it worked and with a bit of positive attitude we really found it pretty good and quite amusing The business class lounge was not the most modern and delicate one for sure but had what we needed and was quite comfortable Check in Qatar was very well organized friendly and correct in every way Same for immigration and document control We give the airport good marks not need to worry when going tofrom Maldives

Hamad International Airport is nice brand new airport Very spacious and clean Good wifi line and plenty of free desktop for internet Seats are everywhere and they are comfortable Charging points are available throughout this airport Many choices for food and shopping However I find that the price is rather high

Dragonair is part of Cathay Pacific From Hong Kong to Guangzhou is less than miles but they provide an excellent service When on board cabin crew deliver a bottle of water and a cookie The cabin crew are very nice
Love Quebecs airport Small but offers all of the facilities in a big airport Not too much people

Auckland to Chengdu Their cabin was fresh and clean and being a newer aircraft was kept very well The service is warm and professional The seats fold flat and my kids slept for most of the hour flight We arrived relaxed and stress free considering that we had young kids to look after and worry about Night flights with kids are the way to go The food was very tasty The flight attendants were very polite and accommodating They never made you feel you were a burden to them I will happily fly Sichuan in the future

March The area around the airport seems clean and pretty organized But that lasts only until you reach the terminals gates Without eticket printed in advance you wont be allowed to enter the terminal The security is oppressive and unintelligent People accompanying you can enter only after paying an entrance fee to the airport police station which is a procedure taking min The terminal itself is spacious with modernistic and actually pleasant looks Even if I had an already printed boarding pass for online checkin I actually waited much longer than other passengers as their system wasnt working and they had to check me in again There were around passengers for members of staff at a time and they seemed totally overwhelmed despite the low volume of passengers The departures level was pretty empty and immigration a breeze as it was very early morning The airside area didnt offer anything special but was clean and pleasant nevertheless No AC sockets working anywhere in the airport All in all the airport seems to be more about looks than substance Nevertheless TRV remains probably the best airport I experienced in India and I would advise it as an alternative gateway to other airports in the South

Do Book the First Class lounge as soon as you arrive ready for your return I didnt and sat jealously sweltering and being zapped by mozzies as I waited for my inevitably late flight Otherwise if there is only one flight due there seems to be enough room and seats probably get too crowded if more than one flight waiting to depart Arrival and getting through customs is a fuss and very slow although the security people are friendly I got my passport stamped as well as the visa when I asked nice free souvenir Toilets were a bit smelly and not totally functioning but did have toilet paper Gents Stuff is sold in both duty free shop and kiosks around the departure lounge Note as expected the duty free shop is much cheaper You can only pay in CUCs or at an exorbitant markup by credit card Good views of the apron from the lounge and the only downside is if you are a fervent antismoker This is cuba they sell cigars you can work it out Tip a few people had stuff confiscated from their hand luggage tobacco and spirits I think it was all stuff that the proper export tax hadnt been paid on Keep a few CUCs to slip the staff at the airport and they also really apreciated a drink or two As everywhere the porters are quite bullish Dont get upset at being asked for a tip just for loading the suitcase into the coach Look how much you earn and then realise how much is worth to them

Im autistic and was nonverbal unable to speak when I went through security but the staff were incredibly kind and helpful It was very much appreciated as its obviously very difficult to navigate the world when one cannot speak and the staff were completely understanding Be proud

On time departure from Larnaca to Leipzig Very friendly crew I was surprised that of them including first officer was from Greece and Cyprus Very nice and colorful aircraft that makes your day Wind in Leipzig was not calm it was about kts Perfect landing

Vistara stands out as a premium fullservice carrier offering a superior travel experience that consistently impresses From checkin to landing the attention to detail and customer focus is evident making it one of the best choices for both domestic and international travel in India The cabin crew is exceptionally professional courteous and attentive ensuring passengers feel comfortable throughout the journey The seating arrangement especially in Premium Economy and Business Class provides ample legroom and ergonomic comfort ideal for long flights The inflight entertainment options are diverse catering to various preferences and the complimentary meals are thoughtfully curated offering both quality and variety Punctuality is another area where Vistara excels with flights often departing and arriving on time Additionally the checkin process is seamless and the airline staff are welltrained to handle queries efficiently The partnership with Singapore Airlines also adds a layer of credibility and enhances the overall experience That said Vistaras ticket prices can be slightly higher than budget carriers but the services provided justify the cost For those who value comfort reliability and excellent service Vistara is worth every penny Its an airline that truly redefines air travel in India with its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction

Main hub in Northeast Colombia Although small the terminal is clean and tidy Tends to get crowded during peak hours As many airports in Colombia renovation is taking place Most of the terminal is airconditioned immigration and customs was fast as was luggage delivery The airport has ATMs some souvenir shops and a small observation deck Flight arrival and departure announcements need improvement with regard to acoustics as information can barely be heard while waiting in the food court airconditioning will be more than welcome in this area Lets see what the airport looks after renovation is completed Pleasant experience Wifi connectivity was very good

Went through Cairo airport during my recent trip arriving from Emirates and leaving to the UK both in terminal Despite the long queues in departure being a bit of a hassle the coordinators were incredibly helpful They did their best to address any issues and kept things moving as smoothly as possible The terminal itself is pretty modern and clean the lounge is amazing and while it could use a few more amenities i would say it was an overall satisfying experience a solid out of

I arrived at Cape Town International Airport and had to wait for my baggage almost minutes This was a local flight from JNB to CPT This is not my first bad experience of the same nature in recent weeks

Super tiny Airport like a bus terminal in my town but it was a quite clean and cozy place Location is nice not far from city and you can get there from city center by local bus for about euro There were nice sofas inside and the toilet was neat and clean
I would like to thank Alessandra at the customer services desk for the phenomenal service and friendliness she has provided me at the airport She is an absolute gem

Very short min flight to Zanzibar and back again from Dar es Salaam with Coastal Aviation Both flights were on time and our luggage arrived too Tiny aircraft and fully booked so quite a squeeze but comfortable enough for such a short flight Was very pleasantly surprised with the punctuality and reliability Would definitely recommend flying Coastal

Cant fault this airport at all the staff are very friendly helpful I found the experience of arrival departure stress free Its nice clean one of the friendliest airports I have ever been to on my holidays abroad

Very nice small airport easy check in with friendly staff Plenty of seating in the airport with small selection of shops and restaurants and bars Parking for cars very close to terminal and with plenty of spaces Easy access to main roads when you leave the airport Baggage reclaim very quick A pleasure to arrive at this airport
New facilities in the national arrivalsdepartures concourse very nice modern terminal new roads from Quito recently finished so the trip to city is quicker and easier overall great airport

I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of Air KBZ flying from Yangon to Mandalay I bought the ticket just two days before the flight and the fare was very reasonable Checkin was fast and efficient and a Air KBZ employee approached me in the line and escorted me to the checkin desk and helped me checkin The domestic terminal is small and a bit chaotic but this is not Air KBZs fault and should be remedied when the new domestic terminal is finished There are no screens announcing that boarding has commenced so you have to pay attention to the airline employees who walk up and down the waiting area with handheld signs with your airline and flight number on it Boarding was via a bus to the aircraft The plane was clean in good condition and the seats were comfortable The flight crew was helpful and friendly We were served a light breakfast on this minute flight The flight took off and landed on time I would certainly fly Air KBZ again

Small airport dating back to the early days of aviation when the thinking was that would be aerodromes in most towns Today BUR is convenient airport for those wishing to avoid LAX You pick up your bags from the baggage conveyor belt outside the terminal

Bangkok to Taipei Having now taken four flights on V Air my comments remain virtually the same as my earlier review I arrived at the newly opened international terminal at Bangkoks Don Mueang airport about minutes prior to the scheduled departure Checkin took less than minutes even though the plane was around full The aircraft pushed back minutes late but arrived precisely on time The seat is comfortable with more leg space than is usual on budget carriers my preordered meal of chicken teriyaki was excellent and the FAs are efficient and cheerful One even came to my seat to welcome me back having seen me on my last flight almost months earlier I wish all budget carriers were of a similar standard

Had a missing baggage when landing at Victoria Falls Airlinks staff was very helpful in tracing and rerouting this baggage to Nairobi where I was when they traced the baggage Awesome customer experience

The airport is different from how I last saw it Its been renovated and finally reached an international standard Theres a lovely restaurant on the th floor called Oea I had a wonderful meal there Theres also a quaint but useful duty free section A first class lounge can also be found close to the Duty Free section Air conditioning and spacious areas throughout makes this airport impressive and comfortable
