It is an efficiently run small low cost carrier hub As long as you consider it as such it is appropriate and convenient I see it more as a kind of bus stop for airplanes to a limited number of countries Parking is great and affordable an in walking distance to the terminal Guess total distance from car door to plane door is appx metres Services are limited and foodshops overpriced Big airport prices here on this small airfield Boarding procedures check in and security OK Kind staff

The terminal offers an array of restaurants and shops which gives passengers a well rounded experience The security was smooth and quick with just only a few passengers waiting in line The airport has a very white theme which makes the interior very bright Staff at the airport are generally helpful and able to speak basic to intermediate level of English I had troubles connecting to the WiFi network I asked the airport staffs to help me out because they couldnt figure out the reason of not being able to connect the WiFi All in all Bahrain Airport is one of the nicest airports to travel in addition to Doha and Muscat Airports

This little airport is very nice and adapted to the demand and number of passengers There was only one cafe but with nice food and drinks Because of the small numbers of passengers traveling through that airport there was absolutely no waiting I would defenitly go there again

Bloemfontein airport is currently undergoing improvements to its buildings and facilities This is with a view to the FIFA Soccer World Cup to be held in South Africa I love this little airport because there is an air of excitement and a bustle of activity While the upstairs cafeteria is undergoing improvements there is a downstairs cafeteria where refreshments may be purchased The airport personnel are some of the friendliest i have ever met Their are ample parking and car rental facilities available

Not the newest airplane but the cabin is clean and it is in the new configuration where you do not need to cross your neighbors if you stand up Food on this short route is classic Air stewardess always perfect as expected from Korean Air

Very small airport with not many destinations to fly to from Free parking in front of airport very fast check in One restaurant coffee shop with nice local food Arriving at Antwerp airport it will take you around to after disembarking until you receive your suitcase and are in a taxi home

Izmir Adnan Menderes Airport seems a bit far from downtown but it has a connection of a local rail system called zban and it takes about minutes to reach the airport There are lots of food and beverage options on the ground Prices are high in my opinion but you can find something suitable for your budget Its very clean and safe Also there are lots of taxis and buses you can use

Honiara on the island of Guadalcanal is the capital of the Solomon Islands in the South West Pacific and the only international airport in the country The traffic flow into Solomon Islands is minimal about six or seven flights a week mainly filled with Australian government officials Asian businessmen and the odd tourist The terminal itself was built by the Japanese Government about It is not airconditioned and can be very warm and humid inside given that Honiara is in the middle of the tropics Due to water and plumbing problems the toilets can be unpleasant It is a good idea to check in two hours before hand as checkin queues can be long as departure time approaches Flights are often delayed but airport staff are unlikely to be able to tell you much one way of checking to see if your departure will be on time is to check the Brisbane Airport website to see if the flight left Brisbane for Honiara on time Customs and security is usually quick on departure but customs and immigration can be somewhat slower on arrival Forget duty free shopping on departure shop in Honiara town instead On arrival sometimes the duty free booth is open and if so it does offer good prices on alcohol All in all a hot humid experience which will not leave you feeling terribly comfortable On the plus side staff are usually helpful and cheerful and cleanliness has improved considerably over the last couple of years

I think Dublin airport does a very good job of dealing with large number of passengers efficiently and with courtesy I travel through there at least once a month and rarely come across any issues I think when they get more of the enhanced security scanners it will be even better

Very impressed with HiSky The trip from JFK and back from OTP was on par with major airlines we had entertainment and good food I loved the breakfast Romanian sausages crenwurst The flight attendants were pleasant and helpful flight was on time each way It would be useful if they partnered with United or a US airline to connect flights Right now its a hassle to connect into JFK on two tickets

I recently slipped a disc and needed assistance at Gibraltar airport I cant say just how heartwarming it was to be met by the lovely Sam and guided through what can be a pretty stressful experience with genuine humanity and not a few laughs along the way Shes a real gem as were all other staff involved from check in to departure Another client asked what happened as we were raised into the transport and an attendant whod had a similar injury gave some really good supplementary advice as we disappeared I do a fair amount of travelling and that was a rare experience Thank you all
OPOMIR return Cabin crew friendly breakfast served it was nothing special but not bad for plane food There was no entertainment onboard but the planes were clean

I live in Dubai marina and this is a fantastic option to travel from Small quiet check in to boarding in minutes Its still in its infancy before being ramped up to being a hub but it is a joy to use compared to big busy DXB Bags are always office in minutes and you sail through immigration

I fly this airline regularly between Yellowknife and Edmonton Staff is generally friendly and the complimentary food service is a nice touch but generally inedible Unfortunately they have the tendency to change your seats without notice and you will not find out until checkin time Much of the reason for this change is that if they notice a flight is only half booked they use half of the plane for cargo which eliminates the first rows of seats Thus when booking on Canadian North make sure you book the back row of seats between and you likely wont have to worry about your seat being changed Prepare to be packed in like sardines on most Canadian North flights though Seat pitchwidth is standard

Liked the airport of Edmonton Very efficient security and no big walking distances A nice bright design that make you feel comfortable Besides there are a lot of shopping and dining options here This Airport can be a role model how regional midsize airports should be
St Petersburg to Moscow Efficient check in Comfortable seats and a fairly decent snack sandwich Certainly good value for money and spot on with departurelanding times Would use again

The booking was easy via Zipair website reasonable price and good flight time The trip was pleasant in general the plane is clean new upgraded the staff were very friendly and polite and flight was on time But need to be more clear about the low price comes from not providing anything in return Like things are granted on other long flights hours for example a screen to watch movies games tv show this is unavailable on zipair there is WiFi to use on your own devices its not that strong anyway Other things are unavailable blankets no free non alcohol drinks even water I dont need to say food or snacks Thats all needed to be mentioned clearly on their website to be prepared ahead There are a few items available for purchase honestly the food could not be worse they bring it in small carton box water bottle thats it no tray no bread butter no dessert Otherwiseall good just needed to add these information and details make a plan to enjoy the trip

Flight slightly delayed but arrived slightly ahead of time by minutes Crew well presented and very professional Meal type and beverage selection an overkill for such a short flight Will fly Eswatini Air again

HELMUC on tired MD Took the Internet upgrade opportunity for to Premium Economy Worth it on ground service Quick checkin Fast Track at Security as Economy Pax had a long queue for both The SAS Lounge in Helsinki very basic Cabin crew friendly nice breakfast However no English newspapers available and no comments at all to the flight from the cockpit The price for the upgrade is ok as I had rows for me alone in contrary to the Economy cabin which was full Otherwise you are flying Low Cost with a high economy fare

I enjoyed lengthy stop overs here on a recent flight to BKK in Biz class with Gulf Air The airport is amazing clean and transit was smooth The lounge was fantastic and food and drinks were excellent Staff throughout the airport were amenable and friendly Overall it is a much less stress free and agreeable experience in comparison to transit through Doha or Dubai

Air New Zealand representative named Leanne was very helpful when I needed help to check in my ft surfboard she was helpful when I needed help to print out my boarding pass exceptional patience and excellent customer skills

Bradley is my home airport I fly from and to here multiple times a year to visit friends and family While it isnt as big as the New York airports or Boston fares are usually among the cheapest in southern New England and southeastern New York and BDL provides service to all major eastern hubs such as Atlanta Detroit Cincinnati Charlotte Minneapolis ChicagoORD Washington Philly and Baltimore as well as numerous Florida destinations Las Vegas Denver Toronto Montreal Cleveland Raleigh San Juan Cancun and starting later this year LA and Dublin Ireland Concessions are ample and security is usually manageable in under thirty except some mornings I nearly always fly Delta and their service out of BDL has been fantastic Flights to Salt Lake City Seattle San Francisco and Nashville would be ideal additions

IND is one of our two main options along with CVG when flying Both are excellent Traveling from Indy this week reminded me why I like it In morning and afternoon there are multiple good choices and most are reasonably priced in comparison to many other world airports crowds are nowhere near some airports so it is easy to move around TSA has always been friendly and efficient unlike some airports restrooms are generally cleaner than many other airports We do wish there were a couple of direct flights options to Europe but for flying domestically we like IND

Geneva to Zurich I was a bit nervous about flying with this airline because of bad reviews but my experience was the complete opposite True boarding was done a bit late but we took off only minutes after scheduled departure time and landed minutes before scheduled time which means the flight was only mins Despite the short flight time passengers were handed a pack of small biscuits and a brioche together with a ml bottle of water each Seating on the Saab is x which means that the passenger sitting on the left hand side of the aircraft gets a window AND the aisle in economy class Truly stunning morning views of the Swiss Alps during sunrise The Saab aircraft is a small turboprop aircraft which is pretty fun to fly on for true aviation enthusiasts like me Cabin pressure is good and the noise level is a bit higher than on other aircraft but thats quite cool for av geeks Definitely better than what I was expecting and I recommend this great airline and the Saab

Munich to Kabul Privilege Style is flying this year old Boeing on behalf of other customers as a charter airline The flight was okay seats are comfortable enough and i felt safe throughout the journey

We took Flight from Kathmandu to Bangkok by Nepal airlines for our Holiday trip Flight was on time meal provided during flight is delicious and have veg and non veg options Staff of airline were well behaved and professional I will use service of Nepal in future as well Highly recommended
Very new very clean lots of natural light Easy and fast arrivals process Departure area spacious

I am delighted to share my exceptional experience with Officer Lucas at San Francisco International Airport His assistance in locating my lost phone and guiding me to the correct boarding gate was invaluable Not only did he ensure I found my belongings but he also took the time to ensure my wellbeing before departing I am sincerely grateful for his kindness and assistance

Great regional airport Friendly people and some little shops It is nice and clean everything goes fast I have never waited more than minutes The flights to Munich and Frankfurt gives opportunities to travel from there and the flights to Antalya and other vacation destinations are great too

A very small airport that mainly serves Trieste Udine Gorizia and the western part of Slovenia More similar to a train station as it often happens for small airports A few shops that mainly sell local food and wine a very small duty free and a couple of bars It also features a small but comfortable lounge

Yangon to Nyaung My wife and me flew three routes with Air KBZ over our holiday in Myanmar and we got outstanding service every time The cabin crew all have excellent presentation and are very courteous and attentive We had a cold snack tea and coffee all of which were very tasty on all flights Its unusual to be given cream cakes at am but they were very nice All aircraft used were very clean and in good condition and all flights departed and arrived exactly on time Air KBZ is way better than we expected
Jayapura to Tanahmerah Flight left and arrived on time Aircraft was clean and cool crew friendly and even a simple inflight meal of a box of tea and a cake was provided

Nice and clean airport As an avgeek I love watching planes and there are so many big windows next to restaurants to watch planes Security wasnt long The checkin staff were really nice On arrival Immigration was really quick and baggage claim was surprisingly quick Very quick and free wifi

This airport is located in a train station next to it which is pretty cool but can cause major traffic getting in to it The inside is clean and well kept with plenty of restaurants Security is just ok not many lines open so it can take a long time to get through The issue I have like most Chinese airports is that they dont use the jetways much and make you walk out on tarmac and take buses sometimes to and from aircraft In our case it was in the rain which made for an uncomfortable trip Not sure why when jetways were open and they have enough but from what I can tell is that when the plane is not to depart after landing it gets stored over night and if you fly in later at night you will have to take bus so I try to avoid night flights into this airport

Volaris is starting to grow on me It is quickly becoming my favourite Mexican airline The nofuss booking procedure and easytounderstand and reasonably priced baggage options are just some of the perks this airline offers They are just a good allaround no fuss no frills good airline

Check in and security very fast and efficient but then you hit the overpriced shops and the limited and expensive catering options They should let the cafe outside arrivals take over a spot inside they offer decent food at good prices The place is clean the staff are pleasant and helpful but it doesnt make up for the over priced shops and the limited choice of food
Taipei Hualein TaiChung Both flights by ATR cabin was clean and comfortable Very friendly crew Drinks service on both flights

Small but efficient little island airport Quite possibly the cleanest terminal building Ive ever been in a small team of cleaners were walking around constantly dusting vacuuming polishing and looking for any litter the whole time we were there No fuss no overly loud announcements friendly staff obvious sign posting and a nice selection of shops which had very reasonable prices and unobtrusive sales assistants who didnt attempt to force anyone into buying things I really like this airport a lot the only thing Id mention is that try to remember its a tropical island so be careful where you leave your bags While waiting outside for the shuttle bus to take us to our rental car centre I saw a huge spider the size of the palm of my hand scurry into someones luggage Probably not the best start to that persons vacation but thankfully we managed to arrive and depart without any extra passengers with us
A quiet domestic airport with adequate facilities though passengers are open to the elements on boarding and disembarking from aircraft
The plane was in a good condition even for an old plane Both flights were on time On the minute flight there was no service Staff of the airline were professional and quick at check in No echeck in
Quite amazing that Bangkok Airways manages to serve a warm meal with drinks and coffee on a minutes full flight free of charge Even though the food wasnt very special but still edible it impressed me

Our outbound flight was delayed which caused us to miss our connecting flight to Toronto with another airline The delay was due to a late inbound flight This created a small issue in Montreal but the other airline was able to get us on a later flight The flight itself was uneventful Service on board was good flight attendants were fantastic and friendly

Modern and clean airport The transit is really strange like you have to get into China and leave China again Came from Beijing to Singapore via Shenzhen Convenient airport lot of shops reasonable price airports many eateries Western Chinese Easy to find your way to the gate Ground staff do not smile
Great airline Very friendly staff Flown with this airline around times and never had a bad experience only of my flights have Been delayed and none cancelled

I Flew on flight TK on the th February from Istanbul to Bangkok which was an excellent business class flight experience The food on board was as usual very good indeed as was the superb service provided by cabin crew hostess Grulsah She was extremely friendly and very professional for which I would like to thank her for If I had one perhaps negative comment to make and that is regarding the dated seating layout on the airbus A Which with a layout of doesnt provide much in the way of privacy and should if possible be changed to a layout That aside the flight itself arrived into Bangkok exactly on time Highly recommended

Traveling through Murtala International airport in Lagos Nigeria is an experience Staff are generally friendly and smiled a lot My documents were repeatedly checked I counted ten checkpoints altogether At five of them I was asked if I would hand over some money They weirdest situation was that the customs officer asked how much money I carry and then after hearing the honest as he was a customs officer answer asked me if I would give him some of it The airport is quite run down and processes are not streamlined Boarding was rather chaotic with passengers placed on different coloured seats after the boarding passes were scanned

The airport staff are friendly and the waiting time is short very convenient because there are many transport choices to choose The seats are comfortable and there are the sky bridge let me see the airplanes

Old airport looks like a s relic which it is Only used for transfer which was so simple just a short walk In that sense convenient but not much to do air side and unable to comment on passport or check in services Staff pleasant and very helpful So my one hour in the Seychelles was smooth and pleasant Departure area airconditioned which was handy in c humid outside temps

In the UK it is pretty difficult to get a fullservice airline offering direct flights to anywhere except Heathrow or Gatwick The socalled lowcost carriers dominate Having flown the competition we reluctantly tried Jet for our flights to and from Madeira In many ways Jet proved to be a long rung above the competition kg of checked luggage and kg of hand luggage plus a handbag or laptop bag are included as standard The seats are as you would expect on this type of airline minimalist The cabin crew were friendly and the drinks and food onboard appeared to be reasonably priced I cannot vouch for the quality of the hot or cold food as we did not try it Flights out and back were on time and boarding was smooth and efficient

It was really nice experience this was my first journey with Vistara I am feet height and still I was able to sit comfortably They provided food also after long time get food in Indian domestic flight was a good feel Every days we used to get in jet and kingfisher airlines It was a nice experience now waiting for my connecting flight to Dubai

Keflavk to Copenhagen This flight was operated on anew Aneo showcasing Icelandairs Saga Class the airlines Business Class product Although the flight was delayed by three hours an uncommon occurrence given Icelandairs excellent ontime performance access to the Saga Lounge at Keflavk ensured the wait was a comfortable one The flight itself was smooth and pleasant While the Saga Class seats are not lieflat they are wellcushioned and provide ample comfort for the short journey The onboard service was warm and efficient Overall no complaints Icelandairs Saga Class delivers the most comfortable option for travel between Iceland and Europe or the Nordics

A poor low cost experience with full service airline Lufthansa for which I paid a high fare Got a cup of water and a chocolate gr Kindly enough they let me have a second chocolate because I nicely asked In their Tourist Class not that their intraEuropean Business Class is anything great much better Lufthansa Co are nothing better than any other low cost airline when flying in Europe The only difference is that most of the European low cost airlines are consistent you get what you pay for and there are no surprises Not with Lufthansa pay higher fares add luggage seats etc and get the full noservice experience

XIYCTUAUH Arrived from Xian on domestic flight in Terminal which was newly opened in Spring All very clean and tidy with clear signs in Mandarin and English Quite a long walk to Baggage Reclaim for the furthest gates but not unreasonable Toilets clean and plentiful with both squat and regular options For International Departures there are main dining options before Checkin either KFC or local Chinese food There are a few stores selling various local foods and some souvenirs CheckIn pretty good and Passport Control and Security all pretty smooth No requirement to remove belts or laptops for security scanning but do enforce the ml liquid rules from Europe In the International Departures no dining opportunities but a couple of coffeeshop options along with the usual array of Duty Free shops Most departures are from one of the airbridges Announcements made in both Chinese and English Toilets are clean

I was stopped by the airport because i had a problem with my passport the bluebird staff did everything to help me get on the plane on time The staff ran with me to the place where they make you a new passport and the Security head took me in his car to the airplane they all did a great effort to let me fly to my destination and not cancel it Thank you guys

StarFlyer is by far the best lowcost airline I have used anywhere Price was low about half of what Shinkansen bullet train would have been and included luggage On board the plane you have stylish leather seats with IFE and good legroom Drinks are also included in the price and flight attendants made sure everything is ok and in general were very friendly Ryanair and Easyjet should learn from them in fact StarFlyer is better than many full service airlines

Round trip from Guatemala to Roatan via San Pedro Sula and Tegucigalpa respectively June For all hour flying segments service was exemplary lunch box on every flight with delicious sandwiches On the way back departing Roatan plane was intensively checked for an oil leakage threatening our connection at Tegucigalpa with passengers getting nervous about the situation but TACA agent in the waiting room was reassuring Even offered a free phone call to Guatemala The plane got fix and we landed just in time in Tegucigalpa with TACA personnel waiting for us at the door of the plane with umbrellas over the tarmac to get to the other plane When we landed in Guatemala all luggage arrived too Great service from all the involved staff at all the airports and flights

Please note booking was made directly with Etihad Trip started great with a visit to Etihads excellent lounge at Term at LHR It became time for boarding and it was clear the flight was going to be delayed Etihad ground staff did their best to keep us informed and they had a large number of staff at the gate to answer questions We were assured that any missed connections would be dealt with in AUH and we departed about hours late The A is as always an excellent plane and the seat and staff were to match on this flight Etihad offers dine on demand and I opted for a sandwich prior to landing in order to get some sleep I did connection to the wifi prior to getting some rest and about minutes after take off I received an email stating I had been rebooked to a later flight from AUH to BKK I was able to accept the rebooking and get my boarding pass within an hour of taking off from LHR The seat is excellent both for sittinglounging and sleeping Staff were on the ball and offered me food as soon as I woke up At AUH ground staff were waiting for us with a number of counters set up with preprinted boarding cards for passengers with missed connections All you had to do was go to the right counter and get your onwards boarding card I skipped all that and went straight to the impressive business class lounge at AUH and spent a few hours there before my connecting flight A B took me the last leg to BKK The seat consistency Etihad has across their wide body fleet is impressive and gives a familiar feel regardless of the aircraft type Once again staff were excellent The only downside I could find on this flight was they have cut the prelanding snack service but the flight is relatively short so not a massive issue Overall a very enjoyable flight despite arriving at my destination about hours later than expected but I wish all airlines would handle delays that well big praise to Etihad on this one The only place they have fallen down a bit is they have not proactively offered me compensation as I am intitled to and finding that on their website is not straight forward however once the process is started it is very quick and easy
Short but pleasant flight on time Friendly crew cheap tickets clean plane and for a such a short flight a good snack was offered Boarding and deboarding fast

Visited nice airport upon transit to Doha A very long stopover which I will not do again but couldnt be helped Landing and disembarking fairly routine and swift After clearing passport control I was expecting to see a sign where I could wait in the transit area Only there was no transit area Just an arrivals lounge and free reign to leave the airport Airport itself is functional and basic Nearby hotels are expensive so if youre only going to be around for a short while you can try it and slum it on the waiting seats scattered across arrivals Or not They are immensely uncomfortable and youll find other travellers bending their bodies around seats lying on chairs just to lie flat in the desperate hope of getting some decent shut eye Information counter closes at so if you land after that youre on your own Plus side local supermarkets like Lidl are mins walk away if youre put off by food prices inside the airport All in all an ok airport i guess not recommended for long layovers Designated quiet rooms with chairs for resting like they have in Doha would be ideal Fantastic Mediterranean sea air outside the airport A solid from me

Flew Lublin to Heraklion Very comfortale trip without delays friendly helpful and professional crew good amtosphere on board everything fast and without problems I felt safe during the journey and I think that I will choose Small Planet for my next year holiday

Birgi Airport has recently had a makeover so new there were no arrival or departure boards In many respects it reminded me of Pisa Aeroporto before it got too big On arrival I was nearly the victim of a potential scam Unlicensed taxi drivers gather around the door to the arrivals hall They spot your name on a card being held by a genuine tour company As you come into the arrivals hall they call out your name and when you acknowledge them they claim to be your pre booked taxi Fortunately I noticed my name on a card being held by representatives from the genuine company I had booked with For departing flights eat before you set out for the airport At checkin there is just one very small snack bar and shop Panini and water just over EUR and not a great deal of seating Everything was clean and new but facilities are extremely minimal with only vending machines for refreshments after security Waiting in the gate area the seating is insufficient to cope with the number of passengers I thought it was also very warm but probably not so for your average Sicilian Access to aircraft is by descending several flights of stairs and then crossing the tarmac on foot

Modern airport and very efficient Upon arrival by taxi one of the porters thoughtfully brought a cart for the luggage Checkin area wide and modern No queue at check in airport security or even for payment of airport charges Gate area very clean and equipped with a wide selection of dining options The view of the imposing Mount Pinatubo is something unique

Arrival from and departure to Shanghai I hadnt been to Tianjin for years its now one of those standard new Asian airports all sweeping steel and glass and marble Its easy to navigate and checkin and security are quick and efficient Theres cheap Internet access airside landside too but it was down and reasonable food options on both airside and landside Theres lots of room and seating and airport as a whole and the toilets are clean A metered taxi to or from the city is around RMB My only criticism would be the flight announcements they have one of those computers that says Fliight xxx from xxx to xxx is now checking in at gate xxx I dont know why these computers have the From xxx bit in China youre in Tianjin or wherever so its pretty obvious where the flight is from The computer couldnt pronounce Tianjin which made this even more irritating youd have thought they could find a computer that could pronounce the name of their own airport But otherwise it was lovely

As the previous reviewer noted Eilat airport terminal is in the centre of the city and surrounded by hotels I didnt believe the taxi driver for a few seconds when he dropped us there Once inside we got a thorough grilling by security and our bags swabbed throughout for explosives I think we got extra attention as foreigners but the female security official was very friendly and jovial much nicer that the humourless officials who you normally meet Checkin and hand baggage checks were quick and easy as the only flight was our seater Arkia departure There is a shopcafe on both landside and airside parts but we didnt get a chance to try either Overall it does the job well just be prepared for the security

Due to cancellation of BA flights tofrom Amman I ended up taking RJ Had a good experience in both directions Plane was clean the seats comfortable and there was a decent IFE selection for the hour flight Crew were fine polite but not particularly friendly or warm They didnt go out of their way to assist but were responsive I was impressed that before meal service they came around with drinks and nuts you dont get that on many airlines anymore The meal selection was decent with a choice of hot dishes accompanied by a starter roll and dessert and a selection of alcohol All flights were on time I wouldnt hesitate to take them again

Myself and my wife were on our first visit to Lanzarote and my first time as an assisted passenger The team who took care of us were excellent friendly and so helpful This made our holiday so much more enjoyable Thanks to the team well done assistance team at Lanzarote airport Thank You

I recently flew from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic Airways and had a fantastic experience The flight crew was attentive and professional ensuring everything ran smoothly from boarding to landing The aircraft was clean and comfortable and the service was prompt despite the short flight duration The pilot provided clear updates and the entire trip was seamless A great example of efficient and excellent regional service

Great service overall Timely departure after very organized boarding procedure Aircraft clean and well air conditioned for boarding Staff very friendly and professional Good meal service with table cloth tableware and drinks in glasses Good infos from cockpit Would surely fly Thai Smile again
We took flight from Kathmandu to Delhi The aircraft was Airbus Flight was quite good and on time Food that was given during flight was good and well presented cabin crew was so friendly and humble

China Eastern Airlines customer service has been improved dramatically since before the pandemic of COVID In economy class I feel well treated by cabin crew and everyone was so kind and well motivated I have ordered the vegetarian meal and I was not enjoyed the the cabin crew brought me nice food to replace Especially flight MU compared to MU I flew with this month the cabin crew did really fantastic job The only thing I was a bit disappointed is there is very limited option of inflight entertainment especially in A which was MU flight But overall both two aircrafts had fantastic leg space for a cm tall guy

The best airport in the Middle East and Europe Staff service is very good Checkin procedure was fast and efficient The airport amentities are quite good good cafes to eat something Segafredo for coffee Duty Free is really very big and the selection is quite large
Kuala Lumpur to Pangkor Island return This is the most pleasant way of flying for those who love airplanes

A wonderful little airport So impressed While it was busy at the peak of the holiday season everything moved quickly and efficiently The shops airside while small have a great selection of Spanish specialties like olive oil I hope the new airport that opens next year keeps up the same high standards

JNZDLC Flight departed and arrived on schedule Aircraft was newish MA clean and tidy Cabin announcements in English as well as Chinese but no cabin service only hour flight so acceptable especially given price of ticket RMB Aircraft named Modern Ark apt as modernised Chinese version of old Antinov design Overall perfectly acceptable
Fantastic airport I go in and out at least once a month Yesterday I timed my arrival and from walking off the plane to being outside at a taxi was seconds minute check in for departures

Well the airport is small so no comment there Toilets pretty clean However theres a bus every hour The bus driver doesnt sell tickets so I missed my bus at am for having to go back inside find the ticket machine somewhere and stay in a queue and buy it Theres no shade for the people and there are lots of children and pregnant women Information point nowhere to be seen

Flew on four separate legs within Myanmar and found them to be surprisingly good You dont normally expect catering on flights of under an hour but there was something on all segments Arrived in good time at Heho Airport for a flight to Yangon and they automatically put me on to an earlier departure There is a certain amount of third world amateurism about the boarding process but it all seemed to work

I booked London Mexico City London Business Class tickets Outgoing flight gave us access to the Virgin lounge at Heathrow and it was excellent Return flight had problems could not check in or select meal online using iPad their website only works on Microsoft Though in transit I had to go through immigration baggage reclaim and security before handing back my luggage to be loaded on the flight home Refused admittance to their Heineken lounge because I presented more than hours early just arrived on their flight from Cuba Lounge was noisy cramped and spartan when I did get in But flight was good
Kiev to Odessa but they serve sandwiches and the whole range of beverages B clean Plenty of legroom Flight was ontime Its worth the money

The onground experience was great very pleasant checkin experience the Adani lounge has a separate section for Vistara Frequent Fliers and Business Class which is quite nice The onboard experience is a bit soso the legroom in economy is fairly tight and feels less than Indigo They have cutdown on the quantity of food in meals visibly in economy class The IFE was good enough to keep oneself entertained and thankfully with the middle seat remaining empty the flight was quite comfortable

Ive lived in El Paso for two years now for school and I often use the airport to visit my hometown as well as other destinations The busiest Ive ever seen the airport from the time of walking through the doors checking baggage going through security and getting to my gate was about minutes Christmas vacation time Ive even got through in minutes Its a smaller airport with only one terminal thats ever used and about gates so from security to walk to your gate takes maybe minutes This isnt one of the airports youll need to devote hours in order to get through it Id say hour is fine because you never know even if it does only take minutes to get to your gate and maybe during busy holiday times or if youre going to have to check the whole family might even be hours for that

High marks for YOW Transited from USA to international There is no sterile transit area One has to enter Canada and then go through security again but the process was fast I was number at passport control Service personnel uniformly nice and helpful Reasonable number of shops and eateries for a small airport Well done Ottawa

If you dont need to go to Denver I recommend COS as the best option for going to Colorado Small but not too small clean efficient quick and centrally located to most points in Colorado Good quick car rentals I use it routinely to go to Pueblo and Denver Yes Denver as it can be more convenient and faster to get to a lot of places especially in south Denver Remember Denver airport is miles east and an expensive toll road from many points in Denver Also traffic is very congested in Denver but only moderately so in Colorado Springs Only problem I have is that most often but not always the cheaper fares are into and out of Denver

I was very nervous as was flying on my own for the first time and with my young child All staff were very helpful from the minute we walked into the airport The lady who booked us in was so considerate When we got on to the plane we were met by Joanie she was so welcoming and involved Samuel straight away Joanie then went above and beyond during the flight to make sure we were ok and to help me keep Samuel occupied She was so kind and thoughtful and was very complementary about his behaviour To absolutely blow us away she let us meet Johnathan and Catherine I hope I have names right this made Samuels day He couldnt stop smiling Please pass on my heartfelt thanks to them all what a super team I will definitely be using Loganair again

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment

Plovdiv is a small domestic airport It doesnt have any lounges Checkin is okay Not many staff so the lines are long There are very few flights some days even no flights The little bar next to check in is good However the airport is nice

Egilsstadir to Reykjavk Check in was a breeze Waiting area very clean Boarding was very easy just showing ticket and photo ID It was a minute flight They served tea or coffee with a chocolate I really enjoyed the flight as I did not want to travel by road again I will fly them again

I have been flying with Volotea for years and have never had any problems I believe that the company is one of the best in existence This is due to all the staff and the company organization Sono anni che volo con Volotea non ho avuto mai problemi Ritengo che la compagnia sia una delle migliori tra quelle in essere Questo merito vs al personale tutto e allorganizzazione aziendale

We had some troubles getting to the airport and were so worried we were going to be late We arrived at the check in counter just a few minutes late but the Jin Air employees were so kind and accommodating They got us through security and to our gate and we made a flight we otherwise would have definitely missed Just so grateful Thank you

Return Edinburgh to London City BAs CityFlyer remains the most pleasant way to get to and from London from Edinburgh The Embraer has much better legroom than the so look out for the type flying when booking The blue leather seats and layout make for comfort Trip to London City on Oct at on the EMB was wholly smooth Fantastic view of the three Forth bridges on departure So much legroom and space and Im ft in st On time more or less pleasant crew and a free breakfast of bacon rolls or a platter of fruit salad and organic yoghurt Water and hot drinks Just what was needed LCY is so easy to get through in arrival and I was on the DLR to the city in minutes flat A great start to the day Returning home on Oct at the on the smaller EMB was much less comfortable due to turbulence for at least mins thanks to the tail of a US hurricane passing over GB The reassuring captain apologised several times and explained he was trying to get clearance to a higher level Good to be kept informed The crew were marvellous Kind cheerful the best of BA Drinks and snacks served despite the plane lurching about All comp including a good Glenlivet malt Edinburgh arrival fine and into tram within mins of touchdown These jets arent new and it does show a bit but its a cutabove experience still compared to the alternatives The tickets to LCY on the travel app I use are a little more than Gatwick but if you can miss the absolute peak flights the difference isnt much and to me anyway worth it for the good service and central location and efficiency of London City Airport

Hakodate airport is fairly small but the building is modernised with only two floors Before the security gate on the second floor a small shopping arcade selling mainly Japanese goods Like all Japanese domestic airports Hakodate is well organised clean and efficient It caters mainly for passengers travelling with ANA and JAL two of the major Japanese airlines and Do airline a subsidiary of ANA If you are staying in the downtown area there is direct airport bus from JAL hotel the Grand hotel and the Hokodate train station to the airport The bus fare is yens and it takes only minutes

It was an easy online check in Due to other company flight delays I was short on time to drop my bag in When I arrived it was too late for me to print my bag tag Ricky at LAX directed me to an operator who printed my tag and checked my bag in Flight was also great Service when needed but nice and quiet during the night to sleep I recommend Delta Air Lines

Berlin to Hurghada It was the first time I am flown with Germania It was a good choice after Air Berlin terminated service on this route They offer free baggage kg a complimentary hot meal and three legs of complimentary non alcoholic hot or cold drinks on this hrs trip If the flight is booked more you have the possibility to upgrade to an extra legroom seat containing up to inch more legroom head phones and one beerwhine Flight attendants were very friendly and caring all the flight One documentary and one movie were shown on overhead screens But if you are not interested in their IFE bring your own device CheckIn was a bit confusing because they tell that your seat is advised automatically which I believe is not the truth There were many free seats Therfore this was not a problem but would be if this flight have been more crowded All in all a very good price service ratio

Orlando to Manchester with Thomas Cook Airlines A low cost airline which provided a really good experience especially given the very low price of the ticket The flight departed one hour late but caught up and arrived on time Food was really good The entertainment was limited only a few movies but good Excellent flight for a cheap price

Same plane on both DALDCA and DCAPVD Aircraft was very clean with the pleasant flight crew providing the usual no frills service IFE worked flawlessly There was a good selection of movies and live TV however there are no power ports to charge personal devices at the seats iPhones or iPads An added bonus on the connecting flight to PVD I got a whole row to myself which is a rarity nowadays

Naha airport has undergone some renovation and expansion it keeps improving each time I go there Being a small airport arrival is easy and luggage waiting time is not too long customs are also friendly and easy to pass through There is a major improvement in checkin areas for international flights and some domestic Used to be in a cramped little area now its a lot more spacious There is also a big improvement in food offering before immigration Once passed international immigration you will be left with very little choice I believe they are still undergoing some major facelifts for the departure gate areas maybe more stores will be added soon Overall this is a charming little regional airport which is easy to move around

Brussels to Stockholm and return They land at Bromma very close to the city small and friendly airport Checkin staff and cabin crew were friendly and helpful Plane was a BA with in one row instead of Look a little old inside Nevertheless good value for your money Cheap fares and drinks and snacks at good prices available on board We will fly them again when we go back to Sweden

Sal is a great small airport which is easy to use lots of signs and decent food options Good taxi services and shuttle buses to hotels Clean and airy and bright Would recommend Aeroplanes park very close and many airlines fly to Sal which is useful Friendly staff

Checkin security check an immigration at Xiamen Airport swift although not very friendly Contract lounge large with decent FB choices Boarding for both flights well organized Both flights with good FB offerings and service and on time IFE very good The big letdown was again the lack of frequent flyer points for members of other One lWorld airlines besides Asia Miles There was not even a fare bookable in economy which attracts frequent flyer points I fly frequently within the OneWord alliance and no other carrier has this practice I will therefore stick to the other members of Oneworld in the future

Modern airport surprisingly efficient compared with some other internal Russian airports Arrival facilities good baggage on the conveyor without a long wait On departure check in facilities were good security efficient and the Skyteam business lounge was of a high standard with free Internet connection although all drinks etc had to be paid for

Delightful little airport serving virtually all Shetland passengers Internal flights from Aberdeen Edinburgh Glasgow Orkney and twice a week STN plus occasional scheduled flights to Bergen and Faroe Terminal has a restaurant tourist office bookshop and car hire Everyone is friendly even though they have significant disruption from time to time when fog closes down operations The only gripe is that public transport to Lerwick is not frequent enough to meet all flights But overall just like the rest of Shetland it is a refreshing change form the me too culture of most of Europe

Its always a pleasure going through this airport It is clean spacious and easy to navigate Immigration and customs are always fast and efficient There are a good number of dutyfree shops although not as many food outlets

Almaty to Karaganda Purchasing a ticket days before the flight from Almaty to Karaganda was super fast and cheap Airplane looks new and clean Service exceeded my expectations Cabin seat was quite comfortable Menu of snacks teacoffee and other bevarages is affordable One unusual thing is while checking in they sort flyers based on their seat numbers to make it easier to board a plane

Entire flight was smooth however boarding time was a little confusing and the assigned gate they suddenly changed it so it caused more confusion I ordered prebook meal it tasted good but the food itself was somehow cold For me airlines baggage policy was highly favorable as I was able to check in kilos regardless of number of luggage

I chose this airline for the simple reason of its aircraft type Boarding was completed quickly for on time departure On board seat pitch was a little tight snack service box was offered water and a sweet coffee bun and a sales trolley after that Cabin was quite warm and no walk though by cabin crew offering water Cabin is showing it age for sure but still enjoyed my flight

Like many airports food and drinks are much too expensive I do therefore I also do not want to buy water It is not allowed to take bottled water through customs so most airports have free tap drinking water Also this airport But they are all disconnected I find this outrageous To have access to drinking water is a right

Frequented CMB many times in the last decade and on the whole its ok It runs pretty smoothly and in fact has improved over the years the immigration particularly seems quicker I do however hate the exorbitant dollar priced fooddrink and duty free etc The contrast between what this cost just outside the door or the airport and the terminal prices must be one of the biggest contrasts in the world That said its a pretty painless experience to pass through

Modern airport medium in Chinese terms Incoming by bus from runway efficient and fast very simple to get your bearings Outgoing fast very clear information very efficient checkin good facilities About min from city center

Great restaurant upstairs that serves main course meals and happy to work in your time frame for your flight Modern building and brilliant to depart and arrive from if you live anywhere nearby Just make sure you check the kind of aircraft being used for your flight If you do NOT want to be on a small regional or propeller plane your choices are limited Nothing better than arriving at HPN and getting home locally in under minutes

Szczecins Solidarity Airport is one of the smaller regional airports in Poland The cartaxi ride from Szczecin takes a bit longer than expected but once there you will find a pleasant airport located in a wood away from the city It has only a small terminal but it is very modern fresh and complete with all facilities bookstalls shops cafs etc that open also for early morning departures Im told there is a small hotel nearby The staff is helpful Only a handful of flights depart each day so the terminal does not get crowded and the atmosphere is casual and relaxed And the security check was very thorough which I appreciated

Qazaq Air from Almaty to Shymkent returning a few days later Very good value considering tickets were booked less than hours before departure Nice new aircraft and smartly attired crew who were all trilingual Baggage is included in the ticket price and hand luggage was not strictly monitored but since both flights were not full there was plenty of space in the overhead lockers Check in at both ends was perfunctory and more or less wordless but the flights were punctual the return flight leaving minutes before the scheduled time of which was greatly appreciated by all on board There was even a snack service with a good choice of drinks all included in the ticket price Another retro touch was the basket of sweets offered round before take off I would definitely fly this airline again and hope they expand their destinations The only thing I would say against them is that at present their small fleet seems to mean that certain routes are served with en route stops that added to the slower speed of the Q aircraft could make some trips around Kazakhstan quite arduous Overall though excellent and amazing value

The schedules are well respected and the staff is excellent Boarding and disembarkation are quick The plane is clean and the information is clear Les horaires sont bien respects et le personnel est parfait Lembarquement se fait rapidement ainsi que le dbarquement Lavion est propre et les informations sont claires

Apart from the fact that the crew at Incheon were a little rude everything was perfect For a low cost airline the seats were very comfy and the legroom was amazing I would definitely recommend this airline

I fly weekly for work and Gerald R Ford Intl Airport in Grand Rapids is one of my two homebase airports Its served by American Delta United Southwest and Allegiant and has nonstop flights to twentysomething destinations I primarily fly American and mostly take flights that connect through Chicago OHare or DallasFort Worth GRR is a larger regional airport with two concourses of gates each but not a large airport by any means I can park in the garage walk in clear security TSA PreCheck and walk to my gate within minutes of driving into the garage I love that kind of convenience Employees are friendly and helpful pretty much across the board at the airline counters security and at the gates GRR recently finished a fairly large renovation in late They now have one central security checkpoint and a central area with new shopping and dining including a local brewpub Starbucks and a Michiganthemed souvenir shop There are also new lounge areas childrens play area and a business center not to mention new large restrooms In general GRR operates on time which is key for me Most delays Ive experienced have come from aircraft delayed at their originating airport mostly OHare Im basically comfortable relying on this airport for my weekly business travel needs

When cabin crew ask for your feedback and thoughts on how they could improve you know they are genuinely committed to improving service To be honest I could not fault them on our hour mins flight The plane was fairly new very clean and the welcome aboard and service throughout exceptional I had to compliment the crew on the food The steak was perfect and tasted as if it had been cooked onboard It bettered my steak experience from steak cooked on board in first class I really look forward to flying Aircalin again and experiencing that level of customer service and care Highly recommended
Great airline Very friendly staff Flown with this airline around times and never had a bad experience only of my flights have Been delayed and none cancelled

I guess the main factor to consider when assessing TVM aiport is perspective Most visitors to the airport are NRI returning home Hence issues like good shopping and dining dont really matter to most As an NRI what I really want is fast processing whether it is arrival or departure This has historically been the major lament about Indian aiports In this regard TVM airport gets top marks It is easy to drive into and there is good parking space Ticketing security checks and immigration are fairly quick and the aiport staff do not hassle you as long as you have your valid documents ready it is better to have a printed ticket with you It is not a fancy airport although the buildings are modern and clean but I am very proud of it

Not a large airport my wife and I found this one more like ones we are used to in New Zealand No airbridges but airstairs do the job well especially at smaller airports Arrival was good a lot of taxi touts which is not unusual in Malaysia we used a coupon taxi for transport to our hotel Did not visit the shops or toilets here had a long wait in departure lounge for our flight Met our needs staff helpful

I would like to say a very special thank you to the security staff that helped my friend and I last week at Naples Airport A friend had travelled earlier that day and inadvertently left his iPad behind in security We only had a short time before our departure to try and retrieve it for him The staff were fast efficient and located the iPad within minutes After running through some security checks we were able to take the iPad home back to its owner saving everyone a lot of time and energy I dont usually write reviews but the service we received from the security staff was first class and deserved a mention

Gatwick to Puerto Vallarta We travelled in premium economy both directions and its worth the upgrade but only just Firstly the premium check in was fast the included lounge access was great The only part of the upgrade that doesnt work is the bags off first this didnt happen in both directions The food quality was acceptable drinks were free flowing The crew seemed to be experienced and happy which made for an enjoyable flight both ways

I had a better experience than most of the other people who posted reviews here The airplane departed on time in Tblisi and arrived even a bit earlier Seats are comfortable Checked luggage is free which is very rare these days Be prepared for zero interaction with the staff members in the plane though Only at the entrance the staff greets you They seemed quite friendly though Theres no option to buy food and no information apart from an announcement that the landing has started The life vests looked quite old frayed and stained at least the one that the safety instructor showed maybe the ones stored under your seat are newer If you dont need luxury and you bring your own food this airline is really fine I dont know how they act in case of delays or cancellations though

Flew GA Amsterdam to Jakarta from Madrid Spain GarudaIndonesia had arranged with the Schiphol VIP Center to meet me at the plane door upon arrival from Madrid and I was taken to the VIP centre for check in security and immigration formalities This is a great service as it bypasses all queues Within the VIP Lounge at Schiphol Airport there are full service including a full Al La Cart dining When I it came time to board the aircraft I was assisted by a member of the VIP team that took me by car to the aircraft stairs At the aircraft door I was meet by the cabin crew Fauziah Pradita Maurenia Ade Indrawati and Chef Aris Gumilar who give me a very warm welcome and guided me to my seat The First Class Team gave outstanding service from boarding in flight dining and general overall service There was a very good selection of food for both evening meal and for breakfast The meals can be served on demand however as I wanted to have some sleep I requested my meal two hours after takeoff The quality portion and presentation of the food was outstanding There was quite some turbulence throughout the flight however I still had an excellent sleep We were slightly delayed arriving in Jakarta but this was caused by the delay in departing Schiphol as it is over minutes taxi to the remote runway When I arrived in Jakarta I was meet at the aircraft door by Yudi from the First Class Team who help and assisted me through immigration luggage collection and through customs and out to a car provided by GarudaIndonesia to take me to my home I used the onboard Wi Fi and connectifity and speed was excellent This was another excellent flight and I thank the Cabin crew for their outstanding service

Very clean and modern airport New terminal added in New access highway to Shenyang Limited air traffic with few delays Baggage area is poorly lit Not sure why As the Chinese economy grows who knows what will come of this airport Right now its a clean well run airport albeit with little air traffic Interesting for an American to see Air Koryo planes and personnel at the airport

Very nice new airport approx km from Warsaw The airport is easy to navigate the staff is very helpful There was no queue to check in or security control so it was good for family travel We ate a dinner in the airports restaurant the meal was tasty and there was a large selection of food for children There is also a small playground for kids nice thing if you have some time to spend The airport is very clean and quiet the terminal has a very good acoustic capabilities and there was no noise when we were waiting for the flight On the arrival journey everything was very quick just few minutes from the airplane doors to the luggage claim and city exit The car parking is just in front of the terminal building its much cheaper than at Warsaw Chopin airport theres also a bus station just next to the terminal

On arrival Very long queue for passport control over an hour They have plenty of staff but processing time per person is simply very long On departure queues were fine We were told to arrive hours in advance which meant waiting doing nothing for a long time There are no restaurants after security just a few fast food options Also WiFi only works if you can receive an OTP by text ie you already have data Clean and pleasant but some of the details could be thought through a bit more

On the understanding that Srinagar being the capital of Indian administered Kashmir is at the centre of one of longest running conflicts in the world then one should expect a particularly unique experience regarding airport security Srinagar airport in this respect does not disappoint On arrival on Jet Airways from Delhi one is immediately struck by the fact that this is a military airfield masquerading as a civilian airport MiG fighters and helicopter gunships abound at the far end of the airfield and all buildings are camoflauge painted The odd civilian Boening looks incongruous For arriving foreigners you are accosted by a security official fairly politely it must be said to fill in a long registration document He then accompanies you out of the arrival and baggage collection hall on a dirt track to the carpark to ensure you are being met by whoever you had claimed you were on the form Only then can you be on your way If you are not being met I am not sure what your fate would be Departure though is an object lesson in airport security The first hurdle is a kilometer or so before the airport terminal where you are stopped at a roadblock and put your luggage through an xray machine Entering the airport and only passengers are allowed not guests or friends you again put bags through another xray sceeening Then you are allowed to go to check in after which you must as a foreigner fill out another lengthy departure registration form for the police No hand luggage whatsoever is allowed on Delhi bound flights so all you can carry is what you can fit in your pockets therefore travel with a multipocket vest or similar to maximise carry on potential Hand carried clear plastic water bottles do suprisingly seem OK though to carry on The waiting area after check in is basic but OK as long as you dont mind being stared at suspiciously by numerous armed army and poice men Then there is another long queue for a more detailed security check which involves turning out all pockets and being individually scanned Finally you are through to the actual departure area but this is not the end After being released to go out on foot to your waiting Boeing you again go through another security check all pockets and a patdown before eventually you board the plane Great views of the Himalayas to the north on the flight out but since cameras are not allowed on board the memories stay in your mind and not on film

After reading lots of reviews I was really sceptical about flying with WOW air I still went ahead and booked my ticket to detroit as it was the cheapest option for a one way and I had to book last minute which is always more expensive I decided to pay for selected seats up the front with extra leg room on both flights and got really lucky with having no one in my row for the first flight The second flight I chose a seat with no middle seat and was really happy with this decision As its a cheap airline a lot of people do not pay for the seat upgrade its really not expensive to purchase the extra leg room and well worth it for the comfort Plus you will likely not have many people around The food and drink on board is very expensive but as I knew this beforehand I purchased food and water at the airport to take on the flight with me I think I was lucky with the reliability of both my flights taking off on time as this was the one thing I was worried about The seats are very dirty front seat pocket but all airlines are usually quite unhygienic so this was to be expected The service on board I thought was great very friendly staff and attentive Overall I would say you get what you pay for and you are taking a risk booking with WOW air but lucky for me I had a good experience with them and would book again

I flew from and to Varna Airport in April The airport is good but the lounges were closed early in the morning There is only duty free shop and the prices there are good One bad thing is that boarding the plane is always by bus otherwise it is a good experience
A quick hop from Bangkok to Chiang Rai here No frills did the job perfectly left slightly early and arrived well on time Seats comfortable for an hours flight I still love the liveries of the airline

Its for T international arrivals Newly operated T pleasant experience no rush hardly min for immigration still under construction no eatingforex options within the terminal whatever available is outside the terminal Bag arrived on time hardly min to exit with baggage Clean toilets and facilities

Worst service I have ever seen in my entire life Had to wait for hrs at the carousel for my baggage to arrive Im told workers were slacking off and didnt see my bags until a senior officer had come to get the baggage moving Unfriendly staff who dont even wish to communicate with passengers unless you incorrectly use an aircrew term where they are most happy to correct you and then snigger about it and then once again act like youre nonexistent Well at least that informed me that they are not deaf but clearly ignoring me Porters in uniform are helpful and kindly directed me too Beware of Taxi drivers and ununiformed porters my baggage was forcibly snatched by one these to help me to the domestic flight departures

ArkhangelskARH to TromsoeTOS with a stop in MurmanskMMK Fast and easy checkin and boarding Decently comfortable and rapid security check Aircraft Antonov has seen better days but was OK for a short flight Cabin crew polite and professional Got served drinks on the first leg to Murmansk then snacks selection of meats with bread and piclkes on the way from Murmansk to Tromsoe Departure and arrival according to the timetable Luggage arrived OK Overall experience fine apart from the high price

Minsk Airport was recently renovated and even though the layout may be outdated it looks brand new The airport is easy to get around and there are plenty of signs and directions for the passengers I did not experience any queues at all neither at checkin nor with the security and passport control it was all very quick and professional The terminal is extremely clean just like the city is which is almost surreal at times given that it is the place where thousands of people pass through every single day Food and shopping options seem standard for the airport of this size there is a dutyfree shop a souvenir shop fast food restaurant and a few cafeterias The only problem is that I havent seen any money exchange offices Airport staff are very professional and efficient When it comes to wifi there is a minute free connection however one can buy a very cheap wifi service for several days which also works in the city The main downside of the airport is the fact that it is so far away from the city and that there are no low cost options

Brussels to Casablanca on Jetairfly and everything was great The price wasnt too expensive there were no delays and the staff were polite and professional Only negative point is the leg space but thats okay for less than hours in my opinion I will fly with them again

Keflavk to Copenhagen This flight was operated on anew Aneo showcasing Icelandairs Saga Class the airlines Business Class product Although the flight was delayed by three hours an uncommon occurrence given Icelandairs excellent ontime performance access to the Saga Lounge at Keflavk ensured the wait was a comfortable one The flight itself was smooth and pleasant While the Saga Class seats are not lieflat they are wellcushioned and provide ample comfort for the short journey The onboard service was warm and efficient Overall no complaints Icelandairs Saga Class delivers the most comfortable option for travel between Iceland and Europe or the Nordics

Orlando to Jackson I am a frequent traveler and have flown my entire life My mother is a Delta flight attendant of years and when I was young she would take me on her flights I had flown over times before the age of Given this background I am very particular when it comes to my air travel Going into flying with Via I had my reservations as I normally stick to the main carriers but their service and in flight experience greatly exceeded both me and my fiancs expectations Would gladly fly with Via Air again and look forward to the next chance I get to fly with them

I had a pleasant experience on my Teheran Mehrabad to Shiraz flight It was a little bumpy due to weather but a delicious packed snack and drink were served for the short flight All the crew were very friendly and are a credit to their airline The A EPIEG was clean with a decent seat pitch for my foot frame and I was given a row of seats to myself All in all a very nice company who charged a very reasonable for my one way ticket I wish Iran Air the very best with each new addition to their expanding fleet and this wont be the last time I fly Iran Air

Vistara is overall good The seats were comfortable the food was kind of okayish staff service on point inflight entertainment was okay This my first time flying with Vistara and i am sure that i will be flying again with this airline The ground service could have been more better than this the bus took a little bit of time

John Wayne Airport is all about efficiency and comfort This airport has one of the most direct and easy access to the freeway of any airport that I have been to I took Southwest Airlines from John Wayne to Las Vegas Checkingin my bags at the airline counter and going through security took me no more than minutes There are plenty of open seats at this terminal and a variety of restaurants to choose from Southwest terminal has large windows from which passengers can enjoy views of aircraft taking off and landing John Wayne also provides free wifi

It was the cheapest way to go back after yet another season in Asia and honestly I didnt expect too much But the plane was quite new and the cabin was in a good condition Departed on time unlike the connecting domestic flight by another airline before There was an inflight entertainment system available and it seems to be modern but after a night spent in two different airports I hardly used it for anything other than the D map Although the food was served not as elegantly as some airlines do it was quite delicious and I could choose what I preferred on both meals despite sitting not in the middle of the cabin Note that there are only soft drinks available but for me it doesnt really matter The seats are not exactly Emirateslike but still quite comfortable for an hours flight The headphones were usual cheap earbuds unfortunately but they also included an adapter which I took away and which will let me plug in my own headphones on some later flight great and I just dont understand why airlines besides those smart few who provide multiuse washablecup large headphones couldnt distribute just that on request rather than generating tons of cheap headphones waste The flight was smooth and arrived minutes early Definitely would fly Tianjin Airlines again if the price is right and the route will fit my plans and will stop at Chongqing or Tianjin where I havent been yet as well should I have time for that

Was looking forward to flying with Solomon Airlines who were operating this flight on behalf of Air Vanuatu Check in was quick efficient and polite Boarding passes issued and invitation to the Air New Zealand Lounge where we sipped champagne and ate nibbles while we waited for our flight Boarding was quick and we sat in our allocated seats A C in Business Class Immediately offered champagneJuice or water before takeoff Naturally we had Champagne on this midday flight Cabin was clean airy and bright and the cabin crew were an absolute delight Friendly smiles everywhere and typical south pacific hospitality Lunch served was fresh very inviting and very tasty naturally followed by more champagne Flight time hours went by very quickly Even though the aircraft did not have WiFi no IFE and no charging ports that really didnt bother us as we were forewarned by researching in advance and we came prepared Its when youre not prepared travelling with kids and their electronic bits and pieces that they are forever glued to is where this could be an issue Be prepared Highly recommend Solomon Airlines and would be very happy to fly with them again

After a long transatlantic flight the last leg of my flight was with TAM from Sao Paulo to Porto Alegre When I landed in Sao Paulo I still had a couple of hours before my next flight I went to TAM desk for the checkin and the person there offered me to take an earlier flight which was in half an hour I was extremely happy about this Its the first time that I was so satisfied with the airline staff The flight was ok and with some snacks and a drink nothing too special but as youd expect in a one something hour flight

I would like to say a huge thank to Yasmin who went to great lengths to find us a new flight the same day but from Bristol airport flight missed just Start of holiday delayed by hours only her professional and helpful support was greatly appreciated Thank you again

Ground staff at JFK could have been better I had a great deal of luggage and needed a special staff member to handle tagging It was hard to find him and found out he hadnt been informed for several minutes Seats comfortable to Casablanca good flight crew good catering Casablanca to Lagos had an excellent crew and the best airline catering Ive had in decades of traveling Id definitely fly them again

A very friendly team of airport workers overall Southern hospitality goes a long way Would like to see more dining options and shops that are not all identical in product choices Overall a very good experience Would definitely fly to Memphis again without hesitation

This was my first flight with Starlux and was most impressed Checkin was quick and easy The plane is new quiet spacious and spotlessly clean featuring a large screen with many entertainment choices The flight left a few minutes late from Terminal One which was recently renovated and quite comfortable The onboard service was caring and professional My two oriental veg meals were somewhat bland but were generous and wellprepared

I had a fantastic experience on American Eagle operated by Republic Airlines The flight departed on time and despite being only minutes the service was exceptional We were offered a predeparture beverage and even a full beverage service once airborne a rare treat for such a short flight As someone who takes this route twice a week Ive consistently been impressed with the professionalism and efficiency of the crew
I really love this airport It is small and very quick Regular security is quicker than TSA Pre The Airport has nice entertainment and its a nice regional airport

A comfortable flight seated in a pair of two seats on the left of the aircraft The ground service and on board service were friendly and efficient and we were pleasantly surprised to get a tasty snack and an alcoholic or nonalcoholic drink on this short leg plus an Easter chocolate The flight operated about mins late There was no attempt to enforce the airlines policy on takeon baggage Luckily we were on early and could find space for our takeon bags over our seats but other people were struggling due to the suitcasesize bags allowed on board

I have flown times on La Companie so far and could not be happier It makes me laugh to see complaints about ground accommodations and old planes etc this is an airline that flies to a manageable airport Orly with lower taxes than for example CDG it is a boutique operation with limited flights and proposes business class flights RT for as low as vs on poorer major airlines It is great value for the price and grumpy people can still spend their on a coach ticket booked on United coping with the CDG mess and see if they are offered hot towels full meal champagne and most importantly business class seats with better air quality
A small but friendly airport which is quite central The facilities are adequate for the size of the country It is clean and tidy and the staff are helpful

I had an excellent experience at Taoyuan Airport Very impressed with the smooth and efficient baggage handling process The staff were incredibly helpful offering assistance with moving my luggage at the baggage carousel It made the entire process much easier and stressfree Really appreciated the level of customer care and attention to detail in ensuring that everything went smoothly Im highly satisfied with the service and would definitely recommend it
The airport is new modern and colorful Everywhere is clean There are nice looking green areas with flowers and trees outside The employees were polite and smiling

I have travelled to Yangon many times in the past and this was the first time I used the new airport extension On arrival luggage has to go through baggage scanner just like some airports in Middle East Guests are also able to enter the airport too until immigration and passport control The airport is very large and spacious there are international branded shops and some that sell local products The products in the convenience store were not over priced The airport facilities are better than in some western European cities

I suddenly needed to use the special assistance service at Newcastle airport in order to go on holiday in May I had seen in the media the chaotic scenes at some uk airports and in addition the issues for passengers with disabilities I never expected Newcastle special assistance service to contradict the horror stories but it certainly did To put it simply they excelled and you should go on holiday via Newcastle with absolute confidence What an amazing service They have some of the most friendly helpful and professional staff who cannot do enough to help you and put you at ease They explain what is happening throughout the transit process in the airport To and from the aeroplane Through security to baggage collection even right through to getting in the taxis home They get you through
