Nice and small airport at El Alto La Paz The process to get my bags was average in time and customs was friendly and polite There are a few cafes and a couple of restaurants I could see Ground transpiration is readily available by taxi or minibus The airport is not a big building but it has wifi it is clean and has many standard services

London Gatwick to Podgorica The Fokker seats were comfortable in formation but they were small and legroom was limited Crew members were helpful and attentive We were served a couple of drinks and a fairly basic sandwich but it was fine It was cheaper for me to book a ticket to Belgrade via Podgorica than it was just to Podgorica I told the checkin staff I wanted to get off at Podgorica and that was fine

The rum and pretty well everything in the duty free stores costs double what it costs in a grocery store in Managua Rum is about US in a grocery and in the duty free in the airport A pound of Case de Cafe coffee is about vs about in the grocery store However the duty free shops are the only place to buy legitimate Nicaraguan cigars as total production in the country is for export They are very good and very high quality but to be honest at times in the USA they cost less Random luggage searches on departure are almost always for locals rarely tourists The airport is really quite advanced for Central America currently departures are a bit of a hassle with the construction of that area arrivals are a breeze and rarely does it take more than minutes with immigration and customs both especially for tourists vs visitingreturning Nicaraguans Taxis to the city are clean and controlled if a bit slow vs a regular taxista and cost US with the drivers in the red shirts However if you walk to the street about feet the fare is around If you can negotiate in Spanish that is

Saint Petersburg to Samara The airline is very good The cabin is clean and comfortable and with this always promised food and friendly staff As for the baggage allowance things are even better the baggage allowance is kilograms

Apart from a minute delay outbound it is hard to fault my SydneyAdelaide return trip Yes its a no frills carrier but most everything worked efficiently and I was impressed by how smiling and happy all the staff were

Flew GA Jakarta to Amsterdam I was picked up at home by a car provided by GarudaIndonesia and was them met at the terminal kerb side by GarudaIndonesia First Class Team Nidya Ahda who helped me with check in security and through immigration formalities Although the airport was very busy this process was very quick In the Jakarta airport FirstClass lounge there is full menu and drinks service available however I chose a sandwich When it came time for boarding Naiya assisted me to the aircraft door where I was meet by the FirstClass cabin crew Romad Wanda Cartika and Chef Angga who provided me with a very warm welcome I was quite tired therefore after a short snack after takeoff I bedded down and had a very good sleep for hours There was a good selection of food available for breakfast The breakfast meal can be ordered on demand therefore I chose for breakfast to be served hours prior to landing The quality of food portion size and presentation were outstanding and refills of tea and coffee are none stop When we arrived in Amsterdam Schiphol airport we were met at the plane door by the Schiphol VIP Team who took me to the VIP centre where we go through immigration and checkin for my onward flight This is also a great service and it avoids all the queues I used the onboard Wi Fi and the connectivity was very excellent I would like to thank the GarudaIndonesia First Class Team on the ground and to the Cabin crew for the outstanding service they provided

An uneventful flight to Amsterdam Catering was not the best this time bland food and sides We were served twice it filled our stomach but that was it Service provided by the staff was friendly and speedy despite a full plane Seats were comfortable We landed min earlier in Amsterdam

LAN Peru flights from Bogota to Santiago via Lima Although it was a relatively small aircraft A I think and the flight departed am on time we did get a blanket plus pillow eye cover and ear plugs and headphones for free The flight attendants were extremely friendly and elegant The flight entertainment was pretty good not personal IFE though and the food was a small breakfast sandwich or muffin with complementary hot and cold beverages There was a choice of good Colombian coffee We were informed from the cockpit about the status of our flight and it landed on time enough to catch the connection to Santiago The seat space was more then average and overall a very good experience

Travellers arriving into SSA on international flights beware most of the cash machines in the airport for some unfathomable reason cease service at Particularly inconvenient since TAP and Air Europa flights from Lisbon and Madrid arrive shortly before midnight leaving international travellers with no Brazilian money This happened to me for the second time now which suggests it is a continuous issue There are three cash machines in the revamped Banco do Brasil right next to international arrivals which accept foreign maestro cirrus cards but they only issue a maximum of R per card which is just about enough for a taxi ride to the city centre and a beer Apart from this major issue which is strictly speaking not Infraeros fault but the banks SSA still remains an efficient and pleasant airport

I was visiting family in India so this was the airport we went to and it was actually really good there They had lounge chairs at the gates The only problem was the constant beep during a conveyor belt motion and it was really annoying and it spread throughout the airport I really do think this is a great airport overall

The service was simply outstanding on this my first flight with Hainan Airlines Very comfortable business class seat on B provided with plush Sofitel duvet and bedding beyond anything I have received on other airlines Food was excellent many courses and beautifully served Cabin staff service was exceptional friendly and very attentive more than Singapore Airlines and seemed very genuine Onboard entertainment was okay but lacking compared to many airlines Look forward to further flights with this airline
A pleasant small airport very useful for southern Spain A minus point would be being held in the sun before boarding a plane this is quite unpleasant Announcements are very clear Very good airport

I was down with flu and surprised when I checked in and cleared passport that the airport did not have any pharmacies or clinics inside the airport This is the first time in a long history of travel that an airport doesnt have these facilities Very disappointed

Stewart Airport in Newburgh NY is simply good I love to use this airport and often choose international carriers based on their landing at Stewart My experiences with Play Airlines have also been great Lorraine in checkin is a gem and keeps things running smoothly It is wonderful that the airport keeps adding domestic flight carriers as well Now travel is possible from Stewart International to Charleston SC No other airport is as easy to navigate as Stewart International The atmosphere is pleasant the staffing is topnotch and the TSA agents are respectful and helpful The entire process from checkin to boarding is smooth and efficient International arrivals are quick and Ive never had an issue with my luggage I highly recommend Stewart Airport to anyone who wants a simple hasslefree international travel experience
We had a challenge with checking due to a third party error Even so Sarah was super kind and efficient She made us feel at ease and resolved the issues we had promptly Thanks again

This was a lovely flight from Hobart to the Gold Coast on Tigerair Boarding was orderly We walked to the plane and boarded through the rear I had row to myself in the second last row I will travel with them again

BK TSNXIY Not as bad as I thought very cheap no IFE pretty bad meal but still a meal nonetheless Aircraft was an older but was perfectly clean Service was efficient but brash Chinese regulations mean that you cant use your mobile phone any time during the flight even in flight mode and they do enforce this

We arrived at Dinard airport at around in April The airport is tiny so dont expect much The queue for the passport control was queuing out of the door and took around mins to pass The airport has one small baggage belt that gets very cramped When you get into arrivals there are car hire desks Overall the arrival experience was ok considering what a small airport Dinard is On our departure there was only bag drop desk for an entire flight Next step is security where you have to show your passportboarding pass times to different people There is only security lane which took mins clear and when you get into the departure lounge it is no better there either there are no shops whatsoever no not even a magazine shop just a few vending machines Overall this airport was ok

Book flight for Thanksgiving Left Nov one way to Fresno Flight was nice and comfortable no complications Book flight back from Reno Nevada December at am direct flight to Portland only to have canceled and reschedule for over booking Unable rescheduled on Sunday to fly so forced rebook by airline for Monday No base seat available so force to buy a higher price ticket or be reschedule for Tuesday Refunded dollar from Sunday then force to pay dollar Monday or be scheduled There more but I book flight through Alaska and flight was Via Skywest So their more even late leave airport on Monday and ground stewardess take minute to play with another passenger tablet before being able board plain Flight suppose be am left Reno after am

I fly into and out of Albany a few times a year on business For my money its one of the most efficient airports in terms of securityTSA in the country They get you in out and on your way with very little hassle the way it should be The airport itself isnt huge and doesnt have some of the amenities of a larger hub but as a traveller Im looking for efficiency and thats what Albany Airport provides

This is a very nice airport Very clean and modern Airport staff are courteous and helpful It is definitely the best airport I have been to in the Caribbean and definitely better than some airports in the US especially Miami where you are not even offered free WiFi Nassau airport has complimentary WiFi everywhere Selection of popular restaurants inside the US departure lounge There are some shops but mostly expensive souvenirs A great experience hats off to everyone at NAS

I recently flew American Eagle operated by Republic from Washington DC to Philadelphia and I was really impressed The E was comfortable and wellsuited for the short hop between cities Even though the flight was only minutes and we had a slight delay leaving Washington due to congestion the crew still managed to offer a full beverage service in first class which I really appreciated Despite the delay we landed in Philadelphia on time It was a smooth and enjoyable flight overall

Short hour hop from Vancouver to Castlegar and all good The plane looks tiny on the ground but the ride was smooth and on time Not much time for more than a swift Sprite and pretzels before we made the descent This landing is one which all Air Canada pilots practice over and over on the simulator as it is apparently one of the most challenging in Canada Not bad on a sunny day such as we travelled but I am sure on a wet evening it would be quite a tricky path through the mountains Also advised that the route can get cancelled for days at a time due to fog No such problems for us as flights out and back were fine Great to arrive at an airport and your bag is there in literally minutes Give this route a go but make sure to check the Castlegar weather first

The airport is much improved since I was last here in Arrivals not much to say there was just my flight in so the baggage queue was pretty tame Departure check in was a breeze even though there were three flights due to depart that morning There is free wifi and plenty of seating The new terminal building is spacious and modern with a nice outside seating area overlooking the runway and apron Security was also a breeze with only a very small queue and security staff seemed pleasant enough No air bridge though so if its raining you have a couple of minutes walk before you get to your aircraft Overall a nice little airport

Stewart Airport in Newburgh NY is simply good I love to use this airport and often choose international carriers based on their landing at Stewart My experiences with Play Airlines have also been great Lorraine in checkin is a gem and keeps things running smoothly It is wonderful that the airport keeps adding domestic flight carriers as well Now travel is possible from Stewart International to Charleston SC No other airport is as easy to navigate as Stewart International The atmosphere is pleasant the staffing is topnotch and the TSA agents are respectful and helpful The entire process from checkin to boarding is smooth and efficient International arrivals are quick and Ive never had an issue with my luggage I highly recommend Stewart Airport to anyone who wants a simple hasslefree international travel experience

Sal is a great small airport which is easy to use lots of signs and decent food options Good taxi services and shuttle buses to hotels Clean and airy and bright Would recommend Aeroplanes park very close and many airlines fly to Sal which is useful Friendly staff

The food wasnt that great and theres no inflight entertainment but we were comfortable and had our iPods With regards to the cleanliness of the aircraft weve been on worse We found the cabin crew to be friendly their English is not great and they all had smiles I think if you expect high standards from a star airline youre bound to come home and write negative reviews Overall we were happy with what we got

Syrian Arab Airlines LHRDamascusLHR Flights departed ontime aircraft an A The crew were helpful and efficient and we were supplied with one main meal which was fine We were also given a drink during the flight Havent used them for an internal flight but would be happy to use them again on an international flight

Transfer from international to domestic flight and back last week My flight from London arrived into Terminal D and transferred to Terminal B for the domestic departure Efficient experience overall clear signage but some long walking distances from arrival to the shuttle train Terminal B has a nice interesting design and plenty of seats with chargers Nice selection of lounges for cardholders Overall recommended

This was a day Southwest Gourmet Tour of Tasmania The same aircraft stayed with us the entire time It was a great size and seemed very efficient All staff were very friendly and professional We were most impressed
UIA is always a great experience in businessclass Great service onboard Very lovely crew The lounges in KBP and MUC are also very relaxing Looking forward to flying UIA again

Pulkovo new terminal is reasonably good and modern Easy to navigate both on arrival and departure Visa checks are very complex in Russia and Pulkovo stands up to the job with lots of passport check desks queue cleared in less than mins both ways Departures hall has restaurants cafes shops signage is good However the airport still has long way to go There are very few air bridges majority of planes sit on the tarmac and require shuttle bus to the terminal Connections to the city centre belong to previous decade you have to take bus that takes you to the metro then ride the metro for several stops Ending up having to take a taxi which has some risks in Russia if you arent familiar

The airport is new and clean however it is already overstretched For departures there are only a couple of snack bars and small shops in the departure area and for an international departure theres only one cafe Although your plane may be parked at a jetbridge you may not board from the jetbridge but rather have to go outside and use stairs Alternatively you may board at gate but then walk in the arrival corridor to the jetbridge at gate Check in and security were easy and fast At arrivals the tourist information office was closed There is no area for rental car return you will have to go in to the building to tell them you have returned Signage on the roads to the airport is not very good and it is tricky to reach the airport from any direction other than downtown There is construction at the airport entrance and perhaps that will address this issue The airport makes a good arrival spot for the Eje Cafetero Arriving with Easy Fly our bags arrived almost instantly

I was pleasantly surprised by Biarritz a small airport where everything seemed to work fine I was particularly impressed by the fact that the immigration officers on arrival and departure were smiling and courteous I wasnt expecting to see the negative reviews below but they are not too recent so maybe things have improved

Arrived from Hong Kong and flew out next day to Beijing A nice little tropical type airport compact and fact to be processed Clean reasonable facilities and nice staff A really easy entry into China and would like to visit Hainan for longer enxt time

The airport was shining new and clean with clear signs and directions both in Vietnamese and English The international departure was smooth though queuing time for immigration and security screening was a bit long due to the jam in the morning Not many dutyfree shopping compared to some other international airports in SEA Dining was expensive seemed the restaurant was trying to make money from tourists Boarding gate was good with a lot of seats Toilet was clean

This is a very pleasant airport especially compared to Schiphol Its efficient staff are friendly and the decor resembles a hotel lounge rather than the average airport look At peak times when a lot of leisure flights depart it can however get quite crowded As this airport is labelled as RotterdamThe Hague Airport there has to be a public transport link to The Hague This is inadequate consisting of a small shuttle bus connecting the terminal with the nearby metro station where you need to change Its all a bit of a hassle as the minibus is often too small for the number of passengers and baggage and runs infrequently outside rush hours The schedule should rather be adjusted to the arrival and departure times of flights Better still would be a direct public transport link to The Hague

My first experience with Malm Aviation flying from StockholmBromma to Malm Cheap fares friendly cabin crew comfortable aircraft free meal and coffee on that domestic flight Do you recognize SAS Youre right it isnt SAS It is Malm Aviation

Very comfortable business class Aneo and surprisingly spacious Food includes special ingredients creates premium touch Staff are professional smiles attitudes word choices Free wifi coupon easily redeemed day before flight Not many movie choices especially for children but good noise cancelling headphones

I am incredibly grateful for the staff at Chiang Mai airport I left my phone in my grab unable to get in touch with grab due to my phone being in my grab car and details being on the app on my phone so I immediately went to the staff in line She took me to the tourist police by exit number in the international departure hall They took details such as where I got the grab from my phone number the car colour i couldnt remember the license plate number In less than minutes they were able to get in touch with the car driver and I got my phone in the next minutes after that Thank you so much to the tourist police staff on shift at am on Jan I cant remember the other staffs name that brought me to the tourist police but i took a photo with her I wish them all the best and am so grateful for their willingness to help

The crew were extremely nice the flight was about hours and hours for the flight back to Hong Kong The flight was really smooth Props to the pilots The food was light and average The drinks were cool the in flight entertainment was out of service but pretty sure the airline is on a budget Warning that the ticket only includes kg of luggage to take on the plane and have to pay individually for luggage in cargo hold kg round trip more than HKD Seat was alright had decent recline trying to avoid flying with Hong Kong Airlines until maybe a few years later when they earn some money back Overall above average flight

Passenger assistance is the best we have experienced very polite helpful and well organised thank you very much airport clean good to see it as drinking water fountain also impressed free bottles of water on arrival on inbound flight
Easy and pleasant smaller airport It has all facilities required for a pleasant wait is spacious and never crowded No wait times at security and very friendly people
The airport is cool clean well ventilation and beautiful The navigation sign is clear help the customer easily navigate inside the airport The staff are considerate and thoughtful

Liked the airport of Edmonton Very efficient security and no big walking distances A nice bright design that make you feel comfortable Besides there are a lot of shopping and dining options here This Airport can be a role model how regional midsize airports should be
Lisbon to Salvador Bahia Flight plastic free The first one I have travelled with And they had Ipads to comfortable watch what we preferred The distance between the chairs was large

Short flight to Shiraz from Tehran Mahan Air already has a reputation of being an airline of choice for travelling within Iran for both safety and service and I could see why While the type of plane is old an A it was well maintained and clean The seating was very impressive definitely the widest and the most legroom I have had in a long time in both long and shorthaul flights For a hour flight I was surprised to be served a substantial cold meal Nonalcoholic beverages are served on the flight The service was courteous and efficient but not warm We landed minutes early The airfare was dirt cheap one way at last minute You cant book directly on their website with an international card but can certainly book through thirdparty sites but checkin is available online

Worst service I have ever seen in my entire life Had to wait for hrs at the carousel for my baggage to arrive Im told workers were slacking off and didnt see my bags until a senior officer had come to get the baggage moving Unfriendly staff who dont even wish to communicate with passengers unless you incorrectly use an aircrew term where they are most happy to correct you and then snigger about it and then once again act like youre nonexistent Well at least that informed me that they are not deaf but clearly ignoring me Porters in uniform are helpful and kindly directed me too Beware of Taxi drivers and ununiformed porters my baggage was forcibly snatched by one these to help me to the domestic flight departures

Flew from Prague to Rome Ciampino return with both flights spot on time noting that both legs were fully booked without any empty seats onboard No checked in baggage so headed straight to the gate The Ryanair mobile App is helpful apart from the nagging up selling but its understandable Its great boarding passes can be saved viewed in Google Wallet Boarding was managed well in PRG and CIA even with the full of passengers with Prague being strict on carry on luggage sizes as some fellow travellers were being a bit cheeky The cabin crew on my return flight were especially superb and professional with a smile Both legs were on a Boeing s I suspect there are no Max stationed in Prague One had an updated interior with slim seats and notably much more comfortable esp Legroom than the other although both were in top condition including cleanliness This product is ideal hassle free for quick flights around Europe

I flew Ariana Afghan Airlines from Kabul to Delhi Timing was good but very crowded while boarding The flight was enjoyable but no entertainment Good and enough food provided Very friendly and helpful staff on the flight The ticket was very reasonable price

We took a short flight from Vientiane to Luang Prabang and service at every touchpoint from checkin to arrival was delivered with smiles professionalism and efficiency A clean aircraft with ample leg room was another example of their star service If my experience was the standard that Lao Airlines delivers then this airline will surely go places Highly recommended

A postmodern airport with many good restaurants and very spacious and comfortable environment Inside the departure area you have an amazing view of the aircrafts The seats are very ergonomic and delightful All the airports areas are very clean and hygienic On the other hand there are not many signals explaining the directions for each of the airports areas and facilities

Super easy to navigate this tiny welcoming airport parking garage fees are reasonable car rental is close by drop off and pickup is efficient airport management does actually care facilities are clean food is sparse but there and it is secure Top notch tiny regional airport

Good experience flying Finnair Tallinn to London via Helsinki No need for security as transfer flight helpful staff everywhere and for big airport very spacious Loved MOOMIN COFFEE and no queue or questions at border control after I was interrogated at Riga Airport due to long stays on my British Passport Loved Finnair too would fly again from Helsinki with this airline
You are all so sweet and smiling I travel frequently and for the first time in my life I saw so many smiles and excellent service Well done Keep it up

Manston is a wonderful airport to fly out of I walked next to my bags as I left the aircraft and collected them withing two minutes The airports size means within another minute I was at the main entrance Departure is wonderful check in was quick despite there only being six desks Within the blink of an eye you are in the departure area Dont expect vast shopping areas or money eating distractions here though

Earlier I reviewed here the disastrous departure with AA from MIA and it seems only fair that I should write about the excellent arrival procedures at Santo Domingo airport On the short walk from the plane to the arrival booths there are some people randomly checking Covid documents At the booth you need to show by phone or paper your electronic E ticket and then it is a breeze When I arrived at the booth there were officers on duty and the line was very short The luggage was on the carousel within minutes of landing and an official will check your bag tag with that on your luggage Plenty of taxis but a bit pricey and a great start to arriving in the DR

Initially booked in Economy Class but when I was about to board agent took my boarding pass and voila got upgraded to Business One thing that stands out with Philippine Airlines is the hospitality and warmth of their crew both on ground and on board Food may not be at par with other big Asian carriers but for what they lack makes it up with their service One thing to consider as well is the ticket price being the most affordable Ill keep using PR as it is the most convenient affordable and with genuine service PRs exclusive Mabuhay Lounge at MNL T is one the best thing that happened with PR so far Keep it up

Luxor via Sharm to Manchester on A after Monarch refused to let me and my year old daughter board with Kiss Flights tickets There were of us stranded at Luxor and about more in Sharm so we only half filled the plane The crew was friendly professional and sympathetic to the fact we had been delayed for a further hours Whilst the plane was obviously quite new the seats were refurb in my opinion but we had plenty of leg room a very pleasant but simple dinner no alcohol on board but drinks free with our meal unlike Monarch who only give coffee free As soon as we had eaten and duty free had been up and down the lights were dimmed as it was very late Air Memphis may be budget domestic flights but their international flight for me and my companions on board I thinks was excellent

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

Corruption and extortion are alive and well at this airport Both myself and four colleagues in the following days were asked for our passports and then dollars to return them from officials at this airport It has been a while since this last happened to me in any country at any airport but this place stands out Who would want to visit this place for business or vacation Never again

I recently had the pleasure of flying with Pegasus and I must take a moment to commend Adnan the head cabin staff for his outstanding service Adnan is truly one of the best cabin staff I have encountered in a very long time From the moment we boarded his attentiveness and warm demeanor made a world of difference especially for my elderly parents and me Adnan was consistently polite and greeted us with a genuine smile which created a welcoming atmosphere on the flight His willingness to assist no matter how big or small the request was evident and greatly appreciated A particularly challenging situation arose during our flight when an incident of domestic violence occurred between a couple I was so impressed with how he handled the situation He remained calm and professional prioritizing the safety and comfort of all passengers His quick thinking and ability to diffuse the situation by separating the individuals without causing further disturbance to the rest of us showcased his exceptional skills in crisis management He is undoubtedly an asset to Pegasus Airlines His dedication to his role and the wellbeing of passengers is commendable

Much better now that they inaugurated the new pier More shops restaurants although some are overpriced and seats available Good staff and cleanlinessThe restrooms are very good and clean One problem is the distances between checkin and boarding

I have been travelling to the Gambia for six years now and have seen alot of changes at the airport over the years Security are very friendly people You can even sit out in the open and have a drink and a bite to eat and watch your plane land

DohaCasablancaGambia on th Jan QR could not issue Boarding Passes though having issued ticket Eventually I got BPs printed out quickly while boarding in Doha Embarked after being bussed around in Doha airport Aircraft was a newer Dreamliner B filled to last seat Was in the middle of a midsection in the back surrounded by passengers all over However the seats are spacious and can recline cm I felt comfortable and slept quite well Food was served on large trays and main course was very delicious spicy seafood with plenty of support like heavy salad desert cheese and chocolate I could choose my favourite meal despite being on of the last being served Got an extra portion on request On this hour night flight the two meal rounds were valued and sufficed Drinks plenty including Moroccan wines and beers Staff are Moroccan males are professional hardworking focused and pragmatic They may appear being blunt but on firm requests they act well They relocate seats up to last Minute and beyond to accommodate passengers wishes allowing couples and families to sit together Amenity kit hearsets pillows blankets provided to all IFA promised a lot with big screens and options However it was not working properly for approx half of the cabin it froze again and again or ran into endless loops In Casablanca RAM kept their announced promises of providing a smooth STPC hotel meals and transport for longhours transit passenger Passed immigration without hurdles I was put up in the fine star Zenith hotel and got two meals within a hours stay Back to airport accessed the RAMs Zenith Lounge which is spacious fine sufficient catering and tarmac views in two floors Upper floor has a manned bar while the lower have barista and meal catering Lively and exotic a surprisingly good lounge Morning flight Kiev Odessa a new clean Embraer It was a very pleasant flight with free candies and beverages served by smiling crew Departed on time and arrived early Check in in Kiev quick and easy The atmosphere and attitude quite relaxed and pleasant

This is a very pleasant airport especially compared to Schiphol Its efficient staff are friendly and the decor resembles a hotel lounge rather than the average airport look At peak times when a lot of leisure flights depart it can however get quite crowded As this airport is labelled as RotterdamThe Hague Airport there has to be a public transport link to The Hague This is inadequate consisting of a small shuttle bus connecting the terminal with the nearby metro station where you need to change Its all a bit of a hassle as the minibus is often too small for the number of passengers and baggage and runs infrequently outside rush hours The schedule should rather be adjusted to the arrival and departure times of flights Better still would be a direct public transport link to The Hague
A decidedly mediocre airport Winnipeg and Quebec City are similar in size but are far advanced in terms of services on offer design and overall experience What happened in Halifax Depressing and sad

Flew SZGZUR Wasnt expecting anything from an hour long flight in a small twinprop plane but this was an excellent flight Smooth takeoffs and landing Easy checkin and great assistance at the airport Flight left on time with no delays Crew is very courteous and they speak very good English When you think it cant get any better they served food Complimentary food is a rare thing on short domestic flights especially on twinprop planes Overall excellent airline and would recommend them

One of Brazils better airports although its design is stark and gloomy though airy Used aforementioned Conexio Aeroporto bus service to get there punctual fast and good quality Food wise all the usual airport restaurants are here but on the third floor to the left is a real find if you want real food and youre on a budget the Restaurante Social looks like a university canteen but serves palatable food at nonairport prices

Great little airport incredibly close in to the city centre minutes by metro from the Domestic Terminal to the central station and the international terminal is spacious with comfortable seating by the gates and good value shopping The only downside is the tedious minute bus transfer to get there from the Domestic Terminal
A great small and friendly airport with views to die for All flights seem to come and go on time with no issues Good choice of shops and eateries plenty of seating great views and friendly staff

This airport is very nice clean and efficient The staff at the airport are also very kind and welcoming I remember I was a little late to my flight and only had around half an hour to the flight from the checkin area They really got me in and out very fast and I had around minutes to spare Very thankful for that

It is a mediumsize International airport located in the city easy to arrive Served with all the big airlines companies in Brazil and also Surinam Airways TAP Portugal and flights to Miami and Fort Lauderdale by LATAM and AZUL The terminal is clean and offers lots of options for shopping and food The departure lounge could be bigger Sometimes it is filled of people and the seats are not enough The staff are good and prepared

Noticed some improvements from last visit about years ago Basically it is the same structure but only interior is much fresher I noticed some new shops inside and outside Inside the arrival hall there is a traditional Javanese music band playing live music with traditional Javanese instruments It is quite a welcoming nice charm There is dedicated taxi stand outside the domestic arrival hall Get a voucher and walk to the taxi pier It is quite organized
No one checked our vaccination upon entry which raises alarm bells Jetstar staff as usual are incredibly rude and money grabbing The facilities are cute and basic

Tiny But stunning location Barra Aiport sits on the edge of a wide beach on the Scottish Island of Barra Twice a day once in winter flights from Glasgow and Benbencula land on one of the three runways But these are no ordinary tarmac runways These are marked out on the sand of the beach and only when the tide is out The flights are the only British Airways flights where the timetable is marked subject to tide The terminal a proper little toytown terminal complete with tiny terminal control tower big burly firemen and one checkin desk No compromise though on safety checks and procedures Be sure to be here in good time to watch the incoming Twin Otter fly in and land on the beach The tiny cafe sells lovely home made organic snacks and the whole experiences is a joy if you have only been used to the hustle and bustle and chaos of some large well known international terminals If a glorious sunny day checkin good and early and take time to stroll three hundred yards up over the dunes to see the other stunning beach close to this amazing little airport

Flew NIKI from Valencia to Vienna Quick boarding and ontime departure Cabin was clean and the flight was smooth and relaxed Cabin crew provided drinks and a very good cheese sandwich Later they provided us another round of water and coffee Seats a little bit narrower than other airlines Paid for a return ticket for flying with a very good airline

One of the better airport experiences in recent times This may be due to this airport not being the big hub type with all its unpleasant experiences that come with it But from curb to boarding everything went smoothly Friendly bar tenders checkin agents emigration officer and security staff A pleasant surprise The building appeared very well designed For urban explorers theres the old brutalism style icon of soviet times next door to explore from outside Only downside is the air conditioning in the air side waiting area too windy and cold

vIve flown with Spirit several times and also contacted their customer service center in the past to cancel a flight Spirit can vary wildly in terms of cancellations delays timeliness and staff attitudes If using a ratio two experiences to every one have been overwhelming positive But the remaining one experience has royally sucked Still I take my chances with Spirit because theyve come to treat me more respectfully as a customer than most other US carriers pound for pound It helps that I understand the concept of ultrabudget airlines having flown them around the world and that I treat airline staff with courtesy and politeness This most recent trip from Orlando to Louisville was mostly positive friendly airline staff on ground and friendly though not particularly attentive in air they only came down the aisle once to collect trash Checkin online was easy though it helped that I wasnt checking a bag The flight took off and arrived early The immediate seat was clean enough but the seat back pocket and tray table were a bit nasty They tout their WiFi as being the fastest of any US airline though I havent tried it But I did manage to use their unpaid WiFi connection to track the flight route to Louisville on my phone so that was cool In all Spirit as great as long as you keep a good attitude and dont have any real expectations Thats the point of budget airlines right And just hope you dont get delayed by eight hours as I did once with Spirit years ago

No complaints about this airline on our flight from Siem Reap to Phnom Pehn in July No queue at checkin comfortable seats with plenty of leg room The A is old but very comfortable and clean Cabin crew and checkin staff very friendly and professional The flight departed early and was in the air for about minutes and they still managed to serve refreshments during the flight Excellent value as well with the tickets for both of us about the same as travelling by bus Would recommend Bassaka very highly and I hope they grow and prosper in the future

It looks like a white elephant but what an elegant one Corpus Christi appears to handle only connecting flights to Dallas and Houston thats the international bit with just three airlines operating there It is light bright airy and wonderfully free of the normal hustle and bustle of a modern airport Checking in took three minutes passport control and security about the same they have new full body scanner Each airline has its own gate complete with airbridge to connect even to small planes

RGNMDL on ATR We were a bit sceptical when our travel agency booked on Air Yangon because we couldnt find much about this airline in Skytrax The plane left twenty minutes earlier than in our tickets stated so do reconfirm the day before No hassle with luggage and weight security checks as in the whole country very relaxed but efficient Comfortable seating on this short trip little snack for those who are extremely hungry Friendly staff clean plane and very pleasant flight We felt safe and would fly with them again

Sydney to Tianjin via Zhengzhou My wife and I could not have been happier with the flight service food and entertainment options provided Staff were great and went out of their way to help other guests We read a lot of reviews prior to our trip and can honestly say we did not experience negative factor Great choices on meals and entertainment pillows and blankets surprising amount of legroom in economy We are going back to China soon and dont see any reason to travel with another airline Great pricing and options for further exploration in China add to the airlines appeal

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap with Bassaka Air and I found this airline to be brilliant in all aspects Their prices are phenomenal and I couldnt complain about anything Check in was super fast and done with a smile The plane is a little outdated but its still new and growing The flight itself was mins and for such a short flight you even got a complimentary drink

China Eastern Airlines customer service has been improved dramatically since before the pandemic of COVID In economy class I feel well treated by cabin crew and everyone was so kind and well motivated I have ordered the vegetarian meal and I was not enjoyed the the cabin crew brought me nice food to replace Especially flight MU compared to MU I flew with this month the cabin crew did really fantastic job The only thing I was a bit disappointed is there is very limited option of inflight entertainment especially in A which was MU flight But overall both two aircrafts had fantastic leg space for a cm tall guy

I prefer using this airport over almost any other in Texas major cities but in true American airport form there are advantages and drawbacks to using San Antonio SAT Here are the pros Access from either I or US is pretty easy considering that interchange is one of the busiest in the city Access to the very busy touristic downtown is relatively easy as the airport isnt far away by rideshare Parking is easy access from the parking garages to the terminal is easy signage leading to and within the airport is pretty easy to follow Delta checkin was quick and friendly Gate agents were professional and helpful Staff in the stores generally seemed friendly The terminal is mostly clean the presecurity checkin area is very spacious and modern Using CLEAR and PreCheck I breezed through security However here are the drawbacks Security TSA had an officious dour attitude that Id expect much more in Houston Miami LAX or NYC not San Antonio Dont know what that was about The restrooms were filthy Seating throughout the terminal was not at all ample for the crowds of people waiting to fly out the airport desperately needs expansion and that includes more seating and general modernization postsecurity Upon return baggage claim was remarkably slow for a small airport albeit a small airport serving a large metropolitan area So pound for pound SAT is an overall good option and Id still rather use them than anything in Houston or Austin but there is still room for improvement

International arrivals at St Petersburg airport are at the newer terminal which is spacious but simply decorated probably below the standard of a modern airport but international flights are not too frequent and it is never congested On your first arrival you may feel uneasy but it is smooth if you know your way To book a taxi it is good to book inside with taxi stands which charges a reasonable standard fare of under ruples to town and if you do not have the currency you may even charge your fare on a credit card The train is not recommended as it terminates far from town To go to the airport book a taxi but specify the use of a metered city taxi or you pay double if not specified hotels will book you a nonmetered taxi and if so agree on a fare first The airport is inadequate in facilities such as shopping and food outlets but is not bad

I have used Monastir Airport now for years and whilst the queues at immigration can be slow at times I think the other facilities and friendly staff more than make up for this Transport links are excellent if you are an independent traveller

PM on a Monday night no restaurants open other than fast food No beerwinecocktails available in the whole airport even outside of security I just busted my butt working for four days at my elderly parents yard and flying home sore but happy to have spent time with them Four days of hard labor vacation and I cant relax with a beer and a burger

Colombo International airport is a joke Never had such a horrific experience as a tourist on an international flight This airport is notorious for ripping you off and charging unconventional baggage fees for carrying a personal item such as a purse or even food They weighed our food and charged me over for my purse and food They even wanted to wear my jacket that I was wearing I do not recommend this airport and they are notorious for treating tourist like this as I was advised when I landed in the Maldives Sri Lanka in general is a phenomenal country with amazing people

This is a pretty nice small airport where you can find anything you would expect from it There are flaws like anywhere else They definitely need more staff which is obvious The offering of time killers are updated with new shopping places but still have to work on it My main issue was the parking which was pretty expensive so I had to search around for other solutions since the parking at the airport ended up more expensive than my Wizz Air ticket I use Google and found a private parking spaces but you can also look for others I suggest this one definitely Overall it is a decent airport that keeps on upgrading every year I visit it

This was the first time I flown with Vanilla Air parent airline is ANA They have a different terminal for low cost airlines Terminal at Narita Airport for LCCs and also at Okinawa Check in was smooth for both flights I had no expectations whatsoever The inflight service was basic and for and hour flight is just fine Seats were comfortable and the cabin crew was nice This is a low cost carrier and I will recommend it and I will be flying again Within Japan is it rather difficult to get a bad service

Hiroshimas airport is somewhat small but is intelligently laid out and easy to navigate Perhaps because of its relative newness it appears to be quite pristine inside with a good range of services for travellers The biggest drawback is the distance from Hiroshima city well over a half hour outside of the city As another reviewer noted the IBEX flight requires walking out onto the tarmac which could be a hassle in inclement weather

Great attentive and warm service at the check in in Paris Orly airport The agent even walked us to the special conveyor belt for extra large luggage Pleasant experience in the lounge enjoying breakfast with a view on the tarmac We boarded well ahead of time and as there are only seats that goes smoothly and without hassle A welcome drink was offered before take off and diner was served in two courses about hours later Before we landed a light meal quiche or sweet quality treat was served The stable WiFi connection allowed to work during the flight Seats are a classic business class seat which can be turned into a full flat bad Overall considering the service and the price I can really recommend La Compagnie

Friedrichshafen Hamburg It was one of my best experiences on a regional flightairline Aircraft was clean The crew CheckIn to cabin crew was very polite as well as highly professional Flight attendant made clearly understandable announcementssafety demos The only downside is that Intersky asks passengers to pay prohibitive expensive prices for onboard drinkssnacks But since they consider themselves as a low cost airline truly providing LCC price level it was no surprise and everybody is free not to buy anything
One of the best choices in Brazil The airport is very modern pretty and clean it can be considered an architecture beauty Way better than So Paulo and Rio

We had a great flight with French Bee from Paris back to NYC We booked late for our first ever Europe trip so we didnt want to buy expensive tickets We took a risk going with French Bee since its cheap about one way We were nervous seeing all the bad reviews especially with cancellations Turned out to be an awesome experience on time good foods no turbulence

A very friendly team of airport workers overall Southern hospitality goes a long way Would like to see more dining options and shops that are not all identical in product choices Overall a very good experience Would definitely fly to Memphis again without hesitation

At Brussels airport the check in service was smooth they even accepted my luggage although it was kg overweight The boarding was quick due to the small plane The trip was around hours I prefer bigger airplanes for longer flights as these smaller planes tend to rock a bit more and the legroom isnt the best either The flight attendants were polite and nice The landing at Tallinn was smooth managed to clear customs very easily

Nice airport but needs modification I have been travelling through this Airport for some time and it is not the best but it is being upgraded and work is going on right now so hopefully it will be a very nice and beautiful Air port with a lot of new facilities Airport need better management in dealing with multiple flights and improving the cleanliness

I fly to LGB twice a year or more to visit family I really cannot say enough good things about this airport especially after the remodel a couple of years ago The place is beautiful It is well laid out it is small and so very easy to deal with I fly Jet Blue and it is almost always on time The restaurants in that terminal are quality and very reasonably priced This was one of the first airports to provide unlimited free wifi I love that you can board and leave the plane from both the front and rear It is so quick If you have to fly to So Cal this is the place to fly too

Very nice very small domestic regional airport I arrived from IAH Houston on a tiny little Saab and I collected my luggage and was outside in about minutes I also departed there for IAH with eventual connection to LHR and was surprised by the very welcoming attitude of the Continental staff The security staff seemed less happy to be working but I was through in under minutes Its a nice little airport with a nice little cafe and a few static displays to look at Its also used by USAF so its common whilst waiting for your flight to see an FA land or depart
Flight was on time food provided is very good and warm They did provide us window seat while boarding Its good idea to try Nepal Airlines for onward journey if you are traveling fromto Nepal

Wenzhou Airport is for me one of best airports in China The New terminal is very big and very beautiful the checkin security check and boarding is fast and easy At this airport they start the automatic checkin and it is fantastic and very simple The airport staff are kind and happy to serve you

If you like large airports with lots of shops restaurants and people then Sanford is not the sort of airport you would appreciate However if you prefer a small regional type airport that you can pass through quickly both in and out without stress then I strongly recommend Sanford We now look at TUI flight options first simply because they use this airport The staff are friendly including immigration and security and yet its only about miles north of Orlando and roughly a minute drive to the Disney resorts We havent been here since but I can confirm from the time we started queuing for immigration to collecting baggage was only minutes Compare this to Orlando International where you would probably be held in a holding area due to congestion

Recently flew throughout Myanmar on the following routes YangonMandalayHehoMandalayNyaung U BaganHehoThandweYangon on their Fokker and ATR aircraft Checkin interesting as there are no computers and everything is weighed manually Ground crew cordial but not overly friendly Flight crews were friendly and always helpful Catering is good for the short flights with croissants and drinks being offered on even the shortest of flights unthinkable in Europe Aircrafts were always spotless and comfortable

The flight was about one hour and yet the flight attendants managed to hand out refresher towels then they gave each passenger a snack box and on the the third service round each passenger was given a drink All this was done unhurried with poise and a smile Such an unexpected level of star service In addition boarding was ontime flight departed and arrived on time What a great airline
The service is good as a budget airline Cabin crew is helpful I did not encounter any bad issue along my flight I will recomment this airline if oyur having a tight budget The fares are reasonable
Airline staff helped me with last minute web check in cancellation also helped locating the luggage and provided the best support and service for such hospitality and customer delight
We flew from Toronto to Paris Flight attendants were very helpful and welcoming We especially appreciated Emersons help He was great Ground crew were great too

Positive departure experience at Seville airport on Oct for a domestic flight After reading previous reviews I was wary of flying out of this airport but our experience was perfectly good Before the security checkpoint we found a pleasant caf for lunch Going through security was quick and easy Restrooms were clean and a cleaning person was busy at work keeping them so A push button rating system for the condition of the restroom was outside the door so perhaps Aena has received the message from prior reviews and is trying to do better No complaints at all about this airport

This is the major airport for southwest China Flew into Chengdu from Shenzhen where it was quite a lengthy walk from the Terminal gate to baggage claim This was topped off with a further lengthy walk to the opposite end of the terminal for the taxi rank Flying out a week later I had time to look at the airport more closely Terminal is old and definitely looking its age Terminal was shiny and modern with three fingers that extend out Plenty of interesting shops to keep myself amused inside the terminal and the lounges were adequately comfortable The feeling was light and airy inside with a good view to the outside despite the extra glass screen separating arriving passengers from departing ones

Harrisburg MDT is a great airport Small but connected to many international gateways Security lines are short Food options are limited but good I only wish they offered a NYC area connection My airport of choice

The wheelchair attendant verified everything for me Verified with me verified with the LYFT driver by asking his name verify the LYFT ride by licenses plate verified I felt ok and I knew where I was going For me its humiliating to be pushed in a wheelchair I never felt humiliation this time I truly felt cared for This trip wasnt the greatest vacay Ive had but when I got home I felt great I want to thank this positive smart caring young man Some ppl have a gift a few share it in this way If your lucky enough to meet this young man at DFW Airport youll know its him Im talking about here

MSL continues to be a good alternative to larger nearby airports Flew to see family in Late Nov and Early Dec of NWA continues to have flights a day to its Memphis Hub As with my previous experiences traveling through MSL the NWA and Airport Staff did a great job in taking care of their passengers Again a job well done by the MSL Airport and Airline Staff Also the New Marriot Hotel and Spa has opened the Robert Trent Jones Golf Course is also open for the avid golfer both of which are just minutes from the airport My round trip flights were flawless and running at or ahead of schedule outbound and inbound from the North West Alabama Airport

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

A good airport to fly in and out of Lines are not long and staff are friendly While it is outside of the city there is OC Transpo service via busways directly to downtown The only down side is that there arent many food options past security

While my arrival at Brunei Airport initially presented a frustrating situation due to a lack of prior communication about the INRS portal requirement the exceptional assistance I received from one of the staff members Mr Asnawi turned things around Despite my frustration he remained calm professional and incredibly supportive His patience and understanding helped deescalate the situation and his dedication to assisting me ensured I could resolve the issue without further stress It is rare to encounter such exceptional service and he truly went above and beyond to make a difficult experience manageable I commend Royal Brunei Airlines for having such exemplary staff who prioritize passenger wellbeing and customer satisfaction This experience reinforced my confidence in the airline and I would not hesitate to fly with Royal Brunei Airlines again

This airport was very wellrun when me and my family were here We were going to Punta Cana for a family vacation through jetBlue We were able to get through security smoothly and the customs and shuttles were fast The food court provided a wide variety of foods for me and my family to choose from and everything was very modern The bathrooms were clean enough for usage The only con about this airport was the lack of the jet bridge It didnt help that it was raining upon our leaving Punta Cana We experienced torrential downpour and had to quickly get onboard and we were drenched by the time we were on the plane But there were also many good things about this airport and I would not mind visiting it again

Check in and immigration fine Nice breakfast in London Cafe Smooth boarding for Windhoek from A Return Cape Town to Addis Arrival At Bole smooth and quick no que at visa on arrival Luggage fine Out quickly

Rode Intersky from SalzburgZurich As it was a short flight I wasnt expecting much I expected wrong Usually airlines with a fleet this small or flights this short wouldnt have as a excellent service as this airline Outstanding selection of drinks and more than two selections of free snacks The flight attendants were kind and the takeoff and landing were smooth as if the plane were a jet and not a prop Would definitely fly them again

Smooth arrival domestic in the new airport It is the only airport that I have arrived at that there is actually free onwards buses to most of the tourist resorts north of the airport about every five minutes I did not know about this free service but if passengers have lots of luggage they need to be mindful that it could be a long haul from the bus stop in their resort to their actual hotel I took a taxi from one of the three or four tax agencies outside arrivals they were actually half the price of taxihailing apps There were some nice airy restaurants in the arrival area and presumably these are available to departing passengers Five stars from me
Professional courteous security Definitely a credit to the management and the leadership team Well done Definitely recommend the team for their professional approach and execution of their duties

Though it is small it is one of the best efficient and beautifully designed international airports in the Philippines Been using it when I am visiting for business and leisure and Im not disappointed everytime I used this airport I do hope the government will expand this soon

Kaimana to Manokwari Plane left and arrived minutes late really on time in this part of the world The check in staff were very flexible about cabin luggage size On board seats were reasonably comfortable and crew pleasant

On our departure from Simferopol to Moscow we were very pleased with friendly and efficient service at the checkin and the information desks But upstairs in the waiting area we were struck by absolutely different attitude The attempt to have some drinks before boarding finished with success only at the third cafe Its name somehow Happy potatoes Sorry not very sure But I am absolutely sure about the names of the cafes where we were met with rudeness and unhelpful attitude The names of those cafes are Skybar and We were flying on the st of July Such a shame to be let down by such a beautiful airport

I fly into Rimini Airport at least times a year to visit family It is a small airport and the restaurant and shops are expensive I love this airport You cant get lost and the best bit is you can go outside on a very large balcony and watch the planes land take off etc Also great if you smoke You are allowed to smoke only outside I would recommend this airport it is still small and friendly

Boarding on TLV was done on time but delayed to get permission to depart A was in a good condition and clean Stewardesses were professional and friendly Inflight service was beverages coffee water sandwich and granola bar On the return flight there was a minutes later departure schedule change they informed us with email days in advance

One nice feature of Maputo Airport is that it has one of the few remaining exterior viewing terraces so you can stand outside and take in arrivals and departures A worse airport on arrival than on departure with the slow waiting around for visas on arrival be sure to have exact change if you can and the relatively slow delivery of baggage which may or may not have items missing or delayed if your transit was via JNB

Anchorage airport north terminal is clean and spacious with very fast and efficient checkin and security There are lots of interesting things to look at in the airport Plenty of eating options and shopping Clean bathrooms and good WiFi No complaints at all

A small airport serving only main highlight in the Red Centre of Australia the tourist attraction of Uluru and Kata Tjuta I arrived by domestic service I understood some international flights do use this airport so customs were negligible The airport is built on the edge of the desert and is surrounded by picturesque desert panorama Being tourist orientated all sorts of tourist services were available immediately upon retrieval of baggage A free tourist bus is available for pick up for everyone staying at the huge monopoly of Ayers Rock Resort about minutes away from the airport which unless you are a local thats where you will be

This small airport was a model of efficiency clean cool organised with a friendly restaurant serving Indian and Western food The Kingfisher Airlines ground crew were excellent The short walk to the plane will sadly end when a shiny new terminal is soon completed

HELLPA return with A Booked flights months earlier and reservation for exit seats for extra charge from their call center was kept at check in Generous legroom Friendly attentive crew flight deck announcements and clean aircraft made hrs flight more enjoyable for a leisure flight Also our pre booked Holiday Meal on outbound flight was surprisingly tasty and hot and portions were more filling than we have had for this route with other carriers Only minus was inbound flight meal which was bit tasteless perhaps due to LPA catering Drinks for purchase but all in all flight with them DK offered more holiday feeling than our national carriers charter flight offers Baggage came fast at LPA but in HEL it took more than min due to ground handling problems

I have been to many many airports all over the world and Little Rock is one of my favorites It is small but modern and clean There are never long lines and the personnel are always helpful and friendly After being away from home for months I always look forward to the simplicity and comfort of LR airport I like that baggage claim is after you meet up with the people waiting to get you as well

Over minutes to get through passport control Travelers and staff looking cold and tired as midnight passes flights luggage all coming onto carousel others silent and still It was an opportunity to shine and it wasnt taken even a hot drink would have made it more bearable No explanation for delays given by any staff

Comfortable and clean provincial airport Didnt use any facilities other than the toilets which were clean and tidy Only real criticism is lack of seats at the gates I was on a full A flight to Brisbane and there were only seats for about passengers There is also no segregation of incoming and outgoing passengers the former have to weave their way through those people waiting to board Passengers seated in the rear half of the cabin were requested to go down stairs across the tarmac then up stairs to the rear door of the aircraft However by the time I reached the front of the queue the outside doors had been locked so I had to fight my way through the whole length of the aircraft cabin

Vnukovo Airport Waiting for baggage almost hour now and havent get it yet No extra infornation from airport officials In combination with absence of smoking rooms everything becomes socalled great Ill consider another airport the next time Though ceiling is ok

The new Terminal at Birsa Munda Airport Ranchi is a welcome surprise for many Its a small but modern terminal with a few amenities that are actually not needed as the wait times are low due to low traffic You will find seats on both floors and few coffee shops to make your wait easier The airside is separated by tall glass panels and one can be entertained by watching the arriving departing planes Disembarkment and Boarding is done via the modern aerobridges that are truly of international standards Since it is a small airport the security checks and checkin process is very informal and the staff are courteous and helpful I always have pleasant experience in this small modern airport I wish there were more flights

Wattay International Airport is small and friendly easy to access from Vientiane and nevertheless very easy to get around The staff are friendly and quick and this includes the Immigration officers and just about every person who you come in contact with while you are there The facilities are in perfect accordance with the size of this airport you wont find any gourmet restaurant here but there is a little bit of everything including a very nice dutyfree shop This is a very comfortable arrival and departure airport as laidback and relaxed as Laos itself Arrived midNovember departed midDecember

Having used Tijuana many times in the past I was surprised while using it recently after a year break The renovations are still under way but it is a clean modern and efficient airport that works well The queues are generally quick and the staff know what theyre doing With some great connections to mainland Mexico and a couple of new discount airlines using the airport it is a great alternative to SAN Only annoying bit is the lack of any decent food and beverage once youre through security Over priced and average The upside is you can check in for most flights in Mexico up to minutes before take off so basically you can just walk through security and to the gate
I am not sure when you went to the airport in maracaibo but things have change a lot Prices are not as bad and there is lots of choices to eat and drink very reasonable
Detroit Metro is always clean convenient and well maintained Staff is usually pleasant and helpful We travel through DTW about times per year and we have always had a positive experience

Yangon International Airport has Terminals and for International Flights and for Domestic Flights This is the review for Terminal Domestic This Terminal is a new build and many upgraded from the old terminal The airport is very clean and you can find the checkin counter very easily After checkin the nd floor is for departure and the rd floor is for lounges The departure hall is very large and can buy goods and many restaurants which already open early morning am The gates numbers are easily to find

I departed on th April and was lucky to make my flight I was part of a tour group and as there were many groups trying to leave at the same time and not enough check in staff to process the travelers I made my flight with minutes to spare

Be Aware Arrival at the airport was okay the immigration line was long but it moved pretty quickly The airport was clean and looks pretty new Our main problem with this airport is the departure security check point where you have to apparently place all liquids below the authorised limit in ziplock bags Nowhere in the airport is there a sign saying that all liquids must be in clear plastic bags The check in agent said nothing nothing from the airline and did I say no signs We got to security and were told to throw away our items or pay US per ziplock bag If that didnt feel like an organised racket then I dont know what else qualifies This type of action is dishonest in every respect but at that point we had no choice Weve travelled through London Luton and they have the same plastic bag policy but not only are signs of it everywhere they provide the bags This felt like a shady scheme and we quite honestly will try to avoid this airport in future PS Duty free alcohol was cheaper in out home country as well

Kuala Lumpur to Kuching return on Feb Overall vey satisfied with the experience An exceptional service by the friendly cabin crew The airline offers an exceptional value for money The economy class cabin very clean and features new seats and wifi entertainment using own device The food is good for a domestic flight In both sectors boarding by groups and strictly follow The ground staff is good but can be better For one and half hour flight am not complaining

Flights to Kefalonia from Athens Arrival smooth with reasonably quick bag delivery Departure less good I felt sorry for the people stuck in a long queue waiting to check in for their charter flight Olympic Air was fairly speedy Terminal facilities are basic at best One shopcafe before security The toilet facilities are dire Very poor signage in the airport domestic departure lane was closed with no instructions to join the long international queue and no gate information once through security However as there are only gates the guess was easy Such a shame that Greek islands have such poor airports for really wonderful places

I recently traveled through Johannesburg International Airport and was thoroughly impressed by the exceptional service and overall experience The airport staff were incredibly helpful and friendly making the whole journey smooth and stressfree The facilities were clean wellmaintained and easy to navigate enhancing the overall travel experience From efficient checkin processes to a wide range of dining and shopping options Johannesburg International Airport truly excels in providing a topnotch travel experience I highly recommend this airport for its great service and overall pleasant atmosphere

I recently flew with China Southern Airlines from Gatwick Airport to Changchun Airport via Zhengzhou to visit my family in China As I bordered the Boeing I was greeted with kind flight attendants who directed me to my seat On my seat was a pillow a thin blanket and headphones for the inflight entertainment We departed on time around in the evening UK time There was meals served and many drinks services with a variety of drinks ranging from fruit juices alcohols beer fizzy drinks and waters The meals were served on trays made up of a warm main dish with a side dish such as vegies and a desert Overall the food was tasty and plentiful There was a wide variety of movies which included Chinese and Western movies in many languages there was also fun mini games and an inflight map showing the progress of our flight I would say my flight to Zhengzhou took around and a half hours The seats were reclinable and padded well In my opinion it was quite comfy and I fell asleep quickly after watching a movie The cushion was soft and surprisingly the blanket offered a good amount of warmth The bathrooms and seats were all cleaned and maintained well and overall the flight was relaxed and peaceful My only complaint is that the cabin was a bit warn out and old with some pieces of fabric missing from the front bit of my seat This did not serve as an issue to me it was only aesthetically unpleasing Another suggestion from me is to offer an amenity kit as the flight was long haul Overall I had an amazing experience with friendly staff delicious meals and extreme comfort and good entertainment that kept me busy
Family trip from Montral to Edmonton Boeing Canadian North is a nice airline Food great No inflight Entertainment Beverages and Cabin Service nice It was a calm nonturbulent flight

From Gothenburg Sweden to Stockholm Sweden and back the same day A min flight Id developed a fear of flying from avoiding flying for years Before boarding I talked to the staff about this and they were very nice Very nice and considerate Perfect takeoffs and landings My advice for those in a similar situation would be tell the staff Dont rush be in plenty of time and tell the staff I had a very pleasant flight they served coffee tea or water with a small brownie Hot miniature towels afterwards Very attentive and polite Highly recommended

Ive lived in El Paso for two years now for school and I often use the airport to visit my hometown as well as other destinations The busiest Ive ever seen the airport from the time of walking through the doors checking baggage going through security and getting to my gate was about minutes Christmas vacation time Ive even got through in minutes Its a smaller airport with only one terminal thats ever used and about gates so from security to walk to your gate takes maybe minutes This isnt one of the airports youll need to devote hours in order to get through it Id say hour is fine because you never know even if it does only take minutes to get to your gate and maybe during busy holiday times or if youre going to have to check the whole family might even be hours for that

Jeju to Seoul The online website to purchase tickets was easy to use as a foreigner There was an English option unlike Tway air The checkin boarding process was very efficient The plane was spacious and the seats comfortable for a budget airline I would fly with them again

PER to MRU Efficient check in at Perth Airport Air Mauritius provides access to the Aspire Lounge at Perth which is actually a very good albeit open access lounge Aircraft was delayed due to delayed connecting passengers Boarding was around minutes late Aircraft quite modern clean and well presented Good amenity kits Welcome drinks served Business class seat is a standard lie flat but works well On the shorter routes like this they dont provide a mattress topper Lunch and drinks served after take off Food was good smoked salmon starter and lamb main Reasonably selection of IFE Staff responded quickly to any calls I managed a few hours sleep Afternoon tea served prior to arrival For an hours and minute flight the offering was a little limited and not presented with much flair Arrival was delayed and though off aircraft quickly immigration was slow Luggage waiting for us when we had cleared immigration My feeling is this represents a solid mid range business product

I feared for the crush that is too common at any Indian queuing point but neednt have For an early morning flight the only short delay was getting in to the terminal like all Indian airport terminals you have to show your flight documents After that checkin immigration security all wellmanaged and smooth at least no problems for me

Eilat to Tel Aviv The plane arrived minutes late but that was ok The boarding was quick and nice The cabin crew was good nice and helpful minutes on the flight and we got some snacks I love Israirs snacks Of course you could get some water with it The landing was pretty shaky

We took a TAME flight to Baltra Galpagos Checkin was very easy with very short queues and very clear instructions given how to get to your gate For the Galpagos Islands you are required to go through a host of quarantine checks and you are required to pay US per person to receive a certificate Without such a certicate you will be unable to board nor will you be allowed past the passport control at Baltra The airport terminal is very organised and gates are well spaced Great airport Also when arriving in Baltra you are required to pay an additional entry fee of US

Living and working in South Africa I fly home to Zimbabwe fairly often and try to be patriotic and use the national airline I have only been delayed once in the past year Food is good and service also of acceptable standards Ggetting through to the Joburg offices is another story altogether overall I think Air ZIm are doing the best they can with the resources at their disposal

Singapore to Yangon I didnt know what to expect when I booked this flight but I dont regret The airplane was clean staff was friendly and food was good Also a lot of space for the legs good entertainment and opportunity to charge phonetablet In the EmiratesGaruda league in my opinion
