Flew with AIRDO a low cost airlines owned by ANA from Tokyo Haneda to Hakodate Flight was on time and full of passengers who were en route to observe the cherry blossoms in Hakodate Cabin crew was really professional friendly and attentive Legroom was good seat was comfy cabin was clean Soft drinks water apple juice tea orange juice coffee was served to all passengers even it was a low cost airlines Both of take off and landing were smooth

TripVerified Smooth Check In cooperative staff at Beijing Daxing International airport on time boarding very friendly in flight crew and wonderful on board services Very nice in flight meal I had ordered vegetarian lacto OVO meal I was confirmed with a type western vegetarian meal and was served a meal with tag AVML However whatever I got to eat was served hot tasty and was tasty I was given a blanket to use for the mid night flight The in flight entertainment was not of my taste though I used the flight information and enjoyed it The cabin was clean and everything else was good Good experience

Nice clean and efficient regional airport which I have used regularly over the years Never had queues at checkin Living in the Eastern part of Holland FMO the official abbreviation of MnsterOsnabrck is a good alternative for me to Amsterdam Provided that is you have a car public transport connections to the airport are not simple and not fast and you find a good and not too expensive flightespecially flights with connections in major hubs Frankfurt or Munich can be rather expensive

Flew Phnom Penh to Siem Reap with Bassaka Air As I knew nothing about this airline I was a bit apprehensive but there was no need to be Checkin was fast and friendly Boarding was by bus and once on board the courteous cabin crew made us feel very welcome The plane was definitely old but very clean and our exit row seats had plenty of legroom Other seats looked a bit cramped but the flight was short Surprisingly a quick drink was served during the minute flight which operated minutes early Overall a pleasant experience The only negative was that the Fasten Seat Belt signs in the cabin were not working

Arrival was a very good experience as the new airport layout is a great improvement Departure was problematic I have always used Brussels Airlines which allows you to check in a dedicated facility in the city This time I was with Kenya Airlines and the check in process was chaotic with only one small kiosk and many people with no idea of a queue trying to check in Once through into the departure lounge things improved greatly and the business class lounge was a revelation comfortable air conditioned and well appointed

Like Bermuda itself this airport is a thoroughly civilized experience not very busy so not crowded with a rather predictable traffic pattern of arrivals and departures Facilities are very adequate and the dutyfree shop has a reasonable variety albeit a bit expensive On entry customs officials are polite and welcoming When checking in for our departing flight the official who had to pat me down for a followup security check the machine beeped when I went through apologized for having to do so and thanked me for accommodating the security process All in all a refreshingly unique experience one that is alas vanishing amid the alltoocommon post overzealous and ironically ineffective security measures elsewhere Bravo to Bermuda and its airport
Sorong to Jayapura Flight left almost on time Aircraft clean and comfortable with friendly crew and many empty seats at the back Inflight meal only a cup of water and a little breadroll
Lisbon to Salvador Bahia Flight plastic free The first one I have travelled with And they had Ipads to comfortable watch what we preferred The distance between the chairs was large
A great small and friendly airport with views to die for All flights seem to come and go on time with no issues Good choice of shops and eateries plenty of seating great views and friendly staff

The airport has a nice design but it is not well maintained and you always feel its aging fast The waiting time to reach immigration might take more than an hour in summer while bags might take on average minutes in nonpeak times Duty free is good and the RJ lounge is very good with plenty of options Toilet and hygiene facilities dont have consistent standard

On the th of March I was flying back to Bangkok from Tokyo At the end of an hour flight with N masks I was exhausted and didnt do the usual always look back the trolley search that I normally would I didnt realize it until I was getting ready the next morning that I have lost my expensive skincare that I bought for mom as a gift Brand new and properly packed in the duty free bag I panicked and thought there was no hope that I would find the goods I called the airport just to try our luck The airport staff told me to describe the items that we lost and would contact us after checking with the lost and found department Only a few moments later the airport called me that they found my items at the lost and found A janitor had turned them in We can arrange to collect the items anytime It all seemed crazy to me because the items were in perfect condition I was so grateful and could not believe that my stuff would be able to be found The airport staff were extremely helpful and nice It made my day and I still feel so thankful even until today

Pricequality is unbeatable Airplane was on the same standard as most European Airlines and Food and service as well Regarding the transfer in Shenzhen it works perfectly It is a huge modern international Airport I was advised that I could enjoy my time outside the aiport as Austria is one of EU countries that are now Visa free Went to the city with public transport and visited the KK Mall and St Regis Highly recommended Plane was empty that was nice as well

Cartagena to Cali Paid the ticket pesos equivalent to mBP or EUR We left on time we arrived before the scheduled time Some people judge an airline when they spend peanuts for it I find Vivacolombia exceptional for what you pay

The airport is really modern and beautiful Its very tidy and clean and has a lot of signs and announcements and a lot of staff that help out with your luggage the staff are really kind and the airport is really clean

The Fokker was certainly old but clean The flight announcements were made in Farsi and English to my surprise The flight was smooth on time and without any nervousness Food was surprisingly excellent Chicken rice and a bottle of Pepsi

Firstly poor info there is no airport mapplan nowhere on internet let alone on their web site The good info should also include that the trolleybus minibus works from till So the airport is OK and the queuing times are good At the arrival one waits up tp some min if there are no other planes passengers coming The taxi people are annoying but bearable The airport is practically in the outskirts suburbia and well communicated by minibus also one can walk some min to the nearest tram line if they wished trams work till There is a kiosk with food and drinks plus a freezer with icecream Several exchange offices rates are a bit worse than those of the city centre vs per euro No shopping in departures is rather a pleasant surprise

Arrival on Sunday morning Apr Good airport quick luggage delivery clean airport Departure on Thursday evening Apr Check in correct no air conditioning very hot temperature more than C on the evening very crowded due to small boarding lounge and not enough seats Only one small bar in international area for more than large aircraft B departing at the same time

This is a small and nice airport Ive landed and departed from this airport before and it has changed a lot I dont know why it is called Leon Airport if it is closer to Silao Gto I landed there a few months ago my destination was Romita Gto my mothers hometown This airport is very convenient for us since it is only about mins away from Romita Also this airport is not very far from Guanajuato city I recommend people to visit Guanajuato this is perhaps the most European style city in Mexico

Seat Comfort was excellent Legroom was excellent The hard product is very good The soft product is abysmal and food is unacceptable Communication is poor The staff is truly detached from their customers Not just the flight attendants but the gate agents and counter personnel It seems like they dont want to be at their job jobs So detached that when we landed in Madrid the purser welcomed us to Paris France I almost always fly British Airways This time a segment was on American Never again

This was a short flight Just under two hours Checkin a breeze with many selfservice kiosks Plane is turboprop Seats are firm and do not recline One small toilet at front of plane Aisle narrow Overhead storage small Board and exit from front and rear This is great for passengers Also larger carryon luggage can be placed at no cost into luggage storage This is helpful Horizon offers free craft beer and wine and serve Starbucks coffee Cabin crew very personable and efficient Overall very satisfied with Horizon and this flight Will use again

I found that I couldnt make my Ryanair flight back to London and to my astonishment found a BA flight to London City my favourite airport for euros The flight was on time and very good My one slight hesitation is that I wish BA had told me that I couldnt check in online at San Sebastian Other than that I have no complaints Indeed at the airport I asked the checkin desk if they might block the seat next to me and they agreed Once on board I drank wine and ate a snack and was very content If only flying was always like this

Transiting here despite a short interval of one hour between flights was easy Its been revamped since last visit and has a lovely new feel The signage was excellent We had to go through security despite having just alighted however that was fast and easy Our next gate was not far away to walk The toilets were in good condition Return transit turned out to be longer as our plane was delayed hours and we had to enter the country Again this was done quickly and efficiently I have no complaints at all Departing was just as easy although being such a small airport there is not much to do or see there bring your own bookentertainment All in all a good experience with this small but efficient airport

Norman Rogers Airport CYGK in Kingston Ontario Canada is a small regional airport located about km east of Toronto and about the same distance west of Montreal Air Canada Jazz offers Dash and Beech service to Toronto times daily The return flight from Kingston to Toronto costs about if you have a connecting flight in Toronto Otherwise a flight from Kingston to Toronto costs a bit more Avoiding checkin in Toronto and the three hour drive to Toronto is worth the extra cost Kingston is a one building terminal and there is never anymore than pax to checkin for any flight Security is very thorough but is done efficiently and saves you the hassle of going through Toronto Pearson for security The terminal is one building and is currently undergoing renovations to improve service There are no restaurants in the terminal but there are a few vending machines AVIS does offer a car rental service but requires advance notice so a representative can meet the flight Overnight parking is only per hr period and is much cheaper than parking in Toronto The flight to Toronto takes min Baggage can be checked through to your destination from Kingston so there is no need to reclaim baggage in Toronto A nice little airport that makes a trip through Toronto Pearson a little more bearable

What a pleasure We arrived into Murcia on the nd June and greeted by cheery ground staff straight to passport control a little queue at passport control nice and polite customs officers Went to baggage belt and there were a few others in front of us but mins at the most wait for our baggage Through the exit and outside in under half an hour how amazing was that The return journey went just as smoothly I was blown away by this efficient friendly and calm airport staff are amazing

My experiences with customs and immigration have always been exceptionally pleasurable Over the past year I arrived in Cayman a dozen times to meet with immigration lawyers on the basis that I will move here The officers greet me warmly and I am processed efficiently I usually try to fly in in midweek when it is less crowded However yesterday I arrived on Saturday This was an interesting experience because the airport was almost full to capacity causing long lines and delays I suggest any traveller to avoid arriving or departing on a Saturday or Sunday because there can be many flights arriving and departing The airport is safe clean and convenient Everyone is friendly and easygoing I love it here I suggest everyone come visit at least once in their lifetime This is paradise an expensive paradise though

Excellent service very good meals and plenty of fresh coffee I have flown EVA several times in the past but this trip was the best and most efficient by far far better than that so called new luxury carrier from Taiwan that I used in EVAs flight attendants are very professional and interact with passengers with a big smile and speedy service best in the industry

Simferopol Airport in has one brand new pier and the other two renovated All look extremely busy at peak season but very well organised clean bright well airconditioned spacious and friendly for travelers Large and convenient parking available Airports transfer options include shuttle buses taxis and even trolleybuses there is the longest km trolleybus line in the world between Simferopol Airport and the coastal city of Yalta on the Black Sea There were no queues at the entrance and pretty short ones at registration desks There could be more seats available at the lounge area than the airport now has Security officers are polite and efficient It was a pity the airport still had outdoor boarding halls but we were assured that it was a matter of time a year or two Overall it is an easy airport to use It will be nice to come back here later

This airport continues to improve as it gets more and more traffic Air Seychelles are the ground handling company and they have built an excellent lounge for premium passengers It really is very very nice The shopping improves with every visit and the space available keeps increasing in size for passengers to stroll That with the friendly and helpful staff makes it a winner

Piedmont Triad is just a jewel of an airport Friendly staff polite and helpful TSA Officers who seem genuinely pleased to have the opportunity to chat to travellers Add to this outstanding wifi connection which comes free of charge with no time limit and comfortable clean and stress free surroundings We fly here frequently from Glasgow with a connection to NC at Newark Not as many shops or food concessions as larger airports but at least the staff are friendly The difference between Newark and Greensboro is really quite startling My wife and I love this airport

Time warp but in a positive sense I guess this is how a small town airport must have looked and felt years ago Sleepy atmosphere old building completely unorganised staff but friendly and quick We got through immigration baggage collection and customs within minutes all without any tips Enjoyed the experience Return flight checkin was quick no hassle The best airports are those in which you dont spend any time If it wasnt for the complete lack of any facilities Id give it four stars

Entebbe airport sets good standards for an airport in Africa Though I do not recommend staying in it for hours it is still a clean safe place Coming from Sydney it is ok Its clean and the lounge is amazing Though having kids with me did make a hassle Otherwise its a nice quiet airport to go to Especially when the border security allowed me to go from the back to the front of the line I like it

The international terminal is small and because of that there are no endless walks which is great The visa on arrival staff were very quick and it only took a few minutes to be processed then it was the same going through immigration Our bags were waiting for us in the baggage hall after immigration then it was over to the taxi desk and straight into cab and on to our hotel On departing once again immigration was very quick then we had a short wait in the departure lounge which was very nice with a few shops and a good cafe

Short one hour flights with Safarilink to Diani from Nairobi Wilson return A very pleasant way to reach the coast from Nairobi and much quicker overall than the JKIA Nairobi Airport to Mombasa route Drink and biscuit served Both airports were small indeed Diani is described as an airstrip

Its big enough for the number of people it serves on a weekday although Id imagine it would get pretty crowded when the larger Virgin planes come in from Melbourne on weekends The staff are friendly the facilities adequate for a regional airport of this size the queues managable and its clean It just feels like its missing something Despite it being refurbished within the last decade or so it feels like it needs a bit of a touch upand the constant use of that sickly blue colour everywhere doesnt necessarily help the situation So yes it is a nice airport in regional NSW that serves its purpose and the needs of the people but I just get the feeling that with a bit of money put in new floorings lick of paint open up the departure lounge a bit more provide wifi it could be have a certain wow factor reserved for NSW regional airports like Newcastle Albury and Dubbo which have been thrust forward into the st Century

It was great to fly out of and into TriCities regional airport again Had no problems it was great From check in thru security and the passenger boarding area Security helped my wife greatly because of back surgery she said they were wonderful

Barbados to Bequia SVG Air Grenadine Alliance will take you to Bequia and other beautiful small Caribbean islands I flew them from Barbados to Bequia return in January Ignore any timetables or prices you find via internet search these are not current Email the airline directly they will respond promptly and courteously You will be billed in Eastern Caribbean dollars XCD These are roughly XCD per one USD Expect your flight to cost roughly the same as or even slightly more than your flight to Barbados from the US It may be more costeffective for a large group to charter a flight Ground staff are laidback but helpful and courteous flight crew are professional Checkin is straightforward and they will let you check one bag without fee plus bring a personal item on plane I was able to fit a mediumsized duffel under the seat Your flight may stop briefly at other islands such as Canouan and Union Island to pick up and discharge passengers It is a beautiful ride My flights were on DHC Twin Otters a workhorse of global aviation and not claustrophobic for a small plane Great views including through windshield which you can see as cockpit door remains open

The arrivals hall at the international terminal is clean and tidy but does not cope well with any more than large aircraft arriving at the same time It can take over an hour to clear customs and there is only one baggage conveyor The only ATM is after passport control and you will need PGK if you wish to purchase a visa so it pays to have your currency ready before you depart for POM The departure lounge is also very clean and tidy and customs and immigration are efficient However if you wish to do shopping there is only one very small duty free shop and an even smaller cafe after customs and security

This airport continues to improve as it gets more and more traffic Air Seychelles are the ground handling company and they have built an excellent lounge for premium passengers It really is very very nice The shopping improves with every visit and the space available keeps increasing in size for passengers to stroll That with the friendly and helpful staff makes it a winner

I have been in this airport many times over the last three years and it is by far the best airport I have experienced in Latin America It is clean and new and easy to get through with no long queues only a little when waiting in immigration after transatlantic flights Everything is very open and there is many different things to buy in taxfree

Really excellent airport I flew to and from Palma De Mallorca airport for a weeks holiday There was absolutely no queues But it was am so it was expected But even when I arrived at about pm the queues were short and went very fast Definitely a great experience No delays or inconvenience except for most of the shops being closed on departure but as stated earlier it was in the morning Highly recommend

Kazan to Baku Its not really a low cost airline because the cost is not low and quality is even lower than a usual lowcost But I had no choice Hand luggage is not included it is made clear on their website But the problem is that you cant pay for the hand luggage on their website you have to pay at checkin counter And they force you to pay in different currency using their crazy exchange rate so you will overpay for it a lot The reason as they explained it it is because they need to check your bag size and weight to see if it will fit Cant they allow to pay for it online and deal with overweight bags at the airport for extra cost My bag was within the limits but I had to pay more Surprisingly seats were pretty comfortable and spacious enough for tall people They even gave a free sandwich But teacoffee was not free Anyway I cant recommend to fly with Buta

Panama City to Caracas a journey of hrs There was very little legroom but we were served quite a decent meal and considering it was a short flight I was impressed We departed on time but arrived min late

Flew SZGZUR Wasnt expecting anything from an hour long flight in a small twinprop plane but this was an excellent flight Smooth takeoffs and landing Easy checkin and great assistance at the airport Flight left on time with no delays Crew is very courteous and they speak very good English When you think it cant get any better they served food Complimentary food is a rare thing on short domestic flights especially on twinprop planes Overall excellent airline and would recommend them

Surprisingly nice flight for a Chinese airline The business class named first class is of the usual type in China ie rows of seats with old seats and small reclining angle The crew was very attentive wine Chinese was decent and so was the food nothing special but ok Reading material is of course restricted to the China Daily and there is no individual entertainment but on a hours flight especially on a night flight this is not essential Flights both ways were on time I would recommend this flight as it is the only airline to fly directly between Bangkok and several places in the Shandong province schedule is terrible but it is still better than transferring

Our flight from Auckland was late leaving due to bad weather We arrived at the REX counter in Melbourne flustered and tired The check in for baggage had just closed but Thomas came to our rescue He checked if our baggage could still be checked in escorted us through security down to the REX gate arriving with minutes to spare before the flight was called With out Thomas we would never have made it he went over and beyond to ensure we were able to make the flight Thomas is a credit to himself and REX The cabin crew had no idea we were weary travellers We were greeted warmly and genuinely thankful to have made the flight for home To the REX staff thank you This is why we always fly REX

I want to commend staff at Alicante airport on what was my first airport visit post covid Arriving and departing was prompt and hassle free When I accidentally broke a mug at the Starbucks counter the staff were just concerned about how I was feeling Also the girl at the EasyJet gate took my postcards which I had forgotten to post and promised to post them for me They all arrived eventually so thank you

I was very impressed by the level of care and support I received at the airport Having a severe reaction to an insect bite and no Antihistamine tablets with me The local team and Airport police went out of their way to help I wish I had noted their names they looked everywhere and obtained tablets for me while making sure I was comfortable and relaxed Thank you very much as the level of care and support at a busy airport was very welcome and impressive

It has everything you need for a small convenient airport One of my carry on bags flew off the top of my Jeep on the way to the airport I found a nice selection of ones to replace it in the shop and the food in the restaurant was very good all the service there was great I had my service dog the security was educated on what documents was needed to prove he was a real service dog The added bonus was they have a small Pet rest area What a gem instead of fighting all the Skyharbor hubbub

A nice airport and frankly I am surprised at the bad reviews I arrived there at approx hrs Entry and checkin were very easy Security was straight forward and immigration was very easy Once on the airside a restaurant was open as were the dutyfree shops The only downside were the grumpy staff of the shops who obviously had not woken up yet Announcements were clear and boarding was orderly and we took off on time
Its not a big airport but clean and good However there is not much signage

Was not impressed with food service and attitude Ordered glasses of wine at Mike Kitchen Charge AUS Is this reasonable Can get bottles for this price Was then told could not take wine into food court where we wanted to get something to eat Could not get food at Mikes Kitchen as kitchen was going to close in minutes Was not permitted to bring food from another outlet to have with my wine Shortly after wine was served was asked to hurry up as premises was about to close We were not advised hen purchasing wine that we would have to hurry up and drink Do not use Mikes Kitchen And then in a rush to buy food went to KFC where the very young staff had no interest in serving me and I was then told that most menu choices were unavailable and only zinger burgers were on sale My wife does not eat any spicy food Will avoid Sydney Airport on future visits to Australia or bring my own sandwiches and but wine in duty free Sadly spoilt an otherwise great visit to Australia

Small and always a risk for bad weather but they do an amazing job clearing the snow closed less than hrs per year despite getting more snow on average than any comparable city Rarely any delays at counters or security Free WiFi Not much in the way of food or shopping No public transportation into Syracuse taxi only

I had lose my hand carry luggage during the security check due to my own negligence I only realized it after boarded to my flight Singapore airline SQ on th Feb I highly appreciated Incheon airport ground staff and Singapore airline staff professional service quick response and putting customer satisfaction at high priority as they managed to quickly locate the luggage ensure me the luggage will be sent back the by the next available flight and I could proceed returning Singapore as per plan Two staff members Im not sure if hes Incheon airport staff or Singapore airline staff I would like to mention in particular who had responded very fast and given me great support at the boarding gate Mr Kang and Mr Lee Both their effort was sincerely appreciated

Spent a few hours at Saskatoon Airport for a layover Comfortable seating and general overall layout Decent selection of food and drink for a smaller airport I enjoyed the interactive flight map Friendly and helpful staff Loved the amount of window space Nice airport

I am sat in a light and airy air conditioned building drinking Cappicino Freddo The queue for checking in was small but very organised and the whole building is welcoming Arrival was just as good although a slight wait for baggage due to three aircraft coming in close together This airport has come on a lot since last year and I recommend it The indicator boards all seem to be working ok and the WiFi is good What more can you want Dont blame the airport for things they dont control

A small very effective airport with few flights Checkin is notorious quick and staff friendly arrival very quick and busses to Aalborg frequent Usually no problems getting taxis as well There used to be a cafeteria but nowadays just a kiosk but good cafeteria with reasonable prizes inside terminal Security check quick and friendly as well There is a nice viewing pavilion at one end of the airport Outside note the famous kiss and goodbye signs Restrooms outside terminal however few

Flown HanedaChitose and FukuokaHaneda in the new A Very good seats almost like business class seats Service on board was excellent Drinks and snacks for a small fee about euro for a coffee Will fly with them again when in Japan

Norwich to Guernsey with Aurigny Air Online service very good when I was booking my seats months after booking the flights I noticed I had spelt my wifes name incorrectly but email to aurigny put that right with no extra charge The flight to Guernsey from Norwich was on time and landed early the same when coming back The flight had people coming back so about full complementary drinks are served which made a nice change The flight crew kept us informed through out the flight I would recommend this airline

This airport is highly recommended Many of the reviews below are pre which is when the facility completed a full upgrade of terminal and gates I would discard any pre reviews as irrelevant to the current condition Long Beach Airport is a welldesigned and pleasant experience compared with LAX and to a degree John Wayne Its a smaller but more efficient facility with competitively priced parking within an easy walk of your gate The TSA Security Checkpoint is relatively fast compared with other airports The facility boasts two outdoor seating areas for two of its restaurants a comparative luxury in this age of airport design being little more than shopping malls with airline gates The central area between the two terminals is an outdoor seating area allowing for a retreat from the madness at the gates One of the unique aspects of LGB is the lack of jetways Walking out onto the tarmac to board a plane is a fun and different experience which adds significantly to the charm of this facility Long Beach doesnt have the cold and sterile feel of most modern airports and that is a welcome aspect of flying here There are a number of restauranteating choices available though the shopping is a relatively weak area In general Long Beach is easily my favorite American airport and is qualitatively far better than the vast majority of facilities I use

Considering that Mykonos is a small hilly island this little airport does well It is small so transit through from disembarkation to exit is really quick and not far to walk Arrived on connecting flight from Athens on Aegean at am Bags were out in around minutes Return flight back to Athens a week later Afternoon flight so busier as flights departing together Check in was busy big queues but efficient check in staff Small coffee sandwich counter and gift shop airside and small duty free shop toilet facilities and snack bar with hot drinks once passed passport control and security Its not the Business Lounge at Changi but it does the job for the short time people are there Good job

Work required me to go on very short notice to London so I decided to fly with VLM which offers you three flights per day from Antwerp to London City with their Fokker Decided as well to fly from Antwerp as they offered reasonable prices for their flights while my usual airlines I usually take from Amsterdam or Rotterdam were extremely expensive for just flying of less than a hour Arriving a touch early at Antwerp Airport checkin and security were quite quiet so it was just a matter of a few minutes to pass both checkin and security while waiting to board Very small airport so dont expect much to do after security Once the aircraft was ready to board it was just minutes to be fully ready to start up and depart The Fokker they were using was surprisingly neat and clean from the inside for an aircraft of this age and was quite spacious to stand in the aisle After an ontime departure out of Antwerp the flight was quite smooth and the flight attendant started to serve us with a complimentary drink and snack of your choosing while the flight crew kept us up to date about their procedure into London City and the estimated time of arrival which to me was well done Turbulence appeared into approach of London and landing was ontime The most surprising factor of the flight was that the noise was quite low for a turboprop within the cabin After a ontime landing the boarding was quickly done in a safe and mannerly matter and all that was left was to wait for our luggage to arrive on our belt which probably was the longest wait

Omsk to Krasnoyarsk I was a little unsure as to what to expect from a second tier Russian company However the check in process was quick and efficient although it was done only in Russian and I had to move a little weight from my checked in luggage to my hand luggage The flight departed and arrived on time The plane was quite small but legroom was still adequate It was subject to turbulence as we were approaching the landing The cabin crew appeared not to speak English as announcements were only in Russian A good snack was served on the almost two hour long flight My luggage came off the flight fairly quickly All in all a satisfactory experience

Hamad International Airport is nice brand new airport Very spacious and clean Good wifi line and plenty of free desktop for internet Seats are everywhere and they are comfortable Charging points are available throughout this airport Many choices for food and shopping However I find that the price is rather high

Billund is an excellent airport with good facilities practical layout and friendly and efficient staff My only gripe is the airport bus which is extortionate DKK to Aarhus and runs at often perplexing times that seem to have no correlation to when major flights are landing Ive travelled here every other month from various UK airports for about years and sometimes have to wait up to hours to get away As the airport is far from where most foreign travellers want to be unless they really like Lego you often have little option but to wait for the bus or pay even more for a taxi

On the way to Prague Bluebird chartered out to an AKL aeroplane which was cramped and the service terrible But on return on an actual Bluebird plane the flight was wonderful Clean roomy seats excellent service from the staff It was the same as flying a nondiscount airline but without the food The captain even came over a few times to announce places of interest we were flying over the staff were lovely and it was a great flight overall

Having lived in the area all of my life Ive flown out of Syracuse Hancock for years It is a smallish regional airport with a few places to eat The bathroom facilities are abundant and clean while gate areas are somewhat outdated and a little shopworn The airport is divided into two main departurearrival wings previously each had its own TSA screening area Recent renovations resulted in consolidation to a single TSA screening area with capacity to manage both gate wings Because I was not aware of the renovations I took my usual path to my assigned gate only to find that I had to backtrack to the TSA area and then back out to the gate Perhaps further renovations andor improvements in signage could result in more a more direct and efficient pathway to TSA Once through the mostly efficient TSA process the walk to the gate was fairly quick and straightforward TSA lines can be long but not like LAX DCA etc during peak periods so be prepared Parking is adjacent to the terminal with very reasonable rates Ive left my car there for a few days at a time without concern While sometimes flights are less expensive out of nearby cities Rochester Buffalo Albany for example I choose to fly out of Syracuse because it is so accessible Lastly the Syracuse illuminated sign on the gate area has welcomed passengers for decades with its comforting deco appearance

My recent return flight from Melbourne to the Gold Coast with REX Airlines was excellent Everything from booking to disembarking on the return flight was easy The staff were friendly and professional Given that CV issues are currently dominating travel within Australia I felt REX Airlines handled everything beautifully

I flew from Marseille to Ajaccio Overall I was satisfied The outbound leg was carried out with an ageing but very well kept ATR and the return with a recent A Both flights were on time and the crew was polite and smiling Given the short duration of the flights both around minutes the inflight service consisted solely of drinks but thats fine The basic fare always includes a checked in luggage and the price was correct I spent euros return to fly on midJuly booking just weeks prior to departure The only minus was the long waiting time to collect the luggage at AJA minutes despite having just aircrafts to unload but I dont blame it on Air Corsica

Szczecins Solidarity Airport is one of the smaller regional airports in Poland The cartaxi ride from Szczecin takes a bit longer than expected but once there you will find a pleasant airport located in a wood away from the city It has only a small terminal but it is very modern fresh and complete with all facilities bookstalls shops cafs etc that open also for early morning departures Im told there is a small hotel nearby The staff is helpful Only a handful of flights depart each day so the terminal does not get crowded and the atmosphere is casual and relaxed And the security check was very thorough which I appreciated
The Aroport international de Qubec is a good example to follow concerning quality of service and infrastructure Its clean well designed and the staff are professional and customer oriented

Extended and refurbished runway is so much improved New Terminal building constructed for Euro Cup is really nice and well designed With lots of space very clean and spacious When I arrived on the flight from Warsaw we were coached to the international arrivals where all or of us cleared passport control in under minutes Baggage was on a belt also in about min after we disembarked It was a pleasure to use such a lovely little airport and o much improved

Passenger wise Indias th busiest airport but infrastructure wise one of the most smallest airport in India When flight lands they dont even provide bus to arrivals but needs to walk from aircraft to terminal via on tarmac Arrivals is very small only baggage belt in a limit spaces but baggage can take more time Toilets are just ok should be more clean Prepaid cab and also uber have pick up point just after exit no issues finding them at the same time many taxi drivers will approach you offering ride Airport needs proper management new terminal is under construction and hope that it is better managed

Brilliant both times we flew them Brilliant food crew especially the Thai based very comfortable seats got a decent amount of sleep Kept snacks in the galleys Stocked bathrooms with toothbrushes eye masks etc Good wifi connectivity decent ife Brilliant airline and will definitely fly again
St Petersburg to Moscow Efficient check in Comfortable seats and a fairly decent snack sandwich Certainly good value for money and spot on with departurelanding times Would use again

I highly recommend traveling out of COS if you live in Pueblo Colorado Springs even Denver COS is a very cozy and convenient airport with easy parking checkin security and baggage claim Its main terminal has gates so it isnt at all huge but it is a very comfortable size In the past several years the planes flying into and out of COS have sadly gotten smaller think regional jets and the routes served are mostly to hub cities That said I would personally rather fly out of COS and connect than drive the extra hour and a half to DEN and fly nonstop because it is a lot less stressful The airport recently purchased new furniture for each gate area and it is a vast improvement They even have padded benchs in the center of the terminal that you can lie on and sleep before you fly This little extra is great because lets face it when people come from sea level to ft it is nice to lie down and adjust to the high altitude That said one downfall of COS is its lack of shops and restaurants though the variety isnt horrible The free WiFi throughout the terminal though helps compensate for this shortfall

Manageable and friendly this feels like an airport from the s Coming in and going out immigration facilities are fairly efficient Going out after immigration there are a few shops a barcafe and a sitting area The layout is semiopen and you can watch the planes land not that many do this is an airport with very few international flights daily You go through another security when heading to your gate where you can have your last beer before leaving the country Overall a good reflection of the country unpretentious clean friendly and relatively efficient

Pros Very good interiors and wellmaintained seats cleanliness lighting Ample space available between knee and seat in front of you Wellmannered and clear language English and Hindi speaking crew led by Ms Unnati Didnt have food nor used washroom so cannot comment on that Journey was comfortable and no bumpy rides encountered Communication from cockpit was also clear everytime Cons Boarding was not done in zoneseat number wise Quite some mosquitoes seen before take off which bit me and some passengers Crew applied some spray but wasnt enough Pricing was a big letdown as huge increase seen while booking on Feb for my journey date of Feb in a short span of time Slight delay in takeoff after closing of doors

Genoa to Paris This was an Air France flight operated by local carrier CityJet Everything was done through the Air France website and I was able to upgrade to business class for around The business class seat was probably one of the smallest seat I ever flown however the service was fantastic and for a flight that lasted under two hours there is really nothing to complain about The airplane had four engines thing that I found quite interesting since it was very small aircraft I was served a full breakfast that was very nice and the presentation was five star I would fly this airline again without hesitation

Clark Airport is well secured and accommodating for passengers and there are plenty of seats provided in the predeparture terminal There are also small food stalls for the passengers who can fill their tummy while waiting their flight to depart

Small airport in the West of Ireland People and staff very friendly New bathrooms in lounge Food expensive Duty free was very big but there are no bargains for people travelling to US as items like perfumes are actually more expensive than sites in US We used to get bargains in duty free but not any more

Little expense has been spared to make DRS a spacious and stateofthe art An allround highly agreeable experience with the added advantage of DRS being very close to the city centre A halfhourly rail service connects DRS with Dresden Hautbahnof a minute journey with several intermediate stops all for a princely EUR oneway fare BA has recently launched an LGWDRS service great views of the heart of the city on the landing approach from the starboard side but the airport remains somewhat underutilised

On December st I had booked a flight for my dad and his brothers to Cape Town I joined them we were helped by Thabile Mchunu at Counter and she was absolutely amazing My elders had never taken a flight before and he kindness and friendliness was amazing and helpful to calm the nerves

The new Hanoi international terminal opened at the end of December excellent and well planned a big improvement on the old terminal It only took me a few minutes to check in and pass the security very efficient happy helpful staff all the way
Very comfortable and the staff were really nice our flight was not delayed it was wonderful flying with HiSky as it was my first time flying with them and had a wonderful experience

Sydney Santiago via Auckland on Above average flight with an average meal very good crew and reasonable IFE selection However the abreast in economy is too tight The seats are too narrow and the aisles are tiny The meal trolley only just fits through The tray table is also very small On the return leg a passenger fell ill immediately after takeoff The crew managed this very well About hours into the flight it was determined that wed have to return to SCL The airline put us into hotels As a transit passenger through SCL the airline arranged to pay our reciprocity fee US to enter into Chile This was a long process over hour but at least they paid for it The airline wasnt able to arrange a single large bus to take us to the hotel at the last minute and so there was another long process about hours of getting all of us into separate mini buses The hotel was excellent and included free food Back to the airport this time in a big coach and a very long checkin process Our bags were checked through to SYD and we were advised wed been put onto a Qantas flight from AKL to SYD The flight was again reasonable good crew OK food definitely not up to Emirates standards and bathrooms kept clean Due to our delayed arrival into AKL we had to overnight there and again LAN had arranged a hotel meal and bus transfer for us Overall LAN managed this stressful situation which was out of their control quite well ensuring we had a place to rest and food to eat and made sure we all got to our final destinations My lower marks are for the standard and quantity of the food and the cramped seating that almost all operators of the have adopted

Bozeman Yellowstone Airport is a rather small airport but its cabinlike design make it unique and special The concourse is easy to maneuver and the directional signs are very helpful and easy to read Security is usually a breeze on days with less travel Bozeman does have TSA PreCheck The seating areas are nice with stations for charging Internet Access is also free but it may not work on some devices The terminal is spotless and there are many little shops to have a coffee in as well as a Yellowstone Association store which offers indepth information about visiting Yellowstone National Park Grand Teton National Park and the surrounding areas

Stavanger airport Sola is a small airport like the one in Bergen and Trondheim Not many international flights but quite many domestic The terminal there is only one is years old but they have started to upgrade everything All in all a comfortable airport

I took the am flight from Basra to Erbil an Iraqi domestic flight I bought the ticket the day before at the Iraqi Airways ticket office in Basra They were friendly spoke English and only take Iraqi dinars no credit cards I paid roughly the equivalent of The flight left on time and was fine The equipment was a B On the short flight they served a breakfast tray with a lot of very sweet things chocolate milk an Iraqi Twinkietype cake a soft roll with jam and a banana It wasnt really to my liking but it was nevertheless an energypacked breakfast which is more than one gets on European carriers these days The flight attendants were friendly and we landed in Erbil on time I was satisfied with my flight and wish other people would also leave reviews for this airline

Was departing New Orleans two days after jazzfest Had no problems with queueing anywhere Had some time to kill before my flight and sat outside in a cool spot close to where buses depart Spent some time chatting to n airport employee Absolutely delightful polite young man

Very pleasant flight from Athens to Thessaloniki with Ellinair Easy process of booking and echeck in the boarding pass is sent to the mobile so no app or printer is needed Athens Airport was a breeze the fee included checked baggage so I chose to check in my hand luggage also for free the company did it with a smile Departure and arrival on time flight about full Good legspace service included very small snack and drinks Immaculate and smiling crew Quick retrieval of baggage in Thessaloniki Excellent experience

Da Nang to Da Lat The checkout process was smooth Although there was a minutes delay due to the late arrival of the airplane once we boarded everything went on well The legroom was not that cramped I found the crew service even better than Vietnam Airlines flight I flew to Da Nang several days before So I might fly this airline again on my future visit to Vietnam

Travelled from Gteborg Landvetter Airport to Pristina in July and returned to Gteborg in August The airport of Pristina is very compact and small It has a restaurant in the checkin area and some shops In the departure area there is a dutyfree shop small but has some good stuff in it When arriving to Pristina we had to walk all the way to the arrival hall which in my opinion looks very old Baggage took a long time to get to the baggage carousels and they were on the wrong carousel They were on the carousel for a Swiss flight instead of where they shouldve been Staff were very helpful helped us to take the bags down from the carousel and explained to us that there was a misunderstanding between the staff But one bad thing is that they didnt bring baggage carts so we had to carry the baggage all the way to the car waiting for us but the walking distance to the parking is really short so frankly it was not a big deal When departing there were enough baggage carts and the whole checkin process and everything worked pretty smoothly and fine Theyre currently on the final phase of building the brand new terminal which can be seen from the runway Hopefully when I arrive and depart next time it will be from the fresh and modern new terminal

Awesome experience The staff was so courteous Food was tasty Very good fellow travelers who made the experience even better Even at Dubai Airport the manager in charge at check in has always been very helpful and is actively monitoring the interactions of people with the check in desk staff Great experience

When I arrived at this airport from incheon the immigration lines were long It took me more than an hour to get out of the airport I headed to Incheon a few days later Security and immigration was actually fine although I found the facilities a little old There were plenty of places to shop and relax but I wished that there were more food choices Overall this is a small but functional airport

Uneventful flight with on time departure and arrival Usual Southwest nofrill service Clean aircraft and friendly flight crew In Flight Entertainment was easy to log on and watch live TV NFL football Unusual for this particular aircraft the overhead cabins were not as large as other aircraft

Pleasant smaller airport Parking is easy as is dealing with rental cars if necessary Ive used both Tucson and Phoenix Airports Phoenix had a direct flight and was less expensive for traveling between Boston and Tucson From now on Ill be using Tucson Airport due to the ease of access and human scale

Flew in and out of Rio Galeao airport in October Terminal was quite clean and quiet and quite a lot of shops but not too many which is neat The walking was a lot though and there were no conveyor belts to speed from the security to my gate all the way at the other end of the airport This is one of two points that could be improved The other one is is that some employes doing reaserch and statistics about client satisfaction were walking aroud the gates to get info No problem there But there are far too many I got interupted almost every minutes and I think that the airport cancould relax on that An otherwise great airport

The passenger terminal in Fargo has limited but all the essential services I used it for arriving and departing to hub cities for onward connections Taxi drivers were near the baggage belts soliciting fares On departure you check in on the main floor and take escalators one flight up To your left is a large enough gift shop with the usual items plus North Dakota State University memorabilia On the right is a food court with a few eateries including a Subway The security check was smooth Once on the airside there is a coffee shop and a kiosk of a shop a miniatiure version of the gift shop on the other side There are quite a few chairs and signage is good A very easy airport to use and quick to get out of and quick to get in

I have to say my second arrival in Dar was much better than the first First time arrived amid a plague of flying cockroachlike insects that were all attracted to the light inside the terminal Spent ages swatting them in a huge line for immigration that took over an hour only to then be told I needed a special permit and had to pay USD I already had a business visa Not wanting to argue I joined the next disorganised line paid my USD and waited another minutes to get my passport back Notable that everyone in the special line was Caucasian Second time all desks open for immigration friendly hello from the official and a quick stamp and on my way No special permit needed this time for some reason Bags came out quickly and was out of the airport within minutes of landing Lets hope that the new terminal will be finished on time and that there will be no more special line

Very nice airport closely situated to New York City and very convenient for all travelling tofrom Long Island Decent selection of shops easy to navigate and not crowded at all when I flew threw both times Local hub for Southwest airlines

Completely pleasant airport Small very clean shopcaferestaurantprices much lower than in Borispol Easily accessible from center by taxi or trolleybus just plan enough time in traffic peaks of Kyiv and Close to very recommendable planemuseum in pedestrian distancemaybe mins to walk Customs working attentively but very polite Immigration takes usually more time mins in average than emigration but much more quickly than in Borispol The same about security Free wifi works properly and fast Have no post office in terminal but one across parking lot located left direction of entrance behind the power plant of the airport

Pleasant and easy check in Perfectly organized boarding Clean and new aircraft Spacious seat distance however seat width not as wide as other carrier on this route Pleasant crew Very good food which however was served a bit late At arrival fast border control and bag arrived rather soon however priority sticker did not give the bag priority delivery

Quite impressed as I was not expecting much the ticket was very cheap brand new aircraft very cleaned and smelled nice Pretty good legroom seat next to me vacant so it was comfortable flight Two hot meal services main meals not very good but was happy with fresh fruit on the tray insider tip when offered SEAFOOD NOODLES dont expect wok stir fried asian style noodlesyou will get something that I would expect in Swedish kindergarten see photo below crew dont speak much English and the service is somehow chaotic but not too bad IFE quite limited but enough for me
Needed a wheel chair because of an injury people were so helpful and caring A special thank you to Damian who pushed my wheel chair So grateful Thank you

I have gone to this airport several times the past two years Beside my bad experience with sixt car rental I can not find any reason to complain Friendly and helpful staff check in and security done in minutes Small duty free and nice coffee shop Well functioning small airport

This was a third flight with this airline during a three week period of a SE Asia tour but Im reviewing this because of the element of positive surprise for a relatively short flight The flight was delayed but apologies were given around because of its double city service this scheduled flight was also used for a Hanoi service A smooth boarding process was also met by using more spacious premium economy seats with snack and hot drink service compared to just water as before Cabin staff were friendly and efficient

I had to cancel my travel plans from Dar Es Salaam to Arusha due to a medical emergency Coastal Aviation was very supportive understanding and efficient in processing my situation Much appreciated Great company

The international arrivals and departure section at Harare Zimbabwe airport is a revelation On arrival all the staff including Immigration and Customs were friendly and welcoming and this contributed to an excellent first impression and a speedy processing Possibly helped by having obtained visas before flying On departure check in was efficient and again the friendly staff were most helpful There is a full range of facilities airside and clean toilets At present there are not too many international flights but the experience was excellent

A great small airport Staff pleasant even down to the security staff which makes a pleasant change from the usual boredrude staff in most airports Free internet in departures and from landing to leaving teh front door only mins A bus to the city would be good

Excellent modern airport that is complete There was a complete redesign and now it consists of concourses West and Central with the East Concourse still to be built The facility is modern and airy and nicely designed for post with lots of shops and restaurants post security Presecurity it is very tight particularly because people waiting for arriving passengers congregate at the two TSA checkpoints see CHOKE points For the passenger flying into or out of OKC is a breeze

UstKamenogorsk to Karaganda I recently took a group tour in Kazakhstan and this flight was part of the itinerary The checkin counters at UstKamenogorsk airport were kinda Sovietstyle but the process was efficient and we were soon in the rather featureless departure lounge bring coins there is a coffee vending machine for entertainment Aircraft wasnt new but was well presented It was completely full apparently this flight doesnt run very often but one flight attendant managed to serve a soft drink to everyone during the short flight We had an airline pilot in our group he had been wondering what to expect but in the end thought the flight was fine Luggage came quickly and nobody had any loss or damage Overall a decent service

Boise is a smaller sized airport which takes in most if the states airline traffic Walking into the airport from the parking garage in the winter time can be quite grueling and in summer afternoons the outside can be very hot Check in lines are never too long and the check in area is large with very pretty murals on the walls to look at Lighting in any part of the terminal is not a problem with great natural light Pre TSA there is only one eating area that is nothing special and the baggage claim is older giving you a s esque feel For the size if the airport the baggage handlers do take their sweet time getting the bags to their destination I have waited over half an hour for bags before Moving on to TSA the lines are usually quick and screening does not take long There is only one full body detector but traffic still flows freely Due to the recent TSA problems though the lines have reached back towards check in but lines are never hectic in the morning Post TSA is a set of large windows and an eating area The windows give a great view across the airport Food in the airport is classy but a little sub par The McDonalds that used to be the main attraction is now replaced with more Boiselike restaurants Five guys and Einsteins bagels take up most of the hunger goers On the other side of the eating are is a local brewing company Shopping in the upper terminal is nothing to write home about there is an MSNBC and cute convenience stores The airport has no specialty shops and the stores all sell the exact same things like candy magazines and little Idaho potato dolls The C terminal below is dark and again very s esque Birds have been seen inside the upper terminal before they are adorable and not a nuisance to passengers They give a somewhat natural ambiance One of the biggest problems with the airport is their horrendous seats and very few charging ports Most of the ports are up against walls or beams Restrooms are located in one spot in the B terminal and one location just past TSA Overall the airport seems very clean friendly like most of Idaho A pretty good airport Not great but pretty good

I thought this airport was lovely Outside are the cobbled roads and tram link into center In the main airport terminal the facilities are excellent They have a truly amazing viewing deck with information about the space programme and aircraft using the airport Security was quick efficient and friendly and boarding immediate to the aircraft I feel Bremen airport gives passengers the proper respect they deserve even when travelling a budget airline

This is a small airport but over the past couple of years it has improved a lot The customs and immigration are polite and fast with the baggage also coming fast There is a coffee shop outside the secure area and also one inside but the coffee outside is better There is also now free WiFi in the airport There is a lounge but this is not connected to the airlines but for payment No need to arrive to early

I have been in this airport many times over the last three years and it is by far the best airport I have experienced in Latin America It is clean and new and easy to get through with no long queues only a little when waiting in immigration after transatlantic flights Everything is very open and there is many different things to buy in taxfree

First time in Jordan we had to change the airplane at Amman airport The experience at the security check was not a good one The staff was rude to the customers and not very professional although we were friendly and everything was ok with our hand luggage We spent a few hours in the BusinessLounge and enjoyed the food and the comfortable atmosphere

Omsk to Krasnoyarsk I was a little unsure as to what to expect from a second tier Russian company However the check in process was quick and efficient although it was done only in Russian and I had to move a little weight from my checked in luggage to my hand luggage The flight departed and arrived on time The plane was quite small but legroom was still adequate It was subject to turbulence as we were approaching the landing The cabin crew appeared not to speak English as announcements were only in Russian A good snack was served on the almost two hour long flight My luggage came off the flight fairly quickly All in all a satisfactory experience

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

Really beautiful airport after the renovations All major fast food places available apart from local cuisine Wifi is free and fast regardless of duration of the connection which is a huge plus Coffee shop was slightly expensive but the food and coffee were fine nonetheless The announcements are a big plus since most airports in the region are switching to quite airports

Thoroughly enjoyed our experience Friendly staff seats felt spacious Delicious meals Our inter island flights were great too loved being able to disembark through both doors Take note interisland flights have lower weight for carry on but checking a bag is free so it was just fine

Very pleasant flight from Athens to Thessaloniki with Ellinair Easy process of booking and echeck in the boarding pass is sent to the mobile so no app or printer is needed Athens Airport was a breeze the fee included checked baggage so I chose to check in my hand luggage also for free the company did it with a smile Departure and arrival on time flight about full Good legspace service included very small snack and drinks Immaculate and smiling crew Quick retrieval of baggage in Thessaloniki Excellent experience

An unexpectedly pleasant experience The booking process was a bit odd but after using several different credit cards one finally worked on the airline website for a ticket about euros less than any other airline Check in and boarding was smooth Two suitcases allowed at kg each Or one at a maximum of kg There was entertainment with several English language recent films Ample food provided The layover was fine No one was saying anything about not taking photos and it wasnt any more different than transferring in China Seemed the duty free shops take card now too

A typical small Australian airport which operated well Some distance out of the city it is served by a bus and taxis fare Check in was easy there being more than enough desks for the traffic Security was efficient with a bookshop and cafe airside All gates are walk to the plane which are never far away Compared to many this is a nice airport

My son who is epileptic had a seizure during the security check in We had already requested Special Assistance at the desk and the airport team were incredibly helpful and took us to a quiet room to wait until our flight was called They checked on us every minutes and arranged a wheelchair and preferential boarding once the Gate opened They also ensured that the crew were aware of our situation and forwarded the request for assistance to Gatwick

Whilst small and basic its the perfect option for a frequent traveller No queues at check in or security Friendly staff even the security guys are nice No long walks to find your gate Arrive mins before departure travel stress free without the crowds and connect to the world via Schiphol Baggage claim takes minutes Would recommend this airport over flying via Manchester any day unless you enjoy arriving hrs early and shopping

A good experience overall with Eastar Jet flying from Jeju to Gimpo The flight was cheap and easy to book on the airlines website I was sent an email a couple of days before flying Pity it was only in Korean I assumed it to be a routine one that airlines commonly send and assume I was correct as there were no repercussions Baggage is a stingy kg why and mine was I was charged for one extra kilo which seems like taking rules to extremes Everything else was satisfactory Checkin was quick the flight was more or less on time and reasonably comfortable and baggage reclaim quick

I arrived at PSP from SFO I have used the airport from time to time in the past It is quite capable of coping with its traffic but has experienced one major improvement whereby hired cars can now be collected on site This is very welcome especially when the heat is high

I had booked this fare at a very discounted rate as I needed to travel back to BLR The check in experience was good I had arrived early and there was still time for check in to open so I was told to wait for mins before check in in my luggage Post that I had noticed that the inbound was delayed due to which the departure was also slightly delayed by mins The crew were welcoming and this flight was not completely full During boarding I had noticed that a lot of people had come with trolleys and they were told to check in their luggage which is good as a lot of folks come carrying big trolleys that just block the cabin overhead bins The flight tried to make time en route and landing in BLR was swift along with luggage retrieval One point to note here is that the seat pitch may be on the tighter side compared to other airlines but otherwise this was a good trip where the crew also distributed water bottles to everyone during boarding

Clean and efficient I was very impressed with Elmas airport Staff are friendly and the airport is very well connected to the city centre by bus The fare is only Only one negative point once youre past the international departures hall there are no shops only one small cafe near gate otherwise this is one of the best regional airports I have visited so far

The flight Taipei to Shenzen was uninspiring with staff being disinterested and an older aircraft with uncomfortable seats but the service after clearing the Shenzen transit lounge hours of life lost there was very good and cheerful However this is a headsup for snowsports travelers Unless you are in business class you will be charged excess luggage for your snowboard or ski bag unless you pay it when purchasing your airfare They advertise free ski equipment and I am sure my travel agent and I checked to make sure it was true They do but the total length width depth has to be cm or less There is no snowboard or ski bag under that size We somehow missed this fact In business class it is cm which is more than enough but for me it meant a US penalty No pay no boarding pass Be aware when they say they will carry your snowsports gear despite being oversize for general luggage it is not entirely true Very strange for a country trying to promote its own snowsports industry

Pretty good airport Nice restaurant shops and post security amenities They recently finished a terminal expansion project which I must say looks very nice Not many cheap airlines though Overall good airport
You are all so sweet and smiling I travel frequently and for the first time in my life I saw so many smiles and excellent service Well done Keep it up

Hong Kong Airport has not lost its lustre beauty elegance cleanliness And its employees are highly professional respectful and friendly Every time I travel through it I discover something new and this time I discovered the following A breathtaking and Epic view from the Sky Deck In late Hong Kong International Airport opened its new Sky Bridge a metrelong bridge built metres above the ground This is the worlds longest bridge over an active runway allowing even an Airbus A to pass underneath This bridge allows passengers and aviation lovers to enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the airports aircraft movement and watch aircraft take off land and pass beneath them an experience unparalleled at any other airport If you are travelling through Hong Kong Airport you must visit this bridge

A brand new airport opened for Dakar in called Blaise Diagne Its infinitely better than the old one mentioned in other reviews on this page which is no longer in use The new airport is clean and modern with helpful staff Once inside I felt like I was already in Europe I had no problems with security or checked baggage

Juan Santamara International Airport has gotten much better over the years Clean and modern The arrival process customs and immigration are as smooth as they can be Departures are easy too they could do better with the Exit Tax process long lines and no where to fill out the forms I understand some airlines will start allowing you to pay in advance which is excellent The food inside the terminal is ridiculously expensive I paid for a fast food breakfast sandwich I still dont understand why they have to check each carryon bag again at the gate when we were just screened and xrayed going through security It just slows the boarding process down

Wonderful regional airline from Luebeck I had a chance to try this airline and the experience was quite comfortable Boarding procedure is in order and each passenger must disinfect hands The legspace is good and cabin is simple yet neat The crew were happy to engage with passengers and the best part was that they serve a small meal on each flight I really appreciate that and the meal was simple yet very tasty and filling You can even book a veggie meal while booking flight Beyond what LH can even offer on regional flights While deboarding they served caramel candies This experience with Lbeck Air took me back to old school days which I miss terribly in aviation world Keep up the standards and service because this will set you apart

Had a great experience Going through security was fast had no wait time They had great local beers on tap and even a smoking section It costs bucks to enter but considering I havent been in an airport that had one in years it made the wait SO much better will layover in

An enjoyable flight It left on time and check in was easy The seat was quite comfortable for a short flight The staff were very friendly and efficient The food was surprisingly good as well The flight offered refreshments twice In fact more food then my flight on QANTAS from Sydney to Cairns

Nice little airport which I use regularly Queues for passport control can be horrendous as has been said but staff are mostly friendly and facilities are good Plenty of places to eat and drink and you can use dinars in these though not in the Duty Free

Multistop from Munich via Kiev to Istanbul Then back to Munich after some days of holiday in Kiev Perfect flight times all flights landing ahead schedule Great service on the ground and on board Relaxing lounges UIA highly recommended

Nice little airport Size is adequate for the small number of flights a day Departures and arrivals are separate buildings so it is quick to checkin and collect baggage Departure hall is basically a pergola with a shop and a bar but its fine On arrival you get free trolleys which is a bonus

Travelled late Marchearly April Completely empty extremely clean overlooking the runway walking distance from town checkin queue was non existent for me travelling to London Car hire is fine quality food available but all very cosy and empty of huge hordes of people The best airport Ive been too
Clean airplane departed on time Crew were professional and friendly Good announcement from the pilot Offered a cookie and a bottle of water No in flight magazine

Quebec City airport is very clean and comfy Free and fast wifi with no submission or forms to fill or emails to wait for to validate the access The whole terminal is bright and welcoming The seats inside the departure terminal are new and very comfortable The checkin area is very well organised and neat The toilets are very clean On my arrival everything was easy and in the end the only little improvement this airport could make is for the luggage delivery time Apart from this very small detail this airport is just perfect

I booked this flight solely because it was by far the cheapest option for me to get to my destination on new years eve I hadnt known much about Garuda Indonesia before except for the fact that its a star airline I must say I was pleasantly surprised Everything from checkin transfers food and service was excellent I was travelling with my elderly relative for whom wed requested a wheelchair for who was escorted by hand to her seat upon boarding something which Ive ever seen on another airline We had a very tight connection in Jakarta minutes which was managed very well by ground staff at all airports The ground staff at Melbourne Airport assured me that our luggage would be loaded onto the connecting flight I was panicking when our flight from Melbourne departed slightly late due to our already tight connection but the ground staff at Jakarta Airport were preprepared and were ready waiting for us to escort us quickly to our connecting flight and we thankfully made the connection Overall a great experience

We have flown twice into Bermuda and each time were inout in under minutes For an island of just residents I am mightily impressed We really appreciated the smiling and welcoming airport staff along with the friendly curbside taxi operators The new terminal is quite impressive and the signage reflects what is commonly used in other international airports The duty free shops sadly offer no bargain prices In fact alcohol products are cheaper in Hamilton Yes the food offerings in the terminal are quite limited but they do attempt to reflect local culinary tastes While local favorites are mostly featured the prices are high but generally commensurate with elsewhere on the island In fact prices are definitely comparable to any of the NY area airports FACT CHECK Bermuda is an island that largely relies on marine shipments of imported food and supplies including oil and gas Closing Thought I have circled the globe and on reflection choose L F Wade airport as my preferred southern transit stop

I attempted to book a ticket online to travel from Dubbo to Sydney late for a flight It was indicated that there were no seats available for the flight so I booked for My Sister was dying in the Martor Hospital in North Sydney and her Family called me to say she was in a critical condition I phoned Rex and spoke to a lovely Customer Service person This person could see that I had tried to book online and said even though she was not supposed to that she would change my flight from to Thanks to this wonderful person I was able to be with my Sister before she passed on If I had taken the flight my Sister would have passed before I got to say goodbye I very much appreciated this kind gesture

This airport is improving In recent days they had added more space and departure gates also arrival area and baggage belt Security checks is most of the time relatively smooth not so long queue clean toilets Need to improve food options and also lounge experience

Athens to Nuremburg First time I had used or heard of this airline and as it was a very late booking I had little choice The experience was very pleasant The plane was modern clean good legroom comfortable seats The cabin staff were young polite and well dressed Plane was delayed after boarding for minutes due to air traffic control and we were informed by pilot who did his best to make up the time They are pretty strict on hand baggage I have sat on many planes that have been delayed due to excess hand luggage which had to be transferred into the hold This plane loaded very quickly due to one person one bag policy If I have one criticism it would be that there is no online check in system I rarely travel with hold luggage so to have to line up with fellow passengers who had cases was a bit of a pain If however like the majority of passengers you are checking in hold luggage then it is probably not such an issue

As a Bahraini Im really proud of this airport Very neat and clean facilities and very well organized with easy signage and boarding procedures Toilets are super clean and well attended Some cons I would give are a lack of food options and the service at check in counters can be a little slow Additionally I wish there was a Marhaba lounge that allowed access to nonAmex credit card holders as well Other than that bravo
