Small plane E it was but everything moved along efficiently Decent legroom nothing to rave nor complain about but more importantly the boarding process was seamless and so was the disembarking process Baggage arrived with zero issues Worthwhile noting that tickets were expensive though Despite all the negative reviews here its one of the only options from La Paz to Uyuni other than the Todo Turismo tourist bus which we took on the way back and was pretty decent as well so where flights are concerned just cross your fingers and hope for the best Do not be afraid after reading all the negativity here Not all is bad

Excellent location Good services I appreciate the airport but maybe it is necessary to improve the checkin services during the night time Sometimes the terminal electronic system does not work and personnel seem to have problems with the check in

I was really happy for the service provided Although this was a budget airline it did not affect my experience The flight crew were amazing and the pilots the same The only advice or suggestion I would give is allow cabin to accept card payments because not everyone carries cash I would have loved to have purchased a beverage but unable to due to this reason Other than that the experience and all was great and couldnt have asked for anything better

Flew in from Baltimore on Southwest What a great little airport Easy to navigate spotless facilities fast wifi and good options for coffee and snacks A great alternative to Boston for access to Cape Cod

Flew to Dublin yesterday th October after catching train from Preston where I had been working for a few days to Squires Gate which is about a minute walk ADF was a bit of a disappointment but checkin and security a breeze Staff friendly and efficient Depatures lounge was a bit oldfashioned not necessarily a bad thing quite nostalgic really but was very clean and the cafe was good Aer Lingus as always a joy to travel with

Pros The flight attendants were kind and helped us with the wifi for minutes Very helpful mindful and demure The food was great I was not expecting that Legroom was wonderful Me being m there was easily lots of legroom Theseat was hard IFE sucked and dirty floors
Nice small friendly airport Good transport links to the city by bus which meets flights and plenty of taxis A few shops and cafes and very clean facilities

For international flights Lusaka now has a brand new airport and it is considerably better than the old airport which is now only used for domestic flights The new airport is spacious and currently clean and well maintained and well ventilated Check in is usually quite speedy Airside there are a few shops and cafes and currently a basic lounge though another is opening soon My only criticism is limited use of the airbridges but I was told that the airlines need to have a correct tow bar which some have and some do not hence some planes parking and passengers walking tofrom the terminal In rains you can be bussed Lots of immigration officers means it is quite quick to enter Zambia now

I had a fantastic experience at Ben Gurion airport From the moment I arrived everything was smooth and efficient The checkin process was quick security lines were wellorganized and the staff was friendly and professional The terminal was clean spacious and wellmaintained with plenty of seating areas to relax before my flight I was especially impressed with the variety of shops and dining optionsthere was something for everyone Free WiFi was fast and reliable making it easy to get work done while waiting Boarding was handled efficiently and overall the experience was stressfree and friendly I highly recommend this airport for its excellent service and organization Looking forward to flying through here again

We had to return early from a holiday in Dubai and it was considerably cheaper to fly from Sharjah than from Dubai Sharjah is a relatively small airport but has a reasonable duty free area a food court with a number of very reasonably priced outlets and very friendly staff It was very clean and staff were constantly and vigilantly cleaning the public areas Unfortunately the check in desk for Pegasus was very slow and boarding was slow as well Nevertheless a stress free experience Would definitely use Sharjah again

Not much to complain about nowadays there is bus service offered by Centrotrans bus company and GRAS as well from airport to down town Personnel at checkin counter need to be more friendly for example our flight to GOT via BUD was cancelled by Malev but we were issued tickets to fly with Austrian and people at checkin counter were making faces exhaling loudly while printing boarding passes for flight via VIE

Kolkata to Bangkok I have nothing but good things to say about Bhutan Airlines Theyre a great ambassador for their country even though I never set foot in Bhutan I flew from Kolkata to Bangkok on an Airbus in Economy bulkhead Surprisingly I had the row to myself The plane was clean and colorful decked out in Bhutanese red and gold in the interior and the crew were in traditional Bhutanese outfits as well Seats were comfortable we were on time and the flight was only about half full There was a meal on this short hop featuring Bhutanese cuisine and it was truly outstandingone of the best economy class meals Ive had in years Even the inflight magazine was superb highlighting not just places to see and things to do in Bhutan as well as spotlighting some of the more unusual aspects of their culture such as women taking multiple husbands Bottom line it was not just a great transport experience on time hassle free but an educational experience about their home country as well I cant wait to take them all the way to Bhutan

The ground staff in Puerto Princesa Airport and air crew of flight Z were so kind and understanding I have traveled via AirAsia Philippines times and I havent encountered any problems with them I always find their crew friendly The online booking is easier to navigate and payment process is smooth compared to the trouble I experienced with the other local airline

Ive flown via Narita Airport before and always found it to be excellent especially the connection between Terminals and via the free shuttle bus This review is specifically about Terminal which serves only a handful of regional airlines like JetStar Japan Spring and Jeju Air Prepandemic it was a functional but drab location By comparison the new Terminal is absolutely stunning easily the most spacious per number of airlines served Ive ever seen There are huge seating areas several appealing food outlets a bookstore and a Lawsons convenience store The beautiful art work complements the peaceful relaxed atmosphere an immediately noticeable contrast to the crowded scene at most of the worlds terminals I really didnt want to depart Congratulations to those responsible

This is a large airport that is undergoing runway expansion which is very visible on takeoff and landing For a midmorning flight the C concourse was very but not very crowded Seating at the gates can be a premium however we had no difficulty finding seating The connecting hall has all kinds of restaurants both fast food and sit down Airport WiFi is easy to connect and fast The bathrooms are impeccable There is an attendant on duty who is constantly cleaning the bathrooms after every use The attendant greets passengers saying welcome to the cleanest bathrooms in CLT Kudos to Airport management

One member of our party has special needs and requires the special assistance service The airport ground staff were exemplary We travel regularly The assistance kindness efficiency and responsiveness of all the ground staff we encountered was the best that we have experienced I would recommend Rhodes airport as an airport with staff that genuinely assist those with special and additional needs

We recently flew business class New Delhi to Paro and Paro to Bangkok with Druk Air They are a fantastic little airline being only one of two airlines serving Bhutan We were on a trip via Delhi to Paro for nights and then onto Bangkok Both flights on time lounges were shared and and of a good standard Both flights considering Paro being one of the worlds most difficult airports to land in were flawless by the flight deck some amazing views en route and pointed out by the crew Food and beverage were of a high standard and plentiful for hour flights combined with excellent service from very professional and and delightful Bhutanese crew Would certainly use again Only point out being there is no Entertainment or wifi but the views en route you dont need it
Phenomenal airport the best I ever experienced in Europe or anywhere else Just the material definition of how an airport should be Well done Albania

Me and my wife flew up from Copenhagen to Kangerlussuaq and back again The food was perfect The seats where okay but you couldnt lower it to a bed There was no AVOD system but the pre selected movies were great directly from the cinema
Nice small friendly airport Good transport links to the city by bus which meets flights and plenty of taxis A few shops and cafes and very clean facilities

Its pretty good for a budget airline As long as you have followed predeparture guidelines packed properly and have your passport valid visa and PNR number checkin is easy even if it takes a while for people in front of you to repack their bags as they were NOT prepared or were taking chances with their baggage allowance The rest of the flight was uneventful the crew cabin and seating were efficient beyond what you would expect from a budget airline

Our outbound flight was delayed which caused us to miss our connecting flight to Toronto with another airline The delay was due to a late inbound flight This created a small issue in Montreal but the other airline was able to get us on a later flight The flight itself was uneventful Service on board was good flight attendants were fantastic and friendly

Frank Pais International Airport at Hologuin has two terminals one modern deals with international charter and scheduled services and the other older deals with flights to and from Havana My comments relate to the older national terminal The tone is set when passengers see the huge portrait of former President Fidel Castro on the airport terminal plus the slogan on the perimeter wall Socialism or Death This sets the tone for what is usually a pleasant visit to the city of Holguin Incoming passengers walk to the terminal where an excellently designed baggage conveyor promptly brings the luggage to be reclaimed The design of this conveyor requiring passengers simply to reach their suitcases off the belt is in contrast to those at much newer larger UK airports On arrival for your return flight check in is swift and simple and the waiting lounge has somewhat noisy Cuban TV playing loud music all the time

Tular to Antananarivo Quick Checkin on time plane a bit old refreshments and a snack served friendly flight attendants The fare was somehow high but this is Madagascar You shouldnt come here if you are pampered by lowcost carriers

We arrived on Monarch which was a great flight from London Gatwick on arrival to Mahon we swiftly disembarked into a very cool air conditioned Arrivals lounge where bags took no more than minutes to reach the conveyors Everything else went smoothly and we proceeded to car rental so all in all I estimate we were on are way to Villa less than an hour of arriving On the return had no problems at check in had a polite and friendly check in lady Aircraft was on time All in all a very good experience of Mahon airport from start to finish
Nordavia has been renamed as Smartavia and reviews can be found on this new linkSmartavia Reviews

Guayaquil Airport is modern and clean but if you arrive on a domestic flight there is no transit You need to go out and do checkin and security Arrivals can be crowded and staff are not that friendly The one smile that I got was from the girl selling chocolates at the store inside

Very swift through check in and security was fairly smooth with around a minute wait so positive in these areas However the departure lounge facilities are woefully inadequate with twice a many people in the area than it was fit to hold There were a many people sitting lying on the floor as there were able to get seats to sit on Only a handful of restaurants which were bursting full with queues running out into the corridors People seemed to be waiting up to an hour just to get an order taken Other than the duty free shop there was little else available only a small WH Smith WH very limited food options and huge queues If they want to have this many passengers they need to make the facilities available for them Very poor and not that safe

Very friendly clean and organized Still in need of more modern technology but above all for being in a poor country it delivers a good service nice food court and souvenir shops although the latter are pricey It has something for everyone

Dar es Salaam to Lilongwe via Blantyre Both legs on a Dash Q the seats still have the same colors as Ethiopian and information is displayed both in English and Amharic Booking and online CheckIn both go through the website of Ethiopian and are smooth as long as the standard Android browser is not used Baggage Drop Off at Dar Airport is also handeled well and staff is friendly turns out to be the crew of the flight The flight leaves Dar at in the morning and takes hours to Blantyre during which a hot breakfast is served My preordered vegetarian option included hashbrowns beans greens and a grilled tomato Surprisingly tasty The aircraft is as noisy as a turboprop is but in a good condition and clean The crew is friendly and welcoming but I could feel that Malawian is a small airline and not so experienced as Ethiopian for example would be Flight to Blantyre was on time stopover quick minutes onward passengers can stay in the aircraft and the short hop to Lilongwe also on time Putting the flight in a nutshell as Malawian is a small airline with only aircraft Dash and and only a handful of destinations in East Africa the flight was surprisingly good and I would fly them again

Lovely airport and great shops for an airport of this size Paying a the counter for taxis removes the touts that descend on you in other places Food options are limited but then who would want to spend too long checking in too early and getting hungry when on such a lovely island

Spotless short flight with NIKI operated with a very clean and good looking plane polite crew and ontime departurearrival which is more than enough for me to be satisfied about this short hop to Vienna where I had to attend a congress A big plus is they fly from Linate airport which is much closer to my house than Malpensa and this is why I did not fly Austrian as I usually do for this route Their website worked well so checkingin online was very easy both ways I will surely fly them again inside Europe

Mildura Airport is the rd busiest airport in Victoria Australia and is serviced by three airlines Virgin Australia QantasLink and of course Rex It has three gates a great bar really clean check in and the people are nice with the perfect amount of seats They do not have aerobridges obiously a really modern airport its just great

Flew SkyWork Airlines from Berlin to Bern You can eckeck in hrs before flight Both flights were on time Cabin was clean and legroom standard Service was friendly and they offer coffee and pie for lunch Airport was small but there was a bustrain connection to the town I would recommend them

TallinnAmsterdam is a short flight but crew were nice helpful and were able to understand at least languages they helped my Dutch Grandmother who speaks no English Amenities not normally provided but because flight was near empty they gave out snacks plus complementary tea and coffee They also allowed us to sit in vacant seats which was nice In general a nice trip and much more than was expected for basically a regional airline

Cape Town to Johannesburg The SLOW lounge in the Cape Town domestic terminal is a maelstrom of activity around lunchtime but at least theres an impressive spread of food Boarding was the now usual queuing on the ramp and airbridge but passengers were sensibly allowed on at both ends of the plane Service was efficient although lacking BAs homegrown friendliness The Comair fourcourse meal was adequate but not up to the best that Club Europe offers A late departure was compensated for along the way and our bags were moreorless first off the carousel Overall a decent flight

Flew in to SavannahHilton Head International September and departed October Once again an absolute pleasure to use My wife and I use this airport frequently when we travel to Hilton Head Island South Carolina On arrival my wife goes straight to the car rental desks about yards from baggage reclaim and I get the baggage from the belt Baggage retrieval usually takes minutes or so and by this time the car rental formalities have just about been completed The cars are just outside the Terminal doors and in about minutes we are on the Interstate On departure checking in with United Express is a breeze after handing back the rental car and then there is a very pleasant courtyard with retail caf outlets before going through security Even through security there are a surprising number and variety of eating and drinking outlets with a few retail shops Usual caveat if you have a late departure they may not all be open If only all Airports were this charming and nice to use

What great TSA staff have at St PeteClearwater Airport The lines moved smoothly and additional lines were opened when it became crowded The food court consists of one small shop where the food is OK Looking forward to going through this airport again on Sunday

In August Johannesburg to Maun and Kisane to Johannesburg Both flights were spot on time Service on board was fine with drinks and light snacks served for the roughly hour flight in each direction Aircrafts were in good shape and the seats comfortable for this type of trip Checkin in Joburg was easy and very quick Check in in Kisane was a breeze as the airport is tiny All in a good experience and a great way to enhance your Botswana experience

The arrivals area is pretty shabby but from disembarking the plane to getting on the bus to St Helier took less than minutes We departed from Jersey late afternoon on a Saturday when it was very quiet and so it was a very pleasant experience The staff at security and in the shops were all helpful and charming For the size of the airport the selection of shops and food were decent although there did seem to be a lack of seating after security however there was plenty at the gate
Melbourne to Nouma Surprisingly very good airline and good business seat for a three hours flight Very good staff and very good product in business Among them Nikko Japanese whisky

Ljubljana to Munich The homebase airport of Adria Airways is Ljubljana and it very small relaxing and convenient It is surrounded by the Alps and the departure was fantastic The airplane was modern and the crew was nice Ontime departure Drinks without alcohol were free and I paid for my white wine Considering that I had a cheap ticket I cannot complain Upgrades would have been available for which includes the lounge

Recife Airport is definitely the best airport I have been through in Brazil The scenery coming in to land is impressive The architecture of the building is very modern and excellent use is made of natural lighting There is an excellent observation deck on the second floor with a good selection of restaurants and shopping outlets The first floor is departures and the ground floor is arrivals Selection is good landside and even airside there are enough options for an early flight including a hour coffee shop Security is extremely tough Be prepared to take off belt shoes wallet etc Checkin machines strategically placed and few queues although my departing flight was at am maybe the situation is different during the day I arrived at lunch time though and no problems either Excellent connections into Boa Viagem and downtown via bus Aeroporto Opcional passes in front of airport very frequent daytime only Taxis are also readily available a trip to Boa Viagem Beach shall be about R which is about USD The airport deserves more international traffic as Recife is a major tourist hub Current flights only to Frankfurt Condor Panama City Copa and Lisbon TAP A tip if you are flying out of Recife be sure to take some bolo de rolo with you Its a local delicacy a kind of guava cake

London Gatwick to Podgorica The Fokker seats were comfortable in formation but they were small and legroom was limited Crew members were helpful and attentive We were served a couple of drinks and a fairly basic sandwich but it was fine It was cheaper for me to book a ticket to Belgrade via Podgorica than it was just to Podgorica I told the checkin staff I wanted to get off at Podgorica and that was fine

A wonderful flight from Tehran to Paris with new A that was very modern Good entertainment system but only a small number of film and music choices but a very good flight map The aircraft was very clean Two meals were served first a very good breakfast and a snack later

Highly recommended airline offering excellent value for money I booked my flight from Bali to Doha via Xiamen and received three full meals a hour entry permit to explore Xiamen during my hour transit a free single hotel room and a free shuttle from airport to hotel all for It is simply incredible to believe that you can fly from Bali to China to Doha for only

We have used this airport in the past there is noticeable improvement in the facilities and services The check in are is spacious with adequate seating and few shops The check in process was smooth and the security swift and friendly After security there is a large waiting area with free newspapers and view of the apron the separture lounge is upstairs and they have aerobridges A good regional airport if you want to go to see the Big Cat Tigers

Shinchitose airport is really effective A lot of souvenir shops and wonderful musiam in the airport A brand new international terminal will be open in Great hotels and various amusement things are worth of expecting

Note that the airport departure tax is SP for over s All taxis from airport are run by private company and are fixed rate The cost is around All previous comments re chaos at departure excessive zeal by document checking officials overcrowding etc are still as relevant as ever A thoroughly depressing experience in what is a friendly generous and wonderful country

The flight took off and landed on time boarding was efficient and the crew were friendly I have no complaints I ignored an offered opportunity to upgrade to business class but did take up the chance to block off the next seat for which was great So often I have watched Luxair planes at London City and wondered how the flights would be Turns out I was impressed

Kamair could do a lot better with the Kabul Dubai flight the food is still lousy the hostess busy closing curtains to do make up and laze around That is the customer care side of things On the security side of things it looks they are finally waking up My flight to Dubai on rd July was surprising though our luggage was let on the rain as the loaders sheltered under the wings the boarding well done under the supervision of two foreign looking gentlemen a security manager and a safety manager who though serious looking and thorough in their work they smiled at us and even greeted passengers as they boarded That was heart warming to say the least

How refreshing for an airport free wifi free minutes parking for passenger pickup abundant electrical outlets under seats a splendid Aviation Historical Museum friendly TSA security welcome home free cookies free shuttle to your car long term parking per day which is closer than the short term in most airports even if it costs a little more to fly out of Fort Wayne it is worth it

On our flight with LAN we had to change flights in Sao Paulo to TAM Airlines retrieve our luggage and check it in again as we were flying a domestic flight to Rio and then to Santiago There wasnt much time between the connections in Sao Paulo and going through immigration and changing terminals made it almost impossible With minutes before departure we didnt have our luggages checked in and there was a big line at the counter The staff on ground made a great job in checking our baggage and then taking us to the plane in a minibus as we were the last ones to board The luggage arrived safe in Santiago and both flights were on time On the way to Rio there was a new A with lots of leg room and for Santiago an old A which gave us a lotof trouble with many turbulences The food served on TAM wasnt different from the one of LAN but the staff were extremely friendly Still the experience in Sao Paulo looked very chaotic to us and we would prefer LAN for further flights

Busy regional airport with many flights to South Korea Manila and other Philippine airports Airbridges and some remote stands Opened in and relatively modern in terms of layout with level for departures and one for arrivals Speed of baggage retrieval very good and distances from arrival to the carpark opposite the airport very short Free WiFi available

I travelled last December to Saint Martin with the new Dominican airline PAWA Dominicana The service was pretty good The flight was punctual cabin crew was kind and served a pretty good snack some chips and the drink that you wanted On the return flight was the same treatment but there was a hours delay because of the traffic over SXM and SJU but the service was the same with nice treatment They have some old airplanes but in a good condition the interior of the MD was shiny and clean They also have DC but I havent flown that

I was travelling with sight impaired friends Assistance was prebooked with Easyjet I cannot praise the staff highly enough We arrived late at night and we were wheeled very efficiently and cheerfully The staff cared for us very well and made sure we got safely to our taxi

Arrived on the last evening flight from Barcelona tourist desk very helpful and received our luggage within minutes No taxis available so took the airport bus driver was very helpful and even dropped us a short distance from our hotel

Arrived in Paro airport at pm There WERE flights that had arrived Immigration was quick and the staff were very polite We got our bags and we left the airport in less than minutes For our departure check in took minutes and immigration another The departure lounge is small but adequate Lots of craft shops and a few places to eat Very casual airport and the staff are very friendly The cafe food was however awful but the coffee was nice Wifi available but kept disconnecting All in all a charming little airport for this stunning country
Little airport very nice Not many dining choices not very important for me because it was a late flight Fast boarding procedure Pleasant view of the tarmac

Had a wonderful flight There was a female black flight attendant who looked after my pregnant daughter and I very well She went into depth about flight safety and when we arrived at our destination gave advice on how to manage the hot weather She was pleasant and friendly to everyone

Xian to London on th Feb Aircraft only years old Good amount seat recline with charger available however the entertainment system need an upgrade It is the coronavirus outbreak at moment the crew did an excellent job measuring temperature and disinfected the aircraft Excellent cabin service I went back to spoke with cabin crew they are willing to share their stories and experiences The lack of entertainment system is covered by the excellent crew service

Santiago de Chile to Isla de Pascua Had the opportunity to fly with LAN from Santiago de Chile to Easter Islands a trip I had been expecting tor a long time Although the LAN web site indicated that you should report to checkin a whole hours before scheduled departure time I decided to play it cool and only arrive at the Santiago airport at for a am flight just to see that checkin was still well in progress without any rush Upon boarding the Boeing I just loved the cabin interior very light and roomy with nice LED lights around When finding my seat I soon realised however how small it was Im sure is the narrowest airplane seat Ive ever seen and the legroom was very short for someone of cm I was happy that I was only going to spend hours and not on this plane However I soon found the IFE which offered a great selection of top recent films certainly far too many for this six hours flight As I hadnt downloaded the LAN application on my tablet beforehand there would have been even a greater choice of entertainment available for this flight Soon after takeoff an excellent breakfast with fresh fruit and an omelette was served During the rest of the flight drinks and coffee were served several times The best part of this flight was however the Chilean LAN cabin crew The steward serving my section was chatting around making jokes and asking several times if I needed something more This is the kind of service I would have expected in First Class but here I was enjoying it in Economy Well done LAN

The flight was a bit late departing from Gaya but I wondered if we would even fly given the dense fog The flight was beautiful scenic in a half empty cabin with cleanest and beautiful interior The crew distributed snacks and drinks quickly and we could enjoy our view Everything was really nice and their flight magazine is informative of the country and sites A really beautiful experience

Another pretty solid trip with Jet A full package holiday was booked through them and they did not disappoint The flight times were good as they offered a decent early flight to get there and a leisurely enough time to return Checkinbag drop at Belfast was quick and easy with friendly staff and the boarding process was fast and well managed leaving the experience hassle free Onboard the plane was clear well kept and pleasant decent leg room for taller passengers as well The inflight shopping options seemed OK although this wasnt something that I would usually avail of however food and drink options were good enough Not bad in terms of range and price to match granted more than you would want to pay on the High Street but OK for a flight The staff really made the experience good with the crew friendly and very efficient getting food and drinks out quickly and picking up the rubbish after in good time Jet has been like this the last few times weve travelled with them so hoping this keeps up

Hollywood Burbank Airport is a perfectly splendid airport and a notsoperfectlyspendid airport simultaneously What do I mean Well first Long Beach is my favorite airport in the Los Angeles area with Burbank a respectable second I find them to be more pleasant than especially LAX and even Orange County The feeling of flying into and out of Burbank is one of aviation yesteryear of sorts think sort of like the show Wings Driving onto the airport and following the signage to the terminal and car rental return is simple and straightforward Dropoff and pickup areas in the front of the terminal are simply and clearly delineated though sometimes difficult to access given the constant flow of traffic in that area which is still nowhere remotely as bad as LAX but remember Burbanks terminal is old Walking into the airport you clearly have a feeling of sera Art Deco architecture something really Americana and unique even as American airports go Checkin for either American or Southwest is a breeze no sarcasm no lip service all business but still pleasant Seating and flooring pre and postsecurity is a little aged and worn in some areas and could really stand to be improved but theyre also no worse than much of LAX Shopping and dining options are very limited even by small airport standards surprising considering that we are still in the greater Los Angeles area after all The staff at the car rental facilities are generally helpful and professional though actually friendliness is hitandmiss Ive never met anybody rude there though TSA personnel seem to be the most truly hitandmiss either sugarcoatedly friendly and jovial or aloof and grumpy almost to the point of being rude To TSAs credit here though they are amazingly efficient even by small airport standards whether you have TSA PreCheck or not There has been a proposal by the airport authority to effectively construct a new terminal in the place of the existing terminal which would be a shame to have materialize with the charming existing terminal could just be renovated and modernized while keeping its rich history in tact In all Burbank is a good airport with some notable warts but positive experiences to be had hard to rave about but still easy to like

Good transport connection via BAB Moderate parkingrates close to the terminals CheckIn only minutes prior to departure Short distances More than daily flights major Star Alliance hubs MUC and FRA and direct flights to holiday destinations Daily lowcost flights to London STN Vienna Rome FMO is a good choice for travellers in northern NRW western Niedersachsen and eastern Holland who want to start their journeys business travel as welll as holiday travel relaxed and in a friendly atmosphere

Thank you so much for a wonderful service Nurit and her great teamstaff were professional attentive friendly and very helpful I was traveling with my mom and they made it easier for me and took care of her needs Id like to thank you all for being so nice and giving such a great service Youre awesome Arzo Diana Chen and special thanks to Mara In addition the food was great

Moroni to Moheli Turned out to be a pretty decent airline Online booking worked well checkin and boarding was fine and the plane looked well maintained Its a very short flight just minutes or so so i didnt expect much but they still managed to hand our a bottle of water and some biscuits which i though was very nice Both flights on time

Pyongyang to Beijing with hotcold drinks and a hamburger which was adequate for length of flight Very polite and welcoming service Efficient check in and boarding In flight entertainment limited to a video of recent North Korean hits Pyongyang Times and Korea Today available to take on board

My Mom required wheel chair service and we received superb service especially on our departure by Devon He ran to get my Mom as there was a gate change and looked for me as I was getting a snack for her None of the crew advised us but there was Devon with his wonderful smile

Pleasant smaller airport Parking is easy as is dealing with rental cars if necessary Ive used both Tucson and Phoenix Airports Phoenix had a direct flight and was less expensive for traveling between Boston and Tucson From now on Ill be using Tucson Airport due to the ease of access and human scale

I arrived on a national flight from Guadalajara The gates of the Tijuana Airport are quite modern with jetways at each gate There are restaurants and shops along the concourse It was necessary to have my passport checked by an immigration officer who saw it was a US passport and waved me through without looking at it The customs inspection was minimal The baggage claim area is OK When I checked in for my departing flight I found passengers were required to go through screening and customs inspection to enter the checkin area It is possible to exit and go outside while awaiting boarding time after you check in The street entrance to the airport is under construction and it is necessary to walk past the boardedoff areas to enter the terminal There is a bus station at the airport right by the terminal for shuttle buses to CA Overall this airport is not bad and will be very good once construction is completed

From the moment you set foot inside Dublin Airport immediately distinguishes itself as a beacon of luxury especially noticeable within the sleek and sophisticated confines of Terminal Its modern aesthetic and design set it apart from the majority of international airports presenting an atmosphere not just of transit but of refined travel experience The layout of Dublin Airport is a testament to thoughtful design and planning The checkin areas are remarkably clear and wellorganized making navigation a breeze for travelers This accessibility extends throughout the airport with ample space lifts and escalators ensuring that everyone regardless of mobility can easily move around Perhaps most impressive is the airports commitment to leveraging cuttingedge technology for security processes The advanced systems in place mean that passengers dont need to remove liquids or electronics from their bags streamlining what is often a cumbersome process This efficiency is further highlighted by the minimal queues with most travelers getting through security in less than five minutesa clear indication of Dublin Airports effective use of technology and operational management The warmth and helpfulness of the staff at Dublin Airport cannot go unmentioned Each interaction is marked by genuine care making the travel experience exceptionally personal and pleasant Dublin Airport also excels in its retail and dining offerings The dutyfree selection is impressive featuring soughtafter brands and exclusive products at prices that challenge those of high street shops The food outlets including some newly launched ones offer a wide array of options catering to diverse tastes and dietary needs all at reasonable prices For travelers seeking a moment of tranquility or needing to attend to work the airport provides numerous lounges and workspaces alongside impeccably clean toilets and abundant seating areas Navigation through the airport is foolproof with gates clearly marked and the overall layout intuitively designed Also has free reliable WiFi unlike other major airports A unique feature that sets Dublin Airport apart on the global stage is its US Customs and Border Protection Preclearance facility allowing travelers to complete all immigration procedures before boarding This means arriving in the USA as if on a domestic flight bypassing the usual long queues upon arrivalan invaluable convenience In summary Dublin Airport is not just a travel hub but a remarkable experience in its own right Its commitment to luxury modernity and efficiency makes it a mustuse airport for anyone looking to elevate their travel experience The seamless blend of advanced technology outstanding customer service and thoughtful amenities positions Dublin Airport as a hidden gem in the world of air travel My advice Run dont walk to Dublin Airport for your next journey Its an experience that not only facilitates travel but inspires more of it

Brilliant Airline Very pleasantly surprised I recently flew with Oman Air on two sectors One was very short haul and one was mid range Both flights were nice The crew were polite and helpful the food was very good and the IFE was quite impressive The planes were clean and comfortable The prices were very competitive

Airport was new and very nice Immigration friendly and welcoming Nice first impression on Egypt upon arrival Washroom need to be cleaned regularly though Other than that its a very nice airport for travellers to Alexandria

I took GOL twice for domestic flights during a recent trip to Brazil I chose the extra legroom seats which were available for a reasonable surcharge and offered plenty of legroom Overall the flights were comfortable and on time All passengers were offered a small snack and a drink I would choose GOL again

Stockholm Vsters is a tiny airport located around minutes drive west of Stockholm The name is therefore misleading as Vsters is a proper mediumsized town in its own right The place has a very friendly easygoing feel to it There is very little to do save buy a cup of coffee or something stronger if thats to your taste but then I have never had course to spend more than minutes at the airport There are special very efficient buses to Stockholm and elsewhere which connect with incoming and outgoing Ryanair flights It is also possible to take a regular bus into Vsters A totally hasslefree calm place to begin or end a journey
Out on QF on Premium Economy back on QF Business Class Premium economy very good and business class great Cabin crew really good and service superb

Ive flown in and out of BJX a half dozen times and have no problems Take along a book or knitting as there are only a couple of souvenir shops but they are colorful and reasonable My destination has been San Miguel de Allende the art colony thats popular with US citizens

Overall I like BHM Its small staff at least at Delta check in and gate are super friendly The amenities are good for a small regional airport Bags are usually quick to retrieve My one gripe is parking The parking deck is always almost very nearly completely full so finding a space can often take as long as the short flight to connect in ATL The one other thing that annoys me every time I do find a space is total lack of smart carts in the parking lots Hey listen up Airport managers This is an airport and customers travel with baggage Dont you think it would be a great idea to facilitate this process of getting bags to terminals by offering a cart service in the parking lots

One of the nicest and cleanest airports Ive experienced Thoughtful touches are everywhere from the piano in the food court to bags for wet umbrellas to a cart of peanuts and pretzels from Delta identical to what they give out in flight at the baggage claim Bathrooms are spotless And clocks throughout the airport

The more I travel the more I appreciate Port Moresbys Jacksons International Airport Whilst the speed at checkin is dependent on the systems sometimes it takes longer but usually its quite fast its always a breeze moving through this terminal from checkin to security to immigration and into the departure lounge The lounge itself has great seating with good food options and drink options as well as shopping POM isnt Changi but then again Changi is matchless

Very Crowded check in and long security lines However once past security it was a very clean and nice airport Not enough seats in the gate area however Just know where you are going and leave plenty of time before your flight

My first experience with this regional airline on a short hop from PointaPietre to Melville Hall Very pleasant and relaxed flight nice staff and decent leg and hand luggage space Will be happy to fly with them at any time again

Economy class SVOIST BER RegRA First of let me start by sharing the details I paid around for the ticket and it granted me cabin baggage and bag for the under seat i bought additional checked bag of kg max for around Seat selections were cheaper for the middle and more expensive for the window I paid for AYou could chose your meal before without any cost latest hours prior to the flight there was a lot of options but I chose not to chose and eat the standard meal given on the flight It was the best flight i have ever had Crew was super helpful greeted us at the beginning were helping some passengers to put their luggage in the overhead bins Blankets were handed when requested The seats were comfortable had plenty of legroom my recommendation for the view is A or K because it will have two windows Safety instructions were given as normal and we rocketed out of SVO Moscow During the meal service turbulence occured and they had to stop it several times in the we got our food they had choices for the breakfast I opted for an omlet it was very good served with a small salad salami butter jam croissant and a bar of chocolate with and aeroflot a picture on its packaging whereas there was also Russian pancake blincikhi with raspberry available and a msli kind of option Because of the turbulence only cold drinks were served during that period but hot drinks were available with a request this was announced several times by the crew There was meal service and service of drinks Lavatories were clean nothing special Inflight Entertainment was OK and they were also an Aeroflot magazine and a duty free catalogue We departed Minutes late from scheduled arrived Minutes early Crew made sure everyone had a nice flight They saw us off as wishing the best and hoping meet again in future I can surely say that they were happy with us being on that plane they were doing their job amazing Thanks for the flight Aeroflot hope to meet again

First time flying with Jet they didnt disappoint We flew on a new A neo aircraft Crew were friendly efficient We got drinks services going but only coming home We paid for inflight meals both ways tea coffee or hot chocolate were included The food was very good hot Drinks were good value

We were running late due to high traffic in Ayodhya owing to Kumbh Mela Akasa helped us by providing buffer minutes at boarding This helped us in arriving to the flight in time They have ensured that our boarding is faster so that overall flight time wont get delayed As soon as we are seated flight took off within mins This did not result in any delay

A superb little airport just one small building really Not many major airlines fly to Avignon so there are only one or two plane loads of passengers in the airport at any time Most of the time yours is the only large aeroplane and you are met at the door to the airport by friendly customs officers most sporting superb Gallic moustaches You can see your luggage being loaded onto the carousel very efficient and the exit from the airport is less than metres from the luggage hall The three or so checkin desks seem efficient and all staff most accomodating All in all a most friendly little airport that will hopefully avoid commercialisation that ravages its British counterparts

Small but good airport I visited it two weeks ago and I found it to be clean Its true that there not many people principally fligths of SAS and Norwegian but I liked it especially the after control zone where two barrestaurants The checkin zone is clean and well organized with an active information point Positive general impression from this airport

Ive been to Wroclaw Airport times Its fast convenient beautiful airport doesnt matter if it is arrival or departure The variety of shops and restaurants is adequate and the prices are normal airport prices A very clean terminal that is one of the prettiest terminals Ive been to Toilets are very clean Only problem is absence of air conditioning in buses between terminal and airplane its very disappointing and uncomfortable in summer

Return Edinburgh to London City BAs CityFlyer remains the most pleasant way to get to and from London from Edinburgh The Embraer has much better legroom than the so look out for the type flying when booking The blue leather seats and layout make for comfort Trip to London City on Oct at on the EMB was wholly smooth Fantastic view of the three Forth bridges on departure So much legroom and space and Im ft in st On time more or less pleasant crew and a free breakfast of bacon rolls or a platter of fruit salad and organic yoghurt Water and hot drinks Just what was needed LCY is so easy to get through in arrival and I was on the DLR to the city in minutes flat A great start to the day Returning home on Oct at the on the smaller EMB was much less comfortable due to turbulence for at least mins thanks to the tail of a US hurricane passing over GB The reassuring captain apologised several times and explained he was trying to get clearance to a higher level Good to be kept informed The crew were marvellous Kind cheerful the best of BA Drinks and snacks served despite the plane lurching about All comp including a good Glenlivet malt Edinburgh arrival fine and into tram within mins of touchdown These jets arent new and it does show a bit but its a cutabove experience still compared to the alternatives The tickets to LCY on the travel app I use are a little more than Gatwick but if you can miss the absolute peak flights the difference isnt much and to me anyway worth it for the good service and central location and efficiency of London City Airport
I have went with Novair four times OSLLPA x OSLTFS OSLFUE Great service good looking planes comfortable seats No delays new clean A The only less good thing the food

The airport is clean and not large Signposts are clear Passengers can get around easily Employees are friendly and helpful Security check is efficient The prices charged at food outlets are reasonable

A totally stressfree experience as sampled on a return charter flight from the Tampa Bay area Just eight departure gates but ample seating and a friendly barcafe No TSA hassle either A good gateway to Biloxi the Mississippi Gulf Coast and even Mobile AL Close to I

MalagaSan Sebastian Approach looked a bit dodgy as the airport is sandwiched between the Pyrenees and the sea but in reality it was a gentle descent From aircraft to baggage yards Baggage arrived very rapidly my host had parked in the free carpark only another yards away Clean modern airport not actually in San Sebastian but Irun about minutes from the French border very convenient for Biarritz

I tried to arrange a group trip with SyrianAir from London to Aleppo via Damascus and back Initially all was fine until they cancelled the first leg of the journey to Damascus a week prior to us leaving The next flight was days later but there was no immediate plane to Aleppo once we had arrived at Damascus which meant we would have to take a bus up instead a journey we werent too keen on While friendly the staff are fairly useless and I sat for MANY hours trying to sort things out We changed the flights to stay the same number of days but decided to go to Aleppo at the tail end of the trip under our own steam and the fly Allepo to London again via Damascus on the same ticket Unfortunately the staff didnt really get the group concept and kept issuing tickets for the wrong dates for different members of the group It took too many visits to their offices in Baker Street to finally get everyone on the same flights at the same time The flight to Syria was fine late and we managed to get up to Aleppo ourselves but the day before we were to fly out again we went into the Syrian air offices to confirm everything was ok IT WAS NOT They had cancelled the flight to Damascus without informing any of us and we had to arrange a midnight bus from Aleppo to Damascus Airport to make the correct flight back to London Luckily this one hadnt been cancelled But it was late My advice Dont Fly SyrianAir and if you do check on your flights constantly

Intersky is another airline charging high prices for regional services using and chartering cheap airlines Just flew back from SZG to ZRH Friendly stewardess and good service captain did not say a word Even though Intersky is the only direct Service between SZG and ZRH I would rather fly LH via Frankfurt

This is a great airport and the T terminal is newly established everything inside this airport are symbols of a modernized airport Staff were friendly and helpful in helping directing me to the baggage claim area upon arrival as well as help me check in efficiently by asking my seat preference which I havent experienced during check in before Only disadvantage would be the WiFi in the airport when I arrived in the airport I do not have a Chinese mobile phone and in order to connect to the airport WiFi I need to have a valid Chinese phone number so I could receive verification code unlike my transfer flight in Guangzhou where I could simply connect to the WiFi using my WeChat account Overall my experience with WNZ is great but please fix the WiFi issue so international traveler can connnect to the WiFi

My bag disappeared into the abyss of their care and weeks later Im left with nothing but their hollow promises echoing in my ears Their customer service call begins with empathy sprinkled with reassuring phrases like Well escalate this immediately Spoiler alert immediately is Aer Lingus code for never Ive given up hoping theyll find my belongings Im now just curious if their lost luggage department is a black hole where all the unclaimed bags of the world congregate for a wild party Aer Lingus if youre reading this I dont need another scripted apology I need my bag or reimbursement

Hua Hin airport offers a direct connection to the resort city of Hua Hin and the surrounding towns of Prachuap and Cha Am and saves the visitor the relative hassle of a and half hour bus ride from BKK airport and a similar time from DMK Don Meuang Bangkoks other airport Especially if you are coming from Malaysia The only airline currently operating a service into Hua Hin is Air Asia God bless them from Kuala Lumpur to Hua Hin The route has been a success and rumour has it that other routes will open up from Hua Hin ideally Chiang Mai to begin with OK to the airport review Its a relatively simple regional airport With checkin counters a small snack counter and adequate seating in the checkin area You go upstairs by escalator to passport control security and then the departure lounge again with adequate seating and a bathroom There is plenty of car parking by the airport and about metres out of the main gate is a Family Mart like a which sells snacks To get in to Hua Hin you can catch a taxi or walk out the gate and catch a Green songtao baht to town then another baht if going on in the direction of Market Village and Khao Takiab One of the pleasures of using the Air Asia service is that as the plane pulls away from the terminal building the ground staff wave you goodbye Thai gesture of respect its a nice touch Anyway many thanks to Hua Hin airport and Air Asia for making this route a reality

A small domestic airport in Taiwan Fast and friendly staff Surprisingly many shops Looked very clean Because this is a military airport too you can spot military aircraft taking off and land taking photos is forbidden though On time nonchaotic boarding and the plane took off in schedule Recommend

Great experience using Norwich airport Efficient and cheerful checkin personnel Compact WH Smith outlets land and airside Fast friendly and helpful security people Sweet little duty free Great hotcold snacksdrinks areas Lots of seating with airfield and runway view Downside was no development fee spent on arrivals Walk from aircraft hoping its not raining then queuing under draughty plasticcovered outside waiting area before clearing customs Not good TIP On arrival phone whoever is picking you up to let them know youve arrived its best if they wait for you away from the airport Most planes arrive late so the minute parking fee becomes

I enjoyed my flight aboard Air Zimbabwe from Harare to Johannesburg the crew were very friendly and the service was excellent We arrived ahead of schedule checkin was fast and smooth and the seats were comfortable
The plane was modern and the cabin very clean and appealing The crew was very friendly and professional Fast check in and at Belgrade Airport the suitcases arrived very fast

Firstly poor info there is no airport mapplan nowhere on internet let alone on their web site The good info should also include that the trolleybus minibus works from till So the airport is OK and the queuing times are good At the arrival one waits up tp some min if there are no other planes passengers coming The taxi people are annoying but bearable The airport is practically in the outskirts suburbia and well communicated by minibus also one can walk some min to the nearest tram line if they wished trams work till There is a kiosk with food and drinks plus a freezer with icecream Several exchange offices rates are a bit worse than those of the city centre vs per euro No shopping in departures is rather a pleasant surprise

Flew Lublin to Heraklion Very comfortale trip without delays friendly helpful and professional crew good amtosphere on board everything fast and without problems I felt safe during the journey and I think that I will choose Small Planet for my next year holiday

This is my home airport so I fly in and out regularly Recent renovations to the central area make it even nicer Fully carpeted soothing music big windows everywhere There is an observation deck open to the public on the nonsecurity side that has good views This is an easy airport in which to get around

Small super convenient airport Its small but efficient Has one food counter with the really good food Better than most airports Have to walk out on tarmac to plane Arrival and exiting are quick and easy Wait about minutes to minutes for bag and out the front door in steps Outside attendant are great The give directions and keep pick up lines organized enough Gets a for Convenience

Travelled in transit LGWTIPACC back in November and on both outward and return legs I found the staff helpful and courteous Although the airport may not be up to the international standards of LHR or AMS nonetheless a compact tidy terminal It also has an excellent duty free shop Remember though that Libya is a dry country The only Becks you can buy is non alcoholic

After so many negative comments I believe a positive is in order Honolulu to Lanai check in a breeze courteous and friendly we paid per bag but now only Flight basically on time aircraft ATR quite comfortable after all flight is only minutes Flight attendants very friendly juice and water offered Bags delivered promptly Will fly them back to HNL and will only post if flight is any less enjoyable

I have flown tofrom RDU times now at different times and hours during I must say that it is one of the best run midtier airports in the country Beautiful and thoughtful design airy and welcoming extremely clean and efficient The security wait times have always been under mins Decent food and shopping options too Its hard to fault this one just needs to step up when it comes to wifi and entertainment options Otherwise its a great airport

Upon arriving home after a lovely Thanksgiving trip I patiently awaited my luggage at the Southwest baggage claim My bag is very distinct and when it didnt come through I knew it was elsewhere I took my baggage claim sticker over to the office and the staff were absolutely wonderful He kindly assisted me and had a genuine demeanour that reassured me my bag would arrive later He told me where it was and when it would arrive Later in the afternoon he called me right at the time he said he would to alert me of my suitcases arrival When I went to pick it up he was so kind and polite to me I appreciated his enthusiasm and positivity He is truly a wonderful example of great customer service I wish all airport staff were as welcoming

New airport building opened in August Large and airy construction gives a positive feeling to airport experience International Arrivals involve a bit of walking to the Baggage Reclaim and International Arrivals which happen on the ground floor Car Rental Caf and Bureau de Change all within the terminal building Bus Taxi and Tram are out by the front door Undercover walkways connect to short stay car parks Departures are on the st floor with the usual automated checkin Security pretty quick with more capacity when things get busy The Departure Lounge overlooks the end of the runway and has air bridges to most departure gates some bus departures for small aircraft parked remotely Good selection of shops and cafes A big improvement on the old terminal building

We arrived well in time for our flight and stood in line for terminal entrance During our time in Pakistan we have been guided to the front of lines quite a few times so were not surprised that this happened here as well by members of airport staff We gave a small tip when inside but soon they asked for big amounts of western money we gave which is quite a lot for Pakistani standards they wanted We ripped away our luggage and walked away They dripped off Once inside long lines for passport control lounges closed but a decent departure hall with enough seating

This review is about the new Siem Reap International Airport that began operations on October It was my first time at this airport and was taking the long hour trip by the post office bus Besides a big nice golden Buddha statue there is nothing decorative cultural paintings etc at this new airport Despite having an invitation to a lounge the lounge was not in operation yet There is only one coffee facility where people must queue up Only one Chinese restaurant was open but who to eat dim sum for breakfast The staff overall seemed distant and immigration staff only became friendly after I began speaking in Khmer I know that this is a new airport but maybe the airport authority can pick up some ideas from this review t was also very hot inside

In May the new international airport terminal was opened in Fez It is an enormous improvement and upgrade on the previous terminal with a much more spacious and aesthetically pleasing environment In departures security can sometimes be a little slow but there is a clear and effective process which is greatly improved as compared to the old terminal Border checks on both arrivals and departures are much more efficient and swift There is a lounge available as well as pleasant shops and cafes in both arrivals hall and departures An entirely upgraded and pleasant experience travelling tofrom Fez

Very comfortable flight This was my first time to fly with FA Fuji Dream Airlines and I was impressed Checkin was efficient departure was punctual and the cabin was very comfortable and stylish Best of all customer service was so friendly both the checkin staff at Matsumoto Airport and the cabin crew It was a short flight of only one hour but very pleasant
I can understand why Incheon airport is one of the best in the world The airport is very clean and peaceful There were various seating options and different shops I definitely recommend it

TLVTLS Flights were on time the plane was clean inside and the seats were comfortable but there was not enough legroom The crew were very friendly and professional We got tasty sandwiches and drinks Take off and landing were excellent We will recommend

Excellent airport having recently done a roundtrip from Dundee to Birmingham It is really convenient for those working in and around Dundee with reliable flights from both Flybe and Cityjet Air France If you need to get away from Dundee Birmingham and London are ideal for onward connections and you dont have the hassle of having to drive to Edinburgh pay for parking and the long check in times Here you can checkin mins prior to your flight

A small domestic airport on Hamilton Island Queensland Australia very small but tidy and efficient Check in was a breeze and through security very quickly Lots of seating and only a couple of gates as planes restricted to daytime flights only Basic refreshments available and toilets although small were nice and clean You had a nice view of planes landing and parking close to the terminal and could see bags being loaded unloaded and the plane being refueled Very small but pleasant airport to wait for your flight

We were running late due to high traffic in Ayodhya owing to Kumbh Mela Akasa helped us by providing buffer minutes at boarding This helped us in arriving to the flight in time They have ensured that our boarding is faster so that overall flight time wont get delayed As soon as we are seated flight took off within mins This did not result in any delay

As per a previous review on checkin was advised that bags could only be sent as far as Haikou At that point I would have to enter China collect baggage then checkin for BKK flight And thats despite both flights being on a single ticket Upon arrival then had issues at passport control They wanted evidence of my nd flight The print out I had on me simply said SYD BKK And had no wifi access Eventually was allowed in The flights themselves were great Relatively modern planes with attentive flight attendants in business on the A and on the Western food options on the way over Very much Chinese on the way back For the price I paid it was a great option but hrs to BKK instead of hours might turn others off

Regional onboard service food and beverages LagosNairobi very good International onboard service food and beverages NairobiWashington good Onboard cleanliness satisfactory Nairobi lounge services good Airline customer support at Airport fair Kenya Airways App unreliable Online customer support very poor

Flew Shanghai to Tinajin Although crowded at times in the summer heat everything went well Checkin queues were very long I was lucky to check in at one of the numerous golden pass counters as have been invited by my companion Although Hongqiao is for domestic flights it is not difficult for a foreigner like me to have the right orientation Airport is clean and very clear and correspond to high international standards

Beautiful state of the art equipment but some poor organisation despite lots of friendly staff Nobody tells you the procedure join this queue then shuffle along only to be told you should have gone to the luggage weighin queue first Weigh luggage then rejoin back of check in queue Told to go to security shuffle along for a bit then someone asks for departure card Leave security queue go to desk where you collect and fill departure card then rejoin back of security queue Suggest check in desk staff give you a departure card so you will know to fill it in before going through security Takes a while to shuffle through that and go through immigration departure check then security check All took about one and a half hours At gate we were divided into groups Not enough seats for group although most passengers are in this group Infrastructure is very impressive and no doubt they will eventually streamline procedures Sign posting would be a good start Shopping and dining facilities are mostly not yet open so I cannot comment on this aspect yet So first taste of new terminal not half bad Clean spacious excellent kit friendly staff but poor procedures

The best airport in the world I have used it multiple times and there is never any significant waiting time at checkin or security The staff are always goodnatured and friendly Parking is free It is quiet Dutyfree items are cheaper than in eg Copenhagen And on top of all this you get free water and a newspaper while you wait for the plane The best by far

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap The check in was fast and the staff friendly The departure arrival were punctual and the aircraft made an average good maintained impression The seat distance was sufficiently good Despite the short flight there was a small bite and water Overall a good experience

Being fed up with the chaos at many ports of entry into the USA from Europe as a non USAcitizen I thought to try out a new way to enter the USA with less wait hassle stress and frustration I flew the nonstop AA flight from LHR into RDU Even though I was in business class and was among the first to disembark I believe all passengers entered the USA border control in minutes or less It took me minutes from plane door to curbside Also the airport is modern and clean really nice staff With just one or two daily incoming flights from Europe I dont think there is a better way to travel into the USA from Europe I connected the next morning on a very early am departure Staff told me there was a morning rush so I was a bit nervous about TSA opening only at am Arrived at am and soon after that TSA started processing passengers Again lovely kind people all around What an exceptional airport

I am a big fan of this airport It has only four or five checkin desks and lots of plants and pine furniture in the small departure hall It feels quite homely The staff at check in and at the small cafe have always been pleasant when I have flown from here I have also flown from Vasteras when the weather conditions have been dreadful very cold and heavy snow and everything at the airport and the shuttle bus from Stockholm have functioned with typical Swedish efficiency

Arrival experience here is brilliant as everything takes mins from plane to taxi On departure it depends on how many flights are leaving at the same time Security lines are bearable however not very fast Border control is always fast and courteous Duty free options are ok Eateries are surprisingly good Toilets are clean For an airport of such a small size it doesnt look claustrophobic and outdated All in all a good option of flying out of the city as the airport location is some km from the downtown The only downside is gate experience You only board via steep stairs

Osaka to Vladivostok Second time to fly S very good experience from checkin to boarding timeprocedure and flight itself Checkin was smooth boarding was quick and efficient The aircraft was new the legroom was decent and the snack offered inflight surprisingly good Total flight time was about h we landed minutes earlier than scheduled Overall high marks for S

I flew with Air France from Vancouver to CDG onward to Seville on Feb and then return Madrid to Vancouver via CDG Paris on Feb rd Air France is now my definite top choice for Canada to Europe Their business class way exceeds Air Canada Turkish and any other European carrier Ive done around trips almost all in business Their food wine quality is restaurant quality very inventive extremely good On my Vancouver to Paris Feb th flight Agnes was my main flight attendant Her service was impeccable Similarly my return flight Paris to Vancouver was also very good flight attendants all excellent focused with very high levels of service The A is a beautiful cabin I got to sit in A coming back and that felt like a first class seat with extra room at bulk head pod sliding door I love how Air France sets up a little refreshment area during rest times Im Star Alliance generally but for Europe an Air France convert Take note Lufthansa you have a long way to catch up and although Ive had kind attendants and service on AC biz class the food wine quality does not compare to Air France Merci beaucoup Air France and mademoiselle Agnes for her kindness on my flight over and for the wonderful service I received Their lounges are a bit crowded but the quality is very good and again for fooddrink showers rest areas What a wonderful experience I hope to fly again with them soon

Excellent airport with ample space and good architecture Checkin very efficient Immigration officers very friendly because now there is a small machine on the left side with which you can evaluate the service of service of the officer from poor to excellent in grades It is true that it doubles as a military airport but you could have a rare sight of military jets standing nearby

Departure was fairly easy and quick and there was an English guide for completing the customs form You can only spend local money in the cafe or burger place but duty free only accepts dollars and euros Escalator up to departures and not big inside but okay and clean Arrival is very slow so be patient There is no queuing at passport control so I just took a seat on the side and waited until only a few people left and was much easier At customs you need to complete two forms and I couldnt see an English guide whereas there was one in departures so ask a local or fill it in best as you can and customs officers will help with rest There is a separate queue for tourists and they speak a little English make sure you keep the second copy as you will need it when you come to leave the country Taxi ride into centre around Som ie but youll need to haggle a lot Overall its a fairly small airport and arrival does take a long time but it seems they are trying to improve things all the time

Great airline punctual The cabin crew is very welcoming and provides excellent service Excellent flight tracking with announcements from the captain Great loyalty program with MegaVolotea Super compagnie ponctuel Le personnel naviguant est trs accueillant et propose un super service Bon suivi de vol avec des annonces micro du commandant de bord Super programme de fidlit avec megavolotea

Hakodate airport is fairly small but the building is modernised with only two floors Before the security gate on the second floor a small shopping arcade selling mainly Japanese goods Like all Japanese domestic airports Hakodate is well organised clean and efficient It caters mainly for passengers travelling with ANA and JAL two of the major Japanese airlines and Do airline a subsidiary of ANA If you are staying in the downtown area there is direct airport bus from JAL hotel the Grand hotel and the Hokodate train station to the airport The bus fare is yens and it takes only minutes

We flew to Johannesburg from London Gatwick via Tripoli to attend the World Cup All flights near enough on time and a smooth transit through Tripoli Tripoli airport is not too bad although I wouldnt like to spend more than a few hours there The entertainment was good food as good as expected the were polite but spoke little English and the seats comfortable with sufficient leg room I did get the impression that the staff were probably a little too laid back at times Overall the value for money was excellent the customer service was good and the planes were modern although they did need cleaning up a bit
Their airport is pragmatic on the right size to be passenger friendly and with all major needs served like SIM cards and ATMs available Beware of overpriced rides to the city center or your hotel

Avoid at peak times security is a mess Gone are the days of the minute check in and smooth easy journey This used to be my go to airport due to the ease of transit Such a shame they have added so much flight capacity and not matched it with security

A small easily accessible airport with good seating no long walks to gates and helpful staff There is the usual choice of shops and a caf serving a variety of snacks including regional specialities The airport is clean and well signed

Norman Manley Airport originally Palisadoes Airport is an old military field that like MBJ has grown As most tourist arrivals are via MBJ KIN gets overlooked when improvements are in the works Indeed an old tired airport with crowding a problem both inside outside the buildings There is an improvement programme underway for the airside facilities with pax facilities coming in second place Walking tofrom the plane is interesting but the smell of jet fuel can be nauseating Like MBJ the approach provides interesting views Kingston and surrounds notably the hills above town The drive in from the airport is a beautiful ride along the peninsula though if going into town will be through some rough spots Recent hurricane damage has been repaired for the most part Overall a far below MBJ in all aspects but workable

Sukhothai Airport about as nice an airport as youll ever find anywhere It is tiny really well maintained and most enjoyable to use I think it hosts two small plane flights a day by Bangkok Airways which also owns the airport maybe a few more flights There is one gate A small complimentary buffet with coffee tea banana sticky rice cookies and such is at one end The waiting area is a traditional wood roof no walls with wood benches to sit and huge AC machines to help cool You get to the aircraft on an open air trolley riding past lily ponds with statues and manicured hedges There a few local items for sale and some Bangkok Airline bling Everyone was pleasant and helpful The Sukhothai airport zoo is next door featuring some giraffes and zebra It was not open both when we arrived and left but we could see the animals through a fence Across the way is what seems to be a dinosaur museum with many lifesize dinosaur statues outside

Transited twice in November without problems Signage is good distances are large even within terminal e No problems either time though timings were circa an hour and a half Security check each time but fairly fast and efficient

Having read earlier reviews of Xiamen Airport I wasnt looking forward to going there and changing from international to domestic First whatever the airline tells you at your point of departure you will have to recheck your bags on to domestic flights and vice versa from domestic to international From international to domestic the signage isnt helpful After collecting your bags go upstairs to the domestic check in area and recheck your bag at the transfer desk of your airline Transferring from domestic to international if the international check in section isnt open you just have to hang around until they open the doors There are plenty of cafes and noodle bars Once through the security screening go to the check in desk for your airline and recheck your bag in In fact at my point of departure Changsha they managed to check my bags through to Amsterdam but when I went to the check in desk to pick up my boarding pass for the next leg there was my bag waiting for me to check it in Apart from all that the airport is spacious and pleasant Lots of shops and cafes All the people I approached for assistance spoke good English

The trip took us from Bangkok to Paro and back to BKK and other than having to use the apron bus at Suvarnabhumi and the lack of IFE the entire process was faultless The flights both departed and landed ahead of schedule checked bags didnt go missing meals were comprehensive and appetising cabin crew were courteous and professional With Business Class fares being a premium over Economy fares I wondered why more people didnt take up that option As several others have pointed out the views upon the journey in and out of Paro were breathtaking making it a great way to welcome any visitors into their enchanting and enthralling kingdom

Couple of short flights with HOP An Embraer to Paris then a Bombadier down to Perpignan Both aircraft cabins were nice staff were friendly and helpful and the snacksdrinks on board were satisfying Flights were on time As a platinum cardholder my connection between CDG and ORY was without charge saving Euro which is a really practical and helpful perk of Flying Blue membership thanks Air France for that I fly a lot with HOP and they always do a good job well done again

CDGTIPOUA out ABJTIPCDG return Excellent flight to TIP clean new A with good food and friendly staff Flight to OUA similarly well presented Unfortunately the flight from ABJTIP was operated by Nouvelair on Afriqiyahs behalf other passengers also noticed the difference with grumpy staff and terrible food Happy to return to CDG with Afriqiyah again and more good service

We flew from Minsk to London on Jan MSQ has been refurbished following the hockey world cup one year ago ish Check in area is bright and efficient There is even a nice play area for children Signage is generally clear and in two languages The terminal is very clean Arrival was also smooth and passport control was quick Security was reasonably fast as it was passport control Gates as the lounge at the upper floor have not been renovated thus still look a bit obsolete there are few shops with prices in Euros and few bars for the last cuppa before flying off there are not many seats by the gate meaning that it might be difficult to find a seat if two flights are departing simultaneously from two adjacent gates Overall a good airport
