Arrival was great with no queues and security quick and easy Luggage arrived on carrousel very quickly Departure less good with long queues at security and long waits Fortunately plenty of seats in departure lounge Not much to do in lounge and poor range of food outlets WiFi free but nonexistent and unable to connect

Its always a pleasure going through this airport It is clean spacious and easy to navigate Immigration and customs are always fast and efficient There are a good number of dutyfree shops although not as many food outlets

Frankfurt Main to Asmara The crew are most friendly The onboard service was excellent and standard of the aircraft was good though the legroom wasnt great The ground handling done by the airline at Asmara International Airport was efficient even though there were a number of shortcomings at the airport the airline got round them The price of the ticket was worth the service I received

The airport itself is tidy and seems pleasant Being a solo traveler with hidden disabilities I am very pleased with the staff who were able to assist me They were helpful and kind So far on my departures the ques havent been too long a wait or crazy timely manner in my experience Look forward to coming back again as Im a frequent flyer to this airport

Very pleasant and helpful staff With my arm in a sling it was hard to do most things but staff were ready to help and the canteen staff were friendly and professional Could do with more shops and a better variety

It was my first time at this small and beautiful airport Very wellmaintained and nicely decorated airport The downtown and hotel areas are not too far Staffs were friendly Outside of the airport is also environment friendly and green

I decided to fly to Siem Reap from Phnom Penh as it was a much quicker and enjoyable I cannot believe the price of the Bassaka Air flight it was pretty much the same as a bus The checkin was the quickest check in Ive had at an airport anywhere The staff were great and it was the first time Ive ever been on a budget airline where I received a free drink Bearing in mind we were only flying for minutes I cant speak highly enough for this airline

The airport is small and modern It has both local and international flights Air France Arrivals are no problem and there is not far to walk from the aircraft to the airport exit There did not seem to be to many people bothering passengers Departures is also straight forward with modern checkin desks There are not many shops in the departure area and only one basic cafe There is adequate seating and the airconditioning works well Overall a very good experience compared with other African airports

Arriving here is a potential nightmare especially at the weekends They are just not geared up to handle more than one jet the size of at a time Queues at passport control can stretch almost out to the tarmac and although very friendly and courteous they are so slow Baggage reclaim takes forever and it is just a scrum to try and get through customs On the last trip we were in a queue for customs clearance and the officer in charge of our line just disappeared We had to start all over again

I could not believe how quiet the airport is now Ryanair have decreased their flights checked in with baggage in less then minutes and through security to departures in no time Once airside there is not much to do but there is several duty free shops a caferestaurant and a SubwayMcDonalds outlet as well as two outdoor smoking terraces All in all a nice clean little airport with helpful and friendly staff
Nothing to do Old airport looks like some maintenance is needed Not a lot of shops or seating Toilets not clean at all No ventilation in terminal humid Definitely not what I would expect in Nice

Been coming to GCM for years Yes tourism has increased based on reports by almost over last years which is fantastic for this beautiful Island But the airport although complete remodelled is poor at best Aesthetically pleasing it is too small and very uncomfortable Why go half way for something inadequate from the start Fortunately the entire staff are awesome and eased the pain Suggest a change in schedule of when flights arrive may assist even by minutes Two recent issues I dealt with The runway pothole was a total screw up From accounts in paper it appeared that new asphalt from night before was destroyed by a jet blast Asphalt needs to cure Second and personally involved is that our plane needed to wait one hour after everyone was boarded for maintenance to return a log book This made our connection for our next flight impossible with all the inconveniences associated How can you allow this calamity to occur is still not sitting well with me If you expect tourism to continue to visit your beautiful Island you need to improve

Camilo Daza Airport serves Colombias largest border city Ccuta Access to the airport is quite easy as is moving inside it Checkin process is fast and hasslefree Staff is quite professional and courteous Free wifi with excellent speed The airport is being remodelled and although small in size will be more beautiful and pleasant to use There are just a few shopping choices which is a drawback and the food court is also small and limited in variety Once improvements are over it will certainly be a more efficient and agreeable airport
Quick lines through security and it is a better option than flying out of Logan with the longer lines Airport restaurantsbars are limited but OK for all the longer that you will be there

The girl who initially was nice to us at the information desk then proceeded to question us at the departure lounge She looked disappointed when we produced our negative results and examined them very closely Travelling right now is stressful enough without somebody who is having a bad day create more stress

Tokyo Haneda to Sapporo return with Skymark Airlines First leg on Boeing NG New cabin comfy seat and generous legroom for a lowcost airline Even though I didnt purchase any the drinks and snakcs are sold at a cheap price Departure and arrival on time Return leg delayed for mins due to congestion at destination airport Return aircraft was an older Boeing Very warm cabin temperature But overall worth the ticket price Definetely better than AirAsia and JetStar

Waiting area is too far from the entrance a lot of mosquitos in waiting area as its open crowded too My flight at am and I arrived long hours before my flight in which they decided to let me stay in waiting area overnight and mosquitos enjoying to eat you alive Please do something

I read lots of bad reviews about this company and was quite nervous to fly with them To my surprise and relief both flights went really well The checkin was quick and problem free everything very efficient Staff very helpful and friendly Both flights left on time Would highly recommend it as a budget airline

I arrived in Lilongwe for a work training we were facilitating and spent one night in Lilongwe and proceeded to Blantyre the following Monday afternoon When I arrived at Crossroads hotel where would stay until the coming Saturday morning I realized I did not have my passport wallet with forex and most importantly my passport and an older one I immediately alerted the hotel and the driver said he would check By the time I got to my room there was a message from Victor the Airport Manager who tried calling on watsap so I immediately responded He assured me they had everything and the next morning I went to collect it Sure enough every last note was still there I waited for a security officer to confirm that nothing was missing and signed off The honesty kindness and sheer humanity displayed was so moving I am deeply grateful to Angel for her assistance and the Airport Manager You guys are really incredible

An hour delay no apologies nor explanations Quite some occasional turbulences again no word from the cockpit What compensated the whole flight was the incredible good seat pitch and the round of drinks and a cookie definitely much better than what some selfproclaimed fullservice airlines deliver

Today we flew on VA Brisbane to Townsville I usually fly Jetstar as it suits my time requirements This flight was perfect the seats were much more comfortable and the staff were the best I have experienced they could not have been more helpful I could not fault Alliance in any way and I would always be happy with them We had just flown from Perth and we were both pretty tired so thankyou so much

Took a trip recently travelling from Sydney to Melbourne on Rex Airlines new intercity jet service It was a chance to test out their new service having many years ago flown on a regional flight to a country NSW town A couple of standouts were immediately obvious starting with the check in staff and process at Terminal in Sydney Not only were the kiosks easy to use for check in but on proceeding to the desk for bag drop the staff were very friendly and helpful On board the planes have good legroom and it was nice although a short flight to at least get a snack and cup of coffee Then on the return leg had to change my flight to an earlier time and again the service stood out The call centre reservations staff member was delightful There was no robot at the end of the phone and they cared about helping make changes Everything about the experience really was good old fashioned country service with a smile It really sets them apart from their competitors

Being in this airport was so much fun From the royce chocolate factory to different shopping areas there are lots of thing to do I arrived hours early but still did not have enoungh time to explore the airport The immigration was systemized and there were almost no lines Although it is not a star airport I think it has to be one of the best in the world

I hope Boutique Air continues this service to altoona I have been able to get my mother who lives in Altoona back and forth to Pittsburgh for medical treatment and advanced care she needs The drive to Pittsburgh is atrocious and I hope boutique continues this route for a very long time A total life saver and an awesome experience Out of about flights i have taken only have been delayed and very short about minutes or so Their customer service is outstanding and always so friendly

The new terminal building is probably the best small airport terminal in Europe Small efficient very friendly and checkin procedure is made in minutes Beside Munich by Lufthansa Amsterdam by KLM Intersky to Vienna and Berlin Brussels is now connected with Berne by EAE Overall a great airport

There was hardly any delay just minutes The plane was old but reasonably clean Staff were friendly I could buy a good sparkling white wine The flight was safe and uneventful So bring your own noise cancelling headphone and enjoy a decent flight at low cost

Small airport only serves a couple of airlines Landing process was pretty fast seem the airport does not have air bridges Bags delivered pretty fast Check in at airport was fine many dining options Security check was fast Not sure about transportation options because we were picked up and dropped off by our hotel It is a very sufficient regional airport

Beijing to Macau Air Macau is the only one carrier operating daily flights from Beijing to Macau The aircraft they use on this route is A The flight attendants can speak English well but the service do not have any shining spot Dinner is provided on this flight which tastes not too bad Although the plane delayed for min to get airborne due to traffic of Beijing Airport the flight made landing min earlier than estimated which surprised me

My mother and I experienced Tokyo Narita International Airport Good service the staff smiled when my mother and I went in to buy things When I transited at Tokyo Narita International Airport To return to Lax International Airport to continue studying I did not know where to go There were two guides very polite the first staff held a map The second staff asked me if I needed a car to gate B At that time I was at gate because flight NH Ana Airlines departed from Ho Chi Minh City to Tokyo Narita International Airport I will come back many more times because the staff is very good

Flew from Lisbon to Las Palmas on th December Wasnt exactly sure what to expect from such a small airline The CRJ plane was fine albeit somewhat dated Service on board was very efficient with a nice spread of snacks for a hm flight I would definitely fly with them again A good airline
I found very good customer service by each and every worker at the airport whom we dealt with Wifi facilities were excellent with no interruptions Overall it passes the required tests
The duty free staff especially the fragrance section was very unprofessional Poor customer service No please to give feedback Otherwise the food and airport is good

Airport is easy to reach by metro train and taxi Check in area and departure area have been perfectly clean In the check in area only few shops and restaurant available departure area have more choice but I did not use them as I used the lounge Check in went fast and efficient same for security check Staff was professional

I was with my mother at the entrance of the airport There was a young man named William He asked us if we needed help and I couldnt believe he helped us to get a wheelchair immediately That was awesome customer service compared to my experience in LA airport

This is a small airport to say the least It only has gates and this is after it is being modernized and expanded Construction is still going on so it can be a bit noisy Security is fairly painless There is only one restaurantlounge airside or curbside Hopefully this will change when construction is complete Airside has floor to ceiling windows affording views of the spectacular Tetons Almost as impressive is the array of private jets lined up toward the south end of the airport If you fly here be sure to take a daytime flight in and book an F side window seat for a jawdropping view of the Tetons on approach

We were flying to Kuala Lumpur from Madinah airport through group reservation on Feb The checkin counter staff separated all of us When we wanted to exchange seats with fellow group members the crew were not really helpful All the havoc could easily have been avoided had the checkin counter staff been more accommodating when seating passengers according to their family groupings Do not assign seats according to your mood or whims and fancies for that day It is very unprofessional Next is the passenger security scan Ladies and men security scans were separated At the scan even folding chair cum walking stick was confiscated How do you suppose the passenger is going to walk to the gate when the walking stick is taken away My yearold mother wears a lumbar support waistband She was told to remove it and go through the scan again How to remove without privacy at that scan area Security lady can easily be more sensitive and take her to a more private place

I experienced the best customer service at Skopje Airport During security I found out that my phone was missing I left my phone at the selfservice check in machine on the other side of security But they helped me out They called their colleagues and eventually found it brought it back to me I felt trustful through the whole process and really really het Thanks a lot

UMEBMA economy This little Swedish airline brings back what flying used to be in the good old days The flight was an hour short hop between Umea a small city up north and Bromma a tiny central airport of Stockholm in an Avro RJ Plane was clean and flight attendants nice free newspapers Aftonbladet and some inflight magazine followed by a coffee service a free meal sandwich fresh orange juice and chocolate cake Before landing we were given hot towels and sweets

Pyongyang to Beijing with Air Koryo The departure and arrival were punctual staff smiling and friendly the aircraft including toilets was clean and there were magazines and newspapers at the entrance The food was a chicken burger but the drink selection was rather limited either water or one type of soft drink It is maybe not the most luxurious airline but the service for a shorthaul flight is better than European or American airlines I have used for the same distance

Given the early morning departure only fast food restaurants were open The terminal was not crowded and there was plenty of seating at the gates Terminal is bright spacious and with plenty of windows through which to see the airfield There was no line going through TSAPre It took me less than minutes to go through I have taken several flights from DAL and have always found TSA officers to polite and courteous Airport was very clean and the WiFI signal was excellent and easy to connect to On return to DAL a week later in the evening rush the terminal was very busy and did not appear to be crowded with plenty of space to disperse the crowds at the gates and concourse

A wonderful little airport So impressed While it was busy at the peak of the holiday season everything moved quickly and efficiently The shops airside while small have a great selection of Spanish specialties like olive oil I hope the new airport that opens next year keeps up the same high standards

I would like to write about the splendid service given to me my spouse by Air Asia AK Kuala Lumpur to Denpasar on Friday Im so proud to mention about these two cabin crew Ms Camelia Mr Amirul Their love and care is still lingering in our mind Kudos to Air Asia to have them in their crew family Our most sincerest gratitude Love you guys a lot our best wishes in your future

The food wasnt that great and theres no inflight entertainment but we were comfortable and had our iPods With regards to the cleanliness of the aircraft weve been on worse We found the cabin crew to be friendly their English is not great and they all had smiles I think if you expect high standards from a star airline youre bound to come home and write negative reviews Overall we were happy with what we got

We were very pleasantly surprised with our experience in Premium We normally fly Premium Economy on British Airways and this was a far better experience the plane was lovely and new and the crew were much friendlier The premium experience on board is good nice to have additional space and a private section of the cabin and the crew were generous with drinks The food was fine and we were pleased to be served two hot meals on the way out Our checked bags came off very promptly at both ends the Premium labels did seem to make a difference The only slight negative was that our flight left Gatwick late afternoon and the Premium check in line took longer than the normal one as they seemed to give priority to those checking in for next mornings flights Strange but didnt spoil the overall experience

Yangon to Mandalay with Golden Myanmar Airlines was very pleasant and positive The airline online booking system was good checkin counter staff very friendly and the checkin was easy The flight left the gate as per schedule and the flight was comfortable Cabin crew were friendly and efficient Passengers were served with light snacks during the approx hrs flight

It was years ago I used this airport and wow so much has changed The check in on nd level had moved to a much more spacious rd level It made the experience totally different in a positive way No longer does it feel cramped Staff are friendly and signage are very clear The only thing that still need improving is the variety of shops available air side and food options It is still pretty basic at this stage With more and more airlines flying to OKA they can be more ambitious and open up more shops and restaurants to cater for us

AirAsia keeps getting better its hard to believe they are a budget airline The ground crew was efficient and accommodating the cabin crew was attentive and friendly and the seats were clean and comfy We chose the Thai vegetarian Penang Curry that was yummy Big tip for this flight Tokyo to Bangkok book a window seat on the right side of the aircraft if you want to get an incredible aerial view of Mount Fuji

Mid size airport with Indian standard with connectivity to most big cities in India after covid no international flight For arrival its easy to use we arrives at baggage hall and same hall have a prepaid taxi counter and a snack shop and a liquor shop Toilets were clean and also the terminal looks clean plenty of baggage trolleys also have paid porter facility Cabs are available book through their kiosk and avoid taking from touts outside It is situated within the city so if travelling light may walk towards outside and get auto that would be cheapest option to travel Ola Uber also available

Lovely little airport Check in was very quick as was passport control and security Good selection of shops after security Airport was very clean including the toilets A couple of dining options available and a drinking water dispenser provided to top up your bottles Mineral water can also be purchased for US Plenty of seating available by the gates On departure there are no gates just a short walk to the plane All in all a great little airport

My son was travelling on Kids Solo as an unaccompanied Minor with a h stop over in Paris The departure from Dublin was delayed by hour The agents Mustafa and Laura at the check in counter went out of their way to arrange a new flight with KLM arriving half an hour earlier than the original flight They were extremely helpful and understanding We were very impressed with their professional approach and excellent customer service

Very clean and well taken care of This airport is served by so many great airlines with diverse destinations I do think that GRR needs more international routes At GRR the airport is not too big so it makes efficient travel Also they have a good selection of shops and stores The airport facility looks really modern and cool for being over years old The only cons is that sometimes it can get a bit crowded and the staff doesnt manage high groups of passengers well Would give an if I could

Subang Airport to Redang The plane was a De Havilland Dash old but in good conditions The flight has been pleasant and crew did the best to offer us a pleasant flight water towels and a little snack The check in area in Subang and the all airport are very nice and clean the service has been very good They will replace their old planes soon with new ATR

SJO is a very modern airport immigration is friendly but asks to see all your papers come prepared if you do not hold your tickets carpeted floor free wifi Internet expensive gift shops and food carts taxi fare is high usd for a minutes drive before checking in you must pay departure tax it now costs usd you can pay with credit card overall good experience I will be back in the summer

Needs a proper restaurant Toilets are not up to the hygiene standard and are very congested I am muslim and offer regular prayers but call is very loud need to maintain at comfortable listening Needs further variety of fast food international chains to have a quick meal

This is a small and nice airport Ive landed and departed from this airport before and it has changed a lot I dont know why it is called Leon Airport if it is closer to Silao Gto I landed there a few months ago my destination was Romita Gto my mothers hometown This airport is very convenient for us since it is only about mins away from Romita Also this airport is not very far from Guanajuato city I recommend people to visit Guanajuato this is perhaps the most European style city in Mexico

Had a flight from Gatwick to Zakynthos with Grand Cru Airlines as Small Planet had an issue with one of there aircraft The staff were stunning and so friendly The aircraft was one of the best with very good comfy seating Thank you for getting our holiday off to a good start Would fly with Grand Cru Airlines any time

Moscow to UlanUde in economy on a Boeing The plane interior was clean and in good shape the dinner was edible staff polite and reasonably efficient Seat pitch is tight for the tallish me cms But the whole experience was better than Id expected from an offbrand carrier

Flying from AEP to IGU in Prem Economy I was nervous about what to expect on Aerolineas I have to say that I was really pleasantly surprised once we got on the plane Check in at Business was a breeze Security and Boarding was polite chaos They had two flights going to two locations boarding at the same gate at the same time However the premium economy was great simple but worth the extra The seats were comfortable and clean think that armchair type of seats you use to get in business class Service on this flight was friendly on others it was nonexistant They provided a sandwich and soft drinks The best thing though is on every Aerolineas flight my bags were on the carousel as I arrived there They have some amazing expedited system to get premium bags off which is great

I recently had the opportunity to experience the new terminal at Kempegowda International Airport in Bangalore and I must say it is a remarkable addition to the citys infrastructure Design and Ambiance The terminal boasts a stunning architectural design that blends modern aesthetics with traditional Indian elements The spacious layout is filled with natural light thanks to large glass facades The use of local materials in the design adds a unique touch making the environment both inviting and reflective of Karnatakas heritage Facilities One of the standout features of the new terminal is its stateoftheart facilities From efficient checkin counters to wellorganized security checks the entire process felt streamlined and userfriendly The wide range of shopping and dining options is impressive offering everything from local delicacies to international brands I particularly enjoyed the curated selection of souvenirs that showcase local artisans Technology The incorporation of technology is commendable Free WiFi charging stations and selfcheckin kiosks make the travel experience more convenient The digital displays for flight information are clear and easy to navigate which is essential in such a busy hub Sustainability What truly sets this airport apart is its commitment to sustainability The use of rainwater harvesting systems and solar energy reflects a forwardthinking approach to airport management which is vital in todays context of climate change Accessibility The airport is wellconnected with ample transportation options including taxis buses and ridesharing services The ease of access from the city makes it a practical choice for travelers Overall Impression In summary the new terminal at Kempegowda International Airport is a remarkable blend of modernity functionality and cultural resonance It elevates the travel experience and sets a high standard for airports in India Whether youre a frequent flyer or just passing through this airport is a pleasant surprise that showcases the best of Bangalore

Arrival was great I was at passport control within minutes of landing On the way back it was another story I couldnt do the online check in and I found out at the airport that its not provided when you fly from Bergerac You have to queue with everybody in order to get your boarding pass even if you only have hand luggage Ground personnel very slow until the call was made to invite people for boarding They then suddenly were very quick The toilets arent provided with coat or handbag hangers which I find not practical

DubaiKabulDubai in early December Kamair continues to be OK Both flights were close to being on time the only small delay down to Dubai air traffic They are now doing the luggage security check in Kabul which means you have to point out your case before it is loaded onto the aircraft Dont forget to do this if you want to see your case at your destination

Yangon Terminal is very nice It is not too large immigration may be slow but they are friendly Atmosphere is modern clean and nice including good restroom Check in counter are totally empty at the time of my departure Once can spend minutes for check in process and wait at a few nice cafe they have noted that you cant find anything to eat after passing immigration

I left on early BA flight and was very impressed with the helpful staff in the airport check in hours ahead fast empty security and border control Nice airy feel and clean although some cafe prices shocking cost me more than Scandinavian airports euro for potato chips Generally modern and relaxed despite a number of early morning flights and there was a machine where robot gives you jelly beans I like distractions in airports takes your mind off stress BA gate staff helpful and whole experience was stress free compared to disgraceful regional airports in UK

We booked different domestic flights tofrom and in Sulawesi with Lion Air as there were no real alternatives What I was afraid for having read reviews here already happened days before departure of our first flight as I got a message our initially booked first flight was cancelled and we were rebooked on a later flight From the flights booked were cancelled and we got rebooked Luckily I managed to arrange my pickup at the Makassar and Ternate airports where we already arranged travel Our flights from Makassar to Palopo and back were the only ones that remained as booked Palopo flights on an ATR twinturboprop had Wings Air owned by Lion Air flight numbers All other flights were on s Service on board of the flights was nonexistent but at least the flights were smooth and left on time as per the new schedule Also baggage reclaim went smooth but this of course shouldnt be an issue as all airports were quite small The positive note is staff at the airports were nice and friendly and always did their best to assign us seats with more legroom which was much appreciated
Not Verified Courteous and friendly staff Flight left early by about minutes when it was confirmed all planning to fly were on board Crew was great Seating was great

My recent minute flight from DCA to PHL operated by PSA Airlines for American Eagle was a pleasant experience Despite a minor delay while waiting for the crew to arrive from another flight the service was good We were offered a predeparture beverage and even received beverage service during the short flight a nice touch for such a brief journey The CRJ proved to be more comfortable than the CRJ making the quick trip enjoyable For such a short flight theres truly nothing to complain about

Gatwick to Venice We were hesitant about this airline having read reviews but booked it for the low price I have to say the flight exceeded our expectations Checkin and boarding were both an extremely smooth process I think we were at the bag drop desk for a total of minutes and boarding was much quicker than with other lowfrills airlines We paid in advance for extra legroom seats my partner is so this is an essential for us and were surprised by the amount of space and comfort We sat at the front of the plane with plenty of room to stretch out unlike Ryanair and EasyJet whose exit row seats only have an extra inch or so Flight took off and landed on time and was far more comfortable than wed anticipated There are definitely some areas to be improved upon in terms of the preflight process I have not come across any other airline in the past few years that makes you print out your own boarding pass rather than making it available electronically Its also pretty irritating to be told you cant check in online unless you pay for it this could potentially lead to long queues at the airport on the day These points lower my overall score for the airline but the flight experience itself was very pleasant

The Port Elizabeth airport is compact and well laid out and it is very convenient to the Summerstrand beach area Car Hire is in a separate building across the entrance road which is close to the terminal but requires dodging traffic with everything in tow Baggage retrieval seemed to take an extraordinary long time considering ours was the only arriving flight and the plane was sitting on the tarmac meters away from the baggage claim but these things happen Check in on return was polite and efficient and there is a modest selection of shops to pass the time waiting for departure but only on the street side of security

Small company but very friendly and efficient staff All passengers treated as business class travelers even though Atlantic Airways only offers one class economy Small planes Bea and Airbus but the comfort is all right for the short trips between Scandinavian countries Faroe Islands and Britain

Dont understand all negative reviews yes you can not compare this airport to a modern European or US one but short lines friendly people despite unfriendly behaving tourists enough seating to wait Smooth entry into the country expect to enter a country that is years back in time and you will enjoy your trip

Nice flights all on time with friendly staff for a good price Non of the services offered could be purchased in advance seats and meals as all credit cards were rejected Also shocked to see use of a kettle On the floor behind row in the galley

Shenyang is my home airport The recent move to the new terminal is a big improvement although there is no smoking room Food and beverage shops ok but overpriced Check in always quick and efficient Same can be said for passport control and security Lounges for frequent fliers are nice with if depart around midday a decent lunch Delays are not very frequent here and if there are delays they are always caused by traffic control Warm in winter and cool in summer Clean toilets Good signs and all within walking distance of minutes maximum

Mahan Air from Kuala Lumpur to Tehran Check in was fast and friendly The signage to find the premier lounge in Kuala Lumpur airport was almost nonexistent and took me a while to locate the lounge which offered minimum amenities Boarding was efficient and the A was packed for this flight The aircraft interior was new and clean with smiling crew The flat bed was great and plenty of food was offered for this hour flight Perhaps the refreshment pizza and a burrito at the end of the flight was a bit too much Only negative thing I can think of was not much entertainment and it was limited to public LCDs Considering the business class fare was almost cheaper than other airlines which operated indirect service it was a good buy I was especially impressed by the very attentive flight attendants Overall a good flight

The flight Taipei to Shenzen was uninspiring with staff being disinterested and an older aircraft with uncomfortable seats but the service after clearing the Shenzen transit lounge hours of life lost there was very good and cheerful However this is a headsup for snowsports travelers Unless you are in business class you will be charged excess luggage for your snowboard or ski bag unless you pay it when purchasing your airfare They advertise free ski equipment and I am sure my travel agent and I checked to make sure it was true They do but the total length width depth has to be cm or less There is no snowboard or ski bag under that size We somehow missed this fact In business class it is cm which is more than enough but for me it meant a US penalty No pay no boarding pass Be aware when they say they will carry your snowsports gear despite being oversize for general luggage it is not entirely true Very strange for a country trying to promote its own snowsports industry

Flight from Karachi to Islamabad plane flight was pleasant and no turbulence during the whole flight enough leg space to stretch your legs as being a domestic flight there wasnt any entertainment available but the food was excellent Even though the airline is cheaper than other airlines in terms of service and satisfaction it has an edge over its competitors

Flew GA Jakarta to Amsterdam GarudaIndonesia arranged a car to pick me up at my home and drop me off at Terminal At the Drop off area Rudy from GarudaFirst Class Team was on hand to assist me with Check in and security process Traveling with Garuda in Business or First Class there is a special lane in the immigration which can be used and this is quite fast even when the airport is busy I was then taken to the FirstClass lounge where full A La Cart dining is available however I just went with the fruit platter as I wanted to wait for the onboard meals The service team in the lounge are most helpful When I it came time to board the aircraft I was assisted by Rudy from the First Class Team who helped me through the boarding gate and on to the aircraft At the aircraft door I was meet by the cabin crew Vivi Jayanti Inggo and Chef Sansan who give me a very warm welcome and guided me to my seat The overall ambience of the FirstClass section is excellent and the crew keep the toilets exceptionally clean The food and drink menus were extensive and meals can be served on demand and I enjoyed both meals severed The onboard wiffi had excellent connectivity Garuda Indonesia First Class service is outstanding as they also include access to the VIP Lounge in Amsterdam Schiphol airport and all formalities for my transfer flight are taken care of including immigration
It is not big The efficiency of checkin and security checks is high Signposts are clear The WiFi connection is stable The ambience is clean and not crowded

Landed at the newer of the two terminals Baggage collection was fast and was able to buy a phone card easily on the lower Arrivals level but telephones were only on the upper Departures level Security was tight with baggage tags checked by airport staff No illegal taxi touts hounding you and bus into the city was quick and easy On departing the airline waiting areas were large and comfortable The food in some places was cheap very cheap Same as supermarket price for bottle of Pepsi Had a gate change but was handled quickly and easily Efforts were made to keep me informed despite being the only foreigner on my flight New monorail will soon open from airport to city Airport taxi prices are not too expensive but be prepared for a wild and crazy ride

Myself and family travel via Liverpool Airport two to three times a year It remains our first choice since we began using it ten years ago where previously we tended to travel via Manchester Liverpool is smaller than most international airports but this has its benefits less crowds less queuing and easy access The staff throughout the airport are friendly and ready to help The signage is easy to read and well proportioned Lifts are available Liverpool recognises the Sunflower scheme Our experience has been security is strict but quick and friendly to get through Prices are typical airport prices for a small bottle of water reasonable I suppose when considering the ridiculous prices airports are allowed to charge where ever you go I can only presume it is down to airport owners and the high rents they charge The only shops I ever see that are really busy are the food beverage and drinks outlets Again our experience has been food is fresh and well prepared The one downside are probably the toilet facilities a bit smelly and like most airports today no free drop off zone Why airports in the name of security are allowed to charge astronomical prices for parking I have never understood Captive audience I suppose All in all I would give Liverpool Airport stars out of Freshen up the loos be the first actually run an airport for the passengers benefit in pricing and parking and you get a

Yesterday I had a pleasant experience from Horizon two airline employees on the Horizon air turboprop that I flew from Missoula to Seatac I had a very short connection time to board an Alaska air flight to Charleston SC I flew this same itinerary MSO to SeaTac to CHS last year and because of airport construction and a long distance between two terminals I nearly missed my flight With this in mind I told the flight attendant named Kyle that I would need someone to help me get to the right terminal in time to make the flight I was quite anxious about it Kyle told me that the first officer agreed to escort me to the terminal as she had a three hour layover She not only made a smooth and soft landing with the plane but she also walked with me all the way to the plane I was to board Please let first officer Emilee know that she went above and beyond her job description She is a lovely person and goes out of her way to increase her customers comfort level I consider it a blessing to have walked beside first officer Emilee
Amazing flight even the fact that it was slightly delayed The food was good and the quilty of the staff was high The cabin was clean

IzmirAdnan Menderes is architecturally a very pleasing airport with lots of glass and steel giving it a very modern look The food and shopping were very good the restrooms were spotless and clean and it was very easy to navigate There is free wifi but only for two hours

Upon arrival in Rhodes a suitcase was delayed Indicated at the counter The handling was done very well We arrived on the next flight and were taken directly to our address Super The entire flight also went great Friendly professional staff Flying with Aegean is a relief Bij aankomst op Rhodos was er een koffer vertraagd Bij de balie aangegeven De afhandeling is super gedaan Met de volgende vlucht meegekomen en direct naar ons adres gebracht Super Ook de gehele vlucht was super verlopen Vriendelijk professioneel personeel Vliegen met Aegean is een verademing
Macau Intl airport is spacious Security was efficient and fast Checkin counter queues not long and fast Staff at the counters were good and friendlyThe boarding gates were big and not crowded

The Airport was quiet and everything went really smooth The staff were professional and did not give me a hard time while checking in and during customsimmigration Toilets and lounge were clean and comfortable to use The wifi was also very reliable

We travelled on Air Namibia after our travel company arranged substitute flights to Victoria Falls due to our Virgin Atlantic plane being delayed from London resulting in us missing our connection Virgin were very unhelpful offering a new flight days later The trip with Air Namibia was excellent from start to finish The crew were very friendly on board the food was nice When we landed at Windhoek the ground staff were very helpful ensuring our bags continued the journey and we were kept informed

I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of Air KBZ flying from Yangon to Mandalay I bought the ticket just two days before the flight and the fare was very reasonable Checkin was fast and efficient and a Air KBZ employee approached me in the line and escorted me to the checkin desk and helped me checkin The domestic terminal is small and a bit chaotic but this is not Air KBZs fault and should be remedied when the new domestic terminal is finished There are no screens announcing that boarding has commenced so you have to pay attention to the airline employees who walk up and down the waiting area with handheld signs with your airline and flight number on it Boarding was via a bus to the aircraft The plane was clean in good condition and the seats were comfortable The flight crew was helpful and friendly We were served a light breakfast on this minute flight The flight took off and landed on time I would certainly fly Air KBZ again

Was transiting between fight from Brisbane to flight to Townsville with wait time of three hours Boarding areas large enough for amount of passengers Lots of windows with views over runway Shops and eateries limited but probably appropriate for airport this size Check in area clear Security staff friendly and talkative Noted the airport has a new Ibis Airport Hotel nearby and looks rather flash Had a pleasant time while at this airport

Seats in economy cabin very comfortable compared to a lot of airlines The hot meal was of good quality however on a hour flight it was the only hot meal and a small roll before landing You need hot meals on such a long flight we were so hungry when we got off the aircraft Half of the crew were tui Scandinavia crew they were lovely very glam and hard working the uk based crew could learn a lot from these guys The uk based crew on my flight out looked a mess and done the bare minimum and werent very pleasant Drinks were plentiful also which they only served at specific times throughout the flight as I heard them say no to a few people when they asked outside of the service I think this is great stops people getting drunk and annoying on a long flight which makes it more pleasant for everyone The hours went quickly and Id fly with TUI again

Barbados to Bequia SVG Air Grenadine Alliance will take you to Bequia and other beautiful small Caribbean islands I flew them from Barbados to Bequia return in January Ignore any timetables or prices you find via internet search these are not current Email the airline directly they will respond promptly and courteously You will be billed in Eastern Caribbean dollars XCD These are roughly XCD per one USD Expect your flight to cost roughly the same as or even slightly more than your flight to Barbados from the US It may be more costeffective for a large group to charter a flight Ground staff are laidback but helpful and courteous flight crew are professional Checkin is straightforward and they will let you check one bag without fee plus bring a personal item on plane I was able to fit a mediumsized duffel under the seat Your flight may stop briefly at other islands such as Canouan and Union Island to pick up and discharge passengers It is a beautiful ride My flights were on DHC Twin Otters a workhorse of global aviation and not claustrophobic for a small plane Great views including through windshield which you can see as cockpit door remains open

A surprisingly large and spacey airport given the size of Porto Boarding times security and seating were all great cuz of the practical layout Even during peak season theres plenty seats available Prices at the foodcourt were lower than youre used to in Europe Theres a convenient metro connection to the city center So all in all a hassle free airport

Phoenix is the easiest of all major US airport to get in and out of I picked Phoenix as my home based in part because I needed a reliable airport considering how often I fly and PHX does not disappoint The new terminal is really excellent and the improved lounge situation at Terminal is really appreciated
Nepal Airlines is a cheap option for direct flights from Nepal with good service Nepal Airlines improved its service over time The cabin crew were professional and meal served was good

Travelled in and out of this Burmese provincial airport early last year arriving from Mandalay and leaving to Rangoon Pretty basic but it was OK and really belonged to another age of flying This because you could wander out onto the runway between planes arriving there werent many and if you wished you could go to your hold luggage which was stacked on a trolley awaiting the planes arrival and put things in or take things out of it Many of the Burmese passengers availed themselves of this facility as our plane was an hour late arriving When its light appeared in the sky on its approach an airport official suggested we all go back into the terminal so we did An airport still in an age of innocence with no apparent need for security of any kind

Much nicer than the concrete block that was YWG open and bright Staff were friendly checkin a breeze and clearing security has never been a problem for me Despite being an International Airport it is small even if you have to walk the furthest distance Gates you can be out of the Airport in minutes if not waiting for checked baggage International travel out of YWG is quite limited so the International secure side is small MAYBE gates with just a couple Restaurants including the required Tim Hortons kiosk Others have complained of the lack of moving sidewalk but dont let that concern you as I said the longest walk is less than minutes from gate to exit so a moving sidewalk would actually be pointless While shopping and Restaurants are an improvement over the old Airport they are still very limited when compared to most other International Airports YWG serves its purpose but it wont wow you
No one checked our vaccination upon entry which raises alarm bells Jetstar staff as usual are incredibly rude and money grabbing The facilities are cute and basic

Johannesburg to St Denis Service like it was years ago professional attentive amenity kit handed out on a hour flight and the quality and quantity of the catering Ive not seen for years Thoroughly recommended

My flights were delayed for many hours due to weather in Dallas El Paso airport is the best airport to be stranded in It has an easilyaccessed smoking area in a lovely courtyard Its small enough to get around quickly but big enough to have decent food My delays would have been much worse in a larger airport but El Paso airport made my delays manageable Staff were also great Security and the like especially outside directing vehicle traffic were nice and helpful offering extra help or information if I needed it Love this airport The only minor annoyance was that it did not have a lot of charging ports in the seating areas so I had to stand while my phone was charging

John Glenn International is a great midsized airport for easy travel The terminal was recently renovated and is very clean bright and modern There are many dining options now that werent present just a few years ago One of the best things about it is the free WiFi and charging plugs for every seat in the waiting areas Overall this is one of the best airports Ive traveled through

A surprisingly large and spacey airport given the size of Porto Boarding times security and seating were all great cuz of the practical layout Even during peak season theres plenty seats available Prices at the foodcourt were lower than youre used to in Europe Theres a convenient metro connection to the city center So all in all a hassle free airport
Come on CMH pm on a Tuesday evening and not one restaurant on B concourse open The pandemic is easing and everyone seems to be flying again We would like to eat

Initially booked in Economy Class but when I was about to board agent took my boarding pass and voila got upgraded to Business One thing that stands out with Philippine Airlines is the hospitality and warmth of their crew both on ground and on board Food may not be at par with other big Asian carriers but for what they lack makes it up with their service One thing to consider as well is the ticket price being the most affordable Ill keep using PR as it is the most convenient affordable and with genuine service PRs exclusive Mabuhay Lounge at MNL T is one the best thing that happened with PR so far Keep it up

While my arrival at Brunei Airport initially presented a frustrating situation due to a lack of prior communication about the INRS portal requirement the exceptional assistance I received from one of the staff members Mr Asnawi turned things around Despite my frustration he remained calm professional and incredibly supportive His patience and understanding helped deescalate the situation and his dedication to assisting me ensured I could resolve the issue without further stress It is rare to encounter such exceptional service and he truly went above and beyond to make a difficult experience manageable I commend Royal Brunei Airlines for having such exemplary staff who prioritize passenger wellbeing and customer satisfaction This experience reinforced my confidence in the airline and I would not hesitate to fly with Royal Brunei Airlines again

I like that Recaro seats were used The seat was very soft and legroom was actually the most I have gotten thus far even for such a tiny plane like the A neo It was very well kept and modern and the cabin was spotlessly clean There was even a meal on the short flight of hours Excellent experience However there was no screens for IFE but there was a cool magazine that kept me entertained so yeah However there unfortunately was a karen or kevin or whatever you call it on our flight The crew were very professional

Impressed by this airport apart from the queue at Passport control It took ages once through to Departures everything was fine Duty Free was reasonable and plenty of places to get a drink or something to eat

I dont ever leave reviews but wanted to for the first of my flights with SAS I had a great time with this airline on flights over a long weekend trip The first flight from Heathrow to Copenhagen really stood out to me The two air stewardsesses were amazing and stood out as caring and genuinely interested A real asset to the airline The food on this first flight would not be my first choice but once i started eating it i was very happy Cant fault SAS on any of the flights They were on time and good flights Highly recommended
Excellent flight Water served during the flight Landed ahead of schedule staff was polite and friendly

Excellent airport I agree completely with the last two reviews I would say to Alastair Finch that he should not worry the airport seems to be holding its own Having flown from Doncaster recently I was expecting a far better level of service from the UKs newest airport but all I found were closed shops and poor customer service Access from the A and M is excellent meaning it can be reached within minutes from all of the nearby population centres Customer service is second to none and one can be off the plane and through to the car in minutes The only thing lacking is the range of direct destinations but it seems that is more to do with the economy than the competition Certainly the KLM service is a godsend and far better than travelling to Heathrow or Manchester for direct flights I would highly recommend people from the Humber region and Lincolnshire to give this place a try if they havent already Given the choice I would sooner travel from Humberside over Leeds Doncaster and East Midlands any day despite living closer to Doncaster

Such a small airport But perfectly sized for the amount of people and traffic Nice staff and very clean facilities Just need to ensure there are some drinks and food available past security as the drink vending machine was broken

Its a relatively small airport I agree with the earlier post about its speediness One of my friends once arrive less than half an hour before his flight departed and was still able to fly out though I wouldnt recommend trying this Overall a very good airport

The great thing about this airport is its size It is small And that means a short walk from the aircraft through the building and out Baggage reclaim is basic you take it from the baggage truck outside but that is efficient and quick The arrivals area appears unfinished Check in and departure are also quick and easy If you want a drink in a nice bar use the place before the immigration After that there is only a small bar The duty free shop is cheap and quite well stocked There is wireless Internet at the airport but it does not work

A moderately sized airport some km away from the city center Its clean and modern and during the offseason security check was very fast and efficient Dutyfree shopping is in abundance and has some good offers Staff is very friendly far nicer than what you experience at other airports All arrivals and departures are busboarding only as there are no jetbridges Connection to the city is by taxi or bus X which cost only euro
Excellent timely departure and arrival The cabin was clean the staff kind and the bags were promptly delivered Nothing to complain about

Domestic flight AccraTamale hr flight One time in both directions Water juice and snack fish or meat pie savoury biscuits provided on this short flight more than you get on BA domesticEuropean flights three days Friendly and very polite cabin crew Marvellous captain who gave great information about the flight Joint venture between Hainan Airlines China Hahn Airways and Ghanian investors An excellent service which makes domestic travel much easier in Ghana

Always a pleasure to travel with Volotea Clear and detailed information on baggage management Punctuality and kindness of both ground and flight staff The courtesy of the staff the comfort on board make the trip relaxing Low cost travel but without the usual hassles you find with other companies

Our arrival was great No problems The airport was clean People were friendly Renting a car was a bit of a pain because it was in another building a long way to drag several bags When departing we arrived hours early but had to wait about minutes before checking our bags There were only people working one for frequent flyers and one for the rest of us The couple at the head of our line had a problem and it took minutes for the lady to get the problem worked out When we got in line there were people in line By the time we were being checked in there were people in line Again everything was clean and the people were very pleasant
I visited Victoria BC two weeks ago and for a small international airport I enjoyed the experience Security was quick the facilities were good and checkin was quick I recommend this airport

I was pleasantly surprised by Safi on a hop from Dubai to Kabul Yes the aircraft was old and the legroom poor But the flight was on time the staff friendly and the food free excellent A shame there is no chance of a glass of wine A big advantage of Safi is that it operates from the very civilised Dubai Terminal making it ideal for connecting to most of the major carriers except Emirates FlyDubai offers a slightly more comfortable service on the same route but operates from Terminal which is little more than a shed and a very long and tedious bus ride to other terminals

Travelled from Dusseldorf to London Stansted booked as Air Berlin flight but actually it was Etihad Regional operated by Darwin Airline I could not book the seat in advance and were forced to wait at the airport until checkin counter opened Flight was stated as delayed by minutes but actually this was more than minutes with very few announcements Flight itself was comfortable SAAB is unique aircraft with one seat on one side and two seats on the other side of the cabin which I like Fortunately I sat on one seat which was good for me As it was an evening flight they gave a bread snack which for a short flight is fair As I like this aircraft maybe if I have a chance I will take this flight again however I would not recommend to my friends
An old Fokker departure and arrival on time very smooth landing proficient bilingual staff and excellent food omelette with herbs coleslaw and chicken

Departure hall clean spacious and air conditioned Well organised queuing system with KLM staff tagging hand baggage in advance to make check in run smoothly Each airline had their own desk Security fast just remember to have your red immigration card Food outlets fine but limited Shopping limited as two shops sold the same items Duty free had a good range of perfume and drinks but beware if you are European and outside the Eurozone prices are more expensive for cosmetics than what you would pay in High Street shops Didnt fully investigate alcohol but you need to look carefully for offers and compare them to a local supermarket We werent travelling with children but I didnnotice any play facilities on offer Seats OK Arrival Hall just had fans but didnt have to wait long for luggage There are toilets in the baggage reclaim hall these were clean and well maintained For a small island a really good airport

Cascais to Bragana with Aero VIP Services are provided by SevenAir The site is easy I had a couple of questions and the support was fantastic The plane was just fine despite being a propeller thus a bit noisy

I had read the worst reviews about NDjili International Airport and did not exactly look forward to the experience of arriving and departing there But my hopes were set on some other articles I had found about a new international terminal that opened end of built by Chinese contractors I must say the new terminal the staff working there and the guarded parking and dropoff areas in front of it are exceptionally good It is a small but very bright and clean building Customs officers are professional and nice to the passengers same applies to security staff at Xray machines and where one must pay for an exit visa when leaving DRCongo Airconditionong works well and there is a nice business class lounge Do not expect any shopping outlets there is only one bar but the latter can easily compare to those in the better European airports Thumbs up for the new terminal hope it stays like it is today The road from the airport to downtown Kinshasa was also completely refurbishes good pavement lighting at night Travel times tofrom the airport to the embassies area of the capital are now only h to be compared to h a few years ago I was said

PSP is a beautiful airport in the secured area However the checkin to the security point is a long walk for the many retired people that travel through this airport The open air feeling is great in this warm climate The biggest negative is that when there is poor weather and those times are few is the lack of technology for pilots to land During a rain storm and low visibility we were delayed minutes while circling and then continued to Los Angelos then bussed back to Palm Springs

It was great to fly out of and into TriCities regional airport again Had no problems it was great From check in thru security and the passenger boarding area Security helped my wife greatly because of back surgery she said they were wonderful
Short trip Arlanda to Helsinki Very nice people working on board Cold but nice meal nice experience

We booked the flight because it was rather cheap on ctrip hours before departure my wife got a message that my flight from Changsha to Chengdu was cancelled and we should call the airline company Due to Chinese New Year and the Coronavirus it was pretty hard to contact anybody so we decided to take the car to the airport At the airport the ticket desk was unable to change my ticket Sichuan Airlines was unable to change my ticket so we had to call ctrip After nearly hours we got the schedule change and I was able to get an earlier flight Would have wished the airlines had offered me the schedule change by themselves Service on the flight ChangshaChengdu was nonexistent I am not sure if that was due to turbulence or to the virus but it was just a twohours flight and I had brought some food of my own In Chengdu I had to get my luggage and wait for hours to check it in again fortunately there is a good lounge for transit passengers at Chengdu Airport At pm the Sichuan Airlines counters got really busy as there were many flights departing It was really crowded but service was quite quick I was pretty surprised when the flight to Rome got cancelled maybe due to personnel shortage because of the virus My gutfeeling says the flights to Prague and to Rome were pretty empty so they cancelled one flight Passangers to Italy got rebooked to our flight and even that one was not full Seats were a bit narrow and my earphones did not work but I was so tired takeoff at am that I did not need any inflight entertainment Luckily there was no foodservice at the start so passangers were able to sleep The flightattendants handed out bottled water and snacks when I awoke I found snacks and water on the vacant seat next to me Very thoughtful hours before landing they served breakfast It was not a lot we did not even get trays It was Chinese food and I liked it but for Europeans who cannot eat spicy food the choice was not good I am used to spicy food but even I considered the breakfast to be quite spicy No drinks were offered for breakfast Luckily I always try to get a seat near the galley so I could get hot water during the flight for my tea Allinall Sichuan Airlines was quite cheap the aircraft semiclean and inflightentertainment choices were okay If you are not too tall and do not need to many amenities I can recommend this airline Worst flight I ever had to China but still reasonably comfortable

Saskatoon airport is small and simple to get around The signs pointing to the right place are just perfect Renovations were being done at this time but it was still super easy to be there and get to my flight on time

Apart from the usual lateness which one comes to expect from some regional airlines this was an excellent flight The aircraft was practically brand new and the cabin crew were professional Between booking and the actual flights it had changed its name from Afrijet to FlyGabon

This airport is vastly improved since the previous comment Ideally situated for the catchment area south of the Humber After nightmare journeys just getting to Manchester Aiport my visits to NZ are now via Humberside and Amsterdam Minimum fuss no crowding a relaxed start to a lengthy trip Additional package flights are now offered and the Amsterdam hub is a definite plus There used to be a direct link to LHR with Air UK but this was discontinued before the demise of the airline and never revived Although not essential could be useful on occasion Landing costs I believe

Pretty new terminal opened about a year and half ago Its an improvement on the old terminal Not many flights and of them from Ryanair Basic regional airport that does the job not huge lines to check in or pass security Dont go through security unless your flight its about to depart since in the air side there is only a little barcafeteria and two vending machines not too many seat if there are two flights at the same time In the land side good bar and resto Bad Bus connection to the city and expensive taxi service EUR to centre So overall small nice airport that allows you to show up h before your flight departs without risk of missing the plane

DubaiKabulDubai The price of tickets is very high It costs more to get to Kabul than to the UK from Dubai Kam Air were OK on this trip It was a MD both ways and were were almost on time The only problem was the return because of some stupid security procedures in the airport They apologised for that though it was not their fault Neither flight was full so was able to get a row to myself which helps Kam Air along with Safi is still the best way to get to Kabul from Dubai

This review applies to Terminal only American Airlines Transited through a rather busy Reagan National There are great views for the airfield from the D concourse terminal building and E concourse The walk from the end of D concourse to the end of E concourse is rather long and with only a minutes connection I made it to the connecting gate in E concourse with minutes to spare Overall a good airport and terminal to transit through

HKGBKK It was quite a pleasant trip from Hong Kong although delayed an hour They served nice food for breakfast and juice or water or fizzy drink It was an old but clean aircraft The pilots were nice and apologised for delay BKKHKG Delayed hrs mins it was an old Japanese again and the food they served for dinner was chicken with rice orange pudding butter cake and peanuts and a drink Recommend this airline

Miami to Brussels On this Boeing plane Jetairfly has a separate cabin called comfort class and I was able to book seats there for an extra fee Only seats in this cabin with FAs doing a great job Seats configuration in xx while regular economy is xx Legroom was very good After take off we were offered Champagne followed by a hot meal together with wine coffee and digestif Before landing breakfast was served I would recommend this airline if you can get seats in this cabin

Johannesburg to Cape Town The SLOW lounge at JNB sets the standard with an impressive array of food even at am and ample seating The bar service is good too and some neighbours had already finished their third refill of pink champagne by the time they boarded the same flight As is common on other BA flights Group passengers were kept waiting on the airbridge before boarding actually commenced Service on board was friendly and efficient but very much old school BA as far as the fourcourse lunch was concerned At least one was able to see the main course before choosing it Departure and arrival were pretty much on schedule and baggage collection was speedy too Overall a decent flight

Have been travelling tofrom this smallish regional airport for around years Have seen a lot of improvements over this time The latest development has provided pax with good eatingdrinking facilities airside On arrival baggage claim is handy to car rentals whose parking lot is only a short walk Departure is easy with security queues usually short and its staff efficient and pleasant Gate lounges have plenty of seating and well placed monitors have the latest flight information Overall clean facilities and friendly mid west staff Always a pleasure to use this airport

A beautiful airport All of you who remember how airline travel was in the sixties and seventies would recognise Ndola Originally built as a RAF airport during the second world war it has continued as the airport to service the Copperbelt region of Zambia I arrived on a domestic flight and departed international to Johannesburg Everything is so laid back and friendly I doubt if there are to many airports that have straw thatched tables for your final beer before departing and straw thatched toilet blocks I love this airport and I usually have tears in my eyes on arrival and also on departure

The wheelchair attendant verified everything for me Verified with me verified with the LYFT driver by asking his name verify the LYFT ride by licenses plate verified I felt ok and I knew where I was going For me its humiliating to be pushed in a wheelchair I never felt humiliation this time I truly felt cared for This trip wasnt the greatest vacay Ive had but when I got home I felt great I want to thank this positive smart caring young man Some ppl have a gift a few share it in this way If your lucky enough to meet this young man at DFW Airport youll know its him Im talking about here

I simply love Norwegian Its a no nonsense airline that has been incredibly reliable on of the legs that I have recently flown with them Seat pitch is sufficient pricing is fair and predictable and everything just works The service is fine and the onboard menu contains all you need for a few hours in the air I regard them much higher than most old airlines now saying this as a Lufthansa Senator

Went through Cairo airport during my recent trip arriving from Emirates and leaving to the UK both in terminal Despite the long queues in departure being a bit of a hassle the coordinators were incredibly helpful They did their best to address any issues and kept things moving as smoothly as possible The terminal itself is pretty modern and clean the lounge is amazing and while it could use a few more amenities i would say it was an overall satisfying experience a solid out of

This airport was previously known as London Manston which is a bit of a joke because of how far it is from London However with a name change new terminal and new budget airline EUJet has started to raise its profile I travelled through there on the way tofrom Amsterdam The airport is small which works to its advantage Check in was very fast and the staff very helpful The car park is right outside the terminal entrance and is very cheap day or week The small cafeteria is good and clean The aircraft are right out side the terminal so no long bus rides or endless walkways On the way back it took less than minutes to reach my car from the time the wheels touched the ground I had no luggage All in all a very good experience

Nice cosy airline with very friendly cabin personnel Comfort standard and entertainment through plane WiFi without screens limited choice Food was plain but sufficient wine could be obtained Flight was absolutely ontime a nice experience

First impression of Minsk airport was given by its exterior grand Brutalist Sovietera architecture Very impressive Inside the terminal doesnt feel grand and impressive I was in transit only so I only saw the arrival gates transfer area and the airside departure areas The arrivals area is a bit of a maze and signage not that clear So be sharp when looking for the transit area after arrivals The transfer area was old fashioned with worn fakeleather couches that seem to taken from a landfill Queuing time at the transfer area was OK around minutes After boarding card check passengers process through security which was a bit of a joke as passengers are not checked at all after passing the walkthrough metal detector The departures area with its shops is a bit of a maze and the gate waiting areas are very small There is not a lot of choice in shops what I saw was mostly liquor or food and beverage outlets Seating in the gate waiting areas is limited but on the upper level of the departures area there is sufficient space to take a rest on one of the seats At the upper level there are also seats on which you can recline but these seats are quite hard and not very comfortable to take a good nap There are also sleeping cabins here Wifi works great login via SMS Terminal and toilets are clean especially at the upper level where not a lot of people go The terminal it not really fit for PRM passengers as there are a lot of stairs but not escalators and just a few lifts They did install stairlifts at the gates a rather silly solution in my opinion but is works This airport is fine when you have a short transfer In case of a long transfer it can be boring and FB options are very limited

I want to thank to all the staff at this airport for helping me find my luggage which was lost because of Zrich airport The medicine of my mom were in that suitcase and all your team helped me a lot to locate and find it as soon as possible Very warm hearted people and extreme professionals They didnt skip any official procedure so that they kept the security conditions but did their best to help me Unfortunately I do not remember their names but I hope this message will find them and make them feel appreciated Thank you wish you all the best and God bless you

Great little airport used mainly by Porter airlines Check in was efficient and you go down to an airport lounge open to everyone They serve free tea coffee and soft drinks along with cookies and nuts The wifi is free and fast Boarding is effortless and the scenery on take off is stunning The only downside was that when the lounge is busy it gets a little grubby with dishes lying everywhere Otherwise it comes highly recommended

Checkin would not accept passengers until hours before the flight despite the monitors advising us to do so Check in person was blunt and almost rude not acceptable we are the customers It isnt my fault she was talking quietly and I had to ask her to repeat every time Then security they take possession of my backpack and without comment put it on a unit away from me and left it there A couple of minutes later another security man came along and started swabbing the bag because I had lots of camera equipment inside The toilets in departures need a good refurbishment Otherwise a great little airport modern clean with duty free and so on

Earlier I reviewed here the disastrous departure with AA from MIA and it seems only fair that I should write about the excellent arrival procedures at Santo Domingo airport On the short walk from the plane to the arrival booths there are some people randomly checking Covid documents At the booth you need to show by phone or paper your electronic E ticket and then it is a breeze When I arrived at the booth there were officers on duty and the line was very short The luggage was on the carousel within minutes of landing and an official will check your bag tag with that on your luggage Plenty of taxis but a bit pricey and a great start to arriving in the DR
The cabin is clean Flight attendants are friendly and polite Seats can be reclined easily The food is delicious and fresh Flights departed on time

I booked return flights from Sydney to Rome via Guangzhou where the airline provides an easy and comfortable option of a free hotel depending on the gap between your next flight The stopover option is incredibly well handled with transport provided to and from your hotel I thoroughly recommend this as Guangzhou has a great easy to use metro system and its very easy to get around The A fleet used are in excellent condition with pleasant staff although meals can be a let down one on my return journey was actually inedible However the real test of a good airline is when things dont go to plan My return flight from Rome was cancelled due to a technical issue after we had boarded the flight We spent hours on board with regular updates provided before the Captain made the decision not to fly Prior to disembarking which involved reentering Italy and collecting our bags lunch was served on board a nice touch Once back in the terminal we were given further meal vouchers and asked to return an hour later On return we were bussed to the nearby Sheraton where all accommodation and meals were covered for hours while the plane was repaired and put back in service These changes left only hours to change to my rescheduled flight from Guangzhou to Sydney however to my delight China Southern provided a hotel option close to the airport allowing for a refreshing stop and rest before the final long leg back to Sydney So sure I arrived on Sunday morning instead of Friday night as planned but the way I was looked after was very good I would certainly recommend China Southern and will fly with them again

First and foremost the charging stations here in T are nothing more than horse posts Zero USB terminals I tried worked Ninety percent of the plugs did not work plus they are shoved on a wall so only people can use the ones that do work MAJOR inconvenience I suggest charging tables with stations and access to both sides in multiple locations throughout Second different restaurants Not sure how many variations of a club sandwich one can experience but that seems to be the theme here Its sad when McDonalds is your best choice Other reviewers are correct who decided how many seats were required in the gate area Its more like a commuter airline in a mountain town with gates Add more Lastly Iberia needs to add personell At least at the Customer Service desk since most of their inbound flight misconnect Two employees to take care of customers an hour is cruel On a positive note it is a very clean airport Cleaning staff gets stars

Was a very pleasant flight the crew was very helpful at all times I was an unaccompanied minor and throughout the journey the crew helped me with all the procedures the flight was very comfortable Would definitely use Ethiopian Airlines whenever Im traveling and would recommend it to friends and family Most of all Ms Leli was the best

Bennett at the TSA first check point was so incredibly sweet to our son and his attitude was great Im sure everyone that works for the TSA feels this way on the inside but he was clearly showing it to us on the outside Keeper
