Flew Vanilla Air from Tokyo Narita to Hong Kong To be honest I did not expect much from a LCC The crew onboard were professional and nice and they tried their very best to communicate with passengers using English The plane was clean and tidy I do not mind having to pay for food and beverages and I do not care about the lack of entertainment Yet the seats are hard as rock which makes me feel like I am sitting on a wooden plank The seat pitch is completely ridiculous that I cannot even tie my shoelaces My height M Sleeping or even resting on the flight is simply Mission Impossible no matter how tired I was given the seat lacks basic support and the unbelievable seat pitch If your only parameter is cost and you can forgo all sorts of comfort go fly with them

Arriving and departing from this regional airport is far less stressful than dealing with the airports in Cancun or Mexico City There are fewer passengers of course plus the airport is well organized and clean Checkin was fast and easy and security was well organized courteous and fast There are several places to enjoy a snack or meal before takeoff The waiting area is spacious and uncrowded and offers great views of planes landing and taking off Wifi was free and worked well

Superb airport Small Friendly service No queuing went through security in under minutes Fast free wifi with constant connection and no connectivity issues Burger and chips SEK cl beer SEK Decent viewing facility but minimal air traffic to view

Small airport yet very efficient Dont come too early as there is not much to do Queuing is almost nonexistent staff checkin and security are very friendly There is a restaurant with view on the tarmac and a small airport shop before the security Arrival is very fast to minutes including bagage reclaim There is a bus stop right before the terminal taking you to AntwerpenBerchem train station a major train station with fast connection to Brussels or anywhere in Belgium Very close to the city center Highly recomended for users who like fast airports

Barcelona BLA to Caracas CCS in Venezuela on a classic Boeing aircraft I experienced Conviasa to be quite nice to fly with Anyhow they do not offer much more than the average European nofrills carriers A costfree nonalcoholic drink was served on that short domestic flight the aircraft was clean and fine despite its age we departed BLA about minutes ahead schedule not every airline in Venezuela manages that Since the ticket costed me less than EUR I can call it a quite satisfying experience

Milwaukee is a great airport to spend a couple of hours in Decent food selection a great interminal aviation museum and the most incredible airport used bookstore Ive experienced Wish I had brought another carryon bag as I could have filled the thing with all the great books at reasonable prices I wanted to buy

FDHTHF Friendly staff clean aircraft with comfortable leather seats Orders for drinks and snacks taken and served individualy Prices on their inflight menu are OK Landing in Berlins Tempelhof airport is a fantastic experience Too bad the airport is due to be closed soon Even with bags to claim aircraft to subway station took less than Minutes Beat that

I flew into and out of Moscow Sheremetyevo Airport in December for the first time and was quite impressed with arrivals and maybe a little less so with the departure process Arriving and clearing customs and security and getting bags was all pretty straight forward and easy enough and efficient Signage for me was great and easily navigated to the bag carousels and also found an ATM before exiting to take out some cash Plenty of food options once exiting and then I easily followed signs to the Aeroexpress train from the airport to Moscow Belorussky about a min walk through terminalI bought my train ticket online prior and scanned the barcode and all worked fineSo transport to and from the airport is easy on the way back I took a Yango ride and it pulled up easily right in front of terminal On the way departing security is pretty tight but to be expected you go through two screening stations and again check in pretty seamless except for the fact your Departure Terminal indicated on the board may not be the one you finally need to go to as I found out Ended up having a fairly decent walk from one terminal to another Once that finished then we headed to the aerobus as is common in Europe to be driven to the plane waited for about mins with open bus doors for late passengers in Moscow winterthen the drive started and instead of a couple of minutes it turned into about minutes driving from one aide of the runway around the end and over to the opposite apron to the plane But for me all an adventure but just be prepared for a bit of a walk and maybe an extended bus ride Overall a nice clean airport that was very functional and not overly crowded when I went through and easily accessible and a good range of eateries and amenities

Amazing experience I want to thank you all of the flight attendants for being so friendly and helpful I am afraid of airplanes and they helped me calm down and relax Special thanks to Maria for being there whenever I need her The best flight attendant Her customer service was super She was there to help and make me feel comfortable

In the UK it is pretty difficult to get a fullservice airline offering direct flights to anywhere except Heathrow or Gatwick The socalled lowcost carriers dominate Having flown the competition we reluctantly tried Jet for our flights to and from Madeira In many ways Jet proved to be a long rung above the competition kg of checked luggage and kg of hand luggage plus a handbag or laptop bag are included as standard The seats are as you would expect on this type of airline minimalist The cabin crew were friendly and the drinks and food onboard appeared to be reasonably priced I cannot vouch for the quality of the hot or cold food as we did not try it Flights out and back were on time and boarding was smooth and efficient

Very pleasant airline Friendly and helpful crew Reasonable prices for food and drinks on board There was limited choice but that is ok on a hour flight This was the second time I flew with SmartLynx We had a nice flight and I would fly again with this airline

Just wanted to shout out the excellent customer service and help I received recently at Denpasar Bali airport I stupidly left two bags on the carousal when I went through customs Airport security were very friendly as the guided me through a secure area to go back behind the luggage area to retrieve the bags and customs did not hassle me for going through twice Cant imagine doing this so easily in a North American airport Bali people are great

As AC has given up this route we again flew with this Lufthansa subsidiary from YYC to FRA and on to Venice Boarding went smoothly as AC staff now handle this aspect for Eurowings which they didnt do last year The plane left and arrived on time which allowed us to make our connection with Lufthansa Cabin crew were very helpful and fluent in both English and German The seating in business class in and the seats were very comfortable As we chose the evening flight we were able to sleep for a number of hours The seats recline into a fully flat position Comfortable blankets and pillows were provided The food was excellent with a choice of three entrees A fairly good selection of movies was available All in all a much better experience than the one we had last year Lufthansa must be having success with this route as there are now two flights daily from YYC to FRA I find it curious that AC gave up this route

Outstanding Customer Service from Air China Jakarta Airport Ground Staff On October nd I arrived from Sydney to Jakarta Qantas planning to board within hours on Air China CA to Beijing then to Madrid and Sao Paulo Due to Qantas airplane problems the Qantas flight arrived hours late leaving me with only hours to board Air China Unfortunately Qantas refused to give any assistance to facilitate the very short time for check in Talking to the Indonesia immigration agent he called Air China ground staff who sent an agent with a mission to help meI did not have a Visa on Arrival no boarding card and a checked luggage at Qantas The agent did everything to make me board the Air China flight talked many times to the immigration officers called Air China office to send a letter to the immigration and ran times to the Air China counter to try to solve all bureaucratic issues The agent and other Air China agents issued all documentation needed and ran with me and my luggage through Jakarta terminal be able to catch the flight Boarding the Air China flight CA in such a short time was a small miracle that was possible because of the competence and excellent service of Jakartas Air China ground staff

Tehran to Copenhagen Excellent value For money Traveling alone with a baby can be challenging but I found Check in and boarding procedures smooth and without delays The flight attendants were young and very nice to us A with smart and clean cabin Food and nonalcoholic beverages was plentiful as a hot breakfast was served at the beginning of flight and a cold refreshment before landing in Copenhagen This was a hour flight and I did not expect that Inflight entertainment could be improved This was a great flight and I would consider to fly with this airline again in the future

I experienced the best customer service at Skopje Airport During security I found out that my phone was missing I left my phone at the selfservice check in machine on the other side of security But they helped me out They called their colleagues and eventually found it brought it back to me I felt trustful through the whole process and really really het Thanks a lot

Not a bad little airport Plenty of space and seating if you need to wait a while But like all most Chinese airports the departure shops are terrible and expensive Bring your own snacks drinks or something to read Nothing to see there but it is comfortable enough

Strasbourg is a nice and convenient regional airport Baggage claim is quick The information desk is friendly and helpful A covered walkway links the terminal to the train station Travel to downtown Strasbourg costs oneway and takes mins while trains run frequently weekdays service is much more reduced during the weekend only one or two trains per hour Beware that the ticket machines accept coins or French credit cards only and that the airport station is called Entzheim Aeroport and not Strasbourg Aeroport Upon departure checkin and security screening are hasslefree For a longer wait there is a socalled relaxation area on the st floor above the information booth few people know about it although the area has comfortable seats working tables and power sockets On the downside there is no airconditioning there so that the area can be quite warm

Skopje is a small airport but quite spacious you can see that there are not many people flying international But there are some coffee shops burger king and car rentals The only shuttle bus goes every hour The toilets could be cleaner they were dirty even when there weere almost no people

Flew on th of February Checkin staff in Miami was the best I ever experienced Fast friendly efficient pleasant Travelled with pet in cabin all formalities were dealt with rapidly and in a friendly way Boarding rapidly inflight crew very friendly We got the feeling that the flight attendants had pride in their job Food offering very good however service could have started slightly earlier Flight left delayed due to late arrival of incoming flight snow storm in Toronto But as we got an email from Porter advising of the delay we were able to leave to the airport later All in all a nice experience

Its mainly a domestic airport Internal sign and direction system is clear and well arranged Immigration check procedure is efficient The Japanese officers are well organized Public transportation from Komatsu airport to city downtown only relies shuttle bus The schedule is not frequent The time interval is often more than one hour

I live in Kampala and fly in and out of this airport regularly It is a rather small and quiet airport clean and modern after the refurbishment There is not much to do a few duty free shops overpriced craft shops and a restaurant Checkin area can be very crowded especially for BA KLM and Emirate flights For all other international flights it is sufficient to arrive at the airport hour before departure The best this airport has to offer is probably the lounge Clean extremely comfy sofas big TV screens friendly service hot showers internet access and an electronic massage chair

It is a very clean airport and very easy to move around Departures and arrivals are well defined and separate It is very safe and there are good shopping areas in the departures My experience at this airport is flights all without problems at the airport and the last flight was in January Nice views from airport we can see Desertas Islands and the sea sunrise and sunset

Great airport but it is huge and can take up to minutes to get from gate to gate if in transit Good variety of shops and restaurants lots of toilets which are always clean Its a shame theres no areas to relax apart from at gates Singapore Doha KL etc all have sofa areas and big TVs to watch which is great when you have a long lay over I always thought there were smoking rooms here but werent Not an issue if you have a lay over of more than hrs as you can go through immigration and leave the airport I did however find cigarette butts behind floor standing AC units on two occasions at unmanned gates where passengers and probably staff hide and have a quick smoke I even smelt cigarette smoke at one point so people obviously are smoking in the terminals Some staff seemed quite unhelpful and standoffish though when I asked about a few things but mainly young ones who were more interested in what was on their mobile phones

I fly this route regularly but usually in Economy as this was a busy weekend there were no economy tickets remaining so I booked BusinessClub Europe I never deal with checkin as Im always hand luggage only I headed straight into the airport and decided Id try out the OneWorld lounge at Schiphol as this was included There was a huge queue with people being turned away from the Lounge front desk this however turned out to be for another providers lounge I checked with the front desk and was allowed to enter the OneWorld lounge This lounge was nicely furnished with plenty of food and snacks available nice quiet restrooms within the lounge were also available This space was a welcome change from the hustle and bustle from the rest of the terminal and I relaxed here for a while before my flight The staff were very friendly and attentive When boarding time came I made my way to the gate of course passengers ignored the boarding order and all just crowded the gate this left multiple priority boarding passengers unable to board until most of economy had seated Schiphols ground staff need to be more organised in this respect On the plane as this is only a seating layout the seating was no different to economy I expected this and the Embraers are quiet spacious despite being smaller planes Our food and drinks orders were taken before take off so the dedicated ClubWorld staff could serve as soon as possible on the short flight Food was a cold dish but was a very tasty Asian style chicken and slaw various other snacks were included and I had glasses of champagne because why not Staff were very friendly and attentive despite how short this flight was Arriving at London City was like it is in any class quick and simple Overall the experience was good and for the difference in cost in Avios points I will now be doing this journey in ClubWorld rather than Economy in the future

Flew Mahan Air economy class from Dubai to Tehran IKA with Mahan Air A felt safe the aircraft was clean and comfortable Cabin crew service was friendly and efficient Quality of food and beverages non alocholic were of good standard Would recommend this airline to everyone

One of the better airports in Africa I made use of the pay lounge at USD where they served snacks and drinks I had a medical situation was referred to the medical station and received good medical attention

Rimini Airport is highly recommended as a way to access the Adriatic Riviera This smaller than average airport is located on the edge of Rimini MiraMare and is well connected to Rimini and the train stations by coach and a local tram service is not far away either The negative aspect is that the lack of clear signs inside the airport for ground transport could be very misleading for newly arrived passengers and lead the newly arrived into the hands of very expensive taxi drivers Rimini Airport has some nice shops and is well set out I highly recommend this airport

Weihai Airport is an efficient modern airport that contains international and domestic flights within the same building Arrived at WEH Airport from ICN Left the aircraft via airbridge I was pleasantly surprised by with number of counters opened at passport control that handled the passengers very quickly After clearing immigration I waited for less than minutes for the luggage Arrived back at WEH a week later for flight to ICN The check in staff understood English and took to effort to confirm the destination of my ticket and luggage Security and passport control was also a quick and efficient process I was amazed with the facilities at the airport terminal given the small number of international flight currently being handled by Weihai The departure hall included duty free and other shops restaurants and television for the passengers The Airport was modern and clean The staff were friendly The process of arrival and departures seemsed less stressful and time consuming than larger airports Also being a smaller airport there was plenty of parking and no traffic congestion to and from the airport

Flew Vanilla Air from Tokyo Narita to Okinawa Naha Boarded on time and with no troubles staff were friendly and welcoming Seats were reasonably comfortable Im ft tall and my knees werent touching the back of the seat in front of me which was definitely a welcome surprise on a low cost carrier No entertainment systems available but not an issue as I usually travel with my iPod and something to read anyway Flight was calm and we experienced no turbulence en route You need to purchase on board food or bring something with you but we knew this in advance so brought some food bought at Narita departures terminal All round good flights cheap and efficient and did exactly what we wanted Took us from A to B with no fuss or issues A solid experience Id recommend and plan on using again in the future

Zurich to Geneva return with Darwin Airline Booking and checkin was smooth online checkin was not available Boarding was quick maybe due to light load factors on both segments Both flights were on time arrival even early Very nice cabin crew comfortable seats with huge seat pitch s style on the Saab I can recommend them at least for flights from and to Geneva I am aware that Darwin Airline has some punctuality issues But that never happened to me Great value for money

A nice airport and frankly I am surprised at the bad reviews I arrived there at approx hrs Entry and checkin were very easy Security was straight forward and immigration was very easy Once on the airside a restaurant was open as were the dutyfree shops The only downside were the grumpy staff of the shops who obviously had not woken up yet Announcements were clear and boarding was orderly and we took off on time

Titan Airways flew us back from Mytilene to Manchester Flight ZT as part of the repatriation after TC collapsed The flight was excellent particularly the stewardesses who were helpful efficient and courteous The plane was very clean with better leg room than Ive had before on a typical economy class carrier at anytime in the past outside of long haul flights The only gripe I had was the in flight entertainment it didnt work even though it said I was connected I got no connection to it at anytime of trying This is why its only a and not a star review
Fantastic Ample and clean restrooms Great restaurants Napping rooms available to rent Everyone was kind and assisted as needed They asked me if I needed help Super customer friendly service

Surprisingly smooth flight on board Czech Airlines checkin was smooth and flight departed on time from Paris and as I had Plus fare they did not bother me about my cabin bag and backpack during boarding On board offer was OK and prices were low the beer which I ordered was cold which is perfect They also offered a water after the paid service so for the price I paid I was more than happy Flight arrived minutes early only downside of the trip was the long wait for the bags in Prague

I had a better experience than most of the other people who posted reviews here The airplane departed on time in Tblisi and arrived even a bit earlier Seats are comfortable Checked luggage is free which is very rare these days Be prepared for zero interaction with the staff members in the plane though Only at the entrance the staff greets you They seemed quite friendly though Theres no option to buy food and no information apart from an announcement that the landing has started The life vests looked quite old frayed and stained at least the one that the safety instructor showed maybe the ones stored under your seat are newer If you dont need luxury and you bring your own food this airline is really fine I dont know how they act in case of delays or cancellations though

On the th of October i arrived at the airport with a Uber rider Shortly after i left i noticed i left my phone in the uber who has driven off My flight was hour and minutes away from departure I tried asking for multiple people within the airport for help if they had the uber app to help me contact the driver as i would not be able to check in to the flight without my phone The kind police security gentleman by the name of Chris kindly helped me contact uber let me use his phone to call the uber driver and with only minutes left for depart kindly helped me through the security queue Honestly a life saver and I couldnt be more grateful for finding this man this day and i would like to once again thank you if you ever read this review

Nice lay out I got to the airport in the morning I just had a bit of some confusion as it was my first flight The automated ticket booths were convenient and quick Security was a breeze No queue the security personnel were nice and polite I didnt feel intimidated The gates are lined up along the back of the building nicely The Tim Hortons was next to my gate Washrooms are clean They even provide you with sanitizing wipes and cleaner to wipe the seat The stalls are private with no big gaps in the stalls Theres tables with outlets to charge your phone Coming back it was alright The luggage carousels are at the main floor where the front doors are

Louisville is actually one of the nicest airports in the United States poundforpound In fact Louisville on steroids gives you an idea of what more of our true international gateways should look like but dont I mean Detroit and Minneapolis are good but LAX and JFK Ill start with the good about Louisville Parking is easy and reasonably priced So easy in fact that its literally at the back door of the terminal and nicely covered for all those inclement weather situations The airport is super clean The personnel are aboveaverage in friendliness some of the security and restaurant staff could learn to smile but its hard for me to recount any particularly rude experiences with personnel The terminal is very Louisville and Kentuckythemed making the airport an unmistakable part of the state of Kentuckys cultural identity Security is usually a breeze even if you dont have TSA PreCheck which I have Its almost immediately next door to the state fairgrounds minutes from downtown and minutes from serene natural areas like Jefferson Memorial Forest The terminals are straightforward and wellsigned The public art is very localspecific and themed and attractively positioned As a bonus the airport is UPS primary North American hub so its neat to see the massive cargo planes regularly flying in and out of there The real drawbacks of flying into and out of Louisville are that baggage claim takes a little longer than it should for a relatively small airport and you have to pay close attention to signage right as youre driving off the property to access the freeways and fairgrounds In summary Its hard to go wrong with flying in and out of Louisville Ive been doing it for years and it just feels almost like putting on a comfortable pair of shoes

My husband suffers with neuropathy and towards the end of our holiday his feet were very painful which made walking difficult I did not arrange assistance at the airport and was concerned he was unable to do all the walking at the airport and worse still the amount of walking at Heathrow I enquired at the help desk and explained my predicament The staff were amazing and not only arranged assistance at Gibraltar but also contacted Heathrow on our behalf I cannot thank them enough for making our Journey an amazing experience at both airports which would have been a nightmare their kindness was was very much appreciated and I cannot thank them enough

From the moment you set foot inside Dublin Airport immediately distinguishes itself as a beacon of luxury especially noticeable within the sleek and sophisticated confines of Terminal Its modern aesthetic and design set it apart from the majority of international airports presenting an atmosphere not just of transit but of refined travel experience The layout of Dublin Airport is a testament to thoughtful design and planning The checkin areas are remarkably clear and wellorganized making navigation a breeze for travelers This accessibility extends throughout the airport with ample space lifts and escalators ensuring that everyone regardless of mobility can easily move around Perhaps most impressive is the airports commitment to leveraging cuttingedge technology for security processes The advanced systems in place mean that passengers dont need to remove liquids or electronics from their bags streamlining what is often a cumbersome process This efficiency is further highlighted by the minimal queues with most travelers getting through security in less than five minutesa clear indication of Dublin Airports effective use of technology and operational management The warmth and helpfulness of the staff at Dublin Airport cannot go unmentioned Each interaction is marked by genuine care making the travel experience exceptionally personal and pleasant Dublin Airport also excels in its retail and dining offerings The dutyfree selection is impressive featuring soughtafter brands and exclusive products at prices that challenge those of high street shops The food outlets including some newly launched ones offer a wide array of options catering to diverse tastes and dietary needs all at reasonable prices For travelers seeking a moment of tranquility or needing to attend to work the airport provides numerous lounges and workspaces alongside impeccably clean toilets and abundant seating areas Navigation through the airport is foolproof with gates clearly marked and the overall layout intuitively designed Also has free reliable WiFi unlike other major airports A unique feature that sets Dublin Airport apart on the global stage is its US Customs and Border Protection Preclearance facility allowing travelers to complete all immigration procedures before boarding This means arriving in the USA as if on a domestic flight bypassing the usual long queues upon arrivalan invaluable convenience In summary Dublin Airport is not just a travel hub but a remarkable experience in its own right Its commitment to luxury modernity and efficiency makes it a mustuse airport for anyone looking to elevate their travel experience The seamless blend of advanced technology outstanding customer service and thoughtful amenities positions Dublin Airport as a hidden gem in the world of air travel My advice Run dont walk to Dublin Airport for your next journey Its an experience that not only facilitates travel but inspires more of it

Fantastic flight Despite a delay departing Narita due to weather I really enjoyed my flight on Air Calin The crew were fantastic very friendly and helpful Excellent onboard service great food a very comfortable seat and the cabin was clean I would fly them again

A very pleasant experience both arriving and leaving this airport the terminal is well designed with some good places to eat and purchase last minute items too There is a business lounge which is a great oasis to relax and catch up on business for a fee which offers drinks and food Baggage collection was fast and was on the reclaim by the time we had walked from the arrival gate to the reclaim The customer service and information is very good and professional as is TSA who all appear to go the extra mile to assist passengers departing

I use this little airport for flights between northern England and SE Asia via AMS on KLM I find it a very convenient feeder airport to the AMS hub and the small size of the terminal ensures that arrivals are swift and painless Im on the road within mins of hitting the tarmac in most cases Staff are generally friendly and helpful By contrast nearby NCL which used to be very quick and efficient is much more hassle with some of the most miserable ground staff in Europe

Really nice clean small airport in terms of actual experience On arrival my Aer Lingus flight landed slightly ahead of schedule and I was airside within minutes from leaving aircraft door Immigration was a breeze and quick and the person checking passportsIDs was friendly and welcoming On departure security was fast and efficient and staff were relaxed and friendly The departure area is small but has couple of food options given the size and there was decent dutyfree area although I think greater part of this could be allocated to local products especially food given some of the really great quality stuff I had during my stay in Cork Toilets very clean and maintained and gate areas had plenty of seating The thing I loved though is they sell bottles of water for which you can just quickly tap and take from a stand no pricegouging and they have a refill station centrally located if you need refill it before you take off or if you brought your own bottle much better than Heathrow T when I left The only thing that lets this airport down and why I have marked it down is poor information on its website before travelling doesnt look like its been updated since covid and poor transfers from the airport to the city on arrival Taxis are expensive to the city at given the distance Bus to the city is regular service bus not a dedicated airport shuttle is only every half an hour in either direction and you need Leap card or euros no cards accepted This is inconvenient as international visitors wont necessarily immediately have the either of the former to hand I was lucky that a kind stranger on the bus paid for me using their own Leap card as the bus was waiting when I arrived if I had to go to get cash I would have missed it and had to wait half an hour for the next one Once on the bus it isnt clear when you arrive in the city as it is neither announced nor displayed on the electronic board just random street names and the bus runs with the lights off inside so you travel in the dark and it is all rather disorientating The stop in the city is also a random bus stop not the bus station which also makes it unclear where to get it from when you need to return to the airport from the city Im really perplexed why a city that has a lot of tourism has made it so difficultinconvenient for visitors in this respect and its a shame as the experience at the airport itself was excellent

Freetown Lungi International Airport is a small airport terminal building It recieves very few flights the majority being international It has so positive attributes like no congestion speedy check in and checkout A hotel is conveniently located near it There is a duty free shop and restaurant There is also a VIP Lounge for the elite and other first class passengers Beware that the airport is very small It needs renovations and a series of expansions effort due to its small size The government is in the works of expanding it to accomodate the international passengers

We had airport assistance for my elderly mother and the chap who met us at the plane Giorgious was excellent He spoke very good English and was super courteous and respectful and helpful throughout our transit He took us through immigration and then onto our lounge for a flight to London with Aegean Airlines He knew us by name within an instant and always explained what was happening next He should be celebrated The staff at the boarding gates were also very courteous and respectful as well I cant speak highly enough of everyone we dealt with at Athens Airport Even the ladies serving at the cafe considering how busy it was was excellent friendly and on point Its always a pleasure when you meet good people doing good things Well done Athens airport

I have used Polonia six times in the last four year both international and domestic arrival and departure No problems with taxis overcharging just as for any airport do your research Be affirmative informed and polite

Like many airports food and drinks are much too expensive I do therefore I also do not want to buy water It is not allowed to take bottled water through customs so most airports have free tap drinking water Also this airport But they are all disconnected I find this outrageous To have access to drinking water is a right
Not as big as Airports in Beijing and Shanghai that it is hard to navigate It is very efficiently run and very clean It is the best midsize international airport in China

The usual service everything ok Lounge at Madrid airport is just great Late boarding and late departure due to traffic control arrived min late On board crew is just great as usual very attentive full lunch served with open bar Seat comfort nothing special but fine for a hr flight Everything worked out well they need to pay attention to punctuality

Seoul to Busan First time with Air Busan and it was great Price App check in employees serviceluggage and on time At the check in I was offered an earlier flight no fee There were no problems with this airline and trip Recommend

Dont understand all negative reviews yes you can not compare this airport to a modern European or US one but short lines friendly people despite unfriendly behaving tourists enough seating to wait Smooth entry into the country expect to enter a country that is years back in time and you will enjoy your trip

Super tiny Airport like a bus terminal in my town but it was a quite clean and cozy place Location is nice not far from city and you can get there from city center by local bus for about euro There were nice sofas inside and the toilet was neat and clean

Gatwick to Larnaca Once you get on the plane all is well The customer service team on the ground not so great They claim they have no managers so the customer service advisors are their own managers Secondly to change your ticket they will only do this by arranging a call back and no other way If you ring to change your ticket they wont put you through to the team that deals with this but instead you need to wait for them to ring you back Very rigid and pretty appalling procedure if you ask me Customer service needs improving Lastly food on the plane could be better Compared to Aegean and British airways Cobalt business class food is economy plus

New airport opened around and much better than the old airport at the military airbase Plenty of checkin counters and smooth handling in security check First class lounge good As most Chinese airports it is noisy from continuous announcements
Perfect and uneventful flight left in time boarding in BKK was done professionally and efficient Staff were polite and helpful Enough space in overhead lockers

Spotlessly clean airport Fantastic cakes in departure Travelling to and from Kiev for Champions League final from Liverpool via Venice and Lviv Very smooth transit through Lviv Airport both ways Cakes were more memorable than the game unfortunately

I would like to give a commendation to the staff of Cebu Pacific working at the Roxas City airport who helped my father recover his lost luggage which was mistakenly picked up by another passenger These people worked hard and I have also witnessed all the efforts they made to give all the help that we needed Thank you for your hard work and dedication You guys are awesome

I arrived in this airport for transit My destination is Bangkok Thailand In my opinion the airport is quite small and kind of boring especially if you have a layover for more than hours There should have been some facilities that make the airport more interesting for example a reading corner some cool spots for taking a picture fun games and more cafes or restaurants The good thing is its easy to follow the signs or directions and you dont have to walk that far to reach the gate transit area departure or arrival hall So it would be a great idea to make this airport bigger and larger with more facilities

Nice pleasant airport Checkin usually fast security queue depends on the number of flights departing at the same time Airport gives you everything you need for a quick departure and arrival Before security check one cafe on st floor that opens too late in the morning and closes too early in the evening After security check one cafe no shops Toilet cleanliness depend on the time of the day but worn out

Three trips between CCS and BLA I found Conviasa to be clean modern friendly and welcoming My Spanish is functional but quite basic and when I struggled there was usually multilingual staff even on the short hop from Caracas to Barcelona and back Luggage allowance on this flight is a generous kg and a free drink is provided despite the flight time being only minutes Seats comfortable with more room than I was expecting All in all Conviasa offer a superior albeit slightly more expensive service on this short route than do their competitors Avior

A fairly typical African airport I was not hassled for bribes or other payments Immigration and baggage reclaim were not a problem on the way in Departure was a bit confusing and facilities limited on the way out They are rebuilding the airport at the moment whilst it is in use So it is in a poor state but looks like it will be very good when complete No business lounge at present The airport is very close to the centre of Ouagadougou so no long drive is required to get anywhere
OPOMIR return Cabin crew friendly breakfast served it was nothing special but not bad for plane food There was no entertainment onboard but the planes were clean

Flying from LHR to BKK Went through additional security checkpoint smoothly No big queues New clean and pleasant terminal All information were given very clear Hope to have such terminals more often in Europe Glad to be here again

I was transiting with Air China in Beijing Capital Airport Terminal Most international flights operate from Concourse TE but some use TD In my cause both arrival and departure were from TE On transit passengers need to go through document and security and customs check The walking times are not really long and mostly travelators are available There are transfer service checkpoints one from each side of the concourse The crowd is not really well organized and staff is not really helpful Not everyone speaks English which is quite frustrating when you actually need to communicate with airport or security staff Arriving early in the morning get ready to spend h queuing for transit Other than that I have to note that Terminal is very modern by its looks and layout The ceiling is high which makes it seam like the airport is free and spacious Walking distances are not too long Most gates are accessible in less than minutes of calm stroll Between TE TD and TC there is an automated people mover train which is easily accessible after security I didnt use it but I located its station and observed it a little There are few restaurants which in my opinion are quite reasonable priced Early in the morning only few Chinese restaurants and Western cafes were opened The food is actually quite delicious I would note good availability of seating spaces Some are equipped with universal power outlets and USB chargers If you want to use WiFi better use WiFi kiosks as SMS sometimes doesnt go through Be aware that you wont be able to use most messengers and social networks Also it was nice to have drinking fountains within short reach from most seating areas I would suggest considering Beijing Capital Airport as transit hub for Asia Clean and modern airport with all the necessary facilities for longer transits

Bogota to Pereira After reading many bad reviews were prepared for anything Fortunately everything went well Our slightly overweight baggage was not an issue kgkg the ground staff was friendly Not knowing if they charge extra for not printing the ticket we did the check in ourselves but seeing many with an airline printed ticket I assume this is not an issue The flight left minutes earlier the cabin crew was friendly as well and during the short flight they even offered us a small free drink The plan was clean the captain friendly So overall a great experience Not much to complain about really

This is one of the main gateways to Lapland and nearby ski resorts and other outdoor activities Terminal has been recently expanded and refurbished but its still quite small for an international airport so during peak season in winter when there are plenty of charter flights from the UK and Central Europe they do run out of space sometimes However the place is cozy and they even have rocking chairs Outside peak season its very easy and fast go through security and checkin

This review is for International arrivals and US Departures Ive used this airport in December and then again in March In general a much better experience this time around On arrival sufficient immigration desks were staffed and customs was quick enough so that I was in my hotel within minutes of touching down On departure the new US Departures terminal is much improved from the older version Check in and security is quick and efficient The only place where there are lines is the US immigration pre clearance Airside the terminal is quite pleasant with lots of shops restaurants etc While the main restaurant Kafe Kalik I think is pleasant with outdoor seating I would not recommend ordering food there unless you want to risk missing your flight they took minutes to bring our food
Very new very clean lots of natural light Easy and fast arrivals process Departure area spacious

Arriving in Manado from Singapore by SilkAir is always a good experience The greenery around the airport was beautiful and the short walk less than minutes from the plane to the immigration counter is a relief compared to the minute walk I used to have in Changi when rushing from immigration to the gate The terminal building is quite clean and adequate The only downside is the crowd outside the arriving gate exit There were lots of illegal taxis touting arriving passengers The lack of seating area outside the terminal is also a concern as it was hard to find a proper place to sit while waiting for someone to arrive
Milan Bergamo to Tirana Lot of comfort reclining seat big leg space cheap food prices on board cabin crew very professional Flight on time

Gothenburg to Cambridge with SunAir a franchise partner of British Airways Aircraft are painted in British Airways livery and operate under BA flight numbers The flight was only half full making the seat Dornier more like a private jet than a small airliner Full meal and bar service on this hour flight Crew very good

I flew China Airlines of Taiwan from Vienna to Taipei in December with an onward journey to Bangkok and Taipei to Vienna in January in their business class The cabin of the A was kept clean and the equipment is modern despite not having a privacy door the privacy was great A is definitely my favorite airplane I have much less jetlag after long haul flights I heard the airline is upgrading its product in years Service on both flights was truly first class Very engaging and friendly and nothing is too much trouble for the crew On the outbound flight the crew working in my section was super professional on par with the standard offered by Singapore Airlines On my return journey Magret was super friendly and take personal care of the passengers The cabin manager on the return journey was also very pleasant and helpful Food onborad was excellent China Airlines unlike its competitor EVA or Starlux doesnt offer an intensive menu but the food and drink quality is really good On the way back I chose the course prepared by a Michelin star restuanrat in Taipei but my favorite is always the special vegetarian food which is also Michelin star and you need to preorder online The lounge in Taipei is either very busy morning peak hours and also evening or very quiet There is no natural light so it is dark However it is tastefully decorated and the food was very tasty Service like their onboard standard was very personal and friendly There is always a queue for the shower due to the terminal size the lounge isnt large Hopefully this will be addressed once Terminal opens so make sure you put your request in early Onboard wifi worked well and there is no data cap that is a huge bonus Now comes the cons the business class seat on A is equipped with a very large and clear monitor but the entertainment choice is fairly limited not sufficient moviesTVmusic to keep me occupied Also the seat and amenity is great especially the duvet but when the seat is fully flat the leg space becomes a bit constrain

This review is limited to Terminal only Terminal is about years old and a significant upgrade over Terminal The terminal is very clean brightly lit and wide concourses There are dining options aplenty and plenty of seating at the gates Immigration was a smooth process with biometric screening epassport line Took no more than minutes in line Upon exiting customsbaggage claim one has to run the gauntlet of the time share vultures Surprisingly there are no benches for passengers to sit awaiting ground transportation pickup Departure experience was very pleasant Easy checkin with minimal wait times for security and immigration

I am convinced that anyone that has anything bad to say about Stansted is either paid delusional or a banker that hasnt got anything positive to say about anything Ive travelled to airports so not quite as many as some people but Ive been to enough to say that Stansted is bloody marvelous at what it does Its simple clean efficient has a beautiful single terminal building some of the fastest security queues Ive ever seen no matter how many people its trying to push through Stansted is quite simply operationally one of the best ever and Ive never had to wait more than minutes departing Even arrivals moves ridiculously fast and while sometimes you can wait in a queue that looks lengthy to enter the country it never takes that long The people working at Stansted know how to move Its an absolutely marvelous display and it always astounds me whenever I go Its a well signposted airport very easy to navigate the quiet area is fantastic loads of shops and food options My only MINOR criticism is that it can sometimes be difficult to find a place to sit down upstairs but other than that its absolutely a class airport

BrisbaneHoniara Checkin a little slow but request for seat changes so our group could sit together handled without fuss A has comfortable seats with good leg room but no IFE despite old style screens throughout the cabin being available Catering is very basic and catering equipment is old and well used Toilets clean but are old and smelly Highlight was the crew who offered drinks throughout the flight not just responding to requests but proactively out in the cabin for the whole flight Recommend having breakfast before the flight and bring a book or iPad but otherwise an enjoyable flight and cheaper than Virgin
From Prague to Saint Petersburg great service nice food professional group price of the ticket was higher than competitors but worth it highly recommended

Atyrau to Uralsk I had a few meetings to attend in Uralsk and Aksai and was not looking forward to the hour or more arduous taxi journey from Atyrau to Uralsk in C heat I was recommend to use Qazaq Air as they now have a direct flight from Atyrau to Uralsk I booked a return flight online selected a seat paid via card and my eticket was immediately emailed On arrival to the airport checkin is simple and efficient The flight was serviced by a Bombardier Dash Next Gen aircraft which was very clean and the aircrew well dressed and welcoming The flight h m was very good with a surprisingly powerful takeoff and flight landing mins earlier than scheduled I certainly was impressed with the overall service and the value for money I will be using Qazaq air again for direct flights around west Kazakhstan

I flew TokyoSapporoTokyo I was pleasantly surprised at the efficiency and professionalism of the staff The crew spoke English We departed and arrived ontime The great price combined with the excellent service ensures I will fly Skymark again

Very quiet and peaceful airport well equipped with benches places to sit and even lie down It is not a large airport so the catering facilities with shops are small but sufficient Very nicely designed areas where you can sit and experience Finnish nature For the first time I see an airport where you can relax physically and mentally It is also a bit cold it perfectly reflects the climate of Finland It does not heat up excessively and there is a delicate chorus which can be annoying at first but after some time you get used to it

LHR T BA Gold Wing worked well Pleasant check in and very fast security screening Concorde room service attentive C gate boarding OK but nothing special for First Passengers Latest BA version of first with only suites with privacy doors Comfortable seat with plenty of stowage Good screen and good choice of IFE Amenity kit good quality and bedding pillows cushions and blankets all good Excellent menu and food very well presented Cabin crew could not have been more attentive and helpful without being obtrusive On time departure and early arrival Bags delivered relatively swiftly and priority tagged bags were first off All in all one of the best BA First flights Ive had in many years Whilst not touching the Middle Eastern carriers BA First on this showing is easily the best way to cross the Atlantic

So refreshing to be able to use Duerne instead of Brussels Less than minutes from plane to car this week and that included collecting a bag On return I checked in about minutes before the flight hardly any queue

Johannesburg to Lilongwe via Blantyre Very impressed with Malawian Airlines On time departures and arrivals excellent food served both outbound lunch chicken and return breakfast fried eggs lovely coffee and generous baggage allowance Crucially Ethiopan Airlines the part owner has timed the flight with an early morning departure from Malawi such that a large majority of passengers were connecting on our flight in Johannesburg onto regional Southern Africa routes and donestically within SA whereas SAA schedule from Lilongwe would require an overnight stay in Johannesburg clever scheduling Both flights nearly full No entertainment or music onboard

Gatwick to Puerto Vallarta We travelled in premium economy both directions and its worth the upgrade but only just Firstly the premium check in was fast the included lounge access was great The only part of the upgrade that doesnt work is the bags off first this didnt happen in both directions The food quality was acceptable drinks were free flowing The crew seemed to be experienced and happy which made for an enjoyable flight both ways

A quick efficient security check just inside the door then youre in a big lobby and go to a checkin counter which you must do at any rate for a flight out of Russia even if you printed a boarding pass online so dont bother There are plenty of shops and places to eat both before and after formal passport control and formal security each of which involved less than minutes queuing Quintessentially Russian the passport officer never smiled but he was efficient and in no way discourteous Restrooms are clean and wellmaintained I awaited boarding in a nice lounge but almost all the newspapers to read are in Russian which I cant read Ample seating area at gate My flight to Paris had boarding via a jetway

Hamilton International is a great little airport and very convenient for people trying to avoid the hustle and bustle of Pearson My family is located in southern Ontario and I always use this airport The only complaint I would have is the decision of management to serve no alcoholic beverages

Excellent flight more leg room than other airlines cabin stewardess who was excellent and tended to all passenger requirements served all passengers with complimentary food with drink which is unknown nowadays Good old fashioned service and customers do count Flight from Waterford VG th June

Just recently MacArthur Airport here in the middle of Long Island recieved a makeover The makeover included a big new concourse added terminals and new concessions Its beautiful It is a big relief to see the airport go from old and small to new and bigger The new concourse was built and is now primarily owned by Southwest Airlines The layout of the airport is very simple and easy to navigate As soon as you walk in the main entrance you can either make a right to get to the checkin counters or make a left to get to the carousels and pickup a friend that just arrived Security is fairly fast There are a number of concession stands as well as souvenir shops located before after the security checkpoint The following airlines service MacArthur Airport some of the airlines may use a codeshare partner for some flights Southwest Airlines Delta Connection Continental Express US Airways express Brand new concourse terminals concessions

Smooth flight and comfortable seat Premium economy still a good value on Finnair The cabin chief was competent as I got a problem with only one choice of meal Im platinum and I was upset to see the poorest service during the dinner on board he went to apologize so its good but when you pay euros you expect a better service concerning the food The flight attendants have to be more smiley

Air Belgium for Srilankan Airlines Uncomfortable business class seat looks well used only good thing was the massage function Mix of crew from Air Belgium and Srilankan mostly friendly Food was tasty and filling a good variety to chooses from Toilet wasnt overly clean
Milan Bergamo to Tirana Lot of comfort reclining seat big leg space cheap food prices on board cabin crew very professional Flight on time

A short but enjoyable flight Staff were friendly and helpful Check in was easy and the plane left on time A small snack was provided which is fine on so short a flight They also offered free beer and wine which was a nice surprise

Nice and efficient airport Security and passport controls are quick and smooth and makes the airport easy to travel to and from Good connections for transfers to other airport in Norway or Europe Easy access to Trondheim with airport train buses or taxi Brand new Radisson SAS hotel adjacent to terminal A

Flew from Prague to Rome Ciampino return with both flights spot on time noting that both legs were fully booked without any empty seats onboard No checked in baggage so headed straight to the gate The Ryanair mobile App is helpful apart from the nagging up selling but its understandable Its great boarding passes can be saved viewed in Google Wallet Boarding was managed well in PRG and CIA even with the full of passengers with Prague being strict on carry on luggage sizes as some fellow travellers were being a bit cheeky The cabin crew on my return flight were especially superb and professional with a smile Both legs were on a Boeing s I suspect there are no Max stationed in Prague One had an updated interior with slim seats and notably much more comfortable esp Legroom than the other although both were in top condition including cleanliness This product is ideal hassle free for quick flights around Europe
Great airport Easy to park easy to get to terminal and fast security Beats almost every other larger airport I have been to Not much to do but you wont be there long anyway

Having gone through so many different airports around the world Kuching Airport is definitely one of the better airports to use Airport workers here checkin counters security immigration etc are generally fine but can be improved especially on the level of professionalism in their communication with passengers The airport may look very new but there is a need to improve some facilities such as seating areas especially the terminal Air Asia uses at one end of the single terminal and the automated passport gates at the arrival hall Cleanliness can be improved as well particularly on the toilets Overall Kuching Airport is a good and hasslefree airport to use

I was very impressed with the experience at Riga Airport So fast through security and no problems with my Japanese hair sticks which look like weapons on xrays Pleasant staff too which makes a real change Wish I could say the same for UK airports Good range of shops and helpful staff but some of the cafes are very expensive just for coffee and cake Slightly let down by toilets and desolate area C after passport control but generally very impressed compared to some nightmare experiences in the UK

Small clean efficient The departure terminal is well run theres a nice bar though the windows have been covered with some coloured adhesive plastic preventing from a view to the runway Everything is so simple and hassle free that one does not need to arrive hours before departure time Very nice indeed

Decided to fly this route to mainland China instead of my usual HKG Flew from TSAKNH return on what seemed to be a new Embraer E This airline is the domestic offshoot for China Airlines and the English language version of their website is a simple cut and paste from the international airline However the baggage allowance for domestic Taiwanese flights is only KG so I had to really point out that the English information states KG and after some trouble I was able to fly without having to pay extra Despite that the actual flight to and from Kinmen was quick comfortable and care free Only a snack and water was served on the flight but it was only minutes long so it was not an issue I was pleased to have been given the Emergency Exit row on both flights too handy being the taller westerner that I am Except for the baggage allowance issue I can not find fault with them

We arrived on Monarch which was a great flight from London Gatwick on arrival to Mahon we swiftly disembarked into a very cool air conditioned Arrivals lounge where bags took no more than minutes to reach the conveyors Everything else went smoothly and we proceeded to car rental so all in all I estimate we were on are way to Villa less than an hour of arriving On the return had no problems at check in had a polite and friendly check in lady Aircraft was on time All in all a very good experience of Mahon airport from start to finish

Wow We were amazed at the transformation of this airport in the space of year since being taken over by a German company Previous check in desks removed and brand new ones on a different wall far more Check in was seamless and plenty check in desks A new security area which was quick and smooth apart from the aggressive female member of staff shouting at passengers and rolling her eyes brand new duty free area Such an improvement Heraklion airport in Crete could take some tips We were stesssed thinking about our return journey but the airport has vastly improved Arrival area is also spacious and easy All toilets in the airport have been renewed

CAA replacement for Thomas Cook flight repatriation back to the UK after firms collapse Staff were excellent plane a little dated but clean and spacious also under subscribed Comfortable great service thank you all
Its easy to get around very friendly people and easy to get bags and leave Always a good experience and they have free wifi so never a problem with communication

Flew Solomon Airlines from Brisbane to Honiara We boarded to be greeted by smiling attendants The flight was not too full so we had seats to ourselves Leg room was quite good IFE was just a screen panel lowered from the ceiling watched a movie The meal was lunch we had the beef and it was delicious Staff came around to check if we needed any more drinks throughout the flight

A small domestic airport in Taiwan Fast and friendly staff Surprisingly many shops Looked very clean Because this is a military airport too you can spot military aircraft taking off and land taking photos is forbidden though On time nonchaotic boarding and the plane took off in schedule Recommend
Nice and very effective Airport With an Business Class Ticket your within Minutes at the Lounge The Security Check also Works smooth Great experience
The area looks is not designed for such a huge passenger number some of the staffs are rude and unfriendly The terminal has a nice overview of the taxiways and runways

Stockholm Bromma to Malm Sturup Very friendly cabin crew and good service This is the only airline in Sweden that serve free meals during domestic flights The plane were clean and the seats were of standard model I will fly with Malm Aviation whenever I go to Stockholm again Best domestic airline so far

This airport is probably one of the best I have been to Every employee I encountered was friendly and eager to help The airport itself was clean and efficient I flew in and out of this airport at busy times of the week and did not experience any problems When I landed I went through baggage claim quickly and was waiting for my friend in a matter of minutes When I was flying out I had the same experience I said goodbye to my friend and five minutes later I was at the gate What a pleasure compared to flying out of Orlando and there is free wifi

Since there is no other airport that you can go through to get to this place I have to recommend it Staff were friendly and nice There were no long lines at departure I was taking AA flight in the afternoon and there were some people waiting for BA flight At arrival I went through immigrations and customs with no hassle Lady at immigration even said Welcome to St Kitts I never hear those pleasantries in the US I heard they are building a new terminal So I hope they could have more services at the new terminal
This airport was very efficient no lines or delayed services There are a lot of shops where you can shop and places where you can have a bite Delicious coffee and bakery items to buy

This is one of the nicest airports I have visited The staff are all helpful and cheerful The security system is quick and efficient and the seating areas are comfortable and spacious The woman playing piano in the area prior to security really sets the tone The whole expereince was professional polite and efficient

Tontouta International Airport is located km outside of Noumea If you catch a cab to the airport be prepared to pay for a twoway journey as cabbies are not guaranteed a return fare back into town Theres no point turning up early for your flight The airport only operates when flights are due to arrivedepart Checkin counters the small souvenir shop and cafe dont open till minutes prior to scheduled departures Duty free shopping is only available airside which can only be accessed minutes prior to departure Surprisingly smoking is permitted in all parts of the terminal In summary Tontouta is a very basic facility offering very basic services On a more positive note all the airports ground staff were exceptionally friendly helpful and good natured including checkin agents security immigration and customs officials

We were booked to take flights on Yangon in June A little concerned when we fronted the quaint little desk in Yangon to find it unattended but were assured that there are helpers at all Myanmar airports who take your bag to the desk and deal with it The next flights on Yangon were good Planes were all prop aircraft seating about I think we were on the same plane every time Seats are not allocated which worried us at first but it was not an issue The sticker to identify patrons in the departure lounge are a cute touch Nice little snack and drink no matter how short the flight Staff were friendly and helpful

RGNSNW Quick boarding with allocated seating for minute flight in ATR to Ngapali Beach Good safety briefing before time take off and light snack and drink en route Pleasant FAs smooth flight and great landing over the surf and through the palm trees to this small exRAF WW strip on the Bay of Bengal Luggage is delivered by handcart to the entrance gatesexpect to pay kyat per piece

This airport has frequent JR rail connections to Sapporo making it very convenient Huge shopping area and many places to eat and drink Support staff was very friendly and helped me make a free Wifi connection as well as find me a restaurant that serves vegetarian food

A quick visit to Rome from Prague on Ryanair The airport location close to the city is great with a painless connection via Airport Link Bus Train The entire trip easily purchased on the Trenitalia app for only to Termini The airport terminal itself is large enough to accommodate flights at the same time could be stretched to capacity with more traffic Boarding and disembarking on foot with some shops available Staff was curtuous so our departure was on time The proximity to Rome is a strong selling point when comparing to FCO

Nice Airport Well organised checkin for B and speedy transit through TSA roomy concourse and nice Buffalo wings There was a fire alarm while we were there which was dealt with with only minor disruption good views of the apron and active runway A good alternative to Toronto for Niagara

I have flown Porter on other occasions and have many good experiences I was supposed to travel with them in April but due to an accident I would not be able to with upcoming doctor and Physio appointments The customer service representative Erin was phenomenal She listened and asked questions as to address my issue with regards to my upcoming flight I am now able to have time to heal myself and take my flight at a later date Thank you Erin and Porter

Frank Pais International Airport at Hologuin has two terminals one modern deals with international charter and scheduled services and the other older deals with flights to and from Havana My comments relate to the older national terminal The tone is set when passengers see the huge portrait of former President Fidel Castro on the airport terminal plus the slogan on the perimeter wall Socialism or Death This sets the tone for what is usually a pleasant visit to the city of Holguin Incoming passengers walk to the terminal where an excellently designed baggage conveyor promptly brings the luggage to be reclaimed The design of this conveyor requiring passengers simply to reach their suitcases off the belt is in contrast to those at much newer larger UK airports On arrival for your return flight check in is swift and simple and the waiting lounge has somewhat noisy Cuban TV playing loud music all the time

Warsaw to Tallinn Our flight was in codeshare with LOT Polish Airlines Between our arrival and departure there were minutes gate opens mins before departure the ground crew worked very well so we could catch our Nordica flight to Tallinn with ease The seats are comfortable the legroom is more than okay Bigger meals and drinks are available on purchase but they serve complementary drinks coffee tea water and snacks chocolate bar The cabin crew was kind and the cabin was clean

Norfolk International Airport ORF in Norfolk Virginia is one of the best airports that I have flown into or out of in the past year The airport itself is set in the middle of a beautiful botanical gardens It is great to wonder through the grounds of the gardens if you have several hours to kill between connections The airport has a variety of resturants that are very reasonably priced and the food is excellent Access into and out of the airport is easy Parking is great with a well lighted attached parking garage The new arrivals terminal which was recently completed is huge and baggage retrieval and rental car pickup is a breeze The only thing lacking at this airport is direct access to the Interstate highway system After leaving the airport property you have to travel through a residentialcommercial neighborhood to gain access to the Interstate

We use the BA lounges here to avoid the horrendous crowds everywhere in the terminals This airport needs at least two more terminals to offer the space and experience many of its rivals offer When we landed at Terminal we had another interminable wait for our luggage Not a great experience again Id recommend it only because it is better than the other London airports

Very clean airport arrival and departure very well organized Lots of places to sit with a view of the runway in the departure hall The Billa supermarket located in the airport terminal is a good choice Transport fromto the airport very easy

This is a comparatively new airport in Tunisia and I have nothing but praise for it It is clean smart and well organised Check in and Security were quick and once through to airside a really good duty free shop and a bar Great views from the glass fronted terminal although the view of some aircraft can be obscured by the piers Everything ran smoothly and just a pleasure to travel through this airport

A very shortened Flight due to favourable Tail Winds saw us arrive minutes early into Bangkok excellent My goal was just to sleep on this overnight flight That goal was achieved and a comfortable hours sleep was enjoyed The actual Seat was looking shabby old No Food or Drink were taken so I can not comment on the service Would fly Gulf Air again if going to the UK

Had a chance to fly Canadian North for the first time from Calgary to Inuvik in the Northwest Territories Check in friendly with no extra charge for my bags The aircraft was a Boeing which replaced the Fokker Flight Attendants were friendly attentive We were served a hot breakfast Return flight equally as pleasant with a hot dinner this time and free wine The service reminded me of the Wardair days I only wish that they flew across lower Canada as well

This is an efficient and wellequipped airport For travellers on AA beware that ground staff and security dont seem to communicate The security channel for US departures remained closed until beyond the scheduled time of departure with no explanation given The departure boards didnt show that there was a minute delay and instead left all boarding passengers to wait outside the secure area This seems to be a specific AA problem

This is a nice airport people are friendly check in efficient It is a clean airport and it has a nice building with plants and water fonts Brasilia is a modern City and it is airport is like the city just fantastic

The airport was a bit far from the city but well connected to the public transportation with clear signs and direction It was in general clean Queuing time at the immigration was not too long for us As many other Asian international airports TPE was full of restaurants and a shopping paradise for passengers to kill waiting time Each boarding gate had a different theme and sometimes did not have enough seats for everyone

Having read reviews here I expected a nightmare but everything went very smoothly Terminal A seems to be new and very efficiently organised Staff friendly and helpful and lines short It was a quiet period so it might be different at Thanksgiving and other busy times
TPEKHH one way Plane full but staff friendly on time and no complaints A bargain considering the onehour flight was only about USD

On arrival the airport was very clean There was water fountains and music It was very peaceful When we departed checkin was so easy and security was simple There were lots of shops and dutyfree Overall One of the best airports in the world

A small airport right in the east of the city center with a convenient metro connection readily available The terminal itself is small but well organized and has enough small shops for food and beverages Security queuing times late in the evening were nonexistent border control only inbound was equally fast Best airport if youve to be in London itself

Flew Flybe on the Belfast to Amsterdam route and was pleasantly surprised on the CheckIn Boarding and inflight service The inflight service is just Tea Coffee Juice and some biscuits however the overall service was very good For such a small aircraft there were cabin crew onboard The overall ambience of the aircraft was very good and clean The cabin crew kept cleaning toilet after anyone had used it I was very happy with the flight and service

Such a cute and well designed airport I am very impressed the moment my flight from Malaysia landed I realized this airport is mainly used for private jets and my flight from Malaysia operated by Firefly Facilities look new and very well maintained Immigration process is very smooth as well as luggage delivery Its great to know theres another alternative to fly into Kuala lumpur

Burbank provides a convenient and easy alternative to LAX although the departure hall in Terminal B is too small to accommodate more than flights at a time There were flights an MD a and CRJ regional jets boarding simultaneously and the small space and cramped conditions caused confusion and delayed boarding for everyone

Hilo International Airport was once THE airport on the Big island before Kona International Airport on the other side of the island opened in the ss Now Hilo Airport is a shadow of its former self with jetways no more than of which are in use at any given time The decor is kitschy s Hawaiiana and the terminal is warm and welcoming Hilo is one of the few US airports where the gate area and the ticketingbag claim are in separate buildings separated by an atrium The ticketingbag claim area has a bar a bookshop a souvenir shop selling Hawaiiana and packaged tropical fruit and a lounge area The gate building has no facilities The parking and car rental areas are just across the street from bag claim and the total walk from gate to kerb is only a few hundred feet Access to and from Hilo town is easy and traffic is usually light

While waiting for passport control I felt very hot and dizzy I asked a make member of staff if I could have some water He got me through security got me water and made sure I was ok Very helpful and I wish I knew his name to thank him

Hargeisa to Djibouti Air Djibouti operates one single Boeing leased with crew from a company in Tajikistan as well as reportedly a few smaller aircraft We flew from Hargeisa to Djibouti in November The plane had arrived from Mogadishu with a delay but landed in JIB almost on time It was definitely at least years old but appeared to be in a very good state of repair Seats were tight but comfortable Catering consisted of a single bottle of water which was ok on this min hop Okay was also our general impression

OsloCopenhagen th Aug on a B Oslo Airport is shamelessly very pricey Timely arrived minutes prior to schedule smooth flight Easy superfast checkin in Oslo Granted nice soft roomy seats and a full row of loads of space Flight only half full Catering onboard good though only at hefty costs Ticket inexpensive No IFE WiFi or frills But no complaints the price does not allow for much complaints Boardingdeboarding very quick through jetbridges Aircraft and FAs were somehow aged but all worked effectively

Very modest airport that clearly cannot handle a high volume of flights Check in is very modest and slow and people speak very basic English Undoubtedly we are facing a country that urgently needs tourism and foreign funds to improve the quality of its infrastructure Fortunately the new international airport in Phnom Penh will open in a few years and I hope they will be able to guarantee the cleanliness of the space a better quality of service increase the number of places where you can sit and also the spaces before boarding

I suddenly needed to use the special assistance service at Newcastle airport in order to go on holiday in May I had seen in the media the chaotic scenes at some uk airports and in addition the issues for passengers with disabilities I never expected Newcastle special assistance service to contradict the horror stories but it certainly did To put it simply they excelled and you should go on holiday via Newcastle with absolute confidence What an amazing service They have some of the most friendly helpful and professional staff who cannot do enough to help you and put you at ease They explain what is happening throughout the transit process in the airport To and from the aeroplane Through security to baggage collection even right through to getting in the taxis home They get you through

Nauru to Pohnpei Small but friendly airline The seat configuration was and the legroom was OK for my ft frame No real inflight entertainment On the relatively shorthaul island hopping only snacks were served but there was beer and wine The best feature of this airline were the charming cabin crew clad in blue and I thought of them as Angels in Blue

I recently flew from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic and it was another fantastic experience The E remains my favorite aircraft for regional travelspacious comfortable and perfect for short flights Despite the flight being only minutes the crew went above and beyond by offering beverage service which exceeded my expectations for such a short route As someone who travels this route twice a week I deeply appreciate the attentiveness of the regional air crew who consistently provide a level of care and attention that rivals the mainline carrier Excellent service all around

Fortaleza Praia February The flight was operated in a reasonable B by no means new but not as rickety as I had been led to believe The seating was alleconomy and the leather seats fine but slippery Seat pitch was OK and I am a tall chap certainly an inch or more greater than its competitors The flight departed minutes late at and due to the hour I declined the meal offered which looked bland but edible We arrived in Praia on schedule and my bags did the same connecting to Sal and Mindelo without delay All in all a reasonable experience
