Tallinn is my favourite airport of all airports Ive been to Its so small lovely and there are never crowds flowing around There are about gates The Business Lounge is quiet and comfy and theres always enough food Its main difference is the low ceiling compared to other airports There arent many restaurants or shops but the Tax Free Shop has almost everything needed for your flight Staff very friendly and WiFi works well

I simply love Norwegian Its a no nonsense airline that has been incredibly reliable on of the legs that I have recently flown with them Seat pitch is sufficient pricing is fair and predictable and everything just works The service is fine and the onboard menu contains all you need for a few hours in the air I regard them much higher than most old airlines now saying this as a Lufthansa Senator

Its been seven years since I last flew on Lufthansa I was fortunate enough to fly on Lufthansa for the first time in seven years and the moment I got on that plane I felt good Because it was a short flight I didnt have to worry about anything But the best part was that I got a Milk Chocolate bar from Lindt and whats nice is that they have a Lufthansa logo on it what a finishing touch
Lovely crew Very clean plane and rather comfy seating The seat belt sign was on most of the flight although not much turbulence Quite many announcements The food was fine but wine glasses very small

Nice friendly airport Quick check in usually efficient security screening everybody keeps moving Gates are easy to findnavigate Short on food options nice bar after security near Gate Good coffeebagel bar near Gate The new airport is about finished Will be nice to see the improvements Eisenhower is the new airport name excellent choice

LX from Vienna to Zurich operated by Helvetic Airways The flight was completely full but boarding was expertly handled by the crew and went very smoothly The EE is a small aircraft and space in the overhead bins is limited The crew assisted passengers with finding a place for their carryon luggage and in the end all luggage could be stored somewhere Also the crew were very friendly and courteous As this was a very short flight a small snack was served which was excellent All in all a very comfortable short flight on a small aircraft with an excellent crew

I was meant to be flying with Wizz Air back from Athens until we were told it was operated by Titan Airways However it was a pleasant surprise to climb aboard a Titan aircraft The staff were extremely professional and incredibly helpful I would happily fly again with them

Dusseldorf to Berlin Eurowings flight operated by Germanwings EW Flight had a slight delay of minutes Flight was smooth and good Seat was fine with enough legroom Food and drinks for puchase crew was just average

The service was good everything that I ordered came in a minute or less and all my needs were attended to Free snacks of hot fudge and tea Fast and there were no delays not late for take off or landing Really recommend thanks for a great flight I am really happy

My husband and I traveled to Yellowknife for a day The main reason was that we wanted to visit Buffalo Airways Canadian North were fantastic Both services on time and on the way back to Edmonton we were lucky enough to travel on a Combi which was fantastic The crew on the way home made us feel so welcome They were efficient and very pleasant Great breakfast on the way up and a good dinner on the way back If only they were a bit closer to our home in Australia We would be more than happy to travel with Canadian North any time A great experience

This review covers only interisland travel On the whole it works pretty well The carousel checkin is OK I recommend printing your boarding pass in advance so its easier to access your reservation number First Class is a breeze Customer service if you need to make a change is very helpful although sometimes overwhelmed for the number of customers and the logistics could be improved TSA has always been swift especially if you have PreCheck and Ive found the agents to be friendly Departure gates could use more seating but boarding has always been prompt and efficient for my flights Arrivals are a breeze although sometimes it takes a bit longer for luggage to arrive The lounge is nothing special but clean and nice to use if you have access I usually only take a carryon and on the whole things work well

I flew with Air France from Vancouver to CDG onward to Seville on Feb and then return Madrid to Vancouver via CDG Paris on Feb rd Air France is now my definite top choice for Canada to Europe Their business class way exceeds Air Canada Turkish and any other European carrier Ive done around trips almost all in business Their food wine quality is restaurant quality very inventive extremely good On my Vancouver to Paris Feb th flight Agnes was my main flight attendant Her service was impeccable Similarly my return flight Paris to Vancouver was also very good flight attendants all excellent focused with very high levels of service The A is a beautiful cabin I got to sit in A coming back and that felt like a first class seat with extra room at bulk head pod sliding door I love how Air France sets up a little refreshment area during rest times Im Star Alliance generally but for Europe an Air France convert Take note Lufthansa you have a long way to catch up and although Ive had kind attendants and service on AC biz class the food wine quality does not compare to Air France Merci beaucoup Air France and mademoiselle Agnes for her kindness on my flight over and for the wonderful service I received Their lounges are a bit crowded but the quality is very good and again for fooddrink showers rest areas What a wonderful experience I hope to fly again with them soon

KigaliJoburg June in an old narrowbody B I was upgraded from an inexpensive economy ticket to business class by using miles in their Dream Miles Frequent Flyer Program Checkin and lounge access in Kigali smooth as usual Luggage was kindly checked in to final destination legs ahead on different tickets and airlines Thats a courtesy winner which hardly any European airlines can cope with Checkin issued my onward Boarding Passes on the spot which made my life easy by staying in transits throughout the journey enjoying entitlements and lounges instead of struggling with immigration and landside eg in South Africa Lounge in Kigali is good though still with room for minor improvements Boarding easy by walking m on tarmac directly to the aircraft The business seats were in rows in x configuration I had D to avoid direct exposure to the rising morning sun In economy seats are narrower and in x configuration Morning flight departed on time and arrived slightly early Onboard seating perfect special meal accommodated other hot meals offered were also good No drinks and no food menu provided Unclear what they actually had onboard for catering Drinks and wine selection sparse and modest However we were offered predeparture champagne Piper Heidshick FAs were generous pampering us well and of world class in kindness and attentiveness They might benefit from further airline exposures IFE is useless no headsets given Given FFP miles instantly according to my original booking Luggage well handled Cannot demand much more for regional flights in business class

Previous comments on GPT are no longer true Often GPT is cheaper that New Orleans or any other nearby airport The presence of AirTran keeps fares very reasonable and service is pretty good in all directions The new terminal to be completed this year will be beautiful

I have taken flights on V Air and found it a surprisingly pleasant experience The aircraft seemed new the FAs were very efficient and the meals prebooked at a discount tasty On the latest TPECNX flight I measured the seat pitch at If this is accurate then it puts many of the long distance flights on legacy carriers to shame The first flight in May was held up an hour at TPE due to runway maintenance The other two this month both departed within minutes of the advertised schedule Its about time there were low cost carriers between BKK and TPE I will happily take V Air for future trips
This is a smashing little airport friendly well laid out and very well run Because of its location very attractive to fly in and out of too always a big shock returning to Gatwick Good ice cream too

ABQ is a nice concept but one that needs some improvements For starters If you have TSA PreCheck here youre golden Security is an efficient and friendly process If you dont have PreCheck then the service at least for a small airport can be quite noncommunicative abrasive and slow The puebloinspired architecture and interior design of the airport render it one of the most beautiful small airports in the USA and the postsecurity viewing area of the runway and mountains is the sort of thing that more airports in this country need However its not always easy to enjoy the design and the views when the tile and carpet flooring and seating throughout the airport are dirty and for a lack of better words dilapidated and outdated Speaking of seating there really isnt enough of it in my opinion The signage directing you to amenities services and locations throughout the airport is helpful but also outdated The dining and shopping options are fine for a small airport so no real complaints Some people complain about the rental car facility being separate from the terminal and requiring a shuttle bus but honestly the bus runs frequently and the ride is pretty short Everything is easily accessible from I and downtown Albuquerque With a little modernization and polishing ABQ has the potential be as good as new again

ZHRGVAVCE and back Checkin at Zurich and Venice airport very quick and efficient Good connection times at Geneva airport much better than other carriers Flights departed on time and arrived early Flight Attendants very friendly both ways Flew over the Alps which was nice but small amount of food served on the flights Overall did the job Looking forward to my next trip with Darwin in July

This is an excellent new airline everything was perfect from the checkin to boarding onboard experience meals video entertainment the flight and baggage retrieval All the staff were friendly and very helpful Will definitely choose this airline again At Chiang Mai the airline uses the Thai Airways lounge

As a frequent flyer on the Kuwait Airways I would recommend it on there large aircrafts such as Ber Aneo or A and specially on business class even though it is expensive but you will get a good quality service My rating would be on there business first and royal class And I have also uploaded a photo of Ber business seat

Albury is a pleasant airport The staff are kind and knowledgeable There are gates departure and arrival The lines are short but it is still good to get in early The seats in the boarding lounges are somewhat comfortable When it comes to security its okay The airlines that you need to go through security for are Qantas and Virgin Australia but not Regional Express The terminal is clean especially the toilets The caf is overpriced but the food is ok The only shopping in the terminal is the caf Unlike most airports it is almost impossible to get lost in ABX The only drawback is that to get to and from the terminal to or from the plane you have to walk across the tarmac Out of all the airports I have been to ABX has been the best

We had an enjoyable flight experience with AC Rouge The flight attendants on this crew worked very well together and demonstrated great cooperation and team work The crew was welcoming personable and professional In particular we enjoyed excellent service from Victoria and Heather

Toluca Airport located about minutes away from Mexico City is a nice alternative to Mexico City Airport It mainly has flights within Mexico and limited service to the USA Florida Las Vegas Houston The best thing about this airport are the short lines Check in and security took less than minutes Its small but has a new feeling to it and covers the most basic needs It has a few shops and a Food court consisting of Subway Dominos hamburger joint and smoothly All seems clean and tidy Boarding is done via Airplane stairs and several ground transport options exist to Toluca and Mexico city

A small airport divided into mini terminals domestic international arrival and international departure Border control was fast and efficient despite the large amount of passengers The terminals itself are clean and well maintained but rather s looking Access to the aircraft is by bus boarding only There are many taxis to the center but negotiate well A few busses are available too but look like from a museum

I have to say I was quite impressed with this place The two terminals are easy to navigate and there is plenty of space Plenty of retail if such is your thing an I enjoyed my Stella as I waited for my next leg One thing I really liked is the ability to get WhatsApp updates for your flight schedule checkin gate departure gate etc I hadnt seen this before Surprised that all the announcements are in English

We booked our return flight as a direct flight which was canceled and then simply staying in Paris We started more than hours later missed our connecting train were poorly provided with drinks unfortunately not a great experience Our direct flight to Colombo from Frankfurt was great very nice staff super on time

Flew Amsterdam Schiphol to Marseille via Strasbourg Hop has good service and comfort levels for a regional airliner Their inflight announcements in English need some work though On my flights I was on an Embrear which has an odd seating arrangement of The seats were comfortable and not cramped The flights were staffed by a single cabin manager but they handled the job of getting everyone onboard and serving a complementary drink with a snack on each leg well Their inflight announcements in English were completely incomprehensible however as were the recorded announcements in English as well Since I dont speak French I just hope they werent telling me anything important On one leg of my flight there was a brief delay but this was communicated in a timely manner

Easy access by bus or taxi Two terminals International on the right Domestic on the left as you face them but only metres apart Signs in English as well as Russian although all announcements are in Russian as you would expect How many of the staff speak English may be a good question one who does is the AviaNova manager Easy layout to navigate in domestic terminal although there is not much space for the checkin queues so they snake around the room However the staff for my flight anyway were very efficient and the queue moved quickly Security check was quick and easy Airside has an expensive cafe and coffee shop as well as a newsstand and gift shop Plenty of comfortable seating WiFi is available good signal but every site I tried came up with Security Certificate not issued by Trusted Source so theres possibly some bug in their software I didnt do any more than just log in Bussed to plane only complaint as with so many of these airports is that you go upstairs to a departure lounge and then have to walk back down for the bus

Flew Ryanair last week to Tenerife Baggage drop was a breeze as was boarding Well organised The flight itself was excellent operated by a fantastic crew especially the cabin manager who was friendly polite and professional Wouldnt hesitate to use again

I arrived at the airport from London Heathrow and travelled via Beijing On arrival at Terminal it was nearing pm and I had been travelling for over hours I wanted to get a taxi to the hotel and go to bed However none of the ATMs in the terminal accepted any of my debit cards I have had trouble in the past in rural areas but never at an international airport I was told to go to terminal one which had international arrivals and try there Fortunately the shuttle bus was free and I go to terminal Only one of the ATMs there which also happened to be the last one I tried accepted my card with one other machine down At other Chinese airports Beijing and XiAn Xingang they have always had ATMs from the big four banks Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Bank of China China Construction Bank Agricultural Bank of China I have never had a problem getting cash from these banks I would also note that the underground station just outside terminal one has multiple big four ATMs and is an excellent way to travel into the city I finally got to my hotel at midnight I wrote to the Airport while in China but never received a response

Its a small airport with the most basic of facilities but there were no delays in either direction I hope that means they have sorted out immigraton though it may be that my BA flight from London City arrived at a quiet time My only gripe is about one woman on security who was quite unfriendly when she told me I had to return to checkin because she didnt like the look of a vase I had in my carryon bag Otherwise the staff seemed quite friendly

I recently flew with China Southern Airlines from Gatwick Airport to Changchun Airport via Zhengzhou to visit my family in China As I bordered the Boeing I was greeted with kind flight attendants who directed me to my seat On my seat was a pillow a thin blanket and headphones for the inflight entertainment We departed on time around in the evening UK time There was meals served and many drinks services with a variety of drinks ranging from fruit juices alcohols beer fizzy drinks and waters The meals were served on trays made up of a warm main dish with a side dish such as vegies and a desert Overall the food was tasty and plentiful There was a wide variety of movies which included Chinese and Western movies in many languages there was also fun mini games and an inflight map showing the progress of our flight I would say my flight to Zhengzhou took around and a half hours The seats were reclinable and padded well In my opinion it was quite comfy and I fell asleep quickly after watching a movie The cushion was soft and surprisingly the blanket offered a good amount of warmth The bathrooms and seats were all cleaned and maintained well and overall the flight was relaxed and peaceful My only complaint is that the cabin was a bit warn out and old with some pieces of fabric missing from the front bit of my seat This did not serve as an issue to me it was only aesthetically unpleasing Another suggestion from me is to offer an amenity kit as the flight was long haul Overall I had an amazing experience with friendly staff delicious meals and extreme comfort and good entertainment that kept me busy

A fine small airport great personal service clean well decorated easy parking simple and efficient signage has a luxury feel befitting the Palm Beach Clientele Food selection adequate and reasonable Parking is a breeze Always many security personnel and queue times very short A pleasure to travel to or from

One of the smallest airports Ive ever encountered Due to required visas for Laos there was a bit of a hold up at immigration but staff were thorough Luggage made it off the aircraft in an efficient manner so waiting times were minimal The whole arrivals area was so compact you could see the baggage hall from immigration and visa versa Interesting as the chaotic arrivals hall had all doors continually open and once you left the baggage collection area you could easily go back Our arrival was an evening one so most retail outlets were closed and inconveniently also the money exchange Not a bad little airport but renovation and refurbishment needed

I wasnt very impressed by the staff The two woman on duty did not appear to be helping visitors much Several of us didnt know which queue to join to go through passport control When I finally got there it was like questions They made me feel like a criminal Is this your first time in Cyprus Do you have house here Where were you in As if anyone can remember that I assured them it was my first visit to the island After some discussion between two if them they eventually stamped my passport and one of them slammed it down onto the counter I know they have to do their job but it wasnt very welcoming and they didnt have to be so rude

We were delayed for nights due to bad weather on the th and th January The staff at Mytilene Airport in Lesbos were excellent they kept a smile during a very difficult time for them We were given a voucher for food and drinks each time our flight was cancelled times in all and they sent us to very good hotels both nights In addition when we asked if they could extend our journey for the days that we had lost they did with no problems

KIR is a very small airport In terms of shopping and gastronomy not much is to be expected It can be found easily if you are in the area There are enough parking spaces and they are close to the terminal Terminal cleanliness is substandard especially the restrooms Terminal seating is barely sufficient if only flight is departing Flights can not be handled there is not enough space in the departure area In this case security is overwhelmed The queues extend to the outside of the airport building Airport staff becomes very aggressive and confrontational Under normal circumstances the staff are grumpy at best When flying from Kerry to Dublin Take the train from Killarney instead All in all it does not take much more time and the experience is much more pleasant

We were totally amazed by their services since none of us have ever heard of this airline The trip was arranged by the travel agency who arranged our tour Even during a short trip they provided us gourmet sandwiches and a warm cookie while beverages was served twice which is far much better than what we experienced from those larger airlines How we wish they can cover more routes

Decent sized airport with friendly staff Arrivals area was pretty small but the airport itself was well connected to the city with the bus service running just a few steps outside the arrivals I travelled during the peak holiday season so was dreading departure from Glasgow but I was pleasantly surprised as the security was well managed and we went through smoothly The restaurants were bearing the brunt of the holiday season with not enough seating but it was still nice nonetheless

Linz is indeed a very small airport however it serves its purpose Facilities are limited and flying in at pm I found the few shops were almost all shut The hourly bus is excellent value for money at EUR compared to the I paid in London approx EUR and only takes minutes non stop to the city centre Beware there is only ONE medium sized duty free shop after passport control

Older Dash but comfortable and good leg room but very noisy Departed on time friendly sole flight attendant juice and water on offer and great views of the Atolls they were organised friendly and have pride in their brand and country cant ask for more than that A bit pricey but no competition I guess

ADDAMM via Sanaa Overnight in Sanaa where Yemenia provide hotel and breakfast Pleasant flight attendants and acceptable food A good flight and a lot cheaper than competitors I had to change this flight and put it forward by one week which was no problem and didnt cost anything to change

As the previous reviewer noted Eilat airport terminal is in the centre of the city and surrounded by hotels I didnt believe the taxi driver for a few seconds when he dropped us there Once inside we got a thorough grilling by security and our bags swabbed throughout for explosives I think we got extra attention as foreigners but the female security official was very friendly and jovial much nicer that the humourless officials who you normally meet Checkin and hand baggage checks were quick and easy as the only flight was our seater Arkia departure There is a shopcafe on both landside and airside parts but we didnt get a chance to try either Overall it does the job well just be prepared for the security

Very smooth and pleasant checkin The Dynasty Lounge at Narita is very large and comfortable but with a limited range of food and drink Onboard the service was excellent and my vegetarian meal was tasty The seat was an old style regional seat with limited recline and storage At Taipei the lounge was comfortable with a range of delicious snacks and meals We transferred to another regional A with more comfortable seats than the previous flight They converted into a rather lumpy angled bed This flight had been advertised as an A with modern lieflat business class seats a plane which was now under maintenance As compensation an upgrade voucher with months validity was provided but with our current travel plans it is difficult to see how we could use it On board service was excellent again and the vegetarian meals were copious and of good quality The flight arrived in good time but our baggage took a long time to arrive though business class luggage was delivered first Despite the aircraft downgrade I think that China Airlines is a good value way to fly between Australia and Japan

There is a reason why this airport is consistently named among the best small airports in the USA Thanks to COVID some shops and eateries have shuttered and not reopened to date Security was a breeze There was no line and I walked right up to the TSA counter and cleared security in less than minutes There is a spill over of passengers from the gate area to the concourse nonetheless there is enough space to navigate the concourses The Escape Lounge is a welcome addition to this airport

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

LimaCusco and three other internal flights within Peru All flights on time and quality of aircraft pilots as in landing and take offs was exceptional Aircraft were almost new As all were clean including the toilets which cannot always be taken for granted on an aircraft that is subjected to multiple take offs and landings during the day FAs very professional A very good experience

The security staff at Aberdeen airport are not up to standard Many of them are aggressive and argumentative and their main aim is not to be friendly or courteous I have been fortunate enough to travel to many countries and I say without hesitation that the security staff at Aberdeen airport are either the most poorly trained that I have encountered or that they are paying no attention to the training they receive The management team needs to review the training of the security staff at Aberdeen airport urgently
The cabin is clean Flight attendants are friendly and polite Seats are comfortable and can be reclined easily The food is delicious Flights departed on time

Checkin at Gatwick Airport was smooth and efficient The airline uses the No Lounge which is nothing special but with comfortable seating and is WiFi more than adequate Boarding was done quickly and the cabin crew was super diligent in helping each of the passengers find their seat and stow their baggage Although the business seats on this were not new they had ample storage space the flat bed was comfortable and everything worked The food was well presented but tasted a little bland and the cabin crew were extremely quick in removing trays when passengers had finished The WiFi on the aircraft was patchy at best and being Chinese quite a few sites seem to be blocked Running a VPN actually made it quicker with no blocked sites There were a few Western movies but the choice was limited Loos were spotless Overall I have no complaints and would happily fly with the airline again

Sawyer is a small airport in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan with flights to Detroit and Chicago provided by Delta and American respectively There is a small store selling Northern Michigan University paraphernalia some basic snacks and coffee The major car rental firms have desks in the terminal with the cars parked just outside The parking is excellent you walk out of the terminal into the parking lot Less than a minutes walk from the airport entrance to the security check area The terminal has excellent free wifi service courtesy Northern Michigan University Very friendly and efficient staff Taxi service is available to the city of Marquette about miles away

This airport is clearly not equipped to take the number of pax departing after the winter break Check in was too crowded so we had to wait on another floor Conveyer belt at check in blocked by heavy usage Boarding never indicated on screens but was only announced via PA system Shambles Shame as we had such a great time in Finland

This is definitely one of the underrated airlines Quality airport and inflight service for quite a reasonable price Check in and boarding were smooth The pilot has maintained adequate communication with us and the cabin crews were very attentive and helpful The food was not superb but beyond average The cabin crews kept checking us from time to time to see if we need anything else which I asked one of the cabin crews for a refill for my cup and she was gladly to do so Seats are average for its class Inflight entertainment was great A good selection of shows to choose from for less than a hour flight If you want to get the most bang for your buck I think you can put Hong Kong Airline into the list
One of the best domestic airports in the country Wellsituated Come prepared for delay gate changes and high prices Be careful with illegal taxis

This is an extremely clean and well maintained airport They do updates regularly as needed Its very easy to get to and from Parking is pretty cheap compared to a bunch of other airports Ive been to but not super cheap Theyre already planning out the new rail connection to downtown that will be running by Currently there is a bus service as well as Uber and taxis if you dont have someone picking you up Lyft on its way to the city Its very easy to get around and if you come in from an international destination the customs is very quick What I do find bothersome is the lack of airport lounge in the US departures area The only lounges in the airport are Air Canada and Porter both on the domesticinternational departures area The food selection in the airport is pretty slim but you wont go hungry its just really limited in the US departures to one soso restaurant and a tim hortons Shopping is even more slim in all departures areas But does anyone really go shopping in an airport This airport is miles or kilometers ahead of those in a lot of US airports Ive been to despite all the drawbacks

The crew were extremely nice the flight was about hours and hours for the flight back to Hong Kong The flight was really smooth Props to the pilots The food was light and average The drinks were cool the in flight entertainment was out of service but pretty sure the airline is on a budget Warning that the ticket only includes kg of luggage to take on the plane and have to pay individually for luggage in cargo hold kg round trip more than HKD Seat was alright had decent recline trying to avoid flying with Hong Kong Airlines until maybe a few years later when they earn some money back Overall above average flight

ChisinauBudapest roundtrip Both departures on time Served breakfast on the way out and lunch inbound Luggage transfer handled efficiently despite relatively short connection time in Budapest SAAB plane offers plenty of legroom and is not so noisy compared to other prop planes Friendly FAs and my favourite option for flights from Moldova to Europe

I must say that in my experience the staff at the security check are doing a great job I was flying back to Moscow from Yerevan on Tuesday th October The staff were very welcoming polite and helpful Moreover while passing the security check I realized that I lost my cross the thread on which it hung was torn and after passing the security check I informed the security staff about it They were very helpful and helped me find my lost cross

From the moment I boarded the crew exuded warmth and professionalism Junu and Reeza provided assistance wherever needed The inflight service was impeccable Bhoomi and Nisha managed the meal service efficiently The crew went above and beyond to ensure passenger comfort Whether it was providing extra blankets assisting with luggage or attending to special requests they were attentive and proactive Their kindness and willingness to help truly stood out Looking forward to flying with Akasa Air again

I had pretty low expectations for this airline but fortunately things turned out well and PIA delivered for me The flight was on time and bags arrived in a timely manner While the meal served was not exactly delicious it was nice to know they at least served some food on this hour flight The seats were standard and flight attendants polite and respectful Would consider using again

I flew into Kasane International Airport onboard Mack Air a Botswanan bush airline that principally services safari lodges in the Okavango Delta area Kasane boasts a nice new and pleasant airport in spite of it seeing much more than people arriving to go to or from various safari lodges Passangers walk from the airplane into the baggage claim area which though not large is efficient and is air conditioned As we did not require an immigration or customs inspection passengers moved directly from the baggage claim area into the main terminal hall This too is very nice air conditioned clean and pleasant and transportation services are available Airport staff are friendly and there is a small shop where one can buy snacks and drinks Though small and not very busy Kasanes airport is a pleasant surprise and is from all I can tell efficient clean and staffed with pleasant and helpful folk

Odessa to Kiev return Plane a rather old Boeing but for such short trips under hour is not a problem I was surprised to see that they offered sandwiches on both flights together with tea coffee and juices

I recently flew out of Manchester Terminal A great experience from leaving the car at the pre booked car park No queues at bag drop off or security even though I had bought a fast track pass The terminal is clean bright and well appointed Within minutes of arrival I was eating breakfast in San Carlo My return trip was as efficient within one hour of landing I had collected my car and was at home Terminal is a revelation after the dire experiences of Terminal Well done from me

As I was travelling in Emirates Business class from Tehran I was able to use the VIP terminal just around the corner of the main terminal It was very clean stylish and modern for Iranian standards Emirates passengers got to use the whole second floor which provided a good buffet nice leather seats clean prayer room and very clean toilets The customer service and security checks were also quite decent despite being busy during the day

Aalborg Lufthavn AAL is a smallish airport near the city of Aalborg There is not usually a lot of people leaving or arriving at any one time so there is hardly ever any time wasted standing in line for checkin or security checks brilliant A very friendly and inviting atmosphere overall

Frankfurt to Berlin our first flight was cancelled but they arranged me other flight Next day I use Air Berlin also this time their service was on time and good service and cabin crew they are very friendly and helpful I was very happy their service
We flew from Toronto to Paris Flight attendants were very helpful and welcoming We especially appreciated Emersons help He was great Ground crew were great too

The airport is small and modern It has both local and international flights Air France Arrivals are no problem and there is not far to walk from the aircraft to the airport exit There did not seem to be to many people bothering passengers Departures is also straight forward with modern checkin desks There are not many shops in the departure area and only one basic cafe There is adequate seating and the airconditioning works well Overall a very good experience compared with other African airports

I absolutely love the WilkesBarreScranton International Airport Small enough to accommodate us easily friendly staff and yet large enough for us to easily reach any destination We especially love the fact that they now have Breeze Airlines which will allow us to increase our travel from this airport Great move on both parts

Nice modern airport Efficiently run Arrived here on an international flight from ICN and was bussed to terminal despite most finger docks being empty Immigration was a breeze and luggate was efficiently delivered On outgoing domestic flight to SZX our flight Shandong airlines didnt appear at all on the departure screens but was correctly displayed at the gate Flight delayed and no announcements made Good selection of outlets Pleasant environment waiting for the plane big bright airy About minutes drive out of Qingdao

I flew into Douala on Swiss and departed on Virgin Nigeria Both experiences were quite pleasant I had only hand luggage and was in and out of the airport quite quickly When departing we waited at the gate which was quite calm and cool Yes its a bit manic as you walk out of the airport with people and noise everywhere but lots of places are like that If you know where you are going or have someone to meet you its fine

Good airport with facilities to cater for the number of flights Slight delays on arrival due to fruit and vegetable quarantine but no problem read the notices and listen to the announcements makes it easy It does the job

Worst Airport in the world arrived to check in then security on baggage Then Passport machine thought great all good Walked through Duty Free then a mile long queue to get through to B gate BA is B gate Poor shops nobody could shop or eat unless you had got their hours early This queue apparently is normal and is called the new fast track what a joke One person in a box checking passports again Run to B hundreds of people standing there no way could you board in Groups just a free for all Again with one woman at the gate before you got on the coach to the plane still coaching you out to the plane She was checking everyones passport again Why havent they upgraded this system by now and built satellite gates off the main airport Not going back there

Hong Kong to Hanoi Regional flight Hong Kong toHanoi January on an A aircraft Ticket included free services and luggage Hot meal given was OK Flight full on time Nice clean aircraft Seats were good but space to front seat was horrible and extremely tiny small de facto painful to knees CheckIn in Hong Kong was quick and easy though my handluggage was double the limit Checked in luggage arrived smoothly checked by customs in Hong Kong who had left a note inside the bag Airbridge provided at both ends

I flew from Karachi to Toronto on PIA LR The seats very comfortable and the leg room was amazing Cabin crew was very friendly and kept on serving refreshments The food is delicious The best part is that it is the only non stop flight from Pakistan to Canada which is very convenient and saves a lot of time The only drawbacks are that the IFE doesnt work except for the flight map and there are no charging ports
UIA is always a great experience in businessclass Great service onboard Very lovely crew The lounges in KBP and MUC are also very relaxing Looking forward to flying UIA again

Aircraft clean with immaculately presented and polite cabin attendants Seat comfortable with great leg room Flights on time Inflight entertainment consisted of North Korean military type music Food was a cold burger with a choice of water coffee tea or soft drink
Flew on th April on day visit to Amsterdam on business Lovely small airport staff friendly good bacon rolls in the cafe A very pleasant relaxing experience

I have so far fly times with Moldavian Airlines in Saab airplanes I have always bought tickets through Malev Hungarian airlines and fly fro CopenhagenChisinau Moldova through Budapest Airplanes are OK seats good and space similar to what I am used to with other airlines Service was excellent and staff on board very nice and take good care of everyone on board even take there time to make you feel good Both times I fly from Moldova was early in morning and then I got bread with ham cheese and paprika red pepper yogurt and chocolate biscuit but when I fly to Moldova in evening fly I got very good chicken meal and I could have many different drinks for free I took good Moldavian red wine

Flew nd January to Innsbruck meant to be There was snow at Innsbruck we had abortive landings and landings at Munich to refuel and to be finally diverted there This was meant to be a hour flight We were in the air for about hours I am a terrible passenger and did not enjoy the flight one bit However the captain looked after our safety kept us informed and although I was in a state they were terrific The stewardesses were all super friendly and very nice to me when I said how anxious I was The seats were more spacious than other European flights Despite the long flight which was nobodys fault Titan struck me as being a professional airline with well trained staff

You might use Moscow Vnukovo when flying to cities within the CIS on regional airlines or catching a charter flight to Turkey Egypt etc The airport is located southwest of the city it takes about minutes and Roubles tofrom Yugo Zapadnaya metro station by minibus in normal traffic taxi drivers ask the usual extortionate rates as in Sheremetyevo The building is very small and displays a bizarre mixture of typical drab Soviet facilities and shiny renovated areas that you could almost call Scandinavian Arriving at about am on a redeye flight I was greeted by a pack of stray dogs roaming the street outside the terminal but then I was able to wait for the first bus into town while having an excellent cappuccino in the new cafe inside the arrival area with plenty of seats and cheerful service from the very friendly staff Immigration is the same as everywhere else in Russia even though this was the only place where I was asked to produce a copy of my invitation and health insurance On an afternoon visit the departure sector which is located on the same level as the arrivals was almost deserted Services on offer are scarce one exchange office with ridiculously short opening times one Atm one cafe a couple of windows selling airline tickets and providing general information in Russian exclusively Everywhere around the airport there are obvious signs of big renovation works going on Im really curious to see what comes out of it in the future All in all one of the most relaxed ways tofrom Moscow and Russia

Just flew on a oneway flight from Zurich to Sarajevo and was extremely pleased The flight was carried out by their ATR aircraft which looked pretty new and was clean too We both departed and arrived early which I found great however What Id noticed is that the only type of entertainment they offered on board were the magazines in the seat pockets which were rather boring but this was after all a small aircraft so I wouldnt have expected anything else The plane was surprisingly full there were only about three unoccupied seats on board The inflight meal consisted of a very tasty sandwich and a wide selection of drinks Very kind cabin crew and they spoke really good English which was great I definitely recommend flying BH Airlines

I had a great experience flying with Cyprus Airways The flight was smooth and comfortable making the journey enjoyable I was impressed with the ground checkin team who were kind and supportive Thank you for the excellent service

Fantastic service from bag drop to landing and getting my baggage on the other end All staff played their role in providing the excellent customer service It was an early morning flight and it was really nice to start the day on the right track

Very early flight out of HK bussed from the terminal near gate downstairs so easy A bit of messing around at check in echeck in you need to show visas etc Plane spotless and staff attentive Bathrooms clean Return we prebooked one bag between us for the hold which we would recommend its about USD to do so whereas on the spot its more like US plane is immaculate and the staff responsive and quick Prebooked meals are served quickly and hot and cold drinks available Walked off to a far gate but train takes you to immigration Great for short flights and I feel they are better earlier in the day as more likely to be on time Seat is fine for a hour flight I would say Drinks arent extortionate nice cold prosecco for HK the app website is a bit tricky I joined it but had to do it all on the laptop first then open the app and register Sort of CX connected but not really Its a bit counterintuitive

The whole experience was very professional Flight was completely comfortable clean and the air crew were friendly and helpful The flight was on time and the in flight service was just excellent for such a short flight

We decided to fly from Santorini to Heraklion rather than take the fast ferry as there wasnt much difference in price and it was more convenient to arrive at Heraklion airport We hadnt heard of Ellinair and there werent many reviews We were a little apprehensive but we were pleasantly surprised The flight was ontime the aircraft clean and comfortable and the crew were friendly and professional

I dont know what all the fuss was about Bad reviews about security dirty airport unfriendly staff no seating I experienced none of that In view of the negative reviews we arrived hours before take off and were through security in five minutes Very cheerful efficient and friendly staff Bought some items at duty free and the lady there was extremely pleasant and helpful Plenty of seating Good food and drink offers and both the airport and toilets were very clean Boarding process straightforward and stressless On return our plane landed about minutes behind schedule This unfortunately coincided with other flights landing at the same time so passport control was very busy but it only took about minutes to get through The staff there were smiling at I understand why passengers complain but its also useful to get positive reviews sometimes I hope my next experience of Leeds Bradford will be as good as this one

Ive traveled through this airport quite a few times due to its location bw Boston and New York Overall its a quiet airport that never seems to be too busy Theres a reasonable share of shops but none too interesting Flights are generally on time in my experiences and airport staff are helpful although you most likely may never need to utilize their assistance The signage is perfectly laid out and food cafes are sprinkled all over The new terminal and parking garage are super convenient
Brilliant Airport new clean clear spacious Shame so few airlines do fly into MVD

Nice terminal though no seating space at the checkin area seems to be very congested After security check the seating area is much better though limited options of food and shopping The terminal itself is new and well maintained not much walk times The view of the runway from the terminal is good so you can pass your time quite well Free wifi with reasonably good connectivity available Announcements are adequate Overall quite good

We adults kids came here about a year ago YOWPUJ nothing bad but nothing good Very clean and a lot of Sunwing Workers are nice and there is a great viewing area for kids But the downside is long waiting times for everything Otherwise it was pretty good and we will be using it again on Mar for a flight to London UK then Warsaw Poland and back Will review it again then

Much better than it used to be they seem to have clamped down on the baggage handlers and general hangers on trying to extract dollars from you on the way in On the way out no real problems aside from a few panhandllers trying to take a last opportunity to rip you off Dont miss the duty free shop it looks awful from the outside but is really well stocked and cheap

Security was super helpful As we were passing through security someone stole my wifes Apple Watch from the box after we went through the Xray We immediately notice it was missing and reported it Security checked the cameras and found the thief Using the image from the cameras they tracked down the passenger and recuperated our watch All this within minutes Amazing

Horizon Air from Seattle to Eugene roundtrip No complaints the crews were great planes clean and on time in both directions As with all of Horizon Air flights free beverages including wine and beer are provided The aircraft was perfect for the less than one hour flight to SeaTac quite fast actually The skies were clear and the view was perfect Nice job all the way around

Excellent airline Flights outbound and return were on time if not early Service and staff were helpful and friendly and the plane was very comfortable Definitely recommend them The only negatives the film choice was not great for an English speaker and there was if anything too much food served

Excellent new terminal spacious and with lots of checkin counters Flew China Southern to Nanjing and the checkin was swift as was security All passengers get patted down regardless of whether you beep or not which was a bit of a nuisance Beyond security good amenities and restaurants We had an early morning departure and the terminal was very busy but it is definitely large enough to handle the number of people One downside is we got a bus to the plane which took minutes

Johannesburg to Lilongwe via Blantyre Very impressed with Malawian Airlines On time departures and arrivals excellent food served both outbound lunch chicken and return breakfast fried eggs lovely coffee and generous baggage allowance Crucially Ethiopan Airlines the part owner has timed the flight with an early morning departure from Malawi such that a large majority of passengers were connecting on our flight in Johannesburg onto regional Southern Africa routes and donestically within SA whereas SAA schedule from Lilongwe would require an overnight stay in Johannesburg clever scheduling Both flights nearly full No entertainment or music onboard

Cusco to Uyuni via La Paz My experience with Amaszonas was good actually Luckily the weather was in my favor too Initially I was a little skeptical after reading reviews but the trip was pretty smooth Flight was on the smaller side although not as small as people had initially mentioned Theres about to rows of seats and I was comfortable THe only thing is they board like minutes prior to departure which makes you a little nervous but the trip as such was okay

Seoul Incheon to Tokyo Narita with Easter Jet This was a low cost airline but everything was fine Check in took five minutes I paid extra for a bulkhead seat and it was worth it The seats were quite narrow but bearable for a two hour flight There was just a small drinks run and no food available but as it was only a two hour flight it was acceptable

Victoria Falls boasts a nice new terminal building that is uncluttered and pleasant I arrived for a flight to Addis Ababa and was immediately impressed with the pleasant surroundings of the terminal and its air conditioned comfort Check in procedures were swiftly handled and passengers then move on to clear security and immigration which are straight forward save for the fact that one has to deal with the nuisance of removing his shoes at security Following security one takes an elevator up to the departure level where there a number of shops very expensive shops and food outlets All of these were clean and presentable Restroom facilities were wellmaintained and clean Boarding was accomplished via an air bridge directly into the plane Surprisingly Victoria Falls International Airport is very straight forward and easy to negotiate Staff are friendly and helpful I feel that anyone traveling through Victoria Falls airport will have no difficulties or issues

A fairly small airport by Chinese standards but then again so is Guilin At checkin they waved me over to check in at the VIP line even though I was flying economy nice of them Despite being small this airport has a nice decor is clean Going through security quite smooth efficient My main complaint is at departures gates many people smoking not much in the way of snacks unless you like strange looking Chinese treats that have no English

Arrival was easy and bags arrived quickly waived through health control and landside within minutes departing again no issues although the airport was busy with the evening departures there was plenty of security checkpoints open and plenty of staff each employee at the airport I encountered was helpful and friendly once through security there is a excellent Duty Free and several restaurantsbars along with a small selection of shops

Amazing team at Hubli airport We had to change the plane in Bangalore to get to Kochi and we might be late however the team assured us that our baggage will go first from plane when we have landed Us and few other people in similar situation were brought by small bus faster than other customer to the airport and one guy from airport in Bangalore from Air Pegasus made sure and check our flights details that we will be on time Thank you one more time especially for team in Hubli Amazing customer service

The airport has a capacity of million passengers a year It has two terminals passenger terminal and cargo It is a nice small airport There is a bar in the waiting lounge and also a restaurant a place where you can buy newspapers At the terminal it also a new Restaourant lot of airline companies has their offices in the airport building including British Airways Adria Austrian Airlines etc You can not sleep in the airport is closed after the last scheduled flight at pm Pristina center is very close as there is a Motel Aviano located km from the airport There is no buss service from airport to the city but the majority of travellers use taxi to get to the town The price is usually euro

Me and a few friends flew to the Dominican Republic in August and the experience upon arrival was outstanding The immigration service was fast and most shops where open The staff help us with our bags and had us out in no time On our way back it was the same very friendly staff no delays food was great on the terminal shops

It was my first time at this small and beautiful airport Very wellmaintained and nicely decorated airport The downtown and hotel areas are not too far Staffs were friendly Outside of the airport is also environment friendly and green

Winnipeg to Abbotsford I flew with Swoop for the first time and I absolutely loved it There were no delays and Winnipeg airport was not busy The signs were easy to follow Airport crew were very friendly
I think it is a great airport compared to most Chinese airports Today Hangzhou Airport is quite different from what it used to be Its very large and modern and has good service

Small airport that you would not want to spend too much time in but that manages to get you on your way reasonably quickly Inbound immigration and visa on arrival facilities are slightly chaotic though not too bad Outbound once you clear passport control facilities are limited to notsoclean toilets a sad looking duty free shop a bar that did not have any change when we visited and a seating area that seemed to be full of mosquitos If youve stayed in the Kempinski you can use their lounge which is probably the best part of this airport

Pros The flight attendants were kind and helped us with the wifi for minutes Very helpful mindful and demure The food was great I was not expecting that Legroom was wonderful Me being m there was easily lots of legroom Theseat was hard IFE sucked and dirty floors

I want to commend staff at Alicante airport on what was my first airport visit post covid Arriving and departing was prompt and hassle free When I accidentally broke a mug at the Starbucks counter the staff were just concerned about how I was feeling Also the girl at the EasyJet gate took my postcards which I had forgotten to post and promised to post them for me They all arrived eventually so thank you

I flew out of Athens on July th with American Airlines and I had requested wheelchair assistance The gentleman who assisted me at the airport Aggelos was absolutely amazing He took great care of me and was extremely respectful and helpful in anyway possible He actual went out of his way and even performed beyond his job responsibilities and provided excellent customer service In my years of travelling I have never experienced such superb customer service He is a very valuable employee who needs to be recognized for his outstanding customer service skills He went above and beyond for a customer I will never forget my positive experience with this Greek fellow

Two years on from my last report and improvements continue to happen The check in area has been updated making for a comfortable experience and the new TSA security area is large and works efficiently A new hotel is now connected directly to the terminal Staff as usual friendly and helpful Forced to deduct one point for the lack of baggage carts If they are there they are well hidden

This airport is so backward its unreal Today you get charged nearly three euros to get hot water for your own teabag You get charged ten euros development fee as you leave Same as Galway airport ten years ago six euros to get out again development fee now its shut Last time I flew from Knock the fee was the same Never went back because of the fee Now the place has hardly changed where did that money go Great idea to put an airport on top of a hill dont have to come down so far but hardly a great advert for Irish aviation or Mayo

Good experience flying Finnair Tallinn to London via Helsinki No need for security as transfer flight helpful staff everywhere and for big airport very spacious Loved MOOMIN COFFEE and no queue or questions at border control after I was interrogated at Riga Airport due to long stays on my British Passport Loved Finnair too would fly again from Helsinki with this airline

Flew SkyWork Airlines from Berlin to Bern You can eckeck in hrs before flight Both flights were on time Cabin was clean and legroom standard Service was friendly and they offer coffee and pie for lunch Airport was small but there was a bustrain connection to the town I would recommend them

I had two flights with Atlantic Airways Flight Bergen Faroe Islands and Faroe Islands to Copenhagen one week later Both flights on time Comfortable seats clean aircraft good food friendly service I will flight with Atlantic Airways again with pleasure

I would not call Terminal of Sofia Airport a terminal for international flights This T is more like an intercity bus station unclean with insufficient seating with only three kiosks called I dont know why Duty free provided that the prices in them are equal and in some cases even higher than those in stores in Bulgaria Boarding organization is bordering on ZERO The socalled gates are indicated by some signs but in no way are they separated into separate areas Duty free

I have travelled through Derry airport numerous times in the last two years with a young child and usually on my own I cannot express enough how helpful staff have been on every single occasion They always offer to help me with bags usually fast track me through security scan my boarding card and passport so that I dont have to stand in long queues especially if my child is sleeping and have even bumped me up to priority boarding again ensuring I am not standing in queues struggling with bags or a toddler Their customer service is second to none and they always make the journey pleasurable

Very nice cabin comfortable seats and good entertainment systems The food tasted very good and there was enough food for the flight length The flight attendants were all very friendly except steward Plane TVJA Date July

Airport Facility Check in staff service Staff was not really friendly Lounge the airport Lounge not airBaltic In this Lounge you can find some light snacks and beverages but the price of entry is not worth it Seat comfort Seats were good for Economy on domestic European flights Seat pitch A bit more than enough Legroom A bit more than on the vast majority of European flights Cabin safety videoinfo they have video displayed on screens above passengers seats Comfort items almost do not exist Cleanliness Its usually clean on airBaltic flights Lavatory cleanliness it was clean Selection of meals preorder the passenger has a lot of options Selection of drinks onboard a wide selection several seasonal drinks are available Selection of snacks onboard different snacks are available and light meals are available Good quality Food a bit overpriced Only one magazine but it is mostly advertisement WiFi was not available on that flight This airline is good for flights up to hours Ticket prices are not high so if person needs to get from point A to point B airBaltic would be a good option

Bangkok to Yangon retjurn in midMay This is my first experience with this airline and it did not disappoint The checkin at the airport for both flights were uneventful efficiently handled and most notably having little or no queues which is always a welcomed sight when there are snaking queues at neighbouring counters for other airlines The boarding for the outgoing flight started a little after the scheduled time The planes do not have any seatback entertainment units but for the outgoing flight there was onboard wifi which allow you free access to a selection of movies and TV shows on the MAI app which can be preloaded onto phones Ipads etc The selection was limited For a min flight it is impressive that the cabin crew is able to come round with wet tissues followed by a meal and drinks service The cabin crew were polite and cheerful The captain made announcements regularly which were spoken in clear English

Arlanda to Marsa Alam return All things considered it was better than the Tui equivalent where our and year olds were only offered coffee or tea no water as a beverage for paid meals Staff were friendly food looked great we packed our own and no price gouging on the drinks service

I arrived from Phnom Penh and then departed to Bangkok On arrival at the domestic airport there was no air bridge and it was a very short walk to the main building It took a while for the luggage to come out but luckily the arrival area was not crowded Departed from the international terminal to Bangkok The terminal was new and clean and check in staff very friendly and helpful There was only one security line open but the queue wasnt too long After security there were few shops and a great Plaza Premium Lounge if you fly Bangkok Airways they also offer their own lounge The Plaza Premium lounge was quiet well design and spacious Overall a great and smooth departure experience

We used Luxor airport both for internal flight to Cairo and international flight to UK On both occasions it was clean and airy with plenty of space to sit We were allowed to take our water with us so no problem in buying drinks Yes there was someone selling us toilet paper despite the notices saying this was not allowed but by then we knew their standard of living and if you cant spare the odd pound when we have spent so much on a holiday what does that say about us We were protected from harassment by helpers by our rep Altogether I thought using Luxor airport a pleasant experience

YYZAMSYYZ Legroom was okay got the exit row on the way back Food decent for a charter Seat width normal unlike Air Transat they dont squeeze an extra row of seats in I didnt feel the need to upgrade to Economy plus The personal entertainment device portable hard drive with monitor was great Worth the euro on the day flight back
The area looks is not designed for such a huge passenger number some of the staffs are rude and unfriendly The terminal has a nice overview of the taxiways and runways

Its a small airport with the most basic of facilities but there were no delays in either direction I hope that means they have sorted out immigraton though it may be that my BA flight from London City arrived at a quiet time My only gripe is about one woman on security who was quite unfriendly when she told me I had to return to checkin because she didnt like the look of a vase I had in my carryon bag Otherwise the staff seemed quite friendly
An old Fokker departure and arrival on time very smooth landing proficient bilingual staff and excellent food omelette with herbs coleslaw and chicken

Airport is clean has good shops great seating area and has clear signs However the thing that annoyed me the most was the fact that in the entire terminal you could literally i counted just find a total of five power outlets that should really be something to be improved so watch out for that

Overall a great airport with great facilities and ample outlets to eatdrinkshop The only issue about this airport is the queues at immigration and security which is serious For instance immigration at arrival took minutes although there were only people in front of me and this was because only windows were open for processing

We flew from Sydney to Zhengzhou and vice versa on Tianjin Airlines recently overall it was a great trip ground staff were very friendly they even reserved a couple extra seats for us so that my two young kids could have a decent sleep on the way home cabin staff were also very friendly they were very helpful throughout the flight Legs rooms great food service was decent as well The only minor issue is their entertainment system was very old there were just a handful movies to select from also their D map system was not functioning for both sectors which meant you couldnt tell where you were currently other than that it was really a great flying experience

I was recently on a short hop from Sevastopol to Kiev Airport checkin was fast and polite Plane was pretty old Embraer with tight legroom Catering consisted of tea coffee water all looked and smelled uninspiring The crew was young and nice Ticket price was a good deal Flight was on time Ok for min flight

Really quick migrations Security checkpoint was full but the line moved really fast People were nice and smiling Is one of the cleanest airports I have been at it really surprised me A lot of duty free stores and different things to buy only thing a bit outdated is that I saw signs saying they are planning to remodel Amazingly fast wifi One bad thing though Lack of plugs to charge phones And if they have they dont have like a universal plug only an Argentinian one

Really lovely small but clean airport Passport Control was really smiley and friendly and our bags were ready on the cute luggage belt by the time we were through which was quick albeit from a small BA Embraer jet Toilets were absolutely spotless

Arrived into Grand Cayman from Miami on Saturday night Immigration took minutes and bags were already off the belt when we came into baggage hall Only recommendation is a larger canopy by car pick up point as needed during heavy downpour we got very wet On departure took minutes from arrival to check in and clear customs check Limited seats at gates but more seats to right hand side as you enter departure lounge A bit warm but not too bad More space needed by desks at each gate as gets crowded Food and shopping limited but sufficient Few restaurants and duty free but food items very expensive Boarding is via walk to plane which is great if weather is good Passengers were crowding the gate before Boarding Zones were called All in all a good airport experience at a small airport

Wonderful experience they saved me from missing my flight I was traveling with my family in China and this airport was my second transit trough this country My first encounter was with Chongqing airport which was significantly worse because my flight was unexpectedly cancelled and they just barely managed to book another one I still had a little time but I was worried if I could make it in time With just minutes left I rushed to find my check in and when this amazing staff found out how little time I had they literally enscorted me and my family to my gate They were communicating with walkie talkies so we were being preferred throughout the way to catch our flight The most pleasant staff ever I will be forever thankful
Flight attendants hospitality service careful consideration I hope the WiFi on airplanes will be better in the future Cabin clean and tidy It was an unforgettable journey

Flew last week from Munich to Tyunmen TJM Siberia B with Europeanstyle business cabin middle seat free Smooth checkin my coat was taken by a smiling attendant but no help to put my kg luggage in the locker No entertainment during the hours journey redeye but more than decent meal with appetisers and good Chilean wine I hope that my return flight in two days will be at least as peaceful although the linguistic capacities of the crew should be improved
Flew on th April on day visit to Amsterdam on business Lovely small airport staff friendly good bacon rolls in the cafe A very pleasant relaxing experience

Very comfortable flight This was my first time to fly with FA Fuji Dream Airlines and I was impressed Checkin was efficient departure was punctual and the cabin was very comfortable and stylish Best of all customer service was so friendly both the checkin staff at Matsumoto Airport and the cabin crew It was a short flight of only one hour but very pleasant

VnukovoIrkutsk An eventful and enjoyable flight Everything went smoothly Vnukovo is the closest airport to the city centre and it has also a convenient train connection the train departs from the Kievsky train station This helps to avoid the usual heavy traffic of Moscow UTair uses a new terminal A which is quite handy It is likely that UTair is the only airline which uses a widebody B on this route and the plane seems to be a relatively new and wellmaintained one Friendly flight attendants the flight was ontime onboard catering is not superb but it was OK Would fly them again

Moscow to Bangkok Rossiya fly some of Aeroflots long haul flights with exEtihad Boeing s Their concept is strange They still have an old personal entertainment system but it only gives you a route map Really Instead they have an inflight wifisystem but to be able to use it you need to download Rossiya app before the flight wifi is only for the system its not connected to the WWW They do not have power sockets is economy class and remember your own headphones as well Our flight was on time No complains Food was ok nothing fancy They serve you two free meals with basic drinks no alcohol This will keep your belly full all flight Ive used many airlines and I have no complaints about Rossiya Ticket was cheap plane was comfy and clean flight was on time service was ok basic Russian style and they didnt lose our bags Good value Just remember what i told you about the entertainment system

I am delighted to share my exceptional experience with Officer Lucas at San Francisco International Airport His assistance in locating my lost phone and guiding me to the correct boarding gate was invaluable Not only did he ensure I found my belongings but he also took the time to ensure my wellbeing before departing I am sincerely grateful for his kindness and assistance

Used this airline for an internal flight in China last October from Kunming to Lijiang and just had to take some photos etc but not a joke crisp new airline with latest Boeings smart logos etc Short flight but adequate English used and friendly crew

I traveled with people from NYC We entered the airport and had no problems coming in Pretty fast service with immigration and getting our bags Outside was rather chaotic Too many men standing around to carry bags They should control them better maybe like cabs take turns as requested On the way out we found the airport entrance very clear Our bus pulled up and emptied better than it could in JFK It was comforting to see the UN security team right outside The building was well air conditioned which was great The ticketing area was easily accessible We found that there was a ton of security checks not sure why as it seemed to be for baggage mostly We had our IDs checked times and our bags screened twice We were told at the ticket area that once inside there were no rest rooms That was not completely true There is a rest room area inside TSA but before the final jetBlue secure gate area baggage screening Also the signs for the duty free shop inside could have been betterhigher to see Overall it was not horrible but just a little cramped in feeling and the double check of the bags while offering a feeling of security sent red flags up as to why they were doing that It seemed like a jetBlue thing as Spirit did not do that Also the place was clean

Very comfortable business class Aneo and surprisingly spacious Food includes special ingredients creates premium touch Staff are professional smiles attitudes word choices Free wifi coupon easily redeemed day before flight Not many movie choices especially for children but good noise cancelling headphones

Moscow to Thessaloniki I usually use this company in my trips to Moscow Even if i was wondering about this new company that they use leasing airplanes i tried it and i want to say just one thing these are our lovely Greeks Every trip is small party specially when the destination is a Greek airport People are drinking free alcohol Greek wine they are eating and are enjoying their trip Staff is very goodThey use more than languages

We flew Jeju AIr which is South Korean Low cost airline again This time from Bangkok to Incheonseoul back and forth The checkin from Bangkok was smooth and the ground staff was very nice and kind enough to arrange wheelchair for my wife who has probem with the legs and difficulty in walking the staff also arrange the front section seat for us which we were very appriciated The plane was OK and the seat was quite comfortable compared to other Low coat Airline The cabin crew were nice and friendly although they did not serve us water as before The plane was delayed due to the late arrival of plane from Seoul Overall the flighy was smooth On the flight back to Bangkok we experienced a very kind and helpful youmg female ground staff who arrange wheelchair for my wife and change the seat to the front section the flight itself was OK The cabin crew were very nice and kind although threre was no water serving The flight was a little delayed due to traffic congestion Overall Jeju Air is quite good Low Cost Airline although there was no food and beverage serving you can purchase noodles snacks coffee and drinks on flight and no entertainment but the best thing the Jeju Air should be pround of was their nice friendly and helpful crew both ground and cabin crew

One of my favorite airports to make a connection through Ive flown through MKE maybe times or so and never have had to wait in a line to go through security There is also a very nice bookstore decent food options nice play areas for kids and an aviation museum The airport is also fairly stress free for making connections

The airport is very very small when arriving However it is clean and staff are kind When leaving the check out is done outside and some companies are not as efficient as others but the airport is at no fault When leaving there are two relatively small waiting room with limited selection of snacks and duty free Based to buy souvenirs and keepsakes before the airport The people are what make this airport pleasant they are friendly and work very hard

Overall very pleasant experience Landed in Terminal Kuwait Airways Holding on to a Singapore passport and it took me just mins to have my evisa stamp Very efficient Custom clearance done under mins and luggage out right on time I was out of the airport in mins Departure from Terminal Qatar Airways fuss free Few DFS stores and cafes Not much options but all good
Chiang Mai to Yangon return and pleasantly surprised by the standard fairly new aircraft and meal service for minute flight Flight attendants were somewhat offhand Reasonable leg room in economy
It is easily accessible from the city center by metro within minutes It is clean and modern Employees are friendly and helpful Signposts are clear Goods are bountiful

Great medium sized airport Travel fairly frequent from Hannover mainly from Terminal B to the UK The three terminals are very similar Good city centre connection with SBahn Fast checkin to gate usually same for arrival to out of door

Whats not to like about TF Green Airport It was recently ranked the d best airport by Travel Leisure readers Its newly remodeled bathrooms are like those of a star hotel Going through TSAPre was a breeze Cleared security in less than minutes Distances from security area to either end of the terminal are manageable WiFi is fast and worked flawlessly This used to be my home airport before I relocated to the Dallas area and it remains one of my favorite airports to fly through

It was five and half hours flight They served only one breakfast After that they didnt offer anything unless we asked for a snack or drinks They should have offered another light meal two hours after breakfast Otherwise everything is perfect

Boarding an A was a unique experience and you will enjoy a pleasant flight thanks to the spaciousness and comfort The cabin crew were admirable and friendly the food was good and delicious Highly recommended

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

Its development in the last years is rather impressive More than one million passengers now use this airport each year for a regional airport this is rather much I think I like she short distances the easy and quick checkin services the nice environment and the very close parking facilities I you arrive at this airport you have to wait never longer than min for the luggage delivery
