situation was provided and as we couldnt check our bags all the way through me and other passengers on this itinerary were stuck at the airport all day lugging our suitcases around No meaningful attempt at improving this situation was made by Aircalin This is where the Aircalin experience really fell apart for me I booked and paid to spend the last day of my holiday relaxing by the beach then catching a night flight to Noumea a swift layover and a subsequent flight to Singapore Instead I had to wake up early to catch my flight to Noumea and spend my entire day at the airport These experiences are entirely different and considering the fact that I booked the st experience it is not acceptable that I was stuck with the nd with no meaningful recourse The first experience is highvalue and efficient while the second experience is more reflective of a budget itinerary As an airline once you create a schedule you should stick to it Constantly changing the schedule and messing around with passengers itineraries is an easy way to leave a sour taste in their mouth even if the inflight experience is decent

I passed through this airport in July They had done a lot of improvements since the first time I flew through in and I know that its not totally finished now The price of food and beverages is pretty expensive The airport looks good and clean The staff are professional

We flew to Cairo from our Sharm elSheikh resort as many others did in order to tour the capital city of Egypt The aircraft was very comfortable and seemed quite new They offer great catering for the one hour flight Couldnt fault it

Its a pleasure to travel with Cyprus airways They are so kind and really try to help The staff in Dubai is super friendly and playful with my daughter Im a nervous flyer and I always feel at ease when travelling with Cyprus airways

Very impressed with Korean Air my first time and hopefully not my last Smart clean modern plane good legroom Meal offered was near excellent fresh and tasty other airlines take note Cabin crew pleasant and efficient flight took off on time and landed slightly ahead of schedule Would I recommend most definitely yes

A good airport to fly in and out of Lines are not long and staff are friendly While it is outside of the city there is OC Transpo service via busways directly to downtown The only down side is that there arent many food options past security

Arrived here for the safari and climb up Mt Kilimanjaro Arrived around hrs you walk into a big room with two areas I have a visa and I do not have a visa So we got in the no visa line Well actually it wasnt so much a line as a big confluence of people and soon we found out why there are multiple windows you need to go to before passing through customs to collect your baggage I had read a blog about the visa scenario at JRO before I left so I had an idea of what to expect but upon returning home I reread the blog and realized that I didnt retain all of what was stated It was all there but like most things in life experience trumps book knowledge You need to get in the far right line first to pay for the visa for USA for non USA Bring large bills preferably new I had been told this prior to the trip so I came prepared with new bills circa or maybe it was Bottom line they werent from before which is the cut off year for American bills accepted in Tanzania After you pay you go to the nd line and get your photo taken and the visa is placed in your passport Get through with that and you realize you still cannot see your baggage you need to go to the rd line for fingerprinting By this time all of the I have a visa people were gone so there were more lines available for this last step All in all it took us minutes from the time we entered the room to the time we saw our baggage Yes its a long time but if you purchase your visa before travelling you only save maybe minutes and you need to consider the fact that you have to mail in your passport for an extended period to receive that visa Add to that you need to purchase the passport photos for the visa for us its worth it to spend the extra time in the airport and never allow your passport to be sent in the mail You save money on the photos because they take your picture at JRO The return leg went very smoothly you get in line they run all of your bags and you through security then you turn in your checked baggage and go through security again with your carry on took about an hour and we were at our gate no worries

I used Tempelhof for the first and I guess last time last week It is wonderful why are modern airports not like this The history and architecture are fabulous of course but it also works incredibly well admittedly having so few flights means nothing is really under pressure As noted elsewhere public transport links are excellent one can be in the city centre within minutes of walking off the plane From the departure lounge to seat on the aircraft takes less than a minute I guess it is an anachronism in the st century but it is sad to say goodbye to an airport with real character

I was very impressed with the experience at Riga Airport So fast through security and no problems with my Japanese hair sticks which look like weapons on xrays Pleasant staff too which makes a real change Wish I could say the same for UK airports Good range of shops and helpful staff but some of the cafes are very expensive just for coffee and cake Slightly let down by toilets and desolate area C after passport control but generally very impressed compared to some nightmare experiences in the UK

Excellent little airport and the relatively new train stop just a few hundred meters across the parking lot from the terminal building makes it even better Its a shame more airlines arent using this perfect spot as Jerez is convenient to Cadiz Capital Sevilla and even Malaga and the Costa del Sol
Superb flight Left on time and arrived early This typifies the reason why Bangkok Airways is world best regional airline You got a little bag with a sandwich and water which was tasty

Well organised for the transit process Airport service persons picked us up at the exit and allocated us in a special area There are free services for water wifi access and breakfast A lady registers and reminds each of the customers in the waiting area for boarding Very good experience

Stansted to Tivat Overall this is a decent airline The cabin staff speak English the plane although old is fine for a short hour flight and the journey was comfortable A few pointers only one of the toilets in the plane were working which was annoying there was a basic selection of drinks and a simple cheese sandwich we took off over hours late but it was unclear if this was the fault of the airline or the ground staff on this flight we arrived too late to land in Tivat it has no night facilities so we had to land in Podgorica They did in the end put a bus for all of us to reach Tivat although the delay was significant

I am flying FDHDUS regularly and I am fully satisfied with this airline Due to the smaller sizes of their aircrafts the flight takes some time about hr min but service onboard is excellent Good regional snacks and plenty of drinks are served during the flight Ground handling in FDH is very quick and efficient Prices are high but still recommendable

Lovely airport and great shops for an airport of this size Paying a the counter for taxis removes the touts that descend on you in other places Food options are limited but then who would want to spend too long checking in too early and getting hungry when on such a lovely island

TAR Aerolineas is a new regional Mexican carrier which operates several routes in Mexico Flew a domestic route roundtrip and found the service to be topnotch Aircraft brand new and clean punctual departures and arrivals attentive ground and cabin personnel excellent value for money Would choose them again when my travel plans take me to Mexico

This place is clean and efficient Lots of room and well staffed airport Both the internationaldomestic terminal and the USA pre clearance terminals are modern and the lines are usually moving very quickly US Customs is exceptionally efficient and considering the volume of persons traveling the process is smooth and the staff is excellent and friendly US citizens get to experience an even smoother passage with the automated terminals Just make sure you follow all the rules because some of them might seem unnecessary but if you have had a big win at the casino declare it or loose it after a night in a terrible local lock up and a visit to a magistrate back in town the next day if it is not a Friday

International arrival hall is small immigration is crowded does not provide much facility except toilet and carousel With its size luggage come very quickly and most passengers only need to spend minutes from gate to pick up area Once you get out of terminal there are plenty of food shops coffee shop including Starbucks on ground floor and food center on the nd floor For Departure facility is much better Check in area is large clean and modern Departure hall have a lot of shops cafe and restaurant but International departure need to make sure to reserve enough time to pass immigration which is at the farthest end of the airport and no more shop beyond that point
Excellent also it is not as large as other mainly international airports it is the largest airport in Shandong province There are many attractive airlines and aircrafts in this airport

I was a disabled passenger on the Tui flight departure date which eventually took off All Madeirian staff at the airport were polite very helpful in particular the disabled Assistance staff The poor weather affecting the departure will not deter my family from coming back to Funchal All the very best for the new year

The airport itself is good but the design looks simply ok The airport is big it has old and new parts the new part looks better It has many checkin desks fast security check and very nice that they have priority security check and priority passport control Some nice business lounges and good duty free

Lives up to its name no signs chaos rude airport staff overflowing rubbish bins of flight delayed and no aircon but great food Unless one wants to fly to Rome and drive not many options to visit Campania and it is worth visiting so just have to roll with it and accept it

Nanjing to Xian The check in process for this flight was smooth Cabin crew were friendly and courteous Hot meal with beverages were served However the standard of the in flight catering was neither appealing nor appetizing The passengers who sat next to me even returned the meal to the flight attendant It is indeed below average Only Chinese movies is available from the drop down LED screen Tianjin Airlines have plenty of room for improvement
The airport services were very attentive to the plane we arrived at local time when we left the plane the luggage gang was already in operation and the suitcases were in very good condition

Prague to Copenhagen Flight was operated by Czech Airlines A reg OKMEL not with lowcost Smartwings like almost all other CSA flights Departure was delayed only about minutes we arrived on time Staff was nice and friendly Ordered food was so expensive CZK but delicious Aircraft was clean and seats were comfortable

Wonderful airline Both going to and coming back from Whitehorse I really enjoyed flying with them Flights were on time No trouble with checked baggage Staff were super friendly They even provided a complimentary sandwich and warm cookie on a flight that was just over two hours I have a high opinion of this airline and would gladly fly with them again Thank you Air North

What is happening with some Italian Airports As Florence and Pisa Bologna is completely and horrendously overcrowded One cannot walk around at the gate area which is immediately after a socalled DutyFree With people queuing to get on a plane or for a sandwich or coffee there is no space to get anywhere without pushing your way through The worse there is absolutely no air to breath with all these people standing around Probably much is because of some low cost airlines which let you queue well before effectively boarding planes but whatever it is Bologna should think about some solution as it is an ordeal A pity because personnel is generically very friendly and there are lovely food options in the terminal

Brussels to Eskisehir with Tailwind Airlines Nice flight The crew was okay the plane was outdated The food was okay too not free or included though There wasnt any kind of inflight entertainment Great if you dont want WiFi connection or when you dont want to know where you are

First time to this airport When we arrived it was such a pleasant surprise to see how small it was The time from landing to being on the transfer bus was minutes The cases were already waiting after passport control On the return visit it was much busier as several flights were taking off in a short period However they dealt with the people quickly with no issues at all I wish all airports were like this one

Nice clean provincial airport handy for Asturias Cantabria and Galicia The checkin hall is spacious and on the occasions Ive used it it has always been hasslefree The cafe is large and reasonably priced and the toilets clean There are a half dozen care hire booths in the airport I always use the bus to get into and out of Oviedo It is cheap euros single and runs regularly from the stop outside the arrivals hall Regular buses also run to Gijon and Aviles There are plentiful taxis if you want a more expensive drive in The only mild criticism I have of the airport is the time it takes to get through customs on arrival Other than that a pleasant airport which nearly makes flying pleasurable

I have never experienced such patience ever since I started travelling I became late because as we got to the airport my year old son fell and injured himself and had to take care of him The two ladies working at the boarding gate that afternoon called me twice to check up and make sure we got onto that flight and waited until the last minute before they closed check in I was in awe of their patience and care for me as a passenger this has never happened to me before especially to go to the extent of calling me Genuinely grateful and can never thank them enough We need more of this kind of understanding with airlines Best flying experience ever

It is absolutely unfair to give only one star to this airline the Tupolev plane is in good condition and perfectly clean the crew are efficient pleasant and helpful and last but not least it is always on time you can find many airlines much worse than that for instance Air China on the same route The route flown is the no route of Air Koryo linking DPRK to Beijing and this entitles you to some patriotic videos on the overhead screen The buns served are not too bad and drinks are acceptable for such a small trip All in all a good experience

Paris to San Francisco Read the reviews after purchasing my ticket and was quite worried Ive flown to Europe multiple times on multiple airlines and this flight was just the same as all the other airlines Economy seats are the same size as UnitedDelta Our flight was several hundred dollars cheaper per person than any other alternative Yes boarding is a bit chaotic and unorganized but that was not that big of a deal to me Yes there are no screens on the seats however they offer free WiFi with access to their entertainment on your own device that includes movies tv shows games and music They do not have charging in seat so bring your own portable charger if necessary Food was delicious and they had good options for purchase throughout the flight Flight attendants were very friendly and provided great service We sat in the back of the plane with seats together and that was great because the aisles were a bit roomier back there

Clean airport Fairly good coffee and muffin place inside The cafe takes Som or US Power for charging stuff in the cafe Duty free a bit sad separate security screenings but all fast enough minutes from kerbside to airline gate better than many civilised airports Bags checked there arrived ok at destination on time after flights Take off minutes late without explanation The indicator board was never altered The information desk had no better advice Maybe the airport could insist airlines provide up to date information The waiting masses were getting restless One announcement was made in a language that may have been Korean but none of the Korean passengers could understand it It was not English or Uzbek
We were booked on Condor but last minute this flight was changed to Wamos Our experience was very good with this airline The crew was polite and efficient The service and food was very good

WestJet from Calgary to London Heathrow was excellent The flight attendant introduced herself by name and provided a warm welcome Remembered customers names as well A very decent sparkling wine and hot towels were served before take off Menu choices were good and dinner was quite tasty Breakfast options were far better than on other carriers There was a good choice of wines poured generously IFE system was pretty standard Seats comfortable Overall the quality of the premium economy product on WestJet is far superior to Air Canadas and better than British Airways

In spite of a delay of one hour at LHR the flights to and from Australia were the most pleasant that I have made on this route The cabin service is outstanding and my dietary requirements diabetic were met and were some of the best I have ever eaten The cabin crew at all times were top class

This was my first time on EVA Air and I must say that it was a highly impressive experience Yes it was pricey flying premium economy but at this will be the only way to fly when traveling to Asia from here on out unless traveling business I found the premium economy cabin to be more than satisfactory The seats of course were not lie flat but they still had enough pitch to be comfortable And the one thing that stood out were the cushions in seating There was enough padding that I wasnt even remotely uncomfortable throughout the entire flight I arrived in Taipei from LAX comfortable and refreshed The service was good and the food though not Michelinrated was still perfectly fine I would fly them again While some may say its not different enough from coach to make it worth the money when youre it makes a big difference Ive flown economy to Asia and never again

Agree with all the positive comments only in transit at Pittsburgh International recently and found it to be a very pleasnt experience due in large part to the variety of shops and restaurants An uncrowded spacious layout adds to the comfort level Also agree with a previous comment regarding the downside of this airport being the near monopoly of US Airways a greater presence by competing carriers would be a real plus

We flew from Minsk to London on Jan MSQ has been refurbished following the hockey world cup one year ago ish Check in area is bright and efficient There is even a nice play area for children Signage is generally clear and in two languages The terminal is very clean Arrival was also smooth and passport control was quick Security was reasonably fast as it was passport control Gates as the lounge at the upper floor have not been renovated thus still look a bit obsolete there are few shops with prices in Euros and few bars for the last cuppa before flying off there are not many seats by the gate meaning that it might be difficult to find a seat if two flights are departing simultaneously from two adjacent gates Overall a good airport

Excellent flight good service with hearty meal starter main course dessert tea and coffee Duty service on board A generous pitch for economy class seats Note the delay at departure due to the closure of Orly airport and the flights diverted to Paris CDG

I chose this airline for the simple reason of its aircraft type Boarding was completed quickly for on time departure On board seat pitch was a little tight snack service box was offered water and a sweet coffee bun and a sales trolley after that Cabin was quite warm and no walk though by cabin crew offering water Cabin is showing it age for sure but still enjoyed my flight

Thoroughly workmanlike return flights Johannesburg to Cape Town Cabin crew were efficient and personable Seats AC had adequate leg room Food was adequate and it was helpful to see the three main courses before choosing one Both flights arrived ahead of schedule
I think it is a great airport compared to most Chinese airports Today Hangzhou Airport is quite different from what it used to be Its very large and modern and has good service

Just wanted to shout out the excellent customer service and help I received recently at Denpasar Bali airport I stupidly left two bags on the carousal when I went through customs Airport security were very friendly as the guided me through a secure area to go back behind the luggage area to retrieve the bags and customs did not hassle me for going through twice Cant imagine doing this so easily in a North American airport Bali people are great
Very good array of shops ahead of security Very modern very clean Far nicer than the other airports that Ive encountered in Brazil

A true surprise and real gem of an airport Superbly clean and tidy nice array of shops to suit all prices and barcafes also serve good food Staff pleasant seating comfortable and good signposting Only downside was that internet charges too high and not always available

There are a lot of negative reviews for this airlines but for a budget airline what do these reviewers expect Premium airline service They have obviously never flown on EasyJet or Ryanair to make a comparison Flew to Turkey from Manchester and was quite impressed by their checkin service and legroom on the plane Recommend to anyone

AmsterdamCancun bought Comfort Class seats The cabin attendants were friendly food served was a little less good it wasnt bad just average The legroom in Comfort Class was good and other benefits are the complimentary alcoholic beverages and personal media player that you get So overall a satisfying flight

Verona to Mahon Flight at full hour aircraft slightly dated but maintained better than others very comfortable seats In mid flight we were served a very good snack nice and elegant and above all professional hostesses volo in pieno orarioaereo leggermente datato ma tenuto meglio di altri sedili molto comodi a met volo ci stato servito lo spuntino molto buono hostess carine e eleganti e soprattutto professionali

I fly out of Winnipeg many times Although its not the best in terms of stores and flight choice it is very spacious bright and traveler friendly Its one of the nicest airports Ive traveled through Massive glass windows give a wonderful view of the planes and surrounding area Check in is usually quick and easy although the self serve machines are useless Lots of parking and room to drop off as well Security is quick and simple dropping you in the middle of the terminal Moving around isnt hard either since it only takes mins to walk the entire terminal length The only issue I have with this airport is that there isnt many food and store options The food court has a Pizza place and sandwich store along with the necessary Tim Hortons in the airport They sell some snacks at the usual travel stores though quite expensive Wifi and staff are great along with bag claimcustoms being quick to get through Overall great airport

Whilst small and basic its the perfect option for a frequent traveller No queues at check in or security Friendly staff even the security guys are nice No long walks to find your gate Arrive mins before departure travel stress free without the crowds and connect to the world via Schiphol Baggage claim takes minutes Would recommend this airport over flying via Manchester any day unless you enjoy arriving hrs early and shopping

While it is beyond the reach of New York City taxis ISP is five minutes away from Ronkonkoma railroad station in turn a hm train ride to Penn Station This may seem very inconvenient for Newyorkers used to La Guardia airoport but it isnt so bad if compared with JFK The airport is small and efficient There are little or no delays on the ground This field is used primarily by Southwest as its gateway to New York Southwest partner ATA is another visitor while some legacy carriers only offer regional service to their respective hubs or focus cities For those passengers who dont like turboprops be advised that Piedmont Airlines operates from this field with DHCs for Us Airways express while Colgate uses tiny Beechcrafts on flights for Usair express and Continental I find those tiny planes charming but many passengers complain Overall a very pleasant passenger oriented airport

The new airport in Miri is a blessing to all of us frequent travellers Although it is small it is efficient clean and cool If anything needs to be imroved on is the charges we have to pay for a small cup of coffee or a meal The charges are much too high for a domestic airport

We have flown twice into Bermuda and each time were inout in under minutes For an island of just residents I am mightily impressed We really appreciated the smiling and welcoming airport staff along with the friendly curbside taxi operators The new terminal is quite impressive and the signage reflects what is commonly used in other international airports The duty free shops sadly offer no bargain prices In fact alcohol products are cheaper in Hamilton Yes the food offerings in the terminal are quite limited but they do attempt to reflect local culinary tastes While local favorites are mostly featured the prices are high but generally commensurate with elsewhere on the island In fact prices are definitely comparable to any of the NY area airports FACT CHECK Bermuda is an island that largely relies on marine shipments of imported food and supplies including oil and gas Closing Thought I have circled the globe and on reflection choose L F Wade airport as my preferred southern transit stop
Small airport which makes everything easier But going through security was a hassle with lines nothing compared to Beijing though Dont expect much of it given the size Very clean

The airport and their airlines offer a wide range of European and North African leisure destinations but also large German cities such as Frankfurt or Munich Nice little shops and restauantscafes Staff are very friendly and the waiting times as well as the walking times are unbeatable Love flying fromto the Airport

Overall a lovely flight with BA cityflyer as usual I will review both the outbound and return EDIPMI Check in wasnt particularly friendly at EDI no consideration for priority as a business class customer Fast track security was good BA lounge at EDI had a poor selection of food in the morning but plenty choice of drinks and staff were lovely EDI PMI flight on E aircraft configuration for business and economy In business the drinks were flowing constantly and a wrap was offered to eat In economy a sandwich and free bar was also offered Crew were friendly PMI EDI Check in at PMI was chaos and took an hour for priority Fast track security was quick Lounge was drab and we only stayed for a coffee There was food and drink available Flight was good I was in row and only Arabic chicken dish left it didnt appeal and I asked for an economy sandwich they only had vegan option available sweet potato and cranberry It was ok Crew were lovely and drinks were flowing constantly to those that wanted it Again economy was given free bar and a sandwich It was nice to travel club Europe as a treat but to be honest on a hr flight low cost airlines are more than fine

Barcelona BLA to Caracas CCS in Venezuela on a classic Boeing aircraft I experienced Conviasa to be quite nice to fly with Anyhow they do not offer much more than the average European nofrills carriers A costfree nonalcoholic drink was served on that short domestic flight the aircraft was clean and fine despite its age we departed BLA about minutes ahead schedule not every airline in Venezuela manages that Since the ticket costed me less than EUR I can call it a quite satisfying experience

Flying Icelandair Saga business class is a real pleasure I got access to the Lounge in Toronto boarding was smooth and the seats though not flat bed comfortable for at five hour flight In flight service started with a glass of sparkling wine This was followed by a bar service and a a three course meal served on a textile table cloth textile napkins proper glases tablewear and silver The cured lamb entree and the braised brisket with mashed potatoes fennel fried cherry tomatoes in red wine sauce were all excellent as well as the chocolate lava mousse and the wines Connecting time in Keflavik was enough though a little bit stressful A rich breakfast was served between Keflavik and Helsinki I very much appreciated the friendly and professional staff It always feels safe to have Icelandic pilots in the cockpit

Coxs Bazar to Dhaka with USBangla Airlines The checkin process was smooth The plane arrived exactly on time But had to refuel for mins We were on a full family trip The staff was friendly and helpful The seats were a bit tight and narrow Food was average Landing was smooth We got our baggage in time I dont know about others but my experience was satisfactory

My flight with Air Do was a great example of Japanese customer service Being an All Nippon codeshare flight I was connecting from another ANA flight that unfortunately ran late and my connection was already only minutes the tightest theoretical connection that ANA allows My flight to Fukuoka arrived at a remote stand and they already had a van with a concierge best I can describe it waiting with a sign for me They whisked me away and drove me right to the gate with just minutes to spare My bags also made the transfer as well with them having their own luggage cart drive them right to the plane As for the flight itself the plane itself wasnt in the best shape being an exANA that was at years old and definitely showing its age I was able to get the bulkhead seat and had the entire row to myself Im a tall guy and leg room was no issue Recline was great considering theyre a budget airline and they had the usual drink service with a choice of green tea coffee and apple juice Their inflight shop has some cool items too I got myself a little plushie of the airlines polar bear mascot One downside of this flight was that we arrived at a remote stand at the farthest end of Sapporo airport having to take a min bus ride to get to the terminal Other than that a good flight but excellent customer service
Excellent also it is not as large as other mainly international airports it is the largest airport in Shandong province There are many attractive airlines and aircrafts in this airport

I arrived at T Terminal Hongqiao Used the Sky Priority Customer Service Lovely helpful staff who helped me with my oversized baggage I was stressed about it and the team helped me without a problem Then even showed me clearly were to go as well as showing me were Sky Priority Lounge was I couldnt be more grateful for their good service

Bradley is my home airport I fly from and to here multiple times a year to visit friends and family While it isnt as big as the New York airports or Boston fares are usually among the cheapest in southern New England and southeastern New York and BDL provides service to all major eastern hubs such as Atlanta Detroit Cincinnati Charlotte Minneapolis ChicagoORD Washington Philly and Baltimore as well as numerous Florida destinations Las Vegas Denver Toronto Montreal Cleveland Raleigh San Juan Cancun and starting later this year LA and Dublin Ireland Concessions are ample and security is usually manageable in under thirty except some mornings I nearly always fly Delta and their service out of BDL has been fantastic Flights to Salt Lake City Seattle San Francisco and Nashville would be ideal additions

Awful from front desk to boarding airport is like a sauna staff are rude and dont want to be here but then there is only a handful of staff No information for English lucky I speak Italian it makes you appreciate Gatwick and Heathrow

Contrary to all of the recent negative press about airports and their staff our experience flying and coming back in was seamless Given the pressure that all airport staff are under they are doing an amazing job and are doing it with a smile We travelled down to Newcastle from Scotland and stayed in the Premier Inn the night before I would have no hesitation in using this airport again Well done to all of the staff

The airport is a small regional airport However there is a nice souvenir shop and a decent number of places to eat given its modest size One thing you will see in the airport is life size cardboard cut outs of the famous Boise State American Football team the towns most famous export There is a bus link from the airport to downtown but when I went it appeared to be having serious delays A cab into downtown is not too expensive The queuing times are very quick as this airport never really gets too busy as it is small

Terminal is the area I am reviewing this trip We used the short stay car park as you can walk undercover into the terminal Very easy although not the cheapest option Finding the Aer Lingus checkin was simple and as we stood in line the single checkin operator asked for passengers for Belfast to come forward first which was great The airline uses T for short hops to Belfast and Dublin the main activity for long haul is in T Security was very quiet and efficient for those of us who understand and stick to the rules One family was annoyed at having to surrender much of their liquids and cosmetics because they did not know the rules My partners bag was sidetracked for search Apparently her paperback novel attracted their attention Mine thankfully did not so go figure Once through we ran the gauntlet of the Duty Free maze and found our way to the Aspire Lounge included with the economyflex ticket Boarding was simple with the ATR aircraft having only seats Returning the aircraft was parked very remotely for some reason and we were bussed to the terminal at times I thought we were on an executive allareas tour By the time we got there the bags were on the belt and we were away

City of Derry is a small regional airport however check in was very straight forward the Logan Air staff were very friendly The security process was a little over the top however it was fast There is a small cafe within the terminal and its servers drinks and snacks which was more than sufficient for the short wait prior to boarding the aircraft Boarding the flight was by seat number however this was orderly and efficient The flight from City of Derry to London takes just over hour The cabin crew are extremely friendly and provided some teacoffee and biscuits After landing the plane was parked in a remote apron however there was a bus to take us to the terminal upon arrival My luggage was also coming out of the carousal by the time we got to the terminal which meant I was on my way to next destination very quickly Overall this is a great service by Loganair from a regional airport

Yangon to Thandwe and pleasantly surprised by Air KBZ Snacks served onboard seats generally comfortable Organisational issues with boarding and a slight delay in departure from Yangon Check in at RGN was not very organised however once inside the departure terminal ground staff were more helpful They give you a coloured sticker to put on your shirt to ensure you get on the correct flight Would use again

It was my first time flying with PLAY and I have no complaints whatsoever I booked a roundtrip flight from Hamilton CA to Berlin Germany for US PLAY Flex with seat choice in the front of the plane and one kilo piece of checked luggage included What more can you ask for at this price The crews were friendly the seats have plenty of leg room the plane was clean There are no screens free movies etc and you have to pay for drinks ie Euros for a cup of coffee thats less than at the airport I was happy to pay for my coffee and to read a book instead of watching a movie because I saved about compared to a flight on a US airline out of Buffalo NY where I live To all those writing bad reviews regarding carryon luggage Ive seen people carrying large duffle bags onto the plane or a rather large suitcase a backpack AND a stuffed shopping bag type of bag and the crews were very helpful finding room for those bags in the cabin What are these people complaining about My personal opinion Pay a little more when making your reservation check your luggage and quit complaining I dont understand the I have to take my entire household into the cabin mentality at all And remember if there are issues at the airport with carryon luggage or a long wait for your checked luggage its not on the airline its on the airport employees And that is the only complaint I have the check in people at BER are very unfriendly But those are Swissport employees not PLAY employees Thank you PLAY for a very nice experience

Newark to Paris Orly I booked this airline because my family and I travel to France once or twice a year I decided to try this airline alone first As I got closer to the departure I decided to read the reviews As you have read there are many that are not favorable I became nervous because I had a small window of time for my visit this summer and I didnt want to spend it with airline drama I also want to point out that I travel K miles per year domestically for work and that I am a Delta Status flyer Previously I have flown Air France and Delta to Europe My review of this airline is superb The check in was uneventful the lounge was busy its summer the cabin crew were pleasant and the lite dinner salad with large shrimp was good My arrival was on time I carried on my bags Returning was the same on time pleasant and tasty I am a seasoned traveller to know that things can go wrong mechanical weather unpleasant staff and inedible food But in this case and on my flight it was a delight

As I live nearby its a convenient airport for me especially because of frequent flights to London and Southern France You can make use of free Internet Parking is cheap Connection to Rotterdam City and Port area is good and quick Hardly any queuing you can arrive mins before departure without any problems Whenever possible I make use of RotterdamThe Hague Airport

Small airport with basic but sufficient facilities Upon arrival airport staff welcomed passengers and provided a small bag of local snacks which was a nice touch Outbound processing was fine with courteous and friendly staff in security Checkin queue took a bit longer than normal for a regional ATR flight Room for improvement on this but ground staff very friendly and helpful

Flew with Canadian North on two occasions Found both flights to be very enjoyable First flight was Edmonton to Norman Wells and the next was Edmonton to Yellowknife Found check in staff to be friendly and helpful both times Flight Attendants were very courteous and friendly No corny jokes unlike Westjet Meals are also included with the fare For breakfast it was a hot or cold meal For dinner on the way home it was pork or chicken with free wine almost unheard of today on domestic economy flights The airplane was an older but in nice condition and lots of baggage allowance Would fly with them again and strongly recommend them

I am a frequent traveller and I like Hyderabad airport It offers a good shopping experience Has many brands and user friendly I keep traveling to middle East through this airport as well as various through Mumbai and Delhi as well I would like to say people are helpful and good easy to understand and very clean airport I can rate it as one of the best airports in India

Considering that Mykonos is a small hilly island this little airport does well It is small so transit through from disembarkation to exit is really quick and not far to walk Arrived on connecting flight from Athens on Aegean at am Bags were out in around minutes Return flight back to Athens a week later Afternoon flight so busier as flights departing together Check in was busy big queues but efficient check in staff Small coffee sandwich counter and gift shop airside and small duty free shop toilet facilities and snack bar with hot drinks once passed passport control and security Its not the Business Lounge at Changi but it does the job for the short time people are there Good job

Please dont heed old reviews Baku airport is modern immaculately clean entirely non smoking It has plenty of landside facilities including business lounge when it is open toilets cafebar and McDonalds Plenty of comfortable seating areas Sheraton hotel on site Good free WiFi Staff speak English and are helpful No hassling taxi drivers Cant fault it

Landing in Carrasco is a nice experience if the plane approaches the tarmac overflying the nice beaches and architecture Immigration did not take more than a few minutes and luggage was efficiently delivered it is necessary to go through a dutyfree in order to reach the hall where the conveyors are placed After customs the main lobby is very illuminated with natural light and spotlessly clean Taxis are abundant and comfortable and the airport is located about minutes from downtown However some of the carhiring companies are not located in the terminal but there is an efficient shuttle service to their offices

This airport has a extremely large number of visitors Ground transport and flow to and from are fine Concessions facilities and restaurants are far and few between sit down bar restaurant for many gates waiting lines everywhere all facilities both male and female have long lines Very far behind the times would rather fly to any other airport in they area

The airport was shining new and clean with clear signs and directions both in Vietnamese and English The international departure was smooth though queuing time for immigration and security screening was a bit long due to the jam in the morning Not many dutyfree shopping compared to some other international airports in SEA Dining was expensive seemed the restaurant was trying to make money from tourists Boarding gate was good with a lot of seats Toilet was clean

Great restaurant upstairs that serves main course meals and happy to work in your time frame for your flight Modern building and brilliant to depart and arrive from if you live anywhere nearby Just make sure you check the kind of aircraft being used for your flight If you do NOT want to be on a small regional or propeller plane your choices are limited Nothing better than arriving at HPN and getting home locally in under minutes

Nouakchott to Dakar The new Nouakchott airport is about min from the city and opened only years ago Pretty efficient airport not crowded and only gates The lounge was surprisingly good English spoken fast WiFi and a decent selection of food and beverages Mauritania is a dry country The plane was less then a year old but very poor maintained The whole seating arrangement was mixed up Seat itself was old and relatively clean No welcome drink amenities or InFlight magazine Hot meal was served on a min flight Only coffee was served no other options The toilet had no soap nor towels Many passengers eat their meal with bare hands Crew was friendly but didnt speak English Not flag carrier worthy airline but for African standards pretty cheap and the hard product is pretty new Service in business class to Easyjet economy
Check in was easy as was boarding Staff coped well on a flight that was completely full The departure was punctual and the staff were efficient and helpful Overall a pleasant experience

Bangkok to Osaka Smooth check in and efficient seat allocation They didnt check cabin baggage weight nor size Had to buy food and drinks as refused internet preorder because we used a travel agent Seats ok but a night flight which was very uncomfortable Saw in the inflight magazine we could upgrade enroute to premium economy a good idea For B a good flight

Tashkent Airport can be difficult to navigate Regulations are strictly enforced especially at departure Upon arrival I noticed that the people do not observe lines and not speaking Uzbek or Russian can be a disadvantage Make sure that you fill out and keep all official forms you receive There is one for each hotel you stay in and there are matching customs forms for arrival and departure you need to list valuables and cash and produce both forms when leaving the country Departure gate is a floor below the departure area There is now an escalator and carts are available for taking bags from the entrance gate to the escalator but only passengers may enter the departure gate Good luck if you have more than one or two bags There are no porters or at least not when I was there I had forgotten about the customs forms after I had to repeatedly insist to the airline representative that I was allowed to check in more than one bag and the customs official said I could not take my money out of the country without submitting both forms You will have to remove your shoes and socks and put on blue plastic booties before going through security The airport personnel were courteous and even friendly but it was clear that no exceptions would be made

XIYCTUAUH Arrived from Xian on domestic flight in Terminal which was newly opened in Spring All very clean and tidy with clear signs in Mandarin and English Quite a long walk to Baggage Reclaim for the furthest gates but not unreasonable Toilets clean and plentiful with both squat and regular options For International Departures there are main dining options before Checkin either KFC or local Chinese food There are a few stores selling various local foods and some souvenirs CheckIn pretty good and Passport Control and Security all pretty smooth No requirement to remove belts or laptops for security scanning but do enforce the ml liquid rules from Europe In the International Departures no dining opportunities but a couple of coffeeshop options along with the usual array of Duty Free shops Most departures are from one of the airbridges Announcements made in both Chinese and English Toilets are clean

Toronto City Center while dwarfed in size by nearby Toronto Pearson Airport provides an exceptional experience for travelers Most notable is the terminal cafeteria stocked with free coffee soft drinks and light snacks In an era where nothing seems to be given out for free in air travel it is refreshing to see this at City Center The terminal is designed differently than those at most other airports As opposed to separate waiting areas for each gate there is one central waiting area which serves every gate the airport has gates At first glance the sight is a bit jarring but travelers will feel at ease as they settle in to the comfortable seats with their free snacks City Center is also recommended because of its location Views from within the airport and during approaches are beautiful as the airport is situated over water Lake Ontario Meanwhile the airport is very close to downtown Toronto making transport to and from the airport quick and cheap

The airport of Medan has been moved from Polonia to Kuala Namu International Airport KNIA KNIA is now the most advanced and the second largest airport in Indonesia It is also the first integrated airport rail link in Indonesia The whole area is free from smoke means that they provide and manage the smoking area well The baggage claim area is welldesigned Restrooms are always clean and have no pungent smell
Very decent airline Crew very friendly although their English command could be better The cheese sandwich is fantastic

We flew from Dubrovnik to Athens and then Athens to Zagreb on Croatia Airlines They were on time within minutes for both flights You drop your bag on the tarmac and they load it into the belly of the plane And then you pick it up directly from the tarmac after the flight so there is very little chance for lost luggage which I like They allow a smaller carryone bag as well They did not weigh our bag or try to charge us for anything extra We were allowed to pick our seats for no charge The seats are standard and comparable to Southwest airlines for leg room and space We were served water and drinks on both flights For the price we paid it was a great deal Some people might be nervous about flying a propeller plane but it was a very smooth flight in both directions with almost zero turbulence and a very smooth landing If you had to fault them for one thing it would be nice to have some in flight entertainment Other than that it was a perfect flight Definitely recommend

Upon arrival at MRV discovered a new arrivals hall since my last visit in October last year Baggage very quick into hall Outside a pleasant array of kiosks should you need anything food wise Departures hall is spotless and some nice Caucasian shops to spend your Rubles in Security quick and easy and departure lounge has a nice cafe and a few more shops A pleasant experience before the hassle of Domodedevo

Pretty much the only option between the islands around St Maarten and Winair knows that so their proces are high We paid each for two times twelve minutes of flying Having said that it is real fun to fly their Twin Otter out of Saba with the shortest runway on earth and than landing at the rollercoaster runway at Saint Barthlemy The move our departure time one hour forward Sabas tiny airport is more like a bus stop and the plan cans land with too much wind so its always unsure Taking off is spectacular since the engines are pushed to their limits before being catapulted on the runway The plane doesnt give you any personal space there is no service of any kind but the view is great Since the same plane took us form SXM tot SBH we could stay inside and repeated the whole thing Flying Winair between the Caribbean islands is part of the experience so dont skip it
In this scorching heat ACs dont work Travelers are sweating Even lounges dont have working AC Very uncomfortable atmosphere with direct sun rays

KIVBUDKIV early February The plane was a SAAB both ways It is a bit old and noisy especially during takeoff but once at cruising altitude turned out to be a nice ride Check in efficient and departurearrival on time The service on this hour flight consists of a light breakfast in the morning and a hot meal for afternoon and evening flights All in all a pleasant experience Checkin quick and the same could be said about baggage delivery at both ends Would fly this airline again which is the only direct option to Budapest

Nice cosy airline with very friendly cabin personnel Comfort standard and entertainment through plane WiFi without screens limited choice Food was plain but sufficient wine could be obtained Flight was absolutely ontime a nice experience

Toronto City Center while dwarfed in size by nearby Toronto Pearson Airport provides an exceptional experience for travelers Most notable is the terminal cafeteria stocked with free coffee soft drinks and light snacks In an era where nothing seems to be given out for free in air travel it is refreshing to see this at City Center The terminal is designed differently than those at most other airports As opposed to separate waiting areas for each gate there is one central waiting area which serves every gate the airport has gates At first glance the sight is a bit jarring but travelers will feel at ease as they settle in to the comfortable seats with their free snacks City Center is also recommended because of its location Views from within the airport and during approaches are beautiful as the airport is situated over water Lake Ontario Meanwhile the airport is very close to downtown Toronto making transport to and from the airport quick and cheap

I fly into Rimini Airport at least times a year to visit family It is a small airport and the restaurant and shops are expensive I love this airport You cant get lost and the best bit is you can go outside on a very large balcony and watch the planes land take off etc Also great if you smoke You are allowed to smoke only outside I would recommend this airport it is still small and friendly

Santiago de Chile to Isla de Pascua Had the opportunity to fly with LAN from Santiago de Chile to Easter Islands a trip I had been expecting tor a long time Although the LAN web site indicated that you should report to checkin a whole hours before scheduled departure time I decided to play it cool and only arrive at the Santiago airport at for a am flight just to see that checkin was still well in progress without any rush Upon boarding the Boeing I just loved the cabin interior very light and roomy with nice LED lights around When finding my seat I soon realised however how small it was Im sure is the narrowest airplane seat Ive ever seen and the legroom was very short for someone of cm I was happy that I was only going to spend hours and not on this plane However I soon found the IFE which offered a great selection of top recent films certainly far too many for this six hours flight As I hadnt downloaded the LAN application on my tablet beforehand there would have been even a greater choice of entertainment available for this flight Soon after takeoff an excellent breakfast with fresh fruit and an omelette was served During the rest of the flight drinks and coffee were served several times The best part of this flight was however the Chilean LAN cabin crew The steward serving my section was chatting around making jokes and asking several times if I needed something more This is the kind of service I would have expected in First Class but here I was enjoying it in Economy Well done LAN

Although there is little traffic at SSA there will always be long lines This is especially true for international flights Although there may be only one international flight leave in hrs immigration will take hr And beware of the arrival of international flights within hr You will see the typical Brazilian chaos

First time contributing to this thread and I must say Kuala Namu International Airport looks pretty modern and roomy indeed something I truly want to see in a functioning airport I mean yes it has opened recently yet I saw in the preopening photos a lot of modern features from streamlined checkin desks and a variety of shops Im surprised I saw a branch of Cotton On at the airport to modern jetways and small plants placed along the waiting areas near gates I wonder if those are actual palm trees

LHR T BA Gold Wing worked well Pleasant check in and very fast security screening Concorde room service attentive C gate boarding OK but nothing special for First Passengers Latest BA version of first with only suites with privacy doors Comfortable seat with plenty of stowage Good screen and good choice of IFE Amenity kit good quality and bedding pillows cushions and blankets all good Excellent menu and food very well presented Cabin crew could not have been more attentive and helpful without being obtrusive On time departure and early arrival Bags delivered relatively swiftly and priority tagged bags were first off All in all one of the best BA First flights Ive had in many years Whilst not touching the Middle Eastern carriers BA First on this showing is easily the best way to cross the Atlantic
Short domestic flight Flight on time well coordinated boarding nice snack box friendly cabin crew good leg room arrival in Krabi at an airbridge recommended

Bagan to Heho Very short flight again another ATR aircraft as a nervous passenger I was not looking forward to the flight but it was great Seating was no seat numbers given as only a few passengers on this flight No Inflight snack but coffee or cold drinks were supplied All in all a good flight and would travel again

I flew roundtrip to visit family for Christmas week On the outbound leg all the flight attendants were decked out in their fanciest tackiest holiday finery We even had the Grinch try to run down the jetway at LaGuardia Plentiful snacks and the WiFi worked well enough for the inflight entertainment bring your own device for that I was also able to use the WiFi to track my luggage through the Southwest website The best part is unlike other airlines one can check up to two bags for free very important when youre bringing NYC goodies to Brooklyn expats Flights took off on time and arrived on time the outbound to SMF arrived early in fact so early we had to wait for a gate Ten out of ten would recommend

A very pleasant airport Modern spacious very quiet the building has good acoustics to dampen internal and external noise Tasty food free drinking water you need to bring your own bottle Also interesting in the general area of the terminal you can spend time in the Flyport an interesting educational area about aerospace Efficient service smiling and helpful staff All in all highly recommended

I am grateful to the staff at DEL airport for the cooperation on th Jan Flt noVS I had a problem with my luggage as by mistake I had left a charger battery in my checked baggage One staff member helped me to a great extent to settle the issue The support given to me by her was exemplery

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well

Used this airport several times over the past decade at various times of the day and on long and short haul flights A small pleasant airport where it is usually possible to find a quiet corner Staff are helpful and usually smile Dining is American fast food variety and expensive Pay the departure tax in advance at your hotel Avoid the postsecurity shopping as the prices are high

Wenzhou Airport is for me one of best airports in China The New terminal is very big and very beautiful the checkin security check and boarding is fast and easy At this airport they start the automatic checkin and it is fantastic and very simple The airport staff are kind and happy to serve you

Flew KigaliNairobiDar and return midMarch Aircrafts were all on ageing B except the st leg was on the smaller Embraer A flight cancellation was clearly announced days in advance allowing for alternative and even better options compared to original schedule All flights on time FAs catering and seating were all good Could select my preferred exit seat free with amble legroom through KQs homepage Transfers in Nairobi were smooth Twothree pieces of luggage were received well both ways Paid access to lounge in Nairobi discounted to USD due to Silver status with Kenya airways Miles earned and given generous luggage allowance together with the inexpensive ticket make this detour over Nairobi worth the trouble as compared to direct flight alternatives All flights on time

I have flown from Charlotte NC to Pittsburgh many times in the past yrs Today I lost my wallet I was very fortunate to be called informing me someone had turned in my wallet They kindly sent an employee up to gate B to return it to me just minutes before my flight took off That is excellent customer service and I will be forever grateful for their kindness I will never forget this Thanks for such a wonderful and caring staff You guys rock

Flew from CKGLHW on Sichuan Airlines a pleasant enough flight We used an airbridge in the older Terminal while the booking hall is now closed the baggage hall and arrivals remain the same for Terminal The high speed railway has been completed so I decided to catch the train to Lanzhou West railway station The train station is a short walk to the left from the exit of Terminal opposite Terminal There was only a short queue for tickets in the Ticket hall to the right of the station entrance about for First class on the very next train Travel time was about minutes All in all it was much better than slow airport bus and taxi options

Toykos nd airport smaller and closer to the city Arrival process OK but suffered from being rather manual with queues for immigration and then passport control despite offering online advanced registration Baggage reclaim quite quick Excellent transport links by bus train or taxi clear signs in Japanese and English Ticket Machines for trains ONLY take cash but do give change and are fantastic value for money Leaving Japan the process is very speedy with Bag Drop etc and then Security and automated passport gates There is a cafe on the Arrivals Level if you arrive too early to checkin or are waiting to be picked up on arrival Within the terminal is the usual array of shops and eating places focused more on the regionallocal travellers rather than the full Duty Free range of goods you might find elsewhere in the region Reasonable seating near the departure gates and overall quite quick turnround of planes

Having lived in the area all of my life Ive flown out of Syracuse Hancock for years It is a smallish regional airport with a few places to eat The bathroom facilities are abundant and clean while gate areas are somewhat outdated and a little shopworn The airport is divided into two main departurearrival wings previously each had its own TSA screening area Recent renovations resulted in consolidation to a single TSA screening area with capacity to manage both gate wings Because I was not aware of the renovations I took my usual path to my assigned gate only to find that I had to backtrack to the TSA area and then back out to the gate Perhaps further renovations andor improvements in signage could result in more a more direct and efficient pathway to TSA Once through the mostly efficient TSA process the walk to the gate was fairly quick and straightforward TSA lines can be long but not like LAX DCA etc during peak periods so be prepared Parking is adjacent to the terminal with very reasonable rates Ive left my car there for a few days at a time without concern While sometimes flights are less expensive out of nearby cities Rochester Buffalo Albany for example I choose to fly out of Syracuse because it is so accessible Lastly the Syracuse illuminated sign on the gate area has welcomed passengers for decades with its comforting deco appearance

Very clean and modern airport New terminal added in New access highway to Shenyang Limited air traffic with few delays Baggage area is poorly lit Not sure why As the Chinese economy grows who knows what will come of this airport Right now its a clean well run airport albeit with little air traffic Interesting for an American to see Air Koryo planes and personnel at the airport

Was on flight with Vietnam Airlines from Hanoi to OsakaKansai on its business class Nothing to complain as ground staff cabin crew were professional and offered the best that they could Seat was comfortable I chose the Japanese breakfast and found that it was somehow delicious Inflight entertainment surprisingly was excellent with new movies and music album No WiFI onboard even in business class which may be something the airline should consider to improve

My flight was to Milan from Toronto and return Checkin was fast the crew were polite and efficient on the ground and in flight For the most part both of my flights were on time just on the way back there was a delay of hours but Expedia had informed me through email days prior of my flight I was pleasantly surprised regarding the meals served on board to and from Italy not only you can choose from a menu but the food was delicious Also I found that choosing the option to pay for checked baggage on Air Italy site was much cheaper than paying at the airport I paid in Canadian dollars instead of euros I usually fly with Air Canada but Air Italy was much cheaper in comparison The only thing that I would appreciate is that when choosing the option to pay for my checked bag online that it would indicate checked baggage included at time of booking The flight was smooth and very pleasant I will definitely fly with Air Italy again in the near future

A little and modest airport in the capital of Saxony Apparently the politicians and the government members of the state of Saxony gave it the right to exist to be able to travel by plane directly to and from Dresden and avoiding using the bigger and better airport in Leipzig one hundert of miles away I wonder if this airport is profitable at all Any how it is very clean and clear and it is the best way to get to Dresden from outside east part of Germany Airport staff seems to be much more bored then engaged

Love John Wayne Airport it is close and convenient to the I and everything in southern California It is a lot easier to get in and out of than LAX and so much more modern Flew from here to Portland recently and going through security and checking in the bags was a breeze

Leipzig is a wonderful city but difficult to reach from the UK Flew from Manchester via Dusseldorf The airport is huge but seemingly deserted for much of the time though most facilities are there There is a long but under cover walk to the railway station to catch the hourly connection into the city euro Here lies the problem There was no indication as to which platform the train departed it was No nor were there any staff to ask Eventually with the help of several other bemused travellers we worked out the ticket machine and the train eventually arrived A great little airport with friendly staff but for international travellers the rail connection into the city needs a bit more working out

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

My husband and I traveled to Yellowknife for a day The main reason was that we wanted to visit Buffalo Airways Canadian North were fantastic Both services on time and on the way back to Edmonton we were lucky enough to travel on a Combi which was fantastic The crew on the way home made us feel so welcome They were efficient and very pleasant Great breakfast on the way up and a good dinner on the way back If only they were a bit closer to our home in Australia We would be more than happy to travel with Canadian North any time A great experience

Lovely small airport with one of the best views of any Ive ever visited About km from the town but generally one plane at a time so queues transport etc not really an issue Great coffee bar go upstairs for views to die for coffee is also good Planes can go early and beware of the winds when leaving Sympathetically installed to harmonise with landscape as much as an airport can Still need to pay in cash a departure tax about GB Pounds Also dont carry fresh food in hand luggage even if on an internal flight it will be confiscated on arrival due to some strange Argentinean regulations

Functioning but nonair conditioned air bridge to terminal Terminal building is easy to navigate and path clearly leads after heading down escalator to baggage pickup Baggage arrives after minimal waiting time of minutes Many people in terminal besides passengers and employees Mainly porters Everyone appears to know everyone else so I guess that security is not an issue Inside and outside terminal many drivers call out offering lifts in carsvans heading to Gorontalo city as airport is to hour from regional capital Fares are negotiable but is the norm Bules may pay more Toilets ATMs and lower end eating facilities as well as souvenir stalls are easily accessible Forget having a drink

A great little regional airport located right on the edge of the coast whose baggage reclaim passport control and lounge are all currently being refurbished and expanded The airport is clean and tidy and has a delightful caferestaurant downstairs before security as well as a great little shop selling local artisan products Check in can be slow as there are no selfservice checkin facilities Note that once you go past security facilities are currently fairly scant small bar area and no shops

If you dont need to go to Denver I recommend COS as the best option for going to Colorado Small but not too small clean efficient quick and centrally located to most points in Colorado Good quick car rentals I use it routinely to go to Pueblo and Denver Yes Denver as it can be more convenient and faster to get to a lot of places especially in south Denver Remember Denver airport is miles east and an expensive toll road from many points in Denver Also traffic is very congested in Denver but only moderately so in Colorado Springs Only problem I have is that most often but not always the cheaper fares are into and out of Denver
Pleasant short flight Plane was clean and on time Boarding was efficient Staff cheerful Very convenient to reach other Caribbean islands Will fly with them again

The airport has a quick checkin counter right outside where you arrive with the taxi This led to a checkin time for our Delta flight including one checked in luggage of just minutes after I got out of the taxi Security was fast too never experienced such a comfortable on boarding on any flight

Check in at San Andres had to be done at the airport since I had a bag to drop off the line was very long so I waited about minutes Since there are no drinks or snacks available for sale on the plane I bought some stuff at the airport to bring along on the plane Flight back to Bogota was quite smooth quiet and easy I flew back on the same plane that had brought me to San Andres Nothing to complain about Cheap option to San Andres and very efficient

I used to live in Albany and have used this airport many times Albany is a really nice regional airport It is very close to the Interstate The standard parking is extremely convenient across an indoor footbridge no shuttles The airport is physically very appealing and flow through checkin to the gates is generally smooth Same on the return also note that rental car stuff seems to be a convenient arrangement as well ALB is as close to get there at the last minute and be OK as any these days B terminal is the nicest Of course this is a regional airport without many of the amenities of a large one The coffee shop and barrestaurant are better than most though I now live in LA and have a much greater hassle Burbank airport seems similar in size to Albany but Albany is much much nicer

Have flown with Air Canada many times and have always had a good experience Our last trip was to Florence via Zurich Flights LX out and LX in No issues whatsoever Check in was smooth boarding in Toronto was about the easiest we have experienced in a while seats were fine service was good The only minor issue was that the seatback in the seatback in front of me was broken somehow and I couldnt put the tray back easily Also whats with offering WiFi but only to Aeroplan members of a certain level I find that annoying Other that that everything was good

New nice and clean This is the way I found this airport services are quite good even if restaurants bars and services in general could be improved But this is a recent airport and the overall experience has been positive maybe in the future it will earn some more stars

I hope Boutique Air continues this service to altoona I have been able to get my mother who lives in Altoona back and forth to Pittsburgh for medical treatment and advanced care she needs The drive to Pittsburgh is atrocious and I hope boutique continues this route for a very long time A total life saver and an awesome experience Out of about flights i have taken only have been delayed and very short about minutes or so Their customer service is outstanding and always so friendly

Like many airports food and drinks are much too expensive I do therefore I also do not want to buy water It is not allowed to take bottled water through customs so most airports have free tap drinking water Also this airport But they are all disconnected I find this outrageous To have access to drinking water is a right

Departure from Memphis The airport was ok I regard it as the best airport I experienced during my trip much better than Newark EWR and better than Chicago OHare ORD The stores and restaurants was plentiful but the airport is quite small The staff was friendly and efficient It was also quite clean much better than the other airports I passed through this trip in the USA It was easy to navigate through too Many small airports are better than their reputation

Because LH flights from FDHCGN are now to FRA only and at inconvenient times followed by connections to CGN by train I elected to fly InterSky instead Very clean aircraft and professional service throughout But for an Economy one way ticket price of they could surely provide at least a free cup of coffee Poor value everything else fine

To get in from the street you must undergo luggage scan first as theres no entry hall To get out onto the tarmac and into your plane note well that theres no queue space the departure lounge seats are right by the exit gate doors Our flight was announced at gate N there are only gates but after minutes delay moved to gate then to gate for people with much luggage for a flight with first come first served seats The hostesses tried to get people to form queue lines in vain so embarkation was a free for all Shocking treatment for an international airport Aside from that the setting is very pleasant

Boarded by airbridge on an AN with very good condition crew was very friendly Legroom was plenty and seat was very comfortable We departed on time Soon after departure they offer free coffee and water and buy food from a menu Captain made announcements of the flight path We had a great experience with them

Tontouta is a fairly basic international airport There are no skybridges so on arrival you descend the stairs and cross the tarmac to the single terminal and vice versa on departure Customs and immigration are fairly straightforward although a little bit of French will help The airport is a long way from Noumea so it is best to arrange a transfer with your hotel pre booking before you leave is the best Arc en ciel was the best company we thought Heading back out is always a nightmare at Tontouta there is no order for anything Customs is always straightforward when departing Only a small duty free on the other side and only cafe not much to do There are no tv screens or monitors for the flights You just have to rely on the French announcements and a piece of paper at the gate Overall was a good experience and a very good airport for a small tropical island
Iloilo Airport is one of the best and nicest airports that Ive seen Shopping store and a number of restaurants and coffee shops are also available Really amazing

This airport is well organized and easy to navigate its become one of my favorite airports in the world On this trip JFKSFOTPE I flew into and also left from Terminal One recently renovated attractive and spacious It also contains quite a few spaces for relaxation plus many restaurants and shops On arrival my bag arrived before I did On departure I checked in at the Interational Terminal which is connected to Terminal One Going through security at International was fast and easy The only negative was that several of the restaurants in Terminal One were closed in the evening

My family and I were due to travel with Phuket airlines in July this year Gatwick Bangkok In January I started to get concerned with the number of cancellations and late flights I then discovered the Skytrax site and am extremely grateful to all of you who have posted comments In January I re booked with Thai Airlines with whom we have previously travelled it appears to be an extra expense well worth making

Its a small airport at an island abt km from Rijeka Checking in and out goes quite fast at our experience Some staff members in the shop are kind of grumpy Nevertheless we are very happy with this airport how they have arranged a hotel in Opatija for our group when our flight was cancelled all of a sudden in the evening Our flight company Transavia told some people to find and book by themselves a hotel but the airport arranged bus transport and a luxurious hotel so our compliments

I had booked this fare at a very discounted rate as I needed to travel back to BLR The check in experience was good I had arrived early and there was still time for check in to open so I was told to wait for mins before check in in my luggage Post that I had noticed that the inbound was delayed due to which the departure was also slightly delayed by mins The crew were welcoming and this flight was not completely full During boarding I had noticed that a lot of people had come with trolleys and they were told to check in their luggage which is good as a lot of folks come carrying big trolleys that just block the cabin overhead bins The flight tried to make time en route and landing in BLR was swift along with luggage retrieval One point to note here is that the seat pitch may be on the tighter side compared to other airlines but otherwise this was a good trip where the crew also distributed water bottles to everyone during boarding

I had a pleasant experience on my Teheran Mehrabad to Shiraz flight It was a little bumpy due to weather but a delicious packed snack and drink were served for the short flight All the crew were very friendly and are a credit to their airline The A EPIEG was clean with a decent seat pitch for my foot frame and I was given a row of seats to myself All in all a very nice company who charged a very reasonable for my one way ticket I wish Iran Air the very best with each new addition to their expanding fleet and this wont be the last time I fly Iran Air

Overall I find Guadalajara Airport to be quite user friendly with helpful staff a decent variety of restaurants cafes and shops Security lines are usually efficient and quick Terminals clean and plenty of seating space Several airline lounges and affordable ground transportation options to the city center and nearby areas One of the easiest Mexican airports to navigate
