Estonian Air TallinnCopenhagen June Flew Tallinn Copenhagen in flex class premium economy which means free meal and bar service kgs of luggage and flexibility to change tickets The food consisted of smoked salmon on a slice of bread a small but fresh salad and an appetizing Sacher cake Not too much but enough for the hr minute flight Swift boarding and disembarkation aircraft clean and fresh newspapers available friendly staff clear safety announcements over good audio system and interesting inflight magazine to while the time away Estonian Air is a small and pleasant regional airline

After reading some of the reviews here I was expecting a real hellscape but instead I found a functional if not very exceptional airport with no real issues for me beyond all the walking more about that later I was arriving from and returning to the US through Terminal using United Airlines traveling at what appeared to be busy times for arrival and departure Arrival was uneventful with a quick trip through immigration The terminal seemed well organized and signed ATMS will give you pounds Euros or dollars I was taking an express bus to Belfast which meant going through a labyrinth of covered walkways in the ground transportation area outside the terminaldespite being able fit and used to walking a lot at home this was more than what I wanted after an overnight flight and the signage could have been betterit was easy to get off track The ground transportation area looks like an former surface lot repurposed for shuttles long and shortdistance buses etc Some areas serve both terminals such as those for hotels while others are meant to serve Terminal or Regardless a lot of walking Ditto on departure Departure was easy and went quicklyimmigration and security didnt have much in the way of lines Security had less of the militant hurry up and wait I usually experience in the US and elsewhere There could have been better spaces for putting bags and gear back together after security but otherwise fine There was less in the way of shopping and food service than I expected If you live in a place that heavily taxes liquor you might find some values but otherwise the prices werent great though not as bad some airports Ive used The seating was adequate although it tended to be toward the end of the shopping area The currency exchange couldnt change my leftover pounds to dollars wo converting them to Euros which seemed ridiculous given that theres a nother country that uses Pounds on the island US Customs is available about hours before your flight There wasnt much of a line and I didnt have to go through security a second time I didnt know if this was because of Global Access but it meant I didnt have to give up my water yes they dont let you bring water through this checkpoint Immigration also was quick although it was easy to miss the path to Global Access The US terminal has an abbreviated set of shops and a caf so you can wait until your gate to buy water I didnt see a currency exchange or ATM The gates are posted once you pass customs and immigration The seating was adequate unless you were boarding a jumbo jet This was the one part of the airport where I saw moving walkways but the whole process of getting there involved a lot of walking The general tone of things was more businesslike than friendly which was fine with me Not a bad airport overall but it would be a lot better with less walking

BOSMKE I have flown to and from Mitchell countless times I grew up in Milwaukee and moved back here in June I agree with other reviewers that it is a clean friendly wellrun airport What stuck in my mind was how swiftly and well the baggage is handled I flew Southwest and sat fairly far forward in the cabin walked directly to the baggage claim area and by the time I arrived my baggage was already on the carousel This is something of a record in all of the flights I have experienced over the past few years at the other end is Copenhagen Kastrup in July where I waited close to minutes for the baggage to arrive with my own valise arriving some minutes later There is also a rapid bus to downtown with the stop now just outside the baggage claim area now that renovations of that area are completed There are also a couple of good Bartolotta restaurants on the concourses Piccolo Pizzeria and Nonna Bartolottas which I have enjoyed on previous departures All in all Mitchell is an excellent airport Now all they need is more nonstop flights
Great airport not many flights so no hassle From check in to take off minutes Car parking also free

Not a bad airport Flew out of Terminal A with American Airlines I thought Terminal B was nicer than Terminal A Plenty of places to eat and view the runway My only complaint was the longish wait at security Other than that San Jose is a very functional airport

This is a small but friendly airport The checkin area is not air conditioned and is hot Checkin was efficient immigration and security were efficient with hardly any queues In departures there were two food and drink outlets a dutyfree shop and several other shops Boarding was efficient

Northwest Arkansas Regional Airport may be the best smallmedium airport in the United States In spite of being a regional airport in a small state XNA has direct flights to New York DC San Francisco and LAX This unparalleled service is ideal for business travelers and those making connections to international flights Most of the planes that fly out of XNA are regional jets CRJ or Embraer but they fly to most of the countrys major hubs The ground services are also above and beyond what is typical of an airport this size with a large brewpub and highquality furnishings I am definitely impressed and would fly from XNA again

A small airport maybe or passengers a day I am guessing Fifteen flights a day AA to CLT and DFW DL to ATL And UA to DEN and IAH The plusses Fast From drop off to gate in maybe minutes max Friendly staff especially at TSA Small town helpfulness had a cell phone left on a plane returned to the check in desk before I got there to ask for lost and found Nice new departure hall and baggage claim Very airy with lots of light Low cost parking for friends picking me up The minuses The airfares They border on extortionate Many times cheaper to fly from MIA to Europe than to Shreveport And UA AA and DL always seem to have the exact same air fare The local chamber of commerce should work on that Concourses are dated Industrial carpeting remember that Looks like they have not been refreshed since the s Odd quirky amateur art and movie posters and house plants maybe a positive No discount carriers like Spirit Jet Blue Frontier or SWA No mainline jets just smallish regional planes

Terminal was fairly good Despite the bustling atmosphere the staff were efficient and helpful The terminal isnt very well organized but the clear signage made it easy to navigate The dutyfree area provided a good amount of choices the terminals facilities are old but clean and despite the usual rush of the terminal at the time I found a peaceful corner to relax before my flight Overall its not the best airport I have been to but it has a good potential for upgrades and enhancement and I can see them trying to achieve it

I was browsing airfares for a late November trip and I stumbled across a business class fare on JAL for much less than it usually sells for Approx USD for TorontoChicagoTokyoBangkok return YYZ ORD was on AA Considering I usually pay about for economy with my extra golf bag this seemed like a no brainer and I pulled the trigger on that fare the very next day That decision was the correct one Ive just returned from the trip which is an annual one and Ive never crossed half the globe and had it feel so easy A fully lie flat bed all the way except TorontoChicago and a completely private one at that The food was great the service was great the lounges were great check in priority and fast track immigration in TokyoBangkok It was as easy as travel can be Ive flown JAL in economy before and even then I thought it was a superior experience than our local option Air Canada which continues to disappoint every time I recall even in economy the seats were wider fewer total seats across instead of and the meals were better Well business exceeded expectations even after YouTube reviews had set them sky high I have no reservations about wholeheartedly recommending them If I were to nitpick and I was fully expecting it as everyone seems to mention it is that the cabin is kept too warm So I packed shorted and a tshirt for sleeping in It was manageable

We travelled to Dubrovnik out of season so unsure what it would be like during the summer season when it is significantly busier What we did experience was a very clean modern stateoftheart airport that has been built and designed to an excellent standard It feels premium and polished not something I expected if I am honest before setting of on our holiday Arrival was very simple walked off plane on to a beautiful bright glass airbridge and into modern terminal structure made of glass and metal Immigration was quick and efficient not overly friendly but not antagonistic either We were airside probably within minutes from leaving the plane There is only one shuttle that goes to the city and it meets each flight leaving half an hour after each flights arrival and the cost was reasonable On Departure the checkin hall is bright and airy and the checkin staff for BA were friendly and helpful Security was a breeze and staff seemed generally fine we were the only flight taking off that evening though so it was very quiet The departure area was clean and well organised there isnt a lot of shopping opportunities or much to do but it is a small airport so that wasnt expected Do be aware of the extortionate prices charged by cafs for water you can buy it cheaper in some of the dutyfree shops at more reasonable cost Also only minutes of free wifi stingy and charging for more in this day and age is deeply odd These niggles aside however overall quite impressed

The new Terminal at Birsa Munda Airport Ranchi is a welcome surprise for many Its a small but modern terminal with a few amenities that are actually not needed as the wait times are low due to low traffic You will find seats on both floors and few coffee shops to make your wait easier The airside is separated by tall glass panels and one can be entertained by watching the arriving departing planes Disembarkment and Boarding is done via the modern aerobridges that are truly of international standards Since it is a small airport the security checks and checkin process is very informal and the staff are courteous and helpful I always have pleasant experience in this small modern airport I wish there were more flights

Wonderful regional airline from Luebeck I had a chance to try this airline and the experience was quite comfortable Boarding procedure is in order and each passenger must disinfect hands The legspace is good and cabin is simple yet neat The crew were happy to engage with passengers and the best part was that they serve a small meal on each flight I really appreciate that and the meal was simple yet very tasty and filling You can even book a veggie meal while booking flight Beyond what LH can even offer on regional flights While deboarding they served caramel candies This experience with Lbeck Air took me back to old school days which I miss terribly in aviation world Keep up the standards and service because this will set you apart

Honeymooning in various resorts in Borneo so visited Kota Kinabalu several times during our trip Check in area busy and crowded and Air Asia check in process a bit confusing but staff very kindly helped us out Rest of airport very well laid out and signage very helpful with ample seating at boarding gates

My wife was carrying few items which were not allowed due to their oversize more than ml The officer obviously had to throw them away before she goes through the security I was very upset to know as these items were medicated and not readily available I called the airport to enquire about the items and was to know that the items were disposed off in the trash I again called today and able to talk to the relevant person He was very helpful and took the pains and advised the supervisor Within half an hour I was called by the Sergeant who break the news that they found both the items Obviously I was overjoyed and so grateful to the efforts made by the energetic and helpful staff at the Cork airport

This airport is old inefficiently designed lacking courteous employees more interested in chatting with each other Waited in a line ft long OUTSIDE I know Hawaii is nice but that tells you that the line was long prior to getting inside the terminal to go through security They are just lucky that people tolerate this in order to be in Hawaii I would have given less than a if the guy at Starbucks wasnt so great
Changes made for the World Cup have improved this airport from small and efficient to small and very slick New access to departures security is welcome

Flew Solomon Airlines from Brisbane to Honiara We boarded to be greeted by smiling attendants The flight was not too full so we had seats to ourselves Leg room was quite good IFE was just a screen panel lowered from the ceiling watched a movie The meal was lunch we had the beef and it was delicious Staff came around to check if we needed any more drinks throughout the flight

My wife and I had the most magnificent experience on Sunday th July when we took a scenic flight with Loch Lomond Seaplanes from Cameron House on Loch Lomond The pilot and staff were exemplary the take off and landing as smooth as operating on tarmac and the inflight commentary first class The day was perfect as we flew over Gare Loch Loch Long Holy Loch Loch Striven Kyles Of Bute Tighnabruaich Loch Fyne along the Crinan Canal and finally turned over the Gulf of Corryvreckan where we saw the infamous whirlpool I cannot praise the whole operation highly enough

Cant fault this airport at all the staff are very friendly helpful I found the experience of arrival departure stress free Its nice clean one of the friendliest airports I have ever been to on my holidays abroad

Bournemouth airport assistance staff gave my disabled fatherinlaw priority treatment right from precheckin to the aircraft entry ramp as did the security team It relieved us of much difficulty with the wheelchair security check and long walk from security to aircraft The staff members were super staying with us throughout Thankyou Bournemouth airport you are light years better than Heathrow for passenger convenience parking as well as disabled assistance and friendliness and we will recommend you to others and will actively select to fly from Bournemouth many times again

A short and very pleasant morning flight Efficient boarding airport is small nice seats Professional staff which served water and a sweet Very soft landing All in all a nice experience meeting again the high expectations for AegeanOlympic Air

Small airport with few services Long enough customs procedures and passport control if you land late in the evening when there is little staff on duty However it offers a good free wifi service also available outside the airside

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment

Barcelona BLA to Caracas CCS in Venezuela on a classic Boeing aircraft I experienced Conviasa to be quite nice to fly with Anyhow they do not offer much more than the average European nofrills carriers A costfree nonalcoholic drink was served on that short domestic flight the aircraft was clean and fine despite its age we departed BLA about minutes ahead schedule not every airline in Venezuela manages that Since the ticket costed me less than EUR I can call it a quite satisfying experience

HarareLondonHarare Originally booked flight on Friday which was cancelled Flights were punctual and staff friendly Old planes and no entertainment But being the only direct flight to Europe from Harare and with prices less then half of any other airline still OK for anybody wanting a cheap flight to London as long as one has the flexibility to cope with changes of schedule

Everything went smoothly on this short flight to Paro We flew a new plane with lovely grey leather seats seat pockets with metal springs it all just smelt new that was a bonus Crew friendly and accommodating So from Katmandu to Paro you need to have window seat on the left of the plane It was my most scenic commercial flight ever stunning views of the Himalayas and Mount Everest for over half the flight sit on the left ABC seats and then the remarkable descent into Paro airport landing at the prettiest airport I ever been to and I have travelled a fair bit Unless the flight in darkness your baggage lost or severe delay non of which happened for me I cannot see how this short flight could fail to impress A cheese roll and drink included Get to Bhutan on this flight

Swanky new recliner seats around Gate but only if you are under foot or over foot tall At the headrest was painfully positioned forcing my chin onto my chest Shame because everything else is brilliant

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

We recently flew business class New Delhi to Paro and Paro to Bangkok with Druk Air They are a fantastic little airline being only one of two airlines serving Bhutan We were on a trip via Delhi to Paro for nights and then onto Bangkok Both flights on time lounges were shared and and of a good standard Both flights considering Paro being one of the worlds most difficult airports to land in were flawless by the flight deck some amazing views en route and pointed out by the crew Food and beverage were of a high standard and plentiful for hour flights combined with excellent service from very professional and and delightful Bhutanese crew Would certainly use again Only point out being there is no Entertainment or wifi but the views en route you dont need it

Burbank provides a convenient and easy alternative to LAX although the departure hall in Terminal B is too small to accommodate more than flights at a time There were flights an MD a and CRJ regional jets boarding simultaneously and the small space and cramped conditions caused confusion and delayed boarding for everyone

Short one hour flights with Safarilink to Diani from Nairobi Wilson return A very pleasant way to reach the coast from Nairobi and much quicker overall than the JKIA Nairobi Airport to Mombasa route Drink and biscuit served Both airports were small indeed Diani is described as an airstrip

This airport is good but there is no wifi and check in desk is one There air two shops and one cafe The best thing is that there is an outdoor square and a fountain after passport control There are international gates The gates area is modern

Competent and efficient flights Delay in Geneva handled well captain came to boarding gate to explain Comfort seats had good leg room even on a A sandwich and drink served on each flight of just over an hour

The checkin staff was very helpful and I had a smooth checkin process I received an aisle seat in the exit row with loads of legroom However that is where the good part ends the aircraft was not very clean and the inflight service consists of a juice nuts and the thinnest bar of Cadbury Diary Milk chocolate you will ever see They did not seem to have any menu for purchase as well After spending hours in the Domestic Terminal at Male where nothing is available to purchase and then going through a hour flight with nothing to eat is not the best experience There is a single attendant on the flight who passes by once to hand out the food and once to take the trash The experience is certainly not comparable to domestic flights in Asia and a tad disappointing especially given the premium prices in Maldives The good thing is that the flight was absolutely on time

MIAT Mongolian Airlines from Berlin via Moscow Sheremetyevo to Ulaanbaatar Well over h queuing in TXL despite web checkin There was no separate line for baggage drop Long lines at the entrance to the hopelessly overcrowded departure lounge at the gate let to a delayed start Further nuisance in Moscow where pax were forced to leave the plane for passport control only to return into the same plane thereafter Not sure if the above is under MIAT control The actual flight was reasonably pleasant The ageing seemingly well looked after was filled to the last seat Crew was efficient but not overly friendly or extra hospitable The IFE was functional but the film selection rather limited and headset quality poor The seats were tight but not uncomfortable I found the food surprisingly decent and the drinks Austrian wine and Mongolian beer actually very good The crew offered soft drinks very frequently which I consider important on a hjourney Immigration in ULN was swift and friendly and put TXL to shame Return was direct from ULN to FRA h again on a full with similar onboard experience Overall I found the journey with MIAT quite ok but not worth raving about
The check in was smooth Signs in English are sufficient to direct the passengers The ambiance is great and its facilities are enough to give comfort to its passengers

Good checkin and boarding excellent lounge but a disappointing experience with an unfriendly and ignorant worker at the security check There were only a few passengers at the airport no queue at the checkin counter The lounge was impeccable with a friendly staff a very good choice of snacks drinks and reading material The only negative moment was in the priority security line despite that there were no passengers in the line right after am The worker who checked my passport and boarding pass sternly told me that next time she would not allow me to use the priority security line if I dont present my Silver Finnair Plus card The Priority Security note was boldly printed in a big font on my boarding pass which she was holding in her hand so Im afraid to think she could not read English RIX in general is a good airport but the management has to teach priority security line workers to read and understand at least two words in English Priority Security

I was here on a stopover on the way to Bangkok I didnt have too many problems and the terminal wasnt that crowded it was early morning Also free internet worked well which was helpful Staff seemed friendly though not really helpful The toilets were overcrowded and not clean Not many shops or restaurants that I saw Overall this airport is nothing to right home about but my experience wasnt that bad Qatar airways is a good airline and hopefully the new airport in Doha is better than Doha international
Thai smile offers convenient service through their app and self service at Suvarnabhumi Airport with staff support The time of flight is in time Staff gave service with hospitality

Friendly flight attendant who take care of the passengers efficiently Excellent flight but the cabin of the Dash needs a very serious refresh and more confortable seats The flight time was respected On the gate the employees of Air Canada Jazz offer a good service

Flights to Kefalonia from Athens Arrival smooth with reasonably quick bag delivery Departure less good I felt sorry for the people stuck in a long queue waiting to check in for their charter flight Olympic Air was fairly speedy Terminal facilities are basic at best One shopcafe before security The toilet facilities are dire Very poor signage in the airport domestic departure lane was closed with no instructions to join the long international queue and no gate information once through security However as there are only gates the guess was easy Such a shame that Greek islands have such poor airports for really wonderful places

Sydney Santiago via Auckland on Above average flight with an average meal very good crew and reasonable IFE selection However the abreast in economy is too tight The seats are too narrow and the aisles are tiny The meal trolley only just fits through The tray table is also very small On the return leg a passenger fell ill immediately after takeoff The crew managed this very well About hours into the flight it was determined that wed have to return to SCL The airline put us into hotels As a transit passenger through SCL the airline arranged to pay our reciprocity fee US to enter into Chile This was a long process over hour but at least they paid for it The airline wasnt able to arrange a single large bus to take us to the hotel at the last minute and so there was another long process about hours of getting all of us into separate mini buses The hotel was excellent and included free food Back to the airport this time in a big coach and a very long checkin process Our bags were checked through to SYD and we were advised wed been put onto a Qantas flight from AKL to SYD The flight was again reasonable good crew OK food definitely not up to Emirates standards and bathrooms kept clean Due to our delayed arrival into AKL we had to overnight there and again LAN had arranged a hotel meal and bus transfer for us Overall LAN managed this stressful situation which was out of their control quite well ensuring we had a place to rest and food to eat and made sure we all got to our final destinations My lower marks are for the standard and quantity of the food and the cramped seating that almost all operators of the have adopted

Stavanger airport Sola is a small airport like the one in Bergen and Trondheim Not many international flights but quite many domestic The terminal there is only one is years old but they have started to upgrade everything All in all a comfortable airport

Very nice small airport located outside Rzeszw easily accesible by the bus from the city center inside the airport was not busy during the time of travel took less than minutes to go through security A duty free shop and a bar available however a very good lounge is avaiable too at a very good price around PLN with very comfortable waiting area and very good selection of drinks and snacks Overall I recommend going from this airport

Small international airport International flights limited to a few charters from China Arrival hall domestic has only one conveyor belt which did not work on the day I arrived so luggage were brought in very swiftly by handcart Taxi and shuttle bus available to city center km away Domestic departure hall is adequate and departure gates have sufficient seating a coffee shop and wifi

Departing from Terminal Lots of space light and helpful signaling Security was well organized and relatively fast moving but the queue was huge Actually three queues one for facial ID one for carryon security checks and the final one for passport control The automatic passport check did not work for us maybe because we had not come to the country through this airport and there were moments of confusion among us and the supervisor The terminal itself is a bit aseptic Impersonal and way too long Food options could be better And a bit of color or additional greenery would have been great

Surabaya is my hometown airport I was really happy when Terminal opened but I think they could improve the facilities such as food and stores Surabaya is a simple airport the terminal is quite clean toilets huge spacious check in and waiting room I spend a lot of time here but I have never used the WiFi so I dont know about the speed Airport staff are attentive

Amazing service on this airline and consistently great as we flew a few times with them On time check in precision boarding and very friendly through out the whole trip even when it gets bumpy We will fly with Asiana Airlines again as this was the best service compared to Qantas Emirates Air France and SAS that we also used Thank you so much for looking after us on board

Aborted take off because of approaching storm Excellent safe service to safe guard passengers Fantastic airline thank you We sat on the tarmac in the plane until clear to take off Pilot flew around bad weather to give us smooth flight
It is clean modern and spacious Employees are friendly and helpful Goods in the shops are bountiful and various Signposts are clear WiFi connection is stable
On my flight from Muscat to London WY I was seated on J seat The cabin crew by the name of Kim was very courteous smiling and helpful She was very calm and polite to passengers

Koh Samui Airport is a lovely little airport and probably the most attractive airport I have ever travelled through Check in seemed to be very efficient and no long queues There is a large number of shops and restaurants available outside after you have checked in Toilets were ok and reasonably clean but quite a lot of insects buzzing around As many airport in Thailand they mix passengers on domestic flights through different parts of the airport and therefore passengers with international departures clear immigration and board the flight through a different gate to the domestic passengers on the same flight Seems a bit odd but they have a system and it works

This is a brand new terminal that opened just about nine months ago It is very well designed spacious light filled and comfortable with a limited yet sufficient number of traveler facilities Immigration both coming in and departing was quick and easy My only gripe is with the terminal and gate announcement system Every announcement in the airport even at the gate was totally garbled and not understandable There is something horribly wrong with the announcement system which really needs some immediate attention

Having travelled to and from Vnukovo twice both times flying on German Wings from Berlin it is an infinitely better introduction to Moscow than Sheremetyevo Immigration on the way in was as foreigner friendly as anywhere else in Russia huge lines officious officers scrutinising every last page of your passport and visa but everything else is great The new international terminal is very modern lots of glass On departure Germanwings flights depart from a gate area in the depths of the basement or so it seems but facilities including duty free and food are good if expensive by Russian standards There is a branch of SberBank in arrivals but the rates are awful so try not to change too much here just enough to get into the city centre As for travel to Moscow the best bet is the shared taxi transit van to Yugo Zapadnaya metro and then take the metro These services leave from just outside the domestic terminal right next to the international one

I will like to thank entire staff of Air Asia We were on family vacation with my year old child and got amazing cooperation Without any hassle we could book seats and the entire journey was enjoyable Will like to be thankful to the pilots as the landing on all the flights was smooth I paid my gratitude to the staff personally too

Changi Airport looking dated but the SQ lounge was outstanding Big working areas excellent shower facilities nice bar plenty of good tasting food spotlessly clean good atmosphere The business class seat lounging and sleeping positions are not comfortable and the seats controls did not work quickly Difficult to use power outlets complicated storage areas sleeping in a diagonal position with very small foothole The IFE feels old with limited choice No live TV Worst deterioration when compared to their past offering was the food beverages Limited choice main course tasted bland and premium drinks served in small sodatype glasses no dining on demand Luckily the complimentary wifi worked well

I dont ever leave reviews but wanted to for the first of my flights with SAS I had a great time with this airline on flights over a long weekend trip The first flight from Heathrow to Copenhagen really stood out to me The two air stewardsesses were amazing and stood out as caring and genuinely interested A real asset to the airline The food on this first flight would not be my first choice but once i started eating it i was very happy Cant fault SAS on any of the flights They were on time and good flights Highly recommended

A typical Ryanair airport Small and miles from anywhere although perhaps suitable for the Alps and skiing access or unless you have relatives nearby However it meant that from the plane to the car hire desk was about metres and we were on our way less than minutes after landing If you need a train the station is literally metres from the terminal door Its not an architectural gem the seating is limited and hard but it has a cafe and a shop and its efficient and has what you need The staff were friendly and allowed us to board first on our return to the UK as my wife had a broken hand in plaster As long as the plane is on time it does the job well

Well where to start Simple straight forward helpful staff at Gatwick They given the passes for the lounge and fast track security The lounge was fairly quiet and so was security mind you it was am on a Monday morning Boarding was quick and once in the seat the service was first class with a team of crew looking after the Premier Economy cabin while waiting we were offered Sparkling wine or Orange Juice Once we had reached cruising height we had the first drinks service and our order for lunch was taken The choices been Sausage and Mash Thai Green Chicken Curry and rice and a Veggie option After lunch which was about hours into the flight and we had another drinks service The Cabin Service Manager then announced that should anyone want more drinks please ring the call bell We had the duty free trolley pass though the cabin about minutes from landing we were served a tea meal of sandwiches scones jam and a drink of our choice You also have a pillow and blanket bottle of water on both legs and you are given amenity kit on the outward leg to use on both legs The head phones are collected at the end of both legs Next thing we knew we were starting our descent into Cancun The return flight was the same format but the food was local sourced but was a choice of beef stew and mash Chicken and Potatoes or the Veggie Option The food was tasty and afterwards the cabin lights were dimmed to allow people to sleep Any drinks etc were ordered from your seat by ringing the call bell We did have a duty free trolley service whilst waiting for the hot meal About minutes before landing we had a breakfast service of Omelette Tomato and Hash Brown which was very nice Next thing we were on finals to land at Gatwick I think the TUI premier economy product is very good value for money the inflight entertainment is very good and has a good range of films TV games music Would I travel Premier Economy again Yes

Not that much leg room If you are over cm tall you will be bashing your kneecaps but otherwise the seat is pretty comfortable The services from the cabin crew were friendly and efficient Due to Covid restrictions no snack was served on this flight There is no screen in the seats so you must supply your own inflight entertainment Would definitely use the airline again as their routes are handy and they were punctual

MAO is an old airport far away from the city but with good and cheap connections They have a lot of security food is expensive so come prepared a simple burger will cost you dollars or so and internet dollars one hour Tourist information center is very friendly and helpful

I recently flew with Aeromexico for the first time with my husband and year old son and we had an exceptional experience From checking in to landing the customer service was topnotch The flight attendants were attentive and kind We were incredibly surprised by the meal we got when we were expecting just a snack It consisted of yogurt fruit cocktail eggs with bacon and vegetables or waffles accompanied by a drink and bread On our return flight we enjoyed a satisfying pasta dinner meal The flight entertainment system was also impressive offering a wide selection of new movies TV series cartoons and music We appreciated the free earphones which allowed us to enjoy the entertainment options without disturbance The aircrafts cleanliness was notable with spotless bathrooms and a well maintained cabin Overall our experience with Aeromexico was outstanding and we would highly recommend them to anyone We look forward to flying with them again in the future

SVOSVXHEL Arrived mid morning from Moscow on domestic flight There seem to be a good number of piers to allow access to the terminal building Airport in the middle of being fully upgraded with building work everywhere estimated to be finished some time in Arrival was via various corridors that would not normally see passengers but the luggage was on the belt when we got there and then out into Arrivals Airport not that busy so things seemed to run OK Early morning Checkin for departure required basic suitcase scanning before Checkin which seemed a little slow Security Scanning perfunctory no need to get laptops out and shoes off with minimal queuing Facilities in Departure Lounge limited but sufficient Free WiFi available which was OK Boarding directly via pier smooth

Great little airport somewhat bizzare security arrangements which seem to depend on who you are or who you are with but really clean and with a nice cafe and seating while you wait the far side of passport control Duty Free expensive and poor selection

I was on an Aer Lingus flight operated by Cityjet My flight was late due to weather in London and my original flight got cancelled but I got put onto a flight minutes later The flight itself was OK The seats on this little Avro are very cramped Cityjet uses a configuration instead of the standard This makes the seats very thin and leaves you with not much room The inflight catering was provided by Aer Lingus and featured a buy on board service As this was a morning flight I opted for a Hot chocolate and some shortbread and for this was decently priced But the highlight of this flight was well and truly the Avro RJ which I wanted to fly on before they all get retired and I am very pleased I did It is a unique experience and I would recommend for any aviation fans to try this flight as it is relatively cheap and the Avro is an absolute joy

Good small airport for a short transit Not as big as NRT which makes it not as daunting Small shopping selection but pretty good food Efficient staff and quick security measures makes transit quite painless

Very small but clean and cozy airport with only gates Going through the passport control and customs was a breeze I do agree with the previous comments about taxis There is no public transportation from the airport to the city so unless someone is picking you up or youre picking up a rental youre forced to take a cab which will routinely rip you off and not even turn on the meter For a minute ride I was charged marks currently USD If you can arrange some type of transportation other than the taxi my advice is to do so

Very nice and comfortable Estonian Air flight from Copenhagen to Vilnius via Tallinn crew friendly and smiling Even if Tallinn airport is very small connection time was too tight Smaller aircraft to Vilnius but comfortable For reasons unknown there were no sales on this h min flight A good experience for the price and safety was taken seriously
The airport is very small however the staff provided a very good service We went through the airport very quickly

This was my nd flight to FLL in months after a year absence This review is limited to Terminal Arrival was at the A Concourse gates which mean a rather long connectors to the BC concourses common area One huge advantage of FLL airport over the others is the car rental facility which is directly across the airport roadway from the terminal The renovated terminal is spacious brightly lit and has a central TSA Entry point for all concourses Each concourse offers dining options a plenty For Christmas Day travel there was enough seating for all with power ports and USB ports at each gate The bathrooms are very clean and maintained at regular intervals Security was a breeze with no wait time for the TSAPre checkpoints WiFi was easy to connect too and blazing fast The refurbished Terminal is a joy to travel through

Its been years since I traveled through Terminal The refurbished Terminal is a world class modern airport terminal It is spacious brightly lit with plenty of seating and dining options aplenty There are oodles of power ports and USB ports at the gates however some of the power ports were not working Bathrooms are very clean The concourses are wide and directions easy to follow to baggage claim Security was a breeze with no wait time for the TSAPre checkpoints WiFi was easy to connect too and blazing fast The refurbished terminal is a significant upgrade to the old terminal

This place is clean and efficient Lots of room and well staffed airport Both the internationaldomestic terminal and the USA pre clearance terminals are modern and the lines are usually moving very quickly US Customs is exceptionally efficient and considering the volume of persons traveling the process is smooth and the staff is excellent and friendly US citizens get to experience an even smoother passage with the automated terminals Just make sure you follow all the rules because some of them might seem unnecessary but if you have had a big win at the casino declare it or loose it after a night in a terrible local lock up and a visit to a magistrate back in town the next day if it is not a Friday

One of the best flights I have been on between Oslo and Billund I didnt know that this kind of service still exsisted Excellent food and service I know it cost a bit more but it is well spent money I do recommend this airline which operates flights on behalf of British Airways

Ive been to Wroclaw Airport times Its fast convenient beautiful airport doesnt matter if it is arrival or departure The variety of shops and restaurants is adequate and the prices are normal airport prices A very clean terminal that is one of the prettiest terminals Ive been to Toilets are very clean Only problem is absence of air conditioning in buses between terminal and airplane its very disappointing and uncomfortable in summer

Easy check in at Gatwick They use the club rooms lounge which was fine Prompt boarding and beverage served One hour delay managed well by crew who served further drinks and snacks During flight beverage good There is a strong emphasis on fish in meals It was fine I just dont like fish Slept well on lie flat mattress topper was very good Breakfast good their orange juice was excellent Easy disembarking and luggage off quickly

ANA might not be the cheapest airline but every time I fly with them I conclude that the premium is worth it This was my tenth flight with ANA and like all the other flights it was a good experience Takeoff and landing were smooth and on time The cabin attendants and airport staff are the best out of all the airlines I have experienced I just wish for the snack before arrival in the paper box to be of better quality I knew what I was in for so I passed on it this time If they scrap it altogether that would be fine as well I could also be happy with more bags of senbei instead The in flight wifi is also quite weak Its hard to load videos The most you can do is some light web browsing and email

Arrival at Maputo Airport is via air stairs to the ramp to the terminal There is no covering that I could see in the event of rain Inside the arrival area is what seems to be a mass of confusion at the desk where one collects his visa unless you are one of those coming from a country not requiring a visa Following issuance of the visa one then has to clear immigration to have an entry stamp put in hisher passport This is a slow procedure and one is frequently asked where one will be staying so best to keep a copy of your hotel confirmation with you Customs is simple enough where all baggage is screened in an xray machine Following this you are finished and can exit the terminal Note that there is presently no air conditioning in the terminal and it can be hot Also lighting is rather limited Departure is likewise slow I arrived hours before my flight time and had to sit and wait almost hour for the counter to open Again the terminal lacks air conditioning the story being that the system is under repair Following check in one takes an escalator to an upper floor where one processes through immigration which oddly enough is a fairly fast process The departure area has a few shops and some airline lounges but is otherwise fairly devoid of anything Flights are called over a loudspeaker system and one descends again to the ground level and proceeds out of the building across the tarmac to hisher plane The very worst part of utilizing Maputo Airport is the arrival where it seems that confusion reigns mostly due to the matter of issuance of a visa and having it applied to ones passport This occurs even if one has acquired the previsa on line and involves paying the fee for issuance of the visa Note the visa fee can be paid by cash or credit card Visa Master Card only If you have secured the online previsa be sure to bring a print out of it to show to the visa issuing clerks There are some countries that do not require a visa and apparently this number has just been expanded although the expansion has yet to be implemented as of this writing If you have not secured a previsa and are from a country that requires a visa you can be delayed by this process for as much as hours In my case I asked the tour company with which I arranged my bookings and tours in Mozambique to arrange a meet and assist service for both arrival and departure at Maputo Airport This was a good investment and I tipped to man who assisted me with US I highly recommend this type of service for a firsttime visitor

During the midnight of rdth of June during a transit flight I had the displeasure of dealing with a poorly coordinated security team Under normal circumstances I would highly recommend this airport as I have traveled through it before To put things in context I was on a transit trip that had a hour period between the departure of the arrival from the earlier destination and the departure of the subsequent flight Given the time constraint one would imagine there to be a better overall coordination among the staff There was particularly poor coordination between those who worked at security checks and those at passport control The staff at security checks not only allowed over people to cut through the long queue sporadically without any consequence or moderation they also performed unnecessary performative passport checks granted we had already done actual complete passport around meters earlier A lot of the questions asked seemed performative as well it seemed as if they were more interested in it the appearance of doing their job while simultaneously doing it at a slow pace without maintaining any sense of order Thankfully it did not cost me the flight but I would urge there to be better coordination in the future as Im fully aware from previous experience that the staff at the airport can do better

St Thomas to St Croix We purchased tickets on Seaborne as part of a family Thanksgiving celebration scheduled for Nov My parents have several medical issues availability of medical facilities are a requirement wherever they travel The Virgin Islands were devastated by Hurricanes Irma and Maria in September My personal home was severely damaged our island was destroyed and most importantly the medical facilities and electrical systems were destroyed I requested refunds of travel tickets from both American and Seaborne for the same reasons American refunded my parents tickets within hours Seaborne however has refused to do so citing a provision that it was not their fault and therefore they will offer a yr rebooking option only We are prohibited from even selling the tickets locally to someone else who could use them Needless to say this is not acceptable We are leaving the island we will never be coming back and neither will my parents Seaborne had an opportunity to rise above petty policy provisions and provide for a base of enthusiastic customer support and they have squandered it The adage of a satisfied customer tells people a dissatisfied customer tells holds true in this case I urge any traveler to the area of the USVI who wishes to travel between the islands to use alternate travel modes there are plenty

Avoid this airport if you have a wheelchair I travelled through Oslo airport with my year old disabled mother yesterday We flew in collected our suitcases and stood in line to recheck our bags on a British airline We had three hours and plenty of time to check in First the woman at the checkin was told by someone in Cargo that they wanted a photo of the battery Then they asked for some obscure information about the battery that we did not have and told us we could not fly unless we somehow produced a paper with the information My mother has been disabled for years and has flown several hundred times on flights in Europe and the USA with the same model of wheelchair she still uses Its a well known brand We have only ever been asked for the weight and dimensions of her wheelchair and the type of battery dry cell and how it turns off by key After standing there for an hour and a half another checkin person finally found some information online and we were told to go as quickly as possible to the gate I asked for help getting there as it was minutes before the boarding time I pleaded with the checkin person to get our suitcases on board they had been taken off the plane half way through this incident No help was given as we had to negotiate security the length of the airport and passport control by ourselves There was no time to use a disabled toilet which we knew from our trip through Oslo a week earlier had a broken seat and was dangerous which resulted in my mother not being able to use a toilet for hours she cant walk to use the ones on the plane This was a nightmare experience which only got worse when we landed at the next airport

It is extremely difficult to find your way around the airport due to lack of signages and there is no staff to help you They could have added direction signages every few meters Because of absence of signs You panic as you do not know where to go Toilets are very few Seating is very less Confused pax are milling about every where Lounges are not in the proper convenient places Duty free shopping is very limited and more expensive than even in other cities of Europe Dont expect to get any good duty free deal here

Staff did not care about customer comfort Had another passenger from the front of the plane come all the way to my seat at the back to chat with their friend while standing in the aisle for mins blocking other passengers going to the toilet Had to confront that same person to remove there elbow off my head rest one time and then again an hour later when they did the same thing Staff passed that person multiple times and said nothing Honestly the worst airline Ive flown with so far

This has to be the most inefficient airport Ive experienced Countless security checks Very limited seating which resulted in having to sit on the floor The cigarette smell looms everywhere in the airport

The airport customs are very long over an hour long and it is very hot The departure was the worse when you arrive everything is fine until you get to security they take again over an hour Once you get into the airport has some small shops barely any seats and the floor is dirty old carpet Their is a nice outside plane spotting area though No WiFi Though this place sucks you cant avoid it if you want to go to Turks and Caicos because its the only international airport on the island

First of all the washrooms are junk not at all clean no hygiene Lounge is also not satisfactory chairs are bad normal pvt bus stand is better than this you will loose your appetite once you get to know the price of edibles In my opinion Cochin airport is far far better

I enjoy my visits thoroughly but the airport is quite tacky and very small The fact that you have to walk across the tarmac from the aircraft can be a pain for those who have a disability or are travelling with children etc but it makes for an authentic touch They have recently added a Burger King but the shops are very limited and if you are on a night flight all shops are closed The staff need to improve their customer service skills as they rarely smile and appear quite serious and some can be quite abrupt They need to some how stop the hustlers from crowding the visitors as they exit the airport trying to make a quick buck as it can be quite intimidating for first timers to the country but once you get through all this you almost instantly forget and enjoy your vacation surroundings

Ashgabat to Birmingham This was a last minute booking due to a business meeting back in the UK The best way to describe the airline is Disorganised Ground staff are surly and dont appear to know what is going on and the flight crew are not a lot better I flew on a which was worn and dirty Only fare paying passengers in Business Class with flight attendants but almost impossible to get their attention There were however another complete crew flying in Business to fly the plane back Ignorant and arrogant is the only way to describe them Food inedible No alcohol No inflight entertainment Crew constantly going to the toilet to smoke Cockpit door left open with the Pilot and Co Pilot smoking When we landed the flight attendants werent even strapped into their seats No pre landing checks made I am amazed that this airline is allowed into UK airspace

I had a flight with Peruvian airline from Cusco to Lima in May traveling with my oneyearold son and two international flights starting from Lima I had bought the tickets separately each from the respective airline directly with fivehour breathing room in Lima to catch my international flight Long story short Peruvian airline was four hours late They refused to send me with LATAM that had several flights from Cusco They lied about the extent they were going to be late And when I asked them to return my luggage so I could buy a ticket with LATAM they all went to lunch and didnt return for another hours On top of that the staff was very rude and verbally aggressive Needless to say I missed my flight and buying a new ticket last minute plus an overnight hotel etc cost me over USD Peruvian airline keeps saying its not their responsibility Big warning about this airline One of the worst if not the worst on the planet

I recently flew with Batik Air and had a very disappointing experience I initially booked my flight assuming I could easily manage my baggage but I was charged per kilo for my luggage on the first leg of my journey When I tried to add a bag for my upcoming flight the system failed to recognize my return booking The lack of transparency and efficiency is frustrating and unacceptable for an airline that markets itself as customerfriendly I urge others to be cautious when booking with Batik Air as their baggage policies seem designed to catch you off guard and extract additional fees This experience has left a sour taste and I will think twice before considering this airline again

Not a good impression on entering Laos through Luang Prabang airport On the flight you are given some forms You queue in the visa on arrival line then you are told you should get another form from a desk in a corner with no information You queue again in the visa on arrival You pay inflated prices in Thai Baht unless you happen to carry dollars Then you queue again in another line with the first form you completed which has same info as second Staff were grumpy Feels very bureaucratic

I booked with my husband FOR OUR vacation expecting us to be at least seated close to each other but we were seated four rows apart You can choose your seats by logging on hours in advance which I did and everything was booked up besides seats that I had to pay extra for I called their customer service and I was told if I wanted better seats I would have to pay Plus they make you pay for every single beer or food item for at least per beer and have no screens or internet Completely disgusted and I will never fly WestJet again

Tiny airport stuck in the dark ages No night landing and the only flight into the airport regularly gets cancelled Very gloomy place to be stuck in with little information One shop one cafe selling expired packaged food beware and one TV set You simply walk between the terminal and the plane Baggage arrival is simply a large hall with a conveyor belt Best left for passing through this place

The airport is clean and easy to go the price for the drop off is high as GBP And the security staff need to be educated to dealing with passenger Some are friendly but some are very rude and abusive They think to have all the power of the police

First time being in Tasmania for a business trip I was first surprised by the tiny size of the airport There were no boarding bridges all you have to do is to walk across a bunch of walkways and that leads you into a corridor where they have dogs detecting food and anything that are not allowed to bring into TAS Then you will see the parking lot like meters ahead of you its that tiny All I know if that the Latte they offered there were pretty good There are several gift shops that sell a large variety of gifts snacks and books to read on your ride Something I found interesting is that the airplanes are not being pushbacked rather they park at sort of a degree angle to the terminal and when they are ready to depart they simply turn out onto the taxiway on their own power One thing I really disliked about this airport is that the wifi there are intermittent and the speed is the type that lags even when watching videos at p resolution Overall satisfactory experience and I would recommend it

Main airport to Philippines terminals squeezed round runways Terminal International Arrivals has airbridges and a shortish walk to Passport Control Important to get your eTravel declaration done before passport control usual baggage reclaim and customs check before getting out of the airport Very busy arrivals area with many taxi offering their services and congested parking directly opposite Terminal is mainly Philippine Airlines with a domestic and international section You have to show your passport and ticketBoarding pass to get into the terminal and get all your bags scanned Checkin Desks and a few other amenities before going through security The Departures Lounge is for domestic flights and separate to the International one A small selection of cafe and similar and gatesair bridges Limited seating means it can get very busy if a few flights go at a similar time There is patchy WiFi

Niki is no low cost airline anymore if it ever was one Flights between large European cities cost up to and more also my flight from VIE to FCO was not cheap but Nikis service is not that good The only thing Niki offers you compared to other airlines is a cold and ugly sandwich plus a soft drink but it is not worth the price However the ground staff which in fact were staff from the airport were experienced and friendly Despite that the cabin crew was unkind and sloppy and their englishskills had been disastrous The IFE was made up of a safety video and a map not more

Small but new building Departure checkin can be chaotic especially on routes within Africa but the international departure gate is spacious Note there are no services duty free or refreshments airside Arrival hyperstrict security Prepare for long delays and numerous passport finger print and visa checks Unlike other African airports however there is no hassle once you get out of the secure area There are not many taxis available and most are unmarked It is assumed that a foreigner will have already arranged for a drive The ride to the city centre is a quick minutes on a new highway

My husband and I were planning on spending Christmas with family in Paris Flight from Tampa was h late We had a h flight from Tampa to Frankfurt Missed our connection to Paris by a few minutes The security at Frankfurt was slow and not friendly and nothing was set up so we could catch our connection though we were told the plane would be held on We had received an email with options of other connections to Paris one was h later and the other was h later than original time That would have been fine However we went to Customer Service Lufthansa and we were told we were booked for a flight in h We were only given a coupon to eat in Frankfurt airport as compensation And we were not upgraded We spent Christmas Eve stuck in an airport for h and got in Paris at pm instead of pm originally We were awake for h when flying to Paris takes to hours We were extremely disappointed

Less than hours before the flight they moved the flight hours earlier from to which really inconvenienced me since I had plans for the morning before my departure I specifically booked this flight because of the time it was scheduled to fly although there were earlier flights available I have never experience a situation where a flight is moved earlier but also on such a short notice it is just ridiculous I arrived earlier at the airport Boarding started minutes after the plane was scheduled to depart And in the end the take off was delayed for hours

Last minute round from Nice to Rome My departure flight was delayed hrs with no information or an estimated departure time On my return from Rome again we were over hrs delayed with no information whatsoever standing in line at the empty boarding gate Since the airline never updated we had no idea whether we could leave the gate to get refreshments To add insult to injury the only company representative kept telling lies we were told several times that the plane was on the ground but since as the airport was busy there was no bus to pick us up The price was only marginally lower than easyjet I only took that flight because I could get to Rome earlier supposedly

Very bad experience I faced in Reunion hour flight delay No one responsible in airport No proper food No proper lounge No proper WiFi Airport shopping is very costly Ground staff dont answer a single question And in between they dont know English

I feel compelled to write this review because the bathrooms at this airport when I flew out this morning th Sept about am are easily the worst I have seen in my entire flying experience of ten years The ladies bathroom close to gates was not only stinky every single stall was clogged and unflushed It is disgraceful for an international airport to maintain such pathetic standards I have seen the railway stations at Tianjin better maintained There were zero staff taking care of maintaining the restrooms This being an international airport I was so horrified to see this level of callous treatment of passengers When they announced my flight would be delayed I really prayed that it wouldnt be too long The airport guys ought to be ashamed

Amsterdam to Tehran via Istanbul The worst experience ever My flights were canceled with no alternative flights offered in two of the cases Two of my flights were canceled just hours prior to the flight Buying new tickets for the same dates costed me EUR extra Despite several attempts to get more information on when I will be reimbursed to date I have no clue weeks after the canceled flight date Several emails sent with no response back yet Unbelievably poor customer communication In one case I received a single Turkish only email hours prior to my flight

Disgusting airport One terminal is nowhere near the rest of the airport No shuttle either You can either walk km in the heat with your luggage near the road and through a car park or take a bus for double the city fare No drinking fountains All prices are more than double the same restaurantscoffeeshops in town WiFi is for lounge members only or you have to pay for it Even at Starbucks you get an hour of WiFi for the price of coffees which is already double the price of Starbucks in the city

Confins looks like a bus station rather than an international airport Poor services bad signage extremely high prices and depressing overcrowded waiting areas close to the boarding gates Catering and shopping options inside security area are very limited so make sure to replenish yourselves before proceeding to it

What a horrible airport In all of my years traveling for business I have never seen such a disorganized mess of an airport Security line literally out the door No one seemed to know what was going on TSA was terrible I wish I could avoid this airport If it wasnt for work I would never fly here again Stay away

Pula is one of my favourite airports to arrive to it takes sometimes min to get through I travelled to Pula in July and return experience was as usual quick swift and enjoyed the upstairs open space Arrival in September was the same The problem was the departure in September Transavia and Ryanair flights were one hour apart causing moderate number of passengers at the airport I arrived hr min prior to flight with hand luggage only and tried to pass the security There was nobody in the queue I was refused entry since the flight was not loaded on the system and asked to wait until h prior to scheduled departure This created surge of people at the exact time causing a queue at the security check without any social distancing measures At the ticket check after I had my boarding pass scanned I was asked to present UK Visas and Immigration document self isolation declaration to the airport staff There are two issues here and I hope somebody from the airport team is reviewing these comments As a healthcare professional and on the front line of COVID I am trying to distance myself The airport queuing system is doing exactly the opposite they are preventing a free flow of passengers and creation of queues I think this is a very poor practice putting at risk staff and passengers with large numbers of people without any good reason Another issue is being asked to present UK Government document to the airport staff I am following the rules and have paperwork ready but this is nothing to do with Croatian authorities and feel this is inappropriate invasion of my privacy I am afraid I hope this is a one off and next year we are back to normal

Arrived on Windy Wednesday th Sept and am one of your bus travellers My experience of the bus shelter is always a cold piercing wind One has just got to look where it is located within the airport grounds The construction of glass panels with surround umpteen gaps like surround sound of howling and whistling makes for a very unpleasant time In particular on Windy Wednesday we had to wait a long time because our bus had been held up because of a fallen tree We were frozen but had to remain there in case the delayed bus arrived Also nobody came out to see if we were okay So why isnt the money we pay to get out of Knock used to redesign the shelter

Premium economy on Eva Air stands out for providing no perks that are now common across the premium economy sector Underwhelming and poor value for money No priority check in or boarding no welcome drink and a baggage allowance lower than offered in other carriers economy service Make sure your bag is not overweight they will charge you even if over by kg The seat has a peculiar design meaning that if your are ft approximately like myself the edge of the seat slowly digs into the back of your knees Fortunately I only had to sit on it for three hours

trust foreigners to navigate the airport on their own The whole feel of the place is very eery We both felt on edge as they monitor everything with an excessive amount of cameras watchingrecording you constantly We had to endure so many painfully long queues that seemed illogical We were getting a transfer but we had to go through the exact same processes we had already cleared hrs prior in London This airport is just sad It is such a beautiful facility that goes largely unused Largely abandoned by US Airways most of the stores close early now so that any travellers coming into the airport in the evening find virtually all food establishments and other retailers closed Many of the gates have been walled off as not necessary Its all just very disappointing for the Pittsburgh area

The airport was very crowded for the upcoming Memorial Day weekend Nonetheless there was plenty of seating at the gates and dining options ranging from sit down restaurants to fast food The terminal is bright spacious and with plenty of windows through which to see the airfield Going through security was a breeze with TSAPre The Airport WIFI is easy to connect too and fast The major drawback to this airport is the lack of bathrooms The bathrooms are small and there are only stalls in each of the mens bathrooms On a busy travel holiday this meant waiting times of about minutes Given the number of passengers that fly through the airport daily renovating andor expanding bathrooms should be considered

I had high expectations for Macau Airport none of which were met and Macau has neglected to bring an intl standard of quality to its airport Poorly lit corners abound in what amounts to three levels of cramped mediocrity In the whole terminal is a lonely down the hall Theres the obligatory McDs upstairs for finer dining but not much else Seeing the jacked up prices in these places turned me off from them An unforgiveable oversight is the lack of standardized mobile device charging Fully expecting to plug my phone into a USB port I still cant fathom what the airport admin was thinking by installing very nonstandard prong charging ports what they dubbed as wireless charging To use these youre forced to buy the local solution in the form of an adapter No worries for the has em for MOP Kudos for removing the useanywhere conveniently universal of the USB That took a special effort The personnel at MA could also use some rewiring Most obvious the airport overstaffed its confines with too much security Here there everywhere youll meet the Blueshirts who you can bet have an eye on you I interacted with a wardenesque washroom attendant who let me know my time was up by rapping the stall door barking admonitions On the way out I fingered him to take the matter to admin for further assessment Macau Airport is not merely a scaled down version of its counterpart across the pond More than that its a featureless frustrating area where youll be in a hurry to not just catch your flight but to escape the pains of being in the place

Denizli ardak Airport is a small regional airport for the city of Denizli with flights to IST SAW and Iran The airport is quite small with the ability to hold aircraft at a time Shops are scarce with cafes souvenir shops and one suitcase shop The main reason people come here is for Pamukkale which is a natural wonder The cafes are good for a quick snack but nothing more Arriving one hour before the flight should be enough as security lines are no longer than ten minutes

Having recently travelled a bit domestically in Australia I want to give a big shout out to the security team at Adelaide Airport which is in complete contrast to Melbourne In Melbourne going through security screening is about as unpleasant as it can get principally due to the staff attitude Complete opposite in Adelaide There was someone available and proactively helping people load to tubs with their carry on item being pleasant and professional about it and if something concerning detected not making the passenger feel like they are an obvious security risk

I returned home to Cape Town with my husband my year old mother and my year old twin boys on June Our flight landed just after am Passport control was overcrowded overwhelming and chaotic There was no queue for elderly people not in wheelchairs or for families with young kids I found this problematic as our kids starting having major meltdowns in the queue that was miles long We tried to call a staff member over to ask if there was any way we could avoid standing in this long queue with my kids and my mother The lady told us to come with her to the front by the counters but we had to all crawl under the metal bars to get there After a few minutes after she had spoken to her supervisor she told us that she was sorry but we had to stay in the queue as the supervisor said if he allows it for us he must allow it for everyone Shouldnt this be the norm though Making provision for families with elderly parents and young kids I found this so hard to understand and felt very frustrated at this point We had to then rejoin the queue and when I asked if my mother could at least go through a gate we were told no When i asked if my mother could sit and wait on a bench until we reached the front of the line we were told no So we all had to climb back under the metal bars to get back into the queue After having lived in many countries and after travelling through a lot of international airports I have to say that Cape Town International Airport is far far behind in terms of international standards Very disappointing to arrive home and to have this experience I am not looking forward to departing from or arriving to this airport again in future

The worst airport Ive ever been to both in Poland and abroad Rude impudent staff who think they are unknown On Thursday March I flew with my yearold autistic son from Balice to Dublin Around pm we were checking in at the conveyor belt where luggage and clothes are put in baskets A staff rudely said to my son Take off your jacket my son stood motionless I said her that he has autism and needs a slightly different approach to which she directly verbally replied that she is ignoring it The son began to get nervous circling and repeating her words it ignores She got my son to a point where he beat his head went around in circles repeated her words finally cried After years of therapy he has not been in such a state for many months

Our inbound flight from Seattle was delayed almost minutes we pushed back from the gate minutes late When we landed in Seattle we were told that we would be able to make our very tight connecting flight without issue We made it to the connecting gate at notably before the scheduled departure of our flight to Missoula Unfortunately our gate was already closed and we were informed the next flight was six hours later The staff were all unfriendly putting us in a loop of people deflecting the blame to the next people and leaving us without any options We asked for any sort of compensation for the entire day they have wasted but were told there was nothing anyone could do I genuinely pray that I never have to fly this airline again T

It all started when we checked in our luggage We arrived at the Discover counter and only saw the Business Class checkin desks Since we were flying Business we headed there A staff member standing in front told us we had to go around the corner to check in That seemed possible so we went there but it turned out to be the Economy checkin So we returned and told the staff member that we needed to check in here since we were flying Business His rude response You could have said that Well its not our job to inform himits his job to ask what class were flying It didnt get better from there The checkin agent seemed completely uninterested and at the end simply stated a number while staring at us when we didnt immediately understand what it meant We had to figure out for ourselves that he was referring to the gate The only positive experience was the lounge which was a Lufthansa lounge not a Discover one Then came boarding After scanning our tickets we walked toward the aircraft but the entrance to Business Class was still blocked because they werent ready If theyre not ready boarding shouldnt start There were passengers with mobility issues who had to stand and wait until they finally opened the section The cabin crew was okay but the welcome Prosecco was undrinkable The salmon trout tataki appetizer was absolutely disgustingit smelled awful The plane itself was old and the seats were extremely uncomfortable If youre tall or overweight good luck Breakfast was fine but Im still waiting for my apple juice The lavatories werent great eithernot at the level of other airlines Overall it was okay but for the price definitely not worth it I cant recommend it

If you like rude staff who shout at you and give instructions inconsistent with every other international airport this is the place for you I was shouted at for using the same clear plastic bag for liquids that Id used at Gatwick in both July and December The man threw a tiny bag at me and then turned his back on me Subsequently my bag was rechecked at security by another man with the type of manners that any parent of a toddler would be embarrassed by Having endured this I then discovered that half of the ladies toilets were unavailable During peak travel season A dreadful experience Id last flown from Stansted years ago and am in no hurry to relive this demeaning and inefficient experience

The setup is poor and unable to handle large numbers of travelers The flow is chaotic the officers sitting around chit chatting very few counters are open and the space is small We went thru the custom scan with all our pursesbags carryon luggages jackets and everything in our pockets There wasnt any officer managing the traffic so we had people cutting queue left right center By the time we got to the other side of the custom scan we realised that our belongings fell on the floor due to the short conveyer belt why would any airport make a conveyer belt that could only fit bags Before we could pick it up we got scolded by officers and said that we were too slow She sat in front of the monitor screen and couldve paused the conveyer belt before our belonging fell on the floor but instead she only paused it afterwards to get a chance to lash out on us After we collected our belongings we heard another yelling by the same officers aimed towards the travelers behind us

I departed from Dublin airport a few times this year and I was shocked by the aggressive and rude manner in which passengers were treated by the Airport security staff Maybe it is time to call on the Irish Tourism Board to protect tourists from this type of humiliation and abuse

In Goa domestic terminal the seating is inadequate at oclock in the morning lots of seating arrangement is in very poor condition and badly maintained For the kind of travellers that are passing through this terminal national image projection is very poor This is when sanitation staff a lady promptly came over to clean spilled coffee due to unbalanced chairs set Seating here is so close that your knees knock If these seats are unfit to use please have them replacedremoved Food offered from kiosk turned out to be stale chicken burger But was returned thankfully At the same time I would like to appreciate courteous behaviour of all individuals on duty
