would appear the baggage handlers were refusing to handle cases over kgs so the cases had to be repacked with kg been taken out and put into carry on cases Security was a quick process and we were airside within about minutes but I did have special assistance which I need due to a sprain which I got whilst on holiday Boarding was fairly quick and painless

Wagga Wagga is a regional airport serving a town of All was good except that our flight was delayed due to Sydney weather thats not an issue but the snack bar closed during the hour wait There is a soft drink vending machine but nothing for food or snacks Oddly there were instant coffee and sugar sachets on the tables but no hot water Large plasma screens whiled away the time and there were enough seats to stretch out and have a nap Its the home base of REX Regional Express Airline a snack machine and hot water would be good

I stopped at this airport on a three leg journey back from Laos with a three hour layover This airports seating options already leave a lot to be desired but when I tried to go down one floor to my gate I was turned away for security reasons I found an uncomfortable chair upstairs near my gate Flash forward to an hour before boarding time and there are tons of people sitting upstairs on the floor because were not allowed down to the gate even though were the next flight to depart Uncomfortable and frustrating Plus the aggravation of watching the entire crew go down while we werent allowed to take all the seating downstairs

A small provincial airport serving Bangkok DMG Two airlines serve the airport NOK Air and Air Asia Avoid using Air Asia if I were you A couple of food outlets selling snacks and water Well set up and very efficient I have used the airport on many occasions I get collected when I use the airport so not sure what the Taxi connections are like

With electronic boarding pass for a Delta flight to SEA USA Carryon luggage only Time from drop off at terminal to clearing security minutes Delta flight departure time pm Arrival processing time with USA passport using electronicautomated entry booth which prints your entry document with photo scan of passport and facial recognition scan Line was long and people were trying to cut into the line with resistance from people in line Delta flight arrival at pm Approximately minutes Waiting line organization could use some work on their part No contact with immigration personnel In advance paid Yucatan tourist tax and immigration processing feesfilling out forms No water stations to refill containers unreasonably expensive bottled water Finding a reliable and honest rental car agency prior to trip was difficult and only found using other peoples reviews Required car Insurance costs are misleading or intentionally hidden Some agencies refused to provide a copy of their insurance policies and prices when requested for review

My family and I experienced a great time in Krakw and thoroughly enjoyed our stay We met some wonderful people and the service anywhere we went was exceptional Unfortunately we had a bad experience at the airport when we were leaving the country The security staff were extremely rude and almost barked orders at everyone What a shame A bad end to a great holiday I really do feel the behaviour of these guards should be looked at and reviewed
The bathrooms all over the airport were so dirty they were like road side public bathrooms So much of international tourist comes to this city and state What an embarrassment

Very small airport which should simplify arrivals but disastrous transportation options to reach the city Taxi service is limited we had to wait in line for minutes to get one There is no Uber option and limited information on bus services if you do not want to wait for a taxi forever

I am writing to express my frustration with a recent security check at your airport While traveling with my two young children security staff threw away all the milk I brought for them They couldnt explain why and struggled with English making communication difficult As a parent it was distressing to have essential items taken without proper justification Thank you for your attention to this matter

The baggage claim carousels had incorrect labeling about which flight they were serving There was a hoard of people waiting for all the rental cars We had checked in online but there was no way to utilize this

The experience starts with the airline asking us to be at the airport hours before the flight yet they do not open the check in both until hrs before the flight The airline asked me to check some hand luggage as I am boarding and hand me a receipt Once I land I wait for my hand luggage and it doesnt come out so I asked the people unloading where it was to which they respond to talk to the air line company We go to their booth and there is no one there so we call and they do not pick up After searching the airport and talking to people for hrs I find out the airline company only opens the booth when they have flights so if your flight lands and they do not have flights you cannot reach them They also do not pick up the phone unless you call in certain hours The next day I manage to reach them on the phone and after wasting hrs of my time they say there is nothing they can do since they are only a call center to book flights even though thats the only number on their website The only thing they say is that I had to report my lost luggage in person at the airport but after spending another hrs that morning looking and waiting for their booth or ticket counter to open they did not After failing to reach their booth to report my lost luggage I had to take my next flight After landing I call them again and they refused to connect me to their airport department We also tried to send emails to them and the only response we got was to call or go to the airport in person The next day we have some local family go to the airport and try to make a report and even after talking to us on the phone they refused to accept the report saying we had to appear in person even though we had already left They also claimed we had messed up by not reporting this so the bag was too far lost but they werent even available or answering calls Worst flight company ever I would not recommend it It seems to me that asking us to check in a hand bag last minute was on a half empty flight was a scam to steal it so be careful if you choose to fly with them Plenty of other companies are available for the same price

This airport is one of the worst airports I have been into in my life Disability with my mum pushing me in a wheelchair no help whatsoever they could see us struggling and just say staring at us but helped everyone else Didnt help us get the bags or anything Airport is tiny crowded No room to do anything especially with a wheelchair Gates are all squeezed in with the restaurants and cafe so your standing next to people getting food while their in a queues at their gate number No food available for allergy sufferers Special assistance people have to wait until the whole plane gets on first then they get on last even though your put at the front to get on first Makes no sense Theres a reason why its called special assistance Jet woman did not care at all that we were distressed stood there like a wet lemon Not sure why she was there Absolutely no staff to look after the ones needing special assistance Very unorganized and unprofessional Wont be returning back to this airport

I am military so I am constantly flying and I have got to say this is the worst airline I have ever flown without question The seats were incredibly uncomfortable the staff was very rude We were delayed hours because our radars stopped working midair and we had to turn around and come back As soon as there is an issue instead of resolving it they delay a whole day so the crew can get their per diem money Food wasnt bad though

Kefalonia airport is really too small Although it was quiet when we travelled and we were able to get through to departures quickly I can see things might be very different if there are more than flights departing Once through the lack of seating was evident and the facilities very scant There is a small duty free shop with a very limited stock The only refreshment facilities consist of a small kiosk with not a lot of choice of anything and rather expensive There was a huge queue for it My wife reported the ladies toilets as appalling with no means of drying her hands after washing them I can vouch that the facilities in the gents were distinctly insalubrious It was a relief to get on the aircraft to depart even for this we had to trail hundreds of yards across hot tarmac in the heat of the afternoon to get to it

We booked with Finnair because weve appreciated the quality of this company for almost a decade Turns out that most of their recent flights are operated by Wideroe On all our flights operated by Wideroe all our flights have been delayed and this time was the worst We had a short connection in Finland to get us to our holiday destination The Wideroe flight departed min late when the boarding started on time We had to run to our gate and barely made it Our luggages didnt and they only managed to get our luggages to our hotel on the rd day when there were flights to that destination everyday We had to buy a whole new set of clothes and a new luggage to bring those clothes back on top of losing time going shopping for clothes I will stop using Finnair for SAS I dont want to take the risk of ending up on another Wideroe flight

On May th EA flight number D that was to take off at am from JFK to GYE was cancelled without warning For more than hours we were kept waiting at JFK by EA agents while the plane underwent mechanical and electrical repairs We were repeatedly assured that we will depart as soon as the plane was fixed In their first announcement EA agents announced to waiting passengers that the flight was rescheduled for pm of that day only to have it changed to pm Again the flight was rescheduled to May th at am but it failed to take off despite repeated and multiple assurances from EA agents While waiting at the boarding lounge we were forced from there to outside the security cordon so that we had to go through TSA checkin and immigration twice Throughout the day we were bounced from terminal to terminal and gate to gate We had to lug our luggage from one part of the airport to another Not only did we carry heavy luggage but some of us have disabilities medical conditions children while others are elderly which made movement around the airport torturous We endured more than hrs without food and water It was a highly stressful ordeal that EA put us through

The airplanes are very old and theres no IFE or WiFi connection The crew was kind but there are some problems with the people at counter they dont give the complete information of schedules The ticket was expensive compared with other countries because they dont offer the prices in Bolivares only in dollars But actually its the best option to travel in Venezuela The biggest problems in Maiquetia airport are from the immigration and security personal also the installations are deficient Theres no paper at bathrooms and blackouts are common

Very disappointed with Xiamen Airlines I went back to china in October and checked in two luggage bags everything went well When I came back to the USA from china things happened First they cancelled the flight then they transferred me to other airlines but only allowed me to checked in only one luggage bag And the manager on duty in the airport on that day couldnt solve the problem she seemed like just wasted my time because I didnt have time to argue as I needed to board first in order to catch the next flight to the United States She asked me to pay for the second luggage by myself which was the only way that I could do I tried to explain that I came from America with two bags she said maybe other staff made mistake and later they would do investigation then someone would contact with me However more than two weeks have passed nobody contacted me Very disappointed with this airline and I feel very angry about what they did

Kangerlussuaq is where you enter Greenland on Air Greenland flights you arrive here from Copenhagen on their A and continue on board smaller planes to towns around this massive land Airport is very relaxed on domestic flights there is no security check so you simply arrive checkin your luggage and off you go The only flight you have security check is the one to Copenhagen Terminal is very small it has couple of shops and cafes and also an outdoor terrace where anyone can enter and watch the airplanes There is only one tiny luggage belt on arrival so when A arrives its very packed and for some reason it took about half an hour for our luggage to arrive They are now expanding airports in the capital Nuuk and also in the main tourist destination Ilulissat to receive larger aircraft so future of Kangerlussuaq is a bit cloudy

Check in efficient long wait at security took almost an hour to get through Boarding unorganized despite gate agents This was the first time that I was not satisfied with a Japanese airport in years of flying to Japan

I was looking forward to using Bergerac Airport for the first time But the experience was dreadful I thought it would be much quicker to check in and go through security But it was the worst airport I have experienced There was only one person most of the time checking in the flight who was spending a ridiculous amount of time in each passenger As a frequent flyer I know of no other airport where every single carry on bag is checked in Security is over zealous checking in more detail than any other airport I have ever visited It was a horrible experience which spoilt my visit to the Dordogne

My two sons arrived on a flight in the pouring rain the flight had arrived ten minutes after the Ryanair Stansted flight had touched down So two full flights and two passport control officials trying to deal with two full flights of possibly around people I waited minutes from the time my boys flight landed to the time they got through passport control Absolutely ridiculous They stood in the pouring rain because there was no room under the hangar of an arrivals hall My sons could have flown to Bordeaux which is minutes from our home and we would have been home quicker travelling mins than me sitting in the carport for minutes waiting for them to come through Bergerac airport had better wake up and smell the coffee and realise you can not treat passengers like this They are not cattle and security checks are carried out heavily in the UK so why on earth they have to interrogate every passenger that arrives One family of four took ten minutes to answer questions Bergerac can not possibly compete with the other international airports in France unless it changes its attitude and builds a better hall for arriving passengers Their car park is being heavily invested in only to make money from people needing to park their cars there Start to invest in a better arrivals hall more staff and a better carousel for the suitcases otherwise they are going to lose passengers who would prefer to travel to Bordeaux or even Toulouse Please get your act together Bergerac

I recently flew business class on Turkish Airlines from JFK New York to Istanbul and unfortunately my experience was far from what I expected The aircraft felt outdated with uncomfortable seats The cabin temperature was unbearably high turning the entire hour flight into a sauna While the food was passable I found it below the standard of other airlines business class offerings My connecting New York to Rochester flight was canceled with no assistance from Turkish Airlines No automatic rebooking No refund or apology I had to book a sameday ticket on a different airline at my own expense just to get home Reaching customer service was a nightmare they were dismissive unhelpful and indifferent Each call ended with them simply asking me to leave feedback on their website Emails were ignored and when I finally spoke to a ground agent they were rude and uncooperative Despite multiple attempts I received no refund no compensation and no resolution This level of service is unacceptable especially for a businessclass passenger I will never fly Turkish Airlines again

I have flown through here a number of times in the past year and it is disorganised and awful The signs are often wrong they divert you to different places and the staff are rude I fly a lot and it is one of the worst airports there are many better ones in much poorer countries A leading European economy shouldnt have this kind of chaos
Nice small airport Close convenient parking Super fast customs on arrival Unfortunately the baggage process was extremely slow It took minutes to get my suitcase

Lagos to Accra From my experience today at Arik Air I can describe the airline as being terribly inefficient and best avoided The flight was delayed first for hours with excuses of the plane developing a fault Later a staff came to tell us after hours that the plane was now on ground and they were running some checks on it After another mins another staff came to tell us that actually the plane has not yet landed and they will give us an update in about minutes time No one is telling us anything and so we do not know whether we will still travel tonight or not On informing someone about my predicament I was told I made a mistake by buying an Arik Air ticket that this is their usual practice I would not advise anyone to travel with this airline

Rude employee and unhelpful My elderly mum had priority ticket and needs support walking I wanted to help her boarding but we got sent back queuing because I didnt have priority ticket Ive asked the guy at the gate to help my mum he replied she is not my mum Im not helping So we went back to the end of the line What a disgraceful attitude towards elderlies This is a young guy who needs to learn how to speak and act with people Unfortunately he doesnt wear a badge so I dont know his name

My travel through Grenoble airport operated by Vinci was the worst experience in all my many years of travelling Having checked the reviews after using Grenoble as a route to the Alps in February I see it continues to get the same bad reviews as six years ago I suspect injuries would be highly likely in an emergency situation due to overcrowding We were standing for more than hours to get through security Vinci have to have passengers standing because otherwise they would have spend money to more than double the size of the departure terminal There is literally not enough floor space to allow passengers to sit down for the flights they schedule through the airport on Saturdays

In the middle of the trip I experienced very bad headache and a sudden loss of consciousness My husband asked for assistance but despite the urgency of the situation the FA who attended to me was not prepared to offer any assistance He was just there watching me Fortunately one copassenger was very kind to assist me until I felt better and until we left the aircraft About the situation I email the airline x to file a complaint but till now I didnt receive any feedback from them

Ive only flown into Hobart once and out of Tasmania via Launceston so my comments will be limited to the arrival side Virgin Blue passengers now get to use a baggage carousel basically a long conveyor belt however the baggage pickup area is very small and quickly became crowded even though my Virgin Blue flight wasnt very full It was rainy when I arrived so I wasnt too keen on the lack of jetways but it did allow my flight to empty quite quickly as we had the use of two doors I like Hobarts onsite car rental unlike Launceston but the separate rental car terminal shared by several companies was very small and was too quite crowded

I was traveling with a family of people including children from London to Phuket on May I chose this airline because of the departure and arrival times at the destination I really wanted to land there in the evening and only these airlines had such a flight on that day I wanted us to be able to skip the jet lag Unfortunately for reasons unknown to us our flight was canceled and the next one was hours later We lost our prepaid airport transfer overnight hotel stay and landed in Thailand at am instead of the one day before evening I filed a feedback on the Oman air website but unfortunately no one has responded to it yet Ive made calls to customer service this week and each time I get the answer that someone will respond to my comment tomorrow Additionally one of the consultants shouted at me on the phone and when I asked for his name and to talk to someone above him he put me on hold and ended my call after minutes So far I have used Qatar Airways for such distances and I have never encountered anything like this

Went to information for some help women standing around talking Didnt even stop when I stood there waiting for someone to acknowledge me Then when I asked the question the just pointed towards the cafe where I had already been and asked So unhelpful and uninterested is an understatement Actually I found that rude Maybe they should try a bit harder to help someone instead of having a paid mothers meeting

Cusco to Lima My flight was delayed and I was not notified I found out when I checked the departure screen Because of the delay I missed my connection flight which according to them was not their faultproblem I talked to the supervisor and she was trying to not assume responsibility Plus they do not follow they own policies Now Im stuck in Lima

The guards on the entrance are so rude he would even raise voice which was unnecessary imagine having a super early flight where you still feel sleepy someone random would shout about the luggages I knew what to do with it I fly all the time and there were absolutely no need for him to be so disrespectful

I didnt have high expectations from Malindo Air but despite this my flight was a disappointment on various fronts New Years Eve is not a busy time to fly and as expected the flight was only full The crew made a good first impression but the flaws started appearing early in the flight Both lavatories had not a drop of soap in them and the crew confirmed they have no soap at all The temperature inside the cabin was very cold and if this wasnt bad enough the air conditioning was blowing at full force This was true even once we landed and waited to disembark The onboard meals are reasonably priced but they come with only one a ml water The menu doesnt display prices for water bottles only soft drinks The cabin was clean and the crew provides good service

The airport looks worn and uninviting Signage is abysmal and staff are just not interested in the flying customers Departures are better than Arrivals You end up walking literal miles This trip return from Fiji was like the airport didnt want to see us The auto kiosk scanning did not work meaning having to go to end of line of human checking There is no joy in Sydney airport It was far superior in the recent past When you exit and look for taxi it is difficult to find Uber gets precedence and is very slow

Prince George to Vancouver I thought to support a small business The free checked bag is cool as is going directly to Vancouver south where my car is parked however the min delay on a sunny day I dont like to complain but time is money We all want to get to our destination we shouldnt be delayed

Through Goiania on a trip from Sao Paolo Small regional airport with surprisingly high number of flights on what appear to be only domestic routes Arrivals experience good walked from plane to terminal and out within minutes of leaving the plane On departure very straightforward I would recommend not going airside until necessary there are no facilities at all apart from one snack bar insufficient seating and very crowded as in fact the whole place was Easy to find a taxi There are plenty of cashpoints as well but these are outside the terminal on the kerbside road Also a small viewing gallery upstairs

Milano to Havana with bluexpress part of Blue Panorama Airlines Very old aircraft with little leg room and bad service We asked for a place closest to the front and they put us in exactly in the last seat we were among the first to check in with a very bad smell of toilet since the very beginning of the flight Other side effects no storage for hand luggage as it is all occupied for the safety equipment The staff were unfriendly and unpleasant

Kept on delaying but passengers were kept in the dark Announcements made only in Korean language til we have to ask ourselves what was going on when the flight will be departing etc Supposed to be a memorable family day trip to Jeju but got ruined at the end of the day Thanks to Tway

Absolutely horror experience They let you wait in the queue for more than hour with months old baby without stroller We asked twice if we please can go to the front and they told us we dont do this here you need to be in the queue In the security they obliged me to take out every single toy from My back pack and touched it

Frankly in shock after going through this airport times better to ferry to Athens instead and take a flight from there Airport authorities screaming at passengers to get on the plane pulling people out of line to charge them arbitrary amounts for additional baggage fees that has happened at no other airport with the same airline and then denying that the fees were paid and demanding money again People were sitting next to the bathroom on the floor in the stairwell crammed into the upstairs patio because there are no chairs anywhere else The bathrooms had no toilet paper or soap This was really really horrible

Never travel to Perpignan on a Sunday if you can help it There is only one bus no which goes about twice a day from the airport and shuttle buses which used to take you to Perpignan station no longer run at the moment I travelled in June You would have to check on this but they were not running when we were in Perpignan Be careful with taxis they run on a meter and are quite expensive We paid over euros to get to Collioures about half an hour drive we shared the cost with two other people who were going the same way During the week buses are much more frequent and perhaps the shuttle buses work during the peak season It would be easier to fly to Carcasonne transport seems to be better from there

I had another unfortunate flying experience on Rouge from YYZ to Miami due to a cancelled Delta flight Paid a premium booking a same day which is fine however I booked a comfort ticket and was given row D I boarded zone as one of the first passengers to board in the zone and was told I would have to check my bag I asked if it was a gate check and they said yes you check it here and it goes to the carousel not gate check by any airline definition Sure enough I arrive at my seat and the luggage bin is empty and remained so for the flight I asked the flight attendant why this constantly happens and she said we are volunteers before the flight and dont get paid By itself its really not a big issue but when you are flying times per week waiting an hour in every city is frustrating when there is capacity for bags on the plane I flew about times of total flights last year on Rouge and each and every time there is some kind of service issue not too mention I was for on time vs delays out of a flights on Delta this flight was delayed for over an hour Sad to see this airline deteriorate since the pandemic

Extremely bad climate control Bad in many aspects Crowded Rude and unrespectful security and passport control Prices in restaurants free shops and any merchandise price in the airport is extremely high A simple sandwich will cost you Free shops are charging you much higher than the product cost you anywhere else on this planet Im shocked that this is allowed to happen and airport authorities allowing this Be careful and keep this in mind

Completely unprofessional They refuse to give the money back and offer no choice but accepting their lousy vouchers only to keep cancelling the flights Briefly they receive money from the customers and transform it into virtual money that you never get the chance to use because they keep cancelling Avoid it by all means
My flight arrived at around am The airport was dead yet bags took forever to come out The airport was clean though There was minimal signage

The flight was alright on time and service during the flight was good However afterwards communication with their customer support was the worst experience ever Simply the customer team brings shame to the company and I dont know if they have any supervisor over their team I asked for simple request but they refer each time new email or refuse to work via phone call and simply dont get the work done So Id not recommend anyone to use this airline as you are highly likely to engage with this terrible customer support team

I use this airport to get to and from work Flight at the start from Cairns and a flight from TSV to Cairns Because I just missed a flight to Cairns at I had to wait hrs for the next flight to Cairns with Qantas Cannot check my luggage in with Qantas as no one is there have to sit near the the strand cafe bar as there is not one shop outside of security to buy a book etc Would have to be one of the most boring airports ever Certainly about time the airport requires an upgrade

Concerned about the COVID safety of this flight Passengers were requested in English to board by seat row numbers eg etc which is sensible Unfortunately the majority of the passengers were young Khmer men who do not understand English The consequence was serious overcrowding in the tunnel I was trapped there shoulder to shoulder with other passengers for at least minutes To compound my concerns I understand that Khmer people returning to Cambodia are not required to obtain a COVID negative test prior to flying unlike foreigners such as myself In addition to the poor boarding process the plane was almost full and being a short haul flight the seats were small and close together Despite SilkAir being owned by Singapore airlines they gave not adopted the high standards operated by Singapore Airlines One must also question the wisdom of serving a meal where masks are of course removed on a flight with only a minute duration

Clean and modern when it was inaugurated maybe years ago this airport is showing its age The large arching windows meant to let in light into the main ticketingcheckin areas are perpetually filthy Checkin area usually not too crowded especially with the de facto demise of Varig Airlines and de jure demise of Air Madrid but lines can vary widely by airline and time of day There is one line to get into the boarding area and at times the airport folks will now allow you in until a certain time which makes no sense since you will just be sitting in the boarding area Pretty boring airport for a long wait Food and shopping alternatives are limited and nearly nonexistent once you go through security Competency of airport staff uneven at best Wait for luggage can vary widely but usually not too bad I have arrived only on domestic flights so cannot comment on immigrationcustoms procedures I departed once on an international flight with domestic stops en route and the only difference for boarding was having to take off my shoes and show my passport

I dont know who decided to add a worker before the controls who is there to be there controlling if the passengers have all the required documents I flew to Italy with my son Covid pass boarding pass passports ok except the mandatory online form for the Italian authorities I almost missed my flight my son had a panic because the woman from security thought that my fpdleu form was not completely ok I did it again in front of her but she rejected the new one Finally she called somebody who told her to let us go Very bad experience conflict stress and frustration and running crazily to catch the plane After that stopping to show the boarding pass again and again in a really pathetic ritual with pathetic security control staff I will avoid this airport in the future

I was looking on Turkish Airlines website for a return flight from Istanbul to Diyarbakir The outward flight at the time I wanted was on Ajet Although shown in the Turkish Airlines computer it made me go to Ajet site to book So I did that and then came back to Turkish Airlines to book my return ticket Entering the aircraft was like stepping back in time Old fashioned ceiling and wall panels small luggage bins no video screens After takeoff there was a line of people waiting for the toilet until the crew realized it had been locked during departure but had not been unlocked after takeoff A Turkish Airlines cart was brought through the cabin from which cold snacks and soft drinks were available for sale I bought a sandwich and drink One bite of the sandwich told it was cold dry and stodgy I looked inside and as you can see in the photo there was a miniscule amount of butter maybe not even butter on both sides of the bread It was undoubtedly the worst catering I have had from Turkish Airlines in years flying on them Later I saw what were obviously hot crew meal entrees being taken to the rear galley I hope they at least had something good to eat Adding the cost of my sandwich and drink I paid more on Ajet than for my flight back on Turkish Airlines The crew were polite with a few smiles One of the crew uniforms was navy blue and green another all red and a third all grey I only saw three of the crew The recorded announcements were clear and understandable but live ones were at double speed and mostly unintelligible Credit where credit is due the flight departed on time and arrived slightly early I had worried about this when I saw that the preceding Tehran flight on the same aircraft was over nine hours delayed Will I fly Ajet again Probably not unless there is no other option

One of the worst experiences ever in a major airport There was no one in the immigration at gates F Orly building h of waiting to have a single policeman for or flights departing from this hall and of course they had to start with passengers with priority so additional minutes of waiting Never in my life I could imagine an airport with no immigration officers even in the worst airports in the world Once the immigration passed gates area is still under construction no wifi and very little number of electric plugs So if you are unlucky and have a flight departing from Orly hall F take everything you need in advance

I was sceptical after reading the reviews but I could not be happier with the flight Staff were polite and attentive left on time and landed mins earlier Airplane was new and very clean I will use them again Only issue I had is the website that shows I know errors and had to call to ask for clarifications and also to receive the confirmation email

The food and beverage selections are appalling For a state that has some amazing wineries and craft breweries there are no options to purchase any of these great things at the airport Come on promote and celebrate the amazing tourist potential of this state rather than sell bland mass produced selections Also this must be worse airport in Australia to charge your devices there must be only powerpoints hidden in really obscure places Very disappointed with this airport

From inception at the gate we had bad feelings Gate agents were very rude and could not care less what passengers were asking They informed us that the plane was parked on the other side of the Airport near freight and repairs We had to be transferred there by bus We each had to walk down several flights of stairs carrying our carryons and hand helds Then walk up the stairs to board the plane with NO HELP We sat there on the plane for hours and were told several lies by the pilot such as we are waiting to be released by air traffic control and waiting for new crew members They finally said we are leaving and promised us free Drinks which never happened We had asked and tried to use WiFi and were told its broken This is a very unprofessional Airline customers are obviously not important and we will never use them again

Had very low expectations which were surpassed somewhat My flight was delayed for departure by over mins Announcements were made in Arabic and Italian mostly with only a short welcome in English so not sure if they ever explained the reason for the delay Despite a scheduled one hour stop in Rome and short flight a modest breakfast was served with a croissant and small yougurt Surprised they severed anything We needed up getting to Milan just a bit late and my checked bag came out in a reasonable time period Overall Tunis Air delivered for what I thought was a fair price

This has got to be the worst airport in terms of BorderCustoms that I have ever seen There were two immigration officers that took over one hour to process one Ryanair flight They were deliberately slow unfriendly and rude officer chatting on the phone Just unbelievably poor

The airport check in process is a nightmare The weighing machines at the check in counters have kg error I trust this is a planned scam I know this because all my bags were weighed more than the actual weight I had an international connection from New Delhi and when my bags wemore weighed again at the Delhi International airport they weighed kg less for each bag If the payment for excess baggage exceeds INR than the payment machine stops working and the passenger is asked to pay in cash Then the invoice printer stops working So at the end of the day you will be wrongly charged for excess baggage weight you will need to pay in cash and dont expect to get any receipts for the payment Being elite or business class customers will not change the unprofessional and frustrated attitude of the airport check in staff

Chronic organisation when two planes arrived it took almost an hour to get through passport control On return the famous Gallic shrug came to the fore with noone seemingly interested or caring about chaos and delays Police attitude was unbelievable with their insistence of accompanying people visiting the toilets The joy of flying into German and British airports

I showed up to MLU for my morning flight I was there in plenty of time and I have flown out of Monroe multiple times A family in front of me was buying tickets for a flight tomorrow I waited and waited Apparently the woman at the counter the only one working thought I was with the family Once she realized I wasnt with the family she tried to get someone to help me but no one was there I waited long enough to miss the time to check a bag Finally a man came to help but immediately gave me a spill about being on time so I can check my bag next time I was polite but Ive done this many times Lets just say the woman working was not happy with him She tried to help me and I dont think it was her fault that no one was there to help her I had to wait from to catch the next flight I guess it is a small airport so theres not many staff I think the problem could be prevented

The staff is probably overworked The sentry security at the gates are rude At the security area they speak to you rudely asking you to remove your watches put your bags in separate bags etc I think a lesson in speaking politely is needed We understand you deal with an immense load of people but this is hospitality sector

This is the worst airport I have ever been to As soon as you are dropped at departures you are hounded with men pretending to work for the airport to try and get tips for wheeling your luggage to the airport door for you When you refuse they will become aggressive Be advised some will be dressed in official looking uniforms others in clothes resembling someone travelling I raised with airport staff and was met with a vacant stare Enhanced security checks are in place I understand this is a Turkey wide thing and not just related to Dalaman The prices inside the airport are obscene Be prepared to pay a minimum of for a burger king meal and for a soft drink There are very little places to sit whilst waiting and then when your gate is called you will have your hand luggage opened and every item spread across a table to be checked by security This is by far the worst airport I have ever been to

A truly horrible airport with a makeshift immigration area that has simply sliced the departures area in half Unfriendly security staff and once airside there are very limited facilities not to mention seating areas in abundance The cafe and bar and shops are mostly all manned by eastern European migrants and the actual gate areas are a relic from the s around seats for plus passengers They extended and remastered this airport shortly after they culled tourism There once was a lovely open air rooftop viewing area which then became a glassed in lounge now even that has gone Couldnt wait to leave the depressing airport for the last time

My flight from Calgary was delayed due to a mechanical error I had a connection to Anchorage that I barely made due to the delay My disappointment was that I had paid for a premium seat and they gave it away to someone else They gave me a middle seat and told me I would have to call to get reimbursed for a credit That is very poor customer service Heads up the premium seats have more leg room but sit across and are narrow The inflight movie app did not work on my iPhone s nor did it work on my brand new lap top I would avoid this airline in the future

I arrived here on a Jetstar flight from Brisbane with my year old mother who needed a wheelchair This latter was provided by Jetstar but then we were on our own to travel from the plane to the baggage area not an easy task as signage was almost nonexistent and some doors along the way were locked necessitating a rather anxious wait until an official with a key card arrived The only lift in the main area of the terminal was broken down although there was no sign about this just a loose flapping internal wall that was evident when the doors opened This discouraged all users including us In the end we ditched the wheelchair and proceeded slowly down the escalator There was a total lack of information signage or assistance of any kind in this outdated dirty terminal I intend to avoid this airport in future

Hanoi to Macau with Air Macau and not very impressed with cabin crew and safety procedures I fly a lot and have used many different airlines It appeared that the staff were not interested in doing their job properly The passenger in front of me never put on his seat belt once take off and landing included and not one member of staff checked or asked him to do so The woman in the isle seat next to me had bags which she held on her knee and at her feet a flight attendant came to answer her question about how long the flight would take but negated to request the passenger to put her luggage in the stow compartment during take off and landing Some seats remained reclined during decent I will mention and this may reflect on the airport but once we were off the aircraft we were put onto a bus to take us to the gate as the door opened there was a lot of pushing and shoving from passengers to be the first one off and through to passport check I had to hold onto a rail so that I would not be pushed over I have never experienced anything like this This airline could much better if improvements are made in regard to the above

I had a terrible experience with Nouvelair on the flight BJ I booked a flight for AM on the I received an email they reschedule the flight to be PM without given any options After the flight a hours minutes delay so instead of arriving at am I arrived at pm Better to avoid this company whatever the cost
